name: BoxPilot: Remote for MAG
description:
BoxPilot turns your iPhone into a fast, modern remote for Infomir MAG set-top boxes, over your home Wi-Fi.

• A one-handed remote: large D-pad, volume and channel rockers, playback and colour keys, with a light haptic tap on every press.
• Phone volume buttons: change the TV volume without looking.
• Type on the TV: letters appear on the TV as you type. No more hunting across an on-screen keyboard for searches, URLs and logins.
• Touchpad: move the pointer, click and scroll on boxes that support a mouse.
• Macros: chain keys into one tap, like "back out to the menu" or "skip three channels".
• Quick actions: jump straight to favourite channels, or pin the keys you use most.
• Finds your box automatically. Works with boxes that use MAGic Remote pairing and boxes that use a Remote control password.
• Private by design: no accounts, no ads, no tracking. Everything stays on your iPhone.

Free to download with a 1-day free trial. After that, one purchase unlocks BoxPilot for good. No subscription.

Requires a MAG box with Remote control switched on (Settings → System settings → Remote control), on the same Wi-Fi as your iPhone.

BoxPilot is an independent app, not affiliated with or endorsed by Infomir. MAG is a trademark of Infomir.

name: reservoirAI
description:
reservoirAI brings your well-log workspace to iPhone and iPad. Sign in with your existing reservoirAI account, review every well in your portfolio, inspect corrected curves, compare petrophysics, and carry a defensible screening summary into the field.

NATIVE WELL INTELLIGENCE
• Portfolio dashboard with wells, analysis status, viability and model economics
• Search, filter and rank wells by recovery, NPV or recency
• Works with your reservoirAI server, including self-hosted deployments

LAS-NATIVE WELL LOGS
• Multi-track log viewer with depth axis, formation tops and hydrocarbon zones
• Corrected and original curves side by side
• Choose up to four curves from the channels in your file
• Drag the log to inspect depth and curve values
• Zoom the interval to the upper, middle or lower quarter

PETROPHYSICS & CROSSPLOTS
• Porosity, water saturation, net pay, net-to-gross, shale volume and permeability
• Interactive neutron-density, resistivity-porosity, gamma-density and sonic crossplots
• Correlation, R², trend line and point inspection by depth
• Formation-top and zone detail tables

AI-ASSISTED SCREENING
• Rules-based signals grounded in your processed data
• AI agent predictions, confidence and review flags
• Similar-well context and next-step guidance
• Clear disclaimers so AI output stays a screening input

REPORTS & EXPORT
• Branded PDF well report generated on-device
• Decision summary, key metrics, petrophysics, zones, tops and methodology
• Share reports through Files, Mail, AirDrop and other apps
• Download the corrected LAS for use in your interpretation suite

DEVICE-FIRST STORAGE
• Original and corrected LAS files live in the app’s private on-device archive
• Your server receives a temporary copy for ML processing and removes its copy after the results are saved
• Cached curves, crossplots, AI output and reports stay available without the server
• Control server cleanup and remove all local files from Settings

UPLOAD FROM ANYWHERE
• Choose one or more .las files from Files, iCloud Drive or a storage provider
• Live upload and analysis status
• Secure token authentication with Keychain-backed sessions

BUILT FOR THE FIELD
• Universal app for iPhone and iPad
• Dark, high-contrast interface for rig, office and travel
• No advertising, no cross-app tracking

REQUIREMENTS
You need an active reservoirAI account and network access to your reservoirAI server. Your organization’s server controls storage, retention and team access. The public server is app.americancode.org; self-hosted HTTPS servers are supported.

reservoirAI is a decision-support tool. Volumes, EUR, NPV, ROI and AI recommendations are estimates. Validate log repairs, petrophysical models, economics and all AI output with a qualified professional before capital commitment.

name: Sideline Teams
description:
Sideline is the team app for youth soccer coaches and families. One screen for where to be, when to be there and what to wear.

Free for teams. No ads. Ever.

FOR FAMILIES
- See the next game or practice the second you open the app
- What to wear, be-there-by time, field and what to bring, all on one card
- Tap Going or Not going. Done.
- Reminders before every game and practice, automatically
- Instant notice when something is canceled or moved
- Message the coaches privately. No group chat noise.
- Your phone number stays hidden from other parents
- Skills reports for your kid with drills to do at home
- Full Spanish, set per family

FOR COACHES
- Create a team in a minute. Sign in with your phone number, no passwords.
- Add players with name, jersey number and birth year
- Build the schedule once. Families get the details and reminders.
- See who is going at a glance
- Post announcements to the whole team
- Cancel or move a game and everyone knows right away
- Send skills reports with at-home drills to each family
- Post results and a Player of the game card families can share

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- Teams are invite only. Only the coach or team manager can invite, by text.
- Parents can only message the coaches. No parent-to-parent group chat.
- Kids never have accounts. Coaches enter what the team needs.
- We do not sell data, show ads or track you.

TRY IT FIRST
Tap Try a sample team on the first screen to look around. No sign-in needed.

Questions? Visit sideline-teams.vercel.app/support

name: MachineDeck
description:
MachineDeck turns your iPhone and iPad into a pocket retro-computing lab.

Boot the built-in 6502 self-test to see a complete machine come up in seconds. Run FreeDOS 1.3 through an embedded x86 WebAssembly machine, or import your own NES ROMs and play with an on-screen D-pad, A/B buttons, Select, Start and save states.

Linux without a cloud
Pull Alpine, Debian, Kali or Linux Mint images and run them inside an x86 guest. MachineDeck explains which images are console-only, which include a desktop, and how much guest memory each one needs — so you pick the right base the first time.

Everything stays on your device. No account, no ads, no analytics, and no developer server. ROMs and images you import remain in MachineDeck's own storage until you delete them.

Built with a native 6502 core, a WebAssembly x86 machine and a SwiftUI shell designed for both iPhone and iPad.

name: 5 Card Flash
description:
Five cards a day. A city that lights up when you learn.

5 Card Flash is SAT and PSAT practice, played like a hand of cards. Every day the Dealer deals you five questions, Math or Reading and Writing or a mix, written to the skills on the digital SAT and PSAT/NMSQT. Finish all five and today counts.

GET A CLUE AFTER EVERY ANSWER
Answer a card and your coach responds right away: the Strategist for Reading and Writing, the Powerhouse for Math. Get it wrong and you see why that choice doesn't work, plus the step that cracks it.

MISS IT. WIN IT BACK.
A skill you miss comes back the next day as a new question. Win it then, and again on day 5 and day 12, and it's mastered.

CHIPS YOU KEEP FOR GOOD
Earn ten mastery chips, from White to Diamond, for study days, recall and skills mastered. Chips are permanent badges. Nothing is bet, wagered or bought, and a chip you earn is never taken away.

STREAKS WITH A SAFETY NET
Three days in a row earns your first Wild Card, then another at 7, 14 and 21 days in a row, and so on. Hold up to two, and each one covers a day you miss.

RAISE A COMPANION
Pick Quill, Pearl or Volt after your first hand. Every study day powers it up, with a new form at 7, 14 and 28 days. Extra hands can't rush it, and it never goes backward.

A WEEKLY TABLE
See where your daily play would place you at a sample weekly table of twenty seats, scored on your first hand each day, so showing up counts more than grinding.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account and no sign-in. No ads, nothing to buy and no tracking. Your progress stays on your iPhone, and you can save a backup file whenever you like.

5 Card Flash is not affiliated with or endorsed by the College Board. SAT and PSAT/NMSQT are trademarks of the College Board. All questions are original practice written for 5 Card Flash.

name: AdScope: Revenue Dashboard
description:
Your AdMob portfolio, clearly presented on your iPhone.

AdScope brings estimated earnings, trends, and ad-delivery metrics into a native dashboard for app publishers.

SEE THE NUMBERS THAT MATTER

• Daily charts for 7 days, 30 days, or the current month.

BUILT FOR YOUR IPHONE

READ-ONLY GOOGLE CONNECTION

TRY IT FIRST
Explore the clearly labeled sample-data demo without a subscription or Google connection.

ONE SUBSCRIPTION, NO ADS
AdScope Monthly is $4.99/month in the US, with local pricing shown before purchase. An active subscription is required to connect Google and view your own reports. All dashboard features are included. There is no free plan for real reports and no advertising. The localized price is shown before purchase. AdScope currently covers AdMob Network reporting. Estimated earnings may be delayed and are not finalized payments. Third-party mediation earnings, policy decisions, and app approval status are not included.

AdScope is independent and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Google. AdMob is a trademark of Google LLC.

name: Aerilo
description:
Aerilo is one button for a lighter photo library.

Tap Breathe. Aerilo looks through your photos and videos and gathers the ones you probably don't need. You review them, tick or untick, and decide what goes.

WHAT IT FINDS
• Exact duplicates: the same picture saved more than once. Aerilo keeps one of each.
• Similar shots: pictures taken seconds apart that look nearly the same. Aerilo suggests the best one to keep.
• Old screenshots: screenshots older than 30 days.
• From WhatsApp: pictures and videos WhatsApp saved to your library, largest first.
• Screen recordings: easy to forget, and often large.
• Largest videos: the ones taking the most space.
Nothing personal is ticked for you: not videos, not recordings, not anything from a conversation.

YOU STAY IN CHARGE
• Nothing is deleted until you review it and tap Delete, and the system asks you to confirm.
• Deleted items stay in Recently Deleted for 30 days, so you can bring them back.
• While it works, Aerilo says what it is doing, step by step.

PRIVATE
• Photos are compared on your device. Nothing is uploaded.
• No account, no analytics, no ads.

A RECORD YOU CAN SHARE
Everything Aerilo looked at and everything you asked it to delete is written to a log on your device. Share it with support or keep it as a record.

ALSO IN THE APP
• A Device screen with free storage, memory in use, processor load, temperature, battery and Low Power Mode.
• A Home Screen widget with free storage and memory in use.
• Siri and Shortcuts: "Tidy my photos with Aerilo".

GOOD TO KNOW
Aerilo for iPhone, iPad, Apple TV and Apple Vision Pro tidies photos and storage. It does not speed up your device or manage other apps; these systems do that by themselves.

Aerilo is free and open source.

name: Affluo
description:
Not sure what to do tonight? Open Affluo and instantly see where the crowd is right now.

Affluo is your real-time guide to nightlife and venues around you. Whether you're deciding where to go tonight, planning one of your upcoming evenings, or already standing outside a spot wondering if it's worth going in, Affluo gives you the answer in seconds.

DECIDE WHAT TO DO TONIGHT (REAL-TIME):
• Live Map & Heatmap: See at a glance which neighborhoods, bars, pubs, clubs, and beach clubs are buzzing right now.
• Proximity-Verified Reports: Live updates from people actually on-site (within 200m of the venue), backed by a Trust Score system for reliable crowd info.
• Favorite Alerts: Save your favorite spots and get push notifications when the vibe picks up.

PLAN YOUR UPCOMING NIGHTS:
• Plan Your Night: Organizing tomorrow or this weekend? Choose your day, time slot (Happy Hour, Dinner, or Club & Night), desired vibe, and venue type to find the best spots for that moment.
• 7x24 Hourly Trends: Check typical peak hours for each venue so you know exactly when a place gets busy.

HANDY IN EVERY SITUATION:
• Already outside a club or bar and unsure if there's a crowd inside? Check Affluo on the spot: if it's lively, step right in—if it's quiet, pick a better place nearby.
• Smart Filters & Search: Filter venues by category, timeframe, or high crowd levels.
• Add Venues & Earn Badges: Add missing bars, clubs, or local festivals on the map, share live updates, and climb the community leaderboard.

No more dead nights or wasted trips. Live your city at its best with Affluo!

name: Aipexpro
description:
Thanks for opening AIPEXPRO. We keep refining this Skill Compost so unread learning feels lighter to work through, and we welcome a note anytime something in the pit, dig flow, ferment stages, or garden could feel clearer for you.

Unread collections stall easily—articles, courses, podcasts, and notes pile up until they feel heavy and unfinished. AIPEXPRO turns that backlog into a compost pile metaphor you can actually finish: drop materials in, let them ferment across stages, dig one shovel at a time, and watch digested work sprout in the garden instead of vanishing inside endless bookmarks. Home keeps the pit stage visible so you always know what still needs attention versus what has already been worked, without turning learning into a guilt streak counter.

Capture titles, notes, and domains from the Command Dock, then open Dig for focused sessions that move items through ferment without forcing a marathon. Browse the pile, Ferment Timeline, Sprout Garden, Gap Finder, Insights, Domains, and Session History whenever you want a calmer map of coverage. Notices surface gentle reminders; Settings hold honest toggles, export, and wipe so the vault stays under your control. The whole product is offline-first SwiftUI on your iPhone—no tab bar clutter, just a dock that routes you to the desk you need when you need it.

Private by design: no account, no ads, no tracking, and no cloud upload of your learning pile. Materials, digs, sprouts, domains, and preferences stay on this iPhone. AIPEXPRO only helps you compost skill work—it never sells your data, never requires a login before you can start, and never ships your vault off-device.

name: AL-MONADEE Prayer Times
description:
AL-MONADEE (المنادي) is a free prayer-times app for iPhone and iPad.

A contribution from EJAD Gulf Technologies Co. Ltd., Al Khobar. No account, no ads, no tracking, nothing to buy.

FOUR PLACES, NOTHING REPEATED
• Home — today: the next prayer and the time left, then the time to the Iqamah, the six times, the Hijri date, a verse and a sahih hadith; the weather if you turn it on
• Dashboard — everything you open on purpose
• Qibla — the compass
• Settings

PRAYER TIMES YOU CAN TRUST
• Calculated on your device — they work with no connection, from the first minute
• The method chosen for your country: Umm al-Qura, Dubai, Qatar, Kuwait, Gulf, Jordan, Egypt, Muslim World League, Karachi, ISNA and more
• Every city of the Gulf built in, any city in the world by name
• A ±minute correction for each prayer, and your own Iqamah intervals

ATHAN
• An alert at every prayer time; with the app open, the Athan in full on its own screen
• Several muezzins to download — or record the Athan in your own voice
• A reminder before each prayer and a short tone at the Iqamah
• A wake-up alarm before Fajr, with snooze (iOS 26 and later)
• "Test the Athan in 1 minute", and a page that shows what your device needs so the Athan is heard

AROUND EACH PRAYER
• Quiet lines in your notifications: the sunnah prayers, Duha, Witr and "Have you prayed?" — all silent, each yours to switch off

QIBLA
• Turn until the Kaaba is under the bar — the dial tells you when you are facing it
• A way by the sun that needs no compass
• Your location is used on the device only, and only if you allow it, so the compass can count from true north

THE QUR'AN
• The Madinah mushaf, page by page — in the King Fahd Complex's own print, sharp at any size, with tajweed colours if you wish, or as page pictures; all 604 pages work with no connection
• Go to any surah, ayah (2:255), page or juz; search the Qur'an by word
• Mark where you stopped; your own labels and notes on any ayah; translation and tafsir (al-Tafsir al-Muyassar)
• Tilawa: twelve recitations to choose from, carrying on with the screen locked; recite from any ayah and the page follows
• Record your own recitation on the page you are reading

ATHKAR AND SUNNAH
• 147 sahih athkar — morning, evening, after the prayer, sleep and more — one to a card, with an optional counter and a tasbih
• 332 sahih hadith by topic, book and narrator — from Sahih al-Bukhari and Sahih Muslim, and what al-Albani grades sahih — each word for word with its reference
• Search thousands more sahih hadith on Dorar

TOOLS
• The month's prayer times, the dates of the Islamic year, a Hijri–Gregorian date converter
• My record: mark the prayers you prayed and the days you fasted
• Share a verse or a hadith as a card — the words are never changed
• Backup without an account: your settings, marks, notes and record in a file you keep
• Four Home Screen widgets and one for the Lock Screen, a dark theme, English and Arabic

PRIVACY
No account, no advertising, no tracking. Prayer times and the Qibla are worked out on your device and send nothing. The weather is off until you turn it on. Your recordings, your record, your marks and notes stay on your device. Full details in the privacy policy.

Qur'an text, translations, tafsir and recitations: Quran.com (Quran Foundation). Mushaf pages: King Fahd Glorious Qur'an Printing Complex, via Quran.com. Hadith and athkar: Dorar (dorar.net). Weather: MET Norway. Athan recordings: Islamic Network. City search: Open-Meteo. Fonts: Readex Pro and Amiri Quran (SIL Open Font License).

name: Amphi Droit
description:
Amphi Droit explique la licence de droit, chapitre par chapitre, de la L1 à la L3.

POUR CHAQUE CHAPITRE
• Une fiche à relire : le problème de départ, les définitions, les articles et les décisions avec leur référence exacte, l'essentiel surligné.
• Les mécanismes en schémas : hiérarchie des normes, étapes d'une procédure, classifications ; en L2, des schémas à légender.
• Un sujet de partiel corrigé pas à pas : cas pratique, commentaire d'arrêt, commentaire de texte, dissertation ou fiche d'arrêt.

AU PROGRAMME
L1 : introduction au droit, droit constitutionnel, droit civil des personnes, méthodologie.
L2 : droit des obligations, le contrat de sa formation à son inexécution.

GRATUIT, ET AMPHI DROIT+
Les fiches de tous les chapitres et l'énoncé de chaque sujet sont gratuits, comme le premier chapitre de chaque matière en entier. Amphi Droit+ ouvre tous les corrigés et les schémas à légender.

SANS COMPTE

name: Apis Command: Beekeeping Log
description:
Keep your bees, not paperwork. Apis Command is a beekeeping app built for the bee yard: gloves on, smoker going, hands full. Talk to it, and it keeps your records.

HANDS-FREE VOICE
Say "inspect Hive 2" and talk through what you see: queen, eggs, brood, stores, temper. Say "remind me to feed Hive 3 Friday", "rename Apiary 1 to Home Yard", or "stop listening". No wake word needed for most commands.

MEET WALT
Walt is a retired beekeeper who's always next to you. He tells you what to do next, flags a hive that needs a look, explains what you're seeing, and gives plain answers on swarm cells, mites, feeding, winter prep and more. His quick answers are built in and work with no signal.

A TO DO LIST THAT WRITES ITSELF
Save an inspection that says "no eggs" or "swarm cells" or "light on stores," and Walt offers the follow-up: check for eggs in 7 days, split or add room, feed today. Inspections and mite checks come due on their own. Tick a task off and log it in one tap.

HONEYCOMB COMMAND CENTER
Every apiary and every hive is its own honeycomb cell. Problem hives show up red before you lift the lid. Tap to open, hold for options, hold and drag to reorder.

EVERYTHING ELSE YOU NEED
- Basic step-by-step inspections, or guided voice inspections (Pro)
- Feedings, treatments with remove-by dates, splits, swarms, queens
- Queen registry with year colors and marks
- Honey harvests by season, apiary and hive, in lb or kg
- Mark a colony as dead or gone and keep its history
- Area alerts: anonymous reports of problems near your ZIP code
- Works offline in the bee yard; sign in to back up and use more than one device

FREE: up to 3 apiaries and 10 hives. Hands-free voice, area alerts and data export are always free.

PRO: guided hands-free inspections (Apis Command walks you through each hive question by question and reads it back), in-depth answers from Walt, unlimited apiaries and up to 100 hives. Apis Command Pro is an auto-renewing subscription: $4.99 a month or $39.99 a year in the US, billed to your Apple ID. It renews at the same price unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the period ends; manage or cancel it in Settings > your name > Subscriptions. Your records stay yours if you cancel; nothing is deleted or locked.

We never sell your data, and there are no ads.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://apiscommand.app/privacy/

Made by a beekeeper, for beekeepers. Published by Stewart's Enterprise.

name: Arlen's Racing Rally
description:
Race e-bikes and electric cars across a hand-drawn island.

Hold to speed up, tap to jump, and swipe in the air for backflips, frontflips, no-handers and supermans. Land clean to keep your speed; bail and you tumble back to the last checkpoint.

• 28 levels across four worlds: Grassy Meadows, Buffalo Gulch, Mountain Summit Forest and Robot City
• Medals for time, tricks and clean runs
• A garage of paint, decals, riders, outfits and parts you win as you go
• A lo-fi soundtrack for every world
• No ads, no in-app purchases, no accounts, no data collected

name: ArmoryOps
description:
ArmoryOps is an offline-first firearm inventory and range tracking app that helps you organize your equipment, monitor ammunition, and maintain detailed records—all in one place.

FIREARM INVENTORY
Keep an organized record of your firearms, including manufacturer, model, caliber, accessories, notes, and rounds fired.

AMMUNITION TRACKING
Manage ammunition quantities by manufacturer, caliber, bullet type, and grain weight. Set low-stock thresholds and monitor your ammunition inventory.

RANGE SESSION LOGGING
Record range sessions, track rounds fired, and maintain a history of your shooting activity. Ammunition quantities and firearm round counts update automatically when sessions are logged.

MAINTENANCE REMINDERS
Track firearm cleaning and inspection intervals based on rounds fired. Log completed maintenance and review maintenance history.

MAGAZINES & ACCESSORIES
Organize magazines and accessories, track quantities, and associate equipment with compatible firearms.

PRIVACY & DATA PROTECTION
ArmoryOps stores your inventory locally on your device and works without an internet connection. Protect access with Face ID and export password-encrypted backups for safekeeping.

KEY FEATURES
• Firearm, ammunition, magazine, and accessory inventory
• Range session history and round-count tracking
• Automatic ammunition usage updates
• Cleaning and inspection reminders
• Customizable low-ammunition alerts
• Face ID authentication
• Password-encrypted backup and restore
• Offline functionality

Keep your records organized and your inventory under your control with ArmoryOps.

name: Arsenal: Security Toolkit
description:
Arsenal is a field security toolkit for iPhone and iPad, built for people who test systems they own or have written permission to assess.

Information gathering
TCP connect port scanner, host discovery, BLE and mDNS browsing, TLS certificate inspection, banner grabbing, DNS and WHOIS lookup, and a subnet calculator.

Web applications
HTTP request builder, header analyser, web crawler and JWT inspector — useful for checking your own services and capturing evidence for a report.

Crypto and encoding
Hash calculator across MD5 through SHA-3, HMAC, base64/hex/URL encoding, password generation and an entropy analyser.

Remote and reporting
Open an SSH terminal to your own hosts, run approved tools through a Remote Kali runner, keep findings and generate a report.

Authorised use only
Arsenal shows an authorisation gate on first launch. Use it only on systems you own or are explicitly permitted to test. It ships with no exploit payloads, no target lists and no bundled wordlists of compromised credentials. No account, ads, analytics, or developer server.

name: atendIA
description:
O atendIA é o app da sua equipe de atendimento. Tudo o que chega no WhatsApp da empresa aparece aqui, e você responde de onde estiver.

• Conversas: veja quem está esperando, responda com texto, foto ou áudio, use respostas prontas com "/" e passe a conversa para um colega.
• Contatos: histórico, dados e anotações de cada cliente.
• Funil: acompanhe em que etapa cada cliente está e segure o cartão para mudar de etapa.
• Agenda, equipe e chamadas: o dia da equipe na palma da mão.
• Copiloto com IA: peça em português ("quem ficou sem resposta hoje?", "mostra a agenda de amanhã") e receba a resposta com atalho para a tela certa. Mande foto ou áudio para ele analisar.
• Avisos: menções e atribuições num só lugar.

Para usar, a sua empresa precisa ter uma conta no atendIA (atendiatec.com.br). Entre com o mesmo e-mail e senha do painel.

name: AumbrioKeshat
description: Autoclave calculator: fill ratio, load density, F0 sterilisation, drying and costs.

name: Backing Drummer: Live Beats
description:
Backing Drummer is a live-play drummer for your phone. Pick a groove, set the tempo, press Play, and steer it like a band's drummer:

- Beat A/B/C change on the next bar line, so you never lose time
- Break fills join on the next beat and land back in the groove
- End A/B/C finish the song with a proper ending and ring-out
- Intros (Start A/B/C), shaker overlay, synth or real multisampled drum kit
- 40 original grooves across Rock, Pop, Funk and Ballad, plus audio-loop beats
- Rock-solid timing on the phone's audio clock, even when the screen is locked
- Beat lights you can see across the room, with one-tap Bluetooth light sync

Built for practice and for the stage: big pads, one-tap changes, and a count you can follow at a glance.

No ads, no account, no data collected. Works offline.

name: BestTech SmartFarm
description:
One Platform — From Field to Factory

BestTech SmartFarm คือแอปภาคสนามของระบบ SmartFarm สำหรับเจ้าหน้าที่โรงงานน้ำตาล ใช้บัญชีเดียวกับเว็บ SmartFarm — แอปแสดงงานตามหน้าที่ของแต่ละคนให้เอง

ผู้คุมงานรถตัด
• ดูรถตัดและรถบรรทุกในเขตบนแผนที่ พร้อมสถานะล่าสุด
• รู้ทันทีเมื่อรถตัดอยู่นอกแปลงตามใบงาน หรือรถเข้าจุดต้องห้าม
• เปิดงานรถบรรทุกจากแปลงที่รถตัดทำงานอยู่ และดูใบงานของวัน
• ดูความคืบหน้าแปลงตัดและปิดแปลงที่ตัดเสร็จ

นักส่งเสริม
• บันทึกกิจกรรมในแปลง — ประเมินผลผลิต วัดค่าความหวาน ตรวจแปลง พร้อมรูปถ่ายและพิกัด
• ขึ้นทะเบียนแปลงใหม่ด้วยการเดินวัดรอบแปลง
• ส่งคำขอขึ้นทะเบียนชาวไร่และคำขอทำสัญญาจากหน้างาน

ฝ่ายตรวจสอบ
• ค้นแปลงทุกชนิดด้วยเลขแปลง ชื่อหรือรหัสชาวไร่
• ดูรูปแปลงบนแผนที่และบันทึกผลตรวจแปลง

ใช้ได้ในไร่ที่สัญญาณอ่อน
• โหลดข้อมูลเขตไว้ในเครื่องก่อนออกไร่
• งานที่บันทึกตอนไม่มีสัญญาณรออยู่ในเครื่อง แล้วส่งเองเมื่อมีสัญญาณ
• ข้อมูลในเครื่องเข้ารหัส และถูกลบเมื่อออกจากระบบ

• เข้าระบบด้วยบัญชี Google หรือชื่อผู้ใช้ที่ผู้ดูแลองค์กรสร้างให้
• ภาษาไทยและอังกฤษ · ใช้ได้ทั้งมือถือและแท็บเล็ต

ต้องมีบัญชีจากผู้ดูแลองค์กรของโรงงานที่ใช้ระบบ SmartFarm จึงจะเข้าใช้งานได้

name: Between by Doggy TuTu
description:
Between is a private, connected space designed exclusively for couples—a little world just for the two of you to document your daily lives, cherish memories, and nurture your relationship.

【Exclusive Pairing】
Link up with your partner using a unique pairing code to unlock a private channel reserved solely for the two of you. Your chats, photo albums, calendar, and home screen interactions are all secured through this pairing, ensuring no one else can access your space.

【Home Screen · Staying Connected】
• Interactive "Heart-Growth" feature and delightful, falling heart animations.
• Real-time status updates to see when your partner is online.
• Optional location sharing (requires in-app location permission).
• Shared wallpapers and photo album slideshows—turn your own photos into a personalized background.

【Chat · Always There】
• Instant messaging with typing indicators and read receipts.
• Send photos, videos, voice notes, and custom stickers.
• Message search and quick-jump navigation.
• Access recent chat history even when offline or on a poor network; text messages can be retried if they fail to send.

【Photo Albums · Shared Memories】
• Organize photos into system-default or custom albums.
• Upload, preview, favorite, and manage your photos and videos.
• Share your most cherished moments with your partner.

【Calendar · Important Dates】
• View your schedule in a monthly or list format.
• Create, edit, and delete shared events so you never miss an anniversary or special occasion.

【Settings · Customize Your Space】
Personalize your space by adjusting your profiles, themes, wallpaper rotation intervals, stickers, notifications, and more—tailor it exactly to your liking.

【System Sharing】
Use the system sharing menu to send photos, videos, links, or text directly to your partner (requires an active, logged-in session).

Between requires you to be paired with a partner to access its core features. An invitation code is needed for registration; existing users can simply log in.

For technical support or privacy-related inquiries, please contact us via the in-app settings or our technical support page.

name: Bible Navigator
description:
Many people start the Bible on page one and make it as far as Leviticus. Sacrificial rules and purity laws pile up, and nobody tells you which other books there are or where to read instead. Sooner or later the Bible goes back on the shelf.

Bible Navigator helps you start differently. Like a navigation app, it shows you where you are and which passage comes next. Think of the Bible as a large house with many rooms. At first a plan leads you through it. Over time you find your own way around and know where the prophets are and how the Old and New Testaments point to each other. Little by little you become at home in Scripture.

GETTING STARTED
• In Discover, pick what fits you, such as "I want to get to know Jesus", and get a few plans to match.
• Begin with Mark, Seven encounters with Jesus, Psalms as a school of prayer.
• Paths for First Communion, read together with parents, and for Confirmation.

FINDING YOUR WAY
• "Biblical common knowledge" takes you through 56 key passages, from creation through Abraham, David and the prophets to Pentecost.
• The House of Scripture shows all 73 books in their groups and which rooms you have already entered. Each book has a short introduction.
• Today shows where each passage sits: book, Testament, group and place in your Bible.

STAYING WITH IT
• Today shows what is next. If you miss a day, a dynamic plan adjusts on its own, and any other plan can be realigned from today.
• Focus mode begins with the Sign of the Cross and a short prayer.
• After a break, the app helps you continue where you left off.
• After that you can read the New Testament, one book of your choice, or the whole Bible at your own pace.
• Daily liturgy shows the day's celebration and, where available, the references for its readings.
• Notes, favorite passages and reminders are there when you want them.

FOR ALL CHRISTIANS
The app follows the Catholic canon of 73 books, but most plans work with any Bible. If you know the 66-book Protestant Bible, the plan "Catholic distinctives" introduces Tobit, Judith, Wisdom, Sirach, Baruch, the books of Maccabees and the additions to Esther and Daniel. Under My Bible you set which edition you use.

YOUR DATA
You don't need an account, and there are no ads and no tracking. Your data stays on your device, the app works offline, and backups are encrypted with a password only you know.

The app contains no Bible text. You read in your own Bible, preferably a printed one. If you like, you can open a passage through a link to the NABRE on Bible Gateway.

The app is free. If you would like to support the work of Bibelcoach and FaithOS, you can leave an optional tip.

name: Bingoals
description:
PANEL 1. A blank page. Someone staring at it.

PANEL 2. Three cards on the table: a character, a place, a twist. "A lighthouse keeper. A night train. Someone lied." The page isn't blank any more.

Bingoals is a tool for planning and writing stories, drawn like an old illustrated comic. It gives you the nudge and the scaffolding. The sentences are yours, because the app doesn't generate AI prose.

PROMPTS
Combine character, place and twist as many times as you like until a mix sticks. Any combination becomes a story with one tap, or waits for later.

STORIES
Give the story a title. Write scenes one at a time and move them around when the ending suddenly wants to be the beginning. A sample story is built in so you can see what a finished scaffold looks like, or start with a title of your own.

SAVED
Ideas that aren't stories yet wait here: combinations, half-sentences, a name you don't want to lose.

SHARE
Export the story as a text document and send it to your editor, your writing group, or yourself in three months.

ON THE DEVICE
Everything you write stays on your iPhone. No account, no internet needed, no adverts, no purchases. Nobody's reading over your shoulder.

PANEL 3. The page is full. Only the title is missing.

name: Biom business.
description:
Biom business., işletmeler için ekip iletişimi, topluluk ve iç iletişim platformu. Kanallar, görüntülü buluşmalar, belgeler ve iş akışları tek bir çalışma alanında; iş iletişiminiz kurumunuzun kontrolünde.

EKİP
• Açık ve özel kanallar, doğrudan mesajlar ve ileti dizileri
• @bahsetmeler, tepkiler ve anketler
• Kanala bağlı belgeler ve listeler
• Zamanlanmış mesajlar ve hatırlatıcılar

BULUŞMALAR
• Kanaldan tek dokunuşla sesli ve görüntülü görüşme
• Ekran paylaşımı ve toplantı notları

TOPLULUK VE AKIŞ
• Müşterileriniz ve iş ortaklarınız için ayrı topluluk alanı
• Duyurular, soru-cevap forumu ve etkinlikler
• Şirket içi gönderiler ve 24 saatlik hikâyeler

ARAMA VE BİLDİRİMLER
• Mesajlarda, kişilerde, kanallarda ve belgelerde arama
• Yeni mesaj, bahsetme ve buluşma davetleri için anlık bildirim

YÖNETİM VE GÜVENLİK
• Üyeler, roller, misafirler ve modüller yöneticinizin kontrolünde
• Kurum hesabıyla giriş (SSO) ve iki adımlı doğrulama
• İçerik şikâyet etme ve kullanıcı engelleme
• Hesabınızı uygulama içinden kalıcı olarak silebilirsiniz

Biom reklam göstermez ve sizi takip etmez. Arayüz, yardım merkezi ve sözleşmeler Türkçe.

name: Bislama Buddy
description:
Halo! Yumi toktok. Let's talk.

Bislama Buddy helps visitors, volunteers, workers and newcomers pick up the everyday Bislama they need to feel at home in Vanuatu. Five minutes a day, real phrases for real life: the market, the bus, the office, the nakamal.

HOW IT WORKS
• Follow a learning path of short lessons, from greetings to shopping, directions and health.
• Meet each new phrase with a plain-English sound guide, then practise it straight away.
• Build sentences by tapping word tiles, match pairs, and train your ear with listening questions.
• Mistakes are part of the fun. Anything you miss comes back later so it sticks.

STAY MOTIVATED
• Earn XP and keep your daily streak going.
• Pick a daily goal that suits you, from 5 to 20 minutes.
• Personalised practice brings back the words you find tricky.

YOUR POCKET PHRASEBOOK
• Search 445 Bislama words and phrases in Bislama or English.
• Tap to hear any phrase, slow it down, and save your favourites.
• Each unit has a guidebook with simple grammar tips: how blong, long, stap and gat work, without the textbook.

16 UNITS, 62 LESSONS
Sounds & greetings · Meeting people · Market & food · Numbers & money · Family & people · Blong · Pronouns · Places & directions · Gat · Questions · Everyday verbs · Past, present & future · Days, months & time · At the store · Body & health · Likes & everyday talk

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads and no tracking. Your progress stays on your phone.

Bislama is Vanuatu's national language, shared across more than 100 local languages. Lukim yu!

name: Bleep: Voice Messaging
description:
Bleep is a voice messaging app for friends. Send a voice message when something’s on your mind. If you’re both around, talk live.

Listen or get the gist

Your friend can listen to your voice message when they have time or read a quick summary, even if you talked for ten minutes. Voice message summaries are available with a subscription.

You can send photos, too. Messages disappear unless you pin them.

Talk live when you’re both free

Want to talk? Leave an invite. Your friend can join when they have a minute. On walkie-talkie, hold to talk and let go to listen. You can answer each other right away without recording and sending a new message every time. You can stay on walkie-talkie even when your phone is locked.

Or just call

Start a call anytime, or switch from walkie-talkie when you want to keep talking. Calls sound crisp on a good connection and adjust if the connection gets weaker.

Find your friends

Find friends through your contacts, or add them by handle or QR code. You don’t need a phone number to connect.

Both friends need Bleep and an internet connection.

———

Questions or feedback
hello@bleep.talk

How Bleep protects your voice
https://bleep.talk/learn/how-encryption-works

Privacy Policy
https://bleep.talk/legal/privacy

Terms of Use
https://bleep.talk/legal/terms

name: Block Puzzle: Spark Harbor
description:
Place a glass piece across a gap. If you close every route out, the spark is trapped, the glass shatters, and the spark flies toward the lantern. Catch every spark on the board to light the lantern and open the next pier.

Build an enclosure on a 7 × 7 grid. Drag a piece into position or select it and tap the board. Even a diagonal gap can let a spark escape. Turn on the spark path to see where a route leads, then check which shape is coming next before you place the current one.

Every capture changes the board. Glass along the boundary breaks, while stone stays in place. Keep a square of free cells for a later piece or use one wall for two enclosures. Sometimes it pays to catch one spark first to make room. On other boards, a single piece can close two gaps in one move.

Follow the lanterns through 25 levels across four chapters. Start in the Lagoon, find your way past stone barriers and shifting glass, then reach the Tidal Caves, where gates move after a capture. Return to four lanterns to earn optional stars by solving them in fewer moves.

Play offline on iPhone. Your current move, level progress, and sound setting are saved on the device. The game interface and hints are in Russian.

name: Blocus Tracker
description:
Your study time, your plan, your progress — all in one place.

Blocus Tracker brings your study timer, Pomodoro sessions, exam planner and progress tracking together. Organize your workload, stay focused and make every study session count.

STUDY WITH PURPOSE

Start a stopwatch or Pomodoro session, track time by subject and switch to Focus mode when it's time to concentrate.

PLAN AROUND YOUR EXAMS

Keep classes, exams, assignments, study sessions and daily goals organized in one place. Switch between day, week and month views, and bring supported university calendars into your planner.

SEE YOUR PROGRESS

Explore study statistics, session history and activity heatmaps. Build consistency with streaks, XP, levels, badges, missions and challenges.

STUDY BETTER TOGETHER

Connect with friends, see who's studying, join groups and course communities, and share the progress you choose to share.

YOUR STUDIES, YOUR WAY

Use the same account on iPhone and the web. Switch between English and French, with light and dark themes.

One place to plan, focus and track how far you've come.

Make every minute count with Blocus Tracker.

name: BlueWorks Level Book
description:
Level Book by BlueWorks: the last level book you'll ever need. From benchmark to backsight, it never lets a number slip.

Built by a surveyor for surveyors, foremen and anyone on site who picks up a level. Type each rod reading and watch it land on a picture of the rod, so you see exactly what you read. Level Book works out your elevations as you go and tells you right away whether your loop closed, while you're still standing at the instrument.

THE FULL KIT
• Site Levels: shoot grades and spot elevations off a benchmark.
• Level Loops: close back on your starting benchmark with an automatic closure check.
• Level Runs: run between benchmarks with a closure check, or leave the closing benchmark blank and end the run on any set point you name. The app gives you that point's elevation. If you get a known elevation later, enter it and the normal closure check runs.
• Three-Wire Leveling: enter upper, middle and lower wires with stadia checks. A running totals card shows ΣBS, ΣFS, balance and total distance as you go, and warns you when your sight balance goes over the limit.
• Stake Out: cut and fill to design grade at each point.
• Peg Test: shows how far your instrument is out of tolerance, and the peg correction is applied to your loops and runs automatically.
• Pipe Slope Calculator: enter a starting flow line elevation, then add sections with a length, a slope percent and a drop or rise. You get the flow line elevation at the end of every section, carried into the next, plus totals and text or CSV export.

CHECKS THAT CATCH ERRORS BEFORE THE TRUCK ROLLS
Arithmetic checks, closure against your allowable error, and clear warnings mean fewer busts and fewer trips back out.

REPORTS AND RECORDS
• Clean PDF reports with distance totals, plus CSV and text exports, sent right from the truck.
• Report import: every Level Book PDF report carries its survey data. Import a report on another phone and the job comes back fully editable.
• Save level work for review, so if there's ever a discrepancy in the field you have a log of everything you did.

MADE FOR THE FIELD
• Works fully offline with no signal.
• No account, no ads, no tracking. Your jobs stay on your device.
• Works in US feet.

A filled level book that fits in your front pocket.

name: Boat Tour Polignano Let's go
description:
Discover Polignano a Mare from the sea! With the Boat Tour Polignano Let's go app you can book your trip among the most beautiful sea caves in Puglia in just a few taps.

SEA CAVES TOUR
Departures every hour from 9:00 to 19:00, about 1 hr 50 min. Grotta Palazzese, Lama Monachile and coves reachable only by sea, with a 20-minute swim stop, snorkelling masks, and an aperitif with taralli and Prosecco.

PRIVATE BOAT
The whole boat just for you, from 2 to 8 hours: tailor-made route, perfect for families, birthdays and marriage proposals. Aperitif, drinks and Prosecco included.

WHY USE THE APP
• Real-time availability
• Clear prices for adults, children and people with disabilities (children 0–2 free)
• Book without signing up: just your name and phone
• Available in Italian, English, French, Spanish and Portuguese
• Directions to the Cala Ponte Marina marina and direct WhatsApp contact

Departure from the "Cala Ponte Marina" marina, Via San Vito, Polignano a Mare (BA), Italy. Let's go!

name: Bricksculpt
description:
Turn your pile of bricks into a sculpture.

BrickSculpt gives you brick sculptures you can build from the bricks you have: a lying Springer Spaniel, a sitting cat and a bunny. Each sculpture comes with a 3-D model, step-by-step layer plans and an exact parts list.

SEE IT IN 3-D • Spin and zoom every sculpture in 3-D • Choose the size that fits your shelf or your brick collection, in centimeters or inches

BUILD LAYER BY LAYER • A clear plan for each layer, with every brick’s size and color • Mark each layer as done; BrickSculpt remembers where you are in every sculpture • Pick up right where you left off from the home screen

KNOW WHAT YOU NEED • A parts list by size and color • Scan the bricks you own with your camera: BrickSculpt counts them by size and color, on your iPhone • See exactly which bricks you still need, and export a wanted list of just the missing ones

USE WHAT YOU HAVE • Build from my bricks: where you’re missing a big brick, BrickSculpt uses smaller ones you own instead. The shape and colors stay the same • Swap colors: make the cat gray or the bunny tan to match the bricks in your collection

PRIVATE BY DESIGN • Photos are analyzed on your device and never stored or sent anywhere • No account, no ads, no tracking

Works on iPhone and iPad.

BrickSculpt is an independent app and is not affiliated with, sponsored or endorsed by any brick manufacturer.

name: BrightVoice AAC
description:
BrightVoice AAC is a calm, customizable picture and text communication board designed for children who are nonverbal, minimally speaking, or developing speech.

Built for Everyday Communication
• Picture Boards: Includes ready-to-use Home, Foods, Actions, Mood, and School boards, plus up to 3 custom boards you can name and personalize.
• Always-Visible YES / NO Bar: Pinned at the bottom of the screen for quick answers at any time.
• Sentence Builder: Tap picture tiles to build a sentence across the top bar, then tap Speak to hear each word highlighted one by one.
• 1-Page ABC & 123 Board: Full alphabet and numbers on one no-scroll screen with a tap-to-place cursor for typing and speaking words or short sentences.

Designed Around Your Child
• Real Photos & Parent Voice: Snap a photo with the iPad camera, choose from your Photo Library with zoom and framing controls, or record your own voice for any tile.
• Flexible Layout: Choose 12 tiles (standard) or 6 tiles (simplified), lock the screen in Portrait or Landscape, and place the Landscape tab bar on the left or right for handedness.
• Offline & Optional AI Voices: Works offline with built-in iPad voices, with adjustable speech speed, font styles, and calm board colors. Parents can also optionally connect their own ElevenLabs API key for neural voices.
• PIN-Protected Parent Settings: Keeps editing, photos, and settings safely locked behind a 4-digit PIN (default: 1234).

name: BromqeliZastun
description: Freeze-dryer calculator: freezing, sublimation, vacuum drying, condenser and cycle time.

name: BSOBAD
seller_name: Brenda's School of Baton and Dance LTD
description:
WELCOME TO Brenda's School of Baton and Dance 

The BSOBAD app allows you to manage your account with ease, register for classes, access your emails, find schedules, and communicate with teachers and groups. You'll also receive important notifications about class changes, closings, registration openings, special announcements, and upcoming events.

The BSOBAD app is an easy-to-use, on-the-go way to access everything Brenda's School of Baton and Dance has to offer right from your smartphone.

name: Build Your Ecosystem
description:
Build a whole world in a jar. Then put the cork in, and watch it live.

Choose a jar, lay the bed, plant it and add a few animals. From the moment you seal it, nothing goes in or out. Plants make oxygen, animals breathe it, bacteria turn waste into food, and algae wait for their chance. The only thing you control is the window blind: how much light reaches the jar.

Build Your Ecosystem is a calm, honest simulation for anyone who loves aquariums, terrariums, or just watching nature do its thing. The jar lives in real time, even when the app is closed. A day in the jar is a day in your life. Some jars thrive for months. Some turn green, or cloudy, or quiet. When one collapses, you get a clear account of what happened and why, and you build the next one better.

BUILD IT YOUR WAY
• Pick a jar, a substrate bed and decorations like river stones and driftwood
• Plant java moss, hornwort, duckweed and more
• Add cherry shrimp and snails, guppies, daphnia and other tiny residents

A REAL LITTLE ECOSYSTEM
• Oxygen, carbon dioxide, ammonia, nitrite, nitrate, pH, temperature, light, algae and bacteria, all modeled together
• Every species has real needs, and every choice ripples through the jar
• Day, night and the seasons follow your local time

WATCH IT CLOSELY
• A beautiful 3D jar you can turn and inspect with a magnifying glass
• Water charts that show how your jar changes over days and weeks
• A journal of births, deaths and turning points
• A collapse report that explains, step by step, what went wrong

ALWAYS WITH YOU
• A home-screen widget that keeps counting the days
• Gentle notifications when something notable is about to happen (optional)
• Share a picture of your jar on any day
• Optional backup with Sign in with Apple, so your jar survives a new iPhone. No account is needed to play.

FREE TO PLAY, ONE OPTIONAL PURCHASE
The free game is complete: one jar on the table at a time, with a starter set of plants, animals and beds. A single one-time purchase, Full Unlock, opens everything: up to five jars at once, every plant, animal and bed, and every jar size and decoration.

No ads. No subscriptions. Pay once, keep it forever.

name: Café Origem
description:
O Café Origem é o aplicativo oficial de vendas desenvolvido para os representantes e equipe comercial da Café da Origem. Com ele, você registra pedidos e acompanha seus resultados de forma rápida e prática direto pelo celular.
O que você encontra no app:
• Acesso Seguro: Login exclusivo para vendedores e representantes autorizados.
• Meus Pedidos: Consulte suas vendas filtrando por cliente ou por data, veja o valor total acumulado e lance novos pedidos com facilidade.
• Detalhes do Pedido: Abra qualquer pedido para conferir os itens, quantidades, valores e dados do cliente.
• Dashboard de Vendas: Acompanhe seus resultados do mês em tempo real, incluindo total de pedidos, valor vendido, ticket médio, previsão de vendas, metas e clientes positivados da sua carteira.
Baixe o Café Origem e tenha mais agilidade no seu dia a dia comercial.

name: Caja TPV
description:
Caja TPV es una caja registradora para el iPad del bar. Cobras en la barra, llevas las comandas de las mesas y cierras el turno con un arqueo que cuadra. Nada de cuentas, suscripciones ni configuraciones eternas: se abre y funciona.

COBRAR EN LA BARRA
Rejilla de productos por categorías, con el ticket siempre a la vista. Efectivo con cálculo del cambio, tarjeta o Bizum. Importe libre para lo que no esté en la carta.

MESAS Y COMANDAS
Lo pedido y no cobrado se queda en la mesa. Añade productos, corrige cantidades, renombra. Cobra la mesa entera o solo unas unidades: lo que no se cobra sigue ahí, y cada cobro parcial genera su propio ticket.

CONTROL DEL EFECTIVO
Abre caja con el fondo inicial y registra entradas y salidas: proveedores, retiradas, lo que haga falta. La app te dice en todo momento el efectivo que debería haber en el cajón.

CIERRE CON ARQUEO
Cuenta billetes y monedas, y la app calcula el descuadre y el fondo que dejas para el turno siguiente. No te deja cerrar con mesas pendientes de cobro, porque ese dinero no está en el cajón y el arqueo saldría torcido. Historial de todos los cierres.

VENTAS
Tickets de cualquier día, totales por forma de pago, ticket medio y lo más vendido. Anula una venta del turno abierto y comparte el ticket.

TU CARTA
Productos y categorías con nombre, precio con IVA, color y visibilidad. Trae una carta de ejemplo para empezar, y puedes importar la tuya entera desde un CSV.

IMPRESORA
Imprime los tickets en una impresora térmica de red (ESC/POS) de tu propia red.

RESPALDO OPCIONAL
Si quieres copia de seguridad, puedes conectar tu propio proyecto de Supabase y la app sube ahí los turnos, las ventas, los movimientos de caja y la carta. Es tu servidor y tus claves: los datos no pasan por nadie más.

NUMERACIÓN SERIA
El número de ticket no se repite nunca. Se asigna de forma atómica y borrar ventas no reinicia la cuenta. Cada ticket guarda cuándo se emitió y cuándo se consumió, que en una mesa no es lo mismo.

Requiere iPad con iPadOS 27 y se usa en horizontal. El ticket impreso es un comprobante interno, no una factura.

name: CalcHub
description:
CalcHub est un tableur pour iPhone, iPhone Duo, iPad et Mac. Créez ou ouvrez un classeur XLSX, sélectionnez une cellule et saisissez sa valeur ou sa formule. Le moteur open source de GridCraft calcule les résultats sur votre appareil.

Passez d’une feuille à l’autre avec les onglets ou saisissez une adresse pour accéder directement à une cellule. Le sélecteur de fichiers système vous permet de retrouver vos classeurs.

name: Calvora
description:
Calvora shows how calving season shapes lactation in a dairy herd.

What it does
You record each cow’s ear tag, calving date and parity. The app groups them into spring, summer, autumn and winter, estimates 305-day yield from test days, and compares the seasons — with statistical tests, lactation curves, and the kilo and euro gap versus the strongest season.

How to use it
1. Overview — herd size, mean 305-day yield, share of summer calving. Switch bar, pie or both, and focus one season. Top right opens feedback.
2. Records — search by ear tag; filter season and parity; sort by tag, date or 305-day. Add a cow or a milk test (days in milk + kg). Tap a row for that cow’s tests.
3. Analysis — pick one-way ANOVA, Welch or Kruskal-Wallis, scale in kg or %, and a season pair for Cohen’s d. The table lists n, mean, sd and optional 95% CI.
4. Lactation — set the day window to full, early (1–60), mid or late. Compare mean daily curves, peak day and persistence.
5. More — convert the yield gap to euros at your milk price, with a breeding window toward the strongest season and heat-stress notes. Import or export CSV, or reload the twelve sample cows.

name: Carnest: Car Dashboard & Log
description:
Carnest keeps everything about your cars in one place and gives you a clean dashboard for the road.

DRIVING MODE
Dock your iPhone and switch to a full-screen dashboard: large GPS speed, trip time and distance, heading, the street you're on, clock and battery. Control Apple Music, open your audio app, tap a favorite contact to call, or start directions home or to work in Apple Maps. Set your own speed alert, keep the screen awake and switch to a night theme. Please set it up before you drive and don't interact with your phone while driving.

DIGITAL GARAGE
Add every vehicle with its photo, plate, odometer, fuel type and VIN. Carnest checks the VIN and decodes the region, maker and model year offline.

SERVICE TRACKER
Oil changes, tire rotations, brakes, filters, inspections or anything custom, by distance and/or time. See what's due soon or overdue, keep a history with costs, shops and receipt photos, and get reminders.

FUEL AND CHARGING
Log fill-ups and EV charges and get accurate full-to-full economy in L/100 km, mpg (US or UK), km/L, kWh/100 km or mi/kWh, with monthly spend and economy charts.

DOC KEEPER
Registration, insurance, inspection, license and warranty with expiry reminders. Scan documents with the camera or import PDFs; they're stored on your iPhone with file protection.

FIND MY CAR
Save your parking spot with level, notes and a photo, get walking directions, and run a parking meter timer with a Live Activity and a reminder.

WIDGETS AND SHORTCUTS
Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets for the next service, your parking spot, monthly fuel spend and expiring documents, plus Shortcuts to save a parking spot or start Driving Mode.

Carnest doesn't connect to or control your car: vehicle details are what you enter, and speed and location come from your iPhone. Free, with no ads, subscriptions or account. Your data stays on your iPhone.

name: CarryChart Medical Records
description:
New hospital, new doctor or care overseas, and you tell your whole story again. Which year was the surgery? What was the last result? Which medicines are you on?

CarryChart keeps it all on your phone. Log each visit, tap where it hurts on a 3D body, and in the consulting room open "Show the doctor" for a one-page summary.

■ Tap where it hurts
· 3D body (adult male / female, boy / girl): rotate, pinch to zoom, tap a spot or paint an area
· Areas with records turn red. Tap one for every record, photo and pain-diary entry there
· Mouth chart: note a single tooth the way dentists do

■ Say it once
· Quick record: speak, type or photograph a document. The date, body part and type are worked out for you; check and save
· Say "follow up in 2 weeks" and a follow-up reminder is set up too
· Attachments: photos, videos, scans (searchable text), PDFs and voice notes (transcribed on device)

■ One page for your doctor
· Allergies, current medicines, the course of each condition, past history, abnormal results and recent pain trends in one summary
· Your main concern for this visit and your questions come first
· Show it full screen or export a PDF
· Emergency info: allergies, blood type, regular medicines, emergency contact

■ Medicines, labs, height & weight, temperature
· Medicine list: what you take, the dose and when, shown in the doctor summary too
· Add lab results by hand: 74 common tests with units, reference ranges and the abbreviation used on lab reports
· Height, weight and BMI charts. Log your temperature any time

■ Calendar and reminders
· Pain calendar: darker means worse. Period log with a next-period prediction
· 16 daily logs: blood pressure, glucose, weight, temperature, headache, sleep, mood and more, plus your own symptoms
· Follow-up reminders the evening before and on the day

■ Timeline
· Visits, tests, diagnoses, surgery and medicines by year. Search titles, notes, hospitals and text inside scans
· Lanes view: what you were taking and which tests you had, and when

■ CarryChart Pro (one-time purchase, not a subscription)
Free, with no limit on records: 3D marking, mouth chart, Quick record, timeline, calendar and daily logs (temperature included), medicine list, follow-up reminders, lab results by hand (latest result per test), height and weight charts, doctor summary and PDF, iCloud sync and full export.
A one-time Pro purchase adds:
· Medicine reminders: alerts when a dose is due, "Taken" on the notification, today's doses at a glance, low-supply alerts, and adding a medicine from a photo of its box
· Temperature chart: follow a fever hour by hour, with the 24-hour high and fever medicines marked
· Lab trend charts: each test's results as a line, reference range in green, out-of-range points in red, units converted automatically
· Lab report recognition: photograph a report; tests, values and ranges are read for you to check
· Compare several results on one time axis
· Translation: the summary and your notes in the local language, for doctors overseas
· Family profiles: one each for parents and children
· Skeleton and muscle layers on the 3D body
· Pain and period statistics
· Ask AI: ask about your own history with Apple Intelligence, on device, nothing uploaded (needs a supported iPhone; not offered in China mainland)
Pro works with Family Sharing.

■ Privacy
No account, no server of our own, no ads, no data collected. Your records stay on your phone and in your own iCloud; turn iCloud off in Settings to keep them on this phone only. Photos, videos, recordings and scans are encrypted on your phone before saving. Lock the app with Face ID and export everything any time.

CarryChart is a record-keeping tool. It does not diagnose or give treatment advice and is no substitute for a doctor. Reference ranges and other figures cite their sources (Settings → About → Sources). If you feel unwell, see a doctor; in an emergency, call your local emergency number.

name: Ceravyn Calc - Clay Shrink
description:
Turn your clay test measurements into a practical guide for sizing pottery. Calculate shrinkage from wet and fired lengths, work backward from a desired finished size, and keep trial results and clay body notes together for future projects.

Measure Shrinkage from Your Tests

Enter a test piece’s wet length and fired length in millimeters to calculate its shrinkage percentage. Give the trial a title and save the measurements for later reference.

Plan Dimensions in Either Direction

Use the active shrinkage rate to estimate how large a wet piece should be for a target fired size. Switch modes to start with a known wet dimension and estimate the size after firing, then share the calculation.

Build a Library of Trial Results

Keep named shrinkage trials in a dedicated library. Return to earlier measurements when reviewing your tests or preparing another piece with similar sizing requirements.

Keep Clay Details with Firing Notes

Create clay body entries with a name, shrinkage percentage, and firing notes. Record observations for different materials and share individual entries when discussing your studio process.

name: Certa Aplicativo Teste
description: Aplicativo para acessos de condóminos e síndicos as informações do condomínio, como extratos com comprovantes digitalizados, demonstrativos financeiros, boletos, reservas de áreas, acessos da portaria, inadimplência, atas, convenções, documentos, avisos e notificações diversas. Este aplicativo é de uso das administradoras de condomínios clientes da Sami Sistemas.

name: CEXRUL
description:
Glad you are here with CEXRUL. We steadily polish these Blue Corridor Rituals so Leave and Return feel calmer to run, and we hope you reach out quickly whenever the dual stage, walk mode, threshold clock, or pattern skip views feel off.

Leaving home and returning home are two different rituals that compete for the same attention. CEXRUL gives you a dual Leave / Return corridor stage to see which side the threshold leans toward, then lets you walk door-by-door checklists across life domains without juggling sticky notes or five separate apps. Home keeps the corridor stage as the quiet center: which ritual is lit, how many doors remain, and what still needs attention stay visible before you dive into any desk.

Shape rituals in the library, edit door nodes, run Walk mode, review Corridor Log and Pattern Skip, load Scene Packs, and tune Threshold Clock from the Command Dock—not a crowded tab bar. Preferences such as return-home-after-walk and preferred corridor when hours are tied change real local behavior rather than decorative switches. Export and wipe keep the vault under your control when you want a clean slate. Everything is built as a local-first SwiftUI utility for iPhone.

Private by design: no account, no ads, no tracking, and no upload of your corridor rituals. Rituals, sessions, skips, scene packs, and preferences stay on this iPhone. CEXRUL only organizes Leave / Return checklists—it never sells your data, never requires a login to begin, and never sends your vault to a server.

name: CleanShield: AdBlock & Privacy
description:
Tired of intrusive web banners, creepy cross-app ad retargeting, hidden motion-sensor redirects, and photos leaking your exact home GPS coordinates?

CleanShield combines four 100% offline, on-device privacy defenses in one lightweight utility:

1. Zero-Permission Safari Web Shield
• Built on Apple's native declarative SFContentBlocker API—blocks annoying banners, popups, and third-party analytics trackers without ever requesting permission to read your passwords, credit cards, or browsing history.
• Includes a built-in 26-domain Safe Whitelist (Maps, Banking, Carriers, Payments) evaluated last via ignore-previous-rules so essential services never break.

2. 30-Point Privacy & Hidden Ad Switch Audit
• Step-by-step interactive checklist to lock down motion sensors, cross-app tracking (ATT), silent clipboard snooping, Significant Locations, and deeply buried ad personalization toggles—complete with 180-day local reset reminders.

3. Instant Photo GPS & EXIF Metadata Scrubber
• Inspect hidden latitude/longitude, timestamp, and camera lens tags before sharing original photos, and save a clean metadata-free copy in one tap.

4. Clean Direct-Launch Home Screen Widgets
• Jump straight to QR scanners, payment passes, and tracker-free search right from your Home Screen.

Subscriptions & Lifetime Unlock:
Core audit checks, base Safari ad/tracker blocking, and single-photo GPS scrubbing are free forever with zero ads. Upgrade to CleanShield Pro via Monthly ($0.99/mo), Yearly ($3.99/yr), or One-Time Lifetime Unlock ($6.99). Auto-renewing subscriptions can be cancelled anytime at least 24 hours before renewal in Apple Account Settings.

Privacy Policy: https://a3152557994-ship-it.github.io/clean-shield/privacy.html
Terms of Use (EULA): https://a3152557994-ship-it.github.io/clean-shield/terms.html

name: ClicFood Print
Clover Reading
description:
Clover is here to help you read.

Bring your own physical book. When a word is tricky, ask Clover for help, spell it aloud, or show it with the camera. Clover checks the word with you, offers a short explanation, and lets you get back to the story.

Ask about word sounds, meanings, and the page you share, then return to your story.

Keep the books you’re reading and the words you’d like to revisit in one place. Reading doesn’t have to be fast or perfect. Asking for help is part of reading.

Choose your buddy, talk naturally, and build a reading habit. Optional parent mode adds a grown-up check to settings.

Clover requires a subscription. Eligible new subscribers can try it free for three days, then pay $12.99 per month in the US. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. The subscription renews automatically unless canceled. Cancel at least 24 hours before the free trial ends to avoid its first charge. Manage or cancel in your Apple Account subscriptions.

Privacy policy: https://heyclover.app/privacy

Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Clube Da Visão
description:
O app que transforma a sua experiência de compra!
Com o Clube, você aproveita descontos exclusivos, cashback, e mais! Tudo isso com acesso a mais de 3 mil marcas parceiras.
Ofertas exclusivas para você:
Encontre cupons e promoções das melhores marcas.
Cashback:
Receba parte do valor gasto em suas compras direto na sua conta via PIX.

Como funciona?
Baixe o app e faça seu cadastro.
Navegue pelas mais de 3 mil marcas e ofertas disponíveis.
Ative o benefício desejado e finalize sua compra no site ou app da loja.
Acompanhe o saldo de cashback no app e resgate quando quiser.
Economize, cuide da saúde e aproveite experiências únicas em um só lugar!

Baixe agora e aproveite!

name: Cozyty
description:
A cozy city builder. Lay a street, zone a few homes and a corner shop, and watch a hamlet become a village, a market town and one day a city: cottages turn into terraces, and terraces into towers.

Nobody's ever in a hurry, nothing burns down, and nobody's run out of town. There's plenty going on under the roofs, though: power and water, buses, trains and ferries, schools and parks, jobs and commutes. Every home will tell you who lives there, what they like about it, and what it's waiting for before it grows.

Fill it with things to do: parks and bandstands, a theater, a stadium for the town's own team, even a Cozysters coaster park. Watch the year go round, with blossom in spring, long golden evenings in summer, the woods turning in autumn, and snow on the roofs with a lit window in every house. There's a festival every season, with lanterns along the streets, and fireworks over the castle once it's dark.

Forty trophies to earn along the way, a camera for when it all looks just right, and, if you save up long enough, a castle for the hill.

No internet needed, no ads, and nothing to buy inside. If you like, link a smol farm account and your towns and trophies follow you between your Mac and your iPad. In English, Japanese, French, German, Spanish, Korean and Simplified Chinese.

name: Creature Cards Explorer
seller_name: World of Wonder Trading Cards Inc.
description:
A windstorm blew through Professor Percy's jungle research station and scattered his life's work, the Creature Card archive, all over the world. He needs an explorer to help bring it home.

A NEW CREATURE EVERY DAY
Spin the globe, pick where to explore and see who turns up. A snow leopard in Asia, a blue-ringed octopus off Australia, maybe a woolly mammoth. Every creature is found only where it really lives.

REAL ANIMALS, REAL FACTS
Every card has fast facts, a danger meter and a rarity based on the animal's real conservation status, from common to critically endangered. Some are extinct. A few are mythical, like the Kraken and the Phoenix.

PERCY REACTS
Find something rare and he's thrilled. Pull something dangerous and, well, you'll see.

BUILD YOUR ARCHIVE
Every find goes into Percy's field journal. Sort by animal group, rarity or continent, finish each series of 100 cards, and earn pins for your explorer's vest.

PLAY GAMES
Animal trivia, memory match, creature bubbles and a forest maze, all starring the creatures you collect.

MADE FOR FAMILIES
For kids and grown-ups to explore together. No ads.

EXPLORER MEMBERSHIP
Members get the chance to find rare holographic cards, hear Professor Percy talk about every creature, and collect stickers. $5.99 a month or $39.99 a year, with a 7-day free trial. Share it with your family through Family Sharing.

Membership renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage it in your Apple ID settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.thecreaturecards.com/pages/app-terms
Privacy Policy: https://www.thecreaturecards.com/pages/app-privacy

name: CrowPhone: Your Second Line
description:
CrowPhone gives you a private second phone number for calls and texts, so your own number stays with the people who matter.

Rent a number in the United States, Canada, Sweden or the Philippines for a day, a week or a month. Use it when you sell online, work with new clients and contractors, or need a local number while you travel. Each number is a real phone number that people can call and text, and it belongs to your signed-in CrowPhone account.

CALLS
• Call from any of your numbers with the built-in keypad.
• See the rate per minute before you call.
• Calls to your numbers ring on your iPhone like a normal phone call, even when the app is closed.
• Check your microphone and speaker with a free test call.
• Calls that do not connect are refunded automatically.

TEXTS
• Read the texts your numbers receive, grouped by conversation.
• Send texts from Sweden and Philippines numbers, and see the cost before you send.
• United States and Canada numbers receive texts but do not send them.
• New texts appear while the app is open and when you refresh. This version does not send notifications for texts.

PAY AS YOU GO
• Add credit in the app with in-app purchase: $10, $20, $50 or $100 of credit.
• Credit never expires.
• Texts that are not delivered are refunded automatically.
• Every price is shown before you pay it. You can browse countries and rates before you sign in.

YOUR ACCOUNT
• Your numbers, texts, calls and balance stay with your account when you sign in on another iPhone.
• Release a number whenever you are done with it.
• Delete your account in the app. It is deleted immediately.
• The only permission the app asks for is the microphone, for calls.

GOOD TO KNOW
• CrowPhone cannot call emergency services. Use your phone's own dialer in an emergency.
• CrowPhone is for people aged 18 or older.

The Terms of Service and Privacy Policy are included in the app.

name: CYSOL Dashboard
description:
CYSOL Dashboard is the iPhone app for the owner and the manager of a business that uses CYSOL POS. You are not behind the counter, and you still know what your till is doing right now.

YOUR SALES, LIVE
• Today's sales, refreshed every few seconds, with the curve of the day
• Tickets, average basket and expenses at a glance
• How customers paid: cash, card and each payment method
• Best sellers, by item or by category
• Open tables and how long they have been open
• Swipe back to yesterday, last week or last month

ALERTS YOU CHOOSE
• Tick what makes your phone ring, even with the app closed: Z report closed, voided tickets, complimentary items, online orders nobody has accepted, items out of stock, low stock
• Nothing is ticked for you, and no amount ever shows on the lock screen

THE EVERYDAY ACTIONS
• Open or close a server's own phone for taking orders
• Take an item off sale when it runs out, and put it back
• Nothing involving money is changed from the phone: no voids, no closings

SAFE IF YOU LOSE IT
• Opens with Face ID: your figures stay hidden from anyone who picks up your phone, and there is no password to type again
• The phone only gets what your role allows
• Sign out every phone at once from your back office

How to start: sign in with the same email and password as your CYSOL back office. No CYSOL account yet? Open one at cysolpos.com.

Available in English, French, Spanish and Portuguese.

name: CYSOL Kitchen & Bar Display
description:
CYSOL Kitchen & Bar turns an iPad into a kitchen display system (KDS) for coffee shops, restaurants and bars that use the CYSOL POS till. Orders taken at the till or on a waiter's phone appear within seconds on the kitchen or bar screen, with the table, the dishes and every option, so the team prepares the right dish without running back and forth.

EVERY ORDER, CLEAR AT A GLANCE
• Each order shows its table, dishes, sizes, options and who took it, so nobody has to ask twice
• Its colour changes when it waits too long, so a late table stands out straight away
• Items removed from an order show in red, so nothing is cooked for nothing

READY IN ONE TAP
• Tap Ready and the till and the waiter know at once that the dish can go out
• Flag a dish that has run out from the screen, and the till stops selling it

NO ORDER GOES UNNOTICED
• A beep for each new order and, if you wish, a ring that keeps going until someone taps Seen
• The screen stays on as long as the app is open, so it never goes dark during service

KITCHEN AND BAR, EACH WITH ITS OWN SCREEN
• When you pair the iPad, choose Kitchen or Bar: each screen shows only what it prepares
• No PIN on this screen: the paired iPad is what protects it, so nobody types a code during the rush

WHAT THE OWNER OR MANAGER CAN SWITCH ON
• Print each new order on the kitchen printer connected to your Wi-Fi or network cable, only once even with two screens

GETTING STARTED
In your CYSOL back office, open Devices and add a device to get a pairing code. Type it on this iPad, choose Kitchen or Bar, and the screen is ready. You need a CYSOL account, which you can open at cysolpos.com.

Available in English, French, Spanish and Portuguese.

name: Darzdoy
description:
Darzdoy helps preserve the Ingush language (ГӀалгӀай мотт).

RECORD YOUR VOICE
We are building a program that reads Ingush text aloud — for cartoons, fairy tales and books. It learns from the real voices of people who speak Ingush. Register, choose how many phrases to read (20, 50 or 100), and once your portion is approved, read them aloud right in the app. Your account page shows your recordings, points and awards. In the participants list others see only your badge and rank, not your name.

DOSHLORG — DICTIONARY
38,745 entries in Ingush and Russian. After the first download, search works without the internet.

TEPTARASH — BOOKS
211 books in Ingush. Read them in the app or download them to read offline.

Darzdoy is free, with no ads and no tracking. You can delete your account and all your recordings at any time from the account menu.

Available in English and Russian.

Privacy Policy: https://darzdoy.com/privacy/
Support: https://darzdoy.com/support/

name: Dashlume: Car Dash Widgets
description:
Dashlume lets you design your own widget look, then use it for seven glanceable widgets: a big clock, the date, a countdown to when you leave, your next calendar event, your iPhone's battery, a short note and a photo frame.

DESIGN A THEME
Pick a solid color, a two- or three-color gradient (linear or radial, any angle) or one of your own pictures with a dim slider so text stays readable. Choose the text and accent colors, one of six fonts, four weights and four layouts: centered, corner, underline or stripe. A live widget preview updates with every change, in small and medium sizes, and warns you when text and background are too close in brightness.

ONE THEME, ANY WIDGET
Save as many themes as you like. Touch and hold a widget, choose Edit Widget and pick its theme. Edit the theme later and every widget using it updates.

THE WIDGETS
• Big Clock: the time in large type, 12- or 24-hour.
• Date: weekday, day and month.
• Trip Countdown: set a departure time. It shows the days left, becomes a live timer in the final 24 hours and says "Time to go" when it's time.
• Next Event: the title and time of your next calendar event, read on your iPhone after you allow Calendar access.
• Phone Battery: your iPhone's charge, re-read each time iOS refreshes the widget (about every 15 minutes).
• Note: a short line of your own text.
• Photo Frame: one of your photos with an optional caption.

HOME SCREEN, STANDBY AND THE CAR
Every widget comes in small and medium sizes for the Home Screen. Small widgets also work in StandBy, and with iOS 26 or later small widgets can appear on CarPlay (CarPlay is a trademark of Apple Inc.; Dashlume is not affiliated with Apple). Which widgets show on a car display and how often they refresh depends on iOS and the vehicle. Dashlume only shows information; it does not control anything in the car.

ORIGINAL CHIMES
A sound board of ten chimes generated by Dashlume's own synthesizer, plus a note grid to compose and save your own with five sounds, a key, speed and echo. Play them in the app or share any chime as an audio file. iOS does not allow apps to change your iPhone's system sounds or your car's sounds, and Dashlume does not.

PRIVATE AND FREE
No account, no ads, no analytics, no in-app purchases and no network requests. Your themes, trips, notes and photos stay on your iPhone, shared only with Dashlume's own widgets.

Please set up widgets while parked and keep your eyes on the road.

name: day.bear: digital planner
description:
day.bear — Your Digital Planner & Paper Notebook

Make everyday feel softer.

day.bear is a cozy digital planner that feels like your favorite paper notebook. Plan your days, write notes, organize tasks, track habits, record moods, and decorate your pages with stickers and doodles.

Whether you're planning a busy week, building gentle routines, journaling your thoughts, or simply making a list, day.bear gives you a little space to slow down and organize your life your way.

No complicated productivity systems. No pressure to be perfect. Just you and your pages.

YOUR PERSONAL DIGITAL NOTEBOOK

Turn your phone into a beautiful paper-inspired notebook.

• Plan meals and everyday activities
• Track your water intake
• Use a Pomodoro timer for focused work or study sessions
• Add the modules you need to your daily pages

Your day doesn't have to look the same every day. Change your layout whenever you want.

BUILD GENTLE HABITS
