Track your daily habits, check off your progress, and build consistency without overwhelming yourself. Whether it's reading, exercising, drinking water, studying, or taking a little time for yourself, keep your habits visible on your daily pages.

Small steps count. Every day is a fresh page.

TRACK YOUR MOOD

Take a moment to check in with yourself.

Record your mood, reflect on your day, and keep track of how you're feeling over time. Your mood tracker gives you a simple way to notice patterns and make space for your emotions.

Make a functional planner, a creative journal, or a little bit of both.

KEEP YOUR FAVORITE THINGS

Create little collections of the things you love.

Keep track of books you've read, movies you've watched, meals you want to try, memories, and other personal favorites. Your notebook is more than a planner — it's a place for your everyday life.

YOUR DAYS, WEEKS & MONTHS

Look beyond today.

Flip through your previous pages, plan upcoming days, explore your weekly and monthly views, and revisit the little moments you've recorded.

Search your notebook to find your notes and keep your favorite pages close with Home Screen widgets.

EXPORT & BACK UP YOUR NOTEBOOK

Your pages can go wherever you want.

Export your day, week, or month as a beautiful PDF. Print your pages, save them, or share them whenever you like.

Create a ZIP backup of your notebook to keep a copy of your personal pages.

YOUR NOTEBOOK. YOUR PRIVACY.

Your personal life belongs to you.

• No cloud notebook

Open your notebook whenever you need it. Your pages are yours.

name: Decibook: Decibel Meter
description:
Measure noise in decibels, keep a noise diary, and hand your landlord or building manager a report they can read.

The meter is free, for good. One payment unlocks the noise diary and the reports. No subscription, no ads, no account.

MEASURE
• Live sound level in dB(A) or dB(C), with a plain scale beside the number: ≈ whisper, ≈ normal conversation, ≈ heavy traffic
• A live graph, and LAeq, Lmax, L10 and L90 for every session
• Night, Music and Cot check modes, with presets for a bedroom, a nursery, live music or your own value
• Exposure: your level compared with the NIOSH 85 dB(A) and OSHA 90 dB(A) reference levels

NIGHT
• On the charger, microphone towards the room. Tap Start and Decibook logs the night
• The free version keeps the screen on for 30 minutes, then follows Auto-Lock
• With the full version, Night runs all night with the screen on or locked, and a Live Activity shows it on the Lock Screen

KEEP EVERY SESSION
• Every measurement goes into the Logbook, with its graph and its peak
• Decibook never deletes a session for you. In the free version a session can be edited for 7 days and read for 30, then it locks until you unlock the full version
• Sessions sync through your own iCloud, so a new iPhone gets them back
• A widget starts a measurement and shows your last session

NOISE DIARY (full version)
• Log each incident: from and to, kind of noise, room, pattern, how it affected you, what you did and who else heard it
• Add contacts: who you reported it to, when, and their reference
• In Night mode, Decibook suggests incidents when the level crosses your preset. You confirm or dismiss them
• A reminder each morning, until the last day of your goal

REPORTS AND EXPORT (full version)
• A noise diary report as a PDF: a summary, the incidents day by day, the levels and a short statement
• A session report for a single night or measurement
• Reports in six languages: English, German, French, Dutch, Korean and Traditional Chinese
• CSV data with timestamps, and a SHA-256 fingerprint of that data printed on the PDF
• Share as PDF, CSV or zip, or print

SOUND LABELS AND CLIPS (full version)
• Sound labels, worked out on your iPhone, suggest what was heard: music, voices, a dog, footsteps. They are indicative
• 30-second clips at an incident. A Voice check discards a clip when it hears voices, and clips stay on the iPhone that recorded them

WHAT THE RULES SAY
• Neighbor noise rules in seven countries, in plain words with their source: the Netherlands, the UK, Germany, France, the US, South Korea and Taiwan
• Not legal advice. Only an official's measurement or finding counts.

CALIBRATION AND HONESTY
• Calibrate against a sound level meter you trust, or enter an offset. Decibook shows whether a reading is standard or calibrated
• Decibook shows when a sound is beyond the microphone's range
• Indicative sound levels measured with an iPhone microphone. Not a calibrated Class 1 or Class 2 sound level meter (IEC 61672) and not intended as an official measurement. Not suitable for legal, regulatory or workplace compliance measurements.

PRIVACY
• Sound is analyzed on your iPhone. No audio is kept unless you turn on clips
• No account, no ads, no tracking

FULL VERSION
• One-time purchase. No subscription. Family Sharing included
• Unlocks the noise diary and PDF report, alerts above your preset, Night all night with the screen on or locked, CSV and zip export, sound labels and clips, and every session

Decibook is not a medical device. It does not measure or assess your hearing.

name: Densinity
description:
Densinity ist die App zur gleichnamigen Software für Träger der Kinder- und Jugendhilfe, Alltagshilfen und Dienstleistungsbetriebe. Fachkräfte dokumentieren direkt nach dem Termin, die Leitung hat Akten, Bewilligungen und Abrechnung im Blick.

Für Fachkräfte
- Termine und offene Dokumentation des Tages auf einen Blick
- Verlaufseinträge mit Zeit, Ort und Text, auch ohne Netz; übertragen wird automatisch, sobald wieder Verbindung besteht
- Dauer in 15-Minuten-Schritten, vertrauliche Einträge für sensible Themen wie Kinderschutz
- Kontingent der Hilfe und eigene Stunden je Monat
- Leistungsnachweis direkt auf dem Handy unterschreiben lassen
- Fotos und Dokumente zur Akte

Für die Leitung
- Akten anlegen mit Hilfeart, Jugendamt, Fallsteuerung und mehreren Bewilligungszeiträumen
- Stunden je Fachkraft und Monat, Abwesenheiten, Ziele aus dem Hilfeplan
- Akten abschließen und archivieren; das Archiv sieht nur die Leitung
- Abrechnung: Monat prüfen, Rechnungen erstellen, Zahlungen vermerken
- Team einladen, Rollen und Zugänge verwalten

Arbeitszeit: stempeln per QR-Code oder einmaliger Ortung, Erinnerung an Pause und Ausstempeln, eigenes Zeitkonto.

Sicher: Anmeldung ohne Passwort per QR-Code und Face ID, die App sperrt sich im Hintergrund, die Daten liegen auf Servern in Deutschland, jeder Zugriff auf eine Akte wird protokolliert. Keine Werbung, kein Tracking.

Densinity setzt einen Zugang über euren Träger oder Betrieb voraus.

name: Dig Site: Fossil Museum
description:
Every rock is hiding something. Chip it open, brush the dust away, rinse it clean, and watch a fossil come out of the stone.

DIG IT OUT
- Three tools: the pick breaks rock, the brush sweeps dust, the water can washes it clean.
- Hard granite, loose slabs that tumble off, fault lines that split with one good strike.
- Go gently near the find. A clean dig keeps it in perfect condition; a careless one leaves chips.

FIND SOMETHING RARE
- 68 finds across five dig sites: the Beach, the Desert, the Ice, a Shipwreck and a Volcano.
- Common to Legendary, and any of them can come out gold.
- Every find has its own painted drawing, a label and a true fact.

BUILD YOUR MUSEUM
- Put your best finds on display in six halls, from the Shore Gallery to the Grand Hall.
- Visitors wander in and pay to see them, even while you're away.
- Complete a set to earn a bonus, and upgrade your tools at the bench.

COME BACK TOMORROW
- The Daily Dig: one rock, the same for every digger that day.
- The Midwinter Frost Fair returns every December with finds you can only dig there.
- Share a postcard of your best find with a friend.

FAIR AND COSY
- No ads, ever. No energy timers. Coins can't be bought.
- Optional purchases change only how things look: museum walls, tool sets and journal pages. They never change what you find or how much you earn.
- Nothing about you is collected. Your museum is saved on your phone.

Calm music, crunchy stone sounds and haptics make every rock feel real. Pick up a rock and see what's inside.

name: DoLess: Quit Smoking & Habits
description:
DoLess helps you do less of what you want to quit: cigarettes, alcohol or any habit of your own. No account, no internet, no ads. Everything stays on your device.

TWO WAYS TO QUIT
- Quit completely: a live timer since your last one, milestones, your best streak and the money you have saved.
- Cut down gradually: set a deadline and a goal, and DoLess builds a plan that slowly stretches the time between each one. You see the whole plan day by day before you start, and you can move the finish date.

WHEN IT'S HARD
- Tap Craving to see your own reasons for quitting, right when you need them.
- A guided breathing exercise with four patterns helps you ride out the urge. A craving usually passes in a few minutes.
- Log how strong it was, what triggered it and how you feel. Statistics show when and why it is hardest.
- A slip is not a failure. Your history and your record are kept, and you simply start again.

SEE YOUR PROGRESS
- Daily use, plan vs. actual, cravings by hour and weekday, top triggers and mood.
- A journal of every mark, craving and slip.
- Money saved and units avoided, in your own currency.

APPLE WATCH
- See your timer or the time until the next allowed one at a glance.
- Log from your wrist and calm a craving with the breathing exercise and gentle haptics.

WIDGETS
- Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets show your progress without opening the app.

TRULY PRIVATE
- No sign-up, no servers, no analytics, no tracking.
- All data is stored only on your device.
- Export everything to JSON or CSV at any time, and import it on a new phone.

MADE FOR YOU
- Gentle reminders of your reasons and, in the gradual mode, of when the next one is allowed.
- Your currency, time zone, time format and accent color. Light and dark mode.
- Available in 22 languages.

DoLess is a self-help tracker. It is not a medical app and does not replace advice from a doctor.

name: Dongne Janggi: Korean Chess
description:
Janggi is Korean chess. In Dongne Janggi you play it against AI opponents, the people of one small Korean neighborhood: a boy at the stationery shop, the snack-bar owner, the estate agent who talks big, the laundry owner who waits for your mistake, a university student, a herbal-shop teacher, an old barber, and the master who sits under the zelkova tree.

Each neighbor plays at three strengths, so a first-time player and a strong club player both find a fair opponent. They react to your moves and call 장군 and 외통 out loud.

RULES
- Based on the official Korean janggi rules: all four 상차림 setups, passing, 빅장, repetition and point counting (덤 1.5 for 한); the in-app rules page shows where the app makes its own choices
- Choose between point scoring and win-or-draw scoring
- Handicap games (접장기) when you want to give or take pieces

PUZZLES AND DAILY PLAY
- Checkmate puzzles in 1, 3, 5 and 7 moves, every move a check
- A new puzzle and a new challenge game every day, with a stamp calendar
- Endgame practice and a weekly neighborhood tournament

LEARN AND REVIEW
- Short lessons from the board up to 빅장
- Game review with an advantage graph and the moves that decided the game
- Save and share your game records

TWO PLAYERS, ONE DEVICE
- Sit face to face with the board turned for both players, with an optional clock

EASY ON THE EYES
- Large pieces with Chinese characters or Korean letters
- A cute doll piece set and a traditional wooden set
- High contrast, slow mode, take-back and hints
- iPhone and iPad, portrait and landscape

PAY ONCE
The first neighbors, all lessons, two-player games, a set of puzzles and the daily puzzle and game are free. One purchase opens every neighbor, every puzzle, full game review and the whole tournament. It is not a subscription, Family Sharing is on, and there are no ads and no accounts.

The app is in Korean, with English menus.

name: Easy Parallel
description:
Parallel parking, stress-free.

Easy Parallel teaches you to park the way you do in a real car: from the driver's seat, with the reference points driving instructors use. You see what to look at, right when to look at it — through the windshield, over your shoulder and in the mirrors.

WATCH, UNDERSTAND, THEN DO IT
• The demo walks through every step, stops on each reference point and explains it, with a top-down view so you always know where you are.
• Push the toy car with your finger to see how a car pivots around its rear wheels.
• Take the Wheel and drive yourself: steering, forward and reverse, look around freely. Three levels: Guided, Cues, then Test.

EVERY MANEUVER
• Parallel parking on the right and on the left, in three moves (45°) or in two.
• Pulling out of a spot, and parallel parking forward into a long spot.
• Perpendicular parking, backing in or nose first, and angled parking.
• Roomy, medium, tight and very tight spots, with extra moves.

JUST LIKE ON THE STREET
• Real mirrors: the curb, the car behind and the spot's line show up in them just as they do in a car.
• Backup camera and parking sensors, from beeps only to dynamic guidelines and a 360° view.
• Situations: a car parked at an angle, a post, a van, a high curb, a marked spot, traffic with a pedestrian and a cyclist.
• Downtown, residential or seaside, by day, at night or in the rain.

YOUR CAR
Look up your model in My Car: the lesson uses its length, its width and its backup camera.

IN MY CAR
With your phone in a mount, parked and safe, a voice co-pilot reminds you of the steps of your own parking maneuver. My Cues keeps photos of what you see from your own seat at the right moment.

YOUR PROGRESS
Every attempt gets a review: final angle, distance to the curb, turning at the right moment, with a replay of your path next to the ideal one.

Easy Parallel is a learning tool for understanding parking paths. It does not replace lessons with a driving instructor. On real roads, stay aware of your surroundings and adjust your speed.

Kids bring home a drawing almost every day. You cannot keep every sheet, but throwing them away hurts. Ekotoba straightens and whitens the paper when you take a photo, and writes your child’s own explanation under the drawing.

SNAP IT, THE PAPER TURNS WHITE

YOUR CHILD’S WORDS

name: Erzählkiesel
description:
Erzählkiesel (“story pebbles”) is a little bag full of painted pebbles. Five tumble into the sand, for example a rabbit, a lighthouse & a treasure map. Your child tells their own story to go with them, out loud & in their own voice. The app listens, records & plays the story back. It never tells a story itself.

SHAKE OR CHOOSE
One tap on the bag and five pebbles are ready: one each for who, where, what, outdoors & and then. If a pebble doesn’t fit, it goes back into the bag and another one comes out. Or your child picks three to seven pebbles from 60 motifs.

TELL & RECORD
One tap on the red pebble and recording starts, for up to five minutes in one go. When your child gets to the next pebble, they tap it. If the story gets stuck, the whisper pebble gives a gentle nudge.

FOR TWO
With the pebble with the two hands, two tellers take turns: yellow starts, then blue, pebble by pebble.

THE STORY SHELF

CALM & SAFE

name: Euro Inspection
description:
Euroins Inspection is the official app of Euroins Insurance Company (Russia) for remote vehicle inspections. Policyholders photograph their car themselves, and the insurer's inspectors and agents use the same app for in-person inspections.

HOW IT WORKS FOR POLICYHOLDERS • Your insurance manager sends you an SMS with a link and a 4-digit code. • Open the link, enter the code and follow the step-by-step scenario: a short walk-around video, photos of each side of the car, the odometer, the VIN plate and documents. • Each shot is checked on the phone and uploaded in the background, so you can finish even with a weak connection. • Submit the inspection and receive an SMS when it has been reviewed.

FOR INSPECTORS AND AGENTS • A list of assignments with deadlines and vehicle details. • The same guided scenarios for pre-insurance inspections and claims. • Materials are sent straight to the underwriters' portal, where the inspection report is generated.

WHAT THE APP NEEDS • Camera and microphone for photos and video. • Location while shooting, to confirm where the inspection took place. • Internet access to upload the materials; shots are kept on the phone until they are uploaded.

There is no registration in the app: access is granted by the insurer via an SMS link or a staff account. The app does not contain advertising or third-party trackers.

What's New (0.1.0): First release: guided photo and video inspections for policyholders and the insurer's staff.

name: Fieldmix: Tank Mix Calculator
description:
Fieldmix works out how much of each product goes in your sprayer tank.

Enter the rate from the product label, your tank size and your spray volume. Fieldmix shows the amount for each tank and the math line by line, so you can check every step.

- Litres and hectares, or gallons and acres. It starts with your phone's region.
- Every field and every answer shows its unit.
- A blank or zero field won't calculate. No hidden defaults.
- Works offline in the field.
- No account, no ads. Your numbers and recipes never leave your phone.

Free: one product per tank, with the full math.
Fieldmix Pro, one-time purchase, no subscription: several products in one tank, and saved recipes for the mixes you use often.

Made by NaavNow, a small app studio.

This app does arithmetic only. It does not recommend products or rates. Always follow the product label and local rules.

name: Fior: Calm ADHD Brain Games
description:
Fior is eight short, calm games made with ADHD brains in mind, each built on a classic task from attention research. No buzzers, no flashing, no daily streak to lose: a few quiet minutes of play, and a small world that grows every time you finish a game.

THE RESEARCH INSIDE EACH GAME
Researchers have used these tasks for decades to study attention, memory, timing and self-control. We kept each task and built a calm game around it.

• Pulse (sustained attention task, 1997): tap as each raindrop lands on the pond, and let the leaves drift by. Your taps play the melody.
• Tempo (time production): brew the tea for exactly the right time, with no clock to watch.
• Firefly Trails (Corsi blocks, 1972): follow the fireflies across the stepping stones, forwards or backwards.
• Koi School (flanker task, 1974): which way is the middle koi swimming? The school waits for you.
• Stone Stacks (Tower of London, 1982): rebuild the cairn in as few moves as you can.
• Echo Bells (n-back, 1958): tap Match when a bell is the same as one from a few rings back.
• Switchyard (task switching): sort parcels onto two trains, by shape or by pattern, as the signal changes the rule.
• Ripe Rush (stop-signal task, 1984): catch the ripe fruit, but hold back when a bee lands on it.

The honest part: a classic task makes a good game, not a treatment. Fior doesn't claim to treat or improve ADHD. It's a few calm minutes with games worth replaying.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Free play: any game, any time. Rounds take one to three minutes.
• Today's mix: three games picked for you, about five minutes, if you'd like a nudge.
Most games settle at a level that stays fun for you.

A WORLD THAT GROWS
Choose Ink & Paper or Soft Flow. Every game you finish grows an ink cherry branch toward full blossom, or a small star system toward a sky full of worlds. Days you rest take nothing away.

FOCUS SOUNDS
Brown noise, pink noise and white noise, made live on your phone. Mix in rain, a stream, wind in the pines, wind chimes or distant thunder. Set a timer, lock your phone, and it keeps playing. Binaural beats are an experimental option for headphones. Each sound carries a plain label, "Studied" or "Not yet studied", so you know what is and isn't known.

SHORT EXERCISES
• Tide: paced breathing for one, two or three minutes, with a soft buzz on each in-breath.
• Shake It Out: a two-minute movement break set to music.
• Reset: a one-minute check-in with your five senses.
• Launch Pad: name the task you've been putting off, pick a first step, and start a ten-minute timer.

STATS, KEPT SIMPLE
Your timing, your memory span, your best rounds, over the last week. It's a game, not a medical test.

MADE TO FEEL CALM
Soft scenes, gentle sound, clear shapes. One-handed play, a left-hand mode, three text sizes and a reduce motion setting.

WHAT'S FREE, AND FIOR PREMIUM
Free, with no time limit: Pulse, Tempo, Firefly Trails and Koi School with every variant, Today's mix, every Focus Sound, Tide, your growing world and your 7-day stats.
Fior Premium adds Stone Stacks, Echo Bells, Switchyard and Ripe Rush, the Shake It Out, Reset and Launch Pad exercises, and your 30-day stats. Monthly or yearly, with a 7-day free trial. Cancel any time in your Apple account settings.

GOOD TO KNOW
• For ages 16 and up. If you're 16 or 17, your progress stays on your phone.
• No ads. No sign-up needed. Save your progress with your email if you want it on another phone.

Fior is a game. It is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any medical condition. It doesn't replace care from a doctor or therapist: please keep using the support that works for you.

name: FitScore: AI Outfit Rater
description:
Snap your outfit, pick the occasion and a judge, and get a score out of 10 with three tips to make it better.

FitScore rates your clothes, never you. The AI looks at the outfit, shoes and accessories only: never your body or face.

HOW IT WORKS
• Take a full-length photo or pick one from your library
• Choose the occasion: everyday, school, work, date night, night out, party, gym or interview
• Choose your judge: Kind (all hype), Honest (straight talk) or Roast (jokes about the outfit, never about you)
• Get your score, what works, and three concrete tips: colors, cuts, accessories

SHARE YOUR SCORE
Turn any result into a 9:16 score card for your Stories, or save it to your photos.

TRACK YOUR STYLE
Your fits stay on your iPhone: look back at your history, your best score, your weekly average and your daily streak. Turn on a daily reminder if you like.

FITSCORE+
• Unlimited fit checks (the free plan includes one a day)
• See your fit upgraded: AI redraws your outfit on your own photo with your three tips applied, up to 3 times a day
FitScore+ is an auto-renewable subscription, weekly or yearly. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. It renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.

PRIVACY
No sign-up, no ads, no tracking. Your photo is sent to our AI providers only to rate it (and to draw an upgrade when you ask), is never stored on our server and never used by us to train AI. You choose before the first upload.

FitScore is for ages 13 and up.

Terms of Use: https://quentin-lauret.github.io/mark/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://quentin-lauret.github.io/mark/privacy.html

name: FletGo Conductor
description:
FletGo Conductor es la app para transportistas de Honduras que quieren más viajes y menos kilómetros vacíos. Recibe solicitudes de carga cerca de ti, oferta tu precio y lleva el control de tus ganancias desde el teléfono.

Trabaja por tu cuenta o con tu empresa, con pickup, panel, NPR, camión mediano, furgón o rastra.

CÓMO FUNCIONA
1. Regístrate y agrega tu vehículo con su placa, año y categoría.
2. Completa tu verificación con los datos de tu licencia y tu vehículo.
3. Ponte disponible y mira las cargas que hay cerca de ti.
4. Acepta el precio sugerido o envía tu propia oferta.
5. Cuando el cliente te elige, el viaje es tuyo.

LLENA TU VIAJE DE RETORNO
Publica tu ruta de regreso y FletGo te muestra cargas que van en tu mismo sentido, con espacio y horario compatibles. Deja de regresar vacío.

VIAJES PASO A PASO
Avanza el viaje con un toque: en camino a recoger, en el punto de recogida, cargando, en ruta y entregado. Ve la ruta en el mapa con la distancia y el tiempo estimado, y registra quién recibe la carga.

CHAT CON EL CLIENTE
Coordina la recogida y la entrega desde la app, sin compartir tu número.

TUS GANANCIAS CLARAS
Revisa lo que llevas ganado, el detalle de cada viaje y lo que pasará a tu liquidación.

TU VEHÍCULO, TU PERFIL
Administra uno o varios vehículos, con su foto y su estado de verificación.

Clientes con pagos asegurados: el cliente paga con tarjeta al confirmar el viaje.

FletGo: el flete que nunca duerme.

name: FletGo HN
description:
FletGo es la forma más rápida de mover tu carga en Honduras. Pide un flete desde tu teléfono, recibe ofertas de transportistas verificados y sigue tu envío en el mapa de principio a fin.

¿Mudanza, mercadería para tu negocio o una carga pesada entre ciudades? Con FletGo encuentras el vehículo justo, al precio justo, sin llamadas ni vueltas.

CÓMO FUNCIONA
1. Marca en el mapa dónde se recoge y a dónde va tu carga.
2. Elige el tipo de vehículo y describe lo que vas a enviar.
3. FletGo te sugiere un precio según la distancia y el vehículo.
4. Recibe ofertas de transportistas cercanos, compáralas o haz una contraoferta.
5. Acepta la que más te convenga, paga con tarjeta y listo.

VEHÍCULOS PARA CADA CARGA
• Turismo: paquetes y carga pequeña.
• Pickup: mudanzas pequeñas y mercadería ligera.
• Panel: carga cerrada de 1,000 a 2,000 lb.
• NPR: camión liviano de hasta 3.5 toneladas para reparto.
• Camión mediano: hasta 8 toneladas, ideal entre ciudades.
• Furgón y rastra: hasta 25 toneladas de carga pesada.

SIGUE TU CARGA EN VIVO
Ve en el mapa dónde va el transportista, cuánto falta para que llegue a recoger y la hora estimada de entrega. Mira el estado en cada etapa: asignado, en camino, cargando, en ruta y entregado.

CHATEA CON TU TRANSPORTISTA
Coordina detalles de la recogida o la entrega desde la app, sin compartir tu número.

PAGOS SEGUROS
Paga con tarjeta de crédito o débito con verificación 3D Secure. Guarda tus tarjetas para pagar más rápido la próxima vez.

TRANSPORTISTAS VERIFICADOS
Cada conductor y vehículo pasa por una revisión de documentos antes de poder ofrecer viajes.

TODO EN UN SOLO LUGAR
Consulta tus envíos activos, tu historial y los detalles de cada viaje cuando lo necesites.

FletGo: el flete que nunca duerme.

¿Eres transportista? Descarga FletGo Conductor y empieza a recibir cargas.

name: Flick Chanbara
description:
A face-to-face sword duel you play with a flick.

Stand before your rival and flick the screen to strike. On your rival's turn, read the swing from where the blade is raised, then flick across it to block. Take turns attacking and defending — first to three points wins.

HOW TO PLAY
- Your turn: flick any way to strike (up, down, left, right and the four diagonals)
- Rival's turn: flick across the incoming swing to block it
- New to it? A master teaches you in a short lesson

MODES
- vs CPU: Easy, Normal, Hard and Oni
- Straw cutting: slash leaning straw posts, each one across its grain, as fast as you can
- Versus: play friends nearby (same Wi-Fi or Bluetooth) or anyone on Game Center. Sword duels and a 30-second straw-cutting battle. Use a passcode to meet friends

COLLECT
- 50 fighters, 100 weapons and 400 pieces of gear
- Slash a shoji screen for fighters, or fusuma doors for weapons and gear (10-pulls too)
- Koban are earned by playing and are never sold for real money
- Ads can be removed with a one-time purchase
- 100 titles and your match records

name: Flip Drop: Marble Sort Puzzle
description:
Drop colorful marbles into a wooden marble run and guide each one into a cup of its own color. Every paddle a marble touches flips to the other side, so every drop changes the path of the next one. Plan ahead, pick the right chute and watch the marbles clatter home!

HOW TO PLAY
• Tap a chute to preview the marble's path, tap it again to drop.
• Paddles send marbles left or right, then flip.
• Wooden ramps always point the same way.
• Fill every cup with marbles of its color. Miss and you can undo!

FEATURES
• An original puzzle mechanic: marble run meets color sorting
• Hundreds of levels, every one guaranteed solvable
• Bigger boards, more chutes and more colors as you progress
• Undo and smart hints when you get stuck
• Satisfying clicks, rolls and haptics
• Play offline, anytime
• English and Turkish

Flip Drop is free to play and supported by ads. Remove ads with a one-time purchase, or grab a hint pack.

name: Foodgy
description:
You live your life. We take care of your food.

Foodgy plans your meals around what is in your fridge, your timetable and your budget, then writes one shopping list for it. Eat out, skip a meal, run out of rice: the rest of the week adapts by itself.

MADE FOR REAL WEEKS
• Tell Foodgy which meals you eat at home, take to class or eat out
• Breakfast stays the one you like, every morning
• Recipes that fit the time you have tonight

A KITCHEN YOU CAN SEE
• Your fridge, freezer and cupboard, drawn with every food on its shelf
• Counts in tins, packs and portions, not grams
• Food that goes off soon is cooked first

SHOPPING THAT MAKES SENSE
• One list grouped by aisle, with an estimated total and how long it lasts
• Tell Foodgy the real price or the receipt total: estimates learn your shop
• Don't like something? Say so at the shop and Foodgy plans something else

COOK WITHOUT THINKING
• Step-by-step cooking mode with animated steps and timers
• Your next meal and timers in the Dynamic Island
• One tap to say you ate it: your kitchen updates itself

EAT BETTER, SIMPLY
• Your week drawn as a plate: vegetables, protein, grains, and a score out of 100
• Allergies and foods you never eat are never planned

IN ENGLISH AND FRENCH

PREMIUM (optional)
• The whole week planned at once (free plans 3 days at a time)
• Unlimited swaps, and Foodgy applies what it learns about your tastes
• Budget, batch cooking, more than 2 people, unlimited kitchen
Monthly or yearly subscription, with a 7-day free trial on the yearly plan.

Nutrition values and storage times are estimates for planning, not medical or food-safety advice.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; manage them in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://foodgy.garinio.com/privacy/

name: Football XO
description:
Football tic-tac-toe online. A 3 by 3 grid: clubs over the columns, footballers on the left of the rows. To close a cell, name a footballer who played for the column's club and with the row's player — in the same team at the same time, not necessarily this one.

Ronaldinho, say, played for Barcelona, and with Beckham at Milan. So he fits the cell Barcelona × Beckham.

ONLINE
• Real-time matches against real people.
• Invite a friend to your room, or anyone in the game right now from the Online list.
• A rating and a leaderboard: climb higher with every win.
• No opponent around? Play the bot or fill the grid alone.

HOW TO PLAY
• Take turns, 30 seconds a turn.
• Wrong or too slow — the turn passes.
• Each footballer can be named only once a match.
• Three closed cells in a line win.

IN A MATCH
• Search footballers by the first letters of a name.
• The “Club only” filter, three times a match.
• Reactions for your opponent: emoji, no text.
• A draw by agreement, and a new match in the same room with the series score.
• Watch other people's matches as a spectator.

AN ACCOUNT IS OPTIONAL
• Play as a guest, no sign-up needed.
• With an account: a nickname, an avatar, a rating, your match history, a place on the leaderboard and the Online list.
• Report or block a player from their card in a match.
• No email or phone number needed. You delete the account in the game itself.

Free, with no ads and no purchases.

No club logos: a club is drawn as a circle with its short name and its kit colors. Footballer photos come from Wikimedia Commons under free licences, with the author and the licence shown on screen.

name: Fretly: Guitar Chords & Scales
description:
Fretly teaches guitar the way the instrument is actually laid out: on the fretboard. Every chord, scale, progression and melody is shown on the neck, played back with a real guitar sound, and coloured by its root note so patterns are easy to spot.

CHORDS
• Look up any chord and get playable shapes all over the neck, not just one box
• Hear each shape strummed or picked string by string
• Alternate tunings and a left-handed mode
• Save favourites and export a short tutorial video of a chord

SCALES AND THE FRETBOARD
• Major, minor, pentatonic, blues and the modes, in every position
• A CAGED map that shows how five shapes cover the whole neck
• A free fretboard where you place notes yourself; Fretly names the chord or scale you built
• Share a shape as an image or a link

HARMONY
• Circle of fifths and the chords of every key
• Ready-made progressions and your own, with strumming patterns and tempo
• Change key in one tap and see the same progression in Roman numerals

LEAD AND SHEET MUSIC
• A library of well-known public-domain melodies with staff, tab and a backing track
• Show staff and tab together, or only one of them
• Hammer-ons, pull-offs, slides and vibrato are written on the tab and played back
• Import your own MusicXML, MXL, MIDI or ABC files
• Solo over any progression with the right scale highlighted and chord tones marked

THEORY COURSE
• 20 short lessons in 5 chapters: notes, scales, chords, harmony, rhythm and reading
• Each lesson is interactive on the fretboard and ends with a quick question

PRACTICE TOOLS
• Metronome with time signatures, accents, subdivisions, a speed trainer and silent bars

AI ASSISTANT (OPTIONAL)
• Ask a music question and get an answer with diagrams drawn on the neck
• Ask for a chord shape, a progression or a solo line and it is placed straight into the app
• The assistant needs an internet connection and your consent before anything is sent. Everything else works offline.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• Your shapes, progressions and progress stay on your device

Fretly is available in English and Vietnamese.

name: FrontHouse Kiosk
description:
FrontHouse Kiosk is the customer-facing order screen for a food truck, stall, or pop-up that uses FrontHouse.

Install it on the iPad at the counter. Pair it with a code from your FrontHouse dashboard. Customers tap the menu, choose modifiers, and pay by card or at the window. Card payment is a QR code they scan with their phone. Pay at the window is cash, or Venmo or Zelle when you turn those on. The order goes to your kitchen display. FrontHouse charges no commission on the order.

This app is for the vendor's tablet. Customers do not download it and do not create an account.

name: Gbachi
description:
Gbachi, c'est la musculation simple et guidée.

S'ENTRAÎNER
• Des séances prêtes selon ton niveau et ton matériel
• Chaque exercice montré en animation
• Temps de repos, charges et répétitions suivis pour toi
• Marche sans compte

PROGRESSER
• Ton historique et ta régularité en un coup d'œil
• Gagne des points et monte de rang, du bronze au rang ultime

TA SALLE DANS TA POCHE
• Trouve les salles près de chez toi : horaires, formules, prix
• Abonne-toi et paie avec Wave
• Entre avec ton code QR, sans carte

TON COACH
• Fais-toi suivre par un vrai coach : il suit tes séances et t'envoie ton programme

DÉCOUVRIR
• Les vidéos des salles et des coachs pour choisir où t'entraîner

Gérant de salle ? Gère tes formules, tes membres, le scan à l'entrée et ton solde depuis l'app.

name: Gemalino: histórias narradas
description:
Gemalino é um ovo de boné amarelo que mora numa fazenda de galinheiro azul. Neste app, a criança ouve as histórias dele lidas em voz alta, frase por frase, e a frase que está sendo lida fica destacada em amarelo. Quando a página termina, o livro vira sozinho.

Comece de graça com "Conheça o Gemalino": o Gemalino se apresenta, mostra a turma e lê para a criança as primeiras páginas do livro 1, com as brincadeiras. Depois, as oito aventuras podem ser compradas uma a uma ou todas juntas, na coleção. Cada livro tem uma lição: dividir, trabalhar em equipe, cuidar da segurança na cozinha, escovar os dentes, pedir desculpas, esperar a vez, saber perder e provar alimentos novos.

O que tem no app:
- Ler para mim: a história narrada, com a frase destacada e a página virando sozinha.
- Eu leio: a criança (ou o adulto) lê e vira a página com o dedo. Tocar numa frase faz ela ser lida.
- Brincar com o dedo: ache os 7 erros, ligue cada amigo à sua sombra e conte os amigos do piquenique.
- Caderno para imprimir, na área dos adultos: 9 folhas de atividades para imprimir ou mandar por mensagem.
- A lição do Gemalino no fim de cada livro.

Feito para crianças de 3 a 5 anos, de preferência junto com um adulto.
Funciona sem internet. Sem anúncios, sem login, sem coleta de dados. Na área dos adultos, protegida por três toques e uma conta, ficam a loja dos livros, os ajustes, o caderno e os links. A criança não vê preços nem pedidos de compra.

As imagens e as vozes deste livro foram feitas com inteligência artificial, a partir das histórias do livro "As aventuras de Gemalino", de Belisário Retto de Abreu. Produção: Multiverso Digital.

Uma história para ler junto com as crianças e conversar depois: quando a gente divide, a alegria fica maior.

name: Gemtiles: Jewel Sort Puzzle
description:
Every gem is sitting on the wrong spot. Move them onto their matching color and stitch together a sparkling pixel art picture, one tile at a time.

HOW TO PLAY
• Tap a connected cluster of same-colored gems to pick it up all at once.
• Tap an empty spot of the same color to set them down.
• Nowhere to put them yet? Park them on the shelf below — but if the shelf fills up, the level is lost.
• Match the whole board to reveal the hidden pixel art.

NO LIVES, NO WAITING
Stuck? Try again right away. Undo, Hint, Magnet and an extra-shelf tool help you out of tight spots.

COLORBLIND FRIENDLY
Switch on "Color + Shape" and every gem also shows a shape — circle, square, triangle, star, heart or drop — so you can finish every picture even when colors are hard to tell apart.

COLLECT THEM ALL
• Finished pictures fill themed albums: animals, landscapes, food and more.
• Each cleared level adds a piece to the big picture on the home screen.
• Keep your streak going with the daily "Today's Picture" and monthly albums.

BEAT YOUR BEST
Finish within the target moves for three stars, then chase a lower best record.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Plays offline.
• Light and dark themes, English and Korean.
• Stays readable with large system text.

Contact: siwooeo@gmail.com

name: Gladecruise
description:
You are the forester on a thinning crew. Each stand is a tenth of a hectare seen from above: spruce, pine, oak, beech and birch, every stem with its diameter, height, crown and class. Your job is to choose which trees go.

Paint-mark a tree and the tally sheet changes at once. When you are done, the stand left behind has to meet its norm:
вЂў basal area per hectare inside the stand's corridor;
вЂў the HartвЂ“Becking spacing index inside its corridor;
вЂў every future tree with room to grow вЂ” no retained neighbour closer than both crown radii plus half a metre.

Then comes the part a spreadsheet can't do for you. Each marked tree needs one of eight felling directions. Its fall line is as long as the tree is tall and must miss every crown you keep. If another marked tree stands on the line, that one is felled first, and two trees that block each other can't be felled at all. Gladecruise draws every line, every snag and every blocked order on the map.

Cruise it
Press Cruise it to check the whole stand. Revenue comes from the timber you cut, graded by diameter into sawlogs, pulpwood and firewood, with defect stems one grade lower. For every one of the 96 stands the best possible revenue that still meets the norm has been found by an exact search, so three stars mean you matched a proven optimum, not a guess.

Eight districts
From a young spruce stand with a single species to an old mixed oakwood with three tree classes and narrow gaps. Districts 1 and 2 (24 stands) and the stand of the day are free. Pro, a one-time purchase, opens districts 3 to 8 (72 stands), the cruise log with your results against the optimum, and the watercolor map style.

Coins
You earn coins for a first pass, for three stars and for the stand of the day. Spend them on two hints вЂ” Mark a tree (shows one tree from the reference marking) and BA lens (shows each tree's share of basal area) вЂ” or on seasons, map styles and paint colours. Stands are never unlocked with coins and there are no random rewards. Coin packs are also available; coins are stored on this device.

The field book
вЂў Species & assortments: form factors, grading thresholds and the formulas behind the tally sheet.
вЂў Metres or feet, a colour-blind mode with species letters and dotted snag lines, sound and vibration switches.
вЂў Works fully offline. No account, no ads, no tracking.

The districts and compartments are invented; the formulas and form factors are standard forestry reference values, and timber prices are in fictional crowns.

name: Glanzwerk Team
description:
Die Glanzwerk-App ist das Werkzeug für alle Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter von Glanzwerk – der Gebäudereinigung aus Ulm und Umgebung.

Wichtig: Die App ist ausschließlich für das Glanzwerk-Team gedacht. Zum Anmelden brauchst du einen Mitarbeiterzugang, den du von Glanzwerk bekommst. Die Anmeldung läuft ohne Passwort über einen Code an deine E-Mail-Adresse.

Was du mit der App machst:
• Deine Objekte und Einsätze für heute auf einen Blick
• Kommen und Gehen mit einem Tipp erfassen
• Tages-Checkliste mit Schritt-für-Schritt-Anleitungen abhaken
• Schäden und Mängel im Objekt mit Foto melden
• Deine Arbeitszeiten und Stunden einsehen
• Navigation zum Objekt
• Mitteilungen, wenn sich bei deinen Einsätzen etwas ändert

Der Standort wird nur beim Kommen, Gehen und beim Abschluss der Checkliste einmalig erfasst – als Nachweis, dass die Reinigung vor Ort erfolgt ist. Eine dauerhafte Ortung findet nicht statt.

Die App lädt immer die aktuelle Version – neue Funktionen sind sofort da, ohne Update.

name: Global Paul Odoo
description:
Global Paul Odoo es la aplicación de Global Paul para consultar información de sus instalaciones Odoo Community desde iPhone y iPad.

Inicia sesión en la página de tu Odoo y conserva tus permisos y el doble factor que tenga configurado tu cuenta. Selecciona una empresa autorizada, consulta clientes, pedidos y facturas, revisa los estados que ya figuran en Odoo y descarga o comparte el PDF original.

La primera versión funciona en modo consulta. No crea ni contabiliza facturas, no emite comprobantes fiscales y no realiza pagos. Requiere una cuenta empresarial existente y que su administrador habilite el acceso móvil. La conexión inicial disponible es la instalación compartida de Global Paul; otras instalaciones necesitan activación individual.

Incluye una demostración claramente identificada con datos ficticios para explorar la interfaz. Los datos empresariales requieren autorización de Odoo y conexión a Internet.

Aplicación de Global Paul compatible con Odoo Community. No es una aplicación oficial de Odoo S.A.

Las funciones de recepción del Hub y los avisos remotos no están habilitados en el piloto inicial.

name: Grasas de cerdo JR
description:
Grasas de cerdo JR reúne los accesos de Clientes y CRM en una sola aplicación.

CLIENTES
• Regístrate o ingresa al portal de tu cuenta.
• Haz pedidos de productos de JR y consulta su estado.
• Revisa entregas, historial y novedades.
• Adjunta los comprobantes y archivos que correspondan a tus pedidos.
• Mantén tus datos de contacto y direcciones.
• Elimina tu cuenta desde Mi información, con una confirmación previa. Los registros comerciales que deban conservarse se tratan conforme a la política de privacidad.

CRM
Acceso para personal y conductores habilitados por JR. Según el rol asignado, permite gestionar ventas, clientes, inventario, rutas y operaciones de la empresa. Descargar la app no crea una cuenta interna ni concede permisos de administración.

La aplicación necesita internet para sincronizar las operaciones. Cámara, archivos y ubicación se utilizan al activar una función compatible y conceder los permisos correspondientes. No solicita ubicación del dispositivo en segundo plano. Los módulos de flota muestran la información de los vehículos autorizados en el servicio de JR.

La descarga es gratuita. Los pedidos y sus importes corresponden a productos físicos y operaciones comerciales; no se venden suscripciones digitales dentro de la app.

Soporte: gerencia.desarrollo@code4bi.com
Privacidad: https://grasasdecerdojr.com/privacy-policy
Condiciones: https://grasasdecerdojr.com/terms-services

name: Griffon Hub
description:
Griffon Hub is the work app for employees of Griffon Security Technologies. It brings the company's internal tools to your phone, so you can handle everyday requests from the office or the field.

Sign in with your Griffon Microsoft account. The app is for Griffon employees only; there is nothing to use without a company account.

What you can do:
- Request time off and see your balances
- Approve time off, expenses and time sheets (managers)
- Submit and fix expenses, with receipt photos
- Enter and submit ConnectWise time, and check your tickets and schedule
- Find coworkers in the company directory
- Look up your assigned vehicle, equipment and credentials
- Search the knowledge base and product catalog
- Get notifications when something needs you

Questions or problems: use Send feedback in the app, or contact Griffon at engineering@griffonsecurity.com.

name: Grosvenor Casino Show Night
description:
Plan an evening at the theater. Browse 16 productions, find a show that suits your mood, choose your seats, and order something for intermission.

Explore the program and filter performances by date or genre. Open a show to learn about its story and atmosphere, check its runtime and intermission details, and see upcoming dates and starting ticket prices. Tap Book Tickets to choose a performance and select your seats.

If you're still deciding what to see, start with a short introduction and answer five questions about your mood, who you're going with, and what kind of evening you want. Get two personalized recommendations from the program, each with a short explanation of why it fits.

Browse 12 post-show meetings, with a different actor featured each day. Each listing shows the actor's photo and roles, along with details about the discussion, audience questions, and autographs. Add a meeting to your favorites for easy access.

Choose from 10 snacks and 10 drinks at the intermission bar. Add items to your cart, select one of the show's three intermissions, and review the total before confirming your order.

Open the seating chart, select a show and performance time, and check which seats are available. Tap a seat to see its row, number, and price, then confirm your booking. Find your tickets for upcoming performances in My Tickets, where you can also return a ticket.

name: GrvtyTugWght
description:
GrvtyTugWght je číselná studňa. Dlaždice sa nedopĺňajú. Klepnite na dve čísla v otvorenom riadku alebo stĺpci. Väčšie pohltí menšie, zostane na mieste a pripíše body. Rovnaké čísla sa spoja do ich súčtu. Keď zostane iba jedno číslo, studňa je vyčistená.

Pokojný režim pridá rezervné ťahy, aby dlaždica mohla prejsť do susedného miesta. Meraná hra ponúka jeden rezervný ťah. Pokojné, zložité a husté studne sú pripravené z vyriešenej plochy, takže riešenie vždy existuje. Nápovedy sú obmedzené. Záznamy zostávajú na zariadení. Žiadne reklamy, žiadny účet, žiadne pripojenie na internet.

name: GS Sainte Ruth Yopougon
description:
L'application officielle du Groupe Scolaire Sainte Ruth de Yopougon.

Pour les parents :
• Présences en temps réel : vous savez dès le matin si votre enfant est en classe.
• Absences et retards : justifiez une absence en ligne, sans vous déplacer.
• Notes et moyenne : les résultats dès leur publication par l'enseignant.
• Devoirs et emploi du temps de la semaine.
• Messages : écrivez directement à l'enseignant et recevez les annonces de l'école.
• Scolarité : suivez les paiements et retrouvez vos reçus.
• Plusieurs enfants, un seul compte. Connexion par Face ID.

Pour les enseignants :
• Appel en quelques secondes, pointage de séance.
• Saisie et publication des notes.

Pour les élèves :
• Emploi du temps, notes et devoirs.

Connexion avec les identifiants remis par l'école. Mot de passe oublié : contactez l'administration du Groupe Scolaire Sainte Ruth Yopougon.

name: Gulp: Water Tracker
description:
Meet Gulp, the little whale who fills up with water as you drink.

LOG IN A SECOND
• “Hey Siri, record water” or “I drank water” logs your usual amount, hands-free
• “Record 500 ml of water”, “I drank half a litre of water”, or “Record a custom amount” and Siri asks how much
• One-tap buttons, Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, and Apple Watch
• Logged one by mistake? Ungulp takes it back

A GOAL THAT FITS YOU
• Your daily goal from your height, weight, age, activity and climate
• A healthy range, not just a target: Gulp gently warns you if you go well past it
• Goes up on hot days (Apple Weather) and after workouts (Apple Health)
• Or set your own

REMINDERS THAT HELP, NOT NAG
• Every 3 hours by default, each telling you exactly how much to drink
• Mark done, type a different amount or snooze, straight from the notification
• Smart timing skips a reminder right after you drink and goes easy before bed
• Optional AI-written messages, so reminders never get stale

NEVER BORING
• A playful whale with moods, bubbles you can pop and a celebratory water spout at your goal
• Pearl Tide: tap the whale three times and play a quick 3D game catching pearls
• Original sounds and haptics, each one easy to switch off
• Light, dark or follow your iPhone
• Today, week, month and year charts of how you're doing

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your drinks and body details stay on your iPhone.

Gulp gives general guidance, not medical advice. Follow your doctor's advice if you have a health condition.

name: Hive Battle
description:
Lead your hive. Hive Battle is a fast 1-vs-1 lane battler: pick 8 insect cards, drop troops and spells on the bridges, and knock down more hives than your rival in three minutes.

Every card is the same level for everyone. Nothing you can buy makes you stronger: the shop sells looks only - troop skins, hives, arenas, pets, banners and music.

- 16 game modes: Classic, Sudden Death, Wild Deck, Nectar Rush, Shuffle Arena, Duo (2v2 with an ally), Swarm Defense and Boss Raids (co-op), Bee Draft, Weekly Cup, Crazy Week, Queen's Training drills and Queen's Journey story battles.
- Online Duel: play a real player, every card at the same level for both of you.
- Weekend Cup: Friday to Sunday, every trophy match counts on the world board.
- Friends: duel a friend's real deck, chat, compare on the rankings.
- Your own hive: a 3D home with a garden that blooms with your wins, pets that grow, a castle you build every 10 wins, and a banner you design.
- Replays with kill-cam, photo mode, a smart queen who tips you during battle, seasonal festivals.
- Cloud save: link an email and keep your progress on any phone.

No ads. Internet needed only for online duels, friends, rankings and cloud saves; the game plays offline too.

name: Horsemaster Farm: Horse Racing
description:
Breed racehorses on your own farm, train them week by week, and send them to fictional races to earn prize money. Plan each horse's training, pick its races and its jockey, then watch it run in a 3D race broadcast.
You're not picking winners here. You're making them.

- PLAY AT YOUR OWN PACE
Each tap of "Next Week" moves the calendar one week forward, with no waiting. Play as many weeks as you like.
While the app is closed, time on the farm stands still. Hand the farm off to your trainer and it keeps going: one in-game week every 24 real minutes, for 10 to 120 weeks, for a fee paid in in-game money. A notification lets you know when the hand-off ends.

- READ YOUR HORSE, THEN TRAIN
Choose from seven tracks (Hill, Woodchip, Turf, Polytrack, In company, Pool and Pasture) and three efforts (Easy, Strong and All-out). Each track builds different abilities.
Check weight, fatigue and legs before deciding the ration and the feed. Training that suits the horse's condition is more likely to be a big success. Push too hard and it may get hurt.
Foals have their own program, from pasture and hand-walks to breaking in, that opens up as they grow.
Short on time? Leave any horse to your trainer.

- CHOOSE THE RACE, CHOOSE THE JOCKEY
Climb from debut races through the class ladder to Open company, graded stakes and G1.
Four racecourses each have their own shape, hills and length of stretch. Turf, dirt and track condition change which abilities matter most.
Eleven jockeys, each with a preferred running style, skill level and riding fee. The jockey decides how your horse runs.
Fifteen domestic G1 races, plus races abroad once your horses are good enough. Strong horses from rival farms stand in your way.

- 3D RACE BROADCAST
Follow every race from the gate to the finish in 3D, with a mini map of every horse's position and running commentary. Skip to the stretch, skip to the finish, or see the result only.
Switch the camera to Jockey to watch the race from the saddle.

- CARRY ON THE BLOODLINE
Every retired horse, male or female, stays on your farm as breeding stock for the next generation.
More stallions open up as your farm achieves more, and the top tiers require Stud Passes, earned by winning G1 races and races abroad. Sire lines have nicks with each other, and before breeding you can check a foal's likely strengths and best distances.
Each horse can be bred only a limited number of times, so choose every pairing with care.
You can also buy yearlings at the sale.

- GROW YOUR FARM
Spend prize money on the stable, training track, paddock and vet clinic to keep more horses, train better and recover faster. The farm changes with the seasons and grows as you build.
Buy feed in the shop to boost growth, and fit your horses with the gear you like.

- KEEP RECORDS
Look back on your graded wins, 27 farm titles, your all-time best horses, rival farms' top horses, and income and spending by year.

- EASY TO START
A two-minute guided intro takes you from your first training session to your first race. New to racing? A simple rating shows which races suit each horse.
There is no bankruptcy. If you run out of money, watch an ad to receive funds and get back on track.

All horses, jockeys, races and racecourses are fictional.
No account needed. Your progress is saved on your device.
Available in Japanese and English. Money is shown in dollars in English.
Music and sound effects can each be turned on or off in Settings.
No in-app purchases. This app shows ads (Google AdMob).

name: Hydro Water Solutions
description:
HYDRO Water Solutions adalah aplikasi resmi dari HYDRO untuk menghadirkan solusi air bersih yang lebih mudah, terpantau, dan terintegrasi—baik bagi pelanggan maupun tim operasional di lapangan.

Mulai dari pemantauan unit filter air, pengajuan layanan servis, hingga koordinasi uji kualitas air dan instalasi, semuanya tersedia dalam satu aplikasi.

FITUR UNTUK PELANGGAN:
• Monitoring Perangkat: Pantau informasi dan detail unit filter air HYDRO yang terpasang di rumah maupun tempat usaha Anda.
• Pengajuan Servis & Perawatan: Ajukan permintaan servis, perawatan berkala, atau pengecekan unit secara praktis langsung melalui aplikasi.
• Layanan Purna Jual Terintegrasi: Terhubung langsung dengan tim cabang dan teknisi resmi HYDRO untuk penanganan yang lebih cepat dan terjadwal.

FITUR OPERASIONAL & LAYANAN LAPANGAN:
• Konsultasi & Penjadwalan Kunjungan: Kelola jadwal survei lokasi, appointment, dan tindak lanjut kebutuhan pelanggan secara real-time.
• Uji Kualitas Air (Water Test): Catat dan dokumentasikan hasil pengujian kualitas air di lokasi sebagai dasar rekomendasi sistem filtrasi yang tepat.
• Manajemen Pekerjaan Teknisi: Pantau penugasan instalasi, perawatan, dan laporan pengerjaan di lapangan secara terstruktur antar cabang.

KENAPA MEMILIH HYDRO?
HYDRO Water Solutions berpengalaman menyediakan sistem pengolahan dan penyaringan air bersih untuk kebutuhan residensial, komersial, hingga industri di berbagai wilayah Indonesia. Melalui aplikasi ini, kami memastikan setiap layanan mulai dari konsultasi, pemasangan, hingga perawatan berjalan transparan dan akurat.

Butuh bantuan atau informasi lebih lanjut? Hubungi layanan pelanggan resmi HYDRO Water Solutions atau cabang terdekat di kota Anda.

name: IAM - Digital pass e ingressi
description:
IAM è il Digital pass della tua associazione.

Niente più cartoncino dimenticato a casa: apri l'app e mostri il tuo codice all'ingresso. Il codice cambia di continuo, così una fotografia non è riutilizzabile da nessun altro.

COSA TROVI NELL'APP

• Il tuo pass, con nome, numero di socio, sede e stato dell'iscrizione
• Il codice QR per entrare in sede, sempre aggiornato
• Gli avvisi della tua associazione e le convocazioni delle assemblee
• I turni da volontario: ti segni ai posti liberi e disdici se non ce la fai
• Le ricevute dei contributi che hai versato
• Lo storico dei tuoi ingressi

PER CHI È

Per chi è socio di un'associazione che usa IAM. Se la tua associazione non lo usa ancora, qui non troverai nulla da fare: parlane con chi la gestisce.

COME SI ENTRA

Con l'email e la password che hai scelto iscrivendoti. Se il pass non è ancora stato approvato, l'app te lo dice e aspetti che lo staff lo attivi.

I TUOI DATI

I dati sono della tua associazione, che ne è titolare: IAM li custodisce per suo conto e non li usa per altro. Nessuna pubblicità, nessuna profilazione, nessuna rivendita a terzi. Puoi cancellare il tuo account direttamente dall'app, dalla scheda Io.

Alcune associazioni conservano per legge il libro dei soci e le ricevute dei contributi anche dopo la cancellazione: l'app te lo spiega prima di procedere.

name: ICAO English Lab
description:
Inglês para pilotos e controladores de tráfego aéreo que vão fazer a prova de proficiência ICAO (SDEA da ANAC). O app é gratuito, não tem cadastro e não tem compras.

READBACK ATC (funciona sem internet)
O app fala uma instrução de controle em inglês, com som de rádio. Depois do bipe, você repete a instrução com o seu indicativo e recebe na hora o que acertou e o que faltou. O treino é todo por voz: continua com a tela bloqueada, pelos fones ou pelo som do carro via Bluetooth, e os botões de mídia pausam e pulam. Escolha 5, 10 ou 20 instruções.

SIMULADOR ATC (funciona sem internet)
Faça uma partida ou uma chegada com o controlador no rádio. Ouça cada transmissão, aperte o botão de falar (PTT) e responda como na prova. No final, ouça a sua própria gravação ao lado das respostas esperadas. As gravações ficam só no seu iPhone, e você pode apagá-las.

PERGUNTAS DE BANCA (precisa de internet)
8 perguntas no estilo da prova, uma de cada parte: apresentação, meteorologia, fases do voo, CRM, comunicação com o ATC, emergências, automação e cenários. Responda em voz alta e receba a correção do seu inglês e um nível estimado, gerados por inteligência artificial.

DIAGNÓSTICO DE NÍVEL (precisa de internet)
Responda uma pergunta de banca em voz alta e veja qual dos critérios da escala ICAO está segurando o seu nível: estrutura, vocabulário, fluência ou compreensão.

COCKPIT MENTAL (funciona sem internet)
Testes de atenção, memória, multitarefa, Torre de Londres e comparação de matrizes, no estilo das provas de seleção das companhias aéreas.

PRIVACIDADE
Antes de enviar qualquer gravação para avaliação por inteligência artificial, o app pede a sua autorização. O app não tem anúncios nem rastreamento. Você pode pedir a remoção dos seus dados dentro do próprio app.

A nota é uma estimativa para treino e não substitui nem garante o resultado de uma prova oficial. O ICAO English Lab não é afiliado à OACI nem à ANAC.

name: Igreja A Videira Itaqua
description:
Em nosso app, você encontrará informações relevantes sobre a nossa igreja, como células, eventos, cultos, programações especiais, pedidos de oração e aconselhamento, e muito mais!

Você também poderá se inscrever em eventos e classes, ler devocionais e receber estudos bíblicos. Além disso, terá à sua disposição diversos planos de leitura bíblica, para aprimorar sua vida espiritual.

A Igreja Evangélica A Videira Itaquá é uma igreja em células, estruturada sobre o discipulado.

Somos sedentos pelo mover do Espírito e ansiamos pelo avivamento em que todos os povos da Terra conhecerão a Jesus Cristo.

name: Ilpil: One Stroke
description:
Link the numbered ink monsters and cut them all down in a single brush stroke.
Slash the weaker ones first to grow stronger, then finish the boss in the same stroke — 一筆揮之.

◆ Draw a path with your finger and let go: the swordsman dashes along it, cutting as he goes
◆ Three chapters — Bamboo Grove, Ruined Temple, Snow Mountain — with 39 stages
◆ Shield, twin and mirror demons bring a new riddle to every stage
◆ The Tower of Training and a daily "One Stroke of the Day" leaderboard
◆ Play instantly without signing in (optional sign-in keeps your progress)

name: IndeptRerve
description: The same route can be compared based on the actual daily expenditure and the total round-trip travel time. Usage and data for a single trip can be grouped together, with any overlapping time periods counted only once. By comparing the two approaches—broken down by route, day of the week, and trip scope—you can click on the difference to review individual charges and daily records. For monthly passes, costs can be prorated based on the actual number of uses; each additional trip will update the cost breakdown for individual journeys. All data is listed in your account ledger according to the actual date of payment or receipt.

name: Insta Sky - Stargazing Sky Map
description:
Explore the universe from the palm of your hand. InstaSky is a real-time sky map and personal planetarium - point your phone at the sky and instantly identify stars, planets, constellations, galaxies, nebulae, comets, meteor showers, and more.

* 132,000+ CELESTIAL OBJECTS
119,626 stars from HYG, 12,584 deep sky objects from OpenNGC, 88 IAU constellations, the solar system, 10 meteor showers, comets, asteroids, and dwarf planets.

* REAL-TIME SKY TRACKING
GPS and motion sensors calculate exactly what is above you right now. Tilt, pan, and rotate - the sky moves with you in real time.

* AR CAMERA
Overlay the star map on your live camera feed. Constellation lines, star names, and object labels appear superimposed on the actual night sky through your lens in augmented reality. The camera is used only for the overlay and is never recorded.

* 24 SKY CULTURES
Choose from 24 sky cultures - each with unique constellation patterns, names, and hand-crafted artwork: IAU Modern, Al-Sufi (Islamic), Norse Edda, Maya, Aztec, Babylonian, Balinese, Boorong, Inuit, Hawaiian Starlines, Kamilaroi, Maori, Belarusian, Khoisan, Romanian, Macedonian, Seri, Andean, Tikuna, Vanuatu Netwar, Xhosa, Zulu, and more. The full set is part of InstaSky Plus.

* DEEP OBJECT DETAILS
Tap any object for rich scientific data:
Stars - spectral type, luminosity, proper motion, H-R diagram, altitude chart, catalog numbers, radial velocity, variability.
Deep Sky Objects - Hubble type, surface brightness, redshift, distance, NGC/IC cross-references.
Planets - magnitude, angular size, phase, real-time distance.

* SOLAR SYSTEM
Track the Sun, Moon, and all seven planets. See phase, brightness, angular size, and distance, calculated in real time.

* COMETS, ASTEROIDS & METEOR SHOWERS
Follow comets including Halley, Hale-Bopp, and NEOWISE. Track asteroids and dwarf planets including Ceres and Vesta. Watch animated meteor shower streaks - know when and where to look for the Perseids, Geminids, and Leonids.

* POWERFUL SEARCH
Search 132,000+ objects by name instantly. Filter by Stars, Deep Sky Objects, Planets, Constellations, Meteor Showers, and Minor Bodies - with smart tabs for Named Stars, Variable Stars, Nearest Stars, Galaxies, and Messier Objects.

* TIME TRAVEL
Explore the sky at any date and time. Replay historic conjunctions, track planetary motions across centuries, or find when the next meteor shower peaks.

* SHARE THE SKY
Share any star, planet, or galaxy with one tap. Each link opens directly in InstaSky pointing to the exact object - and opens a web page if the app is not installed.

* 12 CUSTOMIZABLE LAYERS
Toggle any independently: Stars, Constellation Lines, Deep Sky Objects, Planets, Comets & Asteroids, Meteor Showers, Coordinate Grid, Ecliptic, Boundaries, Labels, Reticle, and Constellation Art.

* SKY THEMES & NIGHT VISION
Choose from Sky, Day, and Night visual themes. Night Vision applies a red tint to preserve your dark adaptation.

* FAVORITES & SKY GUIDE
Save objects to your favorites for quick access. The Sky Guide surfaces the most interesting objects visible from your location tonight.

* FULLY OFFLINE
All star catalogs, sky culture data, and constellation art are bundled inside the app. No internet connection is required for the sky map.

* AVAILABLE IN 24 LANGUAGES
English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Italian, Hindi, Tamil, and more.

FREE WITH AN OPTIONAL PLUS UPGRADE
The full sky map is free. InstaSky Plus is a one-time purchase that unlocks all 24 sky cultures and the advanced star and deep-sky data, including H-R diagrams and 24-hour altitude charts. No subscription; Restore is on the paywall.

PERMISSIONS & PRIVACY
Location - determines which stars are above you. On-device only.
Camera - AR overlay only. Never recorded.
Sensors - accelerometer, gyroscope, magnetometer for orientation. All on-device.
No tracking. Your sky, your privacy.

Download InstaSky and discover what's above you tonight.

name: Internet Manager
description:
تطبيق لأصحاب شبكات الإنترنت يجمع كل ما يخص المشتركين في مكان واحد.

• المشتركون: سجّل الاسم والرقم والعنوان والفئة، واعرف بنظرة واحدة من سدّد ومن عليه دين.
• الاشتراكات: كل دورة ٣٠ يوماً. التجديد يدوي بضغطة واحدة، والمبلغ غير المسدَّد يتراكم تلقائياً.
• التسديد: سجّل أي مبلغ، كاملاً أو جزئياً، ويحسب التطبيق الباقي. ويمكنك إلغاء تسديد أو التراجع عن آخر تجديد.
• الوصولات: وصل تسديد أنيق برقم متسلسل وبشعار شبكتك، ووصل تفعيل يطلب التحويل، وترسلهما للمشترك على واتساب.
• الأرباح والمصاريف: حدّد كلفة كل فئة، وسجّل مصاريف الشبكة والمصاريف الشخصية (والمتكررة شهرياً)، واعرف ربحك الصافي منذ بداية الشهر، مع المقارنة الشهرية والسنوية.
• التقرير الشهري: تقرير PDF بالمشتركين والديون يصدر تلقائياً في اليوم الذي تختاره.
• التذكيرات: تنبيه قبل انتهاء الاشتراكات وتذكير بالصيانة.
• بلا إنترنت: يعمل دون اتصال ويزامن عند عودته، والحساب نفسه على أكثر من جهاز.
• الحماية: قفل برمز وFace ID، وكل شبكة معزولة تماماً عن غيرها.
• التصدير: نسخة احتياطية وتقارير CSV، واستيراد المشتركين من إكسل.

أنشئ حسابك مجاناً من داخل التطبيق وابدأ فوراً.

name: IPR In Family
description:
A igreja 24 horas com você.

-  Carregue a bíblia no seu bolso, estude através dos planos de leitura da igreja e faça anotações.

-  Acompanhe a igreja de onde estiver através dos nossos vídeos, conteúdo em áudio e publicações. Baixe áudios e conteúdos exclusivos na sessão de downloads e tenha tudo offline.

-  Seja notificado de transmissões ao vivo e assista diretamente pelo aplicativo.

-  Siga a agenda e fique por dentro de tudo que acontece na igreja, inscreva-se em eventos e tenha seus ingressos sempre com você.

-  Conecte-se com a igreja através dos grupos de interesse, receba conteúdo direcionado e obtenha sua carteirinha exclusiva.

-  Faça pedidos de oração através dos intercessores da igreja para você e seus familiares.

-  E mais: notícias da igreja, guia de negócios, entre outros.

name: iVidiSolitaire
description:
iVidiSolitaire is Klondike Solitaire that teaches you to win.

SOLITAIRE ACADEMY
Seven short strategy lessons, each with exercises on real positions. You make the move on the board and get feedback straight away: pick a weaker move and the app explains why and lets you try again. Earn up to three stars per exercise.
• Aces and Twos First
• Reveal Hidden Cards
• Tallest Column First
• Empty Columns and Kings
• No Rush to the Foundations
• Splitting a Run
• Using the Stock

COACH AT THE TABLE
In real games the coach comments on your moves: it tells you when another move would have revealed a hidden card, when you empty a column with no King in sight, or when you send a card to the foundation too early. It also praises good choices. The Hint always says why it's the best move.

GAME CENTER
Leaderboards for high score, fastest win and total wins, plus eight achievements.

THE GAME
• Classic Klondike: draw 1 or 3, unlimited or limited passes through the deck
• Tap a card to play it to the best spot, or drag it
• Cards fly between piles, unlimited undo and auto-finish
• Tells you when no moves are left
• Four table themes and five card backs
• Left-handed mode, landscape, iPhone and iPad
• Statistics, personal bests, and your game saved with its undo history

No ads, no accounts, no tracking.

name: Ivy ClassFinder
description:
Ivy ClassFinder is a quiet, independent guide for planning your term. Choose your college, search its public course listings, lay out a week that fits, and find your way across campus.

Covers public course information from Brown, Columbia, Cornell, Dartmouth, Harvard, Penn, Princeton and Yale.

Unofficial: Ivy ClassFinder is independent and is not affiliated with or endorsed by any university or athletic conference.

CATALOGUE
Search by title, course code, subject or instructor. Filter by your school's own requirements: distribution areas, distributives, Gen Ed categories, designations and more. Narrow by time of day, days of the week (no Friday classes, anyone?), credits, level and open sections where seats are published. Dartmouth's quarter system and each school's credit units are handled natively.

ASK IVY
Describe what you want in plain English, such as "writing course with no Friday classes in the afternoon", and Ivy turns it into a search. It is understood on your device; nothing you type leaves your phone.

WEEK
Add courses and Ivy places their sections on a weekly timeline, picking sections that don't overlap where it can. Clashes are explained in plain words.

GROUNDS
An open campus map of libraries, residences and dorms, dining, academic halls and athletics, from OpenStreetMap. Tap a place for walking directions.

SHELF
Bookmark courses, switch college at any time, and see exactly where each school's data comes from.

IVY PRO
Browsing, filters, saved courses, one plan per term with clash warnings, and maps are free. Ivy Pro adds unlimited Ask Ivy searches (free: 3 a day), alternate plans, one-tap clash fixing and calendar export. Choose monthly ($2.99), yearly ($19.99) or lifetime ($39.99); prices vary by country. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period, and can be managed in your Apple Account settings.

WHAT EACH SCHOOL PUBLISHES
How much detail you see depends on what each university publishes openly. Some schools publish live sections with times and seats, some publish catalogue descriptions only, and Princeton's listings are not open to independent apps, so Princeton has the campus map only. The app tells you which is which.

No account. No ads. No tracking. Your plans stay on your device.

Ivy ClassFinder is an independent, unofficial app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by any athletic conference, the Council of Ivy Group Presidents, or Brown, Columbia, Cornell, Dartmouth, Harvard, Penn (the University of Pennsylvania), Princeton or Yale. University names are used only to identify the public course information shown. Always confirm course details with your registrar.

Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).
