Privacy: https://gist.github.com/wonmor/3295c0d0429afe3fc28b3bffc4130e84
Support: john@orchestrsim.com

name: JiftDalara
description:
Ever looked up and wondered what that cloud is actually called? Me too. JiftDalara is a small cloud-spotting kit for your pocket, drawn in bold manga panels with halftone dots and speed lines. It works offline, there is no account, and there are no ads.

Here is what is inside:

1. A guide to the 10 cloud genera
Cirrus, cirrocumulus, cirrostratus, altocumulus, altostratus, nimbostratus, stratocumulus, stratus, cumulus and cumulonimbus. Each one gets its own page with a drawing, its height band, what it looks like, what it is made of, the weather it tends to bring, the cloud it is easily mixed up with, and a spotter's tip you can try on your next walk. Search by name, by two-letter code or by a nickname like "halo", or filter by height.

2. A log for your sightings
Pick the cloud, say how sure you are, add the time and a few words. Want a picture? Add one from your library or take one on the spot. Your photos stay on your phone. Sightings are grouped by day so you can scroll back through a week of skies.

3. A checklist you complete one cloud at a time
Logging a new genus ticks it off for you, or you can pull the little ribbon yourself if you saw it last summer. Every tick adds a cloud to a sky panel that slowly fills with blue. Get all ten and the sky is full. There is also a gentle nudge about which easy cloud to hunt for next.

4. Notes
Some skies refuse to be named. Write a note about them, link it to a cloud if you like, and pin the important ones to the top.

5. Stats
How many sightings, how many genera, your day streak, the last seven days in a little bar chart, which cloud you see most and how your sightings split across high, middle and low skies.

A few small extras: a latch click when you save and a timpani roll when a new cloud joins your sky (switch them off in Settings any time), light and dark looks, and a quiet automatic backup of your entries tied to an anonymous device ID. You can restore that backup or wipe it from Settings.

The cloud pages are friendly field notes for enjoying the sky, not a forecast. For warnings, your local weather service is the place to look. Now go outside and look up.

name: JobProof Turnover Reports
description:
Document a vacation rental turnover and send the host one PDF they can open.

Set up properties with reusable checklists for kitchens, bathrooms, bedrooms, and other areas. Start a visit, record what you completed, flag anything that needs attention, and take or import photos.

Choose which photos and notes appear in the client report. Review the exact PDF before saving it. Your records stay available on your device, and new report revisions preserve the earlier PDFs.

• Add room counts when setting up a property and add one-off rooms during a visit.
• Track task status, observations, and photo requests by room.
• Enter the service date and export a branded PDF with a readable reference and filename.
• Export a local backup and restore it on another installation of JobProof.

JobProof records the observations and statuses you enter. The app works offline, and recipients can open shared PDFs without an account.

Your first three finalized reports are free. A one-time in-app purchase unlocks unlimited new reports. You can always open and share reports you already saved.

name: Kakutei Shinkoku Japan Tax Log
description:
A bookkeeping app for foreigners in Japan who run a sole-proprietor business and file the kakutei shinkoku (white return, or blue return with the ¥100,000 deduction). Record income and expenses in English, Chinese or Japanese, one by one or as monthly totals at year end. Mixed business/personal costs (rent, phone) are prorated by your business share, and withheld income tax can be recorded. Bookkeeping, monthly totals, the "Do I need to file?" check and yearly totals cost nothing. The year-end fill-in checklist is bought per tax year: ¥980 per year, one-time, no auto-renewal. It follows the screens of the National Tax Agency's "確定申告書等作成コーナー" in order, showing each Japanese field name, an explanation and your own amount, from choosing how to submit to the final "sent" screen. Data stays on your phone: no sign-up, no ads, backup file export.

[What it does]
1. Home: this year's income, expenses, net income and days left to the March 15 deadline
2. Record entries with the standard NTA categories (通信費, 地代家賃, 外注工賃...) shown with translations
3. Started late? Enter one total per month
4. "Do I need to file?": general NTA rules with sources, including resident tax (住民税)
5. Year-end checklist (¥980 per tax year): white return (収支内訳書) and blue ¥100,000 (青色申告決算書)

[Note]
This app provides bookkeeping and explanations of the NTA's published general rules only; it does not give individual tax advice. Blue-return ¥550,000/¥650,000 deductions (double-entry) are not supported.

name: Kanji Rush
description:
See a kanji. Pick what it means. Then learn how to read it.

Kanji Rush is a one-tap Japanese game you can jump into instantly. Each question shows one character and four meanings. Get it right — or learn from a miss — and the game teaches the on and kun readings, plus a real example word you can hear spoken out loud.

A NEW DAILY, EVERY DAY
Ten questions, the same for everyone. Share your grid with a friend. Come back tomorrow and keep the streak going.

FOUR LEVELS
• Elementary — school grades 1–2
• Intermediate — grades 3–6
• Advanced — the rest of everyday (jōyō) kanji
• Insane — beyond everyday kanji

Prefer a long run? Play All levels, where Endless starts easy and slowly gets harder.

ENDLESS
How far can you go? One miss ends the run — or watch a short optional ad to keep your streak, once per run.

No account. No lesson tree. Just open the app and play.

The game is free to play, with optional ads between runs. A one-time Remove Ads purchase turns them off. Gems, streak freezes, and streak repairs are optional extras and are never required to play or learn.

name: Kaufpause: Impulskäufe stoppen
description:
Du öffnest Zalando, Amazon oder Temu, und zwei Minuten später liegt etwas im Warenkorb, das du gar nicht wolltest? Kaufpause setzt genau davor einen kurzen Moment für dich. Kein Verbot, keine Sperre: Du entscheidest. Nicht der Impuls.

SO FUNKTIONIERT ES
• Atmen: Öffnest du einen Shop, erscheint zuerst eine kurze Atem-Pause mit deinem Ziel.
• Parken: Wünsche kommen auf den Parkplatz und warten 1, 7 oder 30 Tage. Viele erledigen sich von selbst.
• Entscheiden: Danach wählst du bewusst: loslassen, später entscheiden oder trotzdem kaufen.

PAUSE VOR DEINEN SHOPS
• Für Amazon, Zalando, About You, Temu, Shein, Otto, eBay, H&M, Kleinanzeigen, Etsy und Lieferando.
• Einrichtung mit der Kurzbefehle-App von Apple, für viele Shops mit fertigem Kurzbefehl und Schritt-für-Schritt-Anleitung.
• „Trotzdem weiter“ ist immer möglich.

DEIN ZIEL
• Leg fest, worauf du sparst, zum Beispiel eine Reise.
• Ausgelassene Käufe kannst du für dein Ziel vormerken und umbuchen.

30-TAGE-PROGRAMM
• 2–3 Minuten am Tag: Auslöser verstehen, einen Wenn-dann-Plan bauen, Reize abstellen.
• Danach hält dich der Erhaltungsmodus dran.

DEIN FORTSCHRITT
• Abgewendete Impulse, losgelassene Wünsche und vorgemerktes Geld.
• Deine häufigsten Auslöser und Tageszeiten.
• Skip-Karten zum Teilen.

DATENSCHUTZ
Kein Konto, keine E-Mail. Dein Ziel, deine Wünsche und deine Zahlen bleiben auf deinem Gerät.

KOSTENLOS UND PRO
Kostenlos: Pause vor 1 Shop, 3 geparkte Wünsche und die ersten 3 Programmtage.
Kaufpause Pro: Pause vor bis zu 3 Shops, unbegrenzter Parkplatz, das ganze Programm und die Statistik. Jahresabo 24,99 € mit 7 Tagen gratis, Monatsabo 3,99 € oder einmalig 59,99 € für dauerhaften Zugang. Das Abo verlängert sich automatisch, wenn du es nicht mindestens 24 Stunden vor Ablauf in den Einstellungen deines Apple-Kontos kündigst.

Nutzungsbedingungen: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Datenschutz: https://kaufpause.com/datenschutz

Kaufpause ist ein Selbsthilfe-Werkzeug und ersetzt keine Beratung oder Behandlung. Wenn Kaufen zum Problem wird, findest du in der App Hilfe-Stellen.

name: KernelGater
description:
Το KernelGate είναι για αρχηγούς μηχανών καλαμποκιού. Καταγράφετε υγρασία καρπού σε σταθερά σημεία. Όταν η καμπύλη πιάσει το κατώφλι, ανοίγει το παράθυρο συγκομιδής και στέλνετε μηχανή. Μετά το κόψιμο, θραύση, προσμείξεις και τελική υγρασία μπαίνουν στο ίδιο αρχείο.
﻿
Πώς το χρησιμοποιείτε
1. Χωράφια: νέο χωράφι, κατώφλι υγρασίας, σημεία δειγματοληψίας.
2. Υγρασία: διαδοχικές μετρήσεις και καμπύλη με γραμμή κατωφλίου. Κατάσταση: Έτοιμο, Πλησιάζει, Αναμονή.
3. Αποστολή: μόνο έτοιμα χωράφια χωρίς ανοιχτή εντολή. Διαθέσιμη μηχανή, νέα εντολή, έναρξη εργασίας.
4. Στην ολοκλήρωση: θραύση, προσμείξεις, τελική υγρασία. Μία αρχειοθέτηση ανά εντολή.
5. Αρχική: πρώτο χωράφι στο παράθυρο, ουρά ετοίμων, μέση θραύση, εξοικονόμηση ξήρανσης. Ο στόλος ανοίγει από την Αρχική.

name: KVITZ – Receipts & Statements
description:
No more hunting for receipts when the card statement arrives. KVITZ collects your business receipts, matches them to your company card and shows you instantly which ones are missing.

HOW IT WORKS
• Snap a receipt or pick a photo – KVITZ reads the merchant, date, amount and currency automatically
• Import your card statement – every line is matched to your receipts in seconds
• See exactly which receipts are missing and snap them on the spot
• Create a finished PDF report with a summary, all receipts and the statement
• Monthly report by category: hotel, parking, fuel, client entertainment and more
• Multiple currencies – made for business travel abroad

YOUR RECEIPTS STAY WITH YOU
Everything is stored only on your iPhone. Reading happens on the device – nothing is sent to a server, and there are no accounts, no ads and no tracking. Back up to iCloud Drive whenever you like.

KVITZ PRO
Try every feature free for one month. After that, KVITZ Pro is a low monthly subscription – the price in your currency is shown before you subscribe. Without a subscription you can still view and export your saved receipts.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in Settings → your name → Subscriptions.

Privacy policy: https://kvitz.app/#privacy
Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Support: support@kvitz.app

name: KynzaviMorthul
description: UV disinfection calculator: flow rate, UV dose, lamps, reactor and operating costs.

name: Lakeline: Lake Steamer Co.
description:
The valley's villages sit around a mountain lake with no roads between them. You own one small steamer and three piers. Make it a company.

Every line is yours to draw. Tap the piers in the order your boats should call, choose the boats, set the fares, hire the captains. Then watch the lake: who is waiting on which pier, who gave up and went home, which boat earned its coal this month and which didn't.

Lake by lake, the business grows:
• Harrow Water. Eight villages, passengers only. Learn the trade: piers, lines, captains, breakdowns and the bank.
• Larch Mere. Freight. Logs from the timber camps to the sawmill, planks to the towns so they can grow, fish that spoils in a day, mail that pays for speed. Camps you neglect shrink and close.
• Northshore Lake. A rival. The Northshore Packet Co. opens lines where you serve badly, undercuts your fares and bids for the landing rights to your towns. Win the travellers back, or buy them out.
• The Great Lake. Everything at once: twenty-two places, a quarry, long winters and a rival that fights harder.

Every lake has its own goal and deadline. Chart it to open the next one; your grade earns reputation, which brings a bigger loan and better boats sooner. Your best captains come with you.

The seasons matter. Summer brings tourists. Autumn brings storms. In winter the north freezes and only an ice-class tug gets through.

Made to be run, not watched. No offline income, no timers, no energy. The company makes money when your lines are good and loses it when they aren't, and two months in the red ends it.

No ads. Company cash can be bought if you want to grow faster, but every lake can be won without it, and bought cash never counts toward a lake's goal.

name: Latch Remote
description:
Latch is a fast, simple remote for the original Hatch Rest sound machine.

If you've ever stood in a dark hallway waiting for an app to connect while your kid asks if they can get up yet, Latch is for you. It connects in seconds and puts the light and sound one tap away.

ONE-TAP CONTROLS
• Turn your Hatch Rest on or off right from the home screen
• Pick a color, rainbow mode or a custom color, and set brightness
• Choose from all of the Rest's sounds and set the volume
• Control every Hatch in your home from one screen, or turn them all off at once

FAVORITES AND WIDGET
• Save favorites like a green "OK to come out" light or a red "Stay in bed"
• Apply a favorite to one Hatch or several at once
• Add the Latch widget to your Home Screen and switch with a single tap, without opening the app

PROGRAMS
• View, create, edit and delete the schedules saved on your Hatch
• Turn programs on and off with a switch
• Programs run on the Hatch itself, even when your phone is away

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account and no sign-up
• No ads, analytics or tracking
• Everything stays on your phone and your Hatch

WORKS WITH
The original Bluetooth Hatch Rest (1st generation). The Hatch Rest+, Rest 2nd Gen and Restore aren't supported yet.

Don't have a Hatch nearby? Tap "Try a demo" to look around.

Latch is an independent app. It isn't affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Hatch Baby, Inc. Hatch and Hatch Rest are trademarks of Hatch Baby, Inc.

name: Leapshot: Vertical Jump Test
description:
Leapshot measures your vertical jump from a slow-motion video. Lean your phone on a shoe, step back and jump. It times how long you were in the air, frame by frame, and turns that into your height in inches or centimeters.

Then it shows the jump as one picture: you, five times along the jump from crouch to landing, the highest one lit up, your height beside it.

No ads, no account, and the video never leaves your phone.

HOW IT MEASURES
• Films in slow motion, up to 240 frames a second. The front camera (120 on most iPhones) lets you watch the screen while you set up
• Finds the last frame your feet touch the floor and the first frame they come back down
• Times the flight from the video's real frame times, never an assumed frame rate. A video too slow to time is refused, not guessed

JUMP ON THE BEEP
Tap Jump, step back until your whole body fits the outline, and hold still. A 3-2-1 countdown beeps, then you jump. Spoken cues tell you to step back or move over, and your height is read out, so you never have to walk back to check.

A LANDING CHECK
Flight time only reads true if you land the way you took off. Land with bent knees and the number comes out high. When Leapshot sees that, it marks the jump "reads high" and asks for another; that jump never counts as your best.

SEE THE FRAMES IT USED
Tap the picture to see the takeoff and landing frames. Think it picked wrong? Move either one a frame at a time and the height updates. Then share a card with your picture, height and date.

BEST OF 3
Three jumps in a row, one result: all three heights side by side, your best lit up, and how close they were ("All three within 0.4 in"). One lucky jump doesn't make your number.

SETTLE IT WITH A JUMP-OFF
Who jumps higher? Type the names, take turns, and Leapshot keeps the ranking after every jump ("Maya takes the lead"). The board puts each jumper's best picture side by side on one floor line, ready to share. Two jumpers free, up to eight with Pro.

WITHOUT PRO
Standing jumps, as many as you like, each with the picture, the landing check, the frame check and sharing. Best of 3 and a two-jumper Jump-off. History keeps your last three jumps and your best.

LEAPSHOT PRO
• Run-up jumps: stand on your takeoff spot, walk back on the count, run in and jump
• Dunk check: add your standing reach and see reach plus jump against a 10-foot rim, drawn on your picture
• Every jump kept, with a chart of your weekly best and the average of your top three
• Several athletes on one phone, each with their own jumps, best and reach
• Jump-offs with up to eight jumpers
• Measure a slow-motion video from Photos
• Export your jumps as a spreadsheet (CSV)

Pro comes as a monthly or yearly subscription, or Lifetime with one purchase; all three unlock the same Pro. A subscription renews automatically unless you cancel it at least 24 hours before the period ends, in your Apple Account's subscription settings.

FOR A GOOD READING
Lean the phone upright, 2 to 3 meters (7 to 10 feet) away, with room above your head. Use a bright room: slow motion needs light. Land on straight legs.

Leapshot records only after the countdown, with no sound. The video is measured on your phone and deleted after the result; only the height and the picture are kept.

Made for basketball and volleyball players chasing a dunk or a block, and the parents, teammates and friends who film them. A measuring tool, not a workout program.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://privacy-policy-c48db.web.app/privacy-policy-verticaljump.html

name: learn anything - micro courses
description:
Learn anything, one short step at a time.

Learn Anything turns a subject into a path of bite-size lessons, quick quizzes and conversations with an AI tutor. Each lesson is a few short pages with narration and illustrations, so you can learn something real in a few minutes a day.

• Bite-size lessons with narration you can listen to
• Illustrated pages that come alive as you scroll
• Quick quizzes that check what stuck
• Ask an AI tutor about what you just learned
• Who's who: a cast of characters and their family tree, unlocked as you go
• No account needed: just start

Start with Intro to Greek Mythology, from Chaos and the Titans to the Olympians, heroes and monsters. More courses are on the way.

Privacy Policy: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1PQuuWNY2aggo78T7tEDcqjxwpqM4Op_t/view?usp=sharing

name: Lesson Pickup Planner
description:
Completely free, with no subscriptions or in-app purchases.

Plan children’s lessons and coordinate drop-offs and pickups on iPhone or iPad. Lesson Pickup Planner is for parents, caregivers, and extracurricular education providers.

Add one-time or recurring lessons, filter the calendar by child, and record absences, cancellations, and makeup lessons. Add events to Apple Calendar when needed.

Assign each leg of a trip, claim an unassigned pickup, and manually confirm a drop-off or pickup. The activity history shows who recorded an update and when.

Invite specific Apple Accounts to an optional shared family calendar. Family sharing uses iCloud, and notifications depend on device permissions and sync conditions.

Keep records of tuition, refunds, and lesson passes. Export a backup file, preview a restore, or use personal iCloud backup when iCloud is available.

Providers can set up classes and sessions, publish an individual read-only schedule for an invited guardian, and handle rescheduling and waitlists under their own capacity and class rules.

name: Level One by Lagree.
description:
Download our app Level One by Lagree. to always have your favorite studio in your pocket!
From our app, you can plan and schedule your classes, view schedules, register, and much more!
Maximize your time and never miss out on the latest information that will always be at your fingertips. Don't wait any longer and download Level One by Lagree. now.

name: LGBTV
description:
LGBTV bringt deinen eigenen Jellyfin-Server auf iPhone, iPad, Mac und Apple TV – mit einer Startseite, die sich wie ein Streamingdienst anfühlt.

STARTSEITE
• Großes Hero-Karussell mit Logos, Parallaxe und Trailer-Stimmung
• Endlos scrollen: immer neue Reihen nach Genres, Jahrzehnten, Studios und „Weil du … gesehen hast“
• Weiterschauen und nächste Folgen in einer Reihe – pro Serie immer die neueste Aktivität
• Genres-Tab mit allen Filmen und Serien sortiert nach Genre

PLAYER
• Spielt fast alles direkt ab: MKV, AVI, HEVC, DTS, TrueHD, PGS- und VobSub-Untertitel (VLC) – HDR10 und Dolby Vision über Apples Player
• Vorschaubilder beim Spulen (Trickplay), Kapitel, Intro überspringen
• Pause-Übersicht mit Beschreibung, Folgen- und Schauspieler-Leiste per Wischgeste
• Zwei-Finger-Zoom auf bildschirmfüllend, Stream-Infos, Uhrzeit
• Mac: Tastaturkürzel und Trackpad-Gesten

SEERR & DOWNLOADS (optional)
• Verbinde deine eigene Seerr-Instanz und frage fehlende Filme und Serien direkt in der App an – inklusive Qualitätsprofil und ganzer Filmreihen
• Live-Fortschritt deiner Anfragen, optional mit deinem SABnzbd

PRIVAT
• Keine Werbung, kein Tracking, kein Konto beim Anbieter
• Die App verbindet sich nur mit den Servern, die du selbst einträgst

Hinweis: Für LGBTV brauchst du einen eigenen Jellyfin-Server (kostenlos und Open Source) oder du probierst die App mit dem öffentlichen Jellyfin-Demoserver aus. LGBTV ist ein unabhängiges Projekt und nicht mit Jellyfin verbunden.

name: Light Bulb Puzzle: Circuits
description:
Help Nine the 9V battery wire up lamps and LEDs!
"Turn on switch A and lamp 1 lights." "Flip the changeover switch up and only lamp 2 lights." Meet every goal with a single circuit.

■ Learn how circuits really work
• Electricity flows around a loop
• Switches, series and parallel, why short circuits are dangerous
• Changeover switches (like stair lights)
• LED polarity and what resistors do
Great for kids learning about electricity at school — and a real brain teaser for grown-ups too.

■ Ways to play
• Nine's Lessons: learn the rules step by step
• Practice: pick a level and collect 3 stars (clear, first-try pass, master route)
• Daily Puzzle: one puzzle a day, the same for everyone. Keep your streak going
• Time Attack: how many can you solve in 3 minutes? Chain combos for big scores
• LED Final Exam: test your skills with mixed lamps and LEDs

■ Puzzles are generated automatically, so there's almost no end to the fun.

name: LingoPDF: Translation Reader
description:
LingoPDF is made for Chinese-speaking students and scholars who read in English, and for English speakers who read Chinese. Instead of copying words into another app, you tap them where they are, and the translation appears right beside the line you are reading.

It translates between English and Chinese (Simplified or Traditional), entirely on your device. There is nothing to set up: English comes out in Chinese and Chinese in English. Nothing to download, nothing to sign up for.

TAP TO UNDERSTAND
• Tap an English word: the dictionary entry with phonetics and exam tags (CET-4/6, IELTS, TOEFL, GRE…), and the whole sentence translated.
• Tap a Chinese word: its pinyin and its meaning in English, with the sentence in English. Chinese is written without spaces, so the app finds where the word begins and ends.
• Quick mode: a short meaning pops up beside the word, so your eyes never leave the line. Tap the next word and it switches at once.
• Long-press and drag to translate a sentence or a paragraph.
• Drag a box over a diagram or a photo and translate the text inside it.
• Translate Page, one button: every paragraph is replaced by its translation and the layout stays. Tap a paragraph to compare it with the original.

SCANNED BOOKS TOO
Many classic textbooks exist only as scans. LingoPDF recognizes their text on your device, so you can tap, select and translate them like any other page.

MADE FOR SMALL SCREENS
Smart cropping trims the empty margins of a whole book at once, odd and even pages separately, so the text fills the width of a phone held upright. No more zooming and panning. Scroll, page or two-page layouts, night and sepia modes, search, contents and bookmarks, and smooth scrolling through books of thousands of pages.

PRIVATE AND OFFLINE
The English–Chinese and Chinese–English dictionaries, the translation models for both directions and text recognition are part of the app and run on your device. No account, no ads, no tracking, no downloads; your books never leave your device.

KEEP WHAT YOU LEARN
Star a word to save it with the sentence it came from and a link back to its page, then review your words at growing intervals.

FREE TO READ
Reading, word lookups, text recognition and smart cropping are free, with 30 sentence translations and 5 whole-page translations every day. Unlock LingoPDF Pro once for unlimited translations. It is not a subscription, and one purchase covers iPhone, iPad and Mac.

Translation: English ⇄ Chinese (Simplified and Traditional). Interface languages: English, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese.

name: LionsCont.
description:
LionsCont — Sua contabilidade na palma da mão!

Com o aplicativo da LionsCont, você tem mais praticidade para acessar informações e acompanhar os serviços contábeis da sua empresa.
Tudo para facilitar sua rotina empresarial e aproximar você da nossa equipe contábil.

Com o aplicativo, você poderá:
- Acessar documentos: consulte documentos contábeis disponibilizados pela nossa equipe.
- Consultar guias e impostos: tenha acesso às guias e informações tributárias disponibilizadas para sua empresa.
- Acompanhar informações trabalhistas: consulte documentos e informações relacionados à folha de pagamento, conforme os recursos disponíveis.
- Facilitar a comunicação: tenha mais praticidade no contato com a equipe da LionsCont.
- Centralizar informações: encontre em um só lugar os recursos e serviços disponibilizados para sua empresa.

LionsCont — Contabilidade, assessoria e parceria para o crescimento da sua empresa.

Baixe o aplicativo e tenha sua contabilidade mais perto de você!

name: LQW: Live Baby Lullabies
description:
LQW plays real lullabies live on your phone. There are no ready-made recordings and no repeating loops: ney, kanun and strings are played note by note on your device the moment you listen. The catalogue reaches from ancient Sumer to today, and Create composes a brand-new lullaby at every press.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• LULLABY — familiar, public-domain lullabies: Brahms' Lullaby, Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star, Suo Gân, Arrorró Mi Niño, Fais Dodo, Dandini Dandini Dastana and more, plus ancient melodies such as the Lullaby for a Son of Shulgi (Sumer) and the Seikilos Epitaph (ancient Greece).
• HUM — a deep, calm sound, with 11 tones from low to high. Noise texture: pink, white or hair dryer.
• WOMB — a setting close to the sound inside the womb.
• PULSE — a calm heartbeat.
• CREATE — composes a brand-new lullaby at every press. Three characters: Balanced, Calm, Lively. Save the ones you like to your Library.

DESIGNED FOR THE NIGHT
• A quiet, dark interface with a soft light in the middle that breathes with the sound.
• While playing, the text fades after a few seconds and returns with a tap. You can also black out the screen completely while the sound keeps going.
• No buttons to find in the dark: swipe up or down for volume, left or right to change the lullaby.
• When the timer ends, the sound fades out on its own with a long, gentle close.
• Keeps playing with the screen locked; stop it from the Lock Screen or Control Center.
• Two-step stop: a single accidental tap won't cut the lullaby.

SAFE LISTENING
• Baby mode turns on with one tap in Settings, and it turns on by itself if you choose your baby's age in the short introduction at first launch. It caps the volume at 70% and softens high sounds to suit your baby's age. You can turn it off in Settings at any time.
• We recommend placing the device at least 2 metres (7 ft) from the baby's sleep area and keeping the volume low. Sources: the American Academy of Pediatrics' 2023 noise policy statement and Hugh et al. 2014 (Pediatrics). LQW is not affiliated with or endorsed by the AAP.

PRIVACY AND SIMPLICITY
• No account, no ads, no analytics: we collect no data. Apple handles the optional purchase.
• Sounds are generated on your device; no internet needed to play.
• No microphone, camera, location or contacts access.
• The short notes you leave in the morning stay on your phone only.
• In 12 languages: Türkçe, English, Español, Deutsch, Français, Português, Русский, العربية, Italiano, 日本語, 한국어, 中文.

START FREE
One sound in every menu is free and plays for up to 45 minutes. "Unlock all" is a single one-time in-app purchase that opens every lullaby, every hum tone, every pulse tempo, all Create characters and long timers up to 8 hours. No subscription, no renewals. Bought it before? Tap "Restore purchase".

LQW is a sound and music app; it is not a medical product and makes no health claims.

name: Luffly: Sailboat Maintenance
description:
Luffly is the maintenance logbook for your sailboat. It knows that standing rigging is replaced by years, antifouling by season and the auxiliary engine by hours, and it tells you what's due before launch, during the season and at haul-out.

YOUR SEASON AT A GLANCE
• See what to do now: jobs before launch, in season and at haul-out
• Overdue, due soon and up to date, in the same colours as navigation lights
• Log the engine hours in one tap and get hour-based jobs on time

YOUR WHOLE SAILBOAT, SYSTEM BY SYSTEM
• Standing and running rigging, sails, hull and underwater, deck, auxiliary engine and safety
• Suggested intervals from riggers, sailmakers and engine manuals, always editable
• Start from your boat model and engine, so the list fits your boat from day one
• Reminders before each date, including the boat's insurance and inspection

EVERY JOB ON RECORD
• Log what was done, by whom and how much it cost, with photos of invoices
• A full history for your next survey, your insurer or when you sell

LUFFLY PRO
• Reminders for every element of the boat (the free plan covers 15)
• Sail inventory with age, hours and UV strip, and advice on your rig's age
• Season cost by system, next season's estimate and cost per engine hour
• Papers on board with their expiry dates
• Safety equipment required by navigation zone (Spain's RD 339/2021) and rules for cruising abroad
• Job list for the yard, maintenance logbook in PDF and CSV export
• More than one boat and unlimited photos

Pro is available yearly, with a free trial, or as a one-time purchase. Family Sharing is supported.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

name: Meridrape
description:
Meridrape prints globe gores вЂ” the long pointed map strips that are glued onto a ball to make a globe вЂ” sized for the ball you actually have. A plastic ball from a toy shop, a paper lamp, a wooden sphere from a turner, a classroom model: measure it, and the gores come out the right width.

How it works

1. Sphere. Wrap a tape around the widest part of the ball and enter the circumference, or the diameter if you have calipers. Add the paper thickness; the working diameter is D = C/ПЂ + 2t, so the paper's own thickness is accounted for.

2. Printer Calibration. Print one test sheet with a 100 mm bar, measure it with a ruler and type what you got. Many printers shrink or stretch by a percent or two; Meridrape scales every gore to cancel that out.

3. Gores. Twelve gores by default, in a sinusoidal projection on each strip, so the strips close up neatly at the poles. Pro opens 8 to 36 gores, round polar caps from 60В° to 80В°, and a central meridian of your choice.

4. Map Layers. A built-in world coastline, meridians and parallels every 15В° or 30В°, the equator and both tropics, and ocean names. The map is stored inside the app; nothing is downloaded.

5. Unfold Preview. See the whole globe peeled flat like an orange, zoom in and scroll around before you print.

6. Sheet Layout. Long gores are cut into equal parts with 8 mm glue overlaps and registration crosses that land on top of each other, then packed onto A4 or Letter sheets with every gore numbered.

7. Print. Send it to any printer from the standard print dialog at 1:1. The cover sheet carries a 50 mm check square and every sheet a 100 mm bar, so you can confirm the scale before the first cut.

Free and Pro

Without paying you get one globe, 12 gores, every map layer, printer calibration and printing of the whole set. Meridrape Pro is a single purchase that adds 8 to 36 gores, polar caps, your own central meridian, saved projects for several balls, and export of the sheets as a PDF to print elsewhere.

Made for globe makers and restorers, geography teachers building classroom globes, model makers, and anyone covering a round lamp shade. Everything stays on your device: no account, no ads, no tracking.

name: MULA: Plant Watering Reminder
description:
MULA is a calm plant care app that reminds you when each plant needs you, and asks before it tells. Instead of ordering a watering on a fixed day, MULA asks how the soil feels, so you water when the plant is actually thirsty.

A SOIL CHECK, NEVER AN ORDER
When a plant's watering rhythm comes round, MULA asks: how does the soil feel?
• Dry: water it, and MULA logs the watering
• A little moist: MULA asks again in two days
• Wet: this round is skipped
• Not sure: a one-finger test shows you how to check
Answer in the app, straight from the notification or with Siri. With Premium, also from widgets and Apple Watch.

GENTLE REMINDERS
• Watering and feeding reminders at the time you choose
• Quiet hours: never at night, never more than once a day for the same plant
• Calm reminder sounds made for MULA: kalimba, wind chime, water droplet, singing bowl
• Feeding pauses while a plant rests and starts again with its growing season
• One extra nudge when a check is very late

CARE PLANS THAT FOLLOW THE SEASONS
Every plant gets a four-season plan: how often to water, when to feed, when to rest, and a short tip for the season. Reminders shift on their own when the season changes, in the northern or southern hemisphere. Every number is a gentle starting point you can change.

YOUR GARDEN IN ONE QUIET PLACE
Give each plant a name, a photo, a spot (indoor, balcony or outdoor) and its light. Start from 20 well-loved houseplants and flowers, from monstera, pothos and orchids to lavender and roses, or add any plant with a general care plan. The Today screen shows only what needs you now.

A PHOTO JOURNAL FOR EVERY PLANT
Keep the little changes. Each photo becomes a moment in the plant's journal, and the care calendar shows the days you watered, fed and took a picture. MULA pairs your plants with quiet cut-paper portraits and posters.

MORE WAYS TO KEEP UP
• Watering round: when several plants are waiting, go from one to the next
• Little jobs, suggested by season: turn the pot, dust the leaves, mist, prune, repot
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets
• An Apple Watch app, and Siri: "What needs care in MULA"
• Pot tags: a QR code that opens a plant's page
• A seasonal temperature check for balcony and outdoor plants
• iCloud backup, and sync between your iPhone, iPad and Mac
• A printable care journal (PDF)

CALM BY DESIGN
Washi-paper textures, cut-paper illustrations and soft garden music. Choose Light Paper or Dark Forest. No ads, no account.

MULA PREMIUM
• Unlimited plants and photos (the free version keeps up to 10 plants with 5 photos each)
• Edit every plant's seasonal plan
• The full photo journal and posters
• Vacation mode: pause reminders or share a care sheet with whoever is helping, then catch up when you are home
• Weather alerts for frost and heat, from Apple Weather
• Light meter: estimate the light in a spot with your camera
• Answer buttons on medium and large widgets and on Apple Watch
• Invite someone to share your garden

Premium is offered as a yearly subscription with a one-week free trial for eligible new subscribers, or as a one-time Lifetime purchase. You can manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings. Any unused part of a free trial ends when you buy a subscription.

MULA's care plans are general starting points, not professional horticultural advice. MULA does not diagnose pests or diseases.

name: NewsTrace: News Verification
description:
You've got an article, a forwarded link, a post in your feed, and no easy way to know what's behind it.

NewsTrace is a Safari extension that traces the story you're reading back to its sources. It shows what can be independently confirmed and what can't, and it never tells you what to believe.

WHAT IT SHOWS YOU
• Who actually published this. Not the web address: the real publisher. When a story is carried by an aggregator, NewsTrace names the newsroom behind it.
• Who else is covering it. A live search of other newsrooms reporting the same story, so you can see whether it's widely covered or standing alone.
• How old the website is, from public registration records.
• Whether the outlet is accountable. Does it name its authors? Disclose its ownership? Publish a corrections policy? NewsTrace reads the outlet's own pages and reports what it finds.
• Institutional facts. For known outlets, founding year and current ownership, from a curated registry that is clearly labelled as such.
• Check a single claim. Highlight a sentence and see which outlets are reporting it.

CHECK WHERE A PHOTO CAME FROM
Ask NewsTrace to check an image and it lists other websites carrying the exact same photo, with social media copies shown separately. One-click links let you search it yourself, including a search sorted oldest first, so you can see whether an earlier use describes a different event. A photo turning up on many sites shows how widely it's been used. It doesn't confirm what the caption says, and NewsTrace never claims it does.

TRACE A SOCIAL MEDIA POST (Mac)
Right-click a post on the major social media sites and choose "Trace this post." NewsTrace doesn't rate the account. It traces what the post is passing along: where its link really goes, whether newsrooms are reporting the story, and where its photo appeared before.

WHAT IT WON'T DO
NewsTrace does not score outlets, rate them left or right, or label anything true or false. When it can't confirm something, it says so about itself ("I couldn't corroborate this"), never about the outlet. A story with no other coverage isn't marked suspicious, because that's normal for local news.

PRIVACY
No account, no login, no analytics, no ads. Article text and your reading history never leave your device. To do its checks, NewsTrace sends only small public pieces of information: a headline or short search phrase to a public news search (Google News, or Bing News when Google is unavailable), a domain name to public registration records, and requests for an outlet's own public About and Corrections pages. On iPhone and iPad, where those news searches don't answer the extension directly, the search phrase goes to NewsTrace's own service, which fetches the same public feed and keeps no record of it. Photo checks run only when you ask: NewsTrace's image service receives the photo's web address (or the photo itself, if its site blocks outside lookups), asks Google Cloud Vision where else it appears, and returns the list. It never receives the article, the page you're on, or anything that identifies you.

HOW TO TURN IT ON
On Mac: Safari → Settings → Extensions, turn on NewsTrace, and allow it on all websites.
On iPhone and iPad: in Safari, tap the page menu in the address bar → Manage Extensions → turn on NewsTrace. Then in Settings → Apps → Safari → Extensions → NewsTrace, set All Websites to Allow. Open NewsTrace from Safari's page menu on any article.

NewsTrace sends you back to the source. It never tries to be the source.

name: OrchFold
description:
OrchFold predicts the 3D structure of a protein from a single amino-acid sequence and shows how confident the prediction is, residue by residue.

Paste a sequence or a FASTA record (or import a .fasta file), tap Predict structure, and OrchFold returns a structure from ESMFold, the language-model structure predictor from Meta AI, through the OrchFold cloud service. Most proteins up to 400 residues fold in seconds.

WHAT YOU GET
- An interactive 3D structure you can rotate and zoom, with an all-atom view
- Colouring by pLDDT using the familiar AlphaFold Protein Structure Database palette: very high, confident, low, very low
- Mean pLDDT, share of confident residues and a per-residue confidence strip aligned with the sequence
- Export as mmCIF or PDB to open in PyMOL, ChimeraX or any structure viewer
- A history of your predictions, stored only on your device

HONEST ABOUT WHAT IT IS
Every structure is a prediction, not an experimental structure. OrchFold does not run AlphaFold 2, which needs multiple sequence alignments and GPU inference; ESMFold works from the sequence alone and is close to AlphaFold 2 on well-studied proteins, less accurate on orphan sequences. On-device folding is under evaluation and is not part of this version.

PRIVACY
No account, no ads, no tracking. The sequence you fold is sent to the OrchFold cloud service and ESM Atlas to compute the structure. Do not submit confidential sequences.

Questions: john@orchestrsim.com

PRACTICE ON REAL FAA CHARTS
Since October 26, 2026 the test includes images from FAA sectional charts. Practice on real sectional excerpts of Seattle, Washington and Dallas–Fort Worth: tap the airport, the airspace or the obstacle the question asks about. Pinch to zoom, with the chart legend one tap away. A drawn intro lesson teaches the symbols first.

EVERY EXPLANATION IS FREE
Every question you can see has a full explanation and its source: 14 CFR part 107, parts 48 and 89, AC 107-2A, the Pilot's Handbook of Aeronautical Knowledge or the Remote Pilot ACS. No paywall on answers.

KNOW WHEN YOU'RE READY
Home shows your readiness and your estimated score out of 60, area by area, weighted like the real test (Regulations 48%, Operations 25%, Airspace 20%, Weather 5%, Loading 2%).

A PLAN TO YOUR TEST DATE
Set your test date and the app spreads the questions over the days left, in sessions of 20. Spaced repetition brings each question back just before you would forget it, and missed questions come back sooner. An optional daily reminder tells you how many are waiting.

FULL MOCK TESTS
60 questions, 120 minutes, 70% to pass, the same as the real test. See which areas cost you points and review the questions you missed. A free 20-question check, weighted like the test, shows where you stand at any time.

WRITTEN FOR DRONE PILOTS
500 questions written for remote pilots, with no airplane-only material. Covers the newer rules that older apps miss: operations over people and declarations of compliance (the FAA's most-missed topic), Remote ID and night operations.

FREE TO START
127 questions, one full mock test, the 20-question check, the chart intro lesson and the Seattle chart region are free. The full version is one payment of $29.99: all 500 questions, unlimited mock tests and every chart region. No subscription, no ads, no account. Works offline. Restore on your other devices with the same Apple Account.

Independent study app. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the FAA or PSI. The real test's questions are confidential; the questions here are written from the regulations and FAA guidance cited under each explanation. Chart excerpts are from FAA sectional charts (public domain), for study only and not for navigation.

description:
Payvane turns the debts you owe into a clear, month-by-month plan and shows you the exact month you will be free of them.

SEE YOUR DEBT-FREE MONTH

Set the one monthly amount you can put toward debt, and Payvane simulates every month ahead — interest, minimums and the rollover of freed-up payments — to show your debt-free month, the month each debt closes, the total interest ahead and how much you save compared with paying only the minimums.

THE DEBT-FREE HORIZON
Your whole plan sits on a single bar. Each debt is a blue step whose length is the months it takes to clear, ending at a white flag on your debt-free month. Log a payment and watch the steps shrink.

CHOOSE YOUR ROUTE

ASK "WHAT IF"
Slide in an extra amount each month and see live how many months sooner you finish and how much interest you avoid.

LOG REAL PAYMENTS
Record each payment with its debt, amount, date and a note. Balances drop, the plan updates, and every debt keeps a balance history and a full payoff schedule. Debts that reach zero move to the Cleared shelf with the date you finished them.

CALM, HONEST GUIDANCE
If a minimum payment doesn't cover a month's interest, or your monthly amount is below the minimums, Payvane explains it in plain words. Choose any currency; numbers follow your region's format.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Sign in with email and password, or tap "Look around first" to use Payvane as a guest with no account. Guests can keep their ledger later by adding an email. Your data is stored securely in your own account and works offline. No ads, no tracking, no bank logins. Delete your account and every record any time from the Desk.

Payvane is a planning tool, not financial advice.

name: PBB Officiel
description:
Paris Basketball: basketball, show, tickets, news and live stats.

Basketball like you've never experienced it. Paris Basketball is more than a game: it's an American-style show, an electric atmosphere and a night out for everyone, with friends, with family, as a couple or with colleagues. The official app brings your whole world together: ticketing, news, live stats, a lifestyle store and exclusive games. Live every game to the fullest, wherever you are.

YOUR FAN ACCOUNT
Create your account in seconds and manage your supporter profile. Personalise your experience and keep all of Paris Basketball in one place: your tickets, your content, your games and your perks.

TICKETING AND WALLET
Your tickets always in your pocket, in a secure wallet. Get into the arena with a single tap, and resell, transfer or cancel your seats with ease. Enjoy the games at the adidas arena and the big nights relocated to the Accor Arena. Book your next basketball night and turn it into an unforgettable outing, whatever your plan: a game with the family, a date for two or a big night out with friends.

CLUB NEWS
Never miss a thing at Paris Basketball: articles, exclusive videos, behind-the-scenes content and social media gathered in one feed. Discover the roster, follow your favourite players and go behind the scenes of the club and its unique show.

LIVE STATS AND RESULTS
Follow every game in real time: live scores, standings, the full schedule and results. League, cups and European games: always stay one step ahead of the season.

STORE AND LIFESTYLE
Basketball culture meets fashion. Browse the official store and proudly wear your colours: jerseys, streetwear, collections and lifestyle pieces. The Paris Basketball style is worn on the court and in the street alike.

PERSONALISED NOTIFICATIONS
Get alerts made just for you: starting five, highlights, results, ticket releases, offers and exclusive news. You'll be the first to know, in real time.

GAMES, QUIZZES AND PRIZE DRAWS
Keep the show going off the court. Take part in games, quizzes and prize draws, test your knowledge, challenge other fans and win exclusive rewards and experiences.

Join the Paris Basketball community and live the game, the show and the lifestyle to the fullest. Download the official app and make every game an experience. Come on Paris!

name: Pet animal
description:
Pet animal is a visit memo for a pet clinic. Write who came in, the signs, the diagnosis, and what was done afterward. There is no account, and visits are not uploaded.

Home shows today’s visits, this week, and this month. Search by name, signs, diagnosis, or medicine, and filter by species. A follow-up, vaccine, or deworming date appears when it is due.

Add a visit with the start and end time, species, age, weight, chip, and the owner’s name and phone. Record more than one medicine, attach prescription photos, and leave a voice note. The same pet can be chosen again so you do not retype the profile.

Profiles keep breed, sex, neuter status, weight history, vaccines, and deworming. Desk lists the people to call, what is left on the medicine shelf, and a note for the shift. Stats shows which diagnoses appear most often.

Open a visit to share it or make a one-page chart. The chart is a memo for the owner. It is not a formal medical record or a prescription.

Records stay on this device and are left out of iCloud backup. Export a backup in Settings before you change phones, then import it on the new one. Pet animal needs iOS 17 or later on iPhone or iPad. It does not replace a veterinarian.

name: Pet Rais
description:
Pet Rais is a personal care journal for the animals and plants you look after. Notes stay on this iPhone. There is no account, and journal notes are not uploaded.

Today shows what is due from the rhythm you set: times a day, every few days, times a week, or times a month. Log a note when you feed, water, or check on a name.

Add a note with a category and a kind, a photo, a voice clip, food, and the amount you want to remember. Home searches by name, symptom, or food.

Data follows one name at a time, so a large amount does not flatten the others. Settings can add a category or a kind, set a reminder, and export or restore a package through Files.

Pet Rais is a personal notebook, not a clinic record and not a substitute for a veterinarian or a doctor.

name: Photo Cleanup: Compare & Keep
description:
Make room for the moments you choose.

Photo Cleanup helps you review similar photos, screenshots and videos you allow it to access. Analysis stays on your iPhone. Nothing is selected for deletion automatically.

• Find visually similar photos and compare them before you choose.
• Use local detail and lighting suggestions as a starting point. Keep every photo or override any suggestion.
• Review screenshots and videos. Known original sizes sort largest first; unavailable sizes stay unknown.
• Pause and resume a scan. Save review choices between sessions.
• Check the selection count before requesting Photos confirmation.

Visual similarity does not mean files are identical. Cloud-only or inaccessible items may remain unavailable until you explicitly request access or a download.

Scans, previews and saved choices are free. The free plan permits up to 30 confirmed successful item deletions per local day. Cancelled or failed requests do not count. Pro removes this daily cap. Store offers show their full localized price and billing period. Monthly and yearly subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled through your Apple account. Lifetime is a one-time purchase. Restore purchases uses the same Apple account. Cross-store purchase sharing is not included.

Deleted media can remain in Recently Deleted, and iCloud sync can affect other connected devices. Selected file size is not a promise of immediate recovered space. Photo Cleanup never permanently empties your recovery collection. It does not clean RAM, purge app caches, compress videos or upload your media for analysis.

English iPhone interface. Requires iOS 17 or later.

Privacy: https://photo-cleanup-app.vercel.app/privacy/
Terms of Use (Apple Standard EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: pique fit
description:
O pique fit é o seu coach diário: toda manhã ele lê como você dormiu e monta o dia — o treino de hoje, na medida da sua recuperação, e a direção do prato que sustenta esse treino.

COMO FUNCIONA

Você usa o relógio que já tem. O pique fit lê, no app Saúde do iPhone, o sono e os batimentos que o relógio gravou durante a noite e devolve três coisas, em português de gente:

• Como você acordou — um semáforo e uma frase explicando o que aconteceu com o seu corpo, mais a sua prontidão do dia de 0 a 100.
• Seu treino de hoje — concreto: o quê, quanto e em que ritmo, com o porquê e o erro que estraga justo aquela sessão. Dormiu mal? O treino de hoje já vem ajustado, e a intensidade fica pra outro dia.
• Seu prato de hoje — a direção alimentar que combina com o treino, em comida de verdade.

FUNCIONA COM O RELÓGIO QUE VOCÊ TEM

Apple Watch e os relógios cujo app grava sono e batimentos no app Saúde. Não exige relógio caro: sono e batimentos bastam.

ELE APRENDE VOCÊ

• Descobre quantas horas de sono fazem VOCÊ acordar bem — e não repete uma tabela genérica.
• Ajusta a leitura conforme você responde como o corpo estava no fim do dia.
• Mantém o mesmo treino por 30 dias, porque é repetindo que o corpo responde — e depois sobe o degrau.

MODALIDADES

Corrida, musculação, natação, ciclismo, caminhada e triatlo. Na musculação, o rodízio da semana sai da quantidade de dias que você consegue treinar, do seu histórico com peso e de onde você treina — academia ou em casa.

O QUE É GRÁTIS E O QUE É ASSINATURA

A leitura da manhã — como você acordou, sua prontidão e os números da noite — é grátis pra sempre, sem cartão. O treino, o prato e a rotina de recuperação do dia fazem parte do pique fit completo, uma assinatura mensal ou anual. O preço aparece na tela de planos antes de você confirmar. A cobrança é feita na sua conta Apple e a assinatura se renova sozinha até você cancelar, a qualquer momento, nos Ajustes do iPhone.

Termos de uso: https://pique.fit/termos
Política de privacidade: https://pique.fit/privacidade

SEUS DADOS FICAM COM VOCÊ

Tudo é calculado no seu iPhone. O pique fit só LÊ do app Saúde, não grava nada nele e não envia seus dados de saúde para nenhum servidor.

O pique fit é orientação educativa de treino e alimentação. Não substitui médico, profissional de educação física nem nutricionista. Para maiores de 18 anos.

name: Pitch Sketch: Soccer Board
description:
Pitch Sketch is a soccer whiteboard for your phone. Draw a session on a real pitch, show it one step at a time, and send it to your players before training.

THREE PITCH SIZES
- 11v11, 9v9 or 7v7, each drawn to its own size
- The 11v11 pitch has the box, the goal area, the penalty spot and arc, the center circle and the corner arcs
- 7v7 shows the build-out line at each end
- Change the size and every piece stays where it was
- Half pitch keeps the goal at the top, where most sessions happen. Full pitch for build-up play and team shape
- Two fingers zoom in and pan around

PASS, RUN, DRIBBLE, SHOT
- Each line is drawn its own way
- The US key draws a pass solid and a run dashed. The UK key draws them the other way round. Pick the one your players know
- Dribble is wavy, and Shot is a double line, so it stands out from a pass
- A plain Line, plus Erase and Move
- Undo and redo, or shake to undo

PLAYERS AND GEAR
- X for attackers and O for defenders, numbered
- N for a neutral, who plays for the team with the ball
- GK for the goalkeeper, and C for the coach or a server
- Mini goals for small-sided games, and cones for gates and grids
- A ball you can leave loose or give to a player
- Black, red, blue and green ink

TEN DRILLS TO START
Five for duels and finishing, five for rondos and games. Diamond duels, a first touch away from pressure, finishing with a chaser, a 2v1, a rondo with two neutrals, funino with a joker, fox in the box and a 7v5 build-up with two jokers, among others. Open one and it becomes your own play.

KEY GUIDE
The Key guide shows what every key and piece means, one tap away in Plays.

ONE STEP AT A TIME
- Give each phase its own step
- The step before shows faintly while you draw the next one
- Play it back to walk the team through it

SEND IT TO YOUR PLAYERS
- Every step in one picture, or just the first
- The whole play as an animated GIF
- A play file another coach opens in Pitch Sketch to change it
- In Files and Messages, a play file shows its play
- Share by text, team chat, AirDrop or Photos

YOUR SESSIONS, SAVED
- Plays save on their own
- Search them, sort them, and keep them in folders
- A whiteboard for quick sketches you won't keep
- No account and no sign-in. Your plays stay on your phone

ON iPHONE AND iPHONE DUO
The keys are big enough to tap on the touchline. On iPhone Duo, draw with Apple Pencil and rest your palm on the glass.

FREE, WITH SMALL ADS
Pitch Sketch is free. Small banners show only where there's room, and the pitch stays full size or very close to it. One purchase removes them for good, and lets you hide the "Made with Pitch Sketch" mark on what you export. There's no subscription.

name: Pixshoo
description:
Tausende Fotos, voller Speicher, keine Lust zum Aufräumen? Mit Pixshoo wird Ausmisten zum Spiel.

SO EINFACH GEHT'S
Links wischen: Tschüss! Rechts wischen: Bleibt! Pixshoo zeigt dir deine Fotos Monat für Monat, und du entscheidest mit einem Daumenwisch. Verwischt? Einfach aufs Foto tippen und es ist wieder da.

NICHTS GEHT VERSEHENTLICH VERLOREN
Alles, was du wegwischst, landet erst im Papierkorb von Pixshoo. Dort kannst du jedes Foto zurückholen. Gelöscht wird erst, wenn du es bestätigst.

DEINE FOTOS BLEIBEN BEI DIR
Pixshoo arbeitet komplett auf deinem iPhone. Deine Fotos werden nirgendwo hochgeladen.

SPASS STATT PFLICHT
• Monat für Monat aufräumen statt alles auf einmal
• Sieh, wie viel Speicher du schon freigeschaufelt hast
• Schalte Abzeichen frei, vom „Ersten Wisch“ bis zum „Jahres-Champion“
• Halte deine Serie und werde zum Aufräum-Helden
• „Heute vor …“: Stoß auf alte Erinnerungen

KOSTENLOS STARTEN
Jeden Tag 50 Swipes gratis. Mit kurzen Werbevideos bekommst du Extra-Swipes.

PIXSHOO FÜR IMMER
Einmal zahlen, kein Abo:
• Swipen ohne Limit
• Doppelte Fotos und große Videos finden
• Komplette Statistik und Rückblick
• Keine Werbung, alle Updates inklusive
• Mit Familienfreigabe

Nutzungsbedingungen: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Plasmaleikkuri
description: Plasmaleikkuri on plasmaleikkauksen suunnittelulaskin kaarelle, suuttimelle, kaasulle ja viistekulmalle. Se laskee kaasun paineen ja virtauksen, leikkausnopeuden, virran, tehon, kaaripituuden ja viisteen CNC-työstöä varten. Liukusäätimillä vertailet asetuksia ja tulokset voi tallentaa. Pro-versio avataan kertamaksulla ilman mainoksia tai tilausta, ja kaikki toimii offline-tilassa.

name: Pothole Pete
description:
Pothole Pete has one job: fix every pothole in town. Drive his patch truck through 50 parts of town and 300 streets, haul every PATCH bag, and stay out of the way of the Road Troublemakers.

Hit a pothole and Pete goes flying, with a few choice (censored) words. Grab the Green Light and the troublemakers run, so you can send the road crew home.

• 300 streets across 50 parts of town, from Rush Hour Row to the Industrial Park
• Eight Road Troublemakers: Road Work, Red Light, Traffic Jam, Parking Ticket, Orange Barrel, Parking Meter, Speed Camera and the Steamroller
• Earn stars on every street and unlock prizes in Pete's Shop
• Pick your driver and paint your truck
• Track your career: potholes patched, chopper rides, wrecks and more
• Steer by swiping, with the arrow keys on Mac, with the Siri Remote on Apple TV, or with a PlayStation, Xbox or other Bluetooth game controller
• Game Center leaderboards and iCloud sync between your devices
• Adjustable game speed and number of hearts

Grown-up humor: includes suggestive jokes and censored cursing.

No ads, no in-app purchases, no tracking. From AngelMark Studios.

name: protoselidaX
description:
Όλα τα πρωτοσέλιδα των ελληνικών εφημερίδων, κάθε πρωί, σε μία εφαρμογή. Πολιτικές, κυριακάτικες, αθλητικές, οικονομικές, εβδομαδιαίες και περιφερειακές εφημερίδες και περιοδικά, σε υψηλή ανάλυση, μόλις κυκλοφορήσουν.

ΤΑ ΠΡΩΤΟΣΕΛΙΔΑ ΤΗΣ ΗΜΕΡΑΣ
• Όλες οι εφημερίδες της ημέρας σε ένα «ράφι», ανά κατηγορία
• Νέα πρωτοσέλιδα μόλις κυκλοφορήσουν, από τα μεσάνυχτα ως το πρωί

ΖΟΥΜ ΣΕ ΚΑΘΕ ΤΙΤΛΟ
• Πάτα ένα πρωτοσέλιδο για πλήρη οθόνη
• Δύο δάχτυλα ή διπλό πάτημα για ζουμ, με καθαρά γράμματα ακόμη και στα ψιλά
• Σύρε δεξιά–αριστερά για την επόμενη εφημερίδα

ΟΙ ΔΙΚΕΣ ΣΟΥ ΕΦΗΜΕΡΙΔΕΣ
• Πάτα τον σελιδοδείκτη και οι εφημερίδες σου έρχονται πρώτες, κάθε μέρα, και στη δική τους καρτέλα
• Πρωινή υπενθύμιση στις 7:30 για τα σημερινά πρωτοσέλιδα

ΑΡΧΕΙΟ
• Τα πρωτοσέλιδα κάθε προηγούμενης μέρας, από τη λωρίδα με τις ημερομηνίες ή το ημερολόγιο
• Τα πρωτοσέλιδα μιας εφημερίδας τις τελευταίες 3 εβδομάδες

ΚΑΙ ΑΚΟΜΗ
• Κοινοποίηση πρωτοσέλιδου σε φίλους και αποθήκευση στις Φωτογραφίες σε υψηλή ανάλυση
• Αναζήτηση εφημερίδας με ελληνικά ή λατινικά (π.χ. kathimerini)
• Σκούρο θέμα για το βράδυ

Τα πρωτοσέλιδα προέρχονται από το protoselidax.gr και ανήκουν στις εφημερίδες τους.

name: Providocs Care
description:
Providocs Care is the mobile app for staff of agencies that use Providocs. Sign in with the account your agency created for you and get your day's work in one place.

• Attendance: clock in and out of client visits and review your attendance history.
• Schedule: see your upcoming appointments and what is coming up today on your dashboard.
• Availability: set and update the days and hours you can work.
• Documentation: complete daily documentation and incident reports for the clients you support.
• Team chat: message coworkers and share photos and files.
• Notifications: get alerts about schedule changes and messages.
• Profile and security: keep your details up to date, manage your signature and sign in securely.

Providocs Care requires an account created by your agency. If you don't have one yet, contact your agency administrator.

name: PUTYAVTO: подсветка авто
description:
PUTYAVTO: приложение для управления подсветкой салона автомобиля PUTYAVTO по Bluetooth. Подключите любые комплекты подсветки PUTYAVTO и настраивайте свет со смартфона за пару касаний.

ЦВЕТ
• Цветовой круг и быстрые цвета для точного выбора оттенка
• Плавная регулировка яркости от 0 до 100%
• «Мои цвета»: сохраняйте любимые оттенки и включайте их одним касанием

ЭФФЕКТЫ
• Готовая коллекция световых сценариев: «Красная луна», «Синий рассвет», «Океанский синий», «Розовый Майами», «Закат Малибу» и другие
• Конструктор эффектов: создайте свою последовательность цветов, редактируйте и удаляйте её в любой момент

СВЕТОМУЗЫКА
• Подсветка реагирует на музыку в салоне через микрофон смартфона
• Несколько режимов реакции, выбор основного цвета
• Настройка яркости и чувствительности под громкость и жанр

НЕСКОЛЬКО УСТРОЙСТВ
• Управляйте всеми комплектами PUTYAVTO в машине из одного приложения
• Статус подключения каждого устройства на главном экране
• Быстрое включение и выключение подсветки

УДОБСТВО
• Светлая, тёмная или системная тема оформления
• Калибровка баланса белого для точной цветопередачи
• Без регистрации и без рекламы

Приложение работает с комплектами подсветки PUTYAVTO. Есть вопросы или идеи по развитию приложения? Напишите нам прямо из приложения, мы читаем каждое сообщение.

name: Quarter ClassFinder
description:
Plan a Stanford quarter one week at a time: search every course, lay out lectures and sections on a weekly grid, keep count of your Ways, and find your classroom on the campus map.

Unofficial. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Stanford University. Quarter ClassFinder is an independent app built from Stanford's public ExploreCourses catalog. Always confirm enrolment, requirements and deadlines in the university's official systems.

SEARCH EVERY COURSE
Look up any course this academic year by code, title or instructor. Filter by quarter (Autumn, Winter, Spring, Summer), Ways requirement, units, grading basis (letter or CR/NC), level, days off and time of day. Each course page shows units, grading, Ways and other requirement codes, every section with its meeting times, room and instructors, and live enrolment and waitlist counts loaded from ExploreCourses.

ASK IN PLAIN ENGLISH
Type what you want, for example "4 unit formal reasoning in spring with no Friday classes", and Ask turns it into filters you can see and adjust. It runs on your device.

A WEEKLY QUARTER PLANNER
Add a course and its lecture plus a section that fits drop onto a Monday to Friday grid. See your unit total against the usual 20-unit limit, spot time clashes at a glance, switch sections with one tap, and export the quarter to your calendar as weekly events.

WAYS AT A GLANCE
Count the Ways courses you have finished and see what is left across all eight areas, with a shortcut to courses that satisfy each one this quarter.

CAMPUS MAP
Find classrooms, residences, dining halls, libraries and athletics buildings. Tap a building to see the classes that meet there this quarter, show your own classes on the map, and get walking directions.

QUARTER CLASSFINDER PRO
- Unlimited Ask (free: 3 a day)
- Unlimited plans per quarter, plain-English clash explanations and one-tap Fix Conflicts
- Seat watch: a notification when a full section has room again
- Ways tracker that counts the courses in your plans automatically
Pro is available monthly, yearly or as a one-time lifetime purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period; manage them in your account settings. Browsing courses, sections, the planner and the map stay free.

PRIVACY
No account, no tracking, no ads. Your plans stay on your device.

Course data: Stanford ExploreCourses (explorecourses.stanford.edu). Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://gist.github.com/wonmor/795cf7e66bc8bedb4bfc72bb0e0bf755

name: Quillisse
description:
Quillisse är ett garderobsskåp som du förvarar dig själv i.

Ta en bild av en tröja, en klänning, ett par skor. Eller välj en bild du redan har tagit. Märk föremålet: överdel, underdel, klänning, yttre kläder, skor eller tillbehör; en färg; en säsong; vardaglig, smart eller formell. Bilden kopieras in i appen och stannar där.

Varje morgon väljer du tillfället. Arbete, vardagligt, en date, helgen eller formellt. Välj också väderläget: varmt, mildt, kallt, svalt, kallt eller regnigt, samt om det regnar. Quillisse sammanställer en komplett look från vad du har. En klänning kan ersätta både överdel och underdel. Skor är att föredra. En jacka är att föredra när du säger att det är kallt, och man lämnar den när du säger att det är varmt.

Bär detta idag – skriver ut looken på kalendern. Under nästa vecka rankas samma kombination lägre, så att du inte får samma outfit igen som igår. Tiden kan vara mellan tre dagar och tre veckor. Favoriter behåller en look du vill ha tillbaka. Atelier låter dig bygga upp en handverksmässig, bit för bit, och bära den istället.

En provgarderob är förberedd för den första lanseringen, så dagen blir inte tom. Ta bort den i Om när dina egna föremål är tillräckliga. Dina fotografier ingår inte i provet.

Vädret behöver inte ett konto och behöver inte nätverk. Den manuella valet är det som skåpet använder. Om du aktiverar Apple Weather frågar appen efter plats, hämtar dagens väderförhållanden och sparar endast en band, ett regnflagga och en kort anteckning. Platsen sparas inte. Om du avvisar platsinformation eller är offline säger Quillisse det och behåller det val du har gjort.

Det du hittar:

- Ett skåp med överdelar, bukser, klänningar, yttre kläder, skor och tillbehör  
- Etiketter för färg, årstid, formellhet och vikt  
- En förslag på arbetsplats, vardagligt, date, helg eller formellt  
- Ett väder- och årstidsval som fungerar även offline  
- Valfri Apple Weather, med tydlig reservlösning  
- Bär detta idag och skriv i en dagbok vad du har haft på dig  
- Ett upprepningfönster så att senaste look rankas lägre  
- Favoriter  
- Atelier, för att bygga en look för hand  
- Ett exempelskåp som du kan ta bort  
- Haptikfunktioner som du kan stänga av  
- Integritetspolicy och villkor, läsbara i appen  

Quillisse har inget konto och inga köp för skåpet. Om du tillåter spårning kan en sida du öppnar mäta vilken kampanj som ledde dig hit. Att avvisa spårning gör att skåpet fortfarande är användbart. Om du avvisar kameran kan du fortfarande välja ett foto eller använda exempelskåpet.Om du avvisar foton kan du fortfarande använda kameran. Om du avvisar båda, så föreslår det garderob du redan har fortfarande utseenden.

Ett förslag är en sortering av dina kläder. Det är inte en stilist, inte en klädstil och inte en inköpslista.

name: Retune：耳コピ・練習用プレイヤー
description:
Retuneは、手持ちの音源を速度とピッチを別々に変えて聴き直すための音楽プレイヤーです。

■ 速度とピッチを独立して変更
片方を変えてももう片方は保たれます。0.25x〜4xの速度調整と0.5x〜4xのプリセット、±12半音のピッチシフトに対応。最後に選んだ速度は次の曲でもそのまま使えます。

■ 耳コピ・楽器練習の道具一式（耳コピツール・Pro／買い切り課金）
・ABループ（区間の繰り返し再生）
・10バンドイコライザー（プリセット5種）
・ボーカルキャンセル
・リバーブ／エコー
・逆再生／ノーマライズ／チャンネル分離（左のみ・右のみ）
・波形表示／トリミング書き出し

これらは「耳コピツール」としてまとめて折りたたまれているので、普段は速度・ピッチ・再生の基本操作だけが見えます。一度購入すれば永久に使えます（買い切り・自動更新なし）。

■ iCloudで端末間に同期（無料）
曲・プレイリスト・歌詞に加えて、音源ファイルそのものもあなたのiCloudで同期します。別の端末に曲を持っていき直す必要はありません。同期は設定からオンにでき、進み具合も画面で確認できます。（動画は容量が大きいため同期しません）

■ Apple Watchから再生・停止（無料）
iPhoneで再生中の曲を、Apple Watchの画面をタップするだけで止めたり再開したりできます。画面全体がボタンなので、目を閉じたままでも操作できます。音や振動は出ないので、寝る前にも使えます。

■ 動画もそのまま再生（無料）
動画は映像つきのまま、速度を変えて再生できます。ABループで区間の繰り返しも可能です。

■ 曲の取り込み方は5通り（無料）
Filesアプリ・動画からの音声抽出・Apple Musicライブラリ（端末内の曲）・マイク録音・Dropboxから選べます。

■ プレイリストとライブラリ（無料）
プレイリストは絵柄つきのカードで並び、好きな写真も設定できます。ライブラリで複数の曲を選んでまとめて追加でき、アーティスト・アルバムでの絞り込みや検索にも対応。シャッフル・リピートでの連続再生、歌詞表示（LRC）、ロック画面からの操作もできます。

■ 広告なし
広告表示はありません。アカウント登録も不要です。

name: Rincon Cubano
seller_name: RINCON CUBANO OF CAPE CORAL INC.
description:
Get the best experience with the Rincon Cubano Official App:

Best Prices
- Ordering directly from the Rincon Cubano app saves you money (including any delivery fees).
- Be the first to know about discounts & coupons.
- Our best prices are always shown in the app.
- Earn free food with rewards points.

Convenient
- Re-order your favorites in seconds.
- Get your food fast. Rincon Cubano Official App orders reach the kitchen first.
- Skip the search. Just tap Rincon Cubano.

Reliable
- Real-time order tracking.
- Accurate pickup and delivery time windows.
- Secure payments using bank-level encryption.

Support a Local Business
- You're helping a local business every time you use the Rincon Cubano app!

name: RITUAL PILATES STUDIO
description:
¡Descárgate nuestra app RITUAL PILATES STUDIO para tener siempre tu estudio favorito en el bolsillo!
Desde nuestra app, podrás planificar y programar tus clases, ver horarios, inscribirte, ¡y mucho más!
Maximiza tu tiempo y no te pierdas nunca la información más actualizada que tendrás siempre al alcance de tu mano. No esperes más y descárgate ya RITUAL PILATES STUDIO

name: Road to AGI
description:
In Road to AGI, you and four colleagues start an AI company in a little pixel-art office. Name your first model, decide how large a training run you can afford, and choose a post-training focus for the customers you want to serve. Once you’ve reviewed the model, keep it in-house or release it and see how many trial users become paying customers.

Even free trials use compute, and wages and rent are due every day. Open your first daily statement to see whether this model earns enough to support the team. Can you afford another hire or more cloud compute, or should you save the cash for your next training run?

name: ROMU
description:
測定結果を話す。フォーマットにまとまる。
ROMUは、ROM・MMT・形態測定・握力の測定結果を音声で入力し、所定のフォーマットへ整理するiPhoneアプリです。

部位、左右、運動方向、数値を、普段の言い方で続けて話せます。停止後に発話の文脈を整理し、対応する評価項目へ記録します。測定しながら話した内容を、確認しやすい形にまとめます。

【連続した音声を評価フォーマットへ】
「右肩関節屈曲120度、左は110度」のような発話や、途中の間、言い直しを含む内容の整理を補助します。確認画面で左右・項目・数値を修正してから保存できます。

【ROM・MMT・形態測定・握力に対応】
ROMのマイナス角度や小数、MMTの「3+」「3-」などの記録に対応。形態測定はcm、握力はkgで左右別に記録できます。

【元の文字起こしと照らして確認】
記録された項目から元の文字起こしを確認できます。初回の確認中は該当する音声を再生・一時停止でき、スライドで再生位置を指定できます。記録の保存後は録音を削除します。

【診断書・意見書の記入を支援】
身体障害者診断書・意見書の評価では、ROM・MMT・形態測定・握力を続けて入力できます。「全国共通様式第一」「横浜市様式」から帳票を選び、様式の該当欄へ記入したPDFの出力、共有、印刷ができます。帳票は、公的様式に基づきP-LABが項目構成とレイアウトを再現して作成したものです。

【音声認識と整理は端末内で】
日本語の音声認識と記録の整理は端末内で処理します。患者情報・録音・文字起こし・評価記録を、運営者やクラウドAIへ自動送信しません。アカウント登録は不要です。PDFの共有時は、利用者が選んだ保存先・共有先へ情報が渡ります。

【初めてでも使いやすいガイド】
初回はスクリーンショット付きの使い方ガイドを表示します。設定からいつでも読み返せます。

【利用環境】
iOS 26以降と、Apple Intelligenceおよび日本語の端末内音声認識に対応するiPhoneが必要です。iPhone 15ではPro／Pro Maxが対象です。Apple Intelligenceを有効にし、必要なモデルを準備してください。初回や更新時のモデル取得には通信が必要になる場合があります。

【ご利用にあたって】
本アプリは測定結果の記録・記入を支援します。測定そのもの、診断、障害等級の判定や医師の記載・署名を代替しません。音声認識や整理結果には誤りが生じるため、保存・出力前に左右・項目・数値・単位を確認してください。提出には、提出先が指定する最新様式と記載要領を使用してください。

記録は端末内に保存します。自動クラウド同期やバックアップからの復元機能はありません。機種変更、アプリ削除、故障等に備え、必要な記録は所属施設の規程に従って別途保管してください。

name: Ruiskuvalukone
description: Ruiskuvalukone on ruiskuvalukoneen mitoituslaskin puristukselle, ruuville, muotille ja ruiskutukselle. Se laskee puristusvoiman, ruiskutuspaineen, ruuvin kierron, L/D-suhteen, syklin keston, onteloiden määrän ja tuntituoton. Liukusäätimillä säädetään painetta, nopeutta ja lämpötilaa, ja tulokset voi tallentaa. Pro-versio avataan kertamaksulla ilman mainoksia tai tilausta, ja kaikki toimii offline-tilassa.

name: SAGANTX
description:
Glad you are here with SAGANTX. We steadily polish this Rhythm Manager so your day orbit stays readable, and we hope you reach out quickly whenever focus tools, move sessions, sleep windows, or weekly pulse views feel off.

Work, movement, and rest compete for the same clock. SAGANTX gives you a 24-hour orbit dial to see the shape of a day at a glance, then lets you drop into timelines, energy check-ins, focus and move sessions, and a sleep window without juggling five separate apps. The home orbit is the quiet center: phase, pulse, and what still needs attention stay visible before you dive into any desk, so planning feels like reading a map instead of fighting a checklist.

Shape rhythm blocks, walk the day timeline, run energy or focus sessions, adjust sleep, and review weekly pulse plus insights from the Command Dock—not a crowded tab bar. Preferences such as wind-down assist change real local behavior rather than decorative switches. Export and wipe keep the vault under your control when you want a clean slate. Everything is built as a local-first SwiftUI utility for iPhone, with Reduce Motion respected on splash, orbit, and timers so accessibility stays part of the product, not an afterthought.

Private by design: no account, no ads, no tracking, and no upload of your schedule. Blocks, sessions, energy marks, sleep windows, and preferences stay on this iPhone. SAGANTX only organizes your rhythm—it never sells your orbit, never requires a login to begin, and never sends your vault to a server.

name: Sai’kom Fidelity
description:
Sai’kom Fidelity is the app for Sai’kom partner businesses to run their digital loyalty program in Apple Wallet.

Customers add your card to their iPhone in one tap by scanning your QR code or tapping your NFC plate. Nothing to download on their side.

CREATE YOUR CARD IN 5 MINUTES
• Stamp card (10 coffees = 1 free) or points card (1 € = 1 point)
• Your logo, your colours and your own stamp
• Live preview of the card as it appears in Apple Wallet

STAMP AT THE COUNTER
• Scan the customer’s card with the camera
• Add stamps or the bill amount as points
• Give the reward in one tap: the card resets automatically
• The customer’s card updates live on their iPhone

BRING CUSTOMERS BACK
• Unlimited notifications on your customers’ lock screen
• Automations: lunch offer, “2 stamps to go”, reward unlocked, win-back of absent customers
• Targeted groups: all, inactive, close to the reward, students
• The card is suggested when a customer walks past your business

RUN YOUR BUSINESS
• Members, return rate, visits and rewards at a glance
• Customer profile with history
• Staff access: your team stamps from their own phone

Sai’kom Fidelity is reserved for Sai’kom partner businesses. To get access, apply at saikom-fidelity.fr.

A Sai’kom Agency brand.

name: SalesViking Agent
description:
SalesViking Agent is de mobiele app bij SalesViking, de AI-agent voor acquisitie via LinkedIn. De agent doet het onderzoek en schrijft persoonlijke berichten; met deze app houd je er ook onderweg overzicht over.

Wat je met de app doet:
• Icebreakers bekijken: lees de openingsberichten die de agent voor nieuwe connecties schreef, pas ze aan in een schermvullende editor en kies de verzenddatum.
• Follow-ups beheren: zie welke opvolgberichten klaarstaan, wijzig tekst of datum, of laat een nieuwe versie schrijven.
• Je connecties: open de klantkaart met bedrijfsgegevens en het onderzoeksrapport, en geef aan hoe relevant een contact is.
• Delen: stuur een lead met één tik per e-mail door aan een collega.
• Meldingen: krijg een pushmelding zodra er berichten klaarstaan.
• Instellingen: koppel je LinkedIn-account en bepaal wanneer je agent actief is.

De app is voor klanten van SalesViking. Je logt in met je bestaande SalesViking-account; een account aanmaken kan niet in de app.

Geen advertenties en geen tracking. Lees ons privacy statement op salesviking.ai/privacy.

name: Samurai Split: Video Cutter
description:
Samurai Split cuts a long video into several files.
Just choose a rule such as "1 minute each" or "100 MB each" and the app does the rest. There is no need to mark every cut by hand.

WHEN IT HELPS
• Sending or posting a video to a place that limits length or file size
• Breaking a long recording into parts that are easier to handle

TWO WAYS TO SPLIT
• By time: choose 15 seconds, 30 seconds, 1 minute, 5 minutes or 10 minutes, or enter your own value
• By size: choose 25 MB, 100 MB, 500 MB, 1 GB or 2 GB, or enter your own value

TWO METHODS
• Fast: splits quickly without changing the quality. Cuts are made at the video's natural break points, so each part may be slightly shorter than the value you set
• Precise: re-encodes the video and cuts exactly where you asked. It takes longer. You can choose the quality: Original, High, Medium or Low

SAVING
• Videos picked from Photos are saved to Photos. Videos picked from Files are saved to the folder you choose
• Parts are named after the original file, numbered from 001
• Your original video is never changed or deleted

PRIVACY
• Videos are split on your device. They are never uploaded

PRICE
• Free to use. A video ad plays each time you split
• Buy "Remove Ads" once to split without ads. It works on iPhone, iPad and Mac with the same Apple Account

NOTES
• Keep the app open until the split finishes
• You need enough free space to store the parts

name: Saudi Stocks
description:
Saudi Stocks shows share prices for companies listed on the Saudi Main Market and the TASI index, in clear Arabic and English, with a calm design for day and night.

What you get:
• Market: the TASI value and its change from yesterday's close, today's range, whether the market is open, closed, in an auction or on holiday, and how many stocks are up or down.
• Top gainers, top losers, the most traded stocks by value, and the 30 most searched stocks.
• All stocks: 253 stocks in one list. Search by Arabic or English name or by code, sort by price, change or volume, and filter by sector.
• Stock page: price, change and time of the last trade, day range and 52-week range, open and previous close, volume, market cap, P/E, a chart of recent closing prices, a table of recent closes and companies in the same sector.
• "What are my shares worth?" calculator: enter how many shares you hold and, if you like, your buy price, to see the value at the price shown and an estimated profit or loss.
• Favourites: save your stocks and drag to reorder. They stay on your device.
• Home Screen widget: TASI and your first four favourite stocks, in two sizes.
• Offline: the app shows the last prices it received, with the time they arrived.
• Dark and light appearance, large text sizes and VoiceOver, which reads each stock's name with its price and direction.

Before you rely on the numbers:
