• Prices are 15 minutes behind the market and refresh about every five minutes during the session. Every price shows its time and the delay.
• Figures are for reference only. They are not advice, a recommendation or a nudge to buy or sell any share.
• There is no buying or selling in the app, no account or sign-in, no ads and no tracking.

Data source: alashum-alsueudia.com. The app is not affiliated with the Saudi stock exchange or any listed company.

name: ScanNow Inspector
description:
ScanNow reads QR codes, barcodes and other machine-readable codes and shows you exactly what is inside them, as plain text. You see the raw contents and decide what to do next.

SCAN SEVERAL CODES AT ONCE
Point the camera at a label, a shelf or a circuit board and every code in view is picked up. Each one is highlighted where it sits and drops into a tray at the bottom of the screen, so you can always tell which result came from which code. The camera stays live the whole time, and a code is not scanned again while it remains in view. Two identical codes side by side are still counted separately.

A CAMERA BUILT FOR CODES
• Choose any lens your device offers, from ultra wide to telephoto
• Add digital zoom on top of the lens you picked
• Raise or lower exposure for glossy, dim or backlit labels
• Tap to focus, press and hold to lock focus, or focus by hand with a slider
• Turn on the torch when the light is poor

THE TECHNICAL DETAIL
Every scan shows the exact type of code and how it was built:
• QR Code: version, size in modules, error correction level, mask pattern, data segments and how much capacity is used
• Data Matrix: symbol size, data and error correction codewords
• Aztec: compact or full, layers and error correction share
• PDF417 and linear barcodes: rows and columns, check digits and GS1 application identifiers
• The raw bytes, as a count and as a hex view

For QR Code, Data Matrix and Aztec, ScanNow also measures the damage in the code you actually scanned: how many modules were read wrong and how much of the error correction budget that used up.

SCAN FROM A PHOTO
Pick a picture from your photo library or from Files. ScanNow only receives the picture you choose and never asks for access to your library. Zoom, rotate and adjust brightness until a difficult code reads.

HISTORY
Every scan is saved with the original image it came from and the code outlined in it, so you can go back and check what you scanned. History can be switched off, and it is stored only on your device.

CODES YOU CAN SCAN
QR Code, Micro QR Code, rMQR Code, Data Matrix, Aztec, MaxiCode, PDF417, MicroPDF417, EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A, UPC-E, GS1 DataBar, Code 128, Code 39, Code 93, Codabar, Interleaved 2 of 5, ITF-14, MSI Plessey and DX film edge codes. Turn individual types on or off in Settings.

QR Code is a registered trademark of DENSO WAVE INCORPORATED. GS1 is a registered trademark of GS1 AISBL.

name: SeedO
description:
Dein Keimling springt von selbst – du lenkst ihn mit einem Finger von Blatt zu Blatt. Doch nach einer Weile dreht sich die Welt: Plötzlich geht es nach rechts, dann im freien Fall durch Dornen hinab, dann nach links und wieder hoch. Einmal rundherum – und wer mag, dreht sein Handy jedes Mal mit.

SO SPIELT SICH SEEDO
• Springen geht von selbst, ein Finger lenkt
• Dein Finger lenkt über jede Wende hinweg weiter
• Für Mutige: Handy mitdrehen – quer, auf den Kopf, quer, hochkant
• Im freien Fall ist alles Dornen: Steuere durch die Lücken
• Jeder Lauf zeichnet seinen Weg – schlag deinen Rekord

WAS DIR BEGEGNET
• Pusteblumen tragen dich sanft durch die Luft
• Knospen gehen auf und zu und tragen nur offen
• Wippblätter schleudern dich zur Seite
• Samen keimen, wenn du fällst, und sprengen Dornen

JAHRESZEITENLAUF
Jede Jahreszeit bringt eine Strecke für alle – mit eigener Physik: Im Frühling ist alles leichter, im Sommer trägt der Aufwind, doch Blätter verdorren, im Herbst treiben dich Böen ab, im Winter rutschst du auf Glatteis. In der weltweiten Rangliste siehst du, wo du stehst.

JEDEN TAG NEU
Der Tageslauf ist jeden Tag eine neue Strecke für alle. Halte deine Serie und spiel verpasste Tage im Archiv nach.

SORTEN
Erspiel dir neue Sorten für deinen Keimling – mit Strecke, Umläufen und Tagesserie. Im Laden warten fünf besondere Sorten mit eigenem Schein, eigener Spur und eigenem Aufprall: einmal kaufen, für immer deins. Sie ändern nur das Aussehen, nie die Wertung.

Kein Abo, keine Werbung, kein Tracking.

name: Sheep Salon
description:
Welcome to Sheep Salon – Build Your Own Wool Empire!

Turn a small sheep salon into a thriving business in this fun and relaxing idle clicker game!

Start by shearing adorable sheep, collecting wool, and earning money. Hire employees, upgrade your equipment, expand your salon, and build factories and clothing shops to grow your business empire.

GAME FEATURES

SHEAR ADORABLE SHEEP
Welcome fluffy customers into your salon, shear their wool, and earn rewards as you grow your business.

BUILD AND UPGRADE YOUR SALON
Unlock new chairs, improve your equipment, increase efficiency, and expand your salon to serve more sheep.

HIRE AND MANAGE WORKERS
Recruit barbers and cashiers to help run your business. Upgrade your team and keep your salon running smoothly.

COLLECT WOOL AND BUILD FACTORIES
Transform your collected wool into valuable products. Build and upgrade factories to expand your production.

OPEN YOUR OWN CLOTHING SHOP
Take your wool business to the next level by opening clothing shops and expanding your empire.

GROW YOUR BUSINESS
Earn money, complete tasks, unlock new areas, and discover exciting upgrades as your sheep salon grows.

FUN AND RELAXING GAMEPLAY
Enjoy colorful 3D graphics, adorable sheep, simple controls, and satisfying idle progression.

Can you turn a tiny sheep salon into a successful wool empire?

Download Sheep Salon today and start building your business!

name: Shelfwise: Board Game Picker
description:
Got a shelf full of board games and no idea what to play tonight? Shelfwise picks from the games you own.

SET THE TABLE
Pick how many are playing and how much time you have. Shelfwise shows the games that fit, favourites first. Narrow it down with categories like Strategy, Party, Co-op or Easy to learn.

DRAW A GAME
Can't decide? Draw at random from the games that fit. The tiles light up along the board and land on tonight's game.

ADD YOUR SHELF IN MINUTES
Type a title and pick it from a catalogue of about 6,000 board games. For many well-known games we fill in player count, playing time and category. Or browse the popular games and add them with one tap. Have a spreadsheet? Import it as CSV.

READ THE RULES
Every game has a profile with links to the rules on BoardGameGeek, Wikipedia or the publisher's site, and room for your own link.

GROUPS AND GUESTS
Save your regular groups with their usual player count and time, and use them on Play with one tap. Share a read-only link so friends can see what fits without an account.

SHELFWISE PRO – ONE-TIME PURCHASE
- Unlimited groups, each with its own link
- Exclude categories and "any of" filtering
- Live voting: guests tick the games they want, and the winner is drawn at the table
- Export your collection as CSV
No subscription.

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
No account. Your collection stays on your phone, and you can save a backup file whenever you like. No ads, no tracking.

Catalogue data from Wikidata (CC0). Photos from Wikimedia Commons, credited in the app.

name: SilversSong
description:
Turn the music on your iPhone into a player that feels familiar from the first tap. Choose a comfortable text size yourself, or set it up together with someone in your family.

Pick songs from your music library and SilverSong groups them into stations by artist. Choose Radio mode to resume listening and switch stations with a tap, or use the simple player with three large controls for Previous, Play and Next.

Try six spoken phrases to find a sound setting you like. While a song plays, hold a button to hear the original recording and release it to hear your chosen setting again.

Hold the album cover to bookmark a favorite line or the start of a solo. Give the bookmark a name and come back to that exact moment. You can also import time-stamped lyrics and tap a line to hear it again.

SilverSong plays compatible, unprotected songs stored in your iPhone music library. The interface and voice samples are in English. Your settings and bookmarks stay on your device.

name: Slice N Drop
description:
Fruit tumbles into the funnel and piles up. Swipe one straight line across the screen and every fruit in its path splits in two. Keep cutting until the pieces are small enough to slip through the neck and into the grinder.

Line up big cuts for combos, make every slice count, and steer clear of the bombs. A juicy little puzzle you can play one level at a time.

name: SloMoFlo
description:
You don’t always set out to take a long exposure. Sometimes you’re just out for a walk and take a few photos. SloMoFlo is for those photos.

Choose an iPhone Live Photo with moving water. SloMoFlo uses its short recording to soften the movement and give it that long exposure look. Set the amount of flow, give the colour a lift if it needs it, and save a new still.

It won’t get every bit right first time. If it misses some water, use Refine to brush it in. Keep sharp lets you protect detail you want to leave alone. Check Before to compare, and undo changes whenever you need to.

• Adjust the amount of flow and smoothness.
• Use the colour controls if your photo needs a lift.
• Brush in missed water or keep an area sharp.
• Crop your edit while keeping the photo’s proportions.
• Save a new HEIC or JPEG, or share a copy.
• Keep your original untouched.

Try the full editor with three free full-resolution saves or completed shares. There’s no watermark. After that, a one-off in-app purchase unlocks unlimited saves and shares. Editing and previews stay free.

Editing happens on your iPhone. There’s no account to set up, and your photos aren’t uploaded to us.

SloMoFlo needs an original Live Photo and its paired recording. An ordinary still, screenshot or JPEG on its own won’t work. Results vary with the photo; small cascades, fine spray and awkward edges can need a brush correction. The saved result is a still photograph, not a video.

Requires iPhone with iOS 18 or later.

name: Slotrix: Slot Car Racing
description:
Slotrix is a slot car track inside your screen: a toy table, two lanes and a single button.

HOLD TO ACCELERATE
Press and your car shoots off. Release before the turn and it glides through. Come in too fast and it skids, leaves the slot and may even roll over. Just like a real electric slot car set, the lightest touch wins.

A DIFFERENT CIRCUIT WHENEVER YOU LIKE
One button and the game builds another circuit: straights and turns of different sizes, with the scenery laid out to match. Your last circuit is kept for next time.

SOLO OR HEAD TO HEAD
Race an AI rival or challenge someone on the same screen. Choose races of 3 or 5 laps.

ON iPAD
One touch button per player: two can share the screen, one on each side. Phones on the same Wi-Fi can also be used as optional controllers, with nothing to install on them.

DETAILS
• Real physics: the guide runs in the slot, and the car can come out of it.
• Menus in English, Catalan, Spanish, French, Japanese and Chinese.
• No accounts and no sign-up.

name: Snovyd
description:
Сновид — перший український застосунок для ведення щоденника снів з підтримкою усвідомлених сновидінь.

ОСНОВНІ МОЖЛИВОСТІ

• Швидкий запис снів одразу після пробудження
• Підтримка усвідомлених снів з окремими позначками
• Оцінка якості сну від 1 до 5
• Швидкі теги емоцій та типів снів
• Статистика та інсайти про ваші сновидіння
• План на ніч для підготовки до усвідомлених снів
• Практики та техніки для розвитку усвідомленості

ОСОБЛИВОСТІ

• Повністю українською мовою
• Денна та нічна теми для комфортного використання
• Зручний інтерфейс, створений з урахуванням потреб українських користувачів
• Локальне зберігання даних — ваші сни залишаються приватними
• Експорт даних для резервного копіювання

СТАТИСТИКА ТА АНАЛІЗ

• Кількість записаних снів за період
• Частота усвідомлених снів
• Топ емоцій та місць у ваших снах
• Календар активності
• Графік прогресу практики

ДЛЯ КОГО ЦЕЙ ЗАСТОСУНОК

• Для тих, хто цікавиться усвідомленими сновидіннями
• Для практиків медитації та саморозвитку
• Для всіх, хто хоче краще розуміти свої сни
• Для тих, хто веде щоденник та працює з підсвідомістю

Почніть свою подорож у світ усвідомлених снів разом зі Сновидом!

name: SP Mi Auto
description:
SP Mi Auto connects your phone to your car's computer through an OBD2 Bluetooth adapter and shows you, in plain words, how your car is doing.

What it does:
• Reads the check engine light and the fault codes, and explains what each one means, grouped by system (engine, transmission, ABS brakes, airbag).
• Live: RPM, speed, engine temperature, battery charging, fuel economy and more, while you drive.
• Scanner: reads and clears the codes of the engine and of the modules the app recognizes in your car, with a confirmation before clearing.
• Emissions monitors: which ones are ready.
• Your shop record: the next service and what we see over time.
• Check a used car: before you buy, see what its computer says.

The app never changes your car's programming. Codes are cleared only when you ask, with the car stopped.

To sign in: SP Mi Auto is for customers of auto repair shops that work with HTL ServicePro. You sign in with your mobile number and a code sent by SMS (USA) or WhatsApp (Chile).

What you need: an OBD2 Bluetooth LE adapter (for example Vgate iCar Pro BLE 4.0, OBDLink CX or Veepeak BLE) plugged in under the steering wheel. Classic Bluetooth and Wi-Fi adapters don't work on iPhone.

name: Speeku: British English
description:
Learn to speak the English of London, Manchester, Edinburgh and the rest of the UK. More than 1,400 short lessons take you from your first Hello to a real conversation, all of them offline, with every meaning and instruction in your own language.

FREE TO START
Your first ten lessons are free, then one new lesson every day at no cost, and replays, culture lessons and flashcards are always free. One in-app purchase unlocks every lesson for good: no subscription, no ads.

IN YOUR LANGUAGE
Read the app and the lessons in Portuguese, Spanish, French, Italian, German, Polish, Romanian, Turkish, Russian, Ukrainian or Bosnian. Every meaning and every instruction is shown in the language you choose.

THE ENGLISH OF BRITAIN
Speeku teaches English the way people in Britain really speak it: Alright? and Cheers, a cuppa and crisps, a flat, a queue and I've got. Whether you are a complete beginner or picking it up again, every lesson is written for life in the UK, with a cup of tea, a trip to the chippy and a full English along the way.

WHAT IS INSIDE
• More than 1,400 lessons, from beginner (A1) to intermediate (B1)
• Over 15,000 exercises of more than 50 kinds: pick the picture, build the sentence, fill the gap, play the scene, match the pairs and many more
• Nearly 3,000 words and phrases, each practised until you can recall it on your own
• Every word and sentence spoken aloud, by six different British voices, so your ear learns the sounds of English from day one
• A dictionary of nearly 7,000 entries with British pronunciation, searchable offline
• Flashcards built from the words you have learned, which bring back the ones you are closest to forgetting first
• More than 70 culture lessons about the Britain behind the words, from the queue to the red phone box and bin day

SAY IT OUT LOUD
Speaking drills and flashcards listen to what you say and check that it was the right word. The checking happens on your iPhone: nothing is recorded, uploaded or kept. It tells you which word it heard; it does not pretend to grade your accent.

FOUR STEPS TO EVERY WORD
Read it, hear it, say it, recall it. A few new words at a time, and a word is not yours until it has passed all four. The exercises keep changing, so the same word never comes back the same way twice.

WORKS ANYWHERE, KEEPS NOTHING
No account, no sign-up. Fully offline: the lessons, the dictionary and the speech checking all run on your iPhone, and the app collects no data of any kind. There is a lesson waiting on the plane to London, on the Tube and on a train with no signal. Your progress stays on your iPhone, and Settings can delete it whenever you like.

No streaks to protect and nothing that tells you off for missing a day. Just a short lesson whenever you have ten minutes.

The download is larger than most apps because the audio, the speech checking and the dictionary come with it instead of living on a server. One download, and then it works anywhere.

Start free and say your first words in English this evening.

name: Stavehoop
description:
A cooper raises a cask from a heap of staves. Each stave is wider at the bilge, the belly of the cask, than at the head, its end. The ring only closes when the bilge widths add up to the bilge girth and the head widths to the head girth at the same time, within a single millimetre.

That is the whole puzzle, and it goes deep.

You pick staves from the yard and stand them on the ring. Two gauges show the bilge and the head: how far the ring is short, or how far it overlaps. When it overlaps, you can plane a stave's edge вЂ” but planing takes the same millimetres off both widths, so it never fixes a ring whose bilge and head disagree. Swap a stave with a steeper taper instead. Each heap also hides false friends: staves that match the bilge perfectly and ruin the head.

The wood has its own say. Two sapwood staves side by side will leak. A knotted stave must never sit under the bung. Press Hoop it and the hoops are driven home: gaps and overlaps light up, or the cask settles with a dull knock.

Every heap has exactly one cheapest set of staves, and Stavehoop knows how many millimetres it costs. Three stars mean you matched that proven minimum. Two stars allow five millimetres more. A closed cask is always worth one.

Real cask formats
Five traditional sizes, each with its own diameters: the 41-litre firkin, the kilderkin, the barrique, the hogshead and the 500-litre puncheon. The Cask Book lists their heights, diameters and girths.

120 casks in six chapters
Firkin Yard, Kilderkin Shed, Barrique Hall, Hogshead Loft, Puncheon Works and the Master's Shop. In the second half of every chapter the cask also needs a head: boards laid across its diameter, the two outer boards no narrower than 40 mm.

A Daily Cask
A new heap every day, the same on every device for the same date.

Coins without pressure
Coins come from your first raise of each cask, from hitting the minimum and from the Daily Cask. Spend them on hints вЂ” mark one stave of the cheapest set, or reveal the planing budget вЂ” and on workshop finishes: French oak, acacia or chestnut staves, blackened or copper hoops, a day or winter workshop. Casks never unlock for coins, and the balance never goes below zero.

Stavehoop Pro
A single purchase that opens chapters 3 to 6 (80 casks), a precise mode with a half-millimetre tolerance, the cask journal with planing statistics, and chestnut staves. Chapters 1 and 2, the Daily Cask and all hints stay free.

The workshop is quiet: no accounts, no ads, nothing to sign in to, and no data leaves your phone. Sound, vibration and letter symbols for colour-blind play each have their own switch.

name: StillPond: Breathe & Unwind
description:
StillPond is a pond of still water on your iPhone. Tap it and hear a real drop land. Breathe along with a ring of light, or let the pond go quiet at night with crickets and fireflies.

TAP THE WATER
Every drop is a natural-sounding plink, never the same twice, with ripples that spread across the screen. Taps make deep drops, a finger dragged across the water makes light ones, and the sound follows your finger left and right.

BREATHE
Turn on Breathe and one drop falls with every breath. A ring of light swells as you breathe in and settles as you breathe out, so you can pace yourself without counting. Choose your pace:
• Slow: about 4½ breaths a minute
• Calm: about 5½ a minute
• Easy: about 7 a minute
• Box: 4 in, hold 4, 4 out, hold 4

NIGHT
A moonlit pond with crickets, a distant frog and fireflies drifting over the water.

TONAL
Soft chords that drift slowly on their own, in Bright or Meditation.

MAKE IT YOURS
• Rain: from an occasional drip to a steady shower
• Echo: from dry to spacious
• Background volume
• Sleep timer: 15 minutes, 30 minutes or 1 hour, with a slow fade
• Keeps playing with the screen locked when a background sound or sleep timer is on

Every sound is made by the app as you listen. No recordings, no ads, no account, no tracking, and it's free.

StillPond is for relaxation and isn't a medical device.

StillPond™ is a trademark of James Beyersdorf.

name: Stop the Spiral
description:
Some conversations are hard to start. Spiral helps you work out whether to say something, what to say, and how to say it, before you're in the room.

DECIDE
Not sure if it's worth raising? Tell Spiral what's going on and answer two quick questions. You'll see where your situation lands and why, so you aren't just second-guessing yourself.

PLAN
Pick what you want from the conversation, and Spiral builds a short plan in your own words: how to open, what to ask for, and what to say if they get defensive or it gets heated. Tap any line to make it yours.

PRACTICE
Say it out loud. Spiral plays the other person, responds the way they might, and gives you feedback on what worked and what to try next time.

REFLECT
Come back after the conversation to note how it went and what you'd do differently.

Built for the conversations people put off: a friend who keeps canceling, a coworker who takes over, a partner who's gone quiet, a boss you need to push back on.

Spiral is grounded in communication research. It's coaching, not therapy, and it isn't a substitute for professional or crisis support.

SPIRAL PRO
Deciding is free. Spiral Pro unlocks full plans and out-loud practice for every conversation.
• Monthly: $3.99 per month
• Yearly: $29.99 per year

Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in Settings > your name > Subscriptions. Prices are in US dollars and may vary by country.

Terms: https://www.stopthespiral.app/terms
Privacy: https://www.stopthespiral.app/privacy

name: Stovetrip
description:
Cook real home food from around the world, one clear step at a time.

Stovetrip shows every recipe the way you'd learn it in someone's kitchen: a photo for each step, the exact amounts, and a timer whenever you need to wait. It's free, there's nothing to sign up for, and it works the same on your phone, tablet and computer.

WHAT YOU GET
• A photo for every step, so you can see what it should look like
• Built-in timers on the steps that need them
• Change the servings and every amount updates
• Metric or imperial units
• Add a recipe's ingredients to your shopping list in one tap
• Cook mode: one step per screen, big text, and the screen stays on
• Save your favourite recipes — they're available offline
• Search by dish or by what's in your fridge, like "egg" or "tofu"
• Rate the dishes you've cooked and keep a history

RECIPES
Start with Chinese home cooking — mapo tofu, egg fried rice, Lanzhou beef noodles, Cantonese rice noodle rolls, Xinjiang lamb skewers and more — and Japanese favourites like oyakodon and tamagoyaki. Korean, Thai, Italian, Mexican and many more cuisines are on the way.

LANGUAGES
English, Simplified Chinese and Japanese. The app follows your phone's language, and you can change it any time under Me → Language.

PRIVACY
No account and no personal data. Stovetrip only collects anonymous crash reports and usage statistics to improve the app. Details: https://stovetrip.appdevgpt.com/privacy/

name: Sufle: Teleprompter
description:
Sufle is a teleprompter that lets you read your script while looking straight at the camera. It works on iPhone, on iPad and in beam-splitter teleprompter rigs; you control the scroll with a Bluetooth remote, an Apple Watch, another iPhone, or simply your voice.

SCROLLING
• Smooth scrolling that eases in and out, with no stutter
• Voice follow: the text moves as you read and waits when you pause
• Target duration: tell it the script should last 2 minutes and the speed sets itself
• Rehearsal: read at your own pace and the speed is set from your reading time
• Countdown, elapsed and remaining time

FOR BEAM-SPLITTER TELEPROMPTERS
• Mirror mode and text that can be rotated in four directions
• A reading line with arrows; color, opacity and position are adjustable
• Focus: text away from the reading line dims, so your eyes stay put

REMOTE CONTROL
• Recognizes the Bluetooth remotes that ship with teleprompter rigs and works out their button directions itself
• Assign any action to each button: play/pause, forward/back, section jump, speed
• Apple Watch: a large play/pause button, scrolling or speed on the Digital Crown, and a tap on your wrist when the script stops by itself
• Use another iPhone or iPad as a remote

SCRIPTS
• Section headings, emphasis, breath marks and automatic pause points
• Import Word, PDF, Markdown, RTF and plain text files, or open them from other apps
• New script from the clipboard in one tap
• Folders, sorting, estimated reading time
• Back up all scripts to a single file and restore them

TEXT
• Six typefaces, size, line and letter spacing, margins
• All-caps option, four text colors
• Each script remembers its own speed and text size

PRIVACY
Your scripts are stored only on your device. No account, no ads, no tracking. While voice follow is on, your voice is processed only for speech recognition.

Sufle is for creators, teachers, presenters and anyone who wants to speak comfortably on camera.

name: Supersurf: Surf Forecast
description:
Supersurf is a surf forecast for iPhone with an alarm that rings at dawn only when your spot will be good. It reads the waves, their period, the wind and the tide at each spot, and says in plain words when to go.

- Your spots: now, tomorrow and the week, every hour good, fair or poor, and why.
- The surf alarm: checked the evening before and again before dawn. It rings only if the surf will be good, even in silent mode, and stays quiet when it is not. Skip tomorrow with one tap.
- A ring the moment one of your spots turns good, in the hours you choose.
- Hour by hour: waves, period, swell direction, wind and gusts, the water temperature and the wetsuit for it, air, rain and UV.
- Tides, sunrise, sunset and the moon, worked out on your iPhone, offline.
- More than 2,000 surf spots, and a pin on any coast for a break nobody listed.
- Your level: beginner, intermediate or experienced. Every spot says who its waves are for.
- The map: spots colored by day, each one from above with the parking and the walk, and the best spot within your drive.
- Surf schools and board rentals near each spot. A tap opens Apple Maps.
- Home Screen, Lock Screen and StandBy widgets, a Live Activity with the morning's call, and controls to switch the alarm.
- Siri and Shortcuts: check a spot, when the alarm rings, skip tomorrow.
- Sign in with Apple to keep your spots and alarms the same on your iPad and a new iPhone.

Free: three spots, seven days, the hour-by-hour table, tides, the map and widgets.
Supersurf Pro, bought once: the surf alarm, the ring when a spot turns good, every spot and 15 days ahead. Try it free for 7 days.

name: SURVORA: Offline AI Assistant
description:
The internet goes. SURVORA stays.

SURVORA is an AI assistant that runs entirely on your phone. Download the AI once, then ask anything, anywhere: on a plane, in the mountains, abroad without data, or during a power cut. Your questions never leave your device.

WORKS WITHOUT INTERNET
After a one-time download, every feature works offline, even in airplane mode. No servers, no waiting for a signal.

PRACTICAL GUIDANCE FOR EMERGENCIES
Get clear, step-by-step answers when you need them most. For critical situations such as earthquakes, fire, floods, bleeding, burns, choking, CPR and gas leaks, SURVORA follows built-in basic safety guidance, so you get the right first steps.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Runs entirely on your device
• Your questions, voice and photos never leave it
• No account, no ads, no tracking, no analytics

ASK YOUR WAY
• Type or speak your question; speech recognition runs on the device
• Listen to answers read aloud
• Attach a photo and ask about it (optional photo pack)

ANSWERS IN YOUR LANGUAGE
Write in English, 中文, हिन्दी, Español, العربية, Français, বাংলা, Português, Русский, اردو or Türkçe, and SURVORA replies in the same language.

THE RIGHT AI FOR YOUR PHONE
SURVORA checks your phone and recommends the model that runs best on it:
• Lite: for phones with less memory
• Essential: fast and capable in all 11 languages
• Standard: more detailed explanations and step-by-step guides
All models are included in the price. Only one model is kept on the phone, so no space is wasted. Downloads continue in the background, and SURVORA slows down automatically when your phone is warm or in Low Power Mode.

SIMPLE, RESPECTFUL ANSWERS
Short, plain-language answers anyone can follow, with no swearing, insults or adult content.

YOUR CHATS STAY WITH YOU
Chats are saved only on your device. Search, pin, rename, archive or delete them, and export them whenever you like.

ONE PURCHASE
No subscription and no in-app purchases. Pay once and keep it.

GOOD TO KNOW
• An internet connection is needed once, to download the AI model (about 0.8–4.7 GB depending on your phone) and the voice pack.
• Without internet, SURVORA cannot see today's news, prices or weather, and it tells you so instead of guessing.
• AI answers can be wrong or incomplete. SURVORA is not a substitute for a doctor or other professional. In an emergency, always call your local emergency number first.

Privacy Policy: https://survora.app/privacy
Terms of Use: https://survora.app/terms

name: Swappit — Swap with neighbors
description:
Swappit is an app for swapping items between individuals. List what you no longer use, say what you want in return, and find members near you who are ready to swap.

A SWAP, NOT A SALE
No prices, no haggling over money: one item for another. Swappit handles no payments.

LISTINGS AROUND YOU
Listings are geolocated. Filter by distance, category and condition to see only what interests you.

SMART MATCH
When a member is looking for what you offer and offers what you are looking for, Swappit flags it and lets you propose the swap directly.

MESSAGING AND MEETING POINT
Chat in the app, send a swap proposal in one tap, then let Swappit suggest a meeting place halfway between both members.

TRUST AND REPUTATION
Every member has a trust score based on completed swaps and reviews received: a five-star rating and badges such as "Replies fast", "Punctual" or "Reliable". New members are identified as such. You can report or block a member at any time.

THREE LANGUAGES
French, English and Arabic, with right-to-left support.

Swappit is for adults only. No financial transaction takes place in the app.

Terms of use: https://www.swappit.online/conditions

name: Swayly: Calm Body Pauses
description:
Gününde sakin bir durak.

Swayly, seçtiğin saatler içinde birkaç küçük hatırlatma gönderir. Her biri bedenin için 90 saniyelik bir mola açar: dört kısa yönerge, her seferinde bir nefes, ardından yaptığın işe geri dönersin.

Gününü nasıl geçirdiğine göre şekillenir
Sana en yakın günü seç; molalar bedeninin en çok yorulan bölgelerine göre şekillensin:
• Masa başında ve ekran karşısında: boyun, omuzlar, gözler ve bilekler.
• Gün içinde çoğunlukla ayakta: bacaklar, ayaklar ve bel.
• Ev işleri ve günlük sorumluluklar: nefes, topraklanma, çene ve omuzlar.
Her mola, o güne göre yazılmış yönergelerden dördünü seçer ve bir önceki molanın yönergelerini tekrar etmez.

Saatlerine uyan hatırlatmalar
Aktif olduğun saatleri ve günde kaç mola istediğini seç: 2, 3 ya da 4. Swayly hatırlatmaları bu aralığa eşit dağıtır, aralığın dışında sessiz kalır. Molanı erken mi verdin? O hatırlatma atlanır. Yoğun bir gün mü? "Bugün atla" kalan hatırlatmaları yarına kadar susturur.

Takip etmen gereken bir şey yok
Seri yok, puan yok, rozet yok. Atladığın bir mola sadece atladığın bir moladır.

Gizlilik önce gelir
Üyelik ve kayıt yok. Swayly tamamen çevrimdışı çalışır: tercihlerin iPhone'unda kalır, hatırlatmaları cihazındaki iOS planlar. Analiz yok, reklam yok, takip yok.

Sakinlik için tasarlandı
Yavaşça nefes alan bir halka ve yumuşak titreşimlerle sessiz, karanlık bir arayüz. Dinamik Yazı, VoiceOver ve Hareketi Azalt tam destekli. İngilizce ve Türkçe; dil uygulamanın içinden değiştirilebilir.

Swayly nazik hareket ve nefes önerileri sunar. Tıbbi tavsiye değildir; bir hareket seni rahatsız ederse bırak.

name: Tackle Football Sketch
description:
Tackle Football Sketch is a football whiteboard for your phone. Line up a formation, draw every route, block and run, and send the play to your team before practice.

THREE FIELDS
- 11-man, with high school width and hash marks
- 8-man and 6-man, 40 yards wide with 80 yards between the goal lines
- Change the field and every piece stays where it was
- A 40-yard view for the play at hand, with the offense going up the page. The full field when you need it
- A line of scrimmage you can move. Drag it in Move and it lands on a whole yard. Each play keeps its own
- Two fingers zoom in and pan around

START FROM A FORMATION
A new play can start from I Right, Split Backs, Singleback, Shotgun 2x2 or Trips Right. Or line up a defense too: I Right against a 4-3, Split Backs against a 4-4, or Shotgun 2x2 against a nickel. Or start from an empty field.

ROUTE, BLOCK, PASS, RUN
- Route draws a solid line with an arrow, and keeps its sharp cuts
- Block ends in a short bar where the block lands
- Pass is dashed, for the ball in the air or a pitch
- Run is a double line for the ball carrier, and keeps its curve
- Erase and Move, plus undo and redo, or shake to undo

ALL 22 PLAYERS
- QB, OL, RB, WR and TE on offense
- DL, LB and DB on defense
- Each piece can show its own spot, like G, TB, Z, Y, M or FS
- A football you can set on the line or give to a player
- Cones for starts and lanes
- Black, red and blue ink for lines, defense and offense

TEN DRILLS, READY TO RUN
Seven for tackling and three for blocking and routes. Fit and freeze, a form tackle progression, the tackle wheel, the angle tackle, routes on air, stance and start, a two-man sled drive and more. Open one and it becomes your own play.

KEY GUIDE
The Key guide shows what every key, every piece and the line of scrimmage means.

ONE STEP AT A TIME
- The snap, the blocks and the routes, each in its own step
- The step before shows faintly while you draw the next one
- Play it back to walk the team through it

SEND IT
- Every step in one picture, or just the first
- The whole play as an animated GIF
- A play file another coach opens in Tackle Football Sketch to change it
- In Files and Messages, a play file shows its play
- Share by text, team chat, AirDrop or Photos

KEEP YOUR PLAYS
- Plays save on their own
- Search them, sort them, and keep them in folders
- A whiteboard for quick sketches you won't keep
- No account and no sign-in. Your plays stay on your phone

ON iPHONE AND iPHONE DUO
The keys are big enough to hit on the sideline. On iPhone Duo, draw with Apple Pencil and rest your palm on the glass.

FREE, WITH SMALL ADS
Tackle Football Sketch is free. Small banners show only where there's room, and the field stays full size or very close to it. One purchase removes them for good, and lets you hide the "Made with Tackle Sketch" mark on what you export. There's no subscription.

name: Tadabox: Invitations & Cards
description:
Ta-da! Your invitation, card or gift opens like a surprise, under their fingertip. Make a digital invitation, an ecard or a photo gift in Tadabox and send its link. They open it in their phone’s browser, with nothing to install, and bring it to life: break the wax seal, light the candles on a birthday cake, light up a Christmas tree, unwrap a present.

WEDDING INVITATIONS
• Sealed with wax: guests break the seal and unroll the scroll.
• Names, date, time, venue and directions in one link. One tap adds it to their calendar.
• Ask for an RSVP; see the replies and the head count in the app.

BIRTHDAY PARTY INVITATIONS
• Four ways to open: they ring the bell and push the door; fill the foil letters of the name and float them up; break the piñata; or pull the switch and light the name up in neon.
• Age, hosts, date, time and place in one link; ask who is coming if you like.
• A surprise party too: the invitation tells guests not to tell.

CHRISTMAS AND NEW YEAR’S EVE PARTY INVITATIONS
• Open the day: guests open the party’s door on an advent calendar; the village lights up.
• Light the fire: stockings with your names and one that says YOU; guests strike the match.
• Pull the cracker: guests pull it with you. BANG: a crown, a joke and the invitation.
• Pipe the icing: guests ice a gingerbread house; out you come in gingerbread.
• New Year’s Eve: guests flip a board from 23:59 to 00:00 until it spells your invitation; draw in sparkler light for a photo with the new year; bring the ball down and light up the year; or pop a cork over a tower of glasses. On the night it counts down.
• Name the party: NYE dinner, Ugly Sweater Night.

BIRTHDAY CARDS
• Two ways to open: they light the candles on the cake one by one, or pull the ribbon and let the balloons fly.
• Add their name if you like. A short tune plays at the big moment.

CHRISTMAS AND NEW YEAR’S EVE CARDS
• Christmas, two ways: they wipe the frost off a cottage window or run a finger up the tree and light it to the star.
• New Year’s Eve: they count down with fireworks, one under each tap; at zero the last rocket writes their name in the sky.

ANNIVERSARY CARDS
• Three ways to open: they tear a page off a calendar until it stops on the day; pour coffee for two and the steam writes the names; or shake a glitter globe and its lights come on.

PHOTO GIFTS
• Put your photos in the box and write your card. They pull the ribbon, tear the paper and lift the lid; your photos come out one by one, your card last.
• Birthday, anniversary, graduation, new home or just because: each day has its own wrapping.

BIRTHDAY GIFTS: FOUR MORE SCENES
• Music Box: they turn the key; their photos turn on a carousel; your letter comes out of the drawer.
• Wish Lanterns: a photo on every lantern; they send each one up; one with their name rises last.
• Blow Out the Candles: they really blow on the phone; the lights come on in a room decorated for them.
• The Sky You Were Born Under: the real stars and Moon of the night they were born; a touch draws a constellation.

ANNIVERSARY GIFTS: FIVE SCENES
• The Tree of Our Years: every touch is a year; the tree grows, your photos hang from its branches; it blossoms.
• Our Film: they turn the projector’s crank and your photos play like an old film.
• Our Memories Develop: blank instant photos on the wall come up as they rub them.
• The Clock That Counts Our Years: it strikes once for every year together, a photo with each strike.
• The Sky That Night: the real sky of your anniversary night, two stars joined in gold and named after you.
• For your own anniversary or a couple’s.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Pick what to send, the day and how it opens, write your words and preview it.
2. Send the link anywhere.
3. They need no app and no account. The link opens on any phone.

PRIVACY
• No ads, no tracking.
• Only people with the link can open it. Delete it any time; the link closes at once.
• Delete your account from inside the app.

You sign in with your Apple or Google account.

name: Techverse CRM
description:
Techverse is the official app for Techverse Smart Solutions clients and team members. Order, track and approve your solar and EV engineering work from your phone.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Place orders for Sales Proposals, Plan Sets, EV Plan Sets, PE Stamps, Permitting and PTO / interconnection
• See every job's status, due time and next step at a glance
• Chat with the Techverse team on each project and share photos and files
• Get notifications when a job is delivered, needs your approval or has a new message
• Open delivered plan sets and proposals
• Keep your account private with Face ID lock

Techverse Smart Solutions provides solar PV, battery storage and EV charging design and engineering for contractors across the United States.

An account is required. Techverse clients receive their login from the Techverse team. To open a client account, contact us at techversesmartsolutions.com.

name: TextVoyager
description:
TextVoyager is a personal web and ebook reader with continuous background text-to-speech (TTS) narration, designed for distraction-free reading of content you own.

Features:
• Personal Ebook & Web Reader: Import DRM-free local ebooks (EPUB, TXT, PDF, MOBI) and accessible web pages for personal offline reading.
• Continuous Background TTS: Listen hands-free with background audio playback, Lock Screen controls, and Bluetooth headset media buttons.
• Speech Engine Customization: Choose system voices with granular speech rate, pitch, sentence pause, and paragraph pause controls, plus optional auto-advance across chapters.
• Sleep Timer: Set timers with 15, 30, 45, or 60-minute presets, stop at chapter end, smooth 10-second volume fade-out, and 10-minute Lock Screen snooze.
• Clean Reading Experience: Customizable bundled fonts (Literata, Atkinson Hyperlegible, System Sans, Monospace), font size, line spacing, paragraph bookmarking, and reading themes (OLED Black, Soft Charcoal, Warm Sepia, Daylight).
• iPad & Tablet Support: Responsive layout with portrait and landscape orientation support across iPhone and iPad.
• Reading Companion: Format spoiler-safe reading recaps and passage summaries strictly on-device, bounded to your current chapter and paragraph position.
• Privacy First: 100% offline core. No user accounts, no commercial ads, and zero third-party tracking. All library data and reading progress remain strictly on your device.

TextVoyager is an offline utility and client. TextVoyager does not provide, host, or distribute any books or content. Users are responsible for importing only public domain material or content they own or are legally authorized to access.

name: The Rage Bait Game
description:
Do not download this game.

It looks like a relaxing little notebook doodle. Kill the roach. Jump the gap. Pop the balloon. Open the door. You will read the instruction, nod, and fail. Then fail again. Then a red pen will write something rude in the margin.

Every level can be beaten. None of them can be beaten the way you think. The answer is always simple, always on the page, and always annoying once you see it.

WHAT YOU GET
- 14 hand-drawn levels, each with one sneaky trick
- A red pen that keeps score and has opinions
- Hints that turn up once you have suffered enough
- A grade for every level, so your shame has a letter
- Wobbly ink, squeaky sounds and haptics made for the joke

REELS MODE
Switch on Reels mode and your front camera joins the page in a little circle. The game records one clip per level, covers the moment you solve it with a big CENSORED stamp, and ends on your result. Post the meltdown, keep the secret. Clips stay on your phone unless you share them.

NO NONSENSE
No ads. No accounts. No purchases. Nothing is collected. Just you, a stick figure, and a cockroach that is laughing at you.

You were warned.

name: The Reformé Pilates Studio
description:
Jouw Reformer Pilates studio in Loosduinen, Den Haag.

Plan je Pilatesmoment eenvoudig via onze app.
• Bekijk het lesrooster en boek je lessen.  
• Beheer en annuleer je reserveringen.  
• Synchroniseer je lessen met je agenda.  
• Blijf verbonden met onze community en neem contact op met ons team.
• Beheer je profiel en persoonlijke gegevens.

Je hebt een The Reformé-account nodig om in te loggen.

The Reformé
The way to a stronger you.

Je kunt deze app syncen met de Apple Gezondheid App. Wanneer je deze connectie activeert, worden je workouts in de Gezondheid app automatisch toegevoegd aan je activiteitenkalender.

name: Tickwink: todo list e progetti
description:
Tickwink è l'app italiana per la tua lista di cose da fare: attività, progetti e promemoria che arrivano davvero, sul telefono e sul computer. Per te, o per tutta la squadra.

SCRIVI COME PARLI
Scrivi "Chiamare Paolo domani alle 15 #Clienti" e Tickwink capisce da solo data, ora e progetto. Niente moduli da compilare.

LA GIORNATA, GIÀ IN ORDINE
Apri l'app e trovi oggi e i prossimi giorni in un'unica lista, con orari, progetti e chi se ne occupa. Quello che è rimasto indietro resta in cima finché non lo spunti.
• Promemoria con notifica, anche più di uno per attività
• Riepilogo ogni mattina con le cose di oggi
• Attività ricorrenti: ogni giorno, settimana, mese o nei giorni feriali

PROGETTI CHIARI, ANCHE QUANDO SONO TANTI
• Sezioni, sotto-attività, etichette e quattro livelli di priorità
• Assegna un'attività a una o più persone, con notifica
• Spazi separati: Personale, Studio, Cliente…

OGNI ATTIVITÀ HA LA SUA STORIA
Descrizione, commenti con @menzioni, allegati e stato del lavoro (Da fare, In corso, In attesa, In review). Chi apre l'attività capisce subito a che punto siete.

SAI QUANTO TEMPO CI HAI MESSO
Avvia il timer con un tocco, o inserisci il tempo a mano. Tickwink somma le ore per attività, progetto, persona e giorno: numeri pronti per il preventivo e per la fattura. Il timer in corso resta visibile sulla schermata di blocco e nella Dynamic Island.

FILE E NOTE DEL PROGETTO
Mockup, preventivi, foto e documenti stanno dentro il progetto, non sparsi tra email e chat. Ogni progetto ha le sue note (brief, verbali, idee) che si salvano da sole mentre scrivi.

WIDGET
Le attività di oggi e dei prossimi giorni sulla schermata Home, da spuntare senza aprire l'app.

IN SQUADRA
Invita colleghi e collaboratori negli spazi di lavoro, con ruoli di proprietario, amministratore e membro. Ognuno vede solo gli spazi in cui è stato invitato.

PENSATA PER L'ITALIA
Interfaccia in italiano, dati su server in Italia, backup ogni notte. Tema chiaro e scuro automatico e cinque colori a scelta.

Per uso personale Tickwink è gratis.

name: TokenBuddies: Queue & Booking
description:
TokenBuddies turns your waiting room into an organised queue. Give each customer a token in seconds, call the next person with one tap, and let people follow their turn live on their own phone, so they can wait nearby instead of crowding your counter.

Made for clinics, salons, and any place where people wait their turn.

GIVE TOKENS IN SECONDS
  • Give a walk-in token, with or without a name and mobile number
  • Send the live status link on WhatsApp, copy it, or print a token slip
  • Call next, mark done or no-show with one tap, and serve more than one person at a time
  • Book a token for a later time; bookings join the line 10 minutes before their time

CUSTOMERS SEE THEIR TURN LIVE
  • Every token has its own live page: now serving, how many are ahead and the estimated wait
  • "Alert me before my turn" lets them know when they are close
  • No app to install, it is just a link
  • Directions to your door with Google Maps, and how far away they are

SHOW THE QUEUE ON A TV
  • Open one link on a smart TV or tablet in the waiting area to show "Now serving" and who is next
  • Only token numbers are shown, never names or phone numbers
  • A chime plays when the next token is called

QR CHECK-IN
  • Put a QR poster at your door. Customers scan it, enter their name and mobile, and get a token with a live link, with no waiting at the counter

ONLINE BOOKING
  • Your own booking page with your services, prices, timings and location
  • Customers pick a free slot; you accept or decline, or confirm bookings automatically
  • Set opening hours, slot length and how many people fit in each slot
  • Customers see all their bookings and tokens in one place

BRANCHES AND TEAM
  • Run several branches, each with its own queue, TV link and settings
  • Add staff by mobile number; they only see the branches you give them
  • One customer list shared by all your branches

REPORTS
  • Tokens per day, busy hours, average wait, time at the counter and no-shows
  • The last 7, 30 or 90 days, for every branch

SIMPLE AND SECURE
  • Log in with your mobile number and password, or with a one-time SMS code
  • Get notified about new bookings and new logins to your account
  • Works on iPhone and iPad, and in any web browser on a computer
  • Customers' phone numbers are never shown on public pages

TokenBuddies is made by CarryBuddies.

name: Toss Up Cornhole
description:
Cornhole, cranked up. Hit trick shots, fire off power-ups and beat moving obstacles across four 3D stages.
Play friends in 1v1 or 2v2 online rooms, or work your way up a ladder of bots from Easy to Pro.

HOW IT PLAYS
Drag down to power up, drag sideways to aim, and release to toss. Choose a Flat, Arc or Lob throw. It's real cornhole scoring: 3 for the hole, 1 for the board, and only the difference counts.

THE STAGES
Backyard → Beach → Tailgate → Neon Arena. Read the wind on the beach, time the sliding truck and moving wall at the tailgate, and thread the spinning windmill in the Neon Arena while the hole shrinks and moves.

TRICKS AND POWER-UPS
Airmail, Bank Shot, Push-In, Knock-Off and Slider each add a bonus point and earn a power-up: Sticky, Heavy, Ghost or Split. Watch for power-up crates.

EVERY ROUND IS DIFFERENT
Each round brings a twist: Wind Storm, Moon Gravity, Slippery Board, Tiny Hole, Double Points, Bumpers, and moving, tilting or shrinking targets.

PLAY WITH FRIENDS
Create a room, share the code or invite link, and pick 1v1 or 2v2 and a target of 11, 15 or 21. Bots fill any empty seats. Lost your connection? Rejoin and your seat is waiting.

LEADERBOARDS
Choose a player name and climb the weekly and all-time boards. Every result is decided on the game server, not on your phone.

HIGHLIGHT CLIPS
Every match ends with an automatic highlight of your last throw, with slow-mo, a replay camera and callouts. Share it, or share the full-match reel.

Quick Match is there whenever you want one game. No sign-up needed.

name: Trajek
description:
Trajek is the field companion to trajek.app: the same account, the same rifles, the same paid status — now native on your iPhone, readable with gloves on.

THE HOLD, IN TWO SECONDS
Pick a range, call the wind, read the card. Huge monospaced numbers show your elevation and windage in mils or MOA, with clicks and direction — no math at the trigger.

A WIND CALL YOU CAN ACTUALLY MAKE
Set speed and clock direction on the dial, add your honest error band, and Trajek shows where the bullet lands if your call is off. The Wind Bracket answers the hunter's question: how wrong can you be and still stay in the vitals?

WHICH LOAD STILL HITS
Run two loads against the same wind and range. Trajek tells you which one holds and which one drifts out of the vitals, with a drift chart and error bands.

YOUR RIFLES, YOUR DATA
Save rifles with the real bullet, BC and velocity. Everything lives in your trajek.app account: synced across devices, cached offline for the ridge with no signal.

TRUING (PRO)
Shoot a known distance, enter the hold that hit, and Trajek solves your real muzzle velocity and BC. Your rifle, your speed — not the box.

Free: the solver and the load matchup. Trajek Pro adds unlimited rifles, truing, offline caching for every profile and sync across devices — $9.99/month or $39.99/year through the App Store, the same Pro as trajek.app.

Always confirm holds on paper before shooting game.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://trajek.app/privacy

name: TWKNOX
description:
Welcome aboard TWKNOX. We keep tuning this Invisible Labor Ledger so household load is easier to see and discuss, and we appreciate hearing from you as soon as anything on the balance stage, reports, atlas, or negotiate desk feels unclear.

Invisible chores pile up quietly until someone burns out. TWKNOX helps households log labor, weigh balance on a stage view, browse an atlas of categories, negotiate load, and review the week—without turning care work into a social feed, leaderboard, or public score. Balance Stage is the home signal: who is carrying what stays visible before you open any deeper desk, so fairness talks start from shared facts instead of memory alone.

Add members and labor types, compose entries, walk the ledger and entry detail, then use Week Report, Insights, Category Atlas, and Export Hub from the Command Dock. Negotiate gives a calm place to talk through uneven load without messaging servers. Settings hold honest preferences plus export and wipe. The app is a local-first SwiftUI utility on iPhone; sample data appears only in Debug, while Release starts empty after onboarding so real households begin with a clean ledger.

Private by design: no account, no ads, no tracking, and no cloud sync of household records. Entries, members, negotiations, reports, and preferences stay on this iPhone. TWKNOX only keeps the ledger—it never sells your data, never forces a login before you can log a chore, and never uploads your household vault.

name: UskeliaBromat
description: Ozone dosing calculator: flow, ozone dose, generator, contactor and operating costs.

name: Vaultino – Private Vault
description:
Vaultino is a vault for your private photos and videos. Every file is encrypted, nothing leaves your iPhone, and nobody but you can open it.

Many vault apps only hide files behind a PIN. Vaultino encrypts every single file, including folder names and thumbnails.

SECURE
• Real encryption for every file
• Unlock with Face ID, a PIN, or both
• Folders with their own password, protected even if someone knows your PIN
• Growing lockout times after wrong PINs
• The vault is not part of your iCloud backup

PHOTOS AND VIDEOS
• Import from Photos and Files, optionally deleting the originals
• Camera straight into the vault: captures never touch your library. Lock mid-recording and the video is kept
• Player for almost any format: MP4, MOV, MKV, AVI, WMV and many more, without converting

TOOLS
• Wi-Fi transfer: upload and download files from your computer’s browser, no cable, no cloud
• Private browser with no history and a content blocker; downloads go straight into the vault
• Encrypted backup with its own password, to a drive, a NAS or your computer

FAIR
• Pay once, use forever. No subscription, no in-app purchases
• No ads, no tracking, no account, no server

Important: without your PIN and without a backup, your content cannot be recovered, not even by us. That is the price of real encryption.

name: Veetomax
description:
Thanks for opening Veetomax. We keep refining this Max Pulse Dayboard so daily load feels easier to see and balance, and we welcome a note anytime the orbital stage, log flow, recovery blocks, or weekly pulse could feel clearer for you.

Days fill up across work, home labor, social drain, movement, and sleep margin until everything feels heavy and hard to compare. Veetomax gives you one Max budget and an Orbital Max stage so used points versus budget stay visible before you dive into any desk—without turning life into a guilt streak counter or a clinical tracker. Log pulses with domain, intensity, and duration; recovery blocks and the day timeline keep the board readable when the day tightens.

Capture pulses from the Command Dock, walk Domain Atlas desks, review Weekly Pulse and Insights, and adjust Max Budget when your ceiling changes. Notices surface gentle in-app reminders; Settings hold honest toggles, export, and wipe so the vault stays under your control. The whole product is offline-first SwiftUI on your iPhone—no tab bar clutter, just a dock that routes you to the desk you need when you need it.

Private by design: no account, no ads, no tracking, and no cloud upload of your pulse board. Events, recovery blocks, budgets, notices, and preferences stay on this iPhone. Veetomax only helps you see daily load—it never sells your data, never requires a login before you can start, and never ships your vault off-device.

name: VESPERA '99: Phantom Shift
description:
Welcome to Vespera City, 1999 - a rain-slicked cyber-noir metropolis seen from a classic top-down perspective and powered by dynamic 2.5D normal-mapped lighting, tire-slip drift physics, and two signature tactical systems. When the city's autonomous security grid goes rogue, you step in as a special Phantom Agent to reclaim the streets.

[SIGNATURE MECHANICS]
- WIRE-LINK (Bullet-Time Air-Link and Kinetic Ram)
Hold LINK at redline speeds to enter 0.22x bullet-time. Lock onto a nearby autonomous ride and vault across the asphalt to take the wheel while sending your previous vehicle hurtling forward to clear automated roadblocks.

- PHANTOM SHIFT (9-Second Hologram Decoy and Remote EMP)
Your experimental deck continuously records a rolling 9-second buffer of your driving and pulse fire. Deploy an amber-cyan Phantom Clone to spoof pursuit radar and lure searchlight drones away while you phase ghost-like through traffic - then tap again to trigger a remote EMP shockwave.

[KEY FEATURES]
- 3 Seamless Districts: Skyline Tech Core, Kowloon Neon Strip, and Rust Harbor Docks
- 14 Original Vehicles from V12 twin-turbos to armored transports and energy tankers
- 6 Multi-Stage Tactical Missions plus Phantom Garage and Fleet Recovery Dock
- Switchable 1999 Synthwave and Breakbeat In-Car FM Radio plus CoreHaptics and 120Hz ProMotion
- Instant Single-Player Action - Optional Tactical Supply Drops & 6 Global Languages

name: Vice Navigator
description:
Looking for one last collectible? Open the offline map in Vice Navigator, hide the spots you've already checked off and see what's left.

EXPLORE THE MAP
Browse 2,532 places in 81 categories, from trading cards and stunt jumps to photo spots, races and garages. Search by name or filter the map to see just the places you're looking for. Tap a pin for details and, where available, an image. Mark it as done, save it as a favorite or leave yourself a note.

KEEP TRACK WITH CHECKLISTS
Your progress at a glance: find your favorites, recent places and next milestones in My Journey. Work through 54 checklists covering 1,373 places, grouped by area or sorted A to Z. Mark everything in an area as done at once when you've already cleared it.

GUIDES, VEHICLES AND TOURS
Browse 128 guides and 101 vehicle entries. Guides link to their places on the map. Plan your own exploration tours, put the stops in order and check them off as you go. Keep places and guides together in collections or set a goal for a category or area. The completion assistant offers suggestions for what to finish next based on your progress.

PLAY AT YOUR OWN PACE
Choose how much you want to see: spoiler-free, hints or full details. The base map and guides work offline. You can export your progress, notes and plans to a backup file. Vice Navigator is available in English and German.

FREE AND PREMIUM
The free version includes ads, the offline base map, checklists, guides, search and progress tracking. You can create 2 tours with up to 12 stops each, 3 collections and 3 active goals.

Vice Navigator Premium includes advanced map filters, progress by area and higher limits for tours, collections and goals. It removes ads and includes access to downloadable map packs: a closer street-level zoom and the Night Navigator map style. You can also remove banner ads with a separate one-time purchase.

Premium is an auto-renewing subscription with monthly, three-month, six-month and annual options. Cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period to avoid renewal. Manage your subscription in your account settings.
Terms of Use: https://software-notion.de/apps/vice-navigator/terms
Apple standard EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy policy: https://software-notion.de/apps/vice-navigator/privacy

Unofficial companion guide. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the game publisher. Map data and imagery are used under licence.

name: Vigie VTC
description:
Vigie regarde, en même temps que vous, une offre de course Uber, Bolt ou Heetch, et vous dit en quelques millisecondes si elle est rentable, limite ou mauvaise.

Comment ça marche
Vous réglez une fois vos critères : votre part reversée ou vos cotisations, votre véhicule et ses frais, vos seuils de prix au kilomètre ou de gain net à l'heure. Ensuite, pendant votre service, Vigie lit chaque offre affichée et vous donne son verdict d'un regard, avec un son si vous le voulez,  sans jamais toucher à l'offre à votre place.

Ce que Vigie fait
• Un verdict immédiat : rentable, limite ou mauvais
• Le prix au kilomètre et le gain net à l'heure, calculés avec vos vrais frais
• Un historique de vos courses, par jour et par heure
• Fonctionne avec Uber, Bolt et Heetch

Ce que Vigie ne fait jamais
• N'accepte et ne refuse jamais une course à votre place
• Ne garde ni n'envoie aucune image de votre écran
• Ne garde jamais le nom ni l'adresse d'un passager

Fait par un chauffeur VTC, pour les chauffeurs VTC.

name: Wadih: Ingredient Scanner
description:
Wadih reads the ingredients list printed on any food package, including local products that barcode apps miss, and colours every ingredient against your own filters: green for no conflict, amber for careful, red for a conflict with what you picked. It also reads your lab report from the camera or a PDF and shows every value next to the range printed on your report, with a plain-language explanation.

INGREDIENT SCANNER
• Photograph the ingredients in Arabic, English or French, or type them in.
• Filters you choose: IBS (low FODMAP), gluten and coeliac, lactose, keto, blood sugar, seed oils, halal (standard or strict), vegan, vegetarian, pregnancy, kids, additives.
• 14 food allergens, including "may contain traces" warnings.
• A clear reason for every flagged ingredient, and E-numbers by name.
• Nutrition traffic lights for sugars, fat and salt.
• Your own list of ingredients to avoid.

LAB RESULTS EXPLAINED
• Blood work and CBC, fasting glucose and HbA1c, cholesterol and lipids, thyroid (TSH), vitamin D and B12, iron and ferritin, liver and kidney panels, urine tests.
• Every value next to the reference range printed on your own report, coloured on your phone with a fixed rule.
• What each test measures in plain words, plus questions for your doctor.
• Blood work tracker: follow each value from one report to the next.
• Hide your name and ID on the photo before sending.

SYMPTOM DIARY
• Log bloating, pain, gas and more in a tap, plus the Bristol scale and mood.
• Link what you ate with "I ate this".
• Patterns from your own log to discuss with your doctor or dietitian.

PRIVACY
• No account, no sign-in.
• Your history, diary and results stay on your phone.
• No ads, no tracking.

WADIH PLUS
Unlimited daily checks, unlimited lab reports including multi-page PDFs, values tracked over time, diary patterns and a PDF for your doctor. Monthly or yearly (7 days free on yearly), or a one-time lifetime purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period; manage them in your store account settings.

IMPORTANT
This app is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any medical condition. It is for information only. Always consult a healthcare professional for medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. If you have an allergy, always read the package yourself.

Terms of use: https://mahmoudhssn.com/wadih/en/terms/
Privacy policy: https://mahmoudhssn.com/wadih/en/privacy/

name: Wagner Logger
description:
Wagner Logger connects your iPhone or iPad over Bluetooth to up to 4 compatible pressure and temperature sensors.

- Live readings and charts
- Record measurements, by hand or with an automatic trigger
- Differential between two sensors
- Share saved recordings as CSV or a PDF report

For sensors from Wagner-Hydraulik.

name: WakeSure Alarm: Wake-Up Tasks
description:
Choose tomorrow’s wake-up task before you go to bed. When the alarm sounds, open the app for three rounds of sustained voice, or keep your eyes open for ten seconds.

For a voice task, pick a difficulty when you set the alarm. Hold your voice above the target until each progress bar fills. For a quiet morning, face the front camera and keep both eyes open for a total of ten seconds. Natural blinks keep your progress.

Set an alarm once or repeat it on selected weekdays. Try either task for free under Practice alarm in Settings, without sounding an alarm. The app processes audio and camera frames on your device and saves no recordings or images.

Completing the task is free. An optional one-time App Store purchase lets you skip the current task. Each purchase applies to one alarm. There is no subscription or automatic renewal.

name: Wave Clean: Photos & Contacts
description:
Free up space on your iPhone in minutes. CleanWave finds the photos, videos and contacts you don't need, and lets you choose what to delete. It is free, has no ads, needs no account, and everything happens on your iPhone.

PHOTOS
• All: see every photo and video, sort by newest, oldest or largest, and delete any you choose
• Bursts: find many photos taken within seconds, keep the best shot and delete the rest
• Similar: find near-same photos and keep the best one
• Duplicates: find exact copies and keep the original
• Large: show only files bigger than 5, 10, 50, 100 or 500 MB
• Screenshots and Videos: clear old screenshots and big videos fast
• Hold any photo to see it full screen before you decide

CONTACTS
• All: search and select any contacts to delete
• Duplicates: merge cards with the same name, number or email
• Choose what to keep: pick the name, the numbers (international or local format) and the emails
• Find cards with no name, or with no number and no email

SAFE BY DESIGN
• Nothing is deleted without your OK. Every photo delete is confirmed by iOS
• Deleted photos go to "Recently Deleted" in the Photos app for 30 days
• A backup is saved on your iPhone before any contact merge or delete, so you can undo it from the Vault
• Optional Face ID lock for the Vault

PRIVATE
• No data collected. Your photos and contacts never leave your iPhone
• No account, no ads, no tracking, no subscription

Privacy Policy: https://demobyjoga.online/cleanwave/privacy/

name: Weara: Ne Giysem?
description:
Bugün ne giysem? Weara, kendi dolabındaki kıyafetlerle sana kombin hazırlayan kişisel stilistin.

DOLABINI FOTOĞRAFLA
Kıyafetinin fotoğrafını galerinden seç (birden fazla parçayı tek seferde ekleyebilirsin). Weara parçayı tanır; adını, türünü, rengini, desenini, mevsimini ve ne kadar resmi olduğunu kendisi yazar. İstersen her şeyi sonradan düzeltirsin.

SOHBETTEN KOMBİN İSTE
"Akşam yemeğine gidiyorum", "Pazartesi iş görüşmem var", "Bugün ne giysem?" gibi yaz. Weara hava durumuna, gideceğin yere ve istersen kiminle buluşacağına bakar, dolabındaki parçalardan kombin hazırlar ve nedenini anlatır.

AYNI KOMBİNİ TEKRARLAMAZ
Giydiğin kombinleri Geçmiş'e kaydedersin. Weara son günlerde giydiklerini ve aynı kişiyle en son çıktığında giydiklerini bir sonraki öneride tekrar etmez.

ZEVKİNİ ÖĞRENİR
Önerilere "Beğendim" ya da "Beğenmedim" dersin, "Giydim" ile geçmişe yazarsın. Bunlar sonraki önerileri senin zevkine göre ayarlar.

ALMAYI DÜŞÜNDÜĞÜN ÜRÜNÜ DENE
Bir ürünün fotoğrafını ya da mağaza linkini sohbete at. Weara dolabındaki parçalarla o ürünü kombinler ve dolabında benzeri olup olmadığını söyleyerek "almalı mıyım?" sorusuna kısa bir cevap verir.

GEÇMİŞ
Ne zaman, nerede, kiminle ne giydiğini gör. Kombin fotoğrafı yüklersen Weara parçaları dolabınla eşleştirip kaydı hazırlar.

GÜNLÜK HATIRLATMA (İSTEĞE BAĞLI)
İstediğin saati seç, her gün o saatte kombin hatırlatması al. Ayarlardan istediğin an kapatırsın.

GİZLİLİK
Hava durumu için yalnızca sen "Kombin öner" dediğinde yaklaşık konumun kullanılır ve saklanmaz. Hesabını ve tüm verilerini uygulamadan kalıcı olarak silebilirsin. Reklam yok.

Ücretsiz planda aylık kombin isteği ve dolaba eklenebilecek parça sayısı sınırlıdır.

name: WePlayer - TV
description:
WePlayer for Safari plays the M3U and Xtream playlists you already have, in a full Safari tab on iPhone and Mac.

• Paste your playlist link (M3U, M3U8 or Xtream): WePlayer analyses it in seconds.
• Live TV by category, favourites, global search and quality badges (SD, HD, Full HD, 4K).

name: Wishtale: Manifest Stories
description:
Wishtale writes you a letter from the day your wish came true — and reads it to you.

Answer a few questions about you and what you're calling in: the love you want, the person on your mind, the work, the home, the money, the way you want to feel. A minute later, Wishtale writes a first-person story set on the day it has already happened, full of the small, specific details only your life would have, and reads it to you in a warm voice. Listen in the morning to set your intention, or at night to fall asleep inside the life you're building.

No account needed. Open the app and everything is there.

WHAT YOU GET
• Your first story — written from your own answers, not a template.
• A new story every day — a fresh letter waiting for you each morning.
• Write your own — type any wish, pick a vision, and hear its story.
• Your own voice — record 10–30 seconds and hear your stories read in your own voice, or choose one of our warm narrators.
• Listen your way — background and lock-screen playback, 10-second skip, repeat, read along with the full text, soft sound (rain, ocean), sleep timer and sleep mode.
• Daily affirmations — cards written around your wish. Save them or share them.
• 21-day challenge — listen once a day and watch the moon fill.
• Library — meditations, sleep tracks and affirmations, ready any time.
• Gratitude journal and vision board — keep what you're grateful for and what you're calling in, in one place.
• Daily reminder at the time you choose (optional).

YOUR ANSWERS STAY YOURS
Your answers are used only to write your stories. They are never made public, never sold and never used for ads. Everything is linked to a random number for your phone, not to your name or email. Erase everything at any time in Settings → Erase my data. If a story ever feels wrong, report it from the story screen.

Wishtale is a reflection and visualization tool for wellbeing. Stories are written by AI and are imaginative, not predictions. Wishtale does not give medical, psychological or financial advice and does not promise any outcome. For adults 18+.

name: WLTHMAX
description: Jatka tulojen, menojen ja tilien välisten siirtojen kirjaamista tavalliseen tapaan. Kun käsittelet kiistatilanteita, käytä aikajanaa seurataksesi, mitkä varat on vastaanotettu, mitkä ovat vain väliaikaisia ​​peruutuksia ja mitkä summat on lopulta perittävä takaisin tai palautettava. Jos yksi hyvitys vastaa useita veloituksia, voit kohdistaa sen erä kerrallaan tilitysnäkymässä; myös osissa saapuvat hyvitykset voidaan yhdistää alkuperäiseen menoon. Tarkastele kuukauden päätteeksi nettokulujasi sen mukaan, milloin veloitukset ovat tapahtuneet, ja vertaa tätä sitten todellisiin rahavirtoihin (tuloihin ja menoihin) niinä kuukausina, jolloin varat on vastaanotettu. Tämä auttaa selventämään, miksi nämä kaksi lukusarjaa saattavat poiketa toisistaan.

name: Wolkenwerk – Water Cycle
description:
Wolkenwerk turns the water cycle into something to play with: a painted land with sea, meadow, garden & mountain. Your child sets the sun, wind & cold & sees what the water does. It rises, becomes a cloud, travels across the land, rains or snows & flows back to the sea. Not a single drop is lost.

MAKE THE WEATHER
Pull the sun higher, slide the pinwheel, turn the thermometer colder or tickle a cloud. Every cause has a visible effect: rain makes sunflowers grow, snow falls on the mountain, thaw fills the river & a rainbow appears in the rain.

DRIP COMES ALONG
Drip, a little water droplet, travels the whole cycle & says in one short sentence where it is right now: in the sea, in a cloud, in the snow or in the river.

16 DISCOVERIES IN THE DISCOVERY BOOK
Vapor & clouds, rain on the mountain, snow down to the valley, thaw, fog, dry spells, cloudbursts & more. Each discovery lands in the book as a painted card with one or two short, accurate sentences that are also read aloud.

NO GOAL, NOTHING TO LOSE
There are no tasks, no points & no clock running out. In a dry spell the flowers at most hang their heads & recover with the next rain.

FOR ACCOMPANYING ADULTS
The area for accompanying adults explains what this is about, with conversation starters & honest notes on where the app simplifies.

CALM & SAFE
• No time pressure, no points, no penalties
• No ads, no account, no data collection
• Works offline
• Settings & links sit behind a small sum for accompanying adults
• In English & German

An app by Annico from Berlin.
Privacy: https://annico.eu/apps#wolkenwerk

name: Word of God: Quran
description:
Tell the Quran how you feel, and hear it answer.

Pick a feeling (sad, anxious, grateful, lost, hopeful and more) or ask a question in your own words, and Word of God reads you whole passages in Arabic and English. Never a single verse cut from its place: each answer is a passage, with the verses around it.

HEAR EVERY WORD
• Mishary Alafasy's recitation, with each Arabic word lit as it is recited
• The meaning in English, French or Urdu, each read aloud
• The English of the Rowwad translation read aloud, lit word by word too
• Arabic and English together, Arabic only, or English only
• A speed for the Arabic and a separate speed for the English
• Skip by verse or by passage; keeps playing on the lock screen

READ THE WHOLE QURAN THIS YEAR
• All 114 surahs, read or listened to
• Every verse you read or hear counts once, anywhere in the app

READ IT YOUR WAY
• The app in English, French or Urdu
• Six Arabic scripts, including Madinah, Amiri and IndoPak
• Recitation colours (tajweed) on the Arabic, each linked to its rule
• Eight colour themes, light and dark, and four text sizes
• Save the passages that speak to you

AND MORE
• Qaida: revise the letters and the rules of recitation, out loud or at your own pace
• Duas: supplications for the moments of the day
• A daily verse, with an optional reminder

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no sign-in, no adverts, no tracking. Your reading stays on your device.

Start with 7 days free, then $9.99 a year or $1.99 a month. Cancel any time. Today's verse is always free.

Payment is charged to your Apple ID when the free trial ends. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period; manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

Plan, time and track every workout: HIIT, Tabata, EMOM, circuits, strength or mobility.

BUILD YOUR WORKOUTS

CREATE A WORKOUT WITH AI

A TIMER BUILT FOR TRAINING

WORKOUT PLANNER PRO

name: yamkoo: AI Trip Planner
description:
yamkoo plans a calm, realistic trip around you, with every fact found live and its source next to it.

Tell yamkoo where you'd like to go, when, who's coming and how you like to travel. yamkoo's team of agents then plans the whole trip:

• The route: where to stay how long, and how to get from one place to the next
• Day by day: what to see and do, at a pace that fits you
• Stays, food and getting around, with links straight to the sites where you book
• Entry and safety for your own passports: visas, travel advice, driving licences
• The season and weather for your dates, and a budget

Every fact comes with its source, so you can check it. Ask any agent to look at its part again, with a note if you like.

YOUR ROUTE ON ONE MAP
See the whole trip on a map, tap a stop to see it, and take it with you on the road.

ASK YAMKOO
Questions on the way? Type, speak or send a photo of a menu or a sign. yamkoo can suggest changes to your plan, and you decide what happens.

HELP ON THE ROAD
Emergency numbers, your embassy, toilets nearby and a phrase book for where you are, found on official sites.

MADE FOR YOU
Tell yamkoo your travel style once and every new trip fills itself in. Plans work for travellers from anywhere, with entry rules for the passports you hold. In English and German.

CREDITS
yamkoo's agents use credits when they think and search the web for you. You see an estimate before anything starts and pay nothing if something fails. yamkoo is free to use: every new account starts with free credits, and if you need more, tap Request credits and we'll add some.

yamkoo looks facts up live, but AI can still make mistakes and things change. Please check what matters, like entry rules, on official sites before you travel.

name: Yap Rush: Voice Word Game
description:
Things get tossed into the air. Say what they are out loud before they fall and SPLAT!

Yap Rush is a fast, loud voice game. Your voice is the controller: see a banana, shout "banana", and it pops. The sooner you say it, the more points you score. Too slow? Splat. Three splats and the round is over.

Easy to learn in three seconds, hard to put down, and hilarious with friends.

HOW TO PLAY
• Stickers fly up from the bottom of the screen
• Say each one's name out loud in English
• Pop it early for more points and build combos up to x4
• Miss one and it splats, and the word you missed pops up so you learn it

GAME MODES
• Classic: endless, three lives. Five levels that get faster, then throw two and three stickers at once.
• Daily Splat: 30 stickers, the same for everyone today. Share your score grid with friends.
• Party: pass the phone between 2 and 8 players. Every turn deals its own words, so nobody can learn them by watching.
• Practice: replay the words you missed, slower, with each word written under its sticker.

COLLECT THEM ALL
250 colorful 3D stickers in 9 packs: food, animals, nature, home, tools and science, music, play, clothes and travel. Every sticker you name goes into your Sticker Book, where you can hear the word and read what it means.

GREAT ENGLISH PRACTICE
All words are everyday English, from easy to harder (levels A1, A2 and B1). A fun way to practice English vocabulary and speaking out loud, without it feeling like a lesson.

PRIVATE AND OFFLINE
Speech recognition runs entirely on your phone. Your voice is never recorded, stored or sent anywhere. No account, no sign-up and no internet connection needed.

Turn up the volume, grab your friends and start yapping!

Over 200 countries and regions

Daily, total or unlimited data

No handling fee, no contract

Physical SIM cards too
