name: BCAPEY
description:
Treat the balance sheet as a spring.

Contribution margin is its stiffness, fixed cost is the preload, and a demand shock is the force applied on top. Enter the numbers and the model answers two questions: how far this spring compresses, and whether it returns to shape once the load comes off.

Flex Spring is a stress memo that fits in your pocket. Four input groups, twenty-two fields: revenue, fixed cost, variable cost rate, cash, debt structure; then demand drop, rate shock, receivable delay, price cut; then undrawn credit, capex deferral, payroll flex and a dividend pause.

WHAT YOU WATCH
The top card is a live monitor: a spring index, a one-line verdict, and four readings — spring constant k, deformation, cash runway, recovery. The coil beneath it compresses and springs back as you drag a slider, and a rolling log records the score before and after each change, so you can retrace your own steps.

THE SPRING CONSTANT
k is the buffer divided by a quarter of fixed cost. The buffer counts cash on hand, undrawn credit discounted by how tight the covenant is, the cash saved by deferring capex, the cash freed by payroll flex, and anything a dividend pause holds back.
The higher k, the more shock the structure absorbs before the cost base has to be cut. 1.20 is the structural norm; below it, the spring is already taking a set.

DEFORMATION AND THE ELASTIC LIMIT
Deformation is the stressed EBITDA shortfall divided by eighty percent of fixed cost, expressed as a percentage: how much of its travel the structure has used up.
Seventy-five percent is the elastic limit. Under that line, the structure returns to shape when load is removed. Above it, the set becomes permanent — the cuts are ones you cannot reverse when demand comes back.

FOUR READINGS
Page one, Stress Curve: seven load points through the current cost structure, drawn as load against deformation, with the load level where the curve leaves the elastic band.
Page two, Scenario Set: base, stress, severe and upside, all compressed through the same structure, with the 75 percent line drawn across the bars.
Page three, Elastic Limits: runway, interest cover, term structure and cost flexibility, each converted into a percentage of its threshold — under 100 is short, over 100 clears.
Page four, Recovery Profile: buffer, term, flex, stability and recovery as a five-point radar against a 70 floor. The lowest point is the constraint that actually binds.

EXPORT
A PDF button sits on every result page and writes a one-page A4 memo: index, verdict, curve, scenario table, the four limits, and one recovery recommendation, with a footer noting that the output is a model of the current cost structure, not a forecast. It goes through the system share sheet, so it can be saved, mailed, or handed to a colleague.

name: BeadCount
description:
See what your abacus worksheet actually practices, then drill the moves it misses. BeadCount connects worksheet analysis with a hands-on soroban. Learners can focus on one move at a time, while parents and teachers can check the mix of skills in the worksheets they prepare.

HOW TO PRACTICE

1. Open a worksheet
Start with the built-in 12-question Mixed arithmetic worksheet. To use your own questions, enter or paste one addition or subtraction expression per line, or import a CSV or TXT file.

2. Find a move to work on
Set coverage targets for specific moves and place values. The home screen highlights the largest gap. In the coverage matrix, switch between Occurrences and Questions involved, then tap a cell to find the questions and steps behind the count.

3. Make the move on the abacus
Start Practice bead moves from the home screen or select a move in the matrix. Read the starting value and the operand digit, along with any carry or borrow coming from the right. Tap the beads on the highlighted rod or use the bead controls. Choose No transfer, Carry left, or Borrow from left, then tap Check move. BeadCount checks both the final bead position and the transfer direction.

4. Review the step and finish the set
Open See worked step to see the before and after values, which beads move toward or away from the beam, and how the move affects the next rod. Finish the set to see your first-attempt results and practice again. You can add generated questions to your current worksheet.

5. Refine the worksheet
Lock the questions you want to keep and try replacements for the others. Compare original and candidate expressions by question number, inspect changes in the coverage chart, and see which targets still need work. Apply a plan or save it for later.

Worksheets, targets, plans, and practice progress are stored on the device. Core practice works offline, and you can export a worksheet as CSV.

name: BearingMile
description:
Keep a notebook of manually entered coordinates and calculate approximate distances and initial bearings.

Save named latitude and longitude points, measure a pair, or arrange an ordered route with cumulative leg distances. Repeated stops remain in their chosen order.

• Compare forward and reverse initial bearings calculated independently.
• View distance in kilometres, miles or nautical miles.
• Inspect each leg, its source coordinates and its spherical midpoint when unique.
• See an unavailable value when a bearing or midpoint has no unique answer.
• Freeze independent PDF and CSV reports with the original coordinates, revisions and calculated values.
• Keep historical reports unchanged when live waypoints or routes change.

BearingMile uses a short-arc spherical model with mean Earth radius 6,371,008.8 metres. Distances exclude roads, elevation and ellipsoid corrections. Results are approximate, not survey-grade measurements.

This is a manually entered calculation tool, not navigation, location tracking or an online map. Records and frozen files are stored locally. You choose any sharing destination through iOS; shared copies and system backups are separate.

name: Bee Colony Idle
description:
Start with one clover patch and a single bee. End with a honey empire.

Bee Colony Idle is a cozy idle game with no ads at all. Your bees keep gathering while you are away, so every visit starts with a jar of honey waiting.

• GROW YOUR HIVE: open ten honey sources, from the Clover Patch to the Linden Grove, and watch the numbers climb.
• HIRE BEE CAPTAINS: Pip, Dandy, Viola and friends gather by themselves and level up as you play.
• BLOOM FOR FREE: double all honey for hours with a tap. No videos to watch, ever.
• SWARM: found a new hive to earn Royal Jelly and come back stronger each time.
• COOK IN THE HONEY KITCHEN: make treats for Barnaby the bear and the other forest neighbours.
• TRAVEL: stock up for the journey and migrate through five meadows.
• FESTIVALS: join the seasonal fair, clear its stages and bring home souvenirs.

Fair by design: nothing in the shop is random. Every purchase shows exactly what you get, and everything can also be earned by playing.

Plays offline. English and Portuguese.

name: Before & After Collage
description:
Put two photos together to show an entryway tidy-up, a renovation, a craft project, or a makeover.

• Two landscape photos stack automatically. Other pairs start side by side. Switch at any time and keep both photos in their original proportions.
• Drag or zoom each photo, swap their order, and turn the labels off when you want a clean result.
• Save or share a watermark-free JPEG with a 2048 px long edge. Save to Photos or Files.
• Make a 4:5 share card with a download QR code and a caption for your project. Send your layout as a style code or file.
• Keep drafts and exports on your device. Pick up where you left off or share original-size exports again.

Try high-resolution and custom sizes for 30 days from first launch, then unlock them with a one-time purchase. Basic tools stay available. There are no subscriptions, accounts, ads, or analytics.

name: Belgenie
description:
Belgenie is een AI-assistent die België kent. Je typt je vraag in een chat, in gewone taal, en Belgenie legt het uit, met de Belgische bron erbij.

Wat Belgenie voor je doet:
• Een brief van de belastingen, het OCMW of je verhuurder niet begrepen? Trek een foto en Belgenie legt uit wat erin staat en wat je kunt doen.
• Kent de regels per gewest: Vlaanderen, Brussel en Wallonië.
• Rekent volgens Belgische formules: opzegtermijn, huurindexatie, registratierechten, loon.
• Zoekt uit op welke premies en tegemoetkomingen je misschien recht hebt.
• Checkt een verdachte factuur, sms of mail op fraude.
• Praat zoals jij: kies een karakter zoals Den Antwerpenaar, De West-Vlaming of Le Liégeois.
• Dicteer je vraag met je stem; de omzetting gebeurt op je toestel.

Privacy: geen advertenties, geen trackers. Je gesprekken worden versleuteld bewaard. Belgenie is een product van Return BV uit Wilrijk.

Goed om te weten: Belgenie is een AI-assistent, geen officiële dienst van de overheid. Antwoorden zijn uitleg, geen juridisch of fiscaal advies. Controleer belangrijke beslissingen bij de bevoegde instantie.

name: BeltTensionAnalyzer
description:
Measure belt tension by sound. Tap or pluck a V-belt, flat belt or timing belt, and Belt Tension Analyzer measures the frequency it vibrates at and calculates the tension.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Set the frequency band: MIN below and MAX above the frequency you expect. Other sounds are ignored.
2. Capture the room noise: 2 seconds of background sound is measured and removed from every reading.
3. Choose the belt type and span length.
4. Tap the belt. Each tap fills a measurement box with its frequency (Hz) and tension (N).

FEATURES
• Tap-to-measure with automatic tap detection
• Choose 1–20 measurements per test, with average and spread
• Adjustable frequency band and room-noise removal
• Live spectrum and frequency display
• Save tests with a label and review them in History
• Belt presets (V-belt A/B/C, flat, timing) or custom mass per metre
• Optional microphone calibration against a reference microphone
• Frequency generator: sine, square, triangle, sawtooth and noise, 20 Hz – 16 kHz
• Built-in How to Use guide and troubleshooting tips

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
All audio is analyzed on your iPhone. Nothing is recorded, stored as audio, or sent anywhere. No accounts, ads or tracking.

Tension is calculated as T = 4 × m × f² × L² and is an estimate. Always check against the belt manufacturer's specifications. Stop and lock out the machine before touching the belt.

name: BeoFit App
description:
Dein Fitnessstudio in Interlaken – jederzeit griffbereit.

Mit der offiziellen BeoFit App hast du alles rund um dein Training im BeoFit City Gym immer dabei. Schliesse dein Abo online ab, buche dein Einführungstraining, greife auf deinen Trainingsplan zu und checke rund um die Uhr bequem mit deinem Smartphone ein.

Funktionen:

• Digitaler Check-in per QR-Code – 24/7, 365 Tage im Jahr
• Mitgliedschaften und Eintritte online abschliessen
• Abo-Gutscheine einlösen
• Einführungstraining direkt in der App buchen
• Persönliche Trainingspläne mit der Technogym App
• Trainingsstatistik mit Check-ins, Check-outs und Trainingszeit
• Übersicht aller Geräte im Studio
• Rechnungen und Krankenkassenbelege (QualiCert) herunterladen
• Profil und persönliche Daten verwalten
• Freunde-System und Check-ins teilen
• Push-Benachrichtigungen

Die App wird laufend erweitert und bietet künftig noch mehr Funktionen für dein Training im BeoFit Interlaken.

name: Bhāvanā
description:
Bhāvanā (ภาวนา) หนังสือสวดมนต์สำหรับฆราวาส ที่สวดตามได้ง่ายเหมือนมีคนนำสวด

บทสวดครบ พร้อมเสียงสวด
• บทสวดกว่า ๓๐ บท เช่น อิติปิโส ชินบัญชร พาหุง กรณียเมตตสูตร ธัมมจักกัปปวัตตนสูตร ยอดพระกัณฑ์ไตรปิฎก คาถาเงินล้าน คาถามหาจักรพรรดิ
• เสียงสวดชัด จังหวะสม่ำเสมอ ไฮไลต์ทีละคำให้สวดตาม
• ปรับความเร็วเสียงสวดและขนาดตัวอักษรได้ ล็อกจอแล้วเสียงยังเล่นต่อ

ชุดบทสวดพร้อมใช้
ทำวัตรเช้า ทำวัตรเย็น ขึ้นบ้านใหม่ ทำบุญบ้าน อุทิศส่วนกุศล กรวดน้ำ และขอพรให้หายป่วย

เลือกบทตามใจ
• "วันนี้รู้สึกอะไร" เลือกความรู้สึก แล้วแอปจัดบทสวดให้
• ค้นหาตามพลังพุทธคุณ เช่น จิตสงบ ชนะภัย เทวดาคุ้มครอง สุขภาพดี เมตตามหานิยม
• มีเวลาแค่ ๕ ๑๐ หรือ ๓๐ นาที แอปจัดบทให้พอดีเวลา
• Praylist สร้างชุดบทสวดของตัวเอง แอปเรียงลำดับขั้นการสวดให้ถูกต้องอัตโนมัติ

ห้องสมาธิ
นาฬิกาจับเวลาพร้อมเสียงระฆัง ปฏิทินบันทึกการนั่งสมาธิ สถิติรายสัปดาห์ สตรีค และเหรียญรางวัล

แจ้งเตือนวันพระ และเตือนรักษาสตรีค

ธรรมะฟังสบาย
คำอธิบายหลักธรรม เช่น อริยสัจ ๔ พรหมวิหาร ๔ ขันธ์ ๕ ไตรลักษณ์ พร้อมเสียงบรรยาย และลิงก์ฟังพระอาจารย์

ห้องสนทนาธรรม
ตั้งคำถามเรื่องชีวิตประจำวัน แลกเปลี่ยนมุมมองธรรมะด้วยเมตตา

ทดลองใช้ Premium ฟรี ๗ วัน ไม่ต้องผูกบัตร ไม่มีการตัดเงินอัตโนมัติ
Premium (จ่ายครั้งเดียว ใช้ได้ตลอดไป): สวดไม่จำกัด รายการโปรด Praylist ของตัวเอง และร่วมตอบในห้องสนทนาธรรม
เวอร์ชันฟรีสวดได้วันละ ๓ บท ฟังธรรมะและนั่งสมาธิได้ไม่จำกัด

ไม่มีโฆษณา ไม่ติดตามการใช้งาน ข้อมูลการสวดและการนั่งสมาธิเก็บในเครื่องของคุณ

name: Biblioscope
description:
Your library, in one photo.

Photograph a shelf: Biblioscope reads the spines, finds every book in the great public catalogs and remembers exactly where it sits. Hundreds of books cataloged in minutes, without typing a thing.

SNAP IT, IT'S SHELVED
• Spines read on device, even tilted, worn or upside down
• Free identification: BnF, Open Library, Library of Congress, National Library of Spain, National Diet Library (Japan)
• ISBN barcode on the back as a fallback
• Books that need a second look are set aside; Apple Intelligence helps decide

EVERY BOOK IN ITS PLACE
• Places, rooms, bookcases, shelves: your whole layout, across as many homes as you like
• The Plan: the entire library at a glance, each spine in its color, in real order
• The Shelves: your bookcases rebuilt, spine by spine
• On each book: where it is, and its neighbors

SEE IT YOUR WAY
• Cover grid, list, perspective cover flow
• On iPad and Mac: plan and covers side by side, full sidebar
• Covers found automatically and kept on device, even offline

FIND ANYTHING IN A SECOND
• Instant search: title, author, publisher, ISBN, place
• Natural language: "red books", "written by Umberto Eco", "never opened"
• Smart collections: favorites, to read, reading, read, lent, rare, signed, limited editions
• Groups by theme
• Bookstores and libraries near you

KNOW YOUR LIBRARY
• Statistics: authors, publishers, languages, colors, estimated value
• Lending: who has it, and since when
• Duplicates and multiple copies
• Excerpts and summaries in the book's own language

FOR PROFESSIONALS
Museums, institutional libraries, foundations, bookstores, shops, law firms, medical practices, companies, researchers: one profile per collection or site, inventories counted in thousands, print-ready exports.

PRIVATE AND SECURE
• Photos are analyzed on device and never leave it
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• Your library stays on your devices, synced through your private iCloud across iPhone, iPad and Mac
• Automatic on-device backups, one-tap restore

FREE
Biblioscope is free, with no subscription. Two one-time options, if you need them:
• Pro export: formatted PDF catalog and Excel file
• Unlimited library: beyond 1,000 books, across all your profiles

An app by Cyber Network Consulting.

name: Big Print Solitaire & Mahjong
description:
Big Print Solitaire & Mahjong puts four calm favourites in one app – Solitaire (Klondike), FreeCell, Spider and Mahjong – with big cards, big tiles and big buttons, made for easy reading.

No ads. No purchases. No account. Plays fully offline.

SMART HELP
• Smart Solitaire hints: the Hint button searches for a winning line and shows its next move in plain words
• Stuck? If no winning line is left from where you are, it looks back through your recent moves for one that works and offers to take you there
• Winnable deals (on by default): new Solitaire deals are checked to have a winning line before you play
• Daily deal: a checked-winnable deal for your device's date and your Draw 1 or Draw 3 setting
• Daily calendar: a crown on every day you solve. Missed a day this month or last month? Play it later for the crown

MADE FOR EASY READING
• Extra-big cards and tiles, four-colour suits option, extra-large text, four table styles
• Tap to move – no dragging needed. Or use Read board to read each pile and choose a destination with large buttons
• Read moves aloud (optional): your device's own voice reads hints and moves. It stays quiet while VoiceOver is on
• Calm mode (optional): no animations, no sounds, no glowing hints, no timer or move count
• Undo tells you in plain words what it took back

GAMES
• Solitaire (Klondike, Draw 1 or Draw 3), FreeCell, Spider (1 or 2 suits)
• Cards get bigger when you turn the phone sideways
• Mahjong board journey: 60 picture boards – clear a board to earn 1–3 stars (3 stars: no Mix tiles and 3 hints or fewer). Or choose Easy, Two layers, Wide or Normal. New layouts start solvable

Made by Tosa Creations Limited, Dhaka.

name: Bitora
description:
Bitora brings register planning, protocol flags and bit-level documentation into one visual workbench. Build clear definitions for embedded and firmware projects, inspect their values and keep track of how they evolve.

PLAN EVERY BIT
Work with 8-, 16-, 32- and 64-bit canvases. Toggle individual bits, select ranges, set multiple bits together and zoom into a layout. Binary, hexadecimal and decimal values update together, with positioned masks and decoded field values close at hand.

DEFINE FIELDS WITH MEANING
Name individual flags or contiguous fields, add descriptions and assign track colors. Document access semantics, reset values and named choices so fields such as MODE, READY and LENGTH have clear definitions.

INSPECT VALUES AND BYTE ORDER
Extract field values and preview logical operations, shifts and resets. Encode or decode bytes in little-endian or big-endian order, compare byte changes and apply a chosen value to the canvas. Structural diagnostics highlight invalid ranges, overlaps, naming collisions, conflicting resets and unassigned bits.

KEEP EVIDENCE AS DESIGNS CHANGE
Save reference inputs with expected field values. Recheck numeric decoding and review changed mappings after a layout evolves. Save named versions, compare bit values and field definitions, restore a checkpoint or selectively merge fields from another project.

PREPARE A CLEAR HANDOFF
Record design decisions, checklist notes and selected reference evidence in independent review records. Export C macro headers, annotation lists, Markdown specifications, field CSV files, reference reports and design handoff documents.

BUILD A REUSABLE LIBRARY
Start from eight conceptual recipes covering GPIO, serial frames, DMA, sensor status, message headers, memory attributes, events and power control. Create editable projects, save your own templates and keep frequently used layouts in Favorites.

KEEP YOUR WORK TOGETHER
Projects, fields, versions and templates are saved on your device. Preserve editable plans in JSON backups, preview their contents before importing independent copies, and manage generated documents in Saved Files.

name: Bitrovemqc
description:
Bitrovemqc is a private money-year desk that stays on your phone.

See a contribution ceiling from the numbers you type. Read the math: self-employment tax, the deductible half, net earnings, and the employer share. Split the set-aside across reminder dates that are still ahead.

Keep a vesting rail for a grant you enter. Marlow does not fetch a market. The share price is the one you type. A chart shows slices already in and slices still ahead.

Walk filing notes and mark each one: applies to me, doesn't apply, or I'm not sure. Marlow stores the stance. It does not file a form.

Park a want on the cooling shelf until a ready time. Clip a shelf tag, or let it go early. If you decide to buy, open one errand pass with a purpose and a timer.

Money shape switches — equity, self-employment, and cross-border ties — change which notes stay in view.

A local rank, a sticker folio, and a date-seeded daily bench live on this phone. Nothing is shared. There is no account.

name: Blerina Diet Courier
description: Blerina Diet Courier is the app for staff who deliver orders. It is not an app for placing an order.

name: Blini: Learn Russian Language
description:
Learn Russian the way Russian really works. Every Russian word is built from parts: a prefix, a root, a suffix and an ending. дом (house) + ик (little) + и (many) = домики, "little houses". Blini shows every part in its own color, so cases and endings stop being a list of rules and start making sense.

SEE HOW EVERY WORD IS BUILT
• Tap any sentence to see what it is made of: root, gender, case, tense, person.
• Every prefix, suffix and ending is explained: what it adds and which grammar step it belongs to.

GRAMMAR, ONE STEP AT A TIME
• 18 short grammar steps for level A1, from the alphabet to the past tense.
• Cases, verb conjugation, numbers, verbs of motion — each with a clear example.
• Every step unlocks new sentences to practice.

WORDS AND PHRASES FOR BEGINNERS
• 560+ Russian words and phrases by topic, with audio.
• 800+ example sentences and 270+ exercises.
• Flashcards, your own word list and a dictionary.

PRACTICE THAT STICKS
• A short plan every day and a streak to keep you going.
• Words and exercises come back right before you forget them.
• Build words from their parts, build sentences from tiles, listen and pick the right form.

SIMPLE AND HONEST
• Works offline. Your progress stays on your device.
• No ads, no account, no tracking.
• No subscription: 12 days free with everything open. After that, the whole course opens with a one-time purchase that includes all future levels. Family Sharing is supported.

name: Block Quest: The Lost Jewel
description:
Place the pieces, complete rows and columns, and make your way through five magical realms.

Block Quest is a block puzzle with goals in every level. Collect crystals, break stones, free the ice, detonate bombs, open colored shells and light up stars. There are 500 levels, each one tested, that get smarter step by step.

FIVE WORLDS
• Emerald Forest
• Frozen Kingdom
• Fire Valley
• Crystal Ocean
• Celestial Realm

PLAY AT YOUR OWN PACE
• No timer: you never lose because of time.
• No lives and no waiting.
• No ads.
• Powers (Hammer, Shuffle and Rainbow) are earned by playing, never sold.
• Daily challenge, achievements and stats.
• Works offline. Progress syncs through iCloud between iPhone and iPad.
• Optional Game Center leaderboards and achievements.
• VoiceOver on the board and Reduce Motion support.

FREE TO START
Chapter 1 (levels 1 to 20) is free. A single purchase unlocks the full game, with no subscription.

None of your data leaves your device except your own iCloud and Game Center.

name: Bloqu: Block Puzzle
description:
Drag blocks onto the 8×8 board, fill a row or column and watch it blast away.
Clear several lines with one block for a big combo, keep clearing move after move, and beat your best score.
Bloqu is a calm, colorful block puzzle: easy to learn, hard to put down, perfect for a 5-minute brain break.

HOW TO PLAY
• Drag one of the three blocks onto the board. Blocks don't rotate, so plan ahead.
• Fill a whole row or column to clear it.
• When all three blocks are placed, three new ones arrive.
• The game ends when no block fits. One more try?

TWO WAYS TO PLAY
• Classic: an endless block puzzle. Chase your high score.
• Adventure: 200 levels with goals (clear lines, reach a score, clear a shape) and new obstacles along the way: stone, ice, locks and bombs.

A REASON TO COME BACK EVERY DAY
• 3 new missions every day, with coin rewards
• A daily streak with rewards that grow each day, plus theme pieces
• Collect 9 themes with the coins you earn: Classic, Wood, Pastel, Night, Neon, Marble, Gem, Bright and Glow

LITTLE HELPERS
• Undo a move or rotate a block when you're stuck
• Continue once more after game over

MADE FOR SHORT BREAKS
• Play offline: no account, no clock
• Smooth animations, satisfying sounds and haptics
• In English and Turkish

Bloqu is free to play and contains ads. One optional in-app purchase: Remove Ads (no ads between levels; rewarded videos you choose to watch stay available). Themes are unlocked with coins earned by playing.

Privacy policy: https://alpateknoloji.com/bloqu/privacy/

name: Blumeo
description:
Blumeo for iPhone is the app for home-service businesses that use Blumeo, the AI front office that answers your calls, texts your leads back, follows up on estimates and asks happy customers for reviews.

Sign in with the email you use for Blumeo and run it from anywhere:

- Today: whether your receptionist is live, how many calls it took today, and who is waiting on a call back.
- Calls: every call with a plain summary, what the caller needs, the recording and the full transcript. Call back in one tap, get directions, send the job to a tech or put it on your calendar.
- Inbox: text conversations with your customers. Reply yourself, or take a conversation over from your receptionist.
- Alerts: a notification for emergencies, new jobs and customer texts, with Call and Text buttons right on the alert.
- Reviews: who was asked for a Google review, who replied happy, and a quick call back for anyone who wasn't.
- Follow-ups: every estimate being followed up by text, the dollars at stake, and who replied. Mark each one won or lost.
- Analytics: your revenue trend, key numbers and what stands out, from your own spreadsheet. Ask it questions in plain English.
- Campaigns: text past customers who signed up for offers, like seasonal tune-ups.
- Your receptionist: change its greeting, hours, prices and answers from your phone, and choose who answers.
- Team: invite your crew with a link and remove people who've left.
- Widgets: who's waiting on a call back, right on your Home Screen.

Reviews, follow-ups, analytics and campaigns depend on your Blumeo plan. The app follows your iPhone's light or dark setting.

This app is for Blumeo customers. New to Blumeo? Tap "Try it free" to set up on our website, then sign in here.

name: Boo Trap
description:
Arm your phone. Scare your friends.

Boo Trap turns your iPhone into a hidden prank. Pick a creepy sound, choose what sets it off, leave the phone on a shelf, under a pillow or next to the snack bowl, and wait for the scream.

TIME OR SENSOR: YOU CHOOSE WHAT SPRINGS THE TRAP

Time
• Instant: the sound plays after a countdown you set, from 0 seconds up to 5 minutes. Enough time to put the phone down and walk away.
• Exact time: pick the hour and minute. The scare plays today or, if that time has already passed, tomorrow.
• Random: set a time window, between two times or a number of minutes from now, and the scare plays at a random moment inside it. Even you won't know when.

Sensor
• Loudness: the scare plays when it gets clearly louder around the phone, like a door slamming or someone laughing.
• Motion: the scare plays when someone picks up or moves the phone.
Turn on one sensor or both. After you arm the trap, the sensors wait a few seconds, measure how quiet and still it is, and then start watching. Live meters show how close the noise or movement is to setting it off, and you can test the sensors before you arm them.

STAY HIDDEN

• Camouflage turns the screen completely black, as if the phone were switched off. Tap it to come back.
• The screen stays on while a scare is armed, so the trap keeps working.
• Add a short vibration to make the scare even stronger.
• Before arming, the app checks your setup and warns you about things that could ruin the moment, like low volume, notifications turned off or connected headphones.
• If you leave the app before a timed scare, it plays as a backup notification with the scare sound. Sensor mode works only while the app stays open.

10 SCARE SOUNDS

Creepy Laugh, Banshee Scream, Sudden Jumpscare, Ghostly Whisper, Demon Roar, Witch Cackle, Ghostly Boo, Creepy Music Box, Haunted Piano and Haunting Synth.
One of them, picked at random on your phone, is free. Unlock the others one by one or all 10 at once with Unlock All. Preview any sound before you use it, or let the app pick a random one from your unlocked sounds. Purchases are one-time and can be restored on a new device.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

No account, no ads, no tracking. The microphone is used only to measure loudness, only in Sensor mode with Loudness turned on and only while the app is open. Audio is never recorded, stored or sent anywhere. Motion readings stay on your iPhone. The only network connection is to the App Store for purchases.

PLAY NICE

Jumpscares can be genuinely frightening. Don't scare people with heart conditions or other health problems, small children, or anyone who is driving or operating machinery.

Play nice and keep it fun!

name: BorrowedFaces
description:
Two records show the same cabinet from different angles. Can you find the one arrangement that matches both?

In Borrowed Faces, you restore a royal collection of painted boxes. Each box has four decorated faces. Place the boxes in the cabinet and rotate them to match the Front View and Right View records. A box can look right from the front and show the wrong motif from the side.

Work through 24 puzzles across four chapters. Find boxes hidden behind others, figure out which way two boxes belong on a shared stand, and use intact clues to make sense of damaged records.

Take your time with step-by-step hints, undo, and automatic local saves. Revisit restored cabinets to trace a clue, compare an arrangement that matches only one view, or try your own arrangement before revealing the right view in selected levels.

name: BoskRalis
description:
Laundry day just became a mission you can win. BoskRalis reads the cryptic little symbols on your clothing labels, explains them in plain words, and then plans your loads so nothing shrinks, bleeds or warps on the way.

The whole app runs like a ship console: thin cyan scan lines, corner brackets, live readouts. Every screen tells you exactly what the label wants.

1. Forty care symbols, fully decoded
Wash tubs, bleach triangles, dryer squares, irons and dry-clean circles. All forty are bundled and drawn sharp at any size. Tap one for the meaning, a practical field tip, and what it changes in your wash plan.

2. Label builder
Holding a shirt with a tag full of hieroglyphs? Tap each symbol into the five label slots and the decoder spits out the full order: lane, max temperature, bleach rule, dryer heat and iron level. Missing a row? It tells you which safe default it will use.

3. Wardrobe with care sets
Save garments with a name, fabric, colour group, load weight and their exact care label. Filter by whites, lights, brights or darks and see at a glance which pieces still need a label.

4. Wash-group planner
The planner sorts your wardrobe into baskets that can share a run, split by colour, heat band and cycle. Hand-wash items get their own basin, dry-clean pieces go in the cleaner bag, and big piles get split to fit your drum size. The basket chart fills up live so you can see each load before you start.

5. Search everything
One search bar covers all forty symbols and your whole wardrobe. Type cold, flat, no bleach or a garment name and jump straight to it.

Extra loot:
- Log each finished load with a satisfying bamboo clack, and clear the full plan for a synth victory run (sounds can be switched off).
- A wash log keeps your recent runs with their settings.
- Dark console look by default, with a light look switch in Settings.
- Works fully offline. An anonymous backup keeps your wardrobe safe, with no account and no sign-in.

No ads, no subscriptions, no tracking. Just you, your laundry, and a label decoder that finally speaks human.

name: BrakeThermal
description: Jarrulevyn lämpökuorma, kitka, jäähdytys ja kuluminen. Laske pysäytyskohtainen lämpötilan nousu ja fade-riski.

name: Brew Lid
description:
Brew Lid keeps the way you make one tea on this iPhone, so the next cup can follow the same record.

Name the drink, then write the leaf in grams, the water in milliliters, and the heat in Celsius. For each step, write what you do and how many seconds it takes. Drag Tuck upward to set that step on the bowl. When at least two steps are in place, drag Twist the lid toward the trailing edge. The lid stays on the tray under the drink's name.

Later, drag that lid onto the bowl. The cup shows the leaf, water, heat, and the total seconds. Drag each step upward in order. When the last step is done, the sentence says the cup is made. The record stays on this phone. There is no account, no network, and no sample tea already filled in.

name: BrivThynen
description:
A triangle is only three dots until someone pulls on a corner. Then it leans, opens, and becomes something with a name.

BrivThynen is a quiet place for children to build shapes, measure angles and learn what each one is called. Every screen is laid out like an old paper ticket, with perforations, serial numbers and red ink stamps that land when something new is learned.

1. A board for building shapes
Drag the corners of a shape across a gridded ticket. Add a corner or take one away, from three up to eight. The board reads the shape as it changes and names it: equilateral, isosceles, right triangle, square, rhombus, trapezoid, kite, hexagon, and more. Each corner shows its angle, and right angles glow green. Turn on snapping when you want neat squares.

2. A protractor that turns with you
Two arms meet at a red pin. Swing either one and the gauge reads the opening, from a sharp acute beak to a reflex angle that reaches around the back. The ring turns with the first arm, so counting always starts at zero. A target challenge asks for an exact angle and rewards close work with stars.

3. Sixteen shape names, with clues
A glossary of every shape the board knows. Each entry has a clean drawing, a one-line clue, its corners, its sides and the sum of its angles. One tap sends it to the board to build.

4. Short quizzes
Eight cards a round, with no timer. Name the shape, read a clue, sort an angle into its kind, or guess its size. Wrong answers show the right one, gently, and the end of the round lists what is worth another look.

5. A ledger of progress
A grid of sixteen coupons fills with stamps as shapes are learned, by building them or naming them in a quiz. Angle kinds, quiz scores, stars caught and a daily streak sit beside it.

Kept shapes wait in a drawer of tickets. Gold foil shimmers when the phone tilts. A seed shaker marks a finished task, and a short clarinet riff greets something new; both can be switched off.

There are no accounts, no ads and no purchases. Your shapes (with any names you give them) and scores are backed up anonymously so they can be restored. Nothing else is collected.

name: BrK TV Remote
description:
No subscription. Every button is free. No ad on every tap: just two small fixed banners, removed for life with a single purchase.

BrK TV Remote turns your iPhone into a Wi-Fi remote for the Android TV and Google TV sets and boxes you own (including Chromecast with Google TV).
Not compatible with Samsung (Tizen), LG (webOS), Roku, Fire TV or Apple TV. Hisense, Philips, TCL, Sony: only models running Android TV / Google TV.

• Pair over Wi-Fi: a code appears on the TV, you confirm once
• Touchpad: swipe to navigate, tap for OK, long-press for Back
• Pilot screen: D-pad, volume, channels, power / home / back, number pad
• Built-in keyboard to type searches in your TV apps
• Shortcuts to open the apps installed on your TV
• Sleep timer (a notification alerts you at the set time)
• Automatic reconnection if your router reboots or the TV changes address
• Optional one-time purchase "BrK TV Remote Pro": removes ads and adds themes. No subscription.
• 15 languages

Built for your home: the app only controls the TV you pair on your local Wi-Fi. It does not host, stream, or resell video. It is not an IPTV service.
Your iPhone must be on the same Wi-Fi network as the TV (allow local network access).

Contains ads (Google AdMob banners in the free version). BrK collects no personal data; ads are handled by Google, according to your consent choice.
Android TV, Google TV and Chromecast are trademarks of Google LLC. Independent app, not affiliated with Google or Apple.

Privacy policy: https://brk-apk.com/en/brk-remote-confidentialite.html
Contact: mbarckfamma.mf@gmail.com

name: BroltQuesis
description:
OPERATING MANUAL FOR YOUR BREAKER PANEL

BroltQuesis is a notebook for the grey metal door in the garage. You record what every breaker feeds, once, and from then on you can find the right one without flipping switches at random. Read the five sections below. Then go stand in front of your panel.

1. THE PANEL GRID
Set the number of slots and the main breaker rating. Odd numbers run down the left, even numbers down the right, as on most residential panels. Tap a dashed slot to place a breaker. Choose single pole or double pole; a double pole takes its slot and the one directly beneath it. Each breaker carries a label, an amp rating and a note. Slots can be moved later. The app will refuse a move onto a slot that is already taken.

2. ROOMS AND DEVICES
Create rooms and give each one a flat ink from a ten-colour woodblock palette. Assign a breaker to a room and list the devices it powers: dishwasher, porch light, garage door opener. A device may live in a different room from its breaker. The grid prints every breaker in its room's ink, so the kitchen circuits show as one colour block at a glance. Tap a room chip to light only the breakers that feed it.

3. THE TESTED CHECKLIST
A label is only a guess until it is tested. Switch the panel to Checklist. Turn one breaker off, walk the house, and stamp what you found. "Went dark" marks it tested with the date. "Flag" records what did not match, such as a bedroom light that stayed on. A progress bar keeps count, and a short chord plays when the last breaker is confirmed.

4. WHICH BREAKER FOR...
Type what stopped working. The search reads device names, labels, rooms, notes and slot numbers, ignores the filler words, and ranks the answers. The matching slots light up on a small copy of the panel so you know where to reach before you open the door.

5. SHARE THE MAP
Print the whole panel as one tall image: name, slot numbers, labels, room inks and a legend. Send it to the electrician, the new tenant, or the printer, and tape the sheet inside the panel door.

GENERAL NOTES
Everything is stored on the phone and works with no connection. An anonymous backup copy is kept so a panel can be restored on a new phone. There is no account, no login and no advertising. Sounds can be switched off in Settings, and the look can follow day or night print.

This app is a labelling tool. It is not electrical advice. For any electrical work, use a licensed electrician.

name: Brownly
description:
Brownly brings your birthdays, gift ideas, and wishlists together in one place.

• Save birthdays, likes, sizes, and gift ideas.
• Get a reminder on the birthday when notifications are enabled.
• Create your wishlist, mark favorites, and share all your wishes with a link. Save lists shared with you, too.
• Plan Christmas gifts by person, add estimated prices and statuses, and track your total budget.

The free version lets you add one person. A one-time purchase lets you add more people, view the history of marked ideas, choose advance reminders, and use the royal capybara avatar. The price is shown in the App Store before you confirm the purchase.

name: BSR Integrated & Intelligent
description:
BSR Integrated & Intelligent (BSR I&I) là ứng dụng nội bộ của Công ty Cổ phần Lọc hóa dầu Bình Sơn (BSR), phục vụ kỹ sư, vận hành viên và quản lý tại Nhà máy Lọc dầu Dung Quất.

Tính năng chính:
- Bảo dưỡng: xem và thực hiện Work Order, ghi giờ công, ghi thời điểm bắt đầu/kết thúc từng bước, chụp ảnh hiện trường, tạo Work Request trên Maximo.
- Quét mã QR gói công việc và kho vật tư.
- Làm việc offline, tự đồng bộ khi có kết nối.
- Tài khoản SAP: mở khoá user, cấp lại mật khẩu.
- Nhận thông báo công việc.

Ứng dụng chỉ dành cho nhân viên BSR và đối tác được cấp quyền, đăng nhập bằng tài khoản Microsoft do BSR cấp.

name: BTECH School
description:
BTECH School is your personal online tutor for CSEC and PEP — made in Jamaica.

PRACTISE LIKE THE REAL EXAM
• Exam-style questions for every subject and topic, modelled on the CSEC and PEP format
• Practise by topic, by skill, or sit a full timed paper
• Get it wrong? See why straight away, then watch a short video lesson on that exact skill
• Hints, read-aloud and a tutor's report on your strengths and what to work on

CLUBS FOR EVERY AGE
• Reading Club — learn to read step by step: sounds, words, then stories
• Chess Club — from the very first square to playing against Teacha
• Spelling Club — snap your spelling list and we'll call the words

ASK TEACHA
Stuck or not sure where to go? Ask Teacha, your friendly helper — type or just talk.

LEARNING THAT FEELS LIKE A GAME
Earn coins, keep your streak, unlock badges and climb the leaderboard — by grade, by school or all of Jamaica.

ONE PHONE, THE WHOLE FAMILY
Each child gets their own profile and their own progress.

BTECH School is an independent tutoring service. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Caribbean Examinations Council (CXC). Questions are original practice material modelled on the exam format.

name: Bubble Shooter 3D: City Pop
description:
Aim, shoot and match at least three balls of the same color. Detached bubbles fall too. Explore 400 different levels across Neon City, Sunset and Night City. Clear the board or collect glowing energy cores before your shots run out.

Use bomb, lightning, rainbow and double-ball boosters. Earn game points through popping and combos, then spend them in the points shop. Enjoy bonus levels, daily gifts, a prize wheel and original night-drive music.

Play in Dutch, English, German, French, Spanish or Portuguese. The game uses your device language when supported, with English as the fallback. You can change the language in the game. Progress is stored locally on your device.

Optional rewarded ads grant 300 game points after a full view. No ads interrupt aiming or shooting. Ads need an internet connection. One free spin daily. Earn an extra spin after 5 new levels or by watching an ad. At most one extra spin per day. 300, 500 or 800 points, a bomb, lightning or rainbow: 12.5% each. Double ball: 25%. Game points only; no real money.

For teenagers and adults aged 13 and up.

name: Buddy Trip: Offline Adventures
description:
Pack your bag! Buddy Trip is a one-tap runner across the world's most beautiful cities, and it plays anywhere, even offline on a train or a plane.

Your buddy runs by themselves. Tap to jump, hold to jump higher. Simple to learn, hard to put down.

FOUR CITIES, THIRTY-TWO PLACES
- Paris: hop across Haussmann rooftops, bounce on café parasols, stroll the Seine and finish under the Eiffel Tower with fireworks.
- Rome: run through ancient ruins, double-jump onto temples, ride pulsing fountains and climb into the Colosseum.
- Athens: dash through the white lanes of Plaka and leap crumbling stones on the way up to the Parthenon.
- London: ride riverboats across the Thames, race Tower Bridge as it closes and splash through the rain past Big Ben.

EVERY LEVEL IS A NEW PLACE
Misty mornings, golden afternoons, sudden showers with rainbows, starry nights. Each level has its own scenery, weather and surprises.

POWER-UPS WITH A TRAVEL TWIST
- Café rush: run faster and nothing can stop you
- Souvenir magnet: treats fly into your backpack
- Paper plane: glide over everything

COLLECT AND UNLOCK
Find three hidden treasures in every level, collect macarons, gelato, olives and scones, win each city's outfit (beret, sunglasses, laurel wreath, bowler hat) and earn stars to fly to the next city.

PLAYS OFFLINE
No Wi-Fi? No problem. Your progress is saved on your phone.

Buddy Trip is free to play with optional add-ons!

name: BuddyPort: Fox Defense
description:
The foxes used to disrupt the Buddies' adventures. Now IO and the fox squad must defend the treasure from a growing horde of thieves.

BATTLE YOUR WAY
Hold the battlefield to fire IO's cannon continuously. Drag to aim, then release to stop. Protect three treasure chests as enemies rush forward, shield themselves, and fire back at IO and the fox troops.

BUILD YOUR FOX SQUAD
Spend battle energy to deploy up to three allies at a time. Each fox fires automatically, has its own health and cooldown, and brings a signature skill:

• Travel: Rogue pulls thieves back with a harpoon, Trapper plants a snare mine, and Raider slows crowds with a wide net.
• Space: Pirate Fox fires a piercing starshot, while Miner Fox intercepts a shot aimed at IO.
• Pirate: Corsair fires a three-shell broadside, while Navigator marks targets for stronger allied attacks.

TURN THE TIDE
Call down an arrow volley or bomb strike on a crowded row. Use the Health Injector to restore IO's health. Choose when to use each skill as the waves grow larger and enemies grow tougher.

SIX ADVENTURES, TWO WAYS TO PLAY
Travel, Space, and Pirate are free campaigns. Each has 20 story missions with coin and Fox XP rewards, changing enemy patterns, and boss battles. Endless Waves saves your best wave in each adventure.

The optional, one-time Expansion Pass unlocks Frostwild, Sky Isles, and Ancient Jungle. Each adds 20 story missions, Endless Waves, themed enemies, and a new boss.

GROW YOUR DEFENSE
Earn coins to upgrade IO's cannon, chest defense, and armor. Improve both shot power and health for your fox troops in the Workshop. Clear an adventure's missions to claim its Guardian Relic. The three free relics earn the Master Guardian trophy; collect all six to complete the vault.

A guided first battle teaches the controls, first-time players receive a starter gift, and progress can sync with iCloud when available.

name: Budify: Luggage-Free Travel
description:
Don't drag your suitcase around after you land. Budify delivers your luggage to your hotel or your next destination, so you can travel hands-free from day one.

■ What you can book
• Airport → Hotel delivery: Drop your bags at the arrival airport and start exploring. Pick them up at your hotel.
• Hotel → Airport delivery: Stay light on your last day, even after check-out. Pick up your bags at the departure airport.
• Hotel → Hotel delivery: Changing hotels? Send just your bags to the next one.
• Easy-Drop: Drop off your bags at a city counter in Seoul or Incheon and collect them at your arrival airport.
• Luggage storage: Leave your bags at a city location and explore freely.

■ Where we operate
Major travel destinations across Asia, including Korea, Japan, Taiwan, Hong Kong, Singapore and Thailand.

■ In the app
• See where your bags are at a glance with delivery status
• Book in minutes with just your flight and hotel
• Pay right away with local or international cards
• Change or cancel bookings and see your refund amount
• Available in English, Korean and Japanese

■ Customer support
Email seouloffice@budify.app (Mon–Fri 9:00–19:00 KST)

name: Bump Soccer
description:
Bump Soccer is turn-based soccer for up to 10 players, 2 to 5 a side, in a packed stadium. Every turn, everyone aims in secret, then every shot plays at once: push the ball into the other goal before they push it into yours.

SOCCER WITH A SLINGSHOT
Drag back from your player to aim, lock in, and both teams launch together. Nobody knows who reaches the ball first. Crates bring power-ups: Cross lofts the ball over everyone's heads, Jump leaps you over the players in your way, Scout shows you an opponent's aim, and Cannon, Glue and Keeper are in there too.

NO LAG TO LOSE TO
Everyone gets the same time to aim, and the server plays every shot the same for all. A slow connection only means you see the play a moment later.

PLAY YOUR WAY
- Quick play: Ranked or Casual, alone or with your party.
- Make a room: send the link or its 4-letter code to your friends. The host picks the rules.
- Practice vs computer: up to 5 a side against bots, Easy, Normal or Hard.
- Tournaments and leaderboards when you want to compete.
- Watch any match being played.

YOUR PROFILE
Sign in with just your email to keep your XP, level, rank and badges, unlock new looks as you level up, join a team and add friends. Or play as a guest.

FRIENDLY
Chat and emotes with a filter for rude words, rooms the host can make emotes only, and Report and Block for any player. No ads and nothing to buy.

Play in 12 languages, including English, Portuguese, Spanish and Korean.

HOW TO PLAY
Drag back from your player to aim: the arrow shows the direction and the power. Let go, then tap Lock in. Everyone launches when all have aimed or the clock runs out.

name: BXDelux
description: BXDelux現金の保管場所、取引ごとの支払額、お釣りとして受け取った紙幣・硬貨の内訳を、一つの記録としてまとめて入力できます。 駐車料金については、実際に支払った合計額を記録するだけでなく、必要に応じて、使用した紙幣や硬貨を個別に記録することも可能です。 現金を引き出した際には、その現金がどの保管場所に割り当てられたかを追跡し、発生した手数料は別途「経費」として記録します。 受講料などを現金と銀行カードを併用して支払った場合、後から返金が発生した際にも、元の支払いと紐づけて追跡することが可能です。 現金の棚卸し（実査）を行う際は、紙幣・硬貨の種類ごとに集計します。 もし実査額と記録上の残高が一致しない場合は、前回の棚卸し以降の取引履歴を確認し、未入力の経費を追加したり、現金の保管場所の記録を修正したりすることができます。 現金の流れは週単位または月単位で把握できるほか、期末残高をクリックすれば、その時点の棚卸し記録と、それ以降に行われたすべての取引を確認することが可能です。

name: Calibre Web Companion
description:
This is an unofficial companion app for Calibre-Web (which also works with Calibre-Web Automated, Calibre-Web-NextGen, Grimmory, calibre's "Sharing over the net" and other OPDS servers) that lets you browse your book collection and download books directly to your device. You can also interact with your books by marking them as read, unread or bookmarked. It is also possible to send books directly to your e-reader (Kindle/Kobo) thanks to the great work of BookDrop.

You need your own server: the app does not include any books, it shows what is stored in your library.

Features:

- Connect to your Calibre-Web (Automated), Grimmory, calibre and OPDS servers, including reverse proxy / SSO setups, custom HTTP headers and self-signed certificates.
- Browse your whole library with smooth, fast navigation.
- Discover books by category, author, series, publisher, rating, hot & trending, and more.
- View rich details for every book, edit its metadata and upload new covers.
- Mark books as read or unread, archive them and organize them into shelves.
- Create, edit and browse Magic Shelves: dynamic, rule-based shelves (Calibre-Web Automated & Calibre-Web-NextGen only).
- Add books quickly by scanning their ISBN barcode.
- Read EPUB, PDF and CBZ books in the built-in reader, with bookmarks. Books are fetched when you open them, kept on the device up to a storage limit you choose, and marked as read when you finish them.
- Sync your reading progress across devices with KOReader Sync or your own WebDAV server.
- Send books to your e-reader via BookDrop or Calibre-Web's email function.
- Upload books to your server.
- Sync your whole library or selected books for offline reading; downloads also show up in the Files app.
- Check your collection statistics at a glance.
- Make it yours: reorder or hide book actions, detail sections and Discover sections, choose a theme, enable e-ink mode and adjust the text size.
- Available in 20 languages.

Open source: the app is free software (GNU GPL v3). The price only covers Apple's yearly developer fee, it is not meant to make a profit. The source code is on GitHub, and you can build the app yourself.

The app is in active development. Please report bugs, feedback and feature ideas on GitHub.

name: CALPOR
description: CALPOR Designed for those who want to quickly record income and expenses and periodically organize their accounts. Upon opening the app, you can view monthly totals by category; simply tap a category—such as transportation, housing, or education—enter the amount, and save. For each category, you can set default accounts, frequent notes, and preset amount buttons, or record multiple transactions in succession. Transactions that cannot be categorized immediately can be added to a "pending" queue, where they can later be selected in bulk to update their category, date, or account. If a single payment serves multiple purposes, you can split the amount and verify the total. A dedicated income panel tracks earnings such as wages or income from personal services. The transaction history page allows for searching and editing entries, while the statistics page provides insights into expense rankings, daily spending, cumulative income and expenses, and balance fluctuations—making it easy to review your monthly financial management.

name: CAMI – Histoires du soir
description:
CAMI invente avec vous des histoires personnalisées où votre enfant devient le héros.

Choisissez le prénom, un thème et la durée : en quelques secondes, CAMI écrit une histoire douce et adaptée à l'âge de votre enfant, de 3 à 10 ans. Au milieu de l'aventure, votre enfant choisit la suite !

• Des histoires de 4 à 10 minutes, en mode Dodo ou Aventure
• Des choix interactifs pour que l'enfant participe
• Un livre illustré, avec votre enfant dessiné en héros
• Une bibliothèque familiale pour relire ses histoires préférées
• Lecture à voix haute, avec la voix de l'appareil ou la voix de papa ou maman (option Voix de famille)
• Rappel du coucher, mode nuit et lecture écran verrouillé

Pensé pour les familles : pas de publicité, données hébergées en Europe, suppression du compte en un geste.

Formules : Découverte gratuite (3 histoires), CAMI Mensuel 5,99 €/mois, CAMI Annuel 49,99 €/an, option Voix de famille 3,99 €/mois. Les abonnements se renouvellent automatiquement et se résilient à tout moment dans les réglages de votre identifiant Apple, au moins 24 heures avant la fin de la période en cours.

Conditions d'utilisation : https://cami-stories.app/conditions
Confidentialité : https://cami-stories.app/confidentialite

name: Capybara Crossing: Pond
description:
Meet the comfiest puzzle game on the pond!

Your capybara friends are ready for a little adventure. Each one wears a tiny hat, flower or scarf in its own colour, and each colour has a lotus waiting for it. Hop them across the lily pads and lead every capybara home. Simple to start, surprisingly clever to master, and always relaxing.

HAND-CRAFTED PUZZLES
300 ponds across 12 peaceful worlds, from sunny ponds and lotus lagoons to frosty fens, bamboo groves and hot springs at sunset. A gentle learning curve and plenty of "aha!" moments along the way.

NEW TWISTS IN EVERY WORLD
Wobbly lily pads that sink after one hop, flowing currents, waddling ducks, flower switches and bridges, slippery ice, swirling whirlpools, bobbing turtles and drifting rafts keep every world fresh.

CHASE THREE STARS
Solve each pond in the fewest hops to earn all 3 stars, or just enjoy the journey. Undos, hints and restart are there when you need them.

A NEW POND EVERY DAY
The Daily Pond brings a fresh puzzle every day. Build your streak and collect bonus lily coins.

YOUR OWN CAPYBARA SANCTUARY
Decorate your island with lanterns, lotus flowers, a steamy hot spring and more. Dress your capybaras in hats, bows and crowns, pick new colours and fur, and welcome new friends as you explore each world. Pet them, feed them watermelon and watch them nap in the sun.

COLLECT BADGES
Earn a medal for every world and dozens of milestone badges along the way.

MADE TO UNWIND
Gentle music for every world. No timers, no lives, no rush. Play offline, anytime.

Perfect for puzzle lovers, families and anyone who simply adores capybaras.

Capybara Crossing is free to play. It contains ads (a short ad between some ponds, plus optional videos for extra hints, undos or double lily coins) and optional in-app purchases. The one-time Cozy Supporter purchase removes all ads. Undos and hints refill for free every 5 ponds, and Restart is always free.

Made with love by Peachbyte Studio.

name: CardScore: Score Keeper
description:
CardScore keeps score so you can focus on playing.

Use it for card games, board games, and friendly competitions. Set up players or teams, enter scores round by round, and see totals and standings without passing around a calculator.

INDIVIDUAL AND TEAM PLAY
• Track individual players or teams.
• Choose team-total scoring or individual member scores.
• Use optional average-per-member scoring for unequal teams.

FLEXIBLE RULES
• Higher score wins or lower score wins.
• Target score, round limit, elimination, or manual finish.
• Tie rules to suit your game.

QUICK, CLEAR SCOREKEEPING
• Enter positive, negative, or zero scores.
• Skip a score, edit a past round, or undo a mistake.
• Follow round history and standings as the game progresses.

YOUR GAME LIBRARY
• Save players, teams, and groups.
• Quick Start, templates, duplicate, and rematch.
• Review player and team statistics.

SHARE RESULTS
• Share a result as an image or PDF.
• Export game history to CSV.

OFFLINE BY DESIGN
• No account.
• No ads or analytics.
• Game data is stored on your device.
• No internet connection or cloud sync required.

Your games stay on your device unless you choose to share or export them.

name: CareJobs.Now: Healthcare Jobs
description:
CareJobs.Now shows the open healthcare jobs at about 10,000 US hospitals, health systems, clinics, nursing homes and home care companies, read every night from the employers' own career sites, with the pay each job posts.

Search by job and by state, see what each job pays, and open the job's page to apply. No account is needed.

What you can do:
- See open jobs for your work in your state, newest or best paid first, with the posted pay
- Filter by kind of care work and by the least hourly pay you want
- Save jobs to come back to
- Turn on an alert and get a notification when new jobs that fit open

For nurses (RN and LPN), CNAs and patient care techs, caregivers and home health aides, medical assistants, therapists, imaging and lab techs, pharmacy and dental staff, front desk staff and doctors.

Pay is the base rate employers post on their own career sites. CareJobs.Now is free. Some hiring partners pay CareJobs.Now per click or a referral fee; that never changes the pay shown.

name: CarMirror: Screen to Car
description:
CarMirror puts your iPhone on the car screen — simply.

SCREEN SHARING
Tap Start sharing, then open the address CarMirror shows in your car screen’s web browser. Everything on your iPhone appears on the car display — any app. It works over Personal Hotspot or the same Wi-Fi, with nothing to install in the car. Made for car screens with a web browser, such as many Android head units.

TEST SCREEN
Not sure the car screen is connected? Show a test screen on the car first — colour bars and a clock appear right away.

CAR SCREEN CONTROLS
See a live preview of what the car shows, and change it from your phone: fit or fill the screen, zoom, rotate, flip, freeze the picture, auto-rotate with the phone and a night dim for driving in the dark.

AIRPLAY AND HDMI
Car screen or adapter with AirPlay, or an HDMI input? CarMirror shows the quick steps for the iPhone’s built-in mirroring.

FREE OR PRO
Free sharing runs in 20-minute sessions; a short ad plays on the phone when you start the next one — never on the car screen.
CarMirror Pro, from about a dollar a month:
• Unlimited sharing — no 20-minute limit
• No ads
• Higher picture quality at 30 fps
• No CarMirror label on the car screen
Monthly, or yearly with a free trial. Family Sharing supported.

SAFETY FIRST
CarMirror is for passengers and parked cars. Never watch video while driving.

AirPlay is a trademark of Apple Inc. CarMirror is not affiliated with Apple.

Privacy Policy: https://aliosh99.github.io/carmirror-legal/privacy.html

name: Catmino: Cozy Cat Puzzle
seller_name: BAO LAM INVESTMENT CONSULTING AND MANAGEMENT COMPANY LIMITED
description:
Every cat wants the perfect spot. Can you find it?

Catmino is a cozy puzzle game where every piece is a cat. Each kitty has its own shape, from a tiny curled-up kitten to a long stretched-out tabby. Drag them onto the rug, turn them around, and tuck them in until every square is filled and everyone is purring.

HOW TO PLAY
• Drag a cat onto the rug and let go. Tap it to rotate
• Fill every square to clear the level
• Cats are picky: one wants the sunny spot, one wants the soft cushion, one wants to nap next to its best friend
• Keep every cat happy to earn all 3 stars
• Stuck? Spend a few fish on a hint. There is no timer and no lives, so take your time

FREE TO TRY, ONE PURCHASE FOR THE FULL GAME
• Play the Living Room and the Beach (20 levels), the Daily Puzzle and the Cat House for free
• One purchase of the Full Game unlocks the other 10 rooms, the bonus level and every new story room we add later
• No subscriptions, no energy, no timers. Fish and hints are earned by playing, never sold

120 HAND-PICKED LEVELS, 12 ROOMS
• Start on the living room rug, then move on to the beach, the bathroom, the kitchen, the garden, the attic, a cafe, a campsite and more
• Every room has its own twist: a robot vacuum that makes a mess, crabs on the sand, puddles nobody wants to lie in
• Earn stars to unlock the next room
• A brand-new Daily Puzzle every day

THE CAT HOUSE
• Cats you win over move into your Cat House
• Collect 18 cats, each with its own personality, favourite things and keepsake
• Buy cushions, baskets, beds and a cat tree with the fish you earn, and place them wherever you like
• Pet your cats, feed them, and get little thank-you gifts in return
• Earn enough stars and guest cats drop by to visit

MADE TO RELAX
• Soft felt-style art, gentle music and real purrs
• Squishy cats that wobble and stretch as you drag them
• Play completely offline, anywhere
• No account needed. No data collected
• Plays in portrait on phones and in any orientation on tablets
• English and Vietnamese

Take a breath, find a spot for every cat, and enjoy the purring.

name: CG-Core.
description:
Built around the figures a decision needs, CG-Core. pairs a clear, modern interface with the numbers that matter most: what the work costs, what it brings in, and what is still owed.
We believe a good tool should stay quiet. So the surface holds its voice down — review the work, adjust the figures, keep the record, and watch the result follow as you tap and edit. Nothing on screen competes with the decision you are trying to make.
Performance and reliability, to us, look like consistency: one styling across every screen, practical controls, navigation that never asks you to learn a second system, and attention left on the work itself rather than on settings. That is the standard CG-Core. holds itself to, and the reason it keeps improving without adding noise.
Nothing extra in the way — just the figures, kept where you left them.

name: Chat GGPro
description:
Chat GGPro is an AI assistant designed for everyday work and study. You can use it to draft and revise text, organize the key points and different perspectives on a topic, read lengthy materials and extract key information, and also do translation, break down tasks, analyze data, write and understand code, organize presentation content, summarize meeting notes, prepare for interviews, or plan a trip.

Different tasks are handled by corresponding agents, including writing, research, documents, translation, learning coach, work assistant, data analysis, programming, presentations, meeting notes, career coach, and travel planning. You just need to clearly state your goal, audience, and constraints, and it will provide structured results that you can directly continue to revise.

You can ask questions by text, use voice input, or provide an image and have it describe the scene, extract text, translate content, or summarize key points. Answers are easy to copy and read aloud, and past conversations are kept locally for you to continue next time.

If the subscription is not closed at least 24 hours before the end of the subscription period, it will be automatically renewed.

name: ChatSpln: Talk Together
description:
ChatSpln: Talk Together zamienia zwykłe spotkanie w płynną, angażującą rozmowę. Jednym telefonem uruchomisz scenariusz, dobierzesz liczbę uczestników i zaczniesz serię pytań, tematów oraz wspólnych zadań dopasowanych do sytuacji.

To aplikacja stworzona do spotkań na żywo, bez konta i bez internetu. Wszystko działa od razu po instalacji, a gotowe scenariusze, biblioteka kart, ulubione i historia są zapisywane na urządzeniu.

Najważniejsze funkcje
- 12 gotowych scenariuszy - od pierwszego poznania i pierwszej randki po rodzinny wieczór, podróż, plany, wspomnienia i kreatywne zabawy.
- 180 gotowych kart - pytania i zadania dostępne od razu, bez czekania i bez pustych miejsc w spotkaniu.
- Elastyczny edytor - zmieniaj nazwę scenariusza, dodawaj i usuwaj etapy, edytuj pytania, układaj kartki przeciąganiem i zapisuj własne wersje osobno.
- Biblioteka i ulubione - przeglądaj treści według tematów, szukaj kart, dodawaj własne materiały i szybko buduj spotkanie z ulubionych.
- Różne formaty spotkań - krótka, zwykła lub pełna wersja, z opcją wyłączenia zadań i ustawienia częstotliwości Spin.
- Losowe wydarzenia Spin - obrotowe zwroty akcji, które przekierowują pytania, uruchamiają rundę odpowiedzi, wspólne omawianie albo mieszają karty w trakcie.
- Wspólne działania - zdjęcie, wspólny rysunek i notatka ze spotkania, które można zapisać i wrócić do nich później.
- Historia i wznowienie - niedokończone spotkanie wraca dokładnie tam, gdzie zostało przerwane, także po zamknięciu aplikacji.

Idealne dla
- Par, które chcą spędzić czas bliżej siebie i lepiej się poznać.
- Paczek znajomych szukających prostego sposobu na rozmowę, śmiech i wspólne zadania.
- Rodzin, które chcą ożywić wieczór i otworzyć się na ciekawe tematy.
- Osób prowadzących spotkania towarzyskie, wyjazdy, randki lub integracje.

Dlaczego warto
ChatSpln łączy gotowe treści, elastyczny edytor i dynamiczne wydarzenia Spin w jedną, dopracowaną aplikację do rozmów na żywo. Każdy scenariusz ma logiczną strukturę, a jednocześnie pozostawia miejsce na spontaniczność, własne pomysły i wspólne decyzje. Duże, czytelne karty, przejrzysty interfejs i tryb offline sprawiają, że aplikacja jest wygodna zarówno w domu, jak i w podróży.

Zacznij od gotowego scenariusza albo stwórz własny. Otwórz aplikację, wybierz spotkanie i pozwól rozmowie poprowadzić resztę.

name: Cheat Code for GTA 6
description:
An unofficial, fan-made guide to every cheat in GTA 6 for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.

• All 61 cheats in one place: player, combat, vehicle, environment and screen-filter cheats
• Every code shown as real controller buttons, so you can read it at a glance
• Switch between PS5 and Xbox button layouts
• The in-game challenge that unlocks each cheat
• Step-by-step guide to entering cheats on the in-game phone
• Practice mode: tap codes on an on-screen controller before you try them in the game
• Favorites for the cheats you use most
• New codes appear automatically as they're discovered, no app update needed
• Works offline. No account, no ads, no tracking.

Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Rockstar Games, Take-Two Interactive, Sony Interactive Entertainment or Microsoft. All trademarks belong to their owners and are used only to describe compatibility.

name: Chef Frosty: Fridge Recipes
description:
Not sure what to cook? Chef Frosty looks in your fridge for you.

Take a photo of your fridge and Chef Frosty finds your ingredients, then suggests recipes you can make right now, starting with the food that's about to go off. Less waste, less stress, and no more "there's nothing to eat".

SNAP YOUR FRIDGE
• Take a photo, or pick one from your library
• Chef Frosty spots your food on your phone, no internet needed
• Check the list, add anything it missed, and you're done

COOK WHAT YOU HAVE
• Recipes ready to cook with what's in your fridge
• Ideas that only need 1 or 2 more things
• Food that expires soon comes first, so nothing goes to waste
• Simple step-by-step instructions, from omelettes to stir-fries

KNOW WHAT'S EXPIRING
• Every food gets an expiry estimate you can adjust
• A clear "use soon" reminder at the top of your fridge
• Mark food as used up when you cook

CHEF FROSTY PRO
One purchase, no subscription:
• Unlimited fridge scans (free: 3 a day)
• Reminders the day before food expires
• Vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free and dairy-free filters
• A smart shopping list: add missing ingredients, tick them off and they go straight into your fridge

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your photos and your fridge list stay on your phone.

Available in English, Spanish, French, Portuguese, Russian, Chinese, Hindi, Bengali, Arabic and Indonesian.

Questions or ideas? Write to me from the support page. I'm Alex, an independent developer, and I read every message.

name: Chroma: Color & Material Lab
description:
Step into a physical material and color library with Chroma. Designed for interior designers, industrial creators, photographers, and aesthetic minimalists, Chroma turns your iPhone into an offline tactile swatch studio and lighting laboratory.

TACTILE MATERIAL SWATCHES
Flip through curated decks of physical surfaces—raw linen, brushed titanium, lime plaster, smoked glass, and mineral pigments—complete with crisp card-snap feedback powered by CoreHaptics.

REAL-TIME KELVIN & GYRO LIGHTING
Tilt your device to inspect realistic specular highlights and surface roughness. Shift ambient lighting from warm 2700K candlelight to crisp 6500K north daylight to see how materials truly react.

PRECISION COLOR & CONTRAST METRICS
Inspect exact LCH, CIE LAB, and HEX coordinates. Evaluate optical contrast ratios between paired surfaces and build timeless material compositions without internet access.

TABLETOP PALETTE STANDBY
Mount your device horizontally to display your curated material board under subtle, shifting studio light throughout the day.

name: Cildim: Skin Analysis
description:
Cildim helps you understand your skin and build a care routine that genuinely fits it. Scan your skin signals with your camera in 30 seconds, learn which active ingredients you need, and check whether the product in your hand suits you by scanning its barcode.

KNOW YOUR SKIN
One analysis brings together six signals: hydration, sebum balance, pore appearance, calmness, texture and tone evenness. The result screen clearly shows your strengths and the areas that need support.

INGREDIENTS FIRST, BOTTLES SECOND
Cildim does not sell products or push brands; it tells you which active ingredients to look for based on what your skin needs. Learn what niacinamide, salicylic acid, retinol, vitamin C and more can do, which skin types they suit, and which ingredients should not be used together.

A ROUTINE THAT FITS YOU
Your morning and evening routine is organised around your analysis results. Tick off steps, keep your daily streak going and edit the routine whenever you like.

CHECK A PRODUCT BY ITS BARCODE
Scan a product's barcode and have its ingredient list assessed against your skin type, your priorities and your current routine. See "Suits your skin", "Use with care" or "Not suitable for your skin", with the reasons. Product data comes from the open Open Beauty Facts database; if a product is missing, just paste its ingredient list.

SMART INGREDIENT ANALYZER
Paste a product's INCI list to instantly see how it suits your skin type and whether it conflicts with your current routine.

IN 11 LANGUAGES
Turkish, English, Simplified Chinese, Hindi, Spanish, French, Arabic, Bengali, Portuguese, Russian and Urdu, including right-to-left layouts for Arabic and Urdu.

PRIVACY FIRST
No account needed. Photos never leave your device, are never uploaded to a server and are not saved to history. Analyses, your routine and language choice are stored only on your device. When you scan a barcode, only the barcode number is sent to the Open Beauty Facts database.

IMPORTANT NOTE
Cildim does not diagnose medical conditions and is not a substitute for a dermatologist. Analyses and product assessments are cosmetic estimates for informational purposes only. If you have a persistent or serious skin concern, consult a dermatologist.

Download Cildim and discover what your skin is telling you.

name: CILS B1 Citizenship Mock Exam
description:
This app does not represent any government entity. This is not an official exam.

Prepare for CILS B1 Cittadinanza from the Università per Stranieri di Siena, one of the B1 Italian certificates you can submit with an application for Italian citizenship by residence or by marriage. Requirements and procedures are on the official sources at the end of this page.

THE 4 PARTS OF THE EXAM
• Listening (Ascolto): multiple-choice dialogues and true/false texts
• Reading (Lettura): true/false texts and a gap-fill text (grammar)
• Writing (Produzione scritta): an e-mail
• Speaking (Produzione orale): a presentation and a dialogue

133 PRACTICE TASKS
19 units for each of the 7 task types. Listening and reading are checked instantly, with explanations.

30 FULL MOCK EXAMS
The parts in exam order (Listening, Reading, break, Writing, Speaking), each with its own timer. In listening, each audio plays twice. At the end you get a report for every part.

AI FEEDBACK ON WRITING AND SPEAKING
Write the e-mail and record your spoken answers. The examiner's lines are pre-recorded and you answer by voice: it is not a live conversation. Spoken answers are transcribed first, then evaluated. The AI report gives an estimate for each CILS criterion, your mistakes with corrections, a corrected text and a model answer. It is an estimate for practice: it is not an official score and does not replace assessment by a CILS examiner. AI can make mistakes. The AI evaluation of speaking is indicative and keeps being improved; it may sometimes be paused.

WEAK-AREA TRAINING
With Premium, Training builds sessions from the task types where you make the most mistakes. History and Progress keep your attempts and reports.

LANGUAGE AND SIGN-IN
Interface in Italian and English; exam tasks are always in Italian. Continue as a guest or sign in with Apple or Google.

FREE AND PREMIUM
Free: 10 Reading, 4 Listening, 2 Writing and 4 Speaking tasks, plus 1 full mock exam with its report. The free mock counts only when you finish it and its report is ready.
CILS Premium includes: all 133 practice tasks, all 30 full mock exams, weak-area Training and AI feedback on Writing and Speaking, up to 20 AI reports a day.

SUBSCRIPTION
CILS Premium is an auto-renewing subscription with four lengths: 1 month, 3 months, 6 months or 12 months. The price of each plan in your currency is shown on the Premium screen and by the App Store before you buy. No free trial. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. The subscription renews automatically at the same price and for the same length unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; the renewal is charged within the 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel it in Settings > your name > Subscriptions. On another device, tap "Restore purchases" on the Premium screen. Deleting the app or your account does not cancel the subscription.

AI AND YOUR DATA
When you submit a written or spoken answer, its text or recording and transcript are sent with the task to AI providers (OpenAI; Google Cloud Vertex AI as backup) for evaluation. Your name and e-mail are not sent. You can delete your account in the app (Profile > Delete account) or at https://smartpreplabs.com/delete-account/cils/

OFFICIAL SOURCES
Ministry of the Interior, Citizenship: https://www.interno.gov.it/it/temi/cittadinanza-e-altri-diritti-civili/cittadinanza
Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Citizenship: https://www.esteri.it/it/servizi-opportunita/italiani-all-estero/cittadinanza/
CILS, Università per Stranieri di Siena: https://cils.unistrasi.it/

Privacy Policy: https://smartpreplabs.com/privacy/cils/
Terms of Use: https://smartpreplabs.com/terms/cils/
Apple Standard EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Cindro
description:
Get more from your skillet and Dutch oven with Cindro, your offline cast iron cooking companion for iPhone. Plan your ingredients, follow each cook, and remember what worked for next time.
Prepare with less guesswork
Explore eight illustrated recipes for the stovetop, oven, and camp coals. Adjust servings, scale ingredients automatically, and bring everything together in one organized shopping list.
Find your cooking rhythm
Follow step-by-step instructions and in-app timers. For camp cooking, Heat Coach offers starting charcoal layouts, browning guidance, and short recheck timers to help you adjust as you go.

name: CineLog: Movie & TV Diary
description:
CineLog picks what to watch tonight from your own watchlist, based on what you've loved, and keeps a private diary of everything you watch.

PLAN WHAT TO WATCH • Search millions of movies and series, or browse what's trending this week and explore by genre • Save titles to your Watchlist with one tap • Pick a night to watch — Up Next shows "Tonight", "Tomorrow" or the day you planned • Can't decide? Surprise Me learns your taste from your ratings and picks tonight's movie, with a reason for every pick

SEE WHERE TO WATCH • Streaming, rental and purchase options for your country • Cast, director, trailer and similar titles on every page

REMEMBER WHAT YOU WATCHED • Log a watch with a 5-star rating, the date and your thoughts • Your Diary groups entries by month, with stats for titles logged, this year, hours watched and your average rating • Keep your 5-star favorites front and center • Export your diary as a CSV any time, ready to open in Numbers or import into other apps

PRIVATE BY DESIGN • No account, no sign-in • No ads, analytics or tracking • Your watchlist and diary stay on your devices and sync privately through your own iCloud

BUILT FOR EVERYONE • VoiceOver, Voice Control and Larger Text support • Light and dark appearance, Increase Contrast and Reduce Motion

Movie and series data and images are provided by TMDB. Streaming availability is provided by JustWatch. CineLog uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.

name: CitationKite
description:
Keep a reference desk for books and journal articles. Enter source details, review missing fields, preview a plain-text reference and freeze an ordered bibliography before exporting.

• Record author names in order and add publication details.
• Check required fields and possible local duplicates.
• Preview the defined Author–date and Numbered templates.
• Freeze independent bibliography snapshots with selected sources.
• Generate UTF-8 TXT and BibTeX files and share them through iOS.
• Reopen source records, saved bibliographies and generated files.

CitationKite does not search for or verify references online. A DOI or source URL is stored and exported as text. The templates are drafts, not certified APA, MLA or Chicago styles. Check the original source, your institution's rules and the requirements of your chosen reference tool before using the output.

Source records, bibliography snapshots and generated files are stored locally. System backups and user-chosen shared copies are separate from the app's local library.

name: Clash Of Stars - Space Battles
description:
Clash Of Stars is a real-time strategy game about taking planets.

Every planet you hold builds ships. Drag from one of your planets to any other and a fleet sets off. Land more ships than the planet has defenders and it is yours. Eliminate every opponent to win.
