A match takes two to three minutes. The rules fit in a sentence, and the rest is timing: when to spread out, when to hold back, and when to send everything at one planet.

PLAY
• Quick Match: a rated game against a player near your skill.
• Lobbies: open, friends only or private, for 2 to 4 players. Join a private lobby with its code.
• Singleplayer: 1 to 3 bots on easy, medium or hard, on a small, medium or large map. It works without a connection.

TWO MODES
• Classic: planets and fleets, nothing else.
• Zap: a charged planet sits in the middle of the map. Whoever holds it fires every few seconds and turns a random planet to their colour.

RANK
• Eight ranks from Recruit to Admiral, earned in rated matches.
• Leaderboards for the world, your country and your friends.
• A friends list, with invites into your lobby.

YOUR LOOK
• 16 planets and 16 ships, all open from the start.
• Your homeworld wears your look in the menus and in every match.

GOOD TO KNOW
• No ads and no purchases.
• No account needed: you play as a guest at once. Add an email to keep your rank and your friends on every device.
• Plays upright or on its side, on iPhone and iPad.
• In nine languages: English, German, Spanish, French, Portuguese, Arabic, Chinese, Japanese and Hindi.
• Report or block any player from their name. Delete your account at any time in Options.

name: Clear Call Phone System
description:
Clear Call is the phone system for Clear Recruitment staff. It puts your work number in your pocket, so you can make and take calls, send texts and keep up with WhatsApp wherever you are.

What you can do:
- Make and answer calls on your Clear Recruitment number, with your own extension
- See who in the team is free to talk
- Listen to your voicemail
- Text candidates and clients from your work number
- Chat and call on WhatsApp from your work WhatsApp number
- Search the company phonebook and your call history

Incoming calls ring on your iPhone like any other call, even when the app is closed or the phone is locked.

Clear Call is for invited Clear Recruitment staff only. You need a Clear Call account, set up by your administrator, to sign in. Calls are recorded, and staff let callers know.

name: Clearword: Large Print Search
description:
Large-print word puzzles at your own letter size — word search, Word Wheel and Groups of Four — with no dragging, even with VoiceOver.

Clearword starts with one question: which letters can you read comfortably? Pick the size, and every grid is built around it. It always fits the screen, never scrolls and never cuts a letter.

THREE KINDS OF PUZZLE
• Word search with a hidden message: as you find the words, a saying appears letter by letter.
• Word Wheel: tap the letters on a big wheel to make words that fill a small crossword. Extra words save hints for later.
• Groups of Four: sort sixteen big cards into four groups. "One away!" tells you when you are close, and there is no losing.

A JOURNEY WITH POSTCARDS
Travel through 20 places, from Istanbul to Kyoto, with eight puzzles in each. Finish a place to collect its postcard, with a short note about it. Every puzzle earns up to three stars.

TODAY'S THREE
A word search, a Word Wheel and a Groups puzzle every day, the same for everyone. The gentle streak counts any of them, and a missed day is covered by a rest day.

PLAY WITHOUT DRAGGING
• Tap the first letter, then the last. That's it.
• A tolerance setting forgives a shaky last tap; Undo releases the first letter.
• Prefer to slide? Drag is there too.

PLAY WITH A SCREEN READER
• VoiceOver and TalkBack read every letter as "Row 3, column 5, K".
• Double tap the first and last letter of a word; spoken confirmation when you find it.
• "Read row" and "Read column" actions on every letter.

EASY ON THE EYES
• Paper, sepia, dark and high contrast (yellow on black) themes.
• Found words are marked three ways: a coloured band, an underline pattern and a line through the word in the list. Colour is never the only sign.
• Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, made to keep I, l and 1 apart, or Lexend.
• A magnifier for the letters under your finger.
• Read the word list aloud with your device's voice.

PUZZLES WITH MEANING
• 30 themes in each language — gardens, kitchens, travels, days gone by, seasons and more — written in that language, not translated.
• A short "Did you know?" card after every puzzle.

FAMILY PUZZLES
Make a puzzle from your own words — your grandchildren's names, places you love — add a note and send it as a link. Whoever opens it plays the same puzzle. The words travel inside the link only and are never stored on a server.

PRINT IT (Pro)
Large-print puzzles to print at home, with the answers on a second page. Or print five puzzles of a theme at once, answers at the back.

YOUR PLACE IS KEPT
• Leave a puzzle any time — a phone call, a cup of tea — and continue right where you were.
• Every puzzle includes a hint, and 3 saved hints arrive each day. Extra hints are earned after a puzzle, never in the middle of one.
• The word list grows with your letter size too.

A RESPECTFUL AD PROMISE
Never an ad while you play. Banners only on the home screen and theme list; never in your first three puzzles; Pro and Remove Ads mean no ads at all.

No time pressure: there is no timer unless you turn one on.

PRO
Every puzzle in every theme, unlimited family puzzles and hints, printable PDFs and no ads. Lifetime or yearly.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://devca.app/clearword/privacy/

name: Click: Metronome for Drummers
description:
The metronome for drummers, with a real subdivision mixer.

Open the Mix and build your click: quarter notes, plus eighths, plus triplets, plus sixteenths… Every subdivision turns on with one tap, they can all play at once, and each one has its own sound. Just like a hardware drummer's metronome, but in your pocket.

Click was built by a professional session drummer, for drummers. No ads, no subscription, no account: open it, hit Play, play.

THE SUBDIVISION MIXER
• Downbeat accent, quarter, eighth, triplet, sixteenth, quintuplet, sextuplet, septuplet, octuplet
• Play them alone or stack them: eighths + triplets to work on your time feel, sixteenths + sextuplets for tight placement
• A distinct sound for each one: you instantly hear which subdivision lands where

A CLICK THAT NEVER DRIFTS
Every click is scheduled ahead of time, down to the exact audio sample. The result is rock-solid timing, even at 400 BPM with octuplets, even with the screen locked.

ANY TIME SIGNATURE
1 to 16 beats per bar, with the common ones a tap away: 4/4, 3/4, 2/4, 5/4, 6/8, 7/8, 9/8, 12/8. Accent on the one, and a circular beat indicator that lights red on the one and green on every other beat.

TEMPO AT YOUR FINGERTIPS
• 30 to 400 BPM
• Drag the slider to get there fast
• -1 / +1 buttons, hold to keep going
• Touch the number and turn the wheel to dial in the exact BPM
• Tap tempo: tap along with the song, Click averages your last taps

SEE IT, FEEL IT
• Flashlight flash, on every beat or on the downbeat only
• Haptics, on every beat or on the downbeat only
Set each one separately. Perfect on stage, under headphones, or when the kit drowns everything out.

RELIABLE IN REHEARSAL AND IN THE STUDIO
• Keeps clicking in the background and with the screen locked
• Stops cleanly when a call comes in or when you unplug your headphones
• Your settings are remembered: your click is exactly how you left it

FREE, NO ADS, NO ACCOUNT, NO DATA COLLECTED
Click asks for nothing and sends nothing. Your settings stay on your iPhone.

Available in English and French, on iPhone.

name: Clock Out On Time!
description:
Someone cut in line on your commute. Your messages are left on read. The meeting will not end. And now, five minutes before quitting time, there's a new task on your desk?
Not today. At 18:00, everything in your way goes flying.

Clock Out On Time! is a single-player, landscape action game. Fight from the morning commute all the way to the boss's office with slaps, high heels and one very satisfying resignation letter.

FOUR-HIT COMBOS, ALL IMPACT
- Simple controls: move with your left thumb, attack with your right
- Slap, High Kick, Stomp, Side Kick: the final hit sends enemies flying
- Launched enemies crash into everyone behind them
- Smash office chairs, cardboard boxes and water coolers along the way
- Fill the Rage gauge and unleash an Ultimate that clears the screen

MEET YOUR HEROINE: Rookie Rena
- Rage style: her Rage gauge fills fast and hits hard
- Ultimate "Throw the Resignation Letter!": rain resignation letters down and clear the screen

NEW COWORKERS: Boss Lady Mari AND College Girl Natsu
- Boss Lady Mari: Heavy type with the crushing Ultimate "Redo This Proposal!"
- College Girl Natsu: Rapid-hit type, fast up close, Ultimate "Month-End Closing!"
- Both are playable from the start (Pantsuit for Mari, Long Pajamas for Natsu). Their other outfits unlock as one set per character via in-app purchase

5 CHAPTERS, 21 STAGES OF WORKDAY MISERY
- Chapters: On the Way to Work, Office, After Work, Company Events and Typhoon Day
- Face familiar foes like the Line-Cutting Auntie, Guilt-Tripping Senior, Blame-Shifting Coworker and Meeting Maniac
- Stay on your toes with clock-in points, presentation countdowns and blood pressure monitors
- Take down 9 bosses with signature attacks, including Department Manager, Parachuted Manager, Gaslighting Director and Exploitative Boss
- Keep going in Endless mode and see how high you can climb

A NEW BUILD EVERY RUN
- Pick skills as you level up and fill your Synergy Book with hidden synergies
- Spend your salary on Raises for permanent upgrades

RENA'S 13 OUTFITS, UNLOCKED WITH SALARY
- Pencil Skirt, Pantsuit, Summer Wear, Cheerleader, Christmas, Tennis, Police Officer, Nightclub, Picnic and more: 13 outfits in total
- Start with the Pantsuit and unlock the rest with salary earned in the game. No extra payments for Rena's outfits
- Each outfit has its own stat bonuses, and it grows stronger the longer you wear it

No ads. Just you and the workday.

name: Close Enough: Paint Match
description:
Close Enough finds the paints that come closest to a color you photograph.

Lay a sheet of white printer paper next to the color, take the picture, and tap the paper and the color. The app uses the paper to take the room's light out of the photo, then lines up the closest paints as a deck of dates. Swipe left to pass, swipe right to keep. Keep three, pick one, and it goes in your little black book.

MATCH FROM A PHOTO
• A camera outline sized for a sheet of 8½ × 11 or A4 paper, so every picture is taken the same way
• The white paper corrects for the light in the room
• Optional phone light for dark rooms
• Combine up to three shots of the same color for a steadier reading
• Or skip the photo and type a hex code

MEET THE MATCHES
• Over 100,000 colors across 100 paint lines
• Wall paint, spray paint, paint markers, artist acrylics, sign enamels and color standards
• Match into one brand or across every brand of a type
• A match percentage for every paint, and a plain note on how it differs: lighter, darker, warmer, cooler, more vivid, more muted

TUNE YOUR CAMERA
• Photograph a few paint chips you already own and tell the app which they are
• The app learns how your camera sees color and corrects for it

KEEP WHAT YOU LIKE
• Your chosen matches are saved in the little black book with name, number, brand and percentage

Under ideal conditions (even light, a full sheet of white paper beside the color, and a tuned camera), Close Enough has read colors to within 98% of the true color in our testing. Everyday light varies, and the name says it: this is a close guide, so check a real paint chip before you buy.

Close Enough is an independent app. Brand and product names belong to their owners and are used only to identify the colors.

name: Closeout: Job Report
description:
Closeout turns a day on the job into proof of work. Photograph the site, scan receipts, log the miles, and hand your client a clean one-page PDF job report before you leave.

Built for electricians, plumbers, HVAC techs, handymen, painters and other solo trades and small crews.

WHAT YOU GET
- Job records: client, site address, date, open or closed, hourly or fixed price with materials.
- Evidence photos: take or import photos, add captions, tag them before, after or site. Images are stored on your device.
- Receipt scanning: scan a receipt and Closeout reads the merchant, date and total. Check and edit anything before saving.
- Mileage log: add miles per job with start and end labels. No location access needed.
- One-page PDF job report: job summary, photo sheet, receipts, mileage and totals, with a signature line. Share it or save it to Files.

PRIVATE AND SIMPLE
- No account, no sign-up, no cloud. Your jobs stay on your device and everything works offline.
- Receipt text is read on your device.

FREE AND PRO
Closeout is free to use with unlimited jobs and a limited number of photos per job. Closeout Pro unlocks unlimited photos, your logo and business details on every report, a custom mileage rate and CSV export. Choose a yearly subscription or a one-time lifetime purchase.

Closeout Pro yearly is an auto-renewing subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase and renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings. Any free trial ends when you subscribe.

Closeout creates a job report, a summary of work done. It is not an invoice, tax document or accounting record, and it does not collect payments.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://apps-site-six.vercel.app/apps/closeout/privacy

name: Cloud Whispers
description:
Cloud Whispers is a field guide, journal and sky-reading companion for anyone who looks up and wonders what they're seeing and what it means. Identify clouds with a short key that includes the classic arm's-length hand rule, then build your collection across the full international classification: 10 genera, species, varieties, special features and sky phenomena, each with a rarity from Common to Legendary. Your Atlas fills in as you find them. 

Every sighting becomes a lesson in reading the weather. Log the sky with a photo, cloud cover in oktas, wind direction and conditions, and the clouds will whisper what may come next, using time-tested rules of thumb like a halo around the Sun, towering cumulus at midday or thickening cirrus from the west. Check each forecast when its window ends and see your personal accuracy for every rule. The built-in calculator turns temperature and humidity into the height of a cloud base. Sunrise, sunset and golden hour times are worked out for your city, and reminders can nudge you to look up at the right moment. 

Learn at your own pace with an illustrated course of eight chapters, from how clouds form to reading the sky like a sailor, with quizzes after every lesson. Keep a journal with a calendar, streaks and charts, and trace the whales and dragons you spot in the clouds with your finger. Sky reading rules are heuristics for fun and learning, not an official weather forecast.

name: ClubHub - Gestione Serate
description:
ClubHub è la piattaforma operativa dedicata a discoteche, organizzatori di serate, PR e staff di accoglienza.

Funzionalità principali:
• Gestione Liste Pista e Area Privé: crea, monitora e aggiorna in tempo reale le liste nominative e i tavoli prenotati.
• Dashboard PR e Staff: ogni PR può inserire i propri ospiti, condividere link di prenotazione dedicati e controllare entrate e statistiche della serata.
• Controllo Accessi con QR Code: scanner integrato per validare rapidamente gli ingressi all'entrata e verificare lo stato degli ospiti.
• Mappa Tavoli Interattiva e Bilancio Serata: panoramica immediata dei tavoli assegnati, capienza, omaggi e riepilogo della serata.
• Multi-discoteca e Ruoli Dedicati: accesso differenziato per Admin, Responsabili PR, PR e Sicurezza/Ingresso.

name: Coil Cove: Loop Puzzles
description:
Coil Cove is a slitherlink-style loop puzzle game. Each number tells you how many of its four sides must be part of the loop. Draw lines, mark crossings, and close one single loop around the board — every puzzle has exactly one solution.

What's inside:

- Journey — 24 handcrafted levels, from gentle 5×5 boards to big 10×10 coils
- Daily Coil — a new loop puzzle for everyone, every day, with a fresh tide saying
- Smart hints — get a nudge when you are stuck, and undo any move
- How to Play — a five-step illustrated tutorial for first-time players
- 3 seamless soundtracks and a calm, comfortable look

No account, no ads and no in-app purchases. All puzzles work offline; the daily challenge simply syncs the day's settings when you are online.

name: Collect and Do: Save Links
description:
Save something worth doing. Then make time for it.

Recipes to try, places to visit, things to read: Collect and Do gives your saved links somewhere to go, and a way back into your day.

SAVE WHILE YOU BROWSE
Send a link to Collect and Do from the share sheet, or paste one into the app. Add a note so your future self remembers why it mattered. Saving through the share sheet works without waiting for the network. Works with links from Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Safari and any app with a share button.

A PLACE FOR EVERY IDEA
Keep links in folders and find them with tags and search. Inbox catches anything you haven't filed yet. Your notes take center stage, even when a website doesn't provide a preview.

MAKE A LITTLE TIME
Create a calendar plan for a link, a folder or a tag. Choose a day and set it to repeat if you like. Plans live in a dedicated calendar, with reminders handled by Calendar. Saving and organizing links works without calendar access.

CHOOSE WHAT TO DO NEXT
Open a plan to see the links available for it. Choose one yourself or tap Surprise me. Mark it done, skip this time, or undo a completion. Set a link to be done once, repeated freely or used a chosen number of times.

SHARE SOMETHING GOOD
Invite people to a shared folder. Everyone can add and remove links and see shared completion history, while personal plans and completion rules stay their own. Sharing uses iCloud.

START FREE. UNLOCK ONCE.
Save as many links as you like in Inbox and two folders of your own. Calendar plans, tags, search and Surprise me are included. Folders shared with you never use your allowance, and joining is free.

An optional one-time purchase unlocks unlimited folders of your own and the ability to invite people to your folders. No subscription.

Made for iPhone and iPad. Available in English, French, Italian, German and Spanish.

name: Combo Buster
description:
Combo Buster is a one-tap timing game that's easy to learn and hard to put down.

A comet races around a glowing ring. Tap the moment it meets the star. Every hit speeds it up, flips its direction and tightens the window. One miss ends the run, so every tap counts.

CHAIN PERFECTS INTO COMBOS
Hit the star dead center for a PERFECT. Three perfects in a row raise your multiplier, all the way to x5. Gold stars pay extra points and coins.

MAKE IT YOURS
Unlock 10 comets, 8 trails, 8 themes, 6 hit effects and 5 sound packs, from Lagoon and Synthwave to Aurora and Gold Rush. Preview every look before you pick it.

PLAY EVERY DAY
Claim a daily gift, keep your streak alive to earn the Golden Tail trail, and finish three fresh missions each day for bonus coins. Level up from Spark all the way to Supernova.

CLIMB THE GLOBAL BOARD
See where you rank today and of all time. Board names are picked from a friendly word list, so everyone stays anonymous. Rather play privately? Switch the leaderboard off in Settings and your scores are removed.

MADE FOR QUICK RUNS
• One finger, one tap: play anywhere
• Runs take seconds, so one more try is always within reach
• A soft soundtrack that heats up with your combo
• Haptic feedback on every hit
• Plays offline; the leaderboard catches up when you're back online
• No ads

Everything for sale is cosmetic or coins, so the leaderboard stays fair. Coin packs, the VIP Pass, the Starter Pack and Legend items are optional in-app purchases.

Questions or ideas? Visit the support page or email angeltechcorporationindustries@gmail.com.

name: Comet Calc
description:
Comet Calc is a complete calculation toolkit for iPhone and iPad — 140+ calculators, converters, and tools in one app, all running entirely on your device.

CALCULATORS FOR EVERYTHING
• Finance: mortgage, income tax (2025–2027), loans, college costs, debt payoff, sales tax, fuel cost
• Health & Fitness: BMI, calories, protein, pregnancy, BAC, and more
• Electrical: 19 tools for voltage, current, power, resistance, and more
• Math & Science: algebra, geometry, fractions, binary, statistics — plus 10 scientific calculator models, from a classic two-line to graphing style
• Weather & Kitchen: 19 weather tools and 19 cooking tools
• Everyday: tip, distance, mileage, Roman numerals, BTU, and more

A CONVERTER THAT KEEPS UP
Length, weight, temperature, area, data, volume, and cooking conversions — plus live currency rates from the European Central Bank.

MAKE IT YOURS
43 themes, adjustable display size, optional click sounds and haptics, and 11 languages.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your calculations, history, and notes never leave your device. No account, no ads, no tracking — nothing is uploaded, logged, or shared. The only network request the app ever makes is fetching public currency exchange rates.

One purchase. Every tool. No subscription.

name: Cometloop: Orbit Swing
description:
Tap once. Let go. Catch the next star.

Cometloop is a one-touch arcade game about momentum. Your comet circles a star; tap to release it along its path and fly into the orbit of the next one. Miss, and you drift into the void.

Easy to learn, hard to put down:

• Aim for the centre of a star to score a PERFECT and build your combo • Bank off the walls for bonus points, or skip stars for even more • Watch out for drifting stars, mines and unstable stars that collapse under you • The void rises faster the higher you climb, so don't wait too long • Collect shards and unlock 8 hand-tuned comet trails

Cometloop Premium (one-time purchase): • Double shards on every run • 3 exclusive comets: Aurora, Royal Gold and Eclipse • One continue per run, picking up from your last star

No ads. No accounts. No tracking. Plays completely offline.

name: Contact Intelligence Companion
seller_name: GPT LLM ORAGLE Ltd. Liability Co.
description:
Contact Intelligence is the mobile companion to a Contact Intelligence workspace hosted at contacts.oraglegpt.org. Sign in with the account your workspace administrator invited you with to:

• See your workspace at a glance — contact and company counts, verification outcomes and recent verification jobs.
• Search people by name, title or exact email address and open a contact to see where every value came from: source assertions with their source, confidence and observation time, linked email channels, employment and the full verification history.
• Check a single email address. The server checks syntax, domain mail routing and your workspace’s suppression list and returns each dimension separately with a recommended action. No email is sent. When there is no mailbox-level evidence the app says “Unknown” instead of guessing.
• Work through the identity review queue: approve or reject whether an email address belongs to the contact it is linked to, with a recorded reason. Decisions appear in the workspace audit history and can be undone on the web.
• Manage your account: view your workspace and role, sign out (which revokes the device’s access key), open the privacy policy and support pages, and permanently delete your account from inside the app.

Accounts are created by invitation from a workspace administrator; there is no public sign-up. Imports, provider connections, CRM sync and team management are done in the web app.

name: Convene: Community Chat
seller_name: GPT LLM ORAGLE Ltd. Liability Co.
description:
Convene brings your conversations, communities and the small businesses you work with into one invite-only app.

MESSAGES
• Chat one-to-one or in groups with other Convene members.
• Accept or decline invitations, see unread counts, scroll back through history.
• Start a chat by someone's Convene ID, create a group, or join a room by its address.

COMMUNITIES
• Browse the communities (Matrix Spaces) you belong to and join their rooms.

BOOKINGS
• See your appointments with businesses on Convene, with date, time and status.
• If you run or staff a business, see its upcoming and past appointments.

BUSINESS INBOX
• Business members can read their customer support tickets: subject, status, priority and details, and jump to the customer conversation.

SAFETY AND CONTROL
• Long-press any message to report it or block the sender. Reports are reviewed within 24 hours.
• Block and unblock people from Settings.
• Delete your account from inside the app at any time.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Convene is invite-only: new accounts need an invite code.
• Chats started in this version of the mobile app are not end-to-end encrypted (they are protected in transit with HTTPS). End-to-end encrypted conversations created on the Convene website appear as "Encrypted message" and can be read on the web.
• Booking new appointments, replying to tickets, payments and AI features are not part of this app.
• No ads, no tracking, no in-app purchases.

name: CopperTake
description:
Record voiceovers, narration, auditions, and ideas in a focused native studio for iPhone and iPad. CopperTake keeps the everyday task simple: choose your microphone, press the copper button, and record. Open the tools you need when a take calls for more control.

TRY STUDIO
Start a 14-day trial of recording tools and hosting with one connected monitor. The trial ends automatically and does not renew or charge you later. Continue recording and hosting with a one-time Studio unlock. Add Multi-Monitor to connect up to eight monitors. Companion monitoring stays free, and saved takes always remain available to play and export.

KEEP WORKING ON THE SAME TAKE
Record 24-bit mono WAV audio, stop, and keep the take on screen. Resume at the end to add more, or seek to a point and replace a section after confirmation. Drag the timeline to place the playhead and listen from anywhere. Your takes save automatically.

PREPARE YOUR INPUT
Choose an available built-in, USB, or other microphone exposed by your device. Select a channel when an interface offers several. Check live input levels before recording, compare microphone and file levels, and adjust recording trim, high-pass filtering, and peak limiting. Hardware gain, sources, polar patterns, and sample-rate controls appear when supported by the input. Save custom input presets for the microphone and channel you use.

SEE MORE OF YOUR SOUND
Choose Waveform, Radial Spectrum, Spectrogram, Histogram, or Input Level. View all five in a grid, focus one, or go full screen. Read signed waveform peaks and RMS, clipping, level percentiles, headroom, and the balance between Bass, Warmth, Body, Presence, Clarity, and Air.

MAKE ANOTHER DEVICE PART OF YOUR STUDIO
Pair nearby CopperTake devices on the same local network. An iPhone, iPad, or Mac can host the studio or act as a monitor. Studio includes one connected monitor; the optional Multi-Monitor add-on expands this to eight. Monitors can hear the host's microphone or take playback and follow its visualizations. With the host's permission, adjust its input settings, shared monitor EQ, and presets remotely. Remember paired devices to reconnect automatically when enabled.

SHAPE YOUR MONITOR MIX
Choose Flat, Warm Voice, Clarity, Presence, or Soft Highs, then fine-tune the EQ and save your own presets. Monitor EQ shapes listening and shared playback; the separate Input Setup controls the processing written into the WAV.

READ, ORGANIZE, AND EXPORT
Keep your script in view in Narration mode. Import text or paste it, and adjust the reading size. Rename and favorite takes, reopen them in the recorder, and export the recorded WAV through the system share controls. Customize settings and keyboard shortcuts for a connected hardware keyboard.

After Studio or trial activation, recording and the local library work offline without a CopperTake account. Each device keeps its own library; sharing a monitor stream does not synchronize take files. Remote Studio requires the apps to be open on the same local network with compatible CopperTake versions.

Requires iOS or iPadOS 18 or later. Input capabilities and sample rate depend on the selected hardware and route.

name: Corralia: Software ganadero
description:
Lleva tus fincas desde cualquier dispositivo: control de animales, sanidad, reproducción, finanzas, indicadores y más. Registra en el potrero aunque no haya señal; Corralia sincroniza todo cuando vuelve la conexión.

Torito, tu copiloto
Pregúntale a Torito por tus animales, los próximos partos o los gastos del mes. Te responde con los datos de tu propia finca.

Control de animales
• Inventario por finca, potrero y lote.
• Ficha de cada animal con fotos, genealogía, pesajes e historial completo.
• Lee el DIN con tu bastón lector Bluetooth y encuentra el animal al instante.
• Sube tu inventario desde una foto de cuaderno, notas o desde un Excel que tengas.
• Traslada animales entre tus fincas.

Sanidad
• Vacunas, desparasitaciones y tratamientos, por animal o por lote.
• Trabaja todo el corral de una vez con el registro en tabla.
• Lleva las dosis y el inventario de medicamentos.

Reproducción
• Servicios, inseminación, IATF, palpaciones, diagnósticos de preñez y partos.
• Fechas probables de parto y seguimiento de cada vientre.
• Anota el peso al nacer de cada ternero.

Pesajes y leche
• Pesajes por animal o por lote, comparados con el pesaje anterior.
• Registro de producción de leche.

Finanzas de la finca
• Compras, ventas y gastos.
• Facturas de tus ventas y control del almacén.
• Reportes en PDF y Excel.

Inventario para el ICA
Arma el inventario del RUV por finca, lote, sexo y categoría de edad, listo para descargar.

GenIA
Compra y vende genética: semen, embriones, aspiraciones y preñeces de otras ganaderías, con raza, ubicación y genealogía a la vista. Hablas directo con el vendedor.

Trabaja en equipo
Invita a tu mayordomo, a tus trabajadores y a tu veterinario, y decide qué puede ver y hacer cada uno.

Para veterinarios y zootecnistas
Si eres médico veterinario o zootecnista, en Corralia tienes un espacio especial: un módulo dedicado 100% a los profesionales de la ganadería para gestionar tus trabajos y llevar el control de tus resultados.
• Registra inseminaciones artificiales, trabajos de embriones, procedimientos, tratamientos, cirugías o cualquier otra actividad que realices.
• Lleva el trabajo que haces para una o varias ganaderías.
• Transfiere esos trabajos al usuario de tus clientes sin perder la trazabilidad.

name: Cosplay Convention Center
description:
Find your next comic con, anime convention, or cosplay event with Cosplay Convention Center.

Search upcoming conventions by location, date, or theme. Check event dates, venues, and official websites, then save the conventions you’re interested in to My Conventions so you can find them again when it’s time to make plans.

Explore Merchant Row to discover vendors, artists, and other exhibitors. Browse their profiles and see which conventions they’re attending.

name: Cotton Iron
description:
Cotton Iron keeps each seam and its cotton on this iPhone.

Drag the iron and lift your finger. Cotton holds only in the middle of the seam. Land on the plank and the wood bruises. Stop too shallow and the seam weeps. Drive through and the cotton drops. Pay with pitch only after the cotton holds. Pay earlier and the pitch runs. A seam already paid stays paid.

Name a seam, rename it, delete one, and share the name and the mark.

Seams stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy. This does not caulk a real boat.

name: Countdown ZS
description:
Keep the dates you look forward to close at hand. Countdown ZS shows the time remaining in weeks and days, with a compact Home Screen widget for your next three events.

YOUR DATES, AT A GLANCE
Add a show, vacation, or any other occasion. Include an optional person or client name, choose which events appear in the widget, and keep past dates in the app.

A SMALL WIDGET WITH ROOM FOR THREE
See your nearest included events in date order. Use a short label for a particular event, or turn on Discreet labels to replace identifying widget content with Event 1, Event 2, and Event 3.

OPTIONAL REMINDERS
Choose how many weeks or days ahead reminders begin. Send one reminder, repeat weekly, every two weeks, every ten days, or at a custom interval. Choose a local time. Reminders stop on or before the event date.

The app queues up to 60 upcoming alerts across all events. Reopen it regularly to refill the queue; later alerts are not guaranteed without a revisit. Notification settings and Focus can affect delivery.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, advertising, or analytics. Event data stays in local storage shared by the app and its widget. Names can appear in widgets and notifications; short labels and Discreet labels give you control over what is shown.

Made for iPhone with iOS 17 or later. iOS controls Home Screen widget refresh timing.

name: CountTrellis
description:
Record two physical counts and keep a clear discrepancy report.

Create a local batch with item codes, names and optional expected quantities. Enter the first and second counts separately, review the differences, and freeze the result before exporting.

• Distinguish an unrecorded quantity from a real zero.
• Hide first-count values on the second-entry page.
• Review signed differences, absolute differences and expected variances.
• Freeze immutable report snapshots independent of their source batches.
• Generate CSV and paginated PDF files and share them through iOS.
• Reopen saved batches, reports and generated files.

CountTrellis is a private count notebook, not an inventory backend. It does not enforce separate user identities or tamper-proof auditing and does not scan barcodes. Location labels are typed manually. Quantities are whole numbers from 0 to 1000000000.

Batch records, report snapshots and generated files are stored locally. System backups and user-shared copies are separate from the app's local library.

name: Coupon Hook
description: Coupon Hook keeps a steel coupon on this iPhone for someone new to the trade. At the rack, drag a section onto the plate and write the sizes that belong to that shape, then the grade, the standard, and the yield, tensile, and elongation from the mill tag. Drag the plate up onto the hook. Open the coupon later and read what you wrote. The record stays on this phone.

name: Covenant HR
description:
Our app is your all-in-one solution for managing payroll, HR tasks, and personal information directly from your mobile device. Designed with ease of use in mind, it simplifies your interaction with key company services, giving you the tools to manage your work life with confidence and convenience.

Key Features:

Personal Information Management: Easily update your personal details, such as contact information, emergency contacts, and banking details for payroll. Keep your information up-to-date and secure.

Payroll Access: View current and past pay stubs anytime. Understand your earnings and deductions with transparent, easy-to-read breakdowns.

Time-Off Requests: Submit and track vacation or personal day requests effortlessly. View available days and follow the approval process, all from one place.

Benefits and Deductions: Review and manage your benefits, make changes during open enrollment, and access detailed information on your benefit options.

Enhanced Communication: Stay connected with HR. From receiving company-wide announcements to resolving queries, the app ensures that communication is efficient and transparent.

With a modern, intuitive interface, the app is accessible anytime, anywhere, giving you the flexibility to manage your HR and payroll tasks on the go.

How it Works: Once your company admin sets up your account, you’ll receive an invite to create your personal profile. From there, you can immediately start using the app to manage all your HR-related tasks.

Streamline your work life with this comprehensive mobile HR solution.

Download today!

name: Cozy Cat Home: Kitten Care
description:
In Cozy Cat Home a little kitten is waiting for you. Adopt it, name it, love it and watch it grow up. Your cats live on the same clock as you: even while the game is closed they eat, nap and play, and when you come back they come to greet you.

MEET YOUR KITTEN
• Adopt your kitten, give it any name you like and watch it grow into a cat.
• A short guide shows you the first steps; skip it if you like, or start it again from the settings.

REAL CARE, BY HAND
• Hold the bag to pour the food, tip the jug to fill the water bowl, and scoop the litter clumps one by one. Prefer a single tap? Turn the care gestures off in the settings.
• Pet your cat with your finger and brush its fur until it shines.
• Spoil your cats with treats.
• By day cats nap in the patches of sun; at night they sleep longer.

PLAY LIKE A REAL CAT
• Draw the wand's tassel across the floor: your cat crouches, wiggles and pounces, even at a tassel on the move.
• Flick the felt mouse and watch your cat chase it down.
• Your cats greet each other nose to nose, nap side by side and play together.

THE GAME CORNER
• Three mini games: Mouse Hunt, Food Rain and Cat Talk Memory. Play for stars and gold.

YOUR HOME, YOUR VIEW
• Follow your cat, orbit around it, or walk through the home in Walk view and crouch down to your cat's level.
• Turn your device sideways to watch your cats full screen, and take landscape photos.

HEALTH AND THE VET
• Check your cat's health card, and take it to the vet when it is under the weather.
• Check-ups, vaccines, examination and treatment, and neutering if you choose.
• Short on gold? Once a week the shelter's coupon pays for a treatment.

GET TO KNOW YOUR CAT
• Every cat has its own bond with you: five steps from Stranger to Soulmate.
• As the bond grows, your cat comes when you call, answers your slow blink and brings you its toy.
• The "Cat Talk" notebook: a new page opens the first time your cats show a behavior.

A COZY HOME
• Earn gold as you care for your cats and complete daily tasks.
• Buy toys, beds, cushions, rugs, bowls, an automatic feeder and a water fountain.
• A cardboard box, a fabric tunnel and a heated mat: your cats hide, lie in wait and keep warm in the evening.
• Rare treasures to work toward: a gold felt mouse, gilded bowls, a royal velvet bed and an emerald silk rug, each unlocked by a milestone.
• Edit your home: move and turn the furniture wherever you like.
• Upgrade your home with the Cat Play Room and the Sun Room.
• Japandi, Retro and Farmhouse decor sets for every room.
• Adopt more cats from the cat shop; up to three cats live in your home.

KEEP THE MOMENTS
• Take photos of your cat in photo mode, with frames and filters.
• The album keeps your photos and the memories the game saves for you.

TIME OF DAY
• Day, sunset and night; the music and the sounds of the home change with the hour.
• If you like, we let you know when your cats want something: at most once a day, between 9:00 and 21:00.

GOOD TO KNOW
• No account needed; your progress is stored only on your device. Uninstalling the game may delete it.
• Ads are optional and only play when you choose: watch one for gold, to double a mini game's reward or to play again without waiting. Care and the vet never depend on ads.
• Optional gold packs and a one-time Supporter Pack (a lavender bed and 500 gold) are available as in-app purchases. Restore your purchases on a new device from the Gold page.
• Play in English or Turkish.

Your cats are waiting for you. Welcome to Cozy Cat Home!

name: Cozy Hot Spring: Animal Spa
description:
Deep in the forest, a little hot spring has opened its doors, and the steam is rising.
Roly the raccoon dog and friends are waiting for guests: rabbits, cats, capybaras and more.
Fold towels, stock milk, brew warm tea, and make every guest feel at home.
No rushing timers and no pop-up ads. Play at your own pace.

[Grow your hot spring, slowly and cozily]
• Every guest you serve brings coins, and your hot spring grows little by little.
• Open 13 rooms one by one, from the Open Bath, Snack Shop and Tea House to the Sauna and the Stargazing Attic.
• Towels, milk, tea, baked eggs, rice punch and more: each room has its own favorite.
• Upgrade making speed, seats, stack height and footsteps, and renovate rooms to raise prices.
• Step away for a while, and the coins your staff earned will be waiting for you.

[Hard-working animal staff]
• Raccoon dog, fox, bear, panda and otter: each staff member has a special skill, like strength, speed or kind words.
• Pet them to collect hearts, and dress them up in cute hats.

[Regulars and their stories]
• 16 regular guests visit and share their stories, a little at a time.
• Fill your guest book and help guests with their requests.

[The pond and fishing]
• Go fishing in the yard pond and meet different fish each season.
• Tend the pond: lily pads float, koi and a turtle move in, and all your income grows.

[Four seasons and festivals]
• Enjoy the Blossom Festival in spring, the Melon Festival in summer, the Maple Festival in autumn and the Snowflake Festival in winter, each with its own festival stall.
• At the end of a season, move to the next one and earn starlight. The more starlight you have, the faster your hot spring grows.
• Start in Year 1 Spring and, year by year, raise your grade from Fledgling Spa to Forest Palace Spa.

[Decor]
• Decorate your yard with benches, stone lanterns, cherry trees, wind chimes, snowmen and more.

[With friends (when signed in)]
• Swap friend codes to visit each other's hot springs.
• Send a friend a heart once a day.
• There is no chat and no free-text messaging. Nicknames are picked from preset words.

[And more]
• Daily missions, check-in stamps, a free season pass, and a free gift every 4 hours
• Cloud save with Sign in with Apple or Google, so you can keep playing on a new phone (sign-in is optional)
• Available in 한국어, English, 日本語, Español, 繁體中文 and 简体中文
• The only ads are optional rewarded ads you choose to watch. No pop-up ads.
• Cozy Pass (optional, 7, 30 or 90 days): ad rewards without ads, +4 hours of away earnings, double gifts and +2 bait. It does not renew automatically.

You worked hard today. How about a warm soak?

name: Crema: Coffee Scale Timer
description:
A better app for your Bluetooth coffee scale. Crema works with the Eureka Precisa, Acaia Lunar, Pearl S, Pyxis and Cinco, Felicita Arc, Parallel and Incline, Bookoo Themis, Timemore Black Mirror, Varia AKU, DiFluid Microbalance and more, and turns any of them into a calm shot companion.

Crema is a plain, clear scale until you brew. Put your cup on, tap it on screen and start the machine: Crema zeroes the scale, starts the clock at the first drops and fills a cup on screen as the coffee comes in. A ring around it shows the time: neutral before your window, green inside it, red after. Crema ends the shot two seconds after the last drop and shows the result. Pouring a filter in stages, with pauses? Set the recipe to a manual stop and tap the cup when you are done.

UNDERSTAND EVERY SHOT
- A score out of 100 for time, yield and flow.
- The flow curve of the whole shot: how the coffee came, second by second.
- Advice that separates the grinder from the stop: was the grind right and you stopped late, or should you grind finer?
- Spots channeling from jumps in the flow.

YOUR RECIPES
- Espresso and Filter built in, plus your own recipes for each coffee.
- Dose, ratio, target time, coffee name and grinder setting.
- Automatic or manual stop for each recipe.
- Grams or ounces.

MADE FOR THE BAR
- Large, soft numerals you can read from a step away.
- One tap to brew. Weigh beans in between without starting anything.
- Follow the shot on your Apple Watch while the phone stays in your pocket.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. Your recipes and shots stay on your phone. No ads and no usage tracking.

SUPPORTED SCALES
Eureka Precisa, Acaia (Lunar, Pearl S, Pyxis, Cinco), Decent Scale, Felicita, Bookoo, Timemore Basic 3, Timemore Black Mirror 2, Varia AKU, DiFluid Microbalance, Hiroia Jimmy, Atomax Skale, Espressi, WeighMaster, Futula, Smartchef, Blackcoffee.io and WeighMyBru. Missing yours? Ask for it from the app.

Crema is not affiliated with any scale maker. Requires a supported Bluetooth scale and iOS 17 or later.

name: Crochet & Knitting Counter
description:
Tap +1 when a row is done and always know where you are.
Crochet & Knitting Counter shows "Rows completed" and "Next row" separately, so 12 done always means row 13 is next.
Every tap is saved on the spot. Close the app, lose the battery, come back tomorrow: your row is still there.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Name your project. Add a target from your pattern, or skip it.
2. Tap the big +1 Row button each time you finish a row.
3. Pick up later exactly where you stopped.

MADE FOR REAL PATTERNS
- A huge +1 button you can hit without looking, and a smaller −1 that never goes below zero
- Undo for accidental taps, even after you close the app
- A separate repeat counter, or link repeats to rows: every N rows adds a repeat, and undo takes both back together
- Row milestones like "Row 24: switch to the oat yarn" appear right on the counter when you reach them, and can repeat every few rows
- Project photo from your library, notes and a target with progress
- Optional haptic feedback, and an optional setting to keep the screen awake while you count
- Light and dark mode, Dynamic Type and VoiceOver

FREE
One active project with every counting feature: rows, repeats, undo, milestones, notes, photo and automatic saving. Export a full backup as a JSON file at any time.

PRO
- Count as many projects as you like
- Duplicate a project for the second sleeve or sock
- Archive finished work and share a printable PDF summary

If Pro ends, nothing is deleted. Every project stays readable and exportable, and you can keep counting one project for free.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your projects, notes and photos are stored on your iPhone and are never uploaded by the app.

SUBSCRIPTION
Pro is optional: weekly with a 3-day free trial for eligible new subscribers, or annual, billed in full once a year. Prices are shown in the app before you buy. Subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled in Settings.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://motleystudio.site/crochet-knitting-counter/privacy
Terms: https://motleystudio.site/crochet-knitting-counter/terms

name: Crochet Counter: Rows & Charts
description:
Open the app and start counting. Tap anywhere on the lower half to add a stitch; when the round is complete it moves to the next round, and the current line of your pattern stays highlighted. No more sticky notes or tally marks.

Free to download. Basic counting and access to existing projects remain available. Try Pro for 30 days from your first launch of the paid version, then unlock it with a one-time purchase. No subscription or automatic charge. Pro includes unlimited projects and counters, linked counting, row reminders, size highlighting, ring and grid tracking, and widgets.

YOUR PATTERNS, IMPORTED IN SECONDS
• Pick several screenshots at once and read them as one continuous page
• Open PDFs straight from Files or Mail
• Paste a written pattern and it is split into rows automatically
• Following a video? Save the link and bookmark the time for each round

KEEPS YOUR PLACE AUTOMATICALLY
• Lines are detected on device and the highlight follows your row count
• Stitch counts like "Rnd 23 (24 sts)" are read for you, so the round advances at 24
• Ring highlight for circular charts, row and column rulers for grid charts
• Highlight only your size in multi-size patterns
• Zoom in and come back to exactly the same spot

COMPLEX PATTERNS, CALM MIND
• Multiple linked counters: rows, stitches, pattern repeats
• Reminders on the rows where you decrease or change color
• Separate parts for front, back and both sleeves

MADE FOR ONE HAND
• Huge tap area, one-step undo, lock against pocket taps
• Screen stays on while you count
• Lock Screen and Dynamic Island show your row; tap +1 from the widget

YOUR PROJECT BOOK
• Run several projects at once with photos, yarn, hook and size notes
• Finish with a beautiful project card to share
• Send your setup as a code so a friend can start the same project in one paste
• Stitch symbol reference with US, UK and Japanese names

PRIVATE
• No account, no ads, no tracking. Pattern recognition runs on your iPhone and your files never leave it

Available in English, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese.

name: Croze Drive
description:
Croze Drive keeps each cask and its hoop on this iPhone.

Drag the hoop down the staves and lift your finger. It seats only on the croze, and only when every stave is flush. Stop short and the hoop springs back. Drive past the croze and it drops. A proud stave cocks the hoop and it springs back.

Plane the proud stave, then drive the hoop onto the croze again. Name a cask, rename it, delete one, and share the name, the mark, and how many staves still stand proud.

Casks stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy. This does not raise a real barrel.

name: Cruche ou Crush
description:
Cruche ou Crush is the party game where friends build a sentence one word at a time, and a roulette picks who has to act it out for real.

HOW IT WORKS
Create a game, share the 4-character code and invite your friends. Everyone adds one word in turn, live on every phone. The Maitre Crusheur (the toad) ends the sentence when it is ready, then the roulette picks who takes on the challenge.

DIRTY TRICKS INCLUDED
• Crush: erase another player's last word if it breaks the sentence.
• Cruche: the chosen player swaps one word in the sentence and still has to do the dare.
• Veto: throw out a sentence before the roulette spins.
• Sabotage call: accuse a word and let everyone vote.

NO FRIENDS AROUND?
Add up to four AI friends: Margaux, Kevin, Jojo and Ines. They write, crush, vote and defend themselves like real players.

• 2 players or more, online
• No account needed: just a first name
• Optional profile photo
• Free, no ads

The game is in French. Words are filtered, the host can remove a player, and a link lets you report abuse.

name: Crumb Time
description:
Welcome to Seabright Bay, a little seaside town whose old lighthouse has been dark for twenty-two years. You've just moved into the keeper's cottage. Spend your days listening, helping and giving, and watch the town and the light come back to life.

【Six chapters, six adventures】
Each chapter is its own story somewhere new in town: guide a lost boat through the fog, chase a runaway kite over the dunes, track down a recipe-stealing gull, read a message in a bottle and ride out a storm night. Search scenes for clues, make choices and play story mini-games along the way.

【Listen closely】
When someone mentions a thing they love, the words light up. Tap them to save them in your notebook: Grandpa Otto's peppermint tea, Mira's kite string, Bea's wildflower honey.

【Lend a hand】
Every day, neighbors ask for help with short, relaxing mini-games: untangle Otto's net, patch Mira's kite, weave Bea's pie top and carry Leo's sandcastle up the beach.

【Choose the perfect gift】
The Seaside Market restocks every morning. Use what you heard to pick the right present: a gift someone loves brings three hearts at once, and deeper friendships unlock evening heart stories for your Memories album.

【Relight the lighthouse】
Spend your coins to repair the lighthouse piece by piece, from rusty door hinges to the great lens, and uncover the old keeper's promise.

No timers, no pressure: rest whenever you like, and a new day brings new requests by the sea.

name: CTeen VSM
description:
CTeen Villiers-sur-Marne, c'est la communauté des 12-18 ans : soirées, sorties, voyages, bénévolat et projets menés par les ados eux-mêmes.

Avec l'appli :
• Le programme — découvre toutes les activités et les voyages de l'année, avec la date, le lieu, le prix et le nombre de places.
• Ton calendrier — ajoute une activité au Calendrier de ton iPhone en un toucher.
• Les rappels — demande à être prévenu la veille d'une activité.
• L'inscription — inscris-toi à une activité en quelques secondes.
• Tes XP — gagne des points à chaque participation, monte de niveau et débloque des badges.
• Ta carte de membre — garde ta carte avec ton QR code dans l'appli et dans Apple Wallet.

Tes informations servent uniquement à organiser les activités CTeen : elles ne sont jamais vendues ni utilisées pour de la publicité. Tu peux supprimer ton compte à tout moment depuis l'appli.

name: Cue Care Companion
description:
Cue Care keeps you close to the people you care for.

Your mother, father or another loved one carries a personal alarm button. With Cue Care on your phone you see how they are doing, and you get a message the moment they need you.

At a glance
- Is the alarm button connected?
- How full is the battery, and is it on the charger?
- Where was it last seen, with the address and a map.

When someone needs you
- You receive a message or a request for help on your phone.
- Answer with one tap, so the rest of the family sees who is going.
- Ask for the current place of the alarm button when you want to be sure.

Made to be calm
- One clear screen per person, in plain words.
- Light and dark mode.
- Available in several languages.

Your privacy
Cue Care only receives. It never shares where you are, and it asks for one permission: notifications. The person who carries the alarm button knows that family members can see its status and its last known place.

Cue Care works with a personal alarm button and a subscription from your care or alarm provider. You sign in with the account you received from them.

name: CuePath: Rehearse Your Talk
description:
Find your pace without losing your voice.

CuePath is a private rehearsal desk for presentations, talks, and everyday speaking practice. Build a deck of cue cards, give each segment a target duration, and rehearse with a clear, prominent clock.

A CLOCK THAT FOLLOWS THE SESSION
Pause, resume, move back, or move forward. Each card keeps its accumulated actual time. Present mode brings larger cues and simple controls to the front. Leaving the app pauses the clock. Interrupted sessions are clearly marked rather than filling gaps with invented timing.

MAKE THE NEXT PASS COUNT
A completed session shows actual versus target time for every segment, with clear timing deltas and unvisited-card labels. Retake overrun segments and revise the current cues while keeping previous session snapshots intact.

YOUR DECKS, YOUR DEVICE
Import and export CuePath deck JSON or its plain-text exchange format. Create a run-of-show PDF with segment budgets and cues. Try a genuine sample deck through the explicit demo action.

No microphone permission, recording, speech recognition, AI delivery scoring, account, analytics, ads, subscription, or cloud service. Decks and timings stay in local app storage. You choose what to export.

name: Cuida24
description:
Cuida24 brings your family's lab results, blood pressure and medical reports together in one place, and shows how your values change over time, always against the laboratory's own reference ranges.

LAB RESULTS
• Import the lab's PDF: Cuida24 reads the values, units and reference ranges.
• Paper report? Scan it with the camera or pick a photo.
• Review every value before saving; tap a row to see it highlighted in the original document.
• More than 120 tests recognised: blood count, glucose, cholesterol, kidney and liver function, electrolytes, thyroid, vitamins, urine and more.
• Charts with each lab's reference band, out-of-range values highlighted, and the trend over the years.
• You can also enter values by hand.

BLOOD PRESSURE
• Read systolic and diastolic pressure from your monitor's display with the camera, or enter them by hand. Always check the values before saving.
• 7- and 30-day averages, morning and evening, and charts with the ESC 2024 limits for home measurement.
• Guided 7-day measurement, as doctors often ask for before an appointment, with a summary to share.
• Morning and evening reminders.
• Optional Apple Health integration.

MEDICAL DOCUMENTS
• Keep imaging, cardiology, surgery, consultation and other reports.
• Search the text of all your documents.

FOR YOUR APPOINTMENT
• PDF report with blood pressure averages, lab values and charts.
• CSV export for Excel or Numbers.

THE WHOLE FAMILY
• One profile per person, each with their own results, readings and documents.
• Cuida24 suggests the right profile from the name and date of birth on the report.

PRIVACY
• Your data stays on your device only. No server, no account, no ads.
• Lock with Face ID or Touch ID.
• Encrypted backups protected by your own password.

Important: Cuida24 is not a medical device and does not diagnose. It shows the values and ranges given by your laboratories; always consult your doctor. Cuida24 is an independent app, not affiliated with the Portuguese National Health Service (SNS) or the SNS 24 portal.

name: Cyrus One Remote Controller
description:
Your Cyrus remote is back.

Control your Cyrus ONE amplifier from your iPhone or iPad. Adjust the volume, switch inputs and mute your music from one simple interface.

Open the app, choose your amplifier and take control.

• Adjust volume with a slider or step buttons
• Switch between your amplifier’s inputs
• Mute and unmute with a tap
• Set a volume limit
• Adjust the amplifier’s panel LED brightness
• View connected device information
• Check room sound levels with the built-in dB meter  

Requires a compatible Cyrus ONE amplifier for remote control.

name: dadokan
description:
Dadokan is Afghanistan's online marketplace. Find products from stores and people in every province, order in a few taps, and pay the seller in cash when your order arrives. Anybody can sell, too.

BUY
• Browse by category and by province, from Kabul to Badakhshan
• Search in Dari, Pashto or English, and narrow the results by price, brand and rating
• See the photos, the price in Afghani, whether it is in stock, and what other buyers said
• Ask the seller a question in the app before you order
• Order from several sellers at once, and pay each of them in cash on delivery
• Follow the stores you like and watch their stories

SELL
• Sell as yourself or as a business. Selling is free, and Dadokan takes no share of your sales
• Add products with photos, prices and stock from your phone
• Open your own store, with a logo, a cover photo, an address and a pin on the map
• Get a notification for every new order, and handle it in the app
• Answer buyers in Messages

SAFE
• Dadokan's team checks every store, product, story and review before it appears
• Report anything that looks wrong, and block anybody you do not want to hear from
• Your account is yours: close it in the app whenever you like

MADE FOR AFGHANISTAN
• In Dari, Pashto and English
• Solar Hijri dates and prices in Afghani
• Sign in with email, Google or Apple
• Light and dark themes

Questions? Write to dadokan.app@gmail.com or visit dadokan.app.

name: Daishplus
description: DaishplusYou can break down any interest payment you receive into a daily format. Once you’ve recorded the income, expense, or transfer, you can view the daily balance, applicable interest rate, and calculated interest amount for any given date. If an interest rate changes, you can simply duplicate the existing rule, update the effective date, and compare the results between segmented interest calculation and applying a single rate to the entire period. When interest for multiple periods arrives at once, record it as a single income entry while allocating the specific portions to their respective periods; any minor discrepancies—a few cents, for instance—can be carried over to your next reconciliation. If the bank later refunds a service fee, you can log the refund against the original charge to see the actual net cost you incurred. Monthly and quarterly reports aggregate data based on the date of receipt, and you can also compare the net returns of two different accounts over the same time frame.

name: DATAWIND
description:
DATAWIND muestra el viento, el oleaje y el estado de los puertos del sur de Chile sobre un mapa que se recorre hora a hora.

QUÉ TRAE

• Viento y rachas pintados sobre el mapa, animados, hasta tres días por delante.
• Oleaje: altura, período y dirección.
• Temperatura, lluvia, presión, nubosidad y visibilidad.
• Mareas y coeficientes del SHOA, en hora de Chile.
• Estado de los puertos de la Directemar: abierto, cerrado o con restricción, y el registro de cada cambio.
• Aviso al teléfono cuando se esperan más de 30 nudos en los próximos tres días.
• Widget en la pantalla de inicio con el viento y la marea del lugar elegido.

DE DÓNDE SALEN LOS NÚMEROS

El viento, el oleaje y las demás variables salen del modelo GFS de la NOAA, que OANSDATA descarga y lee directamente: no se piden a un tercero. Las mareas y los coeficientes son los oficiales del SHOA. El estado de los puertos lo publica la Directemar en SITPORT.

Cuando un dato no se puede medir, DATAWIND lo dice. No enseña un cero en lugar de un hueco.

PARA QUIÉN ES

Para quien trabaja en el agua y necesita saber, antes de salir, qué viento va a haber y si el puerto está abierto: acuicultura, pesca, transporte marítimo, buceo y faenas en centros de cultivo.

ACCESO

DATAWIND es un módulo de INTEGRITY, la plataforma de OANSDATA. Se entra con las credenciales que entrega la empresa; no hay registro abierto al público.

name: DaubMagic Journey
description:
DaubMagic Journey puts you in a bingo experience built around three distinct play styles. In Classic Horizon 75, you race adaptive AI opponents to complete a target pattern on your board, timing your daubs to build score combos while rivals compete for the same called numbers. Aurora Rush strips the game to a 90-second sprint where fast reflexes and chain combos drive the score. Puzzle Patterns offers 30 handcrafted levels, each requiring you to fill a specific shape on the board within a limited number of calls, scored on a three-star system.

A daily challenge generates a fresh board each day. Winning consecutive daily challenges builds a streak that multiplies rewards. A once-per-day prize wheel lets you spin for gems and experience points.

Player progression tracks level, experience, and a collection of 20 achievements that span all three modes — from chaining a 10-daub combo to clearing every puzzle level. A customizable profile lets you pick an avatar, set a lucky number that triggers bonus effects during play, and switch between visual themes. Sound effects are synthesized at launch rather than loaded from pre-recorded files, keeping the download lightweight.

name: DCOM: Off-Grid Communication
description:
DCOM keeps a group in touch where there is no mobile network: in the mountains, in a forest, at sea, at a large event or during an outage.

DCOM NEEDS A RADIO DEVICE
The phone connects over Bluetooth to a small LoRa radio that runs the free DCOM firmware. Two devices are supported today: SenseCAP T1000-E and Heltec MeshPocket. The firmware, an online flasher and step-by-step guides are at https://dcom.ibcsc.be
No device yet? Open the app and choose "Look around without a device" to walk through every screen with a sample group.

HOW IT WORKS
• Your group is a "pack" of up to 64 people. One person creates it, the others join by scanning a QR code.
• Messages travel by radio from device to device. Every device in the pack can pass a message on, so the pack is its own mesh network. A repeater on a height extends the range, but it is not required.
• No internet, no mobile network, no servers, no accounts, no phone numbers.

WHAT YOU CAN SEND
• Text, with a delivery meter that shows how many members confirmed the message.
• Voice notes of up to 8 seconds, push-to-talk.
• Photos reduced to about 1.4 kilobytes, enough to show a place or a landmark.
• Field stickers of 4 bytes each: stop, coming to you, need help, rally point and more.
• Your position on the pack map, with offline maps of whole countries.
• SOS with your position, repeated until someone confirms it.
• Morse code, by radio or by the device buzzer.
• Direct messages to one member.

PRIVACY
• Messages are encrypted on your phone with ChaCha20-Poly1305. Direct messages use an X25519 key agreement between the two members.
• The app collects no data. No analytics, no advertising.

RADIO
The firmware transmits in the European 868 MHz band and keeps to its duty-cycle limit. Use it only where this band is allowed.

IMPORTANT
DCOM is not an emergency service and does not replace one. An SOS reaches only the members of your pack who are in radio range.

name: DecisionWeave
description: DecisionWeave gives personal and team choices a structured comparison. Create a decision, define at least two weighted criteria and two alternatives, then score each alternative from 0 to 10. View weighted rankings and temporarily exclude a criterion to inspect sensitivity. Missing scores count as zero and remain visible in the completion count. Keep notes, search decisions, archive completed comparisons and share results. The app organizes your inputs; your judgment makes the final choice.\n\nCore features work offline. Free, with no account, ads or in-app purchases. Choose from eight languages and System, Light or Dark appearance. Records stay in this app’s local storage. Optional example content is fictional.

name: Delight Hub
description:
Delight Hub is the team app for Delight Restaurant Group. It puts the things our restaurant teams look up every week in one place, on the phone in your pocket.

You need the company access code to use it. Your General Manager or Area Coach has it.

WHAT'S INSIDE

Quick Answers
Plain answers to the questions managers hear every day: when payday is, how to get a pay stub, how time off works, who to call for benefits, what to do when the safe or a card reader acts up.

Delight Info
The employee handbook, store directory, payday calendar, period calendars, HR forms and benefits guides. Open any file in the built-in viewer, then share or print it.

Training
Role training, job aids and guides, organized by role from Team Member to General Manager.

Tools for managers
Truck Calc: enter weekly sales and see what to spend on each truck order.
Supreme Calc: tap your star ratings and see your final score.
Speed Calc: the drive-thru pace you need the rest of the period to hit your goal.
Interviews: General Managers and Area Coaches set interview days and times for their restaurants.

Search
One search box across every file, page and answer.

BUILT FOR THE FLOOR
Fast on a phone, easy to read, and it tells you when you are offline.

Delight Hub is for employees of Delight Restaurant Group.

name: Desiderium
description:
Look up and know what you're seeing. Desiderium teaches you the night sky a few minutes a day, and brings each constellation back just before you'd forget it.

NAME IT, THEN FIND IT
Each day the sky turns to a few constellations and asks you to name them. Think of your answer, see it, and say how well you knew it. A proven spaced-repetition scheduler (FSRS) decides when each one returns. When naming gets easy, switch to Find it: you're given a name and search the sky for it yourself.

THE WHOLE SKY, IN THE RIGHT ORDER
• All 88 constellations, starting with the bright, famous ones you can see from where you live.
• 22 asterisms: the Big Dipper, Orion's Belt, the Summer Triangle, the Teapot, the Pleiades, the False Cross and more.
• The 70 brightest named stars, from Sirius and Vega to Betelgeuse and Canopus.

THE REAL SKY, RIGHT NOW
Match my sky shows the stars as they are from your place at this moment: the horizon, twilight, the planets, the Sun and the Moon. Hold up your iPhone and the sky moves with it, while a gentle arrow guides you to each card's target. Scrub through the hours to see what will rise tonight, and set how dark your sky is, from city lights to a dark site, to see only the stars you can really see.

MADE FOR THE DARK
A calm, dark design that protects your night vision, and a red night mode that turns on by itself after dusk, so you can study under the stars.

PROGRESS WITHOUT PRESSURE
A mastery map lights up the sky as you learn it, and the Library lists every constellation, asterism and star with what you know about each. No streaks, no badges, no guilt. An optional daily reminder, if you want one.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Desiderium works fully offline, and your location and study history never leave your device.

Star positions from the Hipparcos Catalogue (ESA); star names from the IAU Working Group on Star Names. Full credits in the app.

name: Detailing Dilution Calculator
description:
Pick a 500 mL bottle, type 1 : 9, and see it at once: 50 mL concentrate + 450 mL water.
Detailing Dilution Calculator turns the ratio on your product's label into two clear amounts for any spray bottle, foam cannon or bucket.
No setup, no account. Your first mix takes seconds.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Choose a container: 500 mL, 750 mL, 1 L, 16 or 32 US fl oz, 1 US gal, your own saved sizes, or any custom size.
2. Enter the ratio from the label, for example 1 : 9.
3. Read the concentrate and water amounts, shown in big numbers next to a bottle diagram.

RATIOS WITHOUT GUESSWORK
- Every ratio says what it means: "Concentrate : Water" (1 : 9 = 1 part concentrate plus 9 parts water) or "Concentrate : Total" (1 : 10 = 1 part concentrate in 10 parts of finished solution). The app never reinterprets your numbers.
- The bottle diagram shows concentrate and water as separate, labelled layers, with a stripe pattern so it doesn't rely on color.
- The two amounts always add back up to the container size you chose.
- Undiluted mixes are clearly labelled, and impossible ratios are explained instead of producing a wrong answer.

UNITS YOU ACTUALLY USE
- Milliliters, liters and US fluid ounces, always labelled "US fl oz" so they can't be mistaken for weight.
- Each amount also shows its equivalent in the other unit, handy when the bottle is in ounces and your measuring cup is in mL.

SAVE YOUR EVERYDAY PRODUCTS
- Save up to three products for free with their ratio, what you paid and the package size, and pick them on the calculator in one tap.
- See what the concentrate in each bottle costs, worked out from the price you entered.

PRO
- Unlimited products and saved containers
- Mix history: save a mix and make it again in one tap
- Cost comparisons: rank your products by cost per container
- Printable mix sheets: a PDF chart of every product and container size for the wall
If Pro ends, nothing is deleted. Saved mixes stay readable and included in your backup.

YOUR DATA STAYS WITH YOU
No account, no ads, no tracking. Products, containers and mixes are stored on your iPhone. Export a JSON backup any time, for free, and delete everything from Settings.

The app does the arithmetic for the ratio you enter. It doesn't recommend ratios or check whether products can be mixed. Always follow the product label and safety data sheet, and never mix different chemicals.

SUBSCRIPTION
Pro is optional: weekly with a 3-day free trial for eligible new subscribers, or annual, billed in full once a year. Prices are shown in the app before you buy. Subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled in Settings.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://motleystudio.site/detailing-dilution-calculator/privacy
Terms: https://motleystudio.site/detailing-dilution-calculator/terms

name: Dimoe
description:
Dimoe helps crafting enthusiasts and DIY hobbyists organize handmade gift projects, step checklists, and creative progress. Users can create project records, track tasks, and keep notes without relying on scattered notes or heavy task management tools.

The app provides a dedicated space for crafting projects across categories like gifts, decorations, cards, albums, and jewelry. Users can add up to two photos to a project record, build step-by-step task checklists, and mark tasks as done.

Project data stays on the device. Dimoe has no paywalls, subscriptions, or in-app purchases. Detailed statistics and local Markdown or CSV exports are free to use. The app asks for tracking permission when it launches, and the Privacy Policy and Terms of Use open in the browser.

name: DiskPlan: Free iPhone Storage
description:
DiskPlan finds what fills your iPhone and proposes a cleanup plan. A scan only reads: nothing is removed until you tick it and confirm.

PHOTOS AND VIDEOS • Duplicates: identical copies are ticked for you and the best one is kept. The same picture saved again from a chat or an export is shown for you to decide. • Similar shots: photos taken within a minute that look alike, with the one worth keeping marked. • Bursts: every frame except the shot Photos shows and the ones you picked. • Screenshots and screen recordings, with a way to tick those older than a month, six months or a year. • Large videos, heaviest first. Compress makes a 1080p copy with the same date, place and favourite mark, and lets you drop the original.

FILES Choose a folder in Files (On My iPhone, Downloads, iCloud Drive, a USB drive) to see its heaviest files and the ones present twice, byte for byte.

MAIL Connect a mailbox with an app password (iCloud, Gmail, Yahoo and most providers) to list its heaviest messages and move the ones you choose to its Trash. Mail on your iPhone then drops its copies.

CONTACTS Merge the same person saved several times into one card.

YOUR APPS DiskPlan recognises the heavy apps you have (WhatsApp, Telegram, Instagram, TikTok, Spotify, Netflix and more) and shows where each one clears its own storage. iOS does not let any app empty another app’s data, so DiskPlan takes you to the right screen instead of pretending.

A CLEAR PLAN Every ticked item is counted once, with a warning if every copy of a picture is ticked. Deleted photos go to Recently Deleted for 30 days, and messages to your mailbox’s Trash, so you can change your mind.

FREE TO TRY Scanning and the results are free, and so is deleting your first 25 photos and videos. One purchase, with no subscription, unlocks unlimited cleanup, video compression, Files and Mail, for your whole family.

PRIVATE No account, no analytics, no advertising. Your photos, files and contacts are examined on your iPhone and never uploaded. The only network connection is to the mail server you choose to connect.

name: Divvan Event
description:
Book Divvan hospitality for your event in two minutes, no waiting for replies.

• Pick guest count, date and time
• Browse packages with photos and videos
• Choose sweets, savouries, juices, mojito and your cappuccino message
• Enter the event address and send your order
• Get the deposit link on WhatsApp and your invoice in the app
• Track your orders under "My orders"

Divvan Event is a registered hospitality and event-styling company in Kuwait.

name: DMV Metro Tracker: Train & Bus
description:
DMV Metro Tracker is a free, real-time DC Metro and bus tracker for Washington DC, Maryland and Virginia. Watch every Metro train move on the map, see live arrivals at every station and stop, and plan your trip door to door, with no account, no ads and no tracking.

LIVE TRAINS ON THE MAP
Every Red, Orange, Silver, Blue, Yellow and Green Line train, moving along the real track, with next-train boards at every station showing the track and how many cars, color-coded by line. Crowding, delays and service alerts are shown right where you need them.

BUSES, MARC AND VRE
Live Metrobus arrivals at every stop, plus ART, Ride On, DASH, Fairfax Connector and TheBus. MARC and VRE commuter trains with delays.

DOOR-TO-DOOR TRIP PLANNER
Type any address or place and compare walking, Metro and buses side by side, fastest first, with live departures you can actually catch, fares, and street-by-street walking directions. Tap Start to walk it with Apple Maps.

NEARBY
Your closest Metro stations, bus stops, Capital Bikeshare docks, scooters and e-bikes, sorted by distance, each with live arrivals on the card.

EXPLORE THE CITY
Tap any restaurant, café, shop or landmark on the map for a photo, Call and Website buttons, Apple Maps hours, photos and reviews, and how to get there by transit. Station sheets list hand-picked local favorites within a short walk.

ALERTS, ELEVATORS AND ESCALATORS
Live service disruptions by line, plus elevator and escalator outages at every station. Get notified when your train is close, when an alert hits your line, or when an elevator you rely on goes out.

WIDGETS, LIVE ACTIVITIES AND APPLE WATCH
Home Screen widgets show your station's next trains. Follow a train on the Lock Screen with Live Activities, and check arrivals from your wrist with the Apple Watch app and complication.

PRIVATE AND FREE
No sign-up, no ads, no analytics or tracking. Your location is only used to show what's near you and is never stored. Favorites stay on your iPhone.

Available in English and Spanish.

DMV Metro Tracker is an independent app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by WMATA, MARC, VRE or Capital Bikeshare. Transit data comes from their public feeds.

name: Document Scanner – PDFNuvio
description:
PDFNuvio is a document scanner for iPhone and iPad that turns paper into clean, searchable PDFs. Point the camera at a page: it finds the edges, takes the picture itself and flattens it. Keep going for as many pages as you need, then keep them as one PDF you can search, share and copy text from.

SCAN PAGES THE EASY WAY
• Apple's document camera finds the edges of the page, takes the shot once the camera is steady and straightens the page.
• Scan several pages in one go: letters, contracts, receipts, forms, notes, homework and manuals.
• Already have a picture of a page? Import it from Photos or Files.

MAKE EVERY PAGE READABLE
• Choose a filter for each page: Original, Enhanced Colour, Greyscale or Black & White.
• Crop and rotate, and fine-tune light and color with sliders.

SEARCHABLE PDFS
• The text on every page is recognized on your device (OCR), so your PDFs are searchable and you can copy text out of them.
• Find a document by the words in it.
• Make your PDFs A4 or US Letter.

SHARE, SAVE, COPY
• Share a PDF to any app, save it to Files, or copy the recognized text.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Everything happens on your iPhone or iPad. Nothing is uploaded, there's no account or sign-up, and PDFNuvio collects no data and doesn't track you.

PRICING
Your first 2 scans are free. After that, choose a subscription or a one-time Lifetime purchase for unlimited scans. There's no free trial.
