The subscription is charged to your Apple Account and renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in Settings › Apple Account › Subscriptions. Lifetime is a single purchase and never renews.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://vaultnuvio.com/pdfnuvio/privacy/
Support: support@vaultnuvio.com

name: Done Day: Daily Shutdown Log
description:
Have a lot on your plate and feel like you’ve been running in circles all day without knowing what you actually got done or what slipped through the cracks? Try this app to see the complete picture of your day: what you finished, what got left behind, and why it happened.

Instead of endless, stressful to-do lists, you get a clear system of control. Map out every task hour-by-hour for the week or month ahead, break big goals down across multiple days, and capture more than just a title define what needs to be done, why it matters, and the exact steps to get there.

When plans change and something doesn't get done, there is no need to feel guilty. Reschedule the task to another day in a single tap, pick the real reason from quick presets whether it was a lack of time, fatigue, or an unexpected disruption or simply drop it if it no longer makes sense. Every action automatically turns into clear visual charts that honestly reflect your real progress, your peak productive hours, and the exact patterns behind your delays.

name: DosePing - Medication Reminder
description:
For older adults who take medicine every day — and the family who looks out for them.

When medicine is part of every day, it is easy to lose track: Did I take this dose? Where did I write down my blood pressure? DosePing keeps it all in one calm, simple place, with large text and big buttons.

Key features
- Today's board: everything due today on one screen — tap "Taken" and you are done
- Medication reminders: multiple medicines, multiple times a day, via system notifications
- Blood pressure & glucose log: enter your readings by hand and see simple charts plus a 30-day overview (average, highest, lowest, count)
- Home medicine cabinet: note expiry dates of medicines at home; items expiring soon or already expired are clearly marked
- History & summary: create a 7-day summary in one tap and share it with family
- Text size: Standard or Extra Large — readable without reading glasses

Deliberately simple
No accounts to create, no complicated menus. Add a medicine, tap "Taken", log a reading — that is all.

Offline & private
Works fully offline. No ads. Everything is stored only on your device; we collect no data at all.

This app is a reminder and recording tool. It does not provide medical advice and does not replace guidance from your doctor. Always follow your doctor's instructions.

name: Dr. Farcas ASP Exam Flashcards
description:
Prepare for the Associate Safety Professional (ASP) certification exam with Dr. Farcas ASP Exam Flashcards.

Study 1,140 flashcards organized into 21 categories covering essential occupational safety, health, and environmental concepts.

KEY FEATURES

• 1,140 study flashcards with questions and answers

• 21 subject categories for focused exam preparation

• Random flashcard study mode

• Track your progress using the Got It feature

• Flag challenging cards for additional review

• Review flagged cards whenever you need extra practice

TOPICS INCLUDE

Biosafety, Biostatistics, Community Exposure, Electricity, Epidemiology, Ergonomics, Hazardous Materials Management, Personal Protective Equipment, Radiation, Safety Management, Sampling, Sound, Thermal Stressors, Toxicology, and more.

Designed for safety professionals preparing for the ASP exam, this app provides a convenient way to reinforce important concepts and study wherever you go.

Developed by Dr. Farcas and Doina Elena Anton.

Independent educational exam preparation resource. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the Board of Certified Safety Professionals (BCSP).

name: DragLab: Cycling Aero & CdA
description:
At race pace, most of your effort goes into pushing air out of the way. DragLab shows you how much, in watts, and what a better position would save: on the hoods or the drops of a road bike, or on the aero bars of a time-trial or triathlon bike.

SCAN YOUR POSITION
Get on your bike on a turbo trainer and hold your race position. A helper walks round you with an iPhone Pro for two to three minutes, and DragLab builds a 3D model of you and your bike using the LiDAR camera.

SEE WHAT THE AIR COSTS YOU
DragLab measures how much of you faces the wind and turns it into air drag in watts at the speed you choose, with a likely range, and shows where your position sits among other riders. Anything propping the bike up is found and taken out, and the wheels are tidied automatically.

WHAT TO CHANGE
DragLab looks at your own outline and suggests the changes worth trying, such as lowering your front end or bringing your elbows in, each with the watts it could save.

COMPARE POSITIONS
Scan a second position, such as lower on the aero bars, and see the watts and minutes it saves over 40 km, 90 km or 180 km.

MAKE IT YOURS
Measure your real drag figure from an outdoor ride file with power, and DragLab uses it for all your positions. Choose your bike for an exact size, and set the temperature and altitude of your race.

WATCH THE AIR
An animated illustration shows air streaming past your 3D model.

BIKE FIT CHECK
For triathletes and time triallists, three side photos give a basic fit check: saddle height, hip and back angles, and the one change to try first. Fluorescent stickers make it more precise.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Everything stays on your iPhone. No account, nothing uploaded, nothing tracked.

Good to know:
- Scanning needs an iPhone with a LiDAR camera: iPhone 12 Pro, 12 Pro Max or any later Pro or Pro Max. You also need a helper, a turbo trainer and room to walk round the bike. On other iPhones (iOS 18 or later) you can explore the three sample scans, measure your CdA from a ride file and check your bike fit.
- Drag figures from a scan are estimates; differences between your own positions are more reliable than any single number. Measuring from a ride makes them your own.
- The bike fit check is a guide, not a professional fit. If anything hurts, see a bike fitter or physio.

name: Drakomoria
description:
Drakomória je tichá hra o hľadaní cesty cez päť krajov, ktoré nepoznáš.

Karty tu neležia v riadkoch. Každá dvojica je roztrúsená po krajine tak, ako by niekto rozložil veci na zem a odišiel. Úlohou je nájsť ich, otvoriť a spoznať, ktoré dve patria k sebe.

PREČO JE INÁ

Ziadna mriežka. Každé rozloženie sa generuje ako roztrúsená scéna, takže sa naviguje terén, nie pevne daná doska.

Päť ručne kreslených krajov, každý s vlastnou paletou, rámami kariet a svetlom: Údolie, Močiar, Kováčia, Jaskyňa a Vrchol.

Dvanásť kreslených relikvií, každá s vlastným menom a poznámkou, ktoré sa ukladajú do Katalógu.

Príbeh sa odvíja medzi kapitolami bez prestávok a bez dialógových okien.

Každá kapitola prináša vlastné pravidlá, takže rovnaký základ nikdy nehráš rovnako.

AKO SA HRÁ

Ťukni na kartu a otočí sa. Keď sa nájdu dve rovnaké relikvie, ostanú odhalené a získajú hviezdu. Dvojice, ktoré sa nezhodujú, sa zakryjú späť.

Tridsať úrovní je rozdelených do piatich kapitol a každá kapitola pridáva nové pravidlo:

Prvé stopy: zisti terén a zvykni si naň.
Od druhej úrovne: limit počtu ťahov.
Od tretej úrovne: limit času.
Od štvrtej úrovne: hmla zakrýva časť mapy.
Od piatej úrovne: parno stmavne celú scénu.
Posledná úroveň kapitoly: tváre kariet sú skryté, rozhoduje tvar a odtieň.

ODOMKNUTIE A POSTUP

Každá úroveň prináša 1 až 3 hviezdy podľa toho, ako rýchlo a ako úsporne sa zvládne. Nová kapitola sa otvorí až vtedy, keď je splnených všetkých šesť úrovní predchádzajúcej kapitoly. Mapa sa teda otvára postupne, kapitola po kapitole, a každý nový kraj odhalí ďalší kus príbehu.

POMOCNÉ NÁSTROJE

Hľadať stopu: zvýrazní oblasť, kde leží jedna z hľadaných kariet.
Pauza: zastaví hodiny aj počítadlo ťahov.
Štatistiky: celkové hviezdy, dokončené úrovne a osobné rekordy v čase a počte ťahov.
Nastavenia: zvuk, vibrácie a vymazanie postupu.

Postup sa ukladá priamo na zariadení a hra beží úplne offline na iPhone aj

name: Driftberth--Magnetic Bay Drift
description:
Driftberth muuttaa kadonneen kuutamaisen rahtitilan rauhalliseksi liukupalapeliksi.

Jokainen laatikko ja malmikuorma odottaa magneettisessa kiinnikkeessään. Valitse suunta, tarkastele kimpoamisreittiä kulmikkaiden ohjaussiipien ja rungon seinämien kautta ja käynnistä sitten yksi siirto. Vain yksi lasti liikkuu kerrallaan, joten myös siirtojen järjestyksellä on merkitystä ratkaisussa.

24 pelitasoa syventävät saman pelialueen haasteita muuttamatta sen kokoa. Suunnittele siirrot ennakkoon, käytä energiaa harkiten ja ohjaa jokainen lasti oikeaan telakointipaikkaan avataksesi rahtiväylän uudelleen.

name: DripLine: Garden Irrigation
description:
DripLine: Garden Irrigation is your offline-first interactive drip system planner, water pressure drop calculator, and emitter flow estimator. Designed for backyard gardeners, greenhouse growers, homesteaders, and landscape installers, DripLine turns hydraulic irrigation math into a clear, stress-free routine.

Interactively lay out mainlines, lateral drip tapes, and individual emitters on a visual 2D garden canvas, simulate water pressure loss along pipe runs, and verify balanced watering zones without needing an active internet connection.


Key Features and Irrigation Utility Tools

Interactive SpriteKit Irrigation Canvas
- Touch-to-Route Drip Lines: Draw 16mm/20mm lateral tubes and mainline headers across raised beds and greenhouse rows.
- Real-Time Pressure Drop Visualizer: Watch color-coded flow gradients highlight pressure starvation at the end of long drip runs.

Flow Rate & Pressure Loss Engine
- Emitter & Tape Flow Scaler: Calculate total liters/gallons per hour (LPH / GPH) for 2 L/h, 4 L/h emitters, or pre-spaced drip tape.
- Pump & Tap Capacity Matcher: Verify whether your water source flow rate can run all zones simultaneously or requires valve splitting.

Irrigation Vault & Zone Log
- Saved Garden Watering Maps: Store multi-zone irrigation schematics and parts lists for backyard plots offline.
- 100% Offline Field Access: Design and troubleshoot drip layouts directly in fields, greenhouses, or remote plots with zero cellular signal.


Designed for:
- Gardeners preventing uneven watering and dry ends on long drip tape lines.
- Greenhouse growers sizing pumps, pressure regulators, and zone valves offline.
- DIY installers estimating exact tubing lengths, tees, and emitter counts before buying parts.

name: Drum Set and Marching Drums
description:
There's a drum kit in your living room.

THE KIT
Sit down and pick up the sticks. Snare, toms, hi-hat, ride and crash, all within reach.
Hit soft and it's soft. Hit hard and it's loud.
Catch the rim for a rimshot. Tap the ride's bell.
The kick and the hi-hat pedal each have a pad you hit with a stick.
Pick your sound: big and deep, bright studio, or vintage.

SONGS
Pick a song on the music stand. The drum to hit next lights up, and the song waits for you.
Tap Listen to hear how it goes first.
The Can-Can. The William Tell Overture. The Stars and Stripes Forever.

MARCHING
Strap on a snare drum or a set of quad toms.
Stand up and march around the room. The drums come with you.

name: Du Nuoc - Water Reminder
description:
Đủ Nước helps you drink enough water every day the simple way: one tap to log.

• Quick log: 100, 150, 250, 500 ml buttons (customizable), or enter a custom amount and backfill when you forget.
• Smart reminders based on your wake and sleep times; it skips a reminder when you've just had a drink or already reached your goal.
• A cute water-drop mascot changes its mood with how much you drink.
• Weekly and monthly stats, daily streaks, and badges to keep you motivated.
• Goal suggestion based on your weight.
• Light/dark theme, a friendly rounded font, and a background that shifts gently through the day.
• Vietnamese & English.
• Fully private: all data stays on your device — no account, no ads, no data collection.

Note: hydration suggestions are general guidance only and not medical advice.

name: DunaMaroc – Immobilier Maroc
description:
DunaMaroc est le portail immobilier du Maroc : appartements, maisons, villas, riads et terrains, à vendre ou à louer.

Pour chercher un bien
• Filtres par ville, type de bien, prix et nombre de chambres
• Carte des annonces
• Photos, vidéos et plans de chaque bien
• Favoris, même sans compte

Pour publier une annonce
• 0 % de commission

Disponible en français, arabe, espagnol, anglais et roumain.

Une question ? contact@dunamaroc.com

name: DupliZap: Photo Cleaner AI
description:
DupliZap finds the photos and videos that waste space on your phone and helps you clear them fast, without uploading anything.

FIND DUPLICATES AND SIMILAR SHOTS
- Exact copies and near-same photos are grouped together.
- The best shot of every group is picked for you, using sharpness and face quality.
- Long-press any photo to keep it forever, so it never shows up as a duplicate again.

SMART CLEAN
- One review for the safe stuff: exact copies and old screenshots.
- Turn each category on or off before you delete.

SWIPE TO SORT
- Go month by month, swipe left to archive and right to keep.
- Undo any swipe. Archived photos wait until you delete them.
- On This Day memories and a daily swipe streak.

BIG FILES AND COMPRESSION
- See your largest photos and videos first.
- Compress videos and photos to smaller copies, keep or delete the original.
- Turn Live Photos into still photos to save space.

PLACES AND TRIPS
- Photos grouped by the places and trips where you took them, with real place names.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- Every scan runs on your device. Nothing is uploaded, ever.
- Deleted items go to Recently Deleted first, so nothing is lost by accident.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://duplizap.ecreateinfotech.info/privacy

name: EarLog - Headphone Time
description:
EarLog keeps track of every minute you wear headphones.

It reads Headphone Audio Levels from the Health app and works out how long you listened each day and with each pair — no manual logging, nothing running in the background.

• Today dial: a 24-hour ring shows exactly when you had headphones on
• Knows every pair of AirPods: detects the exact AirPods, AirPods Pro and AirPods Max model, and keeps same-named pairs from different generations apart
• Details for every pair: total time, last 7 days, daily average, average volume, first and last worn, session count
• Trends: week, month, year and all time, telling you how much more or less you listened than the period before
• Volume: average volume for the week, month or year, with an 80 dB guide line
• Personal records: total time, longest day, longest session, day streak, best month
• Home Screen widgets: today’s total and this week at a glance

Privacy first
No servers, no accounts, no ads, no tracking. Everything is read and calculated on your device.

EarLog Plus
Free: today dial, details for your most-worn pair and weekly trends. EarLog Plus unlocks details for every pair and your all-headphones total, month/year/all-time trends, volume analysis, personal records and widgets.
• Monthly and Yearly are auto-renewable subscriptions with a 3-day free trial for new members; Lifetime is a one-time purchase.
• Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Cancel during the trial and you won’t be charged. Manage or cancel in Settings › Apple Account › Subscriptions.

Terms of Use: https://earlog.huangweihao8713.workers.dev/terms
Privacy Policy: https://earlog.huangweihao8713.workers.dev/privacy

Note: AirPods and Beats are recorded by Health automatically. For other Bluetooth headphones, set the device type to “Headphone” in Settings › Bluetooth. Time only counts while audio is playing.

name: Echo Ink: Voice & AI Journal
description:
The best ideas and everyday errands often vanish in the seconds spent choosing a folder or formatting a list.

Echo Ink is a calm, tactile journal built around effortless capture. Speak a quick voice note, type a few lines, or snap a photo of a receipt or whiteboard—even when a single sentence mixes how your day felt, a 10:00 AM task for tomorrow, a Wi-Fi password, and a sudden product idea. Your original entry is saved in milliseconds while everything is quietly sorted in the background into Tasks, Notes, Mood, and Sparks.

SPEAK ONCE, EVERYTHING FINDS ITS PLACE
• Instant Raw Preservation: Save voice, text, and photos immediately with zero waiting screens. Every original voice clip, line of text, and photo remains untouched in your Originals timeline.
• Dynamic Relative Dates & Timed Alerts: A task recorded yesterday for "tomorrow morning at 9" automatically becomes "Today · 09:00" when morning arrives, complete with optional advance notifications and gentle evening mood check-ins.
• Smart Category Summaries: Review crisp, cached overviews across your Tasks, Notes, Mood reflections, and Sparks without wasted reloads.

ECHO: YOUR CITED SECOND BRAIN
• Grounded Memory Search: Ask natural questions like "What's my home router password?" or "What did I plan for this weekend?" Echo prioritizes your saved entries first, complete with tap-to-view source citations and one-tap copy for key facts.
• Clear Boundaries: Facts drawn from your own notes are visually distinct from optional general suggestions—never blurred or fabricated. Save any helpful exchange back into a new note with one tap.
• A Living Personal Portrait: As your notes accumulate, Echo Ink quietly refreshes a personal portrait of your current focuses, emotional rhythm, and knowledge themes.

TURN PASSING MOMENTS INTO A DAILY EDITION
• Editorial Daily Digest: Weave scattered daily fragments into a calm, readable daily edition you can revisit through your calendar archive.
• Six Writing Voices: Choose between Editorial, Crisp & Brief, Warm Letter, Deep Reflection, Native Voice, or tailor your own Custom Voice and length tier.

SIX TACTILE DESIGN THEMES & APPLE ECOSYSTEM
• Six Visual Themes & Six App Icons: Zen Ink, Warm Washi, Morning Glass, Midnight Gold (Dark), Nordic Sage, and Braun Studio.
• Everywhere You Reach: Home Screen, Lock Screen, and Control Center widgets, Action Button & Shortcuts support, plus a companion Apple Watch app for wrist dictation and task check-offs.

LOCAL-FIRST & PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account required, no ads, and zero analytics tracking. Your notes live locally on your device.
• Works offline with Apple's on-device intelligence frameworks, with optional Bring-Your-Own-Key (Keychain-encrypted) support for frontier cloud models including Google Gemini, Qwen, DeepSeek, and OpenAI-compatible APIs.

name: EcomGini Seller
description:
EcomGini Seller is the companion app for shops built on EcomGini, the all-in-one commerce platform for Bangladeshi businesses. Sign in with the same email and password you use in your web admin and run your shop from your phone.

ORDERS
• See new orders the moment they arrive, with an instant notification
• Open any order to see the items, the customer's details and confirm it
• Take a new order yourself when a customer calls or messages you

CUSTOMER CHATS
• Reply to Facebook Messenger, Instagram and other connected channels from one inbox
• Send product photos right from your phone
• Get notified when a customer is waiting for a reply

PRODUCTS AND STOCK
• Check stock for every product, size and colour
• Scan barcodes with the camera to find a product quickly

SHOWROOM POS
• Sell in your physical shop: scan or search items, add a discount and complete the sale
• Stock updates automatically for both your website and your showroom

AT A GLANCE
• Today's sales, new orders, orders to ship and unanswered chats on the home screen
• Quick links to reports, accounts, customers, coupons, website settings and the full web admin

SECURE
• Optional Face ID or Touch ID lock
• Your shop data stays in your EcomGini account; the app shows no ads and does not track you

The app works in English and Bangla.

You need an EcomGini shop to use this app. Open one at ecomgini.com.

name: eDitari
description:
eDitari është ditari i klasës në telefon, për të gjithë shkollën: drejtorinë, profesorët, prindërit dhe nxënësit.

PËR PROFESORËT
• Orët e sotme në një listë. Ora që po zhvillohet tani shihet menjëherë.
• Çdo orë në dy hapa: shkruaj temën, shëno kush mungon, ruaje.
• Nota, vërejtje dhe detyra shtëpie me një prekje.
• Ditari personal për notat e përditshme, dhe nota përfundimtare e gjysmëvjetorit në ditarin e klasës.

PËR KUJDESTARËT
• Klasa ime: mungesat, arsyetimet dhe ecuria e çdo nxënësi.
• Pasqyrat e fundvitit gati: suksesi sipas lëndëve, mungesat sipas muajve, orët e planifikuara dhe të zhvilluara, lëvizja e nxënësve.
• Printim i ditarit, çdo pjesë në faqe të re.

PËR DREJTORINË
• Lëndët, përdoruesit, klasat dhe orari në një vend.
• Kërkesat për ndryshim notash miratohen ose refuzohen nga drejtoria.
• Çdo veprim i rëndësishëm shkruhet në regjistër.

PËR PRINDËRIT DHE NXËNËSIT
• Notat përfundimtare, mungesat dhe detyrat, kur të duash.
• Njoftim në telefon kur nxënësi mungon, kur vjen me vonesë, ose kur ka notë apo detyrë të re.
• Disa fëmijë në të njëjtën llogari prindi.

Hyrje e shpejtë me Face ID. Pamje e çelët dhe e errët.

Llogaritë i hap shkolla. Nëse shkolla juaj nuk e përdor ende eDitarin, kontaktoni drejtorinë.

name: EH Trieste
description:
EH Trieste is the app for guests of Elisabeth Hospitality: boutique rooms, suites and hotels in the centre of Trieste, Italy.

With an account you find your bookings straight away, including those made on Booking, Airbnb and Expedia, and have your whole stay in one place.

ONLINE CHECK-IN IN A FEW MINUTES
• Take a photo of your ID (front and back) or upload a PDF: we read the data, you check and confirm it.
• Travelling in a group? Send each guest their own link: they fill in their own details, even without the app.
• Towns and countries are picked from a list: no typos.
• Receipt or invoice: choose what you need, with the billing details you already gave when booking.

CODES AND ARRIVAL
• Front door code and room PIN, where needed.
• Address, directions and arrival time.
• Wi-Fi, breakfast, parking and useful information about the property.

YOUR ACCOUNT
• Sign in with Apple, Google or with email and password.
• Bookings made with your email or phone show up automatically.
• The app is available in English, Italian, German, French, Spanish, Slovenian, Croatian, Hungarian, Czech and Polish.

PRIVACY
ID photos are encrypted and deleted after check-in. You can delete your account at any time from your profile.

Our properties: Elisabeth Boutique Rooms, Maria Cristina Boutique Rooms, Regina Boutique Suites, Sophia Boutique Suites, Victoria Boutique Suites and Hotel Palazzo Triestino.

name: El Home de la Risa
description: El Home de la Risa is the home of Cuban comedy: every show from the Marrero Bernal Media network in one app. Browse La Risa es Cosa Seria, Welcome to Apagonia, Bacallao Sin Pan and more, by show or by comedian (30+ comedians, every appearance). See today's premiere first, turn on premiere notifications, book free tickets to live tapings, and search any comedian, show or topic. Videos play inside the app. Free, no account needed. Shows are in Spanish.

name: El Niñja: Outrun the Heat
description:
It's 2026 and the heat is on. Run down a hot Nigerian street, dodge the danfos, grab cold sachets of water and duck into the shade before the sun catches you.

El Niñja is a free endless runner with a daily temperature-guessing game on the side. Quick to learn, hard to put down.

THE RUN
• Swipe left and right to change lane, up to jump, down to slide
• Dodge danfos, road-works barriers and low canopies
• Keep your water up: grab sachets before the meter hits zero
• Keep your body heat down: run through shade to cool off
• Every 30 seconds it gets 1°C hotter, and everything speeds up
• Each run ends with one real-life heat-safety tip

HEAT GUESS
• Guess tomorrow's high temperature for your city once a day
• Land within half a degree for a Perfect and a Cold Zobo power-up
• Build a streak and see how your city's players are doing

MAKE IT YOURS
• Make your own runner: hair, headwear, tops, shoes, shades and more
• Unlock skins such as Agbada Uncle, Mama Put and Okada Rider with the coins you earn
• Daily missions, a 7-day reward calendar and a Heat Tips book to collect

PLAYS ANYWHERE
• Free to play, no sign-up needed
• Your progress is saved on your phone, and the run works offline

Watch an optional ad to revive a run or double your daily reward. Optional purchases (coin packs, a starter pack, remove ads) are available in the shop.

Heat tips are general information, not medical advice.

Made in Nigeria. Questions or ideas? developertobi@gmail.com

name: ElCondo
description:
ElCondo es la aplicación para los condóminos de un condominio administrado con
ElCondoApp. Si su administración usa el sistema, acá tiene en el teléfono lo
que antes había que preguntar por WhatsApp.

CUÁNTO DEBE, SIN PREGUNTAR
Su saldo al abrir, el detalle de la cuota del mes (mantenimiento, agua,
seguridad, lo que su condominio cobre) y el historial de los pagos que la
administración le registró. Con el número de SINPE Móvil a un toque para
pagar desde el mismo teléfono.

UN PASE CON QR PARA SU VISITA
Genere un pase y mándeselo por WhatsApp. Su visita lo muestra en la caseta, el
guarda lo escanea y entra. Es de un solo uso y usted decide por cuánto tiempo
vale: cuatro horas, un día, una semana. Si se arrepiente, lo anula.

QUIÉN PUEDE ENTRAR SIEMPRE
Las personas y los vehículos que entran a su filial a diario (la familia, la
persona que ayuda en la casa, el carro de siempre) quedan autorizados con su
cédula o su placa, y la caseta ya no tiene que llamarlo.

QUIÉN ENTRÓ Y CUÁNDO
La bitácora de los ingresos a su filial, con la hora y quién los autorizó.

RESERVAR LAS ÁREAS COMUNES
El rancho, la piscina, el salón comunal: vea el costo, los días disponibles y
las franjas que ya están tomadas, y pida la reserva. Si su condominio exige
aprobación, le avisamos cuando la administración responda.

LO QUE DICE LA ADMINISTRACIÓN
Los comunicados del condominio y una conversación directa con la
administración, sin perder el hilo entre mensajes de WhatsApp.

Y ADEMÁS
El reglamento, las actas y los estados financieros que la administración
comparta; quiénes integran la junta directiva; y las personas vinculadas a su
filial, que el propietario puede administrar él mismo.

VARIOS CONDOMINIOS, UNA CUENTA
Si tiene filial en más de un condominio, cambia entre ellos desde el
encabezado, sin cerrar sesión.

IMPORTANTE
La cuenta la crea la administración de su condominio y le llega por correo.
Esta aplicación no crea cuentas y no es un servicio que se contrate por aparte:
es la parte del condómino de un sistema que su administración ya usa.

name: Elfish
description:
Every December your elf needs a new idea every night. Elfish plans the whole season for you, so mornings are magic and evenings stay calm.

SWIPE THROUGH 130+ IDEAS
Keep the ideas you love, skip the rest, and mark the ones you already did last year. Elfish shows how many mornings are still missing and fills your calendar automatically, with the big set-ups on weekends.

A PLAN FOR EVERY MORNING
See the whole season at a glance: arrival day, every morning in between, and the goodbye. Tap a day to swap the idea, add a note, or tick it off once it's set up. Big or small, bendy or classic elves, one elf or a whole team, with or without a Grinch: ideas fit your household.

A SECRET MISSION FROM SANTA
Elfish opens on a "Mission from Santa" screen the kids can look at: sleeps until Christmas, your elves watching, a kind mission for the day and a nice list that only goes up. Your plan stays hidden behind a parent code.

WRITE THE MISSIONS YOURSELF
Every mission is filled in for you. Change any day in a tap: "Help set the table", "Draw a picture for the elves", whatever fits your family.

SAVE IDEAS FROM ANYWHERE
Found a great idea on Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, Pinterest or YouTube? Paste the link: Elfish keeps the pictures and writes up the idea for you. Or snap a photo of your own set-up.

PLAN TOGETHER
Sign in with Apple or Google and your plan syncs between both parents' phones and the web.

No ads. No tracking. Your plan is yours, and you can delete your account in the app at any time.

name: EMF Recorder: Magnetic Field
description:
Use the iPhone magnetometer to view local magnetic flux density in microteslas (µT). Follow the live graph and X, Y and Z readings, record a session, and add notes as markers. Reopen saved sessions to inspect the trace and gaps.

Premium adds a local baseline and threshold alerts, Before / After comparisons, Case Files with photos or short voice notes, and CSV/JSON exports for finalized magnetic sessions. Sound Recorder and Motion & Vibration are separate instruments.

Readings depend on your device and surroundings. The baseline is a comparison reference. The app cannot identify a source, assess exposure safety, or detect paranormal activity. Keep the app open while recording.

Terms of Use: https://itspeep.com/emfrecorder-terms

name: Entrena: tu rutina de gym
description:
Entrena es tu entrenador de bolsillo para el gym.

Dile tu meta, tu experiencia y cuántos días puedes ir, y te arma la rutina de cada día: qué aparato usar, cuántas series y repeticiones, y cuánto descansar. O arma la tuya.

RUTINA DE HOY
• Cuerpo completo si vas 2 o 3 días; dividida por zonas si vas 4 o 5.
• Sube de forma gradual: semanas de adaptación, más volumen y luego más peso.
• Mira qué músculos trabajas hoy en un mapa del cuerpo.

MIS RUTINAS
• Crea tus propias rutinas o copia una del plan y ajústala.
• Elige series, repeticiones y descanso de cada ejercicio.
• Une ejercicios en superseries para ahorrar tiempo.

ENTRENAMIENTO EN VIVO
• Marca cada serie y ajusta peso y repeticiones.
• Te dice cuándo subir el peso, hacer más repeticiones o bajar la carga, y por qué.
• Temporizador de descanso con sonido y vibración, aunque tengas música.
• Calculadora de discos para la barra y la prensa.
• Celebración cuando rompes un récord.

SIN DESBLOQUEAR EL TELÉFONO
• En la pantalla bloqueada ves el ejercicio con sus fotos, tu serie, el peso y el descanso.
• Marca "Serie hecha" o "Saltar descanso" desde ahí.

APPLE WATCH
• La serie que toca, el descanso y tu pulso en la muñeca.
• Marca tus series desde el reloj.

TU PROGRESO
• Fuerza por ejercicio (1RM estimado) con tus récords.
• Músculos trabajados en la semana contra el rango recomendado.
• Calendario y mapa de calor de tus entrenamientos.
• Peso corporal, cintura y presión arterial opcional.
• Comparte el resumen de tu semana.

RACHA Y LOGROS
• Mantén tu racha semanal, sube de nivel y desbloquea logros.

FICHAS DE EJERCICIO
• Fotos reales del inicio y el final del movimiento.
• Pasos en español, consejos y errores comunes.
• Guarda el número del aparato en tu gym.

MÚSICA
• Abre tu app de música desde el entrenamiento. Con Apple Music, ve y controla la canción que suena.

APP SALUD
• Llena tu perfil con tus datos de Salud.
• Tus entrenamientos y tu peso se guardan en Salud.

PRIVADO
• Todo se guarda solo en tu teléfono. Sin cuentas, anuncios ni rastreo.
• Bloquea la app con Face ID o Touch ID.
• Exporta tus datos a una hoja de cálculo o guarda un respaldo.

Entrena da sugerencias generales. No es consejo médico ni sustituye a un médico, nutriólogo o entrenador certificado.

name: Epeni
description:
Turn a finished fold into a memory you can revisit. Epeni gives origami enthusiasts a personal journal for keeping paper creations, reflections, and ideas together.

Add a name, choose from seven origami categories, rate your work, and attach up to two photos with notes. Browse your collection in a photo grid, search by name, filter by type, and zoom in on the details. Edit or remove entries as your collection changes.

Keep a wishlist of folds to try and mark completed ideas. View totals, average ratings, and distributions by type and rating. Export your record text through the system share sheet.

Start without an account. Your journal is kept on your device.

name: Erster Satz
description:
Picture yourself about to call the doctor's office, phone in hand, with no idea how to begin. This is a card you fill in beforehand and keep in front of you during the conversation.

You write down what the call is about and the first two sentences you want to say. Add your questions, details such as an account number, and a plan for when things stall. During the call you read the card in large type while a highlighted line moves along, on its own at your pace if you like.

If something comes to mind halfway through, you open a note without leaving the card. Afterward you write one line about how it really went, with no points, streaks or charts. It sits on the card next to what you had feared beforehand.

Templates give you ready-made wording, for example for the doctor's office, a return call, canceling, a government office, a complaint or the landlord. You fill in the bracketed gaps yourself. Free of charge you get three cards, four templates, reading aloud, notes and the afterword. A one-time unlock called The Full Folder adds as many cards as you like, all templates and printing as PDF.

Erster Satz does not judge anything and does not replace medical, therapeutic or legal advice. It is a card to read from, on iPhone and iPad. The first sentence is often the hardest, and with the card in your hand it is already in front of you.

name: EslatMe
seller_name: ASAXIY UZ, MAS ULIYATI CHEKLANGAN JAMIYATI
description:
EslatMe is an assistant that helps you never forget your appliances' service, warranty periods and the important dates in your life.

My devices
When you buy an air conditioner, water filter, refrigerator or other appliance, the store registers it in EslatMe. You see all your devices, their warranty periods and next service dates in one place.
• A regular notification 5 days before the service
• 1 day before — a call-style reminder with a voice message in Uzbek or Russian
• Contact the seller and view the service history with one tap
• You confirm the service done by the technician yourself

My reminders
Add any reminder for yourself: oil change, vehicle inspection, OSAGO car insurance, tires, document expiry dates, payments, health, birthdays and celebrations. The "Service done" button calculates the next date automatically.

Remind a friend
Enter a phone number — your friend receives the reminder through the Telegram bot.

Coins
Earn coins for adding reminders and inviting friends.

For companies
Service company staff add customers and devices, see upcoming services, call a customer with one tap and record completed services.

Sign in through the Telegram bot — no password or SMS needed.

name: Esperanto Prononco
description:
Learn the Esperanto pronunciation rules, one sound at a time.

Esperanto is spelled the way it sounds, and its stress always falls in the same place. Learn those few rules and you can read any word aloud. Esperanto Prononco gets you there with short lessons, a hear-and-repeat turn, and real speakers saying the words.

Eleven lessons, one sound or rule each
Clean vowels, word stress, c, ĉ, ĝ, ŝ and ĵ, j, ŭ, the tapped r, h and ĥ, and consonant clusters. 91 common beginner words and 47 short sentences, every one recorded by a person.

Hear it, say it, compare
One tap plays the example and opens the mic. Say it back, and when you go quiet the app plays the example and your own voice back to back, so you can hear the difference yourself. Then choose Again, hear both once more, or move on. Slow mode plays the example at 0.7× speed, and nearly every word has a second voice, so you are not copying just one speaker. Skip to any word at any time. A checkmark shows the ones you have said out loud.

Hear it in a real video
81 of the 91 words open a short video on the exact line where a speaker says the word, with the word marked. You hear the sound the way people actually say it, not only in a lesson.

Your own text
Paste a script, a speech or a song, and every word shows its syllables, the stressed syllable, its IPA and a respelling in your phone's language (English, German, Spanish, French or Dutch). Words with a recording can be heard and practiced right there. The app can also read the whole text to you. Where nobody has recorded a word, a computer voice fills in. It is marked as a computer voice and can get sounds wrong.

This is a pronunciation trainer for your first steps. It does not teach grammar or vocabulary, and it does not grade your voice: you compare by ear.

Free, with no subscription and nothing to unlock. No account. Your recordings stay on your phone.

Want more after the lessons? Every video ends with a link to Reelang, where you can keep listening to real Esperanto at your level.

Thank you to the volunteers who recorded the voices: the Lingua Libre speakers on Wikimedia Commons for the words, and the Tatoeba contributors for the sentences. Their names are in the app under About.

name: Estava Home ستافا هوم
description:
Estava Home is the official app for residents and owners of properties managed by real-estate companies on the Estava platform. It brings everything about your unit and your communication with property management into one place.

Key features:
• Dues & statement: track upcoming instalments and due dates, view your account statement, and upload transfer receipts.
• Maintenance: submit maintenance requests and follow their status and visit schedule until completion.
• Requests & complaints: send requests and complaints to management and follow their responses.
• My contract & documents: view your contract and unit documents.
• Family & visits: manage the residents of your unit and issue visitor permits.
• My car & access card: parking, vehicle and access-card details.
• Announcements & notifications: receive management announcements and alerts on dues and requests as they happen.
• Owner account: follow your owned properties and leased units.

How to use:
The app requires an account with a real-estate company subscribed to Estava. Get your company link from property management, then sign in with a verification code or your password.

Privacy:
Your data is kept by your property company, is never used for advertising, and you can delete your account from Settings at any time.

name: Etymon: Word Roots
description:
"Notte", "night" and "nocturnal" are one word, 6,000 years old. "Padre" and "paternalistic" meet in Latin "pater". Etymon shows you the family tree hidden in the words around you.

SEE THE WORDS AROUND YOU
Point the camera at a menu, a sign or a book page, or take a photo, and Etymon reads the words and draws their network right over them: which ones share a root, which ones mean the same thing in another language. In AR, the network floats in the room.

TALK, AND WATCH THE WORDS CONNECT
Turn on Talk and have a conversation. Every word said grows its tree of ancestors, in the colour of whoever said it. Etymon works out who is speaking and which language each of you uses, and connects your words where they meet: Italian and English, German and Polish, in the same conversation.

TYPE ANYTHING
Type or paste words and read the story of how they're related, follow a word's journey across the map from where it was born, or explore the whole tree in 3D.

PLAY WITH WORDS
• Root Chain: each word must share an ancestor with the one before. Play against the app or with up to six friends.
• Impostor: three words share a root, one only looks like them. Find it.
• Cousin Hunt and Scavenger: name, or find around you, words descended from an ancient root.
• Birthplace: where was this word born?

20 LANGUAGES
English, Italian, Spanish, French, German, Russian, Ukrainian, Belarusian, Bulgarian, Macedonian, Serbo-Croatian, Polish, Czech, Slovak, Slovene, Romanian, Hungarian, Estonian, Lithuanian and Latvian, and every ancestor behind them: Latin, Ancient Greek, Proto-Germanic, Proto-Slavic, Proto-Indo-European and hundreds more. Each language downloads when you first need it.

EVERYTHING ON YOUR IPHONE
The dictionary, the camera reading and the speech recognition all run on your iPhone. No account, no ads, no tracking, and it works offline.

Etymologies from Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

name: eVisaFlow: TDAC, MDAC, SGAC
description:
Before every trip you type the same passport details into an arrival card again. eVisaFlow remembers them and fills in the official form for you. You look it over and send it yourself.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Save your passport details once. Add your family or anyone you travel with.
• Don't want to type? Take a photo of your passport and the details are filled in for you to check.
• Enter your trip: arrival date, flight and where you are staying.
• Open the official arrival card website in the app and tap "Auto fill". The form is filled in on the spot, and you can see what was filled and what still needs you.
• You finish the rest yourself: the security check, the final review and sending the card.

ARRIVAL CARDS
• Thailand (TDAC)
• Malaysia (MDAC)
• Cambodia (e-Arrival)
• Singapore (SG Arrival Card)

YOUR PRIVACY
• Your phone stores your saved passport details and photos.
• When you tap "Auto fill", the app enters your details on the official website.
• If you scan your passport, eVisaFlow receives a copy of the photo for recognition and deletes that copy after processing.
• You can fill in arrival cards without an account. Scanning a passport needs you to sign in with Apple or Google.

ALREADY USE EVISAFLOW ON YOUR COMPUTER?
Sign in with Google and use the same account as the eVisaFlow Chrome extension.

PLEASE NOTE
eVisaFlow is an independent tool. It is not a government app and has no connection with any government or immigration office. It does not decide whether you can enter a country, and it never sends a form for you.

The official websites:
• Thailand: https://tdac.immigration.go.th
• Malaysia: https://imigresen-online.imi.gov.my/mdac/main
• Cambodia: https://arrival.gov.kh
• Singapore: https://eservices.ica.gov.sg/arrivalcard

name: Exodus: Planet Nine
description:
Earth is dying. The last solar-powered ark leaves for Planet Nine — the only world beyond the edge of the Solar System where humanity can survive.

The farther you fly from the Sun, the weaker your charge and the faster you go.

NINE SECTORS, NINE WORLDS

Earth orbit — satellite wreckage falls from the sky
Mars — rust-red spires rise out of the dust
Asteroid Belt — drifting rocks and falling debris
Jupiter — radiation barriers and spinning rotors
Saturn — ice plates from the rings slide shut
Uranus — crystal fields grow before your eyes
Neptune — supersonic winds push your ship off course
Kuiper Belt — ice hail and crossing comets
Planet Nine — gravity pulls you sideways on the final run

BOOSTS Catch energy cells to stay alive. Grab shields, magnets, jumps, time-slowing chrono and the hyperjump — three seconds faster than light.

HANGAR Unlock five ships, each with its own battery, handling, shields and income: Pioneer, Falcon, Titan, Phantom and the Nova flagship.

Clean low-poly visuals
Procedural soundtrack that changes with every sector
Speed grows sector by sector — every run is a test
English, Russian and Ukrainian

Steer with one thumb. Reach Planet Nine.

name: Experiaodebt
description: Experiaodebt records your daily income and expenses, account transfers, and each instance of contract renewal separately. You can list the old and new monthly fees, installation charges, and promotional periods side-by-side, using a timeline of the transition to track overlapping charges and the dates when refunds are credited. If your first bill includes both a monthly fee and an installation fee, record it as a single debit, then allocate the total amount to the respective line items. For any final settlement statements you have yet to receive, simply set those entries aside for later verification. Once you have reconciled the figures month by month, you can refer back to your original transaction records to identify exactly when the costs of renewing your contract were fully recovered—and determine how much you continue to save even after the promotional period has ended.

name: ExposureJetty
description:
Calculate a shutter duration from a reference exposure, then build an ordered exposure bracket for settings you enter.

Enter a reference aperture, shutter and ISO. Choose your target aperture and ISO, add ND stops and exposure compensation, and compare the calculated duration with a nearby common shutter setting and its EV difference.

• Build 3, 5, 7 or 9 frames with supported EV spacing.
• Review darker-to-brighter exposure rows and total exposure time.
• Freeze named plans with notes and the complete input settings.
• Generate CSV and paginated PDF files from a frozen plan.
• Reopen saved plans and exports, and share files through iOS.

ExposureJetty performs manual arithmetic. It does not measure scene light, control a camera or correct film reciprocity. Total exposure time excludes intervals, processing and camera overhead. Check your equipment and the supported range before using a plan.

Plans and generated files are stored locally. System backups and copies you choose to share are separate from the app's local library.

name: Fadely -
description:
Fadely - Light Field Gradient Sampler, designed for iPhone Duo.
Control sampling grid density continuously via hinge angle. Fold and unfold your device to densify or thin the sampling points. It captures luminance of area light sources and renders gradient heatmap to inspect uniformity of softbox, backlight and studio lighting.

- Hinge-driven sampling density, exclusive interaction for Duo
- Custom sampling region selection, per-point luminance sampling
- Luminance gradient heatmap, brightness range & uniformity calculation
- Export annotated snapshot and luminance CSV table
- All source images stored locally, no cloud transmission

Great for soft light inspection, backlight testing and planar light source uniformity check.

On regular iPhone, you can import photos, sample luminance, view gradient data and export files. Sampling density can only be adjusted by slider in popover. The hinge-linked sampling feature is only available on iPhone Duo.

name: Fami Prompt
description:
Fami Prompt is a mobile companion for developers who run AI coding agents on their own server.

Connect the app to your self-hosted server and manage your work from your iPhone or iPad:

• Files – explore the project tree, open and read source files, attach files to a prompt.

name: Father's Many Mansions

FIND CHURCHES NEAR YOU

name: Feedbackgenerator
description:
Der Feedbackgenerator unterstützt Praxisanleiterinnen und Praxisanleiter dabei, Feedbackgespräche mit Lernenden strukturiert vorzubereiten. Sie wählen Berufsgruppe, Feedbacksituation und Lernziel. Die App schlägt dazu passende Gesprächsmethoden vor und erstellt einen Leitfaden, den Sie an Ihr Gespräch anpassen.

FÜR DIESE BERUFSGRUPPEN
• Physiotherapie
• Ergotherapie
• Pharmazeutisch-technische Assistenz

Die Berufsgruppe steuert Beispiele, Fallübungen und den Ausbildungsrahmen.

FEEDBACK VORBEREITEN
• Sechs Feedbacksituationen, vom unmittelbaren über das korrigierende bis zum prüfungsorientierten Feedback
• Neun Lernziele, darunter praktische Handlungskompetenz, Kommunikation, fachliches Reasoning sowie Patienten- und Arzneimittelsicherheit
• Ein bevorzugter Ansatz und Alternativen mit Begründung, Zeitbedarf und Evidenzhinweis
• Wer die Methode schon kennt, wählt sie direkt aus

NEUN METHODEN
Ask–Tell–Ask, Situation–Behavior–Impact (SBI), R2C2, ALOBA, SET–GO, One-Minute Preceptor, Advocacy–Inquiry, Feed up · Feed back · Feed forward und PEARLS für die Nachbesprechung von Simulationen und Rollenspielen.

LEITFADEN UND PDF
• Gesprächsvorschlag mit Platzhaltern für die eigene Beobachtung
• Eigene Fassungen bleiben je Methode in der Sitzung erhalten
• Lernvereinbarung mit Ziel, nächster Handlung und erkennbarem Fortschritt
• Vorbereitungsblatt, Dokumentationsblatt und Methodenleitfaden als PDF sichern oder drucken

LERNBEREICH
• Methodenprofile mit Gesprächsstruktur, Anwendung und Grenzen
• Methodenvergleich nach Anlass, Funktion, Zeitbedarf und Evidenz
• Fallübungen mit Musterlösungen für jede Berufsgruppe
• Kritische Einordnung von Feedback-Sandwich und Pendleton
• Methodenhandbuch mit 25 Seiten als PDF
• 22 Quellen mit DOI-Verweisen

DATENSCHUTZ
Die App verarbeitet Ihre Eingaben ausschließlich lokal im Arbeitsspeicher des Geräts. Es gibt kein Konto, keine Werbung und keine Auswertung der Nutzung. Beim Beenden der App gehen die Eingaben verloren. Eine Internetverbindung wird nur gebraucht, wenn Sie eine externe Literaturquelle öffnen. Verzichten Sie in Freitextfeldern auf Namen, Fallnummern und identifizierende Einzelheiten.

FACHLICHER RAHMEN
Sicherheit hat Vorrang: Bei Gefährdung zuerst die Handlung unterbrechen, die Situation absichern und die zuständige Fachperson nach Einrichtungsvorgaben hinzuziehen. Die App erkennt Risiken nicht und ersetzt keine fachliche Entscheidung.

name: Feet Down: Mission Alarm
description:
Snoozing is a habit. Feet Down breaks it. The alarm keeps ringing until your feet are on the floor.

60 STEPS, THEN SILENCE
Every alarm is a ticket. When it rings, tap Start mission: walk 60 steps, or solve 3 to 10 sums. The sound keeps going and gets louder until the mission is done. Then the stub tears off.

STOP DOES NOT END IT
Pressed Stop on the Lock Screen and rolled over? The Backstop rings again 2 minutes later, every 2 minutes, until the mission is done.

RINGS THROUGH SILENT AND FOCUS
Feet Down uses Apple's AlarmKit: a full-screen alarm on the Lock Screen, in StandBy and on Apple Watch, through Silent mode and Focus.

FREE, FOREVER
• 1 alarm with a Steps or Maths mission
• Backstop up to 10 minutes

Yearly with a 3-day free trial, or monthly. Cancel any time in Settings.

STAYS ON THIS IPHONE
Steps, photos and barcodes are processed on your iPhone and never uploaded. No tracking.

name: Field Scout: Home Inspector
description:
Viewing five homes in a day? Field Scout turns each one into a dossier you can trust: sun and heat on every facade, a verified direction, noise, measurements, photos and a checklist. Then it puts them side by side so the choice is obvious.

KNOW HOW HOT IT GETS
• Minutes of direct sun and afternoon heat (kWh per m²) for each window, for the hottest month, the coolest month and the day you visit.
• Nearby buildings and terrain in 3D, so you see which tower or hill blocks the sun. Scan the skyline from the window to make it more precise.
• A sun calendar for every day of the year, a 2D sun dial with a time scrubber, and an AR view that draws the sun path on the sky.

A COMPASS THAT ADMITS WHEN IT'S WRONG
• Steel and wiring inside buildings can push a phone compass off by 10 to 40 degrees. Field Scout compares the magnetic field with the Earth's expected field at your location and shows a live trust score.
• When the compass can't be trusted, set the direction another way: rotate an arrow on the satellite map, sight the sun through the camera, or walk along the facade with GPS.

FENG SHUI ON A DIRECTION YOU CAN TRUST
• Eight Mansions (Bát trạch): Kua number, East/West group and the star each facade falls in, for several people at once. Shown as a cultural reference, and you can turn it off.

HEAR WHAT THE LISTING DOESN'T SAY
• Measure the noise level and the quiet background level of each room, and spot hums from transformers, pumps and fans.
• Uncalibrated values are marked "≈"; calibrate against a sound meter if you have one.

CHECK THE APARTMENT AND THE AREA
• Quick tests: water flow, light level, floor vibration and internet speed.
• From the map, before you visit: road and rail noise estimate, walkable shops, transit and schools, and whether the home sits low or close to water.
• AR measuring, floor and wall level, tagged photos by room and a practical checklist.

COMPARE AND DECIDE
• Up to 10 homes side by side with a 0 to 100 score and weights you choose.
• Export a clean PDF report or share a read-only link.

AFTER YOU MOVE IN
• A home journal for issues and repairs, maintenance reminders, and a move-in record for your deposit.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Works offline. No account needed.
• Microphone audio is analysed on your phone and never recorded or uploaded.
• No ads, no tracking.

FREE AND PAID
Free: 3 active homes, today's sun, compass with trust score, feng shui, 10-second noise check, checklist, apartment checks, neighbourhood and home journal.
Hunt Pass (30 days, does not renew), Pro (yearly, 7-day free trial) and Agent (monthly) unlock unlimited homes, seasonal sun and heat, 30-second noise with spectrum and hum detection, compare and PDF reports. Agent adds your logo and contact on reports. Prices are shown in the app before you buy. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled in your Apple account settings at least 24 hours before the end of the period.

Honest limits: map data can be incomplete and phone readings are great for comparing homes, but they are not a certified survey.

name: Fireside Party
description:
Everyone in your group levels at their own pace, and you're rarely online at the same time. Fireside Party keeps track of all your group's World of Warcraft Forever characters and shows you who is close enough in level to play together tonight.

HOW IT WORKS
• Add your characters by name and region. Level, class, race, faction and ruleset come from the public Battle.net armory and stay up to date.
• The armory only knows characters from level 10. Below that, you enter the level yourself, and Fireside Party switches to armory data once it's there.
• Share your friend code. Friends who follow you see your characters, and you see theirs when you follow them back.
• Friends without the app? Add their characters by hand.

CAN PLAY TOGETHER
The Together tab finds groups of up to five players whose characters share region, ruleset and faction and are close enough in level. One character per player, biggest groups first. You decide how big the level gap may be.

EVERYONE BY LEVEL
All characters in your group, sorted by level and grouped by region, ruleset and faction. See at a glance who's ahead and who needs to catch up.

PROGRESS
A chart of everyone's levels over time, for the last week, month or since the start. Filter by player, tap a character to highlight its line, and see who gained the most levels.

SMALL AND PRIVATE
• No Battle.net login. Fireside Party only reads public armory data.
• No email, no password. Your account is a nickname and a friend code, and a backup key moves it to a new phone.
• No ads, no tracking.
• Delete your account in the app at any time.

Fireside Party is an independent app and is not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by Blizzard Entertainment. World of Warcraft and Blizzard Entertainment are trademarks or registered trademarks of Blizzard Entertainment, Inc. in the U.S. and/or other countries.

name: Fixentia
description:
Fixentia is a calm diagnostics console for the things at home that stop working.

When the Wi-Fi drops, the washer won't drain or the TV shows sound but no picture, open the lab, pick the device family and follow a guide laid out as a circuit path. Answer each step with Yes or No: the probe signal moves along the trace, completed nodes light up green, and branches adapt to what you see — until the problem is fixed or it's clearly time to call a professional.

DIAGNOSE SAFELY
• 34 built-in guides across 16 categories: TV, Wi-Fi router, laptop, phone, headphones, printer, smart speaker, fridge, washer, dryer, dishwasher, microwave, oven, air conditioner, water heater and vacuum.
• Each guide lists symptoms, likely causes, step-by-step checks with yes/no branches, safety notes and "call a professional when…" warnings.
• Only outside checks, settings and user-cleanable parts. Fixentia never asks you to open a mains-powered casing.

IDENTIFY THE PROBLEM
• Not sure which guide fits? Pick the category, tap the symptoms you see and get ranked matches with a clear match score.
• Search the whole library by keyword.

RESUME ANY TIME
• Progress is saved after every answer. Leave halfway and resume from the console later.
• Undo an answer, restart a run or attach it to a device.

KEEP A SERVICE RECORD
• My devices: name, brand, model, location, purchase date and warranty end with a live warranty status.
• Device history: every troubleshooting run and every repair (with cost and technician) in one timeline.
• Saved solutions: bookmark guides, and fixes are counted automatically under "Fixed it" with the step that solved it.
• Notes on guides, devices and runs.

MAINTENANCE REMINDERS
• Schedule routine care such as cleaning the dryer lint filter monthly or vacuuming fridge coils twice a year.
• Local notifications on the due date; mark done to schedule the next one.

OFFLINE FIRST, NO ACCOUNT
• Everything works offline and is stored on your iPhone.
• Optional cloud backup keeps a private copy under an anonymous identifier — no sign-up, no sign-in, no ads, no tracking.
• Export your data as JSON or CSV at any time.

DESIGNED FOR LANDSCAPE
A category rail, a three-panel lab and a console look in dark "console black" or light "drafting white".

Guides are general home-user advice and not a substitute for the manufacturer's manual or a qualified technician. If you smell gas or burning, stop and call a professional.
