Pick your departure and arrival airports and what happened. FlightRescue EU works out the flight distance and shows whether EU Regulation 261/2004 or the UK rules may apply and which fixed amount band fits: EUR 250, 400 or 600 (GBP 220, 350 or 520 under UK261). The quick check works offline, even at the gate.

FULL ELIGIBILITY CHECK
A guided check asks about the delay at your final destination, cancellation notice, denied boarding and the airline's explanation, then gives a preliminary result with the facts it used and anything still missing.

SAVED CHECKS
Save several checks on your phone, reopen them later and continue where you stopped. They stay on your device until you delete them.

AIRPORT MODE
Photograph departure boards, gate notices and receipts or import PDFs while it happens. Captures are kept on the device when you are offline and upload to your private claim file when you are back online.

COMPENSATION CLOCK AND LIVE FLIGHTS
Track the three-hour arrival threshold and view live aircraft positions over Europe from the public ADSB.lol feed.

FREE PASSENGER TOOLS
More than 100 free tools: right-to-care checks, letter and complaint helpers, expense trackers, deadline and jurisdiction finders.

YOUR CLAIM FILE
Keep flight details, timeline and evidence in one place, export your data at any time and delete your account in the app.

LANGUAGES
English, Romanian, German and French.

IMPORTANT
FlightRescue EU does not file claims for you and charges no fees or commissions. Results are preliminary automated assessments, not legal advice or a promise of payment. Extraordinary circumstances and other facts can change the outcome. The 2026 EU reform is not applied.

name: FlixTrese
description:
Every candle starts as a small experiment. What happens at 9% fragrance instead of 7? Does this jar really hold 200 grams? Which batch had the throw you loved last spring? FlixTrese is a bench notebook built around those questions, laid out like a lab book with graph paper, tape labels and tidy tables.

THE CALCULATOR
Choose a container, set how many you are pouring and pick your wax. Then set fragrance, dye and a little extra for spills. Weights for wax, fragrance oil and dye appear straight away in grams or ounces. You decide whether fragrance and dye are measured as a percentage of the wax or of the whole blend, and the numbers follow. An animated ingredient stack shows how the pour divides up, layer by layer.

CONTAINER PRESETS
Seven common containers come ready on the stock shelf, from tealights to pillars. Add your own jars with their fill weight, or use the water trick: weigh the water a jar holds and convert it to a wax fill.

THE BATCH LOG
Tap Log this batch and the recipe is stamped into your notebook with the date, container, wax, scent and dye note. Add notes about set-up, frosting, wick behaviour or throw. Pour a favourite again with one tap and the recipe comes along.

A SCENT LIBRARY
Keep each fragrance oil with its family, supplier, max load, flash point and cure time. Search, filter by family and star your favourites. Choose a scent in the calculator and you get a warning if your fragrance percentage goes past the max load you recorded.

CURE-TIME REMINDERS
Every batch sits on a cure shelf with a countdown and a progress bar. Switch on a reminder and you get a notification on the morning the cure ends. When it is ready, mark it burn tested.

SMALL THINGS
Dark lab look by default, with a light page and a system option. Generated sounds for stamping and finishing, which you can switch off. Your notebook lives on your phone and works offline, with a quiet anonymous backup.

A NOTE ON SAFETY
FlixTrese does the arithmetic. Follow your supplier's safety data for fragrance load, flash point and pour temperature, test your wicks, and never leave heating wax or a burning candle unattended. The numbers are arithmetic, not a promise that a candle is safe.

name: Floor Plan Scanner
description:
A plan is built from a photo, wall measurements or freehand rooms. Doors, windows and wall sizes are added, and the app reports room area and free space.

Catalog furniture is placed on the plan, dragged into position and rotated. Fit Check tests whether an item fits a room without blocking a door, and several layout variants can be compared against one another so the better arrangement stays. Favorite pieces are saved from the furniture catalog.

For renovation, flooring, paint, trim and related materials are estimated with a waste allowance. A Sample Apartment is included, so the editor can be explored before any plan of your own exists. Figures replace guesswork before a single piece is moved.

name: Floor Tally: Room Scanner
description:
Scanning needs an iPhone or iPad with LiDAR (Pro models). On any other iPhone or iPad you type each room's length and width, and everything else works the same.

Floor Tally measures rooms and adds them up. Scan a room, or a whole floor one room after another, and get each room's floor area, its length and width, and the total of the rooms you count. Share a floor summary PDF, an image of the plan or the 3D model.

FOR
- Real estate agents sketching a listing
- Flooring installers working out what to order
- Insurance adjusters and appraisers who want a quick room check

SCAN OR TYPE
- Scan with the LiDAR scanner: walls, doors and windows are found on the device
- Scan several rooms in one go; they draw joined up on the plan
- Type a room as a rectangle or an L shape, in feet and inches or meters
- Add closets and bays, rename rooms, set the level
- Leave a garage or porch out of the total with one switch
- Type your own area for any room when you have a better measurement

AREAS AND FLOORING
- Floor area of each room, wall to wall, and the total of the rooms you count
- Flooring take-off with your own waste percent, rounded up, and the box count from the box label

SHARE
- Floor summary PDF with the plan, a room table and the totals
- PNG image of the plan
- 3D model of each scan
- With a plan: your logo, business name and contact line on the PDF

WHAT IT IS NOT
Areas are interior room areas from a phone scan or typed by hand. They are not a survey, an appraisal or a measurement to any square footage standard. Check critical sizes with a tape or laser. No accuracy figure is claimed.

FREE AND PAID
Free: unlimited scans and typed rooms, areas, the flooring take-off, PDF, image and 3D model exports, and backups, for 2 saved floor plans. Free PDFs end with a small "Made with Floor Tally" line.
A plan (monthly, yearly or lifetime) saves as many floor plans as you need and puts your logo and business details on the PDF. Prices are shown in the app before you buy. Subscriptions renew until cancelled in your Apple Account settings. Restore purchases is on the Plan screen.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account and no sign-in. Floor plans stay in the app on your device and in your own iCloud Backup when it is on. An encrypted backup file and daily copies are built in. No ads, no analytics.

Not affiliated with or approved by Apple, any appraisal, lending or insurance body, or any government agency.

Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: FlowCRM by flowwork.ai
description:
FlowCRM is the sales app for companies on flowwork.ai. Scan a visiting card and it becomes a lead in seconds — even with no network at a trade fair — then follow up by call or WhatsApp, and move deals forward from your phone.

SCAN A CARD, GET A LEAD
• Point the camera at a visiting card: name, company, title, mobile, email and address are filled in for you
• Scan a whole pile of cards in one go, front and back
• The text is read on your phone, so scanning works with no internet
• The card photo is saved with the lead

WORKS OFFLINE
• Add and edit leads, notes and follow-ups with no network
• Everything syncs in order when you're back online — nothing is lost if you close the app
• A sync queue shows what is waiting, and lets you retry anything that couldn't be saved

NEVER MISS A FOLLOW-UP
• Today shows what's due and what's overdue
• Reminders 15 minutes before each follow-up
• Call, WhatsApp or email a lead in one tap, and log the call or chat on the timeline

YOUR PIPELINE IN YOUR POCKET
• My leads with status, source and rating, and search across your CRM
• The full timeline of every lead
• Convert a lead to a deal, see your pipeline by stage and move deals forward

PART OF FLOWWORK
• The same account and the same data as flowwork CRM on the web
• Leads you scan follow your company's assignment rules
• One flowwork account also opens People, Payroll, Books, Expense and more

FlowCRM needs a flowwork.ai work account. New here? Create your company with your work email in under a minute at flowwork.ai. Learn more at flowwork.ai.

name: Foldapult
description:
Set a marble in the cup, line up a crown and hold your shot. Let go early for a low toss, or build enough power to reach the far side of the desk. You have three marbles to bring every crown down.

Play through 40 towers across four chapters. Take out a wooden support, lob a marble over heavy stone, shatter glass or ride a tailwind. Clear a tower in fewer shots to earn more stars. A daily tower gives you a new target each day, even offline.

Drag on the playfield to aim on iPhone. On a partially open iPhone Duo in tabletop position, tilt the upper screen to raise the catapult arm. Pressing the button locks your angle.

Choose sound effects, haptics and aiming dots independently. Precise controls let you select an angle and power before launch. Your best scores stay on your device.

name: Foldora
description:
Το Foldora είναι προπόνηση αποφάσεων στο πόκερ: σποτ, τρεις κινήσεις, άμεση ανατροφοδότηση.

Διαβάζεις θέση, φύλλα, μέγεθος ποτ και στοίβας. Διαλέγεις πάσο, κάλεσμα, άνοιγμα ή στοίχημα συνέχειας και βλέπεις αν η γραμμή ήταν η καλύτερη, παίζεται ή έξω, με σύντομη εξήγηση.

Ημερήσια άσκηση: έξι σποτ, ίδια σειρά όλη την ημέρα. Γρήγορος γύρος: πέντε τυχαία σποτ. Έξι διαδρομές από πριν το φλοπ μέχρι θέση και πιθανότητες ποτ. Οκτώ μαθήματα και λεξικό όρων.

Ρυθμός 28 δευτερολεπτών ανά απόφαση. Εμπειρία, επίπεδα, ευστοχία ανά δρόμο και επανάληψη λαθών. Χωρίς λογαριασμό, χωρίς αγορές, χωρίς παιχνίδι με χρήματα — μόνο λογική και δεξιότητα.

Δωρεάν. iOS 15 και νεότερα. Κάθετο iPhone.

name: Forgotten Coast Pools
description:
Forgotten Coast Pools is a simple log and care helper for your pool, built by pool owners on Florida's Forgotten Coast.

LOG YOUR WATER
Record free chlorine, pH, alkalinity, calcium, stabilizer, salt and water temperature. Add chemical doses and see how your pool responded over time.

KNOW WHERE YOU STAND
A clear health status shows what is in range and what needs attention, with plain-English suggestions for what to add and how much.

STAY ON TOP OF CHORES
A task list for skimmers, filters, equipment checks and supplies, with optional reminders on your phone.

MADE FOR THE IPHONE
- Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets with your latest readings
- Siri: say "Log a reading in FC Pools"
- Face ID lock to keep your pool data private
- Scan a test strip or label with the camera, or dictate readings (optional; uses Google's Gemini only when you tap and agree)
- Share or export your readings and chemical additions as spreadsheet files
- Works with a weak signal: pages you have viewed stay available, and readings you log offline sync later

NO ADS. NO TRACKING. Delete your account any time inside the app.

Suggestions are general pool-care guidance. Always follow your chemical labels and local safety rules.

name: Forja: Plano de Vida
description:
Forja é um companheiro para a vida de oração de cada dia: o plano de vida espiritual, um livro de orações, a Sagrada Escritura inteira e as leituras do dia, num app simples, bonito e que funciona sem internet.

PLANO DE VIDA
• Checklist das normas diárias, semanais e mensais, organizadas pelos momentos do dia.
• Lembretes no horário e nos dias que você escolher.
• Marque também o dia anterior, para quem reza depois da meia-noite.
• Cronômetro para a oração mental, que continua contando na Dynamic Island e na tela de bloqueio.

ORAÇÕES
• Mais de 100 orações em português, inglês, espanhol, italiano e latim, com leitura lado a lado em dois idiomas.
• Via Sacra com as catorze estações ilustradas.
• Santo Rosário com os mistérios do dia, pinturas clássicas e um versículo do Evangelho para cada conta.
• Terço guiado em áudio, com cinco vozes, velocidade e pausa ajustáveis — continua tocando com a tela apagada.

SAGRADA ESCRITURA
• A Bíblia completa (73 livros), traduzida da Vulgata: Pe. Matos Soares (português), Douay-Rheims (inglês), Martini (italiano) e a Vulgata Clementina (latim).
• Leitura contínua, busca por palavra ou referência (ex.: Jo 3,16) e o ponto onde você parou em cada Testamento.

LEITURAS DO DIA
• Leituras da Missa de qualquer dia, nas edições das conferências episcopais.
• Meditação diária, salva no aparelho para ler mesmo sem conexão.
• Meditações em áudio de sacerdotes.

PARA QUEM LÊ
• Salve pontos e grife trechos; tudo fica reunido em "Salvos".
• Tamanho do texto ajustável, tema claro, escuro ou automático.

PRIVACIDADE
Sem cadastro, sem anúncios e sem rastreamento. Suas anotações, marcações e preferências ficam apenas no seu aparelho, e as anotações pessoais são protegidas pelo Face ID ou pelo código do iPhone.

Forja é um app independente e gratuito, feito por um leigo católico. Não é um aplicativo oficial e não tem vínculo institucional com nenhuma entidade da Igreja.

name: FP2級3級 CBT模試 計算に強くなる
description:
本番と同じCBTの画面で、何度でも模試が解けるFP技能検定の対策アプリです。
2級と3級の両方が1つに入っています。

■ 本番と同じ形式・同じ画面で解く
2級は四答択一60問・120分、3級は○×30問＋三答択一30問・90分。
開始前の「受験上の注意」から、残り時間・問題一覧・見直しフラグ・画面内電卓まで、
CBT試験の流れをそのまま再現しています。解答中は正解を出さず、提出してから採点します。
1問あたりの目安時間に対して、ペースが早いか遅いかも表示します。

■ 毎回、数値が変わる
計算問題は数値を変えて出題します。答えを覚えても意味がないので、
解き方そのものが身につきます。6つの係数、債券の利回り、建蔽率と容積率、
相続税の基礎控除、ROE・PER・PBR、損益分岐点などを繰り返し練習できます。

■ 正解は計算で求めている
計算問題の正解は、アプリが式から計算しています。人が答えを書き写していないので、
数値の取り違えが起きません。誤答の選択肢も「よくある計算ミス」から作っています。

■ 用語カードで暗記もできる
6つの係数、遺留分、小規模宅地等の特例、定期借地権など、試験に出る用語を181語収録。
表に用語、裏に意味と「試験のツボ」。覚えた用語は記録され、まだの用語から順に出ます。

■ 弱いところが分かる
分野別の正答率、模試の推移、連続学習日数をグラフで確認できます。
間違えた問題は忘却曲線にあわせて復習に並びます。

■ ホーム画面ウィジェット
試験日までの残り日数と、今日の用語を表示します。

■ 無料でできること
・学科6分野の問題と全問の解説
・用語カード 72語
・予想模試 第1回（本番と同じ形式・採点と弱点分析まで全部）
・間違えた問題の復習、ブックマーク、分野別の正答率
・ウィジェット、学習リマインダー

■ 合格パック（買い切り）
・予想模試 第2〜5回（本番と同じ形式・回ごとに固定）
・ランダム模試が無制限
・実技の計算ドリル（日本FP協会／きんざいの機関別）
・ひっかけ問題集
・用語カード 全181語
・広告なし
買い切りです。自動更新はありません。法改正にあわせた更新も追加料金なしで配ります。

■ 問題について
このアプリの問題は、公表されている出題傾向をもとに作ったオリジナルの類題です。
公式の過去問を転載していません。問題の誤りは設定画面から報告できます。

name: Fretlog
description:
Fretlog is a practice notebook for guitars and other fretted instruments you already own. The Week tab draws seven bars of the minutes you typed, ending today, and splits those minutes by focus: chords, songs, ear, technique, or other. Two sittings on the same day stack. A song stores the key you want the room to hear and the chord shapes your fretting hand uses. The sounding key is the shape key moved up by the capo fret. The capo bench also answers the other direction: which fret makes a chosen shape sound in a target key. Twelve note names wrap around. Nothing listens to the instrument.

The tempo bench averages the gaps between your taps and shows beats per minute. It does not play a click. You can compare the figure with a song’s target tempo. String changes store a gauge, a material, and an install date. Hours count practice minutes on that instrument on or after that date. The current set turns a warning color when it reaches the hour limit saved on the instrument. That limit is yours. The sample steel guitar uses a short limit so the warning is visible.

Share builds a plain-text week summary and hands it to the system sheet. Fretlog does not tune a string, identify a chord from a recording, sync a library, or require an account. The file stays in this app’s storage on the phone. Restore sample on About replaces it with the demonstration instruments, songs, sessions, and string changes.

name: Friday Night Dice
description:
Turns out Football brought us all together. In 2026 California passed Proposition 58, and the Municipal Football League was born: a pro team was created for each of the state’s 58 counties, to put Californians on the back roads and give every county something to be proud of.

You're the coach. Pick a county, from the Del Norte Keepers in the redwoods to the San Diego Carriers on the flight deck, and take them all the way to the California Cup.

THE GAME
Roll the dice, keep the ones you want, and call your play: 1st Down, Field Goal or Touchdown. Your hand has to back it up. The defense rolls to stop you. A game takes about ten minutes, and every call matters.

THREE DIVISIONS
D1 teams roll five dice, D2 four and D3 three. Small towns can beat big cities, but they'll have to earn it.

YOUR LINEUP
Every county has its usual three Team cards, from a Running Back who moves the chains to a Head Coach who throws the challenge flag. Pick your three before kickoff and swap at halftime.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Game Night: play a friend, live, on two phones.
• Tournament: run a bracket for your crew and name the trophy.
• County Fair: host another county and play for their keepsakes.
• Tour: hit the road across California, pull over at the sights, and bring home your county's Local Legends.
• Season: seven weeks, the playoffs and Champions' Weekend, then promotion and relegation.
• Practice: just you and the dice.

EVERY COUNTY, ITS OWN STORY
Every team has its own helmet, dice, plate and kit, drawn from the place: the Kern Derricks' pumpjack, the Mono Dry Flies' opening day, the Mariposa Mothers' tattoo heart. Scout them all in the Coach's Office.

No ads. No tracking. Just football, dice and Friday night.

name: Fristfux
description:
Nie wieder eine Frist verpassen.

Rückgabe beim Online-Shop, Garantie für den Fernseher, Kündigung des Handyvertrags, Frist im Brief vom Amt oder der nächste TÜV – Fristfux behält alles im Blick und erinnert dich rechtzeitig.

KASSENBON FOTOGRAFIEREN – FERTIG
Fotografiere einen Kassenbon oder Brief. Fristfux erkennt Händler, Kaufdatum und Fristen und schlägt passende Erinnerungen vor, zum Beispiel Rückgabe nach 14 Tagen und Gewährleistung nach 2 Jahren. Das Belegfoto wird gleich mitgespeichert – praktisch im Garantiefall.

ALLES AUF EINEN BLICK
Die Ampel-Startseite zeigt sofort, was überfällig ist, was diese Woche ansteht und was noch Zeit hat.

VORLAGEN FÜR DEN ALLTAG
Mit einem Tipp angelegt:
• Auto: TÜV, Reifenwechsel, Versicherungswechsel
• Wohnung & Haus: Rauchmelder, Heizung, Zählerstände, Filter
• Ausweise: Personalausweis, Reisepass, Führerschein
• Verträge & Finanzen: Kündigungsfristen, Steuererklärung, Tarife

ERINNERUNGEN, WIE DU SIE WILLST
Am Tag selbst, einen Tag, eine Woche oder Monate vorher. Wiederkehrende Fristen planen sich nach dem Erledigen automatisch neu.

DEINE DATEN BLEIBEN BEI DIR
Kein Konto, keine Werbung, keine Cloud. Fristen und Belegfotos werden nur auf deinem Gerät gespeichert, die Texterkennung läuft direkt auf dem Handy.

FRISTFUX PRO
Kostenlos nutzbar mit bis zu 20 aktiven Fristen und 5 Scans pro Monat. Mit Fristfux Pro hebst du alle Grenzen auf – per Einmalkauf, ohne Abo.

Hinweis: Fristfux ersetzt keine Rechtsberatung. Bitte prüfe erkannte Fristen immer anhand des Originaldokuments.

name: Front Row Sports
description:
Front Row puts the games you care about one tap away.

Pick your sports and your teams, and Front Row builds around them. Your Home screen shows your team's next game with a countdown, its record and streak, and the scores that matter today.

FEATURES
- Live scores and schedules for pro football, college football and pro hockey
- My Teams: live, upcoming and recent games for every team you follow, in one place
- Game pages with team stats, game leaders and box scores
- Standings by division, conference and league, plus college rankings
- Stat leaders across the league
- Home Screen widgets in small, medium and large sizes
- Lock Screen widgets
- Live scores on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island while a game is on
- Game alerts for your teams
- Current and kickoff weather for outdoor games
- Works on iPhone and iPad, with light and dark mode

No account needed. Sign in only if you want the teams you follow to sync across your devices. You can delete your account at any time in Settings.

Front Row Sports is an independent app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by any league, team, school, conference or players' association. Team names and logos are trademarks of their owners and are used only to identify teams.

name: FunnelMatic
description:
Know the second your funnel makes money.

FunnelMatic puts your whole funnel in your pocket: every sale, every lead and every booked call as it happens, plus your training, all in one app.

INSTANT NOTIFICATIONS
• New sale: who bought and for how much
• Call booked: who’s coming and when
• New lead: the moment someone opts in
• Contact alerts: your own “notify me” automations
• Daily summary: today’s leads and sales at 8pm
Tap any notification to open that person or sale. Switch each one on or off in Settings.

YOUR NUMBERS AT A GLANCE
• Money in, ad spend, what you kept after ads, and return on ads
• Today’s funnel: visitors, opt-ins and sales
• Every lead’s full journey: the ad they clicked, the pages they saw, what they bought and every email they got

YOUR TRAINING, SAME APP
Open your courses, community and team chat without leaving the app, and jump back to your dashboard in one tap.

BUILT FOR YOUR PHONE
Sign in with a 6-digit code, pull to refresh, works with your Face ID-locked phone, and shows a clear screen if you lose signal.

FOR FUNNELMATIC MEMBERS
The app is for existing FunnelMatic members. Sign in with the email on your account.

name: FutureAI
description:
FutureAI brings your team, projects and site work together in one secure workspace.
 
CHAT AND CALLS
• Direct messages, team groups and project chats
• Voice and video calls, including group calls
• @mentions, pinned messages, search inside a chat
• Voice notes, photos and file sharing
 
TASKS AND PLANNING
• Create tasks in a project, assign owners and set due dates
• Task board, subtasks, checklists and activity history
• Calendar with events, invitations and task deadlines
 
PROJECTS AND SITE
• Submittals, drawings, RFIs, snags and permits
• Site diary, inspections, deliveries, manpower and plant hours
• Material requests and equipment tracking
 
APPROVALS AND FINANCE
• Payment requests with drafts, comments and audit trail
• Approve, reject and track requests on the go
 
FILES
• Folders, sharing, version history and tags
 
AI ASSISTANT
• Ask AI Draftsman to summarise conversations, find information and suggest tasks
 
SECURE BY DESIGN
• Two-step sign-in, app lock and role-based access — everyone sees only what their role allows
 
FutureAI is for organisations that use the FutureAI platform. Sign in with the account your organisation gave you.

name: GainSextant
description:
Keep decibel calculations explicit. GainSextant brings gain chains, ratio conversion and independent power sums into one manual calculation workspace.

BUILD A GAIN CHAIN
Name and order up to 32 stages. Enter each stage's gain or loss in dB, then inspect cumulative gain together with amplitude and power ratios. Positive and negative stages remain visible in the calculation.

USE THE RIGHT RATIO
Convert dB to amplitude and power ratios, or convert a ratio back to dB. The displayed formulas distinguish 20 times log10 for amplitude from 10 times log10 for power, helping you check which convention you are using.

ADD INDEPENDENT POWERS
Enter signals in dBm and inspect their combined power in both dBm and milliwatts. The calculation adds linear powers using the common 1 mW reference. It is intended for independent, uncorrelated signals, not phase-sensitive amplitude addition.

KEEP THE INPUTS WITH THE RESULT
Freeze chain, conversion and power-sum reports. Save CSV and PDF exports containing the inputs, formulas and results, then preview or share the files. Saved reports remain separate from later edits to a working chain.

Start with the optional practice chain. About includes a library backup export and restoration of the last good local save.

GainSextant calculates from values you enter. It does not record audio, access the microphone, measure sound levels or calibrate equipment.

name: GAIvsIQ
description:
GAIvsIQ estimates Full Scale IQ and GAI from nine tasks, or from two official scores you already have.

Free every time:
• Overall IQ, GAI, and the gap
• A relative five-domain shape
• No account required

Optional written file ($19.99, once — not a subscription):
• Exact domain scores
• Nine-task table
• GAI vs CPI
• Short written reading

Only offered when |GAI − FSIQ| is 5 or more. Smaller splits stay free — one number is enough to quote.

Also included:
• Calculator for WISC/WAIS composites you already hold
• Sample of the paid file before you buy
• Files stay on this device; email only if you unlock a file

Not a WAIS, WISC, or diagnosis. Not a Pearson product. For personal understanding only.

name: Game GPS: IRL QuestMap
description:
Turn your real streets into a game world. QuestMap is turn-by-turn GPS navigation that redraws the map around you in original game-style worlds — and it works for free, with no account and no ads.

PICK YOUR WORLD ON A 3D GLOBE
Spin the Earth in each world's style, see its icons floating over cities, then dive straight down to your own street. Prefer the close-up? Switch to "My streets" and swipe through worlds live on your block in 3D.

THIRTEEN ORIGINAL WORLDS
Minimal World, Western Frontier, Retro City, Neon District, Pixel World, Fantasy Kingdom, Racing Circuit, Synthwave, Midnight Drive, Emerald Valley, Frozen North, Golden Desert and Recon Grid. Every world has its own colours, icons, fonts and sounds, plus a day and a night look.

REAL NAVIGATION
• Turn-by-turn guidance with voice, clear turn banners and speed limits
• Compare route options and avoid tolls or highways
• Add stops on the way
• Driving and walking
• Guidance keeps going with the screen locked

CARPLAY
Take your world to the car screen. Your themed map, turn-by-turn guidance and arrival time show on CarPlay, and phone and car always follow the same trip. Pick Destinations or switch worlds right from the car, and get Home and Work shortcuts on the CarPlay Dashboard.

LOCK-SCREEN TURN ALERTS
While a route runs in the background, your next turn and your arrival appear on the lock screen.

TRIP TRACKER
Open the tracker from the side menu to see distance, moving time, average speed and top speed for your drive.

CHOOSE YOUR RIDE
Show yourself as a sports car, motorbike, horse rider, pirate ship, cyclist, walker or one of many arrows. Markers turn with your direction.

FIND PLACES FAST
• Search addresses, shops and landmarks
• Tap Restaurants, Coffee, Fuel, Parking and more to see them right on the map
• Save Home, Work, favourites and pins

name: Garra da Boiadeira
description:
Welcome to the cutest party at the rodeo!

In Garra da Boiadeira you control a 3D plush claw machine full of adorable squishies: buns, corn, pancakes, popsicles, pizza, a little duck and much more. Aim, drop the claw and lasso your prize!

HOW TO PLAY
• Drag your finger to aim the claw
• Tap SOLTAR! and hope it holds on tight
• Rotate the camera to find the best angle

COLLECT THEM ALL
• 21 different squishies to complete your album
• 4 rarities: Common, Rare, Epic and Legendary
• Can you catch the Golden Bun and the Magic Crystal?

BUILD COMBOS
• Catch several in a row to multiply your points
• Every 3 catches in a row earns a bonus token
• Beat your high score!

MADE FOR EVERYONE
• Quick rounds, perfect for a break
• Works offline
• No sign-up and no data collection
• Charming sounds, music and haptics

Ready to lasso? Yeehaw!

name: Gazetto
description:
Gazetto turns the news into pages you flip. Pick the topics you care about, swipe up to turn the page, and tap any story to read it.

FLIP THROUGH THE NEWS
Each topic opens with a full-page cover story, then alternates between one and two stories per page. Swipe up for the next page and down for the previous one, and the page folds along its middle like a magazine. Pull down on the first page to check for new stories.

ALL YOUR TOPICS IN ONE PLACE
Your home screen shows a tile for every topic you follow, each with its latest photo and headline. Choose from 44 topics, including world news, the U.S., business, technology, science, space, health, sports, travel, food, history, photography, motorsport, the regions of the world and many more. Reorder them, turn them on or off, or add any website's RSS or Atom feed as a topic of its own.

STORIES, CLEANLY LAID OUT
Tap a story and Gazetto shows its text and photos in a clean, consistent layout that's easy to read. Make the text larger or smaller, share the story, or open it in Safari's Reader view.

FREE TO READ
Stories come from publishers' free, public feeds. Gazetto leaves out sources with paywalls, so the stories you open are free to read.

MADE FOR IPHONE AND IPAD
On iPad, Gazetto uses the extra room: more topics on the home screen, larger photos and type, and in landscape, photos beside the text and stories side by side. It works in every orientation, as well as in Split View and Stage Manager.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no sign-up and no tracking. Gazetto doesn't collect any data. Your topics and settings stay on your device.

Gazetto is not affiliated with the publishers whose stories it shows. Every story names its source and links to the original.

name: GeoPic: GPS Map Camera
description:
GeoPic turns your device into a reliable field camera and land measurement tool. Capture photos and videos with automatically stamped location details, compass direction, elevation, date, time, and street addresses.

Whether you supervise construction projects, inspect real estate, measure agricultural land, or conduct field audits, GeoPic gives you clear visual proof for every job site.


KEY FEATURES

Accurate Geotagging
Stamp geographic coordinates, street addresses, elevation, compass heading, and exact timestamps directly onto your pictures and videos.

Satellite and Street Map Overlays
Include a live map within your photo stamp. Choose between satellite views, hybrid imagery, standard street maps, and topographic terrain.

Land and Plot Measurement
Measure property boundaries and calculate plot area. Walk the perimeter of your land or place pins on the satellite map to measure total area and boundary length. Export clean survey summary certificates to share with clients or colleagues.

Professional Project Tags
Add custom project titles, site numbers, and inspector names to your stamps. Select from clean template layouts designed for engineering, construction, and property audits.

Built for Field Work
Use the leveling horizon line to frame structures accurately. Switch lenses smoothly and review your media in a dedicated gallery with an interactive map view.


IDEAL FOR
Civil engineers, construction supervisors, real estate agents, land surveyors, agricultural inspectors, utility technicians, and field professionals who require clear location documentation.

name: getctd
description:
ctd is a private travel photo blog for you and the people you love.

Add photos from the places you visit, tag them with your own categories (cats, history, food, transport, anything you like) and invite family and friends. Each person chooses whether to follow everything or only the categories they care about, and how they want to hear about new posts.

SHARE YOUR TRAVELS
• Create a post for each place and add photos straight from your library
• Add captions and tag photos with your own categories
• Publish when you're ready, and send an update when you add more

MADE FOR FAMILY AND FRIENDS
• Invite people by email; they get their own free account
• Followers pick all updates or just their favourite categories
• Notifications by push, email, WhatsApp, or your family's Slack, Discord or Microsoft Teams channel
• A feed of new posts from everyone you follow

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
• Your blog is visible only to people you invite, unless you choose to make it public
• Photos are stored privately and shared through secure, expiring links
• Report or block anyone, and delete your account at any time from Settings

Available in English, Spanish, French and German.

name: GFVYRA
description:
GFVYRA is a practical planning application designed to improve organization, consistency, and convenience.

The app provides useful tools, customizable options, and visual references to help users manage everyday activities and explore different preferences.

Users can save, organize, and review their records over time, making it easier to maintain consistency and improve their overall experience.

name: Giáo xứ Thánh Gia
description:
Giáo xứ Thánh Gia tái hiện khuôn viên Giáo xứ Thánh Gia – Thầy Ký trong không gian 3D để bà con ở xa có thể ghé thăm nhà thờ, đến nghĩa trang và tưởng nhớ người thân. Bố cục các công trình, vị trí phần mộ và thông tin ngày giỗ được dựng theo tư liệu thực tế của giáo xứ.

• Tìm và viếng mộ người thân, dâng hoa, thắp nhang hoặc thắp nến.
• Lưu phần mộ trên iPhone hoặc iPad và đặt nhắc ngày giỗ hằng năm.
• Xem giờ lễ, lịch Công giáo và mở các kinh nguyện.

Ứng dụng miễn phí. Bạn có thể ghé thăm bằng biệt danh, không cần tạo tài khoản.

name: Glidia: Chord Visualizer
description:
Glidia turns chords into light: ribbons, wheel, fretboard, keyboard or spiral show each chord, with fingerings for guitar, bass, ukulele and piano.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Follow chords live in five modes (ribbons, wheel, fretboard, keyboard, spiral) and tune every detail: lines, curve, glow, colors, presets
• Fingerings for guitar, bass, ukulele and piano
• Compose with one-tap chord suggestions and a plain explanation of each chord, sections and undo, or learn with the guided tutorial
• Twenty built-in sounds: guitars, electric piano, organ, strings, harp, harpsichord, vibraphone, choir and more, nothing to download
• Vibe pedal and effects chain: phaser, chorus, vibrato, flanger, tremolo, delay, reverb
• Play your own instrument through the effects (microphone or audio interface)
• Export a 9:16 video for short-video apps, an audio file or a chord chart PDF
• Simple and Expert modes, themes, note names in your language, 45 languages, works offline

WITH ADS, AND AD-FREE IF YOU WISH
Glidia is funded by ads. Every feature stays available: the optional Ad-Free subscription only removes them. It renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period, from your Apple Account settings.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Glimmer Workshop: Diamond Art
description:
The game interface is in Korean. Drag your finger across the empty spaces and listen as each gem clicks into place. Finish the pair of cherries on your first sheet and the next design unrolls on its own.

Open the mural folio to choose from 48 pictures in 12 volumes. Each mural holds 16,384 gems. Start with the closed eye of a woodland fox, or pick a corner of an underwater scene. Tap the picture to unfold a 64-gem patch. Your progress in each painting is saved on this device.

Touch a golden star gem to fill nearby spaces of the same colour. Use the dust you earn to unlock wider pens. Let your fairy place gems, or switch off automatic placement to finish the picture by hand. Your completed pictures go into your album.

name: Glintile - Mosaic Tile Studio
description:
Welcome to Glintile, your personal tactile mosaic tile workshop.

Step into a calming creative space where every touch places a beautifully rendered ceramic, terracotta, or glass tile. Designed from the ground up for tactile exploration on iOS, Glintile pairs the timeless beauty of Mediterranean mosaic art with thoughtful digital craftsmanship.

KEY FEATURES:

• ARTISAN TILE CANVAS
Compose intricate geometric patterns, organic flourishes, or minimalist tile studies on a dedicated drawing board. Experiment with customizable grid layouts, borders, and tessera densities.

• BESPOKE GLAZE PALETTES
Explore curated glaze collections inspired by historic pottery, sun-drenched terracotta, deep indigo glazes, and warm earth pigments. Blend custom hues and save personalized studio palettes.

• TACTILE TOUCH EXPERIENCE
Feel the gentle weight of each tile placement with responsive haptic feedback, giving your digital creations a grounded, handmade sensibility.

• LOCAL DRAFT RECOVERY & OFFLINE CRAFTING
Every brushstroke and tile arrangement is saved automatically to your device's local storage. Create freely without requiring any internet connection or cloud logins.

• CLEAN EXPORT & SHARING
Export high-resolution artwork or share project documents with fellow mosaic enthusiasts effortlessly.

Pure, relaxing, and distraction-free. No accounts, no subscriptions, and no paywalls. Just you and the art of the tile.

name: GlintLight: Surface Inspector
description:
GlintLight turns your iPhone screen into a light panel for inspecting glossy surfaces. The app draws high-contrast patterns; you hold the phone close to car paint, a piece of jewelry, varnished wood or a screen and look at the reflection. Wherever a stripe bends, ripples or breaks, there is a dent, a mark or a defect.

HOW TO USE IT
1. Pick a ready-made preset or build your own pattern in the editor.
2. Tap Start inspection: the screen stays on and, by default, goes to full brightness.
3. Hold the iPhone close to the surface and move it slowly while watching the reflected lines.

SIX PATTERN TYPES
• Stripes at any angle from 0 to 180°
• Grid
• Checkerboard
• Concentric rings
• Gradient
• Even work light with a warmth control for a softer tone

TUNE EVERY DETAIL
• Line width, spacing and edge softness
• Black and white, inverted or custom colors
• Animated sweep: the pattern glides across the screen on its own, at the speed you choose
• During inspection, pinch to change the width and twist with two fingers to rotate
• Lock gestures or hide every control; a double tap brings them back

READY-MADE PRESETS AND YOUR OWN
Start with Car dents, Jewelry, Miniature painting, Varnish / wood, Screen / glass or Custom. Save as many presets as you like under any name, and rename or delete them with a long press.

CAMERA WITH GRID
Capture the defect with a rule-of-thirds or fine grid overlay and the flashlight. The photo goes straight to your photo library, ready to send to a customer or attach to a quote.

WHO IT IS FOR
• Body shops, paintless dent repair and hail damage
• Polishing, ceramic coating and car detailing
• Buying and selling used cars
• Jewelers and metalsmiths
• Woodworking, varnish and furniture finishing
• Miniature painting and scale modeling
• Screen replacement and screen protector installation

PRIVACY FOR REAL
• Free, with no ads, no in-app purchases and no subscription
• No sign-in and no account
• Collects and shares no data at all
• Works fully offline
Your presets stay on your device and your photos stay in your photo library.

WHAT THE APP DOES NOT DO
GlintLight does not detect defects automatically. It provides the light and the patterns; you examine the surface yourself. Results are sharpest on smooth, reflective surfaces in a dim room.

Available in English and Portuguese, following your device language.

name: GLOW LAGREE CLUB
description:
Téléchargez notre application GLOW LAGREE CLUB  pour toujours avoir votre studio préféré dans votre poche !
À partir de notre application, vous pouvez planifier et programmer vos cours, consulter les horaires, vous inscrire, et bien plus encore !

name: GodTierComputer
description:
GodTierComputer is an offline, one-handed numerical conversion tool. Upon opening the app, you can instantly switch between formats—such as formal Chinese financial numerals (capitalized characters), standard Chinese number readings, Roman numerals, different numeral bases, and various financial calculations. Results can be copied, and past entries can be retrieved for further editing.

It is designed to support two primary workflows:

- Quick Conversions: Convert a number into a formal Chinese financial format, its written-out Chinese form, Roman numerals, or a different base—then simply copy the result and exit.
- Recurring Reconciliations: Perform tasks like calculating tax-inclusive prices, cost allocation, batch conversion to formal Chinese financial numerals, reverse-translating those numerals back into digits, or computing simple interest. Your calculations are saved in the app’s local history, allowing you to retrieve and modify them later.

The interface automatically adapts to your system’s light or dark mode. In financial results, the numerical values ​​are displayed in the app’s primary accent color, while formal Chinese financial numerals are rendered in a larger, bolded font.

name: Goldva
description:
WELCOME TO GOLDVA YOUR FREE-TO-PLAY GAME UNIVERSE!

Discover 12 original games, colorful characters, exciting challenges, and a vibrant neon arcade world — all in one place.

Meet VIREN, your cheerful guide through GOLDVA! Explore unique game worlds, enjoy playful animations, unlock achievements, and collect virtual rewards along the way.

12 ORIGINAL GAMES

Explore a diverse collection of experiences:

• Crystal Harmony — Discover crystal combinations and cascading surprises.
• Aqua Relics — Explore an underwater world of mysterious treasures.
• Skydrift Rush — Follow a thrilling sky adventure with rising multipliers.
• Neon Crossing — Take on colorful, step-by-step challenges.
• Night Leap — Explore a futuristic city filled with neon energy.
• Graffiti Scratch — Reveal hidden symbols on colorful scratch cards.
• Spire Climb — Build your way upward through exciting levels.
• Deep Catch — Dive into an imaginative underwater adventure.
• Ninja Clash — Discover dynamic combinations and special features.
• Hamstar Rally — Join a cheerful racing adventure.
• Limbo Gate — Choose your target multiplier and reveal the result.
• Chaos Crew — Explore a mysterious grid of hidden surprises.

FREE TO PLAY

Enjoy GOLDVA without deposits, subscriptions, or required purchases.

Receive free virtual Game Credits (GC), use them to participate in game rounds, and access free refills when eligible.

YOUR OWN ARCADE ADVENTURE

• Explore 12 unique games.
• Enjoy colorful comic-inspired artwork.
• Meet VIREN, the GOLDVA mascot.
• Discover animated game worlds.
• Collect achievements and virtual rewards.
• Track your game history and progress.
• Customize your experience through game settings.
• Enjoy a mobile-first portrait interface.

A WORLD FULL OF PERSONALITY

GOLDVA brings together expressive characters, original environments, glowing visual effects, and playful game mechanics.

Whether you're exploring crystals, racing through colorful landscapes, revealing hidden symbols, or discovering mysterious portals, there's always another world to explore.

IMPORTANT INFORMATION

GOLDVA is a free-to-play entertainment application featuring simulated games of chance.

All Game Credits (GC), rewards, and balances are entirely virtual and have no real-world monetary value.

There are no real-money wagers, cash withdrawals, deposits, or prizes redeemable for money.

Virtual rewards cannot be exchanged for real currency.

Welcome to GOLDVA. Play for fun, explore freely, and discover your next favorite game!

name: Golf Tracr
description:
Free to use. Pro is a one-time purchase — no subscription.

Golf Tracr draws a broadcast-style trace on your golf shots. Film a swing or import a clip, mark where the ball is at a few moments, and Golf Tracr draws the trace between them. Then style it and export a video you can share.

HOW IT WORKS
• Record a shot on iPhone or iPad, or import a video from Photos. On Mac, open a video or import from Photos.
• Trim the clip to the swing.
• Scrub frame by frame and mark Impact, Apex and Landing. The Apex is optional. Drag a handle to fine-tune; a magnifier helps you place it exactly.
• Shape the trace: height, bend and hang time.
• Pick a style, then adjust colour, width, glow and end taper.
• Add a scoreboard and a distance label, in metres or yards.
• Export at the full resolution of your video, up to 4K, and share it or save it to Photos.

TRY IT FIRST
A sample clip is built in, so you can try tracing without filming anything. No account needed.

FREE
• Record, import, library and trim
• Full manual tracing and editing
• Unlimited projects and unlimited exports
• Export at full resolution (up to 4K)
• 4 of 8 trace styles, plus the scoreboard and distance label
• Free exports carry a small Golf Tracr logo

PRO
• All 8 trace styles
• Turn the logo off
• Includes everything in Golf Tracr 1.x
• One-time purchase. No subscription.
• One purchase covers iPhone, iPad and Mac, and Family Sharing is supported.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your videos and projects stay on your device and nothing is uploaded.

Golf Tracr is available in English and Swedish.

Questions? golftracr@ahedr.com

name: GolfScorer: Scores & Insights
description:
Keep your golf rounds in one place, on your device.

GolfScoring combines 18-hole scorecards, shot records and performance insights. Choose from 664 published course routings with hole-by-hole yardages, or enter your own hole details. Additional directory entries, including both Shanghai Dongzhuang layouts, support manual entry. Record strokes and penalties, keep track of putts, and revisit earlier rounds.

See strokes gained against published historical PGA TOUR benchmarks. Your overall score and skill radar use measured shots across all your scorecards. Compare completed 18-hole rounds with published men's and women's professional, NCAA Division I, II, III and high-school tournament samples. Every sample names its event and source. Scratch and 15-handicap targets use the course ratings you enter for your tees.

Export JSON backups with the native Files picker and import your records on another GolfScoring device. Switch between English and Simplified Chinese at any time. Your scores are stored locally and the app works offline, without a required account.

For a quiet break between rounds, Golfer Life adds timed outings, postcards, training and home decoration. Its virtual coins and progress stay separate from your real scores.

Course yardages and benchmark coverage vary. Record known start and finish positions for shot analysis, and mark holes complete for round comparisons. Insights are not an official Handicap Index.

name: GoShift — Attendance & HR
description:
GoShift is the all-in-one workplace platform for GPS-verified attendance, HR management, payroll, and official team group chat — designed for both employees and managers in a single mobile app.

Register your company right from the app; once your account is activated, add your employees, branches and shifts.

For Employees ("My Attendance" mode):
• Foreground GPS check-in and check-out verified against your assigned branch radius (never tracks your location in the background).
• Clear view of today's shift, upcoming schedule, and daily/monthly attendance history.
• Submit and track leave requests and missed check-out corrections.
• View monthly payslips with full breakdowns of base pay, overtime, bonuses, and deductions.
• Collaborate in official company work groups with photo and document sharing.

For Company Owners, Admins & HR ("Management" mode inside the app):
• Live attendance dashboard, trends, and pending action counters.
• Smart anti-fraud Review Queue to inspect flagged check-ins and verification photos.
• Manage employees, branches (set coordinates instantly by pasting a Google Maps link), shifts, and leave requests on your phone.
• Run, recalculate, and finalize monthly payroll directly from mobile.
• Create and moderate official company chat groups by branch or department.
• One-tap switch between "Management" and "My attendance".

Privacy & Security:
• Foreground location only at the moment of check-in or check-out — zero background tracking.
• Strict per-company data isolation and HTTPS (TLS) encryption in transit.

name: Gospelly: Bible & Daily Verse
description:
Gospelly is a quiet, beautiful place to read the Bible and keep a daily habit. Open it for a single verse in the morning or for a whole chapter at night.

"Your word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my path." — Psalm 119:105

TODAY'S TIME WITH GOD
• Each day, a verse that writes itself in, a short reflection, and a prayer
• Bring one intention to God and find it in each day's prayer, seen only by you
• Touch and hold to pray, then Amen

SCROLL
• Scripture one verse at a time, swiped like a feed, on the painted skies
• Verses for what you are carrying: peace, hope, trust and seventeen more
• Double-tap to save, write a note, share, or open the verse in the Bible

THE WHOLE BIBLE
• The whole Bible in four translations: Berean Standard Bible (BSB), King James Version (KJV), World English Bible (WEB) and American Standard Version (ASV)
• Works offline. Every translation is on your iPhone
• Poetry set as poetry and translators' notes; section headings in the BSB; the words of Jesus in red if you like (BSB, KJV, WEB)
• Search the whole Bible by words, or type a reference such as "John 3:16"
• Choose your text size, line spacing, typeface and page colour
• Highlight, save, note and copy any verse; compare it in all four translations
• Share a verse as a picture on the morning sky

A VERSE EVERY DAY
• A new Verse of the Day, on your Home Screen and Lock Screen with the widget
• One gentle reminder a day at the time you choose
• A streak that walks from Eden to the New Jerusalem, and keeps every place you reach

READING PLANS
• 18 plans: Meeting Jesus, Peace for Anxious Hearts, The Gospel of John, Learning to Pray, Hope in Hard Seasons, Rest for the Weary, Advent, the New Testament in 90 days, the Bible in a year and others
• Every written plan has the passage, a short reflection, a question to sit with and a prayer
• Plans are self-paced. Miss a day and simply pick up where you left off

MADE TO BE CALM
• No ads and no noise
• No account and no sign-up
• Nothing you read, mark or write leaves your iPhone

GOSPELLY PREMIUM
Gospelly is a subscription app: Gospelly Premium unlocks everything above and below. Today's verse can be read without a subscription.
• The whole Bible in four translations, with search, highlights and saved verses
• Every reading plan
• A reflection and a prayer with each day's verse
• Notes on any verse
• Five highlight colours
• Any verse side by side in all four translations
• More page themes and verse picture styles

Two plans are available:
• Gospelly Premium Yearly: 1 year, with a 7-day free trial for new subscribers
• Gospelly Premium Monthly: 1 month

The price of each plan is shown in the app before you subscribe. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase, or at the end of the free trial if one applies. Your subscription renews automatically for the same period and price unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription at any time in your App Store account settings. Cancelling during the free trial means you are not charged.

The Bible translations in Gospelly are in the public domain. The reflections, prayers and plans are written for Gospelly as a companion to Scripture; they are not pastoral, medical or mental-health advice.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://gospelly.app/privacy

name: Gramma: NT Letter Search
description:
Gramma is a letter-pattern search tool for the Greek New Testament.

Search the original Greek text (SBLGNT) for any sequence of letters - a root, a word fragment, a recurring pattern - and see every match instantly, verse by verse, with the American Standard Version (1901) translation alongside it.

FEATURES
- Browse all 27 books of the New Testament in Greek and English, side by side
- Search by letter pattern across the entire Greek text
- Isopsephy: calculate the traditional Greek numeral value of any word, or search for words matching a given number
- Save your favorite verses and search results for quick access later
- Choose whether book references display in English or Greek
- Listen to any verse read aloud in Greek

SOURCES
Gramma uses the SBL Greek New Testament (SBLGNT) as its Greek source text and the public-domain American Standard Version (1901) for the English translation, including the standard set of disputed/variant passages found in most modern Bibles (clearly marked in the text).

PRIVACY
Gramma has no sign-in, no accounts, and no servers of its own. Your searches, saved verses, and settings all stay on your device. The app is supported by non-personalized banner ads; a one-time in-app purchase removes them permanently.

Gramma is built for students of Koine Greek, pastors, teachers, and anyone curious about the patterns hidden in the New Testament's original language.

If this still errors, it's likely a hidden/invisible character that snuck in during copy-paste rather than the visible text — try typing a short placeholder sentence first to confirm the field accepts plain text at all, then paste this in over it.

name: GroulvTosen
description:
GroulvTosen is a tile repeat maker. You draw one small square, and the app lays copies of it side by side so you can see the pattern it makes.

Start on the Draw tab. Pick a grid of 6, 8, 10 or 12 cells and paint with the pen, or tap an area with the fill tool. The ground colour works as an eraser. Undo, turn, flip and clear sit right under the canvas.

Below the canvas is a live repeat preview. Every cell you paint shows up across a strip of copies at once. That instant feedback is the quickest way to learn how a motif behaves when it repeats.

There are four symmetry modes. Straight puts every copy the same way up. Mirror flips neighbours, so a quarter of a flower drawn in one corner becomes whole flowers. Pinwheel turns four copies a quarter turn each. Half-drop slides every other column down by half a tile, the way wallpaper is often printed.

The Repeat tab shows the full wall in a silver frame with a holographic foil sheen. Tilt your phone and the foil shifts. Change how many tiles sit across, from two to eight, and tap the wall to replay its ripple.

Colour sets let you recolour without repainting. Each set has a ground and four inks. Six sets come built in, and you can make your own by tuning hue, strength and light for each slot.

Export as image turns any wall into a PNG up to 3072 pixels wide. Choose how many tiles across and down, then share it or save it to Photos.

The Gallery keeps the tiles you save. Sort them by date, name or symmetry, or shuffle the deck. Open one to rename it, change its mode or colours, duplicate it, export it, or take it back to Draw for more work.

Everything works offline. An anonymous daily backup is kept so you can restore your tiles later, and you can reset it all from Settings.

name: Grove: Study timer
description:
Ever timelapse yourself studying? It drains your battery, and let's be honest: you never watch the video back.

Meet Grove. Instead of filming hours of nothing, Grove clips only the moments you drift. After your session, you see those few seconds, tell Grove if you were really distracted, and learn what pulls you away. Then you grow from it, just like your trees.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Pick a subject and start a session.
2. Turn on Presence mode. Grove notices when you look away and clips just that moment.
3. Finish your session and review your drifts. Be honest: it counts.
4. Watch your tree grow, and your focus with it.

WHY YOU'LL STICK WITH IT
- Clips only the distractions, not hours of footage, and a Battery saver mode to go easy on your phone
- A tree for every subject, growing into your own grove
- One daily ring that changes color as you hit Level 1, 2 and 3
- Streaks with a weekly freeze, so one bad day doesn't wipe your progress
- Small wins and gentle haptics, so studying feels like progress
- Progress tab with study time next to scrolling time, a subject board and history

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Video is processed on your phone. The short drift clips are shown to you after the session and deleted when you tap Done. Nothing is uploaded. No account, no ads, no tracking.

Questions or ideas? Use Send Feedback inside the app.

name: Grumpy Fat Fish
description:
A fat fish with a very unfriendly stare is surrounded by an entire ocean of ink critters. It isn't running away. It's going to clear the screen.

HOW IT PLAYS
• Touch anywhere and drag to swim. Your weapons fire on their own.
• Popped ink critters drop XP. Every level-up is a pick of three: a new weapon, a stronger old one, or a passive.
• Meet the right conditions and weapons evolve: the Bubble Gun becomes a Bubble Storm, the Urchin Mine becomes an Urchin Cluster.
• The fatter you get, the meaner you look: Spiny Puffer, Hammerhead, Orca, Ancient Megalodon.
• Outlast the countdown to clear the level. Switch away and the game pauses itself.

10 CHAPTERS, 50 LEVELS
• Five levels per chapter, a boss at the end, and a new rule in every chapter.
• A swirling current pushes you around, the critters of Glutton Reef eat your XP gems, Clam Reef has an old clam to guard, and in the Midnight Zone you can only hit what is lit up. Keep diving, all the way down to The Descent.
• The deeper the level, the more shells a run pays.

GEAR
• Set your loadout before every level: pick a fish, equip your gear, and bring a few single-run consumables.
• Gear comes in builds (Barrage, Orbit, Shock, Big Bite and more) and powers up the weapons of its build.
• Gear is yours forever and can be starred up. Reaching a new chapter raises your gear slots and your star cap.
• 8 fish with their own personalities, 14 weapons with 14 evolutions, and permanent upgrades bought with shells.

SHELLS
• Shells are the only currency. Levels, trophies and the daily challenge all pay shells, and shells never expire.
• In a hurry? The shop sells shell packs and a one-time Starter Pack as optional in-app purchases. You can keep playing without buying anything.
• No ads. Nothing in the shop is random.

PLAY WITH PEACE OF MIND
• Fully offline single-player. No account, no internet connection needed.
• Play in English or Simplified Chinese.
• Your progress stays on your phone. The game collects no personal data.
• A codex, trophies, a daily challenge and your own records.
• Vibration, sound effects and battle music can each be switched on or off in Settings.
• After a run, send your result poster to a friend or save it to Photos.

The fatter the fish, the less you want to mess with it.

name: GTA VI Guide Map AI
description:
Find your next mission. Track down your next ride. Keep every discovery.

GTA VI Guide Map AI puts Leonida's map, mission guidance, cars, weapons and your own field journal together on iPhone and iPad. Find what you need, make a plan and get back to playing.

950 PLACES. YOUR NEXT STOP.
Explore 950 mapped locations across Leonida. Search by name, filter categories and open the map full screen. Zoom into roads and neighborhoods, read location details and mark places found. Use Hide found and Next unfound to work through your discoveries.

GET THROUGH THE MISSION
Follow a 22-mission story list, open available walkthroughs and check rewards and unlocks. Find help with early missions such as Gear Up, Just a Scratch, Lab Fees and Pipework, plus optional missions including Get Shirley's Rum and Steal the Scooter.

BUILD YOUR LEONIDA FIELD GUIDE
Browse 254 gameplay entries covering missions, game systems, weapons, vehicles, characters, trophies and clothing.
• Compare 18 weapon entries and check available in-game stats.
• Explore 11 vehicles, their driving stats and available acquisition notes.
• Get to know Jason, Lucia and the supporting cast.
• Browse 55 trophy entries and 51 clothing variants.
• Find guidance for saving, fast travel, character switching and the metal detector.

SEE WHAT YOU'RE LOOKING FOR
Open illustrated entries, enlarge photos and watch six included gameplay clips. Search starts with useful categories and examples, so there is something to explore before you type.

ASK YOUR NEXT QUESTION
Try questions such as "When does fast travel unlock?" or "Where can I find the Driveshaft Hustler?" Ask searches the installed guide locally and returns matching cards with clear facts, steps and links into the app. Supported devices can generate answers using Apple's on-device intelligence. Other devices show matching guide text. Your questions stay on your device. AI answers can contain mistakes.

KEEP YOUR PLACE
Bookmark a useful guide. Add a note beside a location. Write a reminder about tomorrow's mission. Your field journal brings notes, saved entries and found locations together, with filters to help you pick up where you left off.

PACKED FOR OFFLINE PLAY
The current guide, original images, six clips and detailed map tiles come bundled with the app. After unlocking access, use them offline. New guide editions can arrive in the app as coverage expands. Personal notes and progress stay on your device.

PREVIEW FREE. UNLOCK ONCE.
Explore the map overview and two closer zoom levels for free. Full Guide Unlock is a one-time $4.99 USD purchase for full map zoom, guide entries, search and the journal. Restore Purchases is available. No app account is required.

OPTIONAL LEONIDA CHAT
Ten guide answers are included free. Continue with unlimited guide answers through an optional monthly or yearly subscription. Guide access and chat plans are separate purchases.

Monthly $1.99 USD. Yearly $9.99 USD. Prices vary by region and are shown before purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the period ends. Renewal is charged within 24 hours before the next period. Manage or cancel in Apple account subscriptions.

Privacy

Support

name: HabitSentry
description:
HabitSentry helps you build the habits you care about, one day at a time.

Create a habit in seconds, tick it off when it's done, and watch your days fill in. Every habit gets its own card with a grid of days, so you can see at a glance how you're doing over the last few months.

BUILD HABITS YOUR WAY
• Repeat every day, on specific days of the week, a number of times a week or month, or every few days
• Give each habit a start date and, if you like, an end date: perfect for 30-day challenges
• Start from a suggestion such as Drink water, Read or Walk, or make your own
• Organise habits into categories such as Health, Fitness, Learning, Mindfulness and Productivity
• Change any habit later: its name, colour, days, reminder and dates

NEVER MISS A DAY
• Get a notification at each habit's reminder time
• Or have a habit ring like a Clock alarm, even in Silent mode and Focus
• Add a habit to Calendar as a repeating event with an alert. HabitSentry only asks to add events: it never reads your calendar

SEE YOUR PROGRESS
• Up to 140 days of history on every habit card
• Tap a habit for its details: this week, your best streak, total days done, the last 12 months and days done per month
• Tick off earlier days this week, or untick today with one tap
• Today's routine lists what's due today in order of time

HOME SCREEN WIDGETS
• Small and medium widgets for any habit you choose, with its days and a tick button
• A large widget with today's routine

MAKE IT YOURS
• Choose from a library of icons for activities, sports, food, art, finance and more
• Choose from 30 bright colours
• Three views: cards with the day grid, a compact list or today's routine
• Looks great in light and dark mode

UNLIMITED HABITS
HabitSentry is free for up to 3 habits. For unlimited habits, choose HabitSentry Monthly, an auto-renewing subscription, or HabitSentry Lifetime, a one-time purchase.

HabitSentry Monthly is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase and renews automatically each month unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in Settings › Apple Account › Subscriptions.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
Your habits are stored on your device and synced through your own iCloud account. No sign-up, no ads and no tracking.

name: Hadra Turizm
description:
Hadra Turizm, hac ve umre yolculuğunuzda ihtiyaç duyabileceğiniz rehber içeriklerini bir araya getirir.

• Umreye hazırlık ve uygulama aşamaları hakkında rehber yazılarını okuyun.
• Duaları Arapça metin, okunuş ve anlamlarıyla inceleyin.
• Mekke ve Medine’deki ziyaret yerlerini keşfedin.
• Yapılacaklar listenizi düzenleyin ve zikirmatik ile sayacınızı takip edin.
• Mekke namaz vakitlerini, sıkça sorulan soruları ve PDF rehberini görüntüleyin.
• Hadra Turizm’in iletişim kanallarına ulaşın.

Temel rehber içerikleri hesap açmadan kullanılabilir. Favoriler için isteğe bağlı hesap oluşturabilirsiniz. İçeriklerin yüklenmesi için internet bağlantısı gerekir. Rehber bilgiler ve namaz vakitleri için yerel yetkili kaynakların ve rehberinizin yönlendirmelerini de takip edin.

Destek: https://hadra.internetingucu.com/iletisim
Gizlilik Politikası: https://hadra.internetingucu.com/gizlilik
Hesap Silme: https://hadra.internetingucu.com/account-deletion.html
Web: https://hadraturizm.com/

name: Hafız Kardeşim
description:
Kur'an ezberini dinlet, hatanı anında gör, unutmadan tekrar et.

Hafız Kardeşim, hafızlık yapanlar ve sure ezberleyenler için hazırlandı. Ayetler gizli gelir; sen ezberden okursun, uygulama seni dinler. Doğru okuduğun kelimeler açılır, hatalı okuduğun kırmızı, atladığın turuncu işaretlenir.

EZBER DİNLET
• Sure (istediğin ayet aralığı), cüz ya da Medine mushafı sayfasına göre seç.
• Ayetleri tamamen gizle, yalnızca ilk harfini göster ya da silik göster.
• Takıldığında ipucu al, ayeti aç; gerekirse bir kelimeyi elle doğru say ya da geri al.
• Her dersin sonunda puanın, hatalı ve atlanan kelimeler tek tek.

KARDEŞİNE DİNLET
Hafızlıktaki gibi: telefonu yanındaki arkadaşın tutar, sen okursun; o her kelimede Doğru ya da Hata'ya basar. Mikrofon ve internet gerekmez.

HOCANA DİNLET
• Hocanı ya da öğrencini arkadaş listenden veya 6 haneli kodla ekle; karşı tarafa "Hoca olarak kabul ediyor musun?" diye sorulur.
• Canlı derste öğrenci kendi telefonunda gizli ayetlerle okur, hoca kendi telefonunda metni açık görür ve işaretler. İşaretler iki telefona anında gider.
• Hoca ödev verir, not yazar; her ders iki tarafın ders geçmişine kaydedilir.

TEKRAR TAKVİMİ
İyi okuduğun ayetler 1, 3, 7, 14, 30 ve 60 gün arayla yeniden karşına çıkar, zorlandıkların ertesi gün. Ana sayfadaki "Bugünün tekrarı" hepsini toplar.

DİNLE VE TEKRARLA
Sekiz kâriden birini seç (öğretici Husarî dahil). Her ayeti istediğin kadar tekrarlat, bölümü döngüye al, hızı ayarla. "Ardından ben tekrar edeyim" açıkken her ayetten sonra senin okuman için bekler. Metni gizleyerek dinleyip ezberleyebilir, Diyanet mealini açabilirsin.

SESLE BUL
Bir ayetten birkaç kelime oku; hangi sure ve ayet olduğunu bulsun, oradan ezbere ya da dinlemeye devam et.

İLERLEMEN
Günlük hedef, gün serisi, 16 haftalık çalışma takvimi, cüz cüz ezber haritası, zayıf ayetler, hata defteri ve tarih tarih bütün ders geçmişin.

AYRICA
Namaz vakitleri ve ezan bildirimi, kıble pusulası, açık ve koyu tema.

Ders geçmişin yalnızca telefonunda ve kendi Google Drive / iCloud yedeğinde durur. Uygulama ücretsizdir, reklam yoktur. Hatim Kardeşim üyeliğinle de giriş yapabilirsin.

Sesli tanıma telefonun konuşma tanıma hizmetini kullanır ve internet gerektirir; tane tane ve net okumak sonucu iyileştirir.

name: Hahi Sesli Chat-Voice Rooms
description:
Hahi Sesli Chat ile sesli odalarda yeni insanlarla tanış, sohbete katıl, eğlenceye ortak ol.

SESLİ ODALAR
Tek dokunuşla kendi odanı aç ya da açık bir odaya katıl. Her odada yayıncıyla birlikte 15 kişi mikrofonla konuşabilir. Koltuğa otur, mikrofonunu aç, muhabbete katıl. Odanın arka planını seç, odanı şifreyle kilitle.

SOHBET
Odadaki herkesle yazışarak sohbet et, emoji gönder, sevdiğin yayıncıları takip et. Takip ettiklerin oda açtığında haberin olsun.

HEDİYELER
Sevdiğin yayıncılara ve konuklara animasyonlu hediyeler gönder. Büyük hediyeler tüm odada tam ekran efektlerle görünür.

AİLE VE SIRALAMALAR
Bir aileye katıl ya da kendi aileni kur, birlikte puan topla. Günlük, haftalık ve aylık sıralamalarda yerini al; seviyeni yükselt, rozet ve rütbeler kazan.

MESAJLAŞMA VE PROFİL
Yeni arkadaşlarınla özel mesajlaş, sesli arama yap, profilini fotoğraflarınla kişiselleştir, gönderiler paylaş.

GÜVENLİ TOPLULUK
Odalar 7/24 moderasyon ekibimiz tarafından denetlenir. Uygunsuz içerik ve kullanıcıları tek dokunuşla şikâyet edebilir veya engelleyebilirsin.

Hahi Sesli Chat 18 yaş ve üzeri kullanıcılar içindir. Uygulama içi coin satın alımları isteğe bağlıdır.

Kullanım koşulları: https://www.hahivoice.com/kullanim-kosullari
Gizlilik politikası: https://www.hahivoice.com/gizlilik

name: Halfsky: Anime Card Roguelike
description:
The sky split between day and night, and living ink poured into the Sky Archive. Every turn can change your cards and the enemies' plans

Turn the sky to flip every two-sided card in your hand and every enemy intent at once. Choose when to turn, what to play, and which sky your foes will face. Climb a branching tower with six heroines, each with her own deck and a bond story to uncover

Build a collection of 200 cards, find keepsakes and tonics, and unlock more as you play. Take on Gentle mode, ten Eclipse tiers for each heroine, Daily Sky, Weekly Constellation, Custom Runs, or the endless Long Night

Play entirely offline, with no ads, purchases, or tracking

name: Ham Signaling
description:
Ham Signaling brings amateur radio's open digital modes to your iPhone and iPad. Hold the phone near your radio's speaker (or connect an audio cable) and it decodes what you hear on a live waterfall. Type a reply and it plays the tones back to your radio to transmit.

SIXTEEN OPEN MODES
FT8, FT4, FT2 and JS8 for weak-signal work. A WSPR propagation beacon. RTTY, JTTY, PSK31, PSK63, PSK125, Olivia and Contestia for keyboard contacts (FT2, JTTY and Contestia marked Experimental). Hellschreiber's painted text. APRS and AX.25 packet at 1200 baud. And Messaging: short text in any language (Arabic, Chinese, Japanese and more), shown in its own script on another Ham Signaling station; RTTY, JTTY, PSK, Olivia, Contestia and JS8 carry other scripts too. Switch on the modes you use; each opens its own console.

AUTOMATIC FT8, FT4 AND FT2
Choose Auto Hunt and the app answers a station calling you, or a CQ, and carries the exchange through the reports, RR73 and 73 into your log. Auto CQ calls CQ and works whoever answers. It works one station at a time, gives up on a station that stops replying, and stops rather than calling into a dead band. A Tx watchdog, as in WSJT-X, stops it after 6 minutes (you choose 1 to 60) without a tap; one tap resumes. Manual is the default.

A WATERFALL THAT TUNES
Tap a signal. On RTTY and PSK the decoder locks on and follows its drift; on Olivia and Contestia a tap within two tones of the lowest tone tunes it; on FT8, FT4, FT2, JS8 and JTTY the tap places your transmit offset in a clear spot. Eight palettes, and a zoom for the HF audio window.

TIMING YOU CAN SEE
Every FT8, FT4 and FT2 decode shows its report and DT (0.0 is on time, as in WSJT-X), and the app keeps its slot clock right (a phone's clock is often a second out) and says whose clock is off. Transmit timing is automatic: your tones leave half a second into the slot, with no delay to set.

YOUR LOG, IN THE STANDARD
FT8, FT4 and FT2 contacts log themselves. A bookmark logs RTTY, JTTY, PSK, Olivia, Contestia, Hellschreiber, JS8, packet and Messaging contacts by hand. Share the log as an ADIF file into Ham Logging or any other logger, written exactly as ADIF 3.1.8 defines it.

RIG CONTROL THAT NEVER TUNES
Optional CAT, marked Experimental, reads your radio's dial frequency and mode, so every contact carries its true frequency: over your network (Hamlib rigctld, FLRig, Icom WLAN, Kenwood KNS, Elecraft K4, TCI, the FlexRadio API or a serial-over-TCP bridge) or over Bluetooth LE (the IC-705, or a Bluetooth LE serial adapter). 109 radios by name plus five generic families, each marked VERIFIED (commands checked against the maker's documentation and reference software) or PER-SPEC (built to the published command set); neither is a bench test. It never changes your frequency, mode or split, and keys PTT only if you choose CAT keying, confirmed by the radio; by default your radio's VOX or your hand keys it.

SAFE ON THE AIR
Send becomes Stop TX while you transmit. Calls, alarms and headphone or Bluetooth changes stop a transmission and say why; with CAT keying, nothing automatic goes out unkeyed.

KEEPS LISTENING
Decoding carries on when you switch to another app, so a long JS8 or packet session keeps its traffic. Switch it off in Settings and the app stops listening the moment you leave it.

BUILT TO BE LEARNED
Every mode has a built-in tutorial: how to use it, best practice and examples. Light and dark themes, adjustable font size, weekly tips and a full user manual.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no servers, no analytics, no ads. Its one internet use, a time check, carries nothing about you. Audio is decoded on the fly and never recorded. Your callsign, grid and log stay on your device until you share them.

Every mode here is open: no proprietary codecs and no licensing walls. A valid amateur radio licence is required to transmit; you operate within your own privileges.

name: Handwriting: Practice Sheets
description:
Turn a sentence you want to practice into a one-page English handwriting worksheet. Start with a focused exercise or type your own text, then make a sheet you can trace and copy on paper.

1. Practice a specific skill. Choose from over 180 built-in exercises for letters, sentences, numbers, and everyday notes, including cursive joins, word spacing, and punctuation. Filter by topic or handwriting style.

2. Make the same text work for different kinds of practice. Try eight fonts across print, cursive, and everyday handwriting. Choose Trace, Trace & Copy, or Model & Copy to arrange examples, lighter tracing text, and blank writing lines on a four-line guide.

3. Preview the full A4 page before export. Save or share a PNG for printing, and reopen previously generated custom sheets from your on-device creation history to export them again.

name: Hannun Calendar
description:
Hannun Calendar shows the Calendar and Reminders already on your iPhone, iPad or Mac in a clear month view and Home Screen widgets. Events from every account on your device — iCloud, Google and more — appear together.

■ The whole month at a glance
· Multi-day events are drawn as connected bars, and holidays show in red.
· Optional lunar dates (1st & 15th, or every day).
· Start the week on Sunday or Monday.

■ Right at your fingertips
· Tap a date to open that day's events and tasks, then tap + to add.
· Copy an event to other days, or turn an event into a task (and back).
· Cancel an event without deleting it — its title is kept with a strike-through.
· Create lunar-calendar repeating events (e.g. a lunar birthday every year).

■ Tasks and D-days
· See Reminders in the Tasks tab and on the calendar; tap the circle to complete.
· Turn on D-day for an event to see days left (D-) or days since (D+) in the D-day tab and widgets.

■ Widgets
· Month, Events, Today, Tasks and D-day widgets (Home Screen on iPhone/iPad, desktop and Notification Center on Mac)
· Complete tasks right from the widget; Lock Screen widgets on iPhone.

■ Places on a map
· Events with a location show it on Apple Maps.

■ Privacy
· Events and tasks are read and written only on your device. There is no developer server, and the developer receives nothing.
· No ads, no analytics.

name: Harbor Hidden Battle: Awaken
description:
Make the harbor a little brighter, one delivery at a time.

Hop straight into your little yellow van and explore a lively 3D coastal town. Rescue driftwood, bright alloy, sea glass and copper cable, then turn them into repairs for your neighbors.

DRIVE YOUR OWN ROUTE
Steer with the thumb stick, orbit the camera to look around corners, and follow your scout toward useful salvage. Stop beside a pile and hold WORK to gather. Bring the right materials to a house and watch a repair come together.

SMALL JOBS, SATISFYING CHOICES
Complete three commissions to finish a shift. Cargo space, tool temperature and changing tides keep each route interesting. Inland materials replenish, spare cargo can be traded, and a free tow gets you out of a tight corner.

BUILD A BETTER LITTLE VAN
Improve your cargo rails, quiet motor, salvage arm and cooler. Craft permanent fittings from rescued materials and bring a friendly mechanical companion along for the ride.

A TOWN THAT REMEMBERS
Restore 24 neighbors across four districts. Earn reputation to open new commission boards, inspect the full town chart, discover materials and keep your best shifts in a local logbook.

Made for landscape play, with procedural 3D scenery, original synthesized sounds and adjustable controls.

name: HarborDash
description:
Harbor Dash is a cartoon-style, vertical-screen game designed for one-handed play. You navigate a small boat, dodging reefs, icebergs, and whirlpools while collecting gold coins and sinking pirate ships with cannon fire. The game features 12 levels—with up to 3 stars to earn in each—as well as an endless mode, and offers controls via either dragging or tilting your phone.
Set sail in Harbor Dash, a fast and friendly cartoon ship adventure!

Steer your little red boat through rocky straits, frozen bays and swirling whirlpools. Grab shiny coins, repair your hull with hearts, and blast the sneaky pirates before they sink you!

FEATURES
• 12 handcrafted levels – sail distances, collect treasure or sink pirate fleets
• Earn up to 3 stars per level by keeping your ship safe
• Endless Mode – how far can you go? Beat your best score!
• Simple one-thumb controls – drag to steer, tap to fire, or tilt your phone
• Cute cartoon art, cheerful music and fun sound effects
• Six sea hazards: rocks, icebergs, whirlpools, pirate ships and their cannonballs
• Captain’s Log tracks your voyages, coins and pirates sunk

Easy to learn, hard to put down. All aboard!

name: Haulers: Cozy Camp Builder
description:
Chop. Carry. Build.

Swing your axe, stack the loot on your back and drop it on a pad: a sawmill builds itself in front of you. Feed it logs and it makes planks. Sell at your stall, scoop up the cash, and build the next thing.

Every unlock is something new to do, not a bigger number:
• Raise sheep, drain the fens for peat, and open the highlands
• Fish the cove, salvage wrecks after a storm and crack oysters for pearls
• Put on shows in town, run caravans to distant markets and fill orders
• Light the catacombs and fight your way down the deep mine
• Build the Great Ship and sail to new islands, each with a good you can't get anywhere else

No waiting. Nothing in Haulers asks you to come back in four hours: you build it, it's built.

Play with friends
• Visit other players' camps and leave a gift
• Team up with two friends to raid the Undervault
• Weekly leaderboards for the minigames
