Your camp keeps earning while you're away, and with a free account it follows you to any phone.

Prefer it calm? Peaceful mode turns off everything that fights back.

Made by a small studio, Squared Games. New districts, events and islands arrive often, straight into the game.

name: Have & Seek
description:
Find what you need nearby, or offer something you have. Have & Seek is a free local classifieds app for buying and selling items, finding free items, and hiring local services in the United States.

• Post a Listing to offer an item or service. Add photos, a price or rate, and a location.
• Start a Quest to tell people what you’re looking for. Members can respond directly, even without a Listing.
• Browse by area or on the map. Open posts, save the ones you want to revisit, and message members to work out the details.

You can browse without an account. Sign in to post, save, or message.

name: Heartpad: Feel a Heartbeat
description:
Some days a message is too much and silence is too little. Heartpad sends a heartbeat.

Tap the heart and your person feels a soft lub-dub in their hand, on their wrist, or under their fingertip on a MacBook trackpad. No typing, no reply needed. Just "I'm thinking of you", felt.

MADE FOR TWO
• Pair with a six-letter code or a QR code. No account, no email, no password.
• One purchase covers both of you. Your person joins free.
• Add as many people as you like: partner, best friend, mum, kids away at college.

FEEL IT, DON'T READ IT
• A real heartbeat rhythm, played with the iPhone's haptic engine.
• Pick a pattern: a heartbeat, a tap, or a double tap.
• Record your own rhythm by tapping it out, and they feel exactly that.

EVERYWHERE THEY ARE
• iPhone: feel it in your hand, or get a gentle notification when the app is closed.
• Apple Watch: tap the heart on your wrist, or double-tap your fingers to send one back.
• Mac: the heartbeat plays on the trackpad the moment your finger touches it.
• Widgets and Control Center: send a heartbeat without opening the app.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Nothing to read, so nothing to leak. There is no chat and no history on our servers.
• Each heartbeat is deleted as soon as it is delivered.
• No ads, no tracking, no contacts, no location.

ONE TIME, NO SUBSCRIPTION
Joining someone's code is free forever. Creating codes is a single purchase: Heartpad for Two. Buy once, keep it.

Questions? hello@heartpad.app

name: Heaven's Phone
description:
HEAVEN'S PHONE
Faith is always within reach.

What if finding comfort, hope, and encouragement from God's Word were as simple as making a phone call?

Welcome to Heaven's Phone, a unique Christian Bible and prayer companion designed to bring Scripture into your everyday life.

DIAL GOD'S WORD

Experience Scripture in an entirely new way! Use our familiar telephone-style keypad to dial one of 120 Scripture contacts.

Whether you're feeling afraid, lonely, discouraged, overwhelmed, or simply seeking guidance, find a Bible passage selected for life's different moments.

Choose a contact, make a simulated Scripture call, and hear God's Word read aloud.

THE COMPLETE HOLY BIBLE

Explore all 66 books of the World English Bible, available for offline reading.

• Read Scripture anywhere, even without internet access.
• Listen as Bible chapters are read aloud.
• Highlight meaningful verses.
• Share favorite passages.
• Return to your previous reading position.

PEACEFUL SCRIPTURE LISTENING

Make your time in God's Word even more meaningful with:

• Different narrator voices available on your device.
• Adjustable narration speed.
• Gentle rain and peaceful dripping sounds.
• Ocean waves rolling onto the shore.
• Beautiful birdsong and soft breezes.
• Calming instrumental music.

YOUR PERSONAL PRAYER JOURNAL

Keep your conversations with God close to your heart.

Write and save personal prayers, revisit meaningful moments, and reflect on your spiritual journey.

FIND HOPE FOR EVERY SEASON

Heaven's Phone brings together Scripture, prayer, and encouragement in one welcoming place.

Save favorite passages, explore Scripture for specific situations, and make Bible reading part of your everyday routine.

Whether you're beginning your journey of faith or have spent a lifetime walking with Christ, Heaven's Phone is here to help you stay connected to God's Word.

No actual phone calls are placed. Some Scripture requests may require an internet connection.

HEAVEN'S PHONE
Faith is always within reach.

name: Heavy Sleepers Alarm Clock
description:
Can't wake up with a normal alarm? Heavy Sleepers Alarm won't stop until your brain is awake. Pick a challenge for each alarm and the only way to turn it off is to finish it.

WAKE-UP CHALLENGES
• Maths: solve a few sums, from easy to hard
• Rewrite: type a line of text exactly
• Shake: shake your iPhone for a set number of seconds
• Barcode: get up and scan a code in another room
• Step Counter: walk a number of steps
• Motivation: watch your own wake-up video

42 GAMES WITH 4 DIFFICULTY LEVELS
Sudoku, Lights Out, 2048, Slide Tile, Memory, Traffic Light, Cross Sums, MineField, Code Break, Balance Scale, Fruit Slice, Maze, Tilt Jump, Pipe Connect, Flow Connect, Color Tube, Tower of Hanoi, Bridges, Block Drop, Order, Unblock, Shape Sequence, Cup Shuffle, Odd One Out, Stack Tower, Ball Catch, Sort Rush, Pop Balloon, Flappy Flight, Sky Shooter, Ball Blast, Checkers, Snake & Ladder, Dots & Boxes, Number Capture, Ludo, Mahjong, Pyramid, Solitaire, FreeCell, Atom Shell and Circuit Lock. Combine several challenges on one alarm.

MADE FOR HEAVY SLEEPERS
• Wake-Up Check: a few minutes after you dismiss, confirm you're still up or the alarm rings again
• Snooze with a limit, so you can't snooze forever
• Gentle wake-up: the volume rises slowly
• Auto silence after a time you choose
• Loud, music and classic tones, or your own audio file
• On iOS 26 and later, alarms ring like the Clock app, even in Silent mode and during a Focus
• A simple setup guide so your alarms ring on time, every time

PRO
The free version includes the everyday challenges and shows ads. Pro unlocks all 42 games and removes every ad with one payment. No subscription.

NO ACCOUNT NEEDED
Your alarms and settings stay on your iPhone.

name: HelloRacket
description:
HelloRacket keeps every racket you own, and every string job it has had, in one place.

YOUR RACKET WALL
• Add rackets from a catalog of popular racket models, or enter your own.
• See each racket in 3D with its current string, tension and grip.
• Arrange your wall and share it with friends through a link.

STRINGING RECORDS
• Log string, tension, pattern and date for every restring.
• See how long the current strings have been in and plan the next job.
• Measure string tension by tapping the string bed: the sound is analysed on your phone and never uploaded.

RACKET ID (NFC)
• Tap a HelloRacket NFC tag on the racket throat to open that racket's record instantly.
• Stringers can scan the tag to see the setup you asked for.

FOR STRINGERS
• Receive stringing requests with the player's preferred setup.
• Record each job and notify the player when the racket is ready for pickup.

ACCOUNT AND PRIVACY
• Sign in with Apple, Google or email; your data syncs across iPhone, Android and the web.
• Export your data or delete your account at any time from the Privacy Center.
• Push notifications only for your own rackets and stringing orders, never for promotions.

Available in English, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Japanese, Korean, Thai, French, German and Spanish.

name: Helm Pass
description:
Helm Pass prepares you for the Croatian boat licence exam, category B, on iPhone and iPad: all study material free, oral exam practice, a mock exam by area and chart tasks. Offline, no ads, no subscription.

The exam is oral, in front of a board, with a chart task and knots. Helm Pass practises exactly that: the question as the board asks it, you answer out loud, reveal what a good answer holds and mark whether you knew it.

EVERYTHING FOR THE EXAM, IN YOUR POCKET

• All study material, free: compass, navigation, charts, knots with photos and video, engine, the sea, rules and weather, the rules of the road and radio. In Croatian, German and English.
• Oral practice, like the board: the question as the board asks it. Answer out loud, reveal what a good answer holds and mark yourself. What you did not know comes back tomorrow.
• Mock exam by area: area by area, then the chart task and knots. At the end, a result for each area and a review of your wrong answers.
• Chart tasks: 16 tasks of five kinds on a practice chart: position, course and distance, compass course, a fix from two bearings, dead reckoning. Checked step by step.
• 300 questions, each explained: every answer has an explanation. Questions you keep missing come back more often, up to your exam date.
• Offline, for everyone: works without internet and nothing leaves your phone. Light, dark and black looks, larger text, screen reader labels.

FREE
• All study material, all eight topics
• 15 sample questions, each explained
• Croatian, German and English

PRO
• All 300 questions with explanations
• Oral practice like the board
• Mock exam by area, with a result for each
• 16 chart tasks, checked step by step
• Review of what you keep missing, up to the exam date

Pay once, yours for good. No subscription, no ads, no account.

NOTHING LEAVES YOUR PHONE
No ads, no tracking, no analytics, no account, no internet.

IS HELM PASS AN OFFICIAL APP?
No. Helm Pass is an independent study aid. It is not linked to the ministry or any harbour master's office and issues no licences. You take the exam in front of a harbour master's board.

A wrong question, an outdated rule, a bug in the app or an idea: write to support@zanoski.com.

Take the helm with Helm Pass.

name: Hetori
description: Make notes for your work: capture an order, add its materials and come back when it is time to work

name: Hide & Stitch: Leather Craft
description:
Leather is bought by the hide and cut once. Hide & Stitch works out the four numbers you need before the knife goes in, and then keeps the project so you still know, three weeks later, which leather it was.

Thickness
Ounces, millimetres and inches, converted in both directions. One ounce is a sixty-fourth of an inch, which is 0.396875 mm — the app carries that figure, not a rounded one. The reference table lists fourteen thicknesses and what each is normally used for, so you can go the other way too: you know it is a belt, you want to know which weight to order.

How much leather to buy
Enter the area of your pattern and a waste allowance. You get the area to buy. Give the average area of the hides your supplier sells and you also get how many hides that is — the question you actually have to answer when ordering.

Thread for a saddle stitch
Number of holes, stitch length, and the multiplier: three for thin leather, four for thick. You get the length to cut, safety margin included. Running out of thread two holes from the end is a particular kind of annoying.

Straps and laces
How many straps you can cut from a piece, straight or in a spiral, with the blade kerf taken into account. The spiral answer is the one nobody works out in their head, and it is often the difference between one lace and none.

The project notebook
A project keeps its name, the leather you used, your calculations, your notes, where you are, and photos. Photos are copied into the app, so a project keeps its pictures even if you later clear your camera roll.

Units follow your phone. If it is set to imperial, you work in inches and square feet; if metric, in millimetres and square decimetres. Available in 25 languages, Arabic and Hebrew included, laid out right to left.

Your projects and photos never leave your phone. There is no account, no sign-in and no server for your data: projects and photos stay on the device, and deleting the app deletes them. Only the purchase and the subscription check go through the network.

Free, for good: thread length, the thickness table and the project notebook.
Subscription: hide area and hides to buy, straps and laces.

Free period: 14 days from first launch, with nothing to subscribe to. After that, the features above require Hide & Stitch Pro, an auto-renewable subscription, monthly or yearly, at the price shown in the app before any purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple account when you confirm. It renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; you can manage or cancel it at any time in your Apple account settings.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://sogerg.github.io/hide-and-stitch-legal/

name: Hivebook
description:
Hivebook is a yard notebook for a handful of hives. Each hive card shows the spot, the queen year you stored, and how many days have passed since the latest inspection. The dot uses the five-year queen-mark cycle: years ending 1 or 6 white, 2 or 7 yellow, 3 or 8 red, 4 or 9 green, and 5 or 0 blue. You can type a year and copy it onto a hive. The app does not see the queen.

An inspection stores whether the queen was seen, brood frames, honey frames, a temperament word, and an optional mite sample. Mites per 100 bees is mites divided by bees in the sample, times 100. A result at or above 3 per 100 is labeled as a prompt to reread local guidance. It is not a diagnosis and not a product recommendation. Follow-up rows are a name, a start date, and a number of days. The next look is the sum. Due means that date is today or earlier.

Honey rows add the pounds you typed. This year is a separate total. Six season notes can be ticked. They are reminders to write something down, not a work order. Share on a hive builds text from the saved numbers and opens the system sheet. Hivebook does not identify a colony from a photo, recommend a treatment, or sync an account. The file stays on this phone. Restore sample replaces it with three hives, three visits, two follow-ups, and two honey rows dated from today.

name: HlNGE：デートアシスタント
description:
自分らしさを大切にした、魅力的で分かりやすいデートプロフィールを作成しましょう。このアプリでは、写真の整理、自己紹介文の作成、興味・関心の選択ができ、ほかのマッチングアプリで使用する前にプロフィール全体を確認できます。

主な機能
- ステップごとにプロフィールを作成 - ゼロから始めることも、前回の編集内容から再開することもできます
- 写真とテキストを整理 - 順番を変更したり、メイン写真を試したり、プロフィール全体の仕上がりを確認できます
- 文章作成をサポート - 書き出しのヒント、回答例、自分らしい表現を見つけるためのアイデアを利用できます
- 質問と回答のライブラリ - 豊富な選択肢から選び、自分の雰囲気に合わせてカスタマイズできます
- サンプルとアドバイス - プロフィール例、おすすめのヒント、プライバシーに関するアドバイスを参考にできます
こんな方におすすめ
- じっくり考えて、自然で魅力的なデートプロフィールを作りたい方
- ほかのアプリに公開する前に、文章や写真を準備しておきたい方
- 短いバージョンや詳細なバージョンなど、複数のプロフィールを作成したい方
- 自分らしさを失わずに、より上手に自分を表現するアイデアが欲しい方
このアプリを選ぶ理由

一般的なマッチングアプリとは異なり、このアプリは自分のプロフィールを落ち着いて準備することに重点を置いています。複数のプロフィールを端末に保存し、いつでも編集、複製、名前の変更ができ、前回の続きから再開できます。ユーザーアカウントは不要で、すべてのデータは端末内に保存されます。サンプルプロフィール、質問、回答、アドバイス、テンプレートにもオフラインでアクセスできます。

また、大きく見やすい写真、読みやすいテキスト、シンプルで落ち着いたモダンなデザインを採用しています。最終確認画面では、不足している項目や、さらに充実させられる部分、公開前に見直したい内容を確認できます。

今すぐ始めて、あなたらしさが伝わる自己紹介を作りましょう。最初のプロフィールを作成し、サンプルを試しながら、より充実した自然で共有しやすいプロフィールに仕上げましょう。

name: HollyFold--Snug Parcel Fit
description:
Astu sisään jouluruusujen juurien keskelle rakennettuun lahjapuotiin, jossa erikoisen muotoiset paketit odottavat vihreän hatun lierillä.

Nosta lahja, käännä sitä lumihiutalekoristeisilla korvalapuilla ja sovita jokainen pala avoimeen puulaatikkoon. Sinetit osoittavat, minkä palan tulee peittää niiden merkki. Kun pelilauta on täynnä, vedä punaiset nauhat yhteen ja viimeistele paketti.

Neljä pakkaustehtävien sarjaa johdattavat takkatulen äärellä olevalta työpöydältä lähetyshyllylle. Kerää jouluruususinet­tejä ratkaisemalla paketteja, avaa rauhallisia työpajamaisemia ja palaa milloin tahansa hiomaan asettelujasi.

Ei kiirettä mittaavia kelloja eikä sekavia välilehtiä – vain rauhallinen pakkauspöytä, pehmeät ommellut ohjaimet ja ilo siitä, kun jokainen muoto löytää viimein paikkansa.

name: Hook Tally
description:
Hook Tally keeps a local count of what is left on three convenience-store fixtures: the cooler, the snack rack, and the noodle shelf.

Drag a blank tag onto a rail and write the goods. Spin the cube on that tag, one unit at a time, from zero through twelve. An unset cube shows a dash until you spin it.

Open the shift to see each rail. Stocked means every counted tag is at least two. Short means a counted tag is one or zero. Bare means nothing is hung. Not counted means the tags are still unset. Units left are the sum of the counted tags.

Nothing is priced, paid, or sent off the iPhone. Uninstalling the app removes the tally.

name: Hortis
description:
Know what to sow, what needs attention today, and what can grow after the harvest. Hortis helps home vegetable growers make those decisions from the first planting through the last picking. It fits a first raised bed, a few backyard rows, or a small allotment.
Give every crop a place and a plan
Organize your beds by planting space and see what is growing where. Use the frost dates you enter to plan sowing and transplanting, follow estimated harvest windows, and record when each milestone actually happens.
Keep up with garden work when plans change
Open Today to see tasks that need attention, from checking soil to picking vegetables. Turn on reminders in My Garden if you want a prompt. If you record heavy rain that affects a planned sowing, compare the proposed date and estimated harvest window before deciding whether to move it.
Put a cleared row back to work
After a harvest, use Next Crop to see which vegetables could mature before the fall frost date you entered. Compare sowing and harvest windows and check crop rotation notes before adding a follow-up crop.
Remember what worked
Log watering, soil checks, and harvests as you work. Add photos or voice notes to capture what you observed, then find those details again by bed, date, or activity in Field Notes. Export journal records as a CSV when you want a copy.
Planting and harvest windows are estimates based on the crop and the dates and observations you enter.

name: Hourlo
description:
Hourlo is a freelance time tracker. Run a timer against a project or log time by hand, see your billable hours and what is still unbilled for each client, and turn unbilled work into invoice summaries. Time placed on an invoice is marked invoiced, so it can't be billed twice.

CLIENTS AND PROJECTS
• Clients with billing email, currency, default hourly rate and notes; archive old clients
• Projects with an optional rate override, a colour and an optional hours budget

TIMER
• Start and stop with one tap; one timer runs at a time
• It keeps running if you close the app
• Switch project mid-session, edit the note, toggle billable or discard
• A live estimate of the billed amount

MANUAL ENTRIES
• Start and end times, or a start time and duration, including entries that cross midnight
• Notes and billable on or off

ROUNDING
Bill exact time or round to 6 or 15 minutes, up or to the nearest step. Your tracked time is never changed.

REPORTS
• Hours per day for any week, billable and non-billable
• Billable value per currency and unbilled totals per client
• A searchable entry log with filters

INVOICES
• Pick a client and choose which unbilled entries to include
• Invoice number with prefix and automatic numbering, issue date, tax, due days and notes
• A live preview grouped by project with subtotal, tax and total
• Status: Draft, Sent or Paid
• Share or copy the invoice as text
• Deleting an invoice releases its entries

BILLING SETTINGS
Rounding, default currency, rate and tax, invoice prefix and next number, due days, business name and week start.

WORKS OFFLINE, ACCOUNT OPTIONAL
Hourlo works fully offline and never asks you to sign up. Tap "Continue as guest" on the welcome screen and every feature is available straight away, with your clients, time and invoices saved on this device.
If you would like a backup, create a free account with your email address and a password. Your data then syncs securely so you can restore it on another iPhone or iPad, and anything you made as a guest is merged into your account. You can delete your account and its backup at any time from Settings.

PRIVATE, FREE AND SIMPLE
• Completely free: no ads, no in-app purchases, no subscriptions
• No tracking and no analytics; your data is never shared with other users
• Export all of your data as JSON from Settings whenever you like
• Currency follows your device's region and can be changed in Settings
• Light and dark mode, with haptics you can switch off
• Designed for landscape on iPhone and iPad (iOS 15 or later)

name: How Well Do You Know Me - Test
description:
How well do your friends really know you? Find out with a fun 2-player party quiz for best friends, couples and family.

HOW IT WORKS
• Answer questions about yourself
• Pass the phone (no peeking!)
• Your friend guesses your answers
• See your score, then swap and play again

TWO WAYS TO PLAY
How Well Do You Know Me? is the classic best friend test. Score your friendship from "Basically strangers" all the way to "Actual mind readers".

Who's Who? is inspired by the couples trend. You both secretly pick who fits each prompt, like "Who said I love you first?" or "Who steals the covers?", then reveal your answers together. Do you agree, or is it time to argue it out?

340+ QUESTIONS
• Best Friends, Couples, Family and Deep Questions decks
• The Classics, Relationship Dynamics, Daily Habits & Chaos and Bestie Edition decks for Who's Who?
• Bold mode adds Confessions and No Filter: cheeky questions about secrets, fibs and embarrassing moments
• Every round picks fresh questions, with no repeats until you've played them all

MAKE IT PERSONAL
Add your own wildcard question at the end of a round. Inside jokes welcome.

SHARE YOUR SCORE
Show off your result with a shareable score card.

PLAY ANYWHERE
One phone, two players. No sign up, no accounts and no ads. Perfect for sleepovers, date nights, road trips and parties.

name: Hungry Dino: Snack Battle
description:
Your dino is lost and very hungry. Help it eat its way home!

Hungry Dino is a fast 3D arcade game for quick reflexes. Snackies roll across the arena, a rival dino waits on the other side, and the first one to reach the goal score wins. Slide to move, tap BITE to chomp – easy to learn, hard to master.

FOUR WORLDS, 32 LEVELS
• Forest – spinning tables and bouncy mushrooms
• Frostland – icy rinks where every snack keeps sliding
• Desert – sand that slows the snacks down and tunnels that throw them back up
• Space – snacks that jump from platform to platform in low gravity
Every world ends with a Boss match over three rounds.

OUTSMART YOUR RIVAL
• Land hits in a row for a COMBO and score more with every bite
• Fill up your FIRE and toast the rival dino for a moment – but watch out, it can do the same to you!
• Use NECK for a long bite and grab the snack before your rival does
• Dodge, time your bites and keep an eye on the score bar

PLAY WITH FRIENDS
• Face-Off: two players, one device – sit face to face and chomp for the win
• Challenge: finish a race, share your code, and your friend plays exactly the same match. Who scores more?

COLLECT AND COME BACK
• Earn stars on every level
• Unlock costumes: hats, a crown, glasses, a jetpack and more
• Daily rewards for a 7-day streak

No account, no sign-up. Your progress stays on your device. The game is free to play and shows ads. A one-time "No Ads" purchase removes the ads between levels.

name: HurdThyzel
description:
HurdThyzel is a logbook for the utility meters in your home. You copy the counter from the meter face; the app does the arithmetic.

WHAT IT CALCULATES
Each pair of readings is treated as a span. The difference is spread evenly over the hours between them and assigned to the calendar days it touches. Noon Monday to noon Wednesday gives Monday half a share, Tuesday a full one and Wednesday half. Days that no reading span covers stay blank instead of showing a false zero.

METERS WITH UNITS
Add electricity, water, gas, or heat and other counters. Pick a suggested unit (kWh, MWh, m³, L, gal, ft³, therm, GJ) or type your own. Each meter keeps its own price per unit.

QUICK READING ENTRY
One large number field, one button. The previous value is shown as you type, together with the change since then and a rough per-day figure. Need to record a reading from yesterday evening? Step the time back by days or hours. A value lower than the last one is flagged and, if you confirm, logged as a meter swap or rollover so it counts as zero use rather than a negative spike.

DAILY AVERAGE USAGE
Bars for the last 7, 14 or 30 days, printed in two overlapping inks. Tap or drag across the bars to read a single day. A dashed line marks the average, with total and peak day underneath.

COST ESTIMATE AT YOUR OWN RATE
Enter the unit price from your bill and the app shows cost per day, cost for the visible days and a 30-day projection. You can also try a different price on the Usage screen before saving it to the meter. Estimates cover the unit price only; standing charges and taxes are not included.

MONTH COMPARISON
This month and last month side by side, compared by average per covered day so a half-finished month is measured fairly. The percentage change is shown in plain figures, followed by a six-month strip of totals.

DESIGN
Risograph print look: pink and teal overprint, paper grain and misregistered headings. Sections switch with a hanging pull cord at the bottom; tug it to move on, or tap a section name.

DATA AND BACKUP
Everything is stored on the phone and works fully offline. Changes go in small batches to an anonymous backup tied to a random device ID. No account, and no name, email or location is asked for; meter names and notes you type are part of the backup. Settings has Restore from backup and Reset my data, which clears the phone and the backup copy.

HurdThyzel does not connect to smart meters or utility companies. It works with the numbers you read yourself.

name: Hureya
description:
Keep the words—and the moments behind them.

Hureya is a personal vocabulary notebook for language learners, travelers, and people using another language at work. Collect expressions you encounter and give them meaning through your own notes.

• Save words, phrases, and sentences with your own meanings and examples.
• Add a photo or a short voice note to preserve the context.
• Organize by topic and find expressions with search and filters.
• Review with cards, reveal your notes, and mark expressions Again or Familiar.
• Create printable PDF sheets with separate prompts and answers.

No account required. Your collection is stored locally in the app, with no cloud sync.

English interface. Expression categories: English, Spanish, French, German, and Japanese. All vocabulary content is entered by you.

name: Hylly
description:
Hylly is a quiet place for one meaningful question a day.

Take a moment to pause, think, and write what feels true to you. Each day, Hylly gives you a new question designed to invite reflection—without pressure to be perfect or to have the “right” answer.

Write privately in your own words, return to questions that stay with you, and discover thoughtful prompts from the community when you’re ready.

Features:
- One reflective question every day
- Write multiple answers as your thoughts evolve
- Discover popular questions and save the ones you want to revisit
- Like, bookmark, report, or block content
- Choose to answer anonymously
- Keep a personal history of your reflections
- Optional profile details and future memory reminders
Hylly is not about answering faster.
It’s about making a little more space to understand yourself.

name: Ice Slide Escape: Maze Puzzle
description:
Slide across the ice and escape the cave!

Ice Slide Escape is a cute maze puzzle where you slide a jiggly jelly across frozen floors. Swipe in any direction and the jelly keeps gliding until it hits a wall or a rock. Plan where to stop and reach the sparkling goal!

■ How to play
・Swipe to slide the jelly
・It won't stop until it bumps into a wall or a rock
・You only see part of the map. Keep sliding and the screen switches to reveal the rest, so remember what you've seen
・Clear levels in few moves and fast to earn up to 3 stars

■ Packed with tricks
・Snowmen: slide into one and you stop softly. Use them to turn
・Arrow tiles: they change your direction. Chain them for long, twisty rides
・Cracked tiles: safe once, but they break the second time you step on them!
・Treasure chests: bump one to open it and win a new outfit

■ 3 courses, 3,000 levels
Chilly, Blizzard and Mega Blizzard, with 1,000 levels each. A 14-level tutorial teaches one trick at a time.

■ Today's Extreme Challenge
One super-tough puzzle a day, the same for everyone. One try, no retries.

■ Relaxed and friendly
・Restart as often as you like, for free
・Stuck? Use a hint: 2 free every day, then watch a short video for one more
・Fell down a crack or took too many moves? No problem. Slide again!

■ Lots to enjoy
・3 cute jelly types and 50+ outfits to dress up
・56 achievements to collect
・Daily Ranking: compete with today's stars (optional, pick your own name)
・One-time "Remove Ads" purchase hides the full-screen ads (hint videos stay optional)
・Optional daily reminder (turn it off any time)
・Available in English, 日本語, Español, Português, 한국어 and 简体中文

name: iFarm Guide
description:
iFarm tells you what to do on your farm each day, and keeps the record of what you did.

Raise broilers, Sasso or egg layers. Start a flock on the day the chicks arrive, or part-way through. Each day, iFarm shows how much feed and water the birds in your house need, the temperature to hold, which vaccine is due, and the one thing that matters most today. The guide follows a published day-by-day programme for each kind of bird.

RECORD THE DAY IN A FEW TAPS
Record deaths and sick birds (with the cause), feed and water given, what is left in the feeders and drinkers, and house temperature as they happen. No sums to work out: say "one more died" and iFarm keeps the count.

WORKS WITHOUT A SIGNAL
Everything you record is kept on the phone and sent when the network comes back.

SEE HOW THE FLOCK IS DOING
Compare growth, feed and deaths with the guide. Weigh a sample of birds to see average weight and how even the flock is. Follow feed conversion and the production efficiency factor as the flock grows.

KNOW WHAT IT COSTS AND EARNS
Record chicks, feed, medicine and other costs, and every sale. See the cost per bird, the break-even price and your profit for each flock and each farm.

ALERTS THAT REACH YOU
Get a notification when deaths jump, the birds drink less, the house is too hot, a vaccine is due tomorrow, a day goes unrecorded or feed is running low.

ASK A VET OR AGRONOMIST
Ask about a flock and add photos or a voice note. A vet or agronomist answers you in the app or by phone.

FOR OWNERS AND CARETAKERS
Owners run one or more farms, add houses and flocks, and give caretakers their own sign-in with a phone number and 4-digit PIN. Caretakers see only the flocks they look after.

WITH YOUR COOPERATIVE OR BANK
An organisation can invite you to join it. Nothing is shared until you accept.

IN KINYARWANDA AND ENGLISH
Switch language at any time.

iFarm gives routine guidance only. For disease, medicines and dosing, always ask a vet.

name: IIKANZI DENKI 2
description:
製造分野特定技能2号評価試験（電気電子機器組立て）のための試験対策アプリです。

日本語の問題文には漢字すべてにふりがなが付き、ベトナム語の訳が並びます。日本語がまだ得意でなくても問題の意味が分かります。

■ 模擬試験20回分 — 第1回は無料
1回30問・4択（ア〜エ）・80分、60％以上で合格の形式です。問題番号の一覧、見直し用のフラグ、スキップ機能付き。提出するとその場で点数と間違えた問題が分かります。第1回は無料で何度でも、残り19回分は3か月プランで開きます。

■ 本試験と同じ出題分野
安全・品質管理、電気・電子の基礎、測定・計測、図記号・製図、計算、組立て・配線、加工・手工具。1回の中で本試験に近い配分で出題します。

■ 図で考える問題 319問
回路図、図記号、測定器の目盛り、配線、QC七つ道具のグラフなど、図を見て答える問題を各回約16問収録しています。

■ 全問題に解説
模擬試験20回分・600問すべてに解説が付きます。なぜその選択肢が正解で、他の3つがなぜ違うのか。暗記のコツと関連する専門用語も一緒に読めます。

■ 練習クラス — 10章・63項目
章と項目を選び、テーマごとに練習します。終わるたびに進み具合（％）が分かります。第1章は無料です。

■ 専門用語 1,874語・9章
試験問題から集めた現場の用語。安全衛生、品質管理、電気製図、工具・器具、機械加工、電気理論、電気・電子作業、電気電子応用、検査・保全・梱包・成形。全語に音声付きで、ベトナム語・英語・インドネシア語・ミャンマー語の意味を表示します。

■ 試験のための文法 55パターン・6パート
会話の日本語ではありません。試験に実際に出る文型だけを、試験問題からとった例文と音声で学びます。第1パートは無料です。

■ 復習・学習ルート
間違えた問題は自動で集まります。学習の順序の目安も収録。どちらも無料です。

■ 無料でできること
第1回（30問）を何度でも受験・採点・正解確認。各分野の最初の2問は解説も全文表示。練習クラス第1章、用語の第1章、文法の第1パート。復習と学習ルートは全て無料です。

■ 3か月プラン
残り19回分の模擬試験、すべての問題の解説・暗記のコツ・専門用語、練習クラス全章、用語9章すべて、文法6パートすべてが開きます。試験までの3か月分の買い切りで、自動更新はありません。

画面の言語は、ベトナム語・日本語・英語・インドネシア語・ミャンマー語から選べます。スマートフォンでもウェブ（d2.iikanzi.jp）でも学習できます。

name: Indanta Drive
description:
Indanta Drive is the app for drivers of taxi companies that work with Indanta. Rides come in, you accept them with one tap, you navigate with the app you already know and you settle the fare in the app.

ACCEPT RIDES
An offered ride shows the pickup address, destination, number of passengers, price and a countdown. Accept or decline with one tap. Open rides you can pick up yourself.

NAVIGATE
Drive straight to the pickup point with Google Maps, Waze or Apple Maps. A note from the customer, such as "at entrance B", is shown with the ride.

UPDATE THE STATUS
On my way, I am here, customer on board: with one tap your dispatch knows where you are, and your customer sees through a link when the taxi arrives.

SETTLE THE FARE
Finish a ride with cash, card or already paid. Prepaid rides and rides on account are settled automatically.

TODAY
Your day overview: the number of rides, what was paid in cash and by card, and what is still to be collected.

DISPATCH FROM THE APP
Allowed to dispatch, for example as an owner who also drives? Then you see the open rides and assign them to a free driver.

YOUR LOCATION, ONLY DURING YOUR SHIFT
The app shares your location only while your shift is on, also when you navigate with Google Maps or Waze and the app is in the background. When you end your shift, it stops immediately. Your location is not used for advertising and is never sold.

WHO IT IS FOR
You do not create an account yourself: your taxi company adds you in Indanta and gives you the company code. Curious how it works? Tap "Bekijk de demo" (view the demo) and explore the app as a driver or as a dispatcher, without an account.

name: INNITI RMC
description:
INNITI RMC brings your ready-mix concrete plant to your phone and tablet. See today's production and dispatch at a glance, approve orders on the move, follow up with customers, and keep your team's attendance accurate — all connected to your company's INNITI system.

PLANT DASHBOARD
• Switch between plants in one tap
• Today's production schedule and dispatch, live
• Plant summary: diesel, outstanding, payables, sales and pending invoices
• Tap any figure to open the records behind it

APPROVALS ON THE GO
• Approve or send back Purchase Orders, Sales Orders and Sales Quotations
• Full approval timeline with approvers and remarks
• Purchase Requisitions with item-level details

SALES & CRM
• Manage leads and parties with billing addresses and sites
• Organise marketing areas
• Plan and record customer follow-ups
• Review and update customer credit limits

FINANCE
• Customer outstanding, bill by bill
• Supplier payables and pending bills against GRN
• Sales invoices and challans still to be invoiced

OPERATIONS
• Diesel usage records
• Shift activity log and a map of field visits

ATTENDANCE & HR
• Geofenced check-in and check-out with a live selfie
• Location tracking during the shift for field staff
• Attendance history, salary slips and profile

SECURE BY DESIGN
• Company-code sign-in to your own company's server
• OTP login tied to your registered device
• Role-based access: everyone sees only what they are allowed to

Built for phones and tablets, including iPad two-pane layouts.

INNITI RMC needs an active account from your company. Contact your administrator for your company code and login.

name: Inova Glass
description:
Cotizaciones de vidrio profesional desde tu iPad o iPhone. Rápido y preciso.

Del croquis a la cotización
Escanea un croquis técnico con la cámara y deja que la IA detecte las piezas automáticamente. También puedes importar una imagen desde la galería o dibujar la forma directamente en la app sobre un canvas táctil.

Geometría precisa
El motor de geometría normaliza el trazo, corrige ángulos rectos y reconoce automáticamente cortes en esquina, resaques y cortes laterales, convirtiendo cada pieza en un modelo con medidas reales en milímetros.

Trabajos de manufactura completos
Añade y configura operaciones por pieza con validaciones en tiempo real: barrenos, avellanados, cantos pulidos, biseles, cortes en L, cortes en escuadra, redondeo de esquinas y bisagras. La app valida distancias mínimas a bordes, radios y dimensiones para evitar errores en producción.

Gestión integral de cotizaciones
• Selecciona productos de vidrio por grupo, tipo y grosor.
• Calcula automáticamente piezas totales, área, peso y precio.
• Guarda borradores, revisa cada posición y envía la cotización a producción.
• Consulta el historial completo con búsqueda y filtros.

Pensada para el trabajo real
• Interfaz optimizada para iPad en horizontal, también disponible en iPhone.
• Modo claro y oscuro.
• Disponible en español e inglés.
• Acceso seguro con sesión cifrada.

Requiere una cuenta de Inova Glass.

name: iPhones LA Buy Sell Trade
description:
Sell your iPhone, iPad or Mac for cash, or buy your next one, from iPhones.LA, a used Apple device shop in Long Beach, California.

SELL
• See a cash offer in seconds: pick your model, storage, carrier and condition.
• Check our full price sheet before you decide.
• Add your device's IMEI or serial number and see what Apple has on file for it.
• Meet us across LA and Orange County, drop it off at our spot, or mail it in from anywhere in the US. If you turn down our final offer on a mailed device, we ship it back free.
• Selling several devices? Build a wholesale lot in one place.

BUY
• Browse the used iPhones, iPads and Macs we have in stock, with real photos, condition and price.
• Every device is tested and IMEI checked, with a 60-day warranty.
• Choose local pickup in Long Beach, local delivery or shipping, where available.

YOUR ORDERS
• Follow each order, see when our team has set your time, and message us in one place.
• Turn on order updates to get a notification when your time is set, when we're on the way and when we've arrived.

Sign in with Apple, or with a code sent to your phone or email. Card payments go through Stripe.

Offers depend on inspection. Service options depend on the device and where you are.

name: iRemote: Keyboard & Trackpad
description:
Use your iPhone or iPad as a keyboard and trackpad for a nearby Mac.

TWO WAYS TO CONNECT
Bluetooth provides keyboard and trackpad control without installing the Mac app. Install IRemote on your Mac from the Mac App Store and connect over your local network for screen preview, Mac input-source information and composed-text transfer.

One purchase includes the iPhone, iPad and Mac apps. Requires iOS/iPadOS 17 or later and a Mac running macOS 14 or later. This app controls a nearby Mac; it does not connect to a distant computer over the internet.

MOVE, CLICK AND SCROLL
Move and click with one finger, scroll and right-click with two fingers, or hold and move to drag. Fold the keyboard to give the trackpad more space. Adjust pointer speed from 0.5× to 3× and keep preferences for each saved Mac.

TYPE AND USE SHORTCUTS
Use the on-screen keyboard, modifier keys, shortcuts and media controls. With the Mac app connection, see the Mac input source and key layout, or compose text with your device keyboard before sending it. Multiline text transfer uses the Mac clipboard. These integrations are not provided by the direct Bluetooth connection.

OPTIONAL SCREEN PREVIEW
With the Mac app connection, view the area near the pointer or a full display. Choose a monitor, zoom and pan. Preview starts only when requested and is a lightweight visual reference, not high-frame-rate video streaming.

CHOOSE WHAT TO CONTROL
Select the Mac you intend to use. Bluetooth pairing and encrypted input connections are managed by the operating systems; a previously trusted connection may not show a new pairing prompt. The Mac app connection requires initial approval in the Mac app and offers a local pause and removal of saved devices.

No developer account, advertising or subscription. Bluetooth permission is needed for direct control. The Mac app connection needs Local Network and macOS permission to control the Mac; Screen Recording is needed only for preview. Camera access is optional for QR-code setup.

name: Is It Halal? Food Scanner
description:
Is It Halal? — Your Halal Food Scanner & Ingredient Checker

Standing in a supermarket abroad, unsure if a product is halal? Is It Halal? is a halal checker that scans any ingredients label and tells you in seconds whether it's halal, haram, or doubtful, with a clear reason for every flagged ingredient.

No more guessing in the aisle or searching E-numbers one by one. Just photograph the label and shop with confidence.


INSTANT HALAL DECISIONS

• Take a photo of any ingredients list
• Automatic text recognition reads the label
• Each ingredient is analyzed instantly
• Get a clear result: HALAL, HARAM, or DOUBTFUL

No research. No confusion. Just clarity.


KNOWS THE HIDDEN INGREDIENTS

Many non-halal ingredients hide behind E-numbers or unfamiliar names. Is It Halal? flags the ones that matter most:

• Gelatin (often pork-derived)
• Carmine / cochineal (E120)
• L-cysteine (E920)
• Mono- and diglycerides (E471)
• Rennet, lard, and animal fats
• Alcohol and hidden derivatives

If a source can't be verified, it's marked doubtful, never guessed.


BUILT FOR REAL ISLAMIC DIFFERENCES

Not every Muslim follows the same rulings — and that matters.

Choose your preferred school of thought:

• Hanafi
• Maliki
• Shafi'i
• Hanbali
• Consensus Mode (only universally agreed rulings)

Switch anytime in Settings.


CLEAR EXPLANATIONS — NOT JUST COLORS

Every flagged ingredient includes:

• Why it may be halal or haram
• Source risks explained simply
• Common ingredient names and E-numbers
• Context you can understand while shopping

You don't just get an answer — you understand it.


DESIGNED FOR DAILY SHOPPING

• Works with foreign languages and imported foods
• Handles small fonts and curved packaging
• Analysis history saved locally
• No account required

Less time deciphering labels, more time enjoying your food.


SUPPORTED LANGUAGES

English • Türkçe • العربية • Bahasa Indonesia


TRUST & METHODOLOGY

Analysis is based on recognized halal ingredient references and classical Islamic rulings across four major madhabs, combined with AI-assisted ingredient interpretation.

The goal is simple: fast, transparent halal food verification you can actually understand.


FREE PLAN

• 5 scans per week
• Watch a short video for bonus scans
• Full feature access
• No signup required

Start free. Upgrade only if you need more scans.


GO PREMIUM

Unlock unlimited scans and an uninterrupted experience.

• Unlimited analyses
• No advertisements
• Support ongoing development

Cancel anytime.


PRIVACY FIRST

• Photos processed temporarily, then deleted
• History stored only on your device
• No account or personal data required


IMPORTANT DISCLAIMER

This application provides informational guidance based on general Islamic sources and AI analysis. Results are not religious rulings (fatwa). For definitive religious decisions, consult a qualified scholar or certified halal authority.


WHO IS THIS FOR?

• Muslims living abroad
• Travelers checking unfamiliar foods
• Families wanting quick halal verification
• Anyone following a halal diet who wants to shop with confidence
• Anyone tired of searching E-numbers manually


Scan it, understand it, and eat with peace of mind.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://bytelunalabs.com/isithalal/privacy

name: Isotope Keyboard
description:
Isotope Keyboard brings multilingual typing and word learning together. Type in Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese for Hong Kong and Taiwan, or English, with Cangjie, Quick, Cantonese Jyutping, and Zhuyin input methods.

The offline Lite dictionary includes 39,780 entries. The top candidate row is for typing; translations below are for reference. Open an entry to view its meaning, pronunciation, part of speech, and word forms.

Add and manage your own dictionaries for everyday typing and vocabulary study. Choose the basic theme or one of two permanently free themes: Startrail Voyage and Sunny Party. Preview and apply themes, with a night appearance available.

Get started:
1. Add and enable Isotope in iPhone Settings.
2. Choose a language, input method, and theme.
3. Tap a top-row candidate to type, or a translation to view entry details.

name: Itihasa - Scroll Ramayana
description:
Swap a few minutes of scrolling for the Ramayana.

Itihasa means "thus it happened". It is the name India gives its two great epics, and this app starts with the first: the complete Valmiki Ramayana in a simple vertical feed. One verse fills the screen. Swipe up for the next. That is the whole idea.

WHAT IS INSIDE
- All 7 kandas: Bala, Ayodhya, Aranya, Kishkindha, Sundara, Yuddha and Uttara
- 641 sargas and 19,328 verses
- The original Sanskrit in Devanagari
- Roman transliteration for reading aloud
- A full English translation for every verse
- Hindi translation (हिन्दी अनुवाद) for every verse, one tap away
- Paintings at the turning points of the story

MADE FOR DAILY READING
- A Home screen that picks up exactly where you stopped, with a verse of the day
- Contents with all seven kandas and a short summary of every sarga
- Show Sanskrit, transliteration, English, or any mix
- Two reading themes: Patra for daylight and Diya for night, or Auto to follow your phone
- Adjustable text size
- Save verses with the heart or a double-tap, and find them again under Saved
- Browse all 46 paintings in one gallery and jump to the verse each one belongs to
- Turn any verse into a shareable card: folio, aged parchment, hanging scroll or plain scripture, in English or Hindi

QUIET BY DESIGN
No ads. No account. No tracking. Your place and saved verses stay on your phone.

ABOUT THE TEXT AND ART
The English translation is by Manmatha Nath Dutt (1891 to 1894), now in the public domain, lightly cleaned of scanning errors. The Sanskrit comes from Sanskrit Wikisource (CC BY-SA 4.0), aligned to Dutt's verse structure. The Hindi translation was made with AI from the Sanskrit, guided by Dutt's English. The paintings are AI-generated, in the tradition of Raja Ravi Varma.

name: J.P.INVEX
description: J.P.INVEX places the entry of the transaction amount at the very beginning of the bookkeeping process, making it ideal for recording expenses on the go. You can simply input an amount—or even a basic arithmetic expression—select the relevant account and category, and save the entry. Frequently used combinations are saved for quick access, while a dedicated list for backfilling missing entries helps you consolidate any overlooked transactions. When reconciling accounts, you can enter the actual balance, review the associated transactions based on the discrepancy, and confirm the final figures after making any necessary adjustments. The transaction log supports searching by amount, bulk-editing categories or dates, and splitting a single expense across multiple purposes—ensuring that the total allocation remains accurate. Seven distinct analytical views provide insights into your income and spending patterns, category breakdowns, account balances, and capital fluctuations, giving you a clear, data-driven basis for managing your finances.

name: JAJA KDS
description:
JAJA KDS is a simple point of sale and kitchen display for cafes, restaurants and food trucks.

TAKE ORDERS IN SECONDS
• Big menu buttons, sizes, add-ons and combos
• Notes for the kitchen on any dish: no onion, extra spicy, allergy
• Cash, card or split payment

KITCHEN QUEUE
• Every order on screen with a live cooking timer
• Sound and pop-up for each new order
• One tap: started, ready, served

RESTAURANT WITH WAITERS
• Waiters join with a QR code; the admin approves every shift
• Floor map: free, taken, reserved and ready tables at a glance
• Reservations by time, guest name and phone
• Waiters see when their order is ready to carry
• Bills are closed by the admin: cash, card, split, discount
• Receipts sent to the guest via any messenger

FOR THE OWNER
• Daily revenue, average check and statistics
• Owner code for the admin panel
• Web admin panel with the same login
• Four colour themes, Russian and English

Works on iPhone and iPad.

name: Jinjja Hangook: Korea Tips
description:
Jinjja Hangook is a free travel app for getting around Korea the way locals do.

SHORT TIPS FROM PEOPLE WHO'VE BEEN THERE
Travelers and neighbors post short tips about places to eat, stay, see and shop. Every tip links to Google Maps or Naver Map, so you always know exactly where it is. Pick what was good (tasty, great view, friendly, fair price) and see what others picked for the same place.

ASK IN YOUR OWN LANGUAGE
Posts, questions and answers are translated automatically into English, Korean, Japanese, Chinese and Spanish. Tap "see original" any time.

SHOW IT BIG IN KOREAN
Joining a waitlist without a Korean phone number, asking if a dish is spicy, showing a taxi driver where to go: open a big Korean card that fills the screen. Staff tap an answer, and you see it in your language.

KOREA BASICS
Naver Map in English, transit cards, taxis, lost items and emergency numbers, plus Korean seasons and holidays.

THE JINJJA STAMP
When a post passes 100 checks, it gets the Jinjja stamp automatically, whoever wrote it.

AREAS OPEN WITH POSTS
No one opens areas by hand. An area appears on the map as soon as someone posts a tip there or asks a question.

KEPT FRIENDLY
Ads, spam and hate are filtered before anything is posted. Report any post in one tap and block anyone you'd rather not see. Reports are reviewed within 24 hours.

PRIVACY FIRST
Browse without signing up. Sign in with Apple or Google only to post. We don't store your email or phone number. Only a flag shows next to your name.

Free. No ads. No in-app purchases.

name: Jise Studio
description:
Jise Studio is a native personal color workspace for designers and developers. Pick colors, build palettes, generate design tokens, check accessibility, and keep assets in one place—from first sample to something you can ship.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

• Color Picker — Sample from photos, files, or the clipboard. Pinpoint pixels with a loupe, review dominant colors, and save swatches to your library.

• Palette Studio — Generate and tune palettes with harmony rules, mood, and OKLCH perceptual controls. Create light and dark variants, compare boards, and hand off into Design System or Accessibility.

• Design System — Turn a brand color into Light and Dark semantic tokens. Preview surfaces, export what you need for product UI, and keep the working color flowing through your studio.

• Accessibility — Choose a text/background pair, read WCAG contrast, repair failing pairs, and verify with color-blind simulation before you ship.

• Color Library — Save palettes and projects as lasting assets. Optionally sync with your own iCloud account so boards travel across iPhone, iPad, and Mac.

• Color Lab — Deeper tools when you need them: image analysis, difference metrics, gamut views, spectral and scope sandboxes—kept out of the way of daily work.

WHY JISE STUDIO

• One visible workflow: pick → harmonize → prove → export  
• Built for real product work, not a pile of disconnected calculators  
• Native on iPhone, iPad, and Mac with a craft-focused interface  
• Exports and handoffs that fit design-to-engineering collaboration  

Whether you’re extracting a brand from a photo, building a theme board, or checking readable type, Jise Studio keeps color decisions clear, connected, and ready to use.

name: JotVoice: Voice Notes Watch
description:
Open JotVoice on your Apple Watch and it is already listening. Say what's on your mind, then simply stop talking: the note saves itself. No tapping, no looking.

WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT
• Hands-free finish: JotVoice waits until you speak, then saves after a short pause, with a gentle countdown you can talk over. Or save by lowering your wrist.
• Where and when: every note remembers the place you recorded it and the meeting you were in, so you can find a thought by where it happened.
• Sorted for you: say "remind me to call the dentist tomorrow at nine" and it becomes an Apple Reminder at 9:00. Say "buy milk and eggs" and both land on your shopping list.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Transcripts are made on your iPhone with Apple's speech recognition. No accounts, no ads, no tracking. Optional sync with your own private iCloud.

MADE FOR THE WRIST
• Complications and a Smart Stack widget open JotVoice already recording
• "Start a note in JotVoice" with Siri, or put it on the Action Button with Shortcuts
• Dictate text when your iPhone isn't nearby
• A watch inbox: swipe to keep a note, mark it done, or get reminded tomorrow
• Calls and Siri pause a take instead of ending it, and a take cut off by a crash is rescued at the next launch

ON YOUR IPHONE
• Search every word, place and meeting; filter by Reminders, Shopping or Ideas
• A map of where your thoughts happened
• Ask your notes, such as "What did I need to buy?", answered on your iPhone
• An evening digest of the day
• Edit transcripts and export to Markdown, Notes or email

JOTVOICE PRO
Free includes unlimited recording, places and sync, plus 15 transcripts a month. Pro adds unlimited transcripts, automatic Reminders and shopping list, "remind me when I'm back here", Ask your notes and the evening digest. Pro is a monthly subscription ($2.99), or a yearly subscription ($19.99) that starts with a free week. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel them in your Apple ID settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://vktherambo.github.io/jotvoice-support/privacy/

name: Juljul
description:
Juljul turns scrolling into Korean practice. Every swipe is a short real-world clip with word-by-word captions, matched to your level.

WATCH: A vertical feed of real Korean Shorts, graded from beginner to advanced, with captions that highlight each word as it is spoken. Slow any clip to 0.75x or 0.5x and loop the lines you want to hear again.

TAP: Tap any word to see its meaning in that sentence, how it breaks down, its level (TOPIK and CEFR), hanja roots, dictionary senses and real example sentences. Ask AI to explain anything that is unclear.

SPEAK: Shadow a line and get pronunciation feedback on the whole sentence and on each word. Review cards ask you to say the word, not just recognise it.

REMEMBER: Save words and lines. Smart spaced-repetition review brings them back at the right time.

STAY ON TRACK: Streaks, milestones and home and lock-screen widgets for a word of the hour and quick reviews.

JULJUL PRO: Unlimited clips, unlimited saved words, the full review queue and speaking practice with scores. Start with a 7-day free trial, then $49.99 per year, or choose $9.99 per month. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel any time in Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions. A free trial converts to a paid subscription unless cancelled before it ends.

Terms of Use: https://juljul.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://juljul.app/privacy

name: K-Lock Calc: Scientific & Tax
description:
Calculate 100 × 1.1 = once — then just type the next number and press =.
K-Lock Calc is a scientific calculator built around constant calculation, the "K" mode of classic calculators, made visible and fast.
Sales tax, tips, discounts, currency, unit prices and compound growth become one-tap repeat calculations.

■ Sound familiar?
• You type "× 1.0825" again for every price on a quote
• Your calculator's constant mode is confusing, and the built-in one has none
• You want 20%, 30% and 40% off prices one after another
• You convert dollars to euros or inches to cm by hand
• You need "× 1.03" for ten years of compound growth
• One typo in a long expression means starting over
• You're tired of calculator apps full of ads

■ 5 reasons to choose K-Lock Calc
1) A constant you can see
After 100 × 1.1 =, the last operation is locked automatically and shown in the K chip as "[ ] × 1.1". Type 250 = and get 275. Tap the chip to turn K on or off; long-press to pin, swap sides or clear.

2) Press = to repeat
Right after a result, press = again to apply K once more. Compound interest and yearly growth take seconds.

3) K Board
Save cards like "Sales tax 8.25%", "Tip 18%", "20% off" or "USD → EUR" and switch K with one tap. Put the constant on the left for math like 100 ÷ [ ].

4) K Table
Apply K to a range (100 to 1,000 in steps of 100) or to a pasted list and get a clean table. Share it as tab-separated text for Numbers, Excel or Google Sheets.

5) A real scientific calculator
See the whole expression and move the cursor by tapping, swiping or with arrow keys to fix any part. Trig and inverse trig, log, ln, powers, roots, factorial, permutations, combinations, modulo, percent and exponent entry. DEG, RAD and GRAD.

■ Features
• K-Lock: auto lock, K key lock, pin, on/off, swap sides
• Repeat K with =
• K Board presets: save, reorder, edit
• K Table with range or list input and sharing
• Cursor editing, live result preview
• sin cos tan and inverses, log, ln, 10^x, e^x, x^2, x^-1, x^y, sqrt, cbrt, n!, abs, nPr, nCr, mod, %, π, e, EXP
• Ans and memory (M+, M-, MR, MC)
• History: tap to edit again, insert results, filter K only
• My Constants: hourly wage, exchange rates, unit prices
• Science constants: speed of light, Planck, Avogadro, Boltzmann, gas constant, elementary charge and more (CODATA 2018)
• Normal, Fixed, Scientific and Engineering formats
• Haptics, Dark Mode, iPad, English and Japanese

■ Great for
Retail prices with or before tax, quotes and markups, bookkeeping, travel currency, DIY unit conversion, savings growth, STEM homework and scaling recipes.

■ FAQ
Q. What is constant calculation?
A. Applying the same operation, like × 1.1, to different numbers. After 100 × 1.1 =, type 250 = to get 250 × 1.1.

Q. How do I calculate without K?
A. Tap the K chip to turn it off. Expressions with an operator, like 2 + 3, are always calculated normally.

Q. Can I stop K from changing?
A. Long-press the K chip and choose Pin K, or type × 1.08 and press K. You can also turn off Auto K lock in Settings.

Q. Is my history saved?
A. Up to 500 calculations are kept on your device.

Q. Do you collect data?
A. No. Everything stays on your device. No ads, no tracking, no account.

■ Why we made it
K-Lock Calc began with a friend's request: "I love my scientific calculator, but it can't do constant calculation." Classic K mode is powerful, but you can't see what is locked. We rebuilt it as a visible chip and extended it into a board and a table.

Coming next: K from a widget, more export formats, time (h:m:s) math and base conversion. Send ideas via Settings → Help & Contact.

name: Kaka Agent
description:
Kaka Agent is a private field-operations app for an elected representative's constituency team in Telangana, India. It is NOT a public consumer app — only authorized staff members use it to run the day-to-day work of a constituency office.

Staff use Kaka Agent to plan daily village tours, log issues reported by constituents, track follow-ups until they close, and review weekly performance. Sign-in is invite-only; new sign-ups go through an in-app approval queue by design.

What the team does each day:

• HOME DASHBOARD — Today's schedule, open issues, overdue follow-ups, and a weekly Kaka Score that tells you if the week is on track.

• ISSUES — Log every field report from a mobile, a market yard, or a mandal office. Set priority, tag the owner, attach evidence photos, and watch an issue move from New → Team visited → Escalated → Closed.

• FOLLOW-UPS — Every promise made in the field becomes a tracked follow-up with a deadline, an owner, and a one-line script of what to say next time. Overdue items surface in red on the dashboard.

• VISITS HISTORY — Log who you met, what you promised, and the locality temperature. Build a visible pattern of presence for workers, women, youth, farmers, and underserved colonies.

• TODAY'S TOUR — A planned route with stops, travel time, talking points, and risks for the day — ready before you leave the office.

• MANDALS, SEGMENTS, SOURCES, PSUs — Group the constituency the way your work actually breaks down, and never lose track of which group hasn't been visited recently.

• USER MANAGEMENT — Admins add new office users, approve or reject pending requests, and (as Super Admin) grant per-module permissions. The last admin and your own account are protected from accidental deletion.

• ACTIVITY LOG — A permanent record of who did what and when, for every approval, follow-up, and escalation.

• ACCOUNT CONTROL — You can delete your own account from inside the app at any time. The server removes your sign-in and personal data immediately.

• PRIVATE BY DEFAULT — Your data lives on your organization's own infrastructure. No ads, no tracking, no third-party analytics.

Kaka Agent is designed for small, mobile-first teams. It works offline-friendly where possible, syncs the moment a signal comes back, and refuses to confuse volunteers with jargon.

Sign in with your mobile number and the password your admin gave you. An administrator has to approve new accounts before they can be used.

name: Keel Yard Thirteen
description:
Set sail on a thoughtful poker puzzle voyage. Arrange13 cards across your ship’s bow, midship and stern, balancing hand strength while fulfilling each port’s order. Limited cranes and visible supply trades make every packing decision matter.

Explore24 authored cargo manifests across four coastal regions. Inspect your ship with clear explanations, discover royalty bonuses and improve your star records. A captain’s reference plan helps you learn without hiding assisted results. Daily tides and free sailing bring new shuffles; your unfinished cargo is always saved locally.

Collect port stamps, review actual deliveries in your captain’s log and unlock distinctive ship emblems. Original illustrated harbors, tactile cargo cards, make every voyage your own. No account, advertising or purchases required.

name: Kept: Habit & Streak Tracker
description:
Kept turns your habits into tiles. Tap once when you do something and that day's tile sets in colour — glossy, glazed, catching the light as you tilt your phone. Keep going and the whole year fills in.

Or keep a day with a photo: a meal, an outfit, a second of video of your kids. Every day's tile becomes that day's picture, and a year plays back in seconds.

No subscription. No account. No ads. Buy it once and it's yours.

ONE TAP, ANYWHERE
• Keep a habit from Today, Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, Control Center, Siri or Apple Watch
• Count the things you do more than once a day: glasses of water, pages, sets
• Add a note to any day, and fill in days you forgot

MOMENTS, A PHOTO A DAY
• Make any habit a Moments habit: a photo of every meal, a short video a day, a weekly progress photo — or as many as you like
• Each day's tile becomes that day's photo — play your month, year or whole history back
• Make a video of any stretch, one second of each clip and a beat of each photo, ready to share
• Give it an end date, like 30 days of progress photos, and when it's done, play the whole run back
• Snap from the Lock Screen, Control Center or the Action button with the Kept Camera control
• Photos and videos stay on your devices and in your own iCloud

GOALS THAT FIT REAL LIFE
• Every day, a few times a week or a few times a month — rest days don't break a weekly streak
• Streaks count days, weeks or months, to match your goal
• Long runs earn rarer finishes: glazed at 7 days, then pearl, gold and iridescent at a full year

QUIT A HABIT
• Quit mode counts every day as kept on its own — tap only on a day you slip
• Made for No alcohol, No doomscrolling, No sugar, No spending
• Challenges with an end date: Dry January, Sober October, 30 or 75 days. They run, then they're done

APPLE HEALTH, FILLED IN
• Link steps, water, workouts, exercise minutes, sleep, mindful minutes and more
• Your whole Health history comes in, so your heatmap starts full
• Read-only: Kept never writes to Health

SEE THE WHOLE PICTURE
• A heatmap for every habit, a year calendar, monthly charts, your best weekdays and a notes timeline
• Monthly and yearly recaps
• Keep a habit private: its name stays blurred until you tap it, and widgets show "Hidden habit"

SHARE IT
• Story and post cards for a month, a year or all time, in three looks
• A time-lapse video of your year filling in, tile by tile
• Print your year as a 24 × 36 in poster

EVERYWHERE YOU ARE
• Widgets in every size, including extra large
• An Apple Watch app with its own widgets
• iPad and iPhone Duo, side by side
• iCloud sync through your own iCloud — no account to make

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Kept collects no data. No analytics, no tracking, no servers of ours. Your habits, photos and videos live on your device and, if you turn it on, in your own iCloud. Export a backup any time.

One purchase. Every feature.

name: Keyfidant
description:
Keyfidant is the trusted place for the entry codes and key instructions of your clients.

Are you a cleaner, carer, dog walker, gardener, handyman or any other professional who lets themselves in? Then you know the problem: door codes in WhatsApp, alarm codes in your notes, "the key is under the third flowerpot" somewhere in an old message. Hard to find, and not safe.

With Keyfidant every client has their own page with everything you need to get in.

HOW IT WORKS
• Add a client and send them their private link by WhatsApp, text or email.
• Your client fills in the entry code, alarm code, where the keys are and anything else that helps. No account or app needed on their side.
• The details appear under that client in your hub. Tap to show or copy a code when you are at the door.
• Did a code change? Your client uses the same link to send the new one.

SAFE BY DESIGN
• Everything is encrypted on the device before it is stored. Only you can read your clients' details. Not even we can.
• A link only lets a client send details. Nobody can read them back through it, and you can close or replace a link at any time.
• Unlock with Face ID or Touch ID.
• The app locks itself after 10 minutes without use, and your codes are hidden in the app switcher.
• No ads, no tracking.

COMFORTABLE FOR YOUR CLIENTS TOO
Your clients do not have to send their alarm code through a chat app. They see your name, fill in one short form, and know that only you can open it.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Works in English and Dutch.
• Also works in your browser on any phone or computer, with the same account.
• Because only you hold the key to your data, keep the recovery key you get when you sign up. Without your password or that key, nobody can restore your data, including us.
• You can delete your account and everything in it yourself, at any time.

FREE AND PREMIUM
• Free to use with up to 3 clients.
• Keyfidant Premium gives you as many clients as you need. It is a subscription per month or per year that renews automatically until you cancel in the App Store.
• If Premium ends, nothing is deleted. With more than 3 clients, 3 of your choice stay open and the others are locked after 7 days, until you have Premium again.
• Terms: https://app.keyfidant.nl/terms
• Privacy: https://app.keyfidant.nl/privacy

name: Kings Yield: Velvet Vault
description:
Step behind the curtain for a poker heist with a different kind of stakes: your plan.

Explore three richly illustrated theatres, each with sixteen connected rooms, its own walls and a watchful patrol. Form real poker combinations to open locks. Keep a pair for the next door, spend a key on the vault, or scout a room before committing your cards.

Choose a Locksmith, Acrobat or Illusionist, each with a different starting kit. Keys, grapples, smoke and masks give you four ways to improvise. Discover twelve keepsakes that change how you handle treasure, patrols and your finite deck.

Carry your treasure deeper, protect them at the coat check, or make a quiet exit. Every route is your decision. There is no reflex timer and every action has a visible consequence.

• Three unlockable theatres with different floorplans and patrol routes
• Three accomplices and four finite tools
• Full poker-hand recognition, from pairs to straight flushes
• Twelve functional keepsakes and a permanent discovery collection
• A daily seeded appointment, with one banked reward per UTC day
• Exact local save/resume and a genuine attempt archive
• Without accounts, ads or in-app purchases

Treasure is fictional and has no cash value.

name: KIO Prime Timing
description:
Gătești mai multe feluri în același timp fără haos și fără să pierzi controlul. KIO Prime Timing te ajută să alegi rețete, să stabilești porțiile și ora servirii, apoi construiește automat un plan clar de preparare cu timere separate pentru fiecare proces.

Ideal pentru o cină completă, un prânz bine organizat sau pentru atunci când vrei să pregătești până la trei feluri fără să te încurci între pași, ingrediente și timpi.

Funcționalități principale
- Planificare pentru până la 3 feluri simultan - vezi ordinea corectă a etapelor și ce trebuie făcut mai întâi.
- Timere separate pentru fiecare proces - urmărești fierberea, coacerea și pașii activi în același timp.
- Calcul automat al ingredientelor - aplicația recalculează cantitățile în funcție de numărul de porții.
- Listă unificată de ingrediente și cumpărături - ingredientele identice sunt grupate corect după nume și unitate.
- Rețete încorporate și rețete proprii - pornești imediat de la exemple gata pregătite sau creezi propriile preparate.
- Căutare și filtre - găsești rapid rețete după nume, categorie și mod de preparare.
- Gestionarea echipamentului - alegi numărul de ochiuri, prezența cuptorului și vasele disponibile.
- Ora de servire estimată - aplicația îți spune dacă planul este posibil și propune cea mai apropiată oră realistă.
- Ecran de gătit clar - vezi pasul curent, următorul pas și timerele active dintr-o privire.
- Funcționează și fără internet - scenariul principal este disponibil offline, fără cont personal.

Pentru cine este potrivită
- Pentru cine gătește acasă și vrea să organizeze mai multe feluri fără stres.
- Pentru cine are nevoie de o listă clară de pași, ingrediente și timpi înainte de a începe.
- Pentru cine vrea să salveze seturi de mese și să le refolosească rapid.
- Pentru cine preferă controlul manual al timerelor, al porțiilor și al echipamentului.

De ce să alegi KIO Prime Timing
Aplicația este construită pentru gătit real, nu doar pentru rețete. Ai un exemplu gata pregătit la prima deschidere, rețete cu etape și echipamente completate, un plan de lucru inteligent și o experiență simplă, modernă și rapidă. Poți vedea imediat ce faci acum, ce urmează și ce se mai gătește în fundal.

Începe acum și transformă pregătirea mesei într-un proces ordonat, rapid și ușor de urmărit.

name: Kivora - Mendora
description:
Before you replace an everyday item, look for a way to fix it. Kivora helps you work through small repairs to clothing, stationery, storage items, and furniture. Browse illustrated discussions to see where others started, then open a repair guide to read the method and outcome.

Keep your own repair notes with photos, optional voice recordings, and updates on what you tried. Save useful guides for later, or personalize your profile with a new frame and background. A new profile starts with 60 coins. Submitting a new repair post costs 30 coins, and saving a draft is free.

name: KKPDF 文件管家
description:
KKPDF 文件管家：離線、無廣告的 PDF 閱讀與工具箱。
閱讀、掃描、簽名、合併、壓縮，全部在你的 iPhone 上完成，文件不上傳任何伺服器。

【閱讀】
・全文搜尋、目錄、書籤、跳頁，自動記住上次讀到哪一頁
・垂直／水平捲動，原色、深色、米黃三種閱讀底色
・開啟有密碼的 PDF
・從「檔案」、Mail、LINE 點 PDF →「用文件管家開啟」，直接閱讀

【掃描】
・相機即時框出文件，自動找四個角，可拖拉微調
・透視校正、去陰影：原色／增強／灰階／黑白濾鏡
・一次掃多頁，存成清晰的 PDF

【簽名與標註】
・手寫簽名板、匯入簽名圖片並自動去背
・把簽名、文字、手寫筆跡蓋到 PDF 上
・加上文字浮水印（單一大字或滿版重複）

【PDF 工具】
・合併、分割、整理頁面（排序／旋轉／刪除／擷取）
・圖片轉 PDF、PDF 轉圖片
・OCR 文字辨識（中、英、日、韓），可做成可搜尋的 PDF
・壓縮 PDF、加上開啟密碼、移除密碼

【文件管理】
・資料夾可多層、排序、收藏、最近開啟
・Face ID 上鎖：整個 App、資料夾或單一文件
・簽名需要 Face ID 才能使用，避免被盜用
・完整備份成 .zip，換手機也能還原
・30 種色系、深色模式、繁簡切換、5 款桌面圖示

【你的文件只屬於你】
・不用註冊帳號，打開就能用
・所有處理都在手機上離線完成，沒有廣告、沒有追蹤

【免費版與完整版】
免費版可保存 10 份文件，所有工具都能試用。
完整版一次買斷，沒有訂閱：文件數量不限，未來更新全部免費。

name: Klarat: Swedish Citizenship
description:
Practice for the Swedish citizenship test (medborgarskapsprovet) in civics with 431 questions based on UHR's study material Sverige i fokus.

Klarat is made for people who need to show basic knowledge of Swedish society to become Swedish citizens. The questions have the same form as the test: four options, one is correct. The test is in Swedish, so every question is in Swedish, with an English or Arabic translation underneath when you want it.

ALL 13 CHAPTERS
- The country, democracy, how Sweden is governed, elections and parties
- Law and justice, media, human rights
- Labor market, welfare, modern history
- Sweden and the world, religion, traditions and holidays

LEARN, DO NOT GUESS
- A short explanation for every question
- A page reference to Sverige i fokus, so you can read more
- Smart practice that starts with what you find hard
- Repeat your mistakes until they stick

HELP IN YOUR LANGUAGE
- Show an English or Arabic translation under questions, answers and explanations
- Listen to the question read aloud in Swedish

MOCK EXAMS
- 40 questions from all chapters
- No answers until you finish, like the real thing
- Review your mistakes with explanations afterwards

FAIR PRICE
- Two chapters and one mock exam are free
- A one-time purchase unlocks everything. No subscription
- No account, no ads, works offline

GOOD TO KNOW
Klarat is an independent app and is not affiliated with UHR, the Swedish Migration Agency or any other authority. The questions are our own practice questions based on Sverige i fokus. They are not the real test questions. Official information about the test: uhr.se/medborgarskapsprovet. About citizenship: migrationsverket.se.

name: Kloro: Pool Water Calculator
description:
Kloro is a pool chemical calculator and test log for pools and hot tubs. Enter a test and Kloro tells you exactly how much of your own bleach, acid or salt to add, and in what order. No account, and it works offline.

The three things other pool apps get wrong:

• A FREE TIER THAT WORKS. Log as many tests as you like and get every dose, free. No account, no sign-in, no limit of one test.
• DOSES FOR WHAT YOU OWN. Bleach at 6, 8.25, 10 or 12.5 %, muriatic acid at 31.45 or 14.5 %, dry acid, cal-hypo, dichlor, trichlor, baking soda, soda ash, borax, calcium chloride, stabilizer, salt and bromine. Every dose shows its side effects: trichlor tablets lower pH and raise CYA, and Kloro says so before you add them.
• HOT TUBS, BROMINE AND HISTORY THAT LASTS. Hot tubs, bromine with its bromide reserve, and salt-water pools. Your tests stay in your phone's backup and in a CSV file you can take to a new phone.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Add your pool or hot tub: its volume, its sanitizer (chlorine, salt or bromine) and the products on your shelf.
2. Enter a test from strips or a drop kit: free and combined chlorine, pH, alkalinity, calcium hardness, CYA, salt, bromine and temperature. Every reading is optional.
3. Add what the Dose Plan says, one product at a time, and mark each dose as added.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• Pool chemical dose calculator for chlorine, pH, total alkalinity, calcium hardness, stabilizer (CYA) and salt.
• Hot tub chemicals: chlorine and bromine spas, with their own targets and safety notes.
• Free chlorine targets that follow your CYA, or classic fixed ranges.
• A pool test log with every test and every addition, newest first.
• Charts for every reading (Pro).
• Water balance with the Langelier Saturation Index, LSI (Pro).
• Test reminders on your schedule (Pro).
• Custom targets for each pool or hot tub (Pro).
• CSV export (Pro) and import.
• US gallons, fl oz, lb and °F, or litres, ml, grams and °C. Light and dark.

Doses are estimates. Read each product's label first, add one product at a time, and never mix chemicals.

FREE AND PRO
Free: one pool or hot tub, unlimited tests, every Dose Plan and the full test history.
Kloro Pro adds more pools and hot tubs, charts for every reading, test reminders, custom targets, water balance (LSI) and CSV export.

Kloro Pro Yearly: $14.99 per year, with a 7-day free trial for new subscribers. Kloro Pro Lifetime: $29.99, paid once. Prices are in US dollars; your store shows the price in your currency. The yearly subscription renews automatically every year until you cancel it, at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, in your store account settings.

Terms: https://kloro.dragon-byte.dev/terms
Privacy: https://kloro.dragon-byte.dev/privacy
Questions: kloro@dragon-byte.dev

name: Knot of Ways
description: Knot of Ways yhdistää korttikuviot ja reittipulmat rauhalliseksi, ilman verkkoyhteyttä pelattavaksi kokonaisuudeksi. Käännä kortteja paperikartan ruudukossa, yhdistä vierekkäiset portit ja avaa lähtöpisteestä maaliin reitti, joka täyttää vaaditun korttikuvion ja virran. Tutki kuutta arkistokarttaa ja päivän karttaa, käytä tarvittaessa vihjeitä ja tallenna valmiit kartat galleriaan. Rakenna omia reittejä laboratoriossa, fuusioi karttoja, tarkista kätesi kuviot sekä pura ja kokoa kortteja uusiksi yhdistelmiksi. Rekisteröitymistä ei tarvita. Edistyminen tallennetaan laitteellesi.

name: Knuckler AI: Resume Builder
description:
Knuckler AI writes a tailored, ATS-ready resume for every job you apply to. Add your resume once, paste a job description or a job link, and get a resume that leads with what that job asks for, in about a minute.

Start with 1,000 free credits. No card needed.

Built from your real experience
• Upload your resume as a PDF or Word file, photograph a printed copy, or paste it. It becomes your master profile.
• It writes from your real experience and never invents an employer, a date, a number or a certification. Anything you add later is shown to you before it's saved.

Tailored to each job
• Paste the job description, a link to the job posting where the site allows it, or screenshots of the posting.
• See the keywords the job asks for before you build. The ones your resume lacks are added unless you untick them; certifications and degrees only if you tick them.
• Choose a template (ATS Plain and Classic are free; others unlock once with credits), one to three pages, and PDF, Word or both.
• Get an ATS check: a score, every job keyword and whether it's on your resume, and what an applicant tracking system reads back from your PDF.
• "What's new" marks in green everything the tailored resume added to yours, so you can check it before you send it.
• Edit by hand, ask the AI to revise it, or get a cover letter for the same job.

Your search at a glance
• Home shows what to do next, your latest resume and your week.
• A calendar of the resumes you made and the emails you sent.
• Tracker keeps every resume and every recruiter you wrote to, with search and filters.

Interview prep
