• For each job you tailored: the questions you're likely to be asked, what each is checking, and an answer outline from your own resume.
• Practice by voice or typing and get feedback.

Reach recruiters
• Find recruiters at the company you're applying to, one company at a time, with an email to each written from your resume.
• Emails go from your own Gmail or mail app. Nothing is sent until you read it and tap Send, unless you choose to have them sent for you.

Batch & Schedule
• Paste up to 25 job descriptions at once, and have the resumes written now, tonight or tomorrow morning.

An AI assistant for your job search
• Ask it to tailor a resume, plan your day or sharpen your summary.
• It always asks before it uses credits or changes your profile.

Find a job, tailor in one tap
• Open popular job sites inside the app, open a job, and tap the K button to send its description to Knuckler AI.
• Or share a job to Knuckler AI from Safari or another app's Share button.
• Knuckler AI doesn't apply to jobs for you: you choose where to send each resume.

Credits and rewards
• Resumes, revisions, cover letters, interview prep and finding recruiters use credits. You see about how many before each one starts, and what it used after.
• 1,000 free credits when you join. They expire after 90 days.
• Small credit rewards for streaks, weekly goals and milestones.
• Have a code from Knuckler or your institute? Redeem it in Profile.
• Need more? Buy a credit pack or a monthly plan in the app. Credits you buy never expire.
• Colleges and companies can sponsor credits for their students and staff. Before you accept, you see exactly what the sponsor will see, and you can stop sharing at any time.

Your data
• Stored in India if you're in India, and in the United States otherwise.
• No ads, and we don't sell your data.
• Export your data or delete your account at any time from Profile.
• Something wrong in what the AI wrote? Report it from the resume or the reply.

The monthly plan renews each month until you cancel it in your Apple Account settings, at least 24 hours before the month ends.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Knuckler AI Terms: https://knuckler.app/app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://knuckler.app/app/privacy

Knuckler AI is for people aged 18 and over.

Questions? Email info@knuckler.app.

name: Koi Launch: AI App Builder
seller_name: KINETROPIC, MASULIYATI CHEKLANGAN JAMIYAT XORIJIY KORXONA
description:
Koi Launch is where the apps you make live on your iPhone and iPad.

Describe an app in ChatGPT or Claude — a quiz for your class, a habit tracker, a family shopping list, a small game — and the assistant builds it and publishes it to your Koi Launch account. Open it here and share it with a link.

What you can do
• My apps: everything you made, plus apps friends shared with you, in one place.
• Create: start from dozens of sample apps, give one your own name and colours, and send the idea to ChatGPT or Claude. You can also dictate it.
• Discover: apps from the community, shown in your language first.
• Share: send a link or a QR code. Friends can open it in any browser or in Telegram, without installing anything.
• Works offline: apps you have opened before keep working without a connection.
• AI inside apps: apps can use AI for things like quizzes, summaries or feedback, with a free daily allowance.
• Private when you want: keep an app to yourself, lock Koi Launch with Face ID or your passcode.

How it works
1. Sign in with Apple, Google, Telegram or email. Your account is free.
2. Connect Koi Launch to ChatGPT or Claude (the app shows you how).
3. Ask for the app you want. Ask for changes the same way; every version is kept and you can go back.

Good to know
• You need your own ChatGPT or Claude account to make apps. Whether custom connectors are available depends on their plans.
• Apps run in an isolated sandbox. Report any app from its menu.
• You can delete your account and all your apps in the app's settings.

Koi Launch is made by Kinetropic in Tashkent, Uzbekistan. Questions: hello@kinetropic.com

name: Kolevia Case - Collectible Log
description:
Every collectible has details worth keeping beyond its place on a shelf. Organize photos, series, quantities, storage locations, and purchase costs in a personal collection cabinet. Follow outstanding preorder balances, review sale results, and create a visual report of your collecting year.

Your Collection at a Glance

See your collection count and payments made so far from the cabinet overview. Upcoming balances and recently added pieces bring pending purchases and new additions into view.

Give Each Piece Its Own Record

Add photos and details for your collectibles, including their category, series, quantity, price, and location. Search by title, series, or storage location, filter by category, and switch between displayed and archived items.

Follow Orders and Transactions

Review preorder balances with their amounts and due dates. Keep purchase and sale transactions organized alongside your collection so you can revisit the movements behind each item.

Understand Costs and Sale Results

View committed purchase costs, payments made, outstanding balances, and net sale proceeds together. Review realized profit or loss for sold batches after purchase costs and selling fees, with a chart showing individual sale results.

Create a Yearly Collection Report

Choose a year and generate a report image featuring collectible photos, purchase totals, and realized sale results. Preview the report, then save or share it as a record of your collection.

name: Koli - AI Art & Friends
description:
Make room for your imagination with Koli — a creative community for AI art, short videos, and visual stories.

• SHARE YOUR WORLD: Post image albums and short videos. Dive into an endless creative feed, zoom in on full-screen details, and save original artwork when creators allow downloads.
• CREATE WITH AI: Turn text prompts or preset styles into stunning visuals in seconds. Generate images using in-app coins or try free community workers (queue times vary by availability; you always choose whether to share prompts and results publicly before generating).
• FIND YOUR PEOPLE: Follow favorite creators, like and save posts, and join the conversation in the comments. Mutual followers can chat privately and share photos and short clips in real time.
• MAKE YOUR PROFILE YOURS: Crop your avatar and profile banner with precision, unlock animated avatar frames with coins, and track your creations and coin history in one place.
• STAY IN CONTROL: Sign in securely with a verified email via password or one-time code. Easily manage download permissions, block or report accounts, or delete your account anytime in Settings.

name: Kotoba：英単語をコアイメージで
description:
英単語は、丸暗記しなくていい。Kotoba は、語の芯（コアイメージ）をつかみ、
そこから意味を筋道立てて導く英単語アプリです。理屈で納得してから覚えたい人へ。

■ まず「コア」で、語の芯をつかむ
収録語のほぼすべて（11,987語）に、その語が何を指しているのかを短く示す「コア」を置いています。
訳語をいくつも並べる前に、意味が広がっていく1つの芯から入ります。

■ 「なぜその意味になるのか」まで書いてある
紛らわしい語・複雑な語ほど厚く解説します（約8,000語）。
・語源の解剖：adore ＝ ad-（〜へ）+ orare（祈る）→ 崇拝する → 熱愛する
・類語との境界線：adore / worship / cherish / idolize の使い分け
・派生語のネットワーク：adopt → adoptive → adopted → adoption
筋道が分かると、まだ知らない語にも見当がつくようになります。

■ 12レベルで、いまの自分から
やさしい基礎語から上級語まで、使用頻度順に12段階へ整理。
今の実力に合ったレベルから無理なく始められます。

■ TOEIC に出る語だけを選んで学ぶ
「TOEIC 頻出語」モードにすると、レベルをまたいで TOEIC の頻出語だけを出題します。
TOEIC では一般の語義と違う意味で問われる語（book＝予約する、address＝対処する など）には、
その意味をカードに書き添えてあります。無料では Lv.01〜05 の範囲が対象です。

■ 間隔反復で「忘れる前に」復習
一度わかった語も、放っておけば薄れます。記憶の忘れ方を推定して最適な日に再出題し（FSRS-6）、
あやふやな語ほど早く戻します。理解を、記憶に変えていきます。

■ 発音も、その場で
各単語をタップで読み上げ。目と耳の両方で覚えられます。
辞書はすべて端末に入っているので、オフラインでもそのまま使えます。

■ 自分の記録を、グラフで見る
学習アクティビティ・復習の見通し・定着度の分布・レベル別の到達状況をグラフで確認。
「今どれくらい定着しているか」「復習がどれだけ溜まっているか」が一目で分かります。

■ 端末をまたいで続ける（使いたい人だけ）
iPhone・Android・Mac のあいだで学習の進捗を揃えられます。
アカウント登録は要りません。表示されたキーを他の端末に入れるだけです。
キーを打ちたくない人だけ、メールに届くコードで任意にログインすることもできます
（メールアドレスそのものは保存しません）。
同期は初期状態ではオフで、キーを設定するかログインしない限り通信しません。

■ 料金について
無料で Lv.01〜05・1日20語まで学べます。気になる上位レベルの語も、通算5語まで試し読みできます。
Kotoba Pro（買い切り・一度の購入で永久）にアップグレードすると、全12レベル・
新規語の無制限学習・全機能が解放されます。自動更新はありません。

丸暗記から、筋道でわかる英単語へ。Kotoba で、納得しながら語彙を積み上げましょう。
TOEIC は ETS の登録商標です。本アプリは ETS の承認・提携を受けたものではありません。

name: Kotobako: JLPT N1 Prep
description:
Kotobako is a complete, free study companion for the JLPT N1, the highest level of the Japanese-Language Proficiency Test.

A CLEAR PATH TO N1
Work through 45 themed units. Each unit is a set of short lessons covering new words, kanji and grammar, followed by a unit test. Score 80% to unlock the next unit, or test out of material you already know.

LEARN IT SEVEN WAYS
• Flashcards with readings and example sentences
• Matching pairs
• Listening: hear a word or sentence and choose
• Speaking: say it aloud and get a match score
• Build the reading from kana tiles
• True or false
• Grammar fill-in-the-blank
Missed items come back at the end of the lesson, and everything you learn feeds a spaced-review schedule so it sticks.

THE CONTENT
• About 2,650 N1 words, each with an example sentence
• About 1,000 N1 kanji with meanings, on and kun readings and example words
• 120 N1 grammar points with formation, explanation and examples
• Animated stroke order and writing practice for every kanji

FULL MOCK EXAMS
Timed mock exams in the JLPT N1 format: Language Knowledge, Reading and Listening. Fill in an answer sheet, hear listening scripts read by different voices, and get a score out of 180 with the pass mark and section minimums applied. Review every question with an explanation.

STAY ON TRACK
• Daily goal and streak
• Countdown to your exam date
• Reviews due today
• Stats for words, kanji, grammar and accuracy by skill
• Optional daily reminder
• Progress syncs across your devices with iCloud

Kotobako is completely free: no ads, no subscriptions, no in-app purchases and no account.

JLPT is administered by the Japan Foundation and Japan Educational Exchanges and Services. Kotobako is not affiliated with or endorsed by them.

name: KSF Anchor Watch
description:
Mark where you dropped anchor and draw the limits that fit the cove. Set a drag circle, trace an outer fence and name the shoals you want to keep clear of. An approach gives an early warning. Crossing a limit can sound the repeating alarm.

Use the offline plot with a suitable device position, or connect compatible boat instruments over Wi-Fi. Compare measured wind with the wind at the set. Combine a sounding with a Norwegian tide prediction or a manually entered range to check expected under-keel clearance.

Pair an iPhone, iPad or Mac on the boat network. A fence saved on one device appears on the others once the monitor accepts it. A disconnected companion keeps the last saved limits. For bedside sound, test the speaker and keep the app open and the devices awake. Free to use, with no subscription or in-app purchases.

When the iPhone is monitoring, warnings and alarms can appear on a paired Apple Watch. For the 15-second wrist test, lock the iPhone and wear your unlocked watch. For live monitoring, keep Anchor Watch open and the iPhone awake. Keep a regular anchor watch and check your position and depth. A missed alert is possible. The app interface is in English.

name: KSI Arena
description:
KSI Arena - Your Arena, One Click Away.

Nikmati kemudahan memesan fasilitas olahraga melalui satu aplikasi. KSI Arena hadir untuk memberikan pengalaman booking yang cepat, praktis, dan nyaman.

Tidak perlu antre atau datang langsung untuk mengecek jadwal. Temukan fasilitas olahraga favoritmu, pilih waktu yang tersedia, dan lakukan reservasi langsung dari smartphone.

FITUR UNGGULAN KSI ARENA

1. Booking Fasilitas Olahraga

Temukan berbagai fasilitas olahraga seperti futsal, padel, sepak bola, tenis, kolam renang, dan fasilitas lainnya.

2. Jadwal Real-Time

Cek ketersediaan lapangan, pilih tanggal dan waktu bermain, serta lihat informasi harga sebelum melakukan pemesanan.

3. Pembayaran Online

Nikmati kemudahan pembayaran melalui metode yang tersedia, termasuk QRIS, e-wallet, dan kartu pembayaran.

4. E-Tiket Digital

Akses tiket pemesanan langsung dari aplikasi. Tunjukkan QR Code saat memasuki fasilitas untuk proses check-in yang lebih praktis.

5. Membership Digital

Akses kartu member digital, informasi keanggotaan, serta riwayat membership dalam satu aplikasi.

6. Promo Menarik

Temukan informasi promo dan penawaran khusus untuk aktivitas olahraga favoritmu.

SEMUA KEBUTUHAN OLAHRAGA DALAM SATU APLIKASI

Mulai dari mencari fasilitas, memilih jadwal, melakukan pembayaran, hingga mendapatkan tiket digital, semuanya dapat dilakukan dengan mudah melalui KSI Arena.

Download KSI Arena sekarang dan nikmati pengalaman booking olahraga yang lebih praktis!

KSI Arena Sport Center
PT Krakatau Sarana Infrastruktur

name: Kuba Tours
description:
كوبا تطبيق سفرك على البحر الأحمر. احجز الإقامة والقوارب والجولات والأنشطة في الغردقة وسahl Hasheesh والمناطق القريبة من مكان واحد.

اختَر إقامة على الشاطئ، فيلا عائلية، رحلة رومانسية، أو مغامرة في البحر. أبحر مع الغروب، اغطس بين الشعاب، أو احجز انتقالًا وغرفة بسعر واضح قبل الدفع.

ماذا تحجز
• إقامات: فنادق وفلل وغرف بالليلة أو اليوم أو الساعة
• قوارب ورحلات بحرية
• جولات وأشياء تفعلها
• أنشطة للبحر والثقافة والعائلة والرومانسية والمغامرة

احجز وأنت مطمئن
• ابحث بالمدينة والمنطقة والتواريخ وعدد الضيوف
• صفِّ حسب السعر والموقع ونوع العقار والخدمات والتقييم
• شوف الصور والتقييمات وأبرز المميزات وسياسة الإلغاء قبل الحجز
• أسعار واضحة بالجنيه، مع عروض خاصة عند توفرها
• تأكيد فوري وإيصال الحجز على الإيميل
• احفظ المفضلات في قائمة الأمنيات، وتابع حجوزاتك القادمة والمكتملة والملغاة

للمسافر المحلي والزائر
استخدم كوبا بالعربي أو بالإنجليزي. سجّل بالإيميل أو جوجل، أو كمّل كزائر، وتابع خططك من الرئيسية والاستكشاف والحجوزات والملف الشخصي.

الدعم متاح لو حابب تعدّل حجزًا، أو تراجع سياسة الإلغاء، أو تتواصل مع مكان الإقامة.

حمّل كوبا وخطّط لرحلتك الجاية في الغردقة والبحر الأحمر في دقايق.

name: kutuda
description:
Kutuda, gıda israfını önlerken bütçenizi korumanızı sağlayan akıllı bir sürpriz gıda kurtarma uygulamasıdır.

Her gün restoranlar, pastaneler, kafeler ve manavlarda gün sonuna kalan taptaze ürünler çöpe gitmek yerine sürpriz kutulara dönüşür.

Öne Çıkan Özellikler:
• Harita ve Konum: Size en yakın işletmeleri haritada görün, mesafelerini ve indirim oranlarını anında keşfedin.
• Sürpriz Kutular: Sevdiğiniz restoran ve fırınların kaliteli ürünlerini %50 - %70 indirimle kurtarın.
• Kolay ve Güvenli Teslimat: Siparişinizi uygulama üzerinden verin, belirlenen teslimat saatinde mağazaya gidip dijital fişinizle kolayca teslim alın.
• İsrafı Önleyin: Hem bütçenize katkı sağlayın hem de gıda atıklarının önüne geçin.

name: La Fjor Atelier
description:
La Fjor Atelier is your personal space for planning and recording fragrance.

Compose a direction for your moment using the La Fjor perfumes you own, your preferences, your outfit colours and optional local weather. Follow a measured application guide, keep track of your current wear, and receive optional check-in notifications when it is time to reassess.

Save favourite recipes, revisit your wear history and record private observations in your journal. Outfit colour analysis stays on your device. Notification and location permissions are optional.

Fragrance suggestions and refresh timings are estimates, not instructions to apply more perfume. Skip a refresh if your composition still feels right.

name: Lanvo: Network Toolkit
description: Lanvo helps you understand and troubleshoot your network. Check connection details, test download and upload speeds, monitor latency, compare DNS resolvers, and inspect websites, TLS, and HTTP/3. Explore your local network, discover devices, calculate subnets, and measure transfer speeds between two Lanvo devices.

name: Lanzio: Zero to Founder
description:
You start from nothing: one idea, a bit of hustle and far too much enthusiasm. Lanzio is a funny, choice-driven story game where every decision writes your journey as an entrepreneur: bankruptcy, a small business that pays the bills, or wild success. Then you watch your business grow in a town of your own.

A REAL STORY, NOT A SPREADSHEET
• Over 750 scenes and illustrated characters who keep coming back: the worried parent, the best friend who wants to be your partner, the poker-faced banker, the big competitor down the street, a deadpan mentor…
• 2 or 3 choices per scene, 5 chapters, from the first idea to the big decision
• 30 to 40 minutes per game, with automatic saving

5 PATHS, 4 OF THEM FREE
• The Food Truck: an old truck and a family recipe
• The Online Shop: mismatched socks and a bedroom full of boxes
• The App that finds sitters for houseplants (it's going to change the world, or at least your living room)
• The Bike Workshop: an old garage and the secret notebook of a former racer
• The Upcycled Thrift Shop, a Lanzio Pro bonus

4 GAUGES TO KEEP UP
Cash, Energy, Reputation, Your people: every choice moves them, and your skills unlock special choices. A gauge hits zero? A crisis begins, and you can still pull through; once per game, a second chance lets you try again.

20 ENDINGS TO COLLECT
Bankruptcy, a small business that pays the bills, a buyout, a trip around the world, unusual endings: all 20 endings are free and kept in your Book of endings, with a hint for each one you're missing.

MY TOWN, FROM ABOVE
After your first game, whatever the ending, your town opens up: an illustrated isometric town you can zoom in on with your fingers.
• Your business grows before your eyes, from a little truck to an office building, and earns money even when you're not playing.
• So does your home: from your old bedroom at your parents' place to a villa with a pool.
• Seasons follow the real calendar, day turns into night, and people, cars and a river bring the streets to life.
• A team, a love life, kids, surprises, risky schemes, shares in local businesses and a small made-up stock market.
• A daily reward that grows over 7 days in a row.
Every path you finish opens a new neighborhood.

YOUR STUFF
Business is good? Treat yourself: city car, motorbike, 4x4, classic car, sports car, limousine, helicopter, yacht, watches, paintings, arcade machine, piano, telescope… all the way to a private island. 20 things that show up in your garage and around town, with a style bonus on your earnings.

YOUR CHARACTER
Create your avatar (skin, hairstyle, eyes, beard, glasses, outfit, accessories): it stays with you through the whole story.

ACHIEVEMENTS AND GOALS
26 achievements to unlock, a secret goal in every game, and after every ending a "Where are they now?" epilogue about your family and friends, your rival and your mentor. Share your ending with your friends.

LANZIO PRO
One single purchase, no subscription: no ads at all, the bonus path, second chance, mentor advice and boosts without videos (same limits for everyone), 3 save slots, restart at any chapter you've already played, and 12 hours of away earnings instead of 8. Everything else is free.

ADS, HONESTLY
No ads during your first game, and never while you're reading a scene. A small banner in menus, chapter summaries, the book of endings and the town. At most one ad between two games (at least 10 minutes of play apart, never right after a bankruptcy). Rewarded videos are always optional.

100% OFFLINE, 22 LANGUAGES
No account, no sign-up. We laugh at situations, never at people. Everything is fictional: the characters, the companies, the stock market and the town's currency, which can never be bought with real money. Lanzio gives no financial advice.

A question, an idea? Write to us at serviceproduction.webm@gmail.com

name: Lashing & Knot Field Log
description:
Lashing & Knot Field Log je denník tréningu lanových prác, nie galéria obrázkov.

Každé sedenie, ktoré naozaj uviažete, sa zaznamená: uzol, dátum, vaše vlastné hodnotenie zvládnutia, chyby, ktoré ste si všimli, a fotografia, ak chcete. Postupne sa z opakovania stáva dôkaz — dvanásťtýždňová mapa aktivity, radar zvládnutia, história pre každý uzol a séria dní, ktorú je ťažké spochybniť.

ČO ZÍSKATE
• Tréningové plány — zostavte si zoznam uzlov na precvičenie a každý deň ich odškrtávajte
• Denník tréningu — hodnotte zvládnutie od začiatočníka po zvládnutý, označujte šmyky a voľné obraty, pripojte až šesť fotografií
• Prehľad — mapa aktivity, radar, vývoj jednotlivých uzlov a celá časová os
• Export do PDF — jednoduchý zoznam alebo pracovný zošit s hlavičkou tréningu a riadkami na podpis
• Priložená príručka — 40 nákresov krokov pre 10 uzlov na tábor, horolezectvo, námorníctvo a viazanie

OFFLINE OD ZÁKLADU
Bez účtu, bez analytiky, bez reklám, bez sieťových požiadaviek. Záznamy a fotografie zostávajú v súkromnom úložišti aplikácie vo vašom zariadení.

UPOZORNENIE
Úrovne zvládnutia sú vaše vlastné hodnotenie, nie kvalifikácia, a nákresy sú učebné pomôcky, nie návod. Táto príručka slúži len na rekreačné učenie lanových techník. Nespoliehajte sa na ňu pri životne dôležitom lezení, záchrane ani nosných konštrukciách.

name: Last Miles
description:
Last Miles adds the miles you type for each run and subtracts them from the retire limit on that pair of shoes. The shoe board shows the miles still left in large type. The shoe page draws an arc for the share already used.

A pair with 50 miles or fewer remaining appears on Retire. Pace uses the last 28 days. If those days contain miles and some limit remains, the app estimates a retire date from that daily average. Places and recent weeks group the same runs another way.

Last Miles does not read a watch and does not give training or medical advice. Distances are the ones you enter. The log stays on this iPhone.

name: Layer – Skin Cycle Planner
description:
Layer turns the skincare you already own into a routine that makes sense.

Add your products and Layer reads their ingredients, works out which ones pair well and which shouldn't share a night, and puts everything in the right order. Each morning and evening, you see exactly what to use, step by step.

SCAN INSTEAD OF TYPING
Point the camera at an ingredient label, scan a barcode, or photograph your whole shelf at once. If the box doesn't list everything, import a screenshot of the product's web page and Layer reads the ingredients and directions from it.

SKIN CYCLING, PLANNED FOR YOU
Exfoliation, retinoid and recovery nights rotate on their own, so strong actives never pile up. See tonight at a glance, check any night ahead in the calendar, and see what's resting tonight and why.

BUILT AROUND YOUR SKIN
Choose your skin type and up to four goals, like dryness, fine lines, dark spots or dark circles. The routine changes with them: a gentler cleanser for dry skin, an extra recovery night for sensitive skin, an eye cream step for dark circles.

THE RESEARCH BEHIND EVERY RULE
Why vitamin C goes in the morning, why acids and retinoids take turns, why sunscreen comes last. Every rule links to the study it comes from.

TODAY'S WEATHER, FACTORED IN
Layer checks the day's UV and humidity. On a high-UV day it tells you when to reapply sunscreen, and on a dry day it adjusts your moisturizer.

SEE WHAT'S MISSING
Layer shows how well your shelf covers each goal, and suggests what's worth adding next at budget, mid-range and luxury prices.

ASK THE COACH
"Can I use my retinol tonight?" "What goes first?" The Coach answers from your own shelf and plan.

A WEEKLY PROGRESS JOURNAL
Take a photo each week, lined up with a ghost of the last one, and compare side by side.

WHEN SOMETHING RUNS OUT
Mark a product as finished and Layer adjusts tonight's routine, then keeps it on a rebuy list.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads and no tracking. Your shelf, routine and photos stay on your iPhone.

Layer gives general skincare information based on published research. It isn't medical advice.

name: Leaving Cert Geography 2027
description:
Leaving Cert Geography Questions and Answers – Higher Level Flashcard Notes

10 years of past paper topics in your pocket. This app is based on what you need to know for Leaving Cert Geography Higher Level. Containing 766 exam-focused questions covering the key topics you should know for the Leaving Cert Geography exam.

Flashcard design to help you test yourself on the go, anytime, anywhere.

The answers contain the key words, geographical terminology and essential information you need to know to achieve good marks in your Leaving Cert.

Everything you need to prepare for your best possible result in Leaving Cert Geography Higher Level.

The app is divided into the various sections of the Leaving Cert Geography syllabus, making it easy to revise individual topics, test your knowledge and build confidence ahead of your exams.

name: Leehwa AX Timepunch
description:
Leehwa AX Timepunch (AX Punch) is a 100% free ($0) GPS workplace time-clock app designed for both individual professionals and organization teams. There are no paid subscriptions, no in-app purchases, and no external fees.

Key Features:
- Instant Clock In & Clock Out: Verify proximity to your designated workplace geofence boundary in the foreground and record attendance with a single tap.
- Free Personal & Organization Modes: Create a free standalone Personal Account ($0) with custom workplace GPS coordinates and radius, or link to an authorized organization profile.
- Weekly Attendance Summary: Review days worked, daily Clock In and Clock Out timestamps, and net hours across the past 4 weeks in the My Week view.
- Privacy-First & Full User Control: Location is checked strictly while the app is open in the foreground. No background tracking, no advertising identifiers, and instant in-app account deletion or device unlinking at any time.

name: LEGEND IS FUN
description:
LEGEND IS FUN is the companion app for LEGEND, the backyard target game from SEEZER LLC.

SCORE KEEPER
Keep score for your LEGEND match right on your phone. Tap +1, +2 or +3 for each throw (1 for the target, 2 through the hole, 3 for knocking the topper down), undo or reset, and save each game into a best-of-3 or best-of-5 match. Your scores stay on your device and the Score Keeper works without a connection.

NATIONAL LEGEND LEAGUE
See the 2026-2027 team standings ranked by points, the points system, the tournament list, and each tournament's bracket and results. Tournament registration opens the tournament's registration page on legendisfun.com. The Official League Constitution opens from the League screen on legendisfun.com.

SHOP
Browse LEGEND discs, koozies, headwear, replacement parts and the Custom Classic Bundle. Choose a product, then continue to legendisfun.com to check out. Checkout, payment and orders are handled on the website, not inside the app.

COLOR SCHEMES
Browse the popular color schemes, then build your own in the 3D color tool on legendisfun.com, which opens inside the app.

ORDERS AND MORE
Order Status, How to Play, Quick Assembly, and Contact Us, including custom design requests, which open an email to us.

PLAY LEGEND DISC TOSS
LEGEND Disc Toss is a separate mobile game from SEEZER LLC. The App Store and Google Play links are on the Home screen.

Questions? a.martinez@legendisfun.com or legendisfun.com

name: Leoforia LIVE
description:
Πού είναι τώρα το λεωφορείο και σε πόσα λεπτά φτάνει στη στάση σου; Το Leoforia LIVE σου το δείχνει σε πραγματικό χρόνο, για όλες τις γραμμές λεωφορείων και τρόλεϊ της Αθήνας και όλες τις γραμμές της Θεσσαλονίκης.

ΖΩΝΤΑΝΟΣ ΧΑΡΤΗΣ
• Όλα τα λεωφορεία και τα τρόλεϊ της περιοχής σου πάνω στον χάρτη, με τον αριθμό της γραμμής
• Οι στάσεις γύρω σου· πάτα μια στάση για τις αφίξεις ή ένα λεωφορείο για τη γραμμή του

ΑΦΙΞΕΙΣ ΣΕ ΚΑΘΕ ΣΤΑΣΗ
• Σε πόσα λεπτά έρχεται κάθε λεωφορείο, με ανανέωση κάθε 20 δευτερόλεπτα
• Στη Θεσσαλονίκη ξεχωρίζουν οι live αφίξεις από τις ώρες του προγράμματος

ΕΙΔΟΠΟΙΗΣΗ ΑΦΙΞΗΣ
• «Ειδοποίησέ με όταν έρχεται»: διάλεξε λεωφορείο και πόσα λεπτά πριν θέλεις να ειδοποιηθείς

ΚΑΘΕ ΓΡΑΜΜΗ
• Η διαδρομή στον χάρτη, με όλες τις στάσεις και για τις δύο κατευθύνσεις
• Τα οχήματα της γραμμής σε πραγματικό χρόνο και σε ποια στάση βρίσκονται
• Πρώτο και τελευταίο δρομολόγιο και όλες οι αναχωρήσεις της ημέρας, χρήσιμα και όταν η τηλεματική δεν απαντά

ΜΕΤΡΟ, ΤΡΑΜ ΚΑΙ ΑΠΕΡΓΙΕΣ
• Μετρό, ΗΣΑΠ, τραμ και Μετρό Θεσσαλονίκης: κάθε πόσο περνά συρμός τώρα, πρώτος και τελευταίος
• Κατάσταση της ΣΤΑΣΥ, έργα και κλειστοί σταθμοί
• Απεργίες και στάσεις εργασίας: πώς κινείται κάθε μέσο

ΓΙΑ ΚΑΘΕ ΜΕΡΑ
• Κοντινές στάσεις με την απόσταση σε μέτρα, αγαπημένες στάσεις και γραμμές
• Αναζήτηση με αριθμό ή περιοχή, ακόμη και με λατινικούς χαρακτήρες (π.χ. 550, kifisia, kamara)
• Σκούρο θέμα, ελληνικά και αγγλικά
• Στείλ' το σε φίλους με ένα άγγιγμα

Τα δεδομένα προέρχονται από την τηλεματική του ΟΑΣΑ (Αθήνα), του ΟΑΣΘ/ΟΣΕΘ (Θεσσαλονίκη) και τη ΣΤΑΣΥ. Η τοποθεσία σου χρησιμοποιείται μόνο στη συσκευή, για τον χάρτη και τις κοντινές στάσεις.

Το Leoforia LIVE δεν είναι επίσημη εφαρμογή του ΟΑΣΑ, του ΟΑΣΘ, του ΟΣΕΘ ή της ΣΤΑΣΥ.

name: Les François
description:
Bienvenue en France, 2026. Le carburant coûte un rein, le rond-point est occupé et ta mère t'attend pour dîner.

Les François est un jeu de rôle rétro et satirique. Tu pars de Trou-Perdu pour devenir Champion de France, en attrapant des François plus vrais que nature.

77 FRANÇOIS À COLLECTIONNER
Le Stagiaire, la Karen, le Gilet Jaune, le Bobo vegan, le Joueur de padel, le Consultant, le Notaire de province… Chacun évolue, et certains te laissent choisir : ton Salarié deviendra-t-il Syndicaliste ou Directeur toxique ? Et au bord de l'eau, sors la canne à pêche : Maître-nageur, Carpiste et Militant anti-bassines mordent à l'hameçon.

DES COMBATS QUI PIQUENT
Mail « Cordialement », Pose de RTT, Agrafeuse lancée, Pitch entre deux étages. Des combats au tour par tour, avec types, faiblesses et statuts.

9 VILLES, 7 ARÈNES
Giratoire-sur-Merguez et son barbecue de rond-point, Ploucville, Boboland, Startup Valley, Sleeptown (ouvert le lundi et le jeudi matin, vraiment), Bourgeois-sur-Seine, Pastis-sur-Sieste, et enfin Politicocity. Des catacombes, un RER en grève et un TGV en retard entre les deux.

UNE SATIRE QUI N'ÉPARGNE PERSONNE
Gauche, droite, villes, campagnes, patrons, salariés : tout le monde y passe. Aucun nom réel, aucune marque, aucune personne visée. Juste des clichés qu'on reconnaît tous.

ESSAI GRATUIT, PUIS UN SEUL ACHAT
Joue gratuitement jusqu'à la première arène. Un achat unique débloque ensuite tout le reste du jeu. Pas d'abonnement, pas de pub, pas de compte. Le jeu se joue hors ligne et ta sauvegarde reste sur ton téléphone.

Ce jeu est une œuvre de fiction humoristique. Toute ressemblance avec ton voisin de palier serait purement fortuite.

name: Linefound
description:
Linefound is a typewriter for writing novels, with your story bible one tap away.

Type, and a typebar strikes each letter through the ribbon. A steel type guide rides under your line, the carriage slides the paper as you go, and a bell rings near the margin. Then, when you need to check a detail, you can look it up and be back in the same sentence without touching the page.

WRITE
• Opens on the line you left, with the cursor where you stopped
• Typewriter sounds, haptics and ink-strike effects, all optional
• Moving carriage, or keep the page still
• Focus mode fades every paragraph except the one you're writing
• Six caret styles modelled on machines from the 1910s to the 1960s
• Typewriter, Courier, Pica and serif type, three page widths, light and dark

KEEP TRACK
• A relationship map of your characters: who's connected, how, and which chapters they share
• Character cards for roles, motivations, secrets and arcs
• Pin a continuity note to a paragraph. It stays attached as you edit around it
• Chapter notes and whole-book notes
• On iPad the story panel sits beside the page while you keep typing

YOURS
• No account, no ads, no analytics, no tracking
• Your writing never leaves your device
• Every chapter is saved as a plain Markdown file you can open in the Files app
• Export the whole book as one Markdown manuscript

Keyboard shortcuts on iPad: ⌘1 Characters, ⌘2 Notes, ⇧⌘N pin a note, ⇧⌘D focus mode, Esc back to the page.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://botland.studio/terms
Privacy Policy: https://botland.studio/privacy

name: Liturgia OAR
description:
Liturgia Recoleta reúne en una sola app el calendario litúrgico de la Orden de Agustinos Recoletos (OAR) para 2026-2027.

HOY
• Celebración del día con su rango y tiempo litúrgico
• Lecturas de la Misa
• Acceso directo a la Liturgia de las Horas

CALENDARIO
• Vista mensual con solemnidades, fiestas y memorias
• Buscador de celebraciones
• Ajustes según el país (Epifanía, Ascensión y Corpus Christi)

RITUAL Y ORACIONAL
• Ritual propio de la Orden
• Oracional con las oraciones de la comunidad

FAMILIA RECOLETA
• Fiestas propias de la Orden y próximas celebraciones
• Cumpleaños de los religiosos
• Intenciones de oración y guía de uso

Disponible en español, inglés, portugués e italiano.

App de uso interno para los religiosos y comunidades de la Orden de Agustinos Recoletos. El acceso requiere una cuenta institucional @oar.it.

name: Lived Today
description:
One moment a day: “I lived today.”

There are no good or bad days here. A hard day is still a day you lived. Lived Today asks one thing, takes a second, and then gets out of the way.

MY YEAR AS A SUN
Every day of the year is a ray. Press and hold the circle in the middle and it slowly fills; let go and today's ray reaches out in the colour of its season: the grey-blue of a winter sky, fresh-leaf green, ripe-wheat gold, dry-leaf red. Day by day the sun fills up. No numbers, no totals, no goals.

HOW THE DAY WENT
If you wrote a note, the ray's length tells how the day went by: a day that dragged on is long, a day that flowed by is short. Your phone works this out on its own. It never shows up as a word or a score, and it goes nowhere.

ONLY TODAY AND YESTERDAY
Forgot yesterday? Press and hold to add it, the same way. Older days are locked: the mark carries how the day felt then, not how you remember it later.

A LINE FOR MYSELF
Leave a short note if you like. Notes stay on your phone and in your own iCloud, encrypted. They never reach a server. Run your finger over the sun to read any day of the year, and swipe left or right in an open note to move between days.

FRIENDS, QUIETLY
Invite friends with a link or a code. If you lived the day, you appear in each other's “Today” strip; a friend can see your last 7 days. Never your notes, never your year, never a count.

NO PRESSURE
No streaks, no reminders, no notifications, no ads, no tracking. No account: just your first and last name. Moving to a new iPhone, everything comes back on its own.

My years: past years stay, each with its own sun.

Available in English, Turkish, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Spanish and German.

name: LocalConvert: File Converter
description:
Convert any file right on your iPhone or iPad. LocalConvert turns HEIC into JPG, MOV into MP4, photos into PDF and 100+ other formats — and compresses, trims and edits them too. Everything happens on your device: no uploads, no account, works offline.

DO SEVERAL THINGS AT ONCE
Pick a format, then stack changes: make it smaller, resize, crop, trim, mute or remove location. LocalConvert does it all in one pass — your file is read once and saved once, so combining changes never costs extra quality. You see the estimated size before you start.

ONE-TAP RECIPES
• Email-ready — photos and videos sized to send
• Messaging — sharp but small for chats
• Web-ready — WebP and 1080p for websites
• Discord (10 MB) — videos that fit the upload limit
• Works everywhere — JPG, MP4 and M4A for any device
• Share privately — strip location before you share
Save your own settings as a recipe and reuse them on any batch.

CONVERT 100+ FORMATS
• Photos: HEIC, JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, TIFF, BMP, JPEG 2000, ICO and 24 camera RAW formats
• Video: MOV, MP4, M4V, 3GP — plus video to GIF or audio (M4A, WAV)
• Audio: MP3, M4A, WAV, AIFF, FLAC, AAC, M4R ringtones
• Documents: PDF, Word, Pages, RTF, HTML, Markdown, plain text
• Data & subtitles: CSV, JSON, XML, YAML, SRT, VTT
• Archives & 3D: ZIP, TAR, GZIP, OBJ, STL, USDZ

COMPRESS WITHOUT GUESSWORK
Shrink videos to fit email, WhatsApp or Discord — choose 10, 20, 50 or 100 MB and LocalConvert hits the size. Make photos and PDFs smaller while keeping them sharp. If a file can't get smaller, you keep the original.

EDIT & CUT
• Trim videos and audio, frame by frame
• Make GIFs from any moment of a video
• Crop, rotate, flip and resize photos
• Extract audio, mute videos, grab a still frame
• Make custom iPhone ringtones with fade in and out

PDF TOOLS
Turn photos and scans into one PDF, merge PDFs, split pages, reorder and rotate pages, compress PDFs, and export pages as images or text.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your files never leave your device. No uploads, no servers, no sign-up, no tracking. Remove GPS location and camera details from photos before you share them.

BUILT FOR iPHONE AND iPAD
Open files from Photos, the Files app or the share sheet, convert whole batches at once, and save results to Photos or Files. A clean, calm design that never gets in your way.

Questions or a format you need? Visit our support page — we read every message.

name: Lone Flame
description:
LONE FLAME (Yalnız Alev) is a fast-paced 3D arcade space shooter that tests your reflexes and survival instincts across deep space.

TWO GAMEPLAY MODES
• Story Mode (21 Levels): Battle through "Escape" (Levels 1–10) and "Blue Planet" (Levels 11–21) — dodge dense asteroid belts, intercept kamikaze squadrons, clear ring passages, and take down massive Destroyer warships and bosses.
• Endless Flight: Push into deeper sectors with escalating waves, sector guardians, cube rewards, and distance leaderboards.

SHIP UPGRADES & ENERGY CUBES
• Spend your score to upgrade Max Health, Fire Rate, and Movement Speed.
• Collect or purchase Green (Health), Purple (Asteroid Durability), and Yellow (Laser Shield) energy cubes to turn the tide in intense firefights.

ADAPTIVE & CUSTOMIZABLE CONTROLS
• Smooth touch steering tailored for phones.
• Customizable transparent square control pads for tablets and foldables (Dual Pad, Single Left/Right Pad, Split iPhone-style Pad, and 4 vertical height levels in Settings).
• Full Gamepad controller support and automatic rear/front laser defense.

Play in English or Turkish, set your pilot name, climb the level leaderboards, and keep your flame burning in deep space!

name: Lottery Ticket Checker: Scan
description:
Scan your lottery ticket and find out if you won. Point your camera at the ticket and the app checks every line against the official results, lights up the numbers you matched and shows any prize.

GAMES
Powerball and Mega Millions in every state. In California, also SuperLotto Plus, Fantasy 5, Daily 3 and Daily 4.

SCAN OR TYPE
Scan a photo of the ticket, or type the numbers in on a big number pad. Typing works for crumpled or faded tickets, and typing tickets in is always free.

TICKETS THAT CHECK THEMSELVES
Saved tickets stay on your phone and are checked again after every drawing they cover, including multi-draw tickets.

FREE
Your first 5 scans, unlimited typed-in tickets and results checks.

PRO
Up to 30 scans a day, results alerts when each drawing on your tickets is posted, a yearly won-and-spent summary, and office pools that split a ticket between people and show each person's share. Choose monthly, yearly or a one-time lifetime purchase. Monthly and yearly plans renew automatically until you cancel in Settings, your name, Subscriptions. Cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. No free trial.

PRIVATE
Ticket photos are sent to our server only to read the numbers, then deleted. No account, no tracking, no ads.

This app is not affiliated with any lottery. Always confirm a winning ticket with your lottery before claiming a prize. For players 18 and older.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://plainworkgroups.duckdns.org/privacy/lottery

name: Lucky Turns Around
description:
Follow a winding path through a world of little wonders. In Lucky Turns Around, every roll opens another moment of a colorful storybook adventure.

Explore three hand-crafted lands, from the Clover Meadow to the Azure Coast and the Starlit Garden. Roll the dice, make simple choices along the way, and collect a keepsake from every completed level. Fireflies can help you through a storm, while coins, keys, and daily gifts brighten the next turn.

Your journey includes 18 levels, a treasure shelf to fill, local progress saving, and a gentle pace that lets you play whenever you like. There are no real-money wagers or paid random rewards. Just a cheerful road, a few lucky turns, and a story worth keeping.

name: Luggzy
description:
Packing is a chore. Luggzy turns it into a game.

Every trip gets its own animated scene that builds as you pack. Tick off items and watch luggage drop onto the dock, the gangway swing down and the lights come on. Hit 100% and your ship sounds its horn and sails away with confetti. Flights taxi and take off, trains pull out of the station, road trips drive off down the road, and camping trips light the campfire under the stars. The scenes follow your local time of day and your destination's weather.

PACK SMARTER
• Ready-made lists for cruises, flights, trains, road trips and camping, fully editable
• Quantities worked out from your trip length (7 days = 7 T-shirts)
• Name your bags, give them colours and icons, and see each bag's progress
• "Before you leave the house", "Last-minute" and "Wearing on travel day" lists, plus a return-trip checklist
• Need-to-buy list, optional item photos, search and drag to reorder
• Free AI list builder, powered by Apple Intelligence on your device. Describe your trip and build the list together by chat, or talk hands-free in voice mode and hear it answer back
• Ask for exactly what you want: "add six socks", "make it ten", "take off the umbrella"
• Quick-add several things at once: "socks, charger, sunglasses"
• Save templates, and Luggzy learns after each trip: "Did you forget anything?"

PLAN THE TRIP
• Countdown, destination forecast and a day-by-day forecast for each port or stop
• Itinerary with times, stops and reminders that work at sea, plus a shareable photo card
• Check-in reminders: 24 hours before flights, and a built-in table of cruise-line check-in windows
• "Time to leave" alerts using Apple Maps traffic, and a departure-day Live Activity
• Passport expiry checks (dates only, never document numbers)
• Quiet hours you choose

PACK TOGETHER
• Share a trip with family through iCloud (Luggzy Plus)
• New items start private; swipe to share the ones everyone should see. Shared items anyone can tick, plus assignments ("Dad packs the passports")
• Each person has their own scene and progress, and the family view shows only how ready everyone is
• Add kids without phones, and pets: their own packing list or a pet-sitter checklist and care card

MADE TO BE LOVED
• 24 themes: Soft Cartoon, Comic, 3D Animated Film, Neon, Surrealist, Stop-Motion, Atomic Age, 90s Kids TV and 80s Retro Sci-Fi, plus holiday themes that switch on automatically on the day, with matching app icons
• Apple Watch app for ticking items off with full hands, and a Home Screen widget
• VoiceOver, Dynamic Type and Reduce Motion supported everywhere
• No accounts, no ads, no tracking. Everything stays on your device and in your own iCloud

FREE TO START
Luggzy is free to download with one trip at a time and nearly everything above. Luggzy Plus unlocks family mode, multiple trips, weather packing suggestions, template sharing, iCloud sync, the Apple Watch app, the widget and choosing holiday themes: $0.99 a month, $9.99 a year, or $19.99 once. All plans support Apple Family Sharing. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period; manage them in your Apple Account settings.

The AI list builder requires a device with Apple Intelligence. Everything else works on any supported iPhone or iPad.

Privacy Policy: https://michaelmuni.com/Luggzy/privacy.html
Support: https://michaelmuni.com/Luggzy/support.html

name: Lumaword: Daily Word Puzzles
description:
All your daily word puzzles and word games in one app. Every day brings a fresh group-sorting board, a 5-letter word guess, a 5×5 mini crossword, a cryptogram, an emoji rebus and a cryptic crossword clue of the day — a full year of new puzzles, written and checked by hand.

• 6 daily puzzles: Four Threads (16 words, 4 hidden groups), word guess (with a shareable result grid), mini crossword, cryptogram, emoji decode with a Four Frames picture round, cryptic clue (with the answer explained)
• A Sunday big puzzle: a seven-clue acrostic that reveals a hidden quote
• 9 more word games to play any time: letter wheel, fillwords, themed crosswords, word solitaire, clue fragments, tile duels, grid sprints, two-player hangman and Ghost Groups
• Only on Lumaword: Ghost Groups — where a clever "wrong" answer can still score
• Set a word for a real friend and share it by link; practise against friendly practice bots
• Difficulty that grows with you, streaks, streak shields and weekly practice leagues
• Brainpower: a game score that tracks your progress from game to game (a score, not a measure of intelligence)
• Gentle daily reminder — one nudge, never spam
• Plays offline: every puzzle is built into the app, so you need no connection to play

Every game and every daily puzzle is free, with no hearts or limits on the dailies. The longer games use 5 hearts that refill over time.

Lumaword Pro adds the Daily Archive (every past daily puzzle), unlimited hearts, a streak repair each month and 3 free power-ups a day. Prefer to pay once? "Unlimited Hearts Forever" gives you unlimited hearts for good.

Subscription details
Lumaword Pro is an auto-renewing subscription: US$2.99 per month or US$19.99 per year (prices are shown in your local currency in the App Store before you buy). Payment is charged to your Apple ID account when you confirm the purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel any time in Settings › [your name] › Subscriptions. "Unlimited Hearts Forever" is a one-time purchase and does not renew.

Ready? Today's puzzle is waiting.

Lumaword uses the Inter and Tajawal typefaces under the SIL Open Font License 1.1.

Terms of Use: https://beyondplaystudios.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://beyondplaystudios.com/privacy

name: Lumen Galaxy
description:
Lumen Galaxy is a one-thumb flight through a living nebula. Hold anywhere to grab a star and orbit it. Release to slingshot your spark into the dark.

Light stars to refill your light and reveal hidden constellations. Chain hops between new stars for a combo. Time a Perfect Handoff through a binary, ride a pulsar, or shatter a void bloom at speed. As you light the sky, it rises from Dusk to Night to Aurora — new color, more music, and a faster drain. A run lasts about a minute or two, and ends when your light runs out.

Every day brings a Daily Sky: the same seeded layout for everyone, with a named Daily target and three objectives. It rolls over at midnight, America/Chicago (Central Time). Your first three runs of the day count for the Daily; after that, free flight on random skies is unlimited. Keep a streak, earn freeze tokens by playing (they are never sold), and chart every completed constellation in your Star Atlas. Unlock Looks — spark skins and trails — by playing. There are no loot boxes and no pay-to-win.

Lumen Galaxy is free. There are no ads, no in-app purchases, no accounts, and no tracking. Your progress is saved only on this device.

How to play
1. Hold to orbit the nearest star ahead of you. Orbiting lights it and refills your light.
2. Release to slingshot off on the tangent. Hop quickly between new stars to build a chain.
3. Light every star in a dotted shape to flare the constellation and add it to your Star Atlas.

Features
• One-thumb, touch-first controls
• A seeded Daily Sky, streaks, and daily objectives
• Star Atlas and earnable Looks
• Haptic cues and a reactive soundtrack
• Plays fully offline
• Share a result card from the game-over screen

name: Lumewell
description:
Your screen is a pane of glass. Behind it is the ocean — real depth, sunlight falling through in swaying beams, specks that drift and glint like gems where the light fades — and a jellyfish that lives there, drawn entirely in glowing characters.

You can't steer it. It has a life of its own: it explores, rests, drifts off until it is only a breathing point of light far below, and comes back.

But it can notice you.

• Knock on the glass. A ripple runs across it. Far away, the light stops, turns and — if it wants to — swims toward you, growing from a point into a creature of a thousand characters, until it stops just behind the glass and looks out.
• Hold your finger on the glass to make a soft light. It may follow it.
• Draw slowly. It may follow your finger.
• Drop in some food and watch it drift down.
• Knock too hard and it backs away. Give it a moment.

Trust grows slowly, over days — never lost, never rushed. A wary stranger keeps its distance. A familiar one comes when you knock. A close one comes to the window by itself to greet you, lingers, and touches the glass where your finger is.

Give it a name. Keep a journal of the moments you share.

Tilt your phone and the water shifts like the view through a real window. Everything you see — the jellyfish, its tentacles, the plankton, the light — is made of characters, rendered live on your iPhone.

LUMEWELL PLUS (optional)
More ocean, and more ways to be together: four new waters (moonlit, dusk, polar and the abyss) and a sea that follows your sky from dawn to night; four rare forms, one that slowly turns through every colour, and the freedom to change its colours any time; painting with light — glowing plankton stays where your finger passes, and it comes to graze along the trail; calling it by name with two fingers on the glass; your light in gold, rose, violet or every colour; soundscapes of rain and whales; and a window that can stay open on your desk. Everything that is free today stays free, and trust can't be bought: it still grows only with time together.
Plus is available yearly (with a one-week free trial for new subscribers), monthly, or once for life. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; payment is charged to your Apple Account. Manage or cancel in Settings › Apple Account › Subscriptions.

No account, no ads, no tracking. Works offline.
Lumewell is part of BoniStudio's ASCII series, alongside Bloomspire.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Lythe
description:
Lythe — Leave Your Thought Here.

The fastest way to catch a thought before it's gone, and the simplest way to make sure it gets done.

JOT IT DOWN
Open Lythe and the keyboard is ready. Type, hit return: the note lands on your day at the exact time you wrote it. Lists and checkboxes when you need them, a star for what matters.

EVERY THOUGHT IN ITS MOMENT
Your notes live on a time bar. Swipe through your day note by note and the bar glides with you, so you always know when something happened.

SEND IT WHERE IT GETS DONE
One tap sends a note to Reminders or Calendar, with the date and time you choose. Or hand it to Notes, Mail, Messages, Notion, Todoist, Things, Obsidian, WhatsApp, Telegram, Gmail, Slack and more. Lythe shows in color the apps you actually have.

NOTHING SLIPS AWAY
A note stays pending until you send it on or mark it done. Every evening your recap shows what's still open — today and on earlier days — with important notes first. Export it as a PDF or an image.

CAPTURE ANYWHERE
"Hey Siri, jot in Lythe", the Action button, or a Shortcut on your Lock Screen.

YOURS
Eight accent colors and three app icons. No account, no ads, no tracking: your notes stay on your iPhone.

Made by Restaino Lab.

name: M4R Partners
description:
M4R Partners is the app for the local businesses that rent mobility equipment through Motion4rent: mobility scooters, manual and electric wheelchairs, rollators and other mobility aids. Handle your reservations and keep your stores up to date from your phone, wherever you are.

The app is for Motion4rent partners only: sign in with the same partner account you use on the Motion4rent website. Not a partner yet? You can join at motion4rent.com.

YOUR DAY AT A GLANCE
• Reservations pending confirmation, soonest first, with a Confirm button
• Upcoming deliveries for the next 24 hours and the next 7 days, in your store’s local time
• For hotel deliveries, “Mark as delivered”: the customer gets an email saying the equipment is waiting at reception
• “I’m running late”: email the customer your own message when a delivery will be later than planned
• A monthly summary with confirmed reservations, amounts, cancellations, rating and most rented products

NEW RESERVATION ALERTS
• A notification as soon as a new reservation comes in
• Tap it to open the reservation and reply before the request expires

RESERVATIONS
• Search and filter by status, booking date, rental dates, delivery type, store, product or customer
• Dates, delivery point, products, extras and booking conditions on one screen
• Accept or reject a request: the customer and your store are notified automatically
• The customer’s contact details appear once you accept
• Download the reservation PDF

CALENDAR
• Current and upcoming reservations, color-coded by status

YOUR STORES
• Store information, contact details, payment methods and store pick-up
• Opening hours and closing days
• Rates and seasons, with each product’s price for every season
• Extras and delivery points for each product
• Closed dates when a product is not available
• New products with their photos

CUSTOMER REVIEWS
• Your customers’ ratings and comments, with your average scores

FINANCE
• A summary of your reservations with commission, net amount and payment status
• The invoices issued by Motion4rent, ready to download

MY ACCOUNT
• Your business and contact details, and your password

Available in English, Spanish, Italian, French, German, Portuguese, Dutch, Chinese and Japanese.

Questions about the app or your account? Write to the Motion4rent team at info@motion4rent.com.

name: Mabel: Unicorn Dostum
description:
Bir yumurta parlıyor… ve içinden minik, gökkuşağı yeleli bir unicorn çıkıyor! Ona bir isim ver ve pastel renkli adasında onunla ilgilen.

UNICORN'UNA BAK
• Besle: "Ne yesin?" menüsünden seç. Çorba sağlığa iyi gelir, ana yemek enerji verir, tatlı çok mutlu eder. Üçünü birden yerse harika bir öğün olur! Ama dikkat: çok yerse ya da arka arkaya çok tatlı yerse midesi bozulur.
• Uyut: Yorulunca kısa bir şekerleme yapar, enerjisi dolunca kendiliğinden uyanır.
• Oyna: İki mini oyundan birini seç.
• İlaç: Hastalanırsa ilacını ver, hemen kendine gelsin.

İKİ MİNİ OYUN
• Yavruları Topla: Adada zıplayan renkli yavru unicorn'lara dokun; anne unicorn koşup onları toplasın!
• Yıldız Yakala: Ekranda beliren gülümseyen yıldızları yakala.
Oynamak mutlu eder ama acıktırır ve yorar; birkaç oyundan sonra unicorn'un yemek ister.

NE YAPMALIYIM?
En acil ihtiyacın butonu zıplayarak parlar: acıkınca Besle, yorulunca Uyut, sıkılınca Oyna. Okumayı yeni öğrenen çocuklar için mesajlar sesli okunur.

DÖRT GÖSTERGE
Tokluk, Enerji, Mutluluk ve Sağlık. Unicorn'unun nasıl hissettiğini yüzünden ve hareketlerinden anlarsın: mutluyken gülümser, uyurken başının üstünde Zzz'ler uçuşur, hastayken solgunlaşır ve başında küçük bir bulut belirir.

GECE VE GÜNDÜZ
Oyun telefonun saatini takip eder. Gece olunca adada yıldızlar ve ay çıkar, unicorn'un da uyumak ister.

UYGULAMA KAPALIYKEN DE YAŞAR
Uygulamayı kapattığında unicorn'un yaşamaya devam eder, geri geldiğinde ona yine bakarsın. Göstergeler hiçbir zaman sıfırın altına inmez ve unicorn'un asla ölmez; çocuklar gönül rahatlığıyla oynayabilir.

SES VE DİL
Sevimli efekt sesleri ve sesli mesajlar; tek dokunuşla sesi kapatabilirsin. Telefonun dili İngilizceyse oyun da İngilizce olur.

ÇOCUKLAR İÇİN GÜVENLİ
• İnternet bağlantısı gerekmez
• Reklam yok
• Uygulama içi satın alma yok
• Hesap açma, giriş yapma yok
• Hiçbir kişisel veri toplanmaz

Minik bir dostun bakımını üstlenmenin keyfini çıkar!

name: MahjongTeacher
description:
Never feel left behind at the mahjong table.
Your friends play American mahjong. You'd love to join them, but the tiles, the card and the passing all look like a foreign language, and you don't want to be the one who slows the game down.
MahjongTeacher takes you from "I've never seen a tile" to playing a whole game, one small step at a time.
BE THE ONE THEY INVITE BACK
• Know every tile by name. Lesson 1 is free, with a test that makes sure you know all 36.
• Understand every word your friends say: pair, pung, kong, Charleston, call, Joker.
• Read the card yourself, without asking anyone what it means.
• Set up your wall and take your tiles without being told how.
• Pass the right way in the Charleston, the round that confuses every beginner.
• Take your turn without holding up the game.
• Know which tile to throw away, every single turn.
• Know the moment you've won, and who pays what.
• Play a whole game yourself before you sit at a real table.
YOU LEARN BY DOING
Every idea is followed straight away by practice. You answer, you get it right, and only then do you move on.
In the last lesson you play a complete game by tapping. You choose your line, pass, pick, throw, call a tile, swap for a Joker and say "Mahjong". Two more practice games follow.
EASY ON THE EYES
• Simple pictures where they help: the table from above, the wall, which way to pass.
• Tap "Big" on any screen and every word and tile gets larger.
• A cheat sheet to keep beside you at the table.
FREE TO START. PAY ONCE.
Lesson 1, its tile test and a preview of your first game are free. One purchase unlocks the other eight lessons, the practice games and the cheat sheet for good. No subscription. No ads.
NO ACCOUNT NEEDED
There is nothing to sign up for. Your progress is saved on your phone and in your own iCloud, so it comes with you to a new phone.
GOOD TO KNOW
MahjongTeacher teaches American-style mahjong, the game played with a yearly card of hands, Jokers and the Charleston. To play at a real table you will need your group's current card. The app teaches you how to read one, using practice lines of its own.
MahjongTeacher is an independent learning app. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the National Mah Jongg League.
In-app purchase
• Type: Non-Consumable
• Product ID: com.troylee.tableready.fullcourse
• Price: $14.99
• Display name (11 of 30): Full Course
• Description (43 of 45): 8 more lessons, 3 games and the cheat sheet

name: Maille Join
description:
Maille Join keeps one cloth and its closed rings on this iPhone.

Drag an open ring through exactly two neighboring closed rings and the ring joins. One ring hangs and springs back. Three rings, or two that are not neighbors, tangle and spring back. A joined ring stays shut.

Name a cloth, rename it, delete one, and share the name and the mark.

Cloths stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy. This does not weave a real garment.

name: Maisie: Network Detective
description:
Maisie shows you what's connected to your network, and stays out of your business while it does.

Tap Scan and Maisie finds the devices on the Wi-Fi network you're joined to (or a wired network, with a USB-C Ethernet adapter): phones, laptops, TVs, speakers, printers, cameras, smart plugs and lights, hubs, access points, servers, the router. It names them from what they say about themselves (Bonjour names and services, host names, the web page or certificate they serve, the SSH key they present) and always shows its working: every guess comes with the clues it used and how sure it is. If it's wrong, give the device your own name or type and Maisie remembers it.

WHAT CHANGED
Each scan is kept on your device, so Maisie can tell you what's new, what's gone and what moved since last time, and keep a history you can look back through, by place if you like. Open an old scan to see every device as it was then.

KNOWN DEVICES
Mark the devices you recognise as known. After that, Maisie points out any device it hasn't seen before, and any port that has newly opened on a known device, at the top of the list. If a device turns up at a familiar address but now shows a different name, Maisie asks whether it is the same device rather than guessing.

THINGS TO LOOK AT
Maisie points out what's worth a second look in what it already found: an old unencrypted service left open, a printer offering file transfer, an expired or self-signed certificate. Each one says why it matters and what you could do. A router checkup looks at your router from inside your network. Port-scan any device on your network: 118 common ports, the top 1,000, or every port up to 65,535.

CHECK FROM OUTSIDE
Each scan notes your network's public address (one DNS question to Cloudflare's 1.1.1.1; you can turn it off). Later, from mobile data or another Wi-Fi, Check from outside shows which ports of that network the internet can reach, and what has opened or closed since your last check.

TOOLS
Ping, traceroute, DNS lookup and whois for any host you type, a route check, and an Internet connection check that tells you your public IP address and provider, only when you ask.

REPORTS
Export a scan as CSV, JSON, a PDF or PNG diagram, or Mermaid text. Looking after someone else's network? Add a client name and notes to a site and share one PDF site report: devices, changes, things to look at and the latest checks. Files go only where you send them.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads, no analytics, no tracking. 
• Scans, names and history never leave your device. Nothing is sent to us; we have no server. 
• Maisie only looks at the network you're on (and any you add yourself). 
• Apple Intelligence explanations, where available, run on your device and are clearly labelled.

ALSO 
• Works on iPhone and iPad, with a sidebar layout on iPad. 
• A Home Screen widget with your device count and how many aren't marked known (never addresses). 
• Siri and Shortcuts: ask what's new, or run "Scan Network and Report New Devices" from an automation, with an optional notification when something new turns up. 
• Four app icons to choose from.

Maisie works within iOS's rules: iOS doesn't let apps see device hardware (MAC) addresses, so Maisie identifies devices from what they announce instead. Some devices stay quiet; Maisie says so rather than guessing. iOS also doesn't let apps scan in the background, so scans run while Maisie is open.

name: Manabig オフライン翻訳・同時通訳・文字起こし
description:
翻訳、同時通訳、文字起こしを、ひとつのアプリで。

Manabigは、会話や会議、旅行の言葉を端末内で扱うためのアプリです。必要な言語・モデル・音声データを事前に準備すると、対応する機能をオフラインで使用できます。翻訳や文字起こしの本文をクラウドの翻訳サービスへ送信しません。

■ WORD：文章を翻訳
入力した文章や音声認識した文章を翻訳できます。標準の文字翻訳は58言語に対応し、無料で使えます。原文と訳文を確認し、利用できる端末内音声で読み上げられます。

■ LIVE：話の区切りごとに翻訳
話した内容を文字として追い、区切りごとに選択した言語へ標準翻訳します。読み上げは、表示された訳文から利用できます。

■ DICTATE：音声を文字に
対応する端末内音声認識で、話した内容を文字にします。

■ 高精度翻訳は任意の買い切りオプション
WORDの高精度翻訳は、日本では980円の1回限りの購入で利用できます。月額料金や自動更新はありません。購入済みの場合は購入の復元に対応します。地域によって価格が異なるため、購入画面の表示をご確認ください。高精度・速さ重視・CPU方式を選べます。使用するモデルによって対応言語、必要な容量、処理速度が異なります。標準翻訳・LIVE・DICTATEは無料です。

■ 初回の準備と音声の対応について
モデルの初回ダウンロード、購入・復元、一部SDKの診断情報送信には通信を使います。モデルの準備はWi-Fiとモバイルデータの両方に対応します。端末内音声認識と読み上げの対応言語は、機種、OS、インストール済みの音声データによって異なり、文字翻訳の対応言語すべてで音声を使えるわけではありません。Appleが提供する読み上げ音声は、端末の設定から準備してください。

音声認識や翻訳には誤りが生じる場合があります。重要な日時、否定、数量、医療などの内容は原文と照らし合わせてご確認ください。iPhone・iPad、iOS／iPadOS 18以降に対応します。

name: Manitas: Easy Crafts
description:
Rainy afternoon and nothing to do? Look in the drawer: a cardboard tube becomes an owl.

Manitas suggests simple crafts made from what is usually at home. Tell it what you have (tubes, paper plates, egg cartons, bottles, clothes pegs, yarn…) and it shows you what you can make today, step by step, with every step in 3D so children see it before they do it.

• 60 crafts: animals, toys that really work, gifts, room decorations and the year's celebrations (Christmas, Halloween, Easter, birthdays).
• Step by step in 3D: the card pieces fly into place, the scissors snip and the glue drips. Turn it with your finger.
• Busy-hands mode: big steps and a screen that stays on while you glue.
• Printable templates at real size (A4 or Letter) for the crafts with cut-out pieces.
• Each craft says the age, the time, how messy it is and what a grown-up should do.
• The wall: stick on a photo of what you made.

Nine crafts are free and complete. All 60 unlock with a single payment: no subscription, no ads, shared with Family Sharing.

Manitas collects no data. Your photos stay on your device.

name: MAPPHOTOS: Camera Roll Map
description:
Put your camera roll on a map. MAPPHOTOS places every photo and video you have taken where you took it, so a trip, a city or a single afternoon is one tap away. Your roll is read on this phone and never uploaded.

See your friends' moments where they happened. Their photos sit on the map as small photo cards with their name and the place. Cards taken at the same spot stack together; tap a stack to open the newest, swipe to see the rest, and tap Directions to get there in Apple Maps.

Post a photo, a short video or a note to a place. You choose how precise the place is: the exact spot, the area around it, or only the city. Exact posts show as the area for the first hour. Nobody sees where you are right now, and nothing runs in the background.

Walk your map through time. Pick a year or a month and the map shows only what happened then.

What is in the app:
- Map: your roll and friends' posts as photo cards, with a card for the one you pick
- Feed: friends' posts, newest first
- Camera: take a photo or video and pin it
- Profile: your posts, friends and requests, privacy settings

You can report or block anyone, and delete your account and posts from Profile at any time.

name: Marabo
description:
Marabo rassemble en un seul endroit les opportunités qui comptent : emplois, stages, bourses, concours, formations et appels à candidatures, en Côte d’Ivoire et partout en Afrique.

Chaque jour, le radar Marabo parcourt les sites d’emploi, les institutions internationales, les agences publiques et les entreprises pour toi. Tu n’as plus besoin de visiter dix sites : tout arrive dans ton fil, trié et à jour.

POUR LES CANDIDATS
• Toutes les opportunités au même endroit : emplois, stages, bourses, concours, freelance, consultance, intérim, certificats et offres des institutions internationales.
• Filtre par catégorie et par pays pour ne voir que ce qui t’intéresse.
• Ne rate plus aucune date limite : compte à rebours sur chaque offre, rubrique « Clôture bientôt » et rappel dans ton calendrier en un geste.
• Un résumé clair de chaque annonce grâce à Marabo IA.
• Des alertes personnalisées selon tes centres d’intérêt, et une notification dès qu’une offre te correspond.
• Postule directement aux offres des entreprises depuis l’application, avec ton CV et ta lettre de motivation.
• Suis tes candidatures et discute avec les recruteurs dans l’onglet Messages.
• Reçois les invitations aux entretiens et confirme-les en un geste.
• Garde tes offres préférées dans tes favoris.

POUR LES ENTREPRISES ET LES RECRUTEURS
• Publie tes annonces et touche des milliers de jeunes talents.
• Reçois les candidatures, classées selon tes propres critères : compétences, niveau d’études, expérience.
• Échange avec les candidats, planifie les entretiens et suis chaque étape du recrutement.
• Trouve des profils dans la CVthèque anonyme et invite-les à postuler.
• Consulte les statistiques de tes annonces.
Les entreprises sont vérifiées par l’équipe Marabo avant de pouvoir publier, pour protéger les candidats contre les fausses annonces.

TA SÉCURITÉ ET TA VIE PRIVÉE
• Ton âge et ton adresse e-mail ne sont jamais transmis aux recruteurs.
• Ta visibilité auprès des recruteurs reste désactivée tant que tu ne l’actives pas.
• Signale une annonce suspecte ou bloque une conversation en un geste.
• Supprime ton compte et toutes tes données à tout moment depuis ton profil.
Rappel : sur Marabo, on ne paie jamais pour postuler.

Marabo est gratuit pour tous les candidats.

Une question ou une suggestion ? Écris-nous depuis l’application, rubrique Aide.

name: Maxwell ADE for Claude Code
description:
Maxwell is an ADE, an agentic development environment: the Mac app where your coding agents work. This app shows the Claude Code sessions running in Maxwell on your Mac, and lets you answer them from your iPhone. Maxwell itself is free and open source.

Your sessions show up in the same groups as on your Mac: Needs you, Your turn, Working, Limited and Safe to close. Open one to read the conversation, or switch to its live terminal.

From your phone you can:
- Approve or deny a permission prompt
- Reply by typing, with a quick reply, or by dictation
- Open a session's artifacts, signed in to the right claude.ai account
- See the 5-hour and weekly usage of each Claude account
- Move a session that hit its limit to the account with the most room left
- Start a new session, or close one that is safe to close

When a session needs you, you get a notification. It doesn't say what the session is about unless you choose to show that.

Privacy
You pair your phone by scanning a code on your Mac, then allow it there. Everything between the two is end-to-end encrypted, and the relay that connects them can't read it. There is no account, no tracking, no analytics and no ads. You can lock the app with Face ID.

You need Maxwell 0.1.63 or later on your Mac. It's free at runmaxwell.com. To look around first, tap Try a demo: it shows invented sessions and needs no Mac.

Maxwell is an independent project, not made by or affiliated with Anthropic. Claude and Claude Code are trademarks of Anthropic.

name: mecSI: Mühendislik Formülleri
description:
mecSI, mühendislik öğrencileri için formülleri oyunla öğreten bir çalışma uygulamasıdır. Akışkanlar Mekaniği, Termodinamik ve Isı Transferi derslerinin tüm müfredatı tek uygulamada.

NELER VAR?
• 3 ders, 211 formül kartı: her formül çizimiyle, sembolleriyle, günlük hayattan bir örnekle ve sık yapılan hatalarla.
• Yüzlerce görselli soru: her sorunun kendi çizimi ve adım adım çözümü var.
• Tablolar sorunun içinde: buhar, hava, su ve malzeme tabloları; ihtiyacın olan satır vurgulu.
• Vize ve final provaları: gerçek sınav tarzında, çok aşamalı problemler; sorular 2 haftada bir yenilenir.
• Görevler: gerçek hayattan hikâyelerle hesap yap.
• Hata avcısı: çözümdeki yanlış adımı bul, en sık hataları öğren.
• Robot düellosu ve günlük sorular: seriyi koru, seviye atla.
• Arkadaş ekle: 8 karakterlik kodunu paylaş, arkadaşlarınla canlı sıralamada yarış.
• Bilim insanları takımı: Arşimet’ten Planck’a; her biri yeni bir soru paketi açar.
• Araçlar: mühendis hesap makinesi, birim dönüştürücü, termodinamik ve ısı transferi tabloları, diyagramlar, not defteri.
• Türkçe, İngilizce ve Almanca arayüz; açık ve koyu tema.

İNTERNETSİZ ÇALIŞIR
Tüm dersler, sorular ve tablolar cihazında. Yalnızca arkadaş sıralaması için internet gerekir.

mecSI+
Tek seferlik 99,90 ₺, abonelik yok: vize ve finallere reklamsız ve sınırsız giriş, reklamsız ödüller (2× XP, ipucu), haftada bir seri kalkanı, günlük sandıkta 2 kat ödül, altın profil ve mecSI+ rozeti, tüm paketlerde %50 fazla.

DİŞLİ VE İPUCU PAKETLERİ
Cep Kiti, Atölye Kasası ve Laboratuvar Sandığı ile daha fazla bilim insanı aç, ipucuyla takılma.

Sorular ve tablolar özgündür; tüm sayılar standart mühendislik bağıntılarıyla hesaplanır.

name: Meloify
description:
Học tiếng Anh mà không cần "ngồi học".

Meloify biến tiếng Anh thành thứ cậu muốn mở ra mỗi ngày: trò chuyện với những nhân vật cậu thích, xem những câu chuyện ngắn 2–5 phút, và tiếng Anh tự thấm vào lúc nào không hay.

TRÒ CHUYỆN VỚI NHÂN VẬT AI
• Mỗi nhân vật có tính cách, câu chuyện và cảm xúc riêng. Mối quan hệ của hai người lớn dần qua từng tin nhắn.
• Nhắn bằng chữ hoặc bằng giọng nói. Câu trả lời có cả tiếng Việt và tiếng Anh, cậu chọn cách hiển thị hợp với mình.
• Chạm vào một câu tiếng Anh để xem "Người bản xứ nói vậy vì sao?": câu dịch từng chữ sai ở đâu, người bản xứ thật sự nói thế nào, kèm mẹo nhỏ và giọng đọc mẫu.
• Lưu những câu hay vào Sổ tay để ôn lại.

CHẾ ĐỘ HỌC (LEARNING MODE)
• Nhân vật lồng vào cuộc trò chuyện các lượt nghe, đọc, nói và viết, đúng trình độ của cậu (A1 đến C2).
• Mỗi lượt được chấm điểm theo 4 kỹ năng. Đủ điểm cả 4 kỹ năng là lên trình độ tiếp theo.
• "Tiếng Anh hôm nay" tổng kết những gì cậu đã học trong ngày.

CHUYỆN NGẮN
• Những đoạn chat ngắn kiểu Messenger, chạm để xem tin tiếp theo, có cả tin nhắn thoại.
• Thích nhân vật nào thì bấm "Nhắn tiếp" để trò chuyện tiếp với chính nhân vật đó.

TỰ TẠO NHÂN VẬT
• Tạo nhân vật của riêng cậu theo từng bước, thử chat ngay, rồi chia sẻ cho mọi người.

VÀ CÒN NỮA
• Coin miễn phí mỗi ngày để trò chuyện.
• Nhắc nhẹ mỗi tối để giữ thói quen.
• Góp ý trực tiếp cho đội ngũ Meloify ngay trong app.

Meloify dành cho những ai từng bỏ dở các app học tiếng Anh vì thấy mệt và chán. Ở đây, cậu chỉ cần trò chuyện, phần tiếng Anh để Meloify lo.

Điều khoản sử dụng: https://meloify.vn/terms.html
Chính sách quyền riêng tư: https://meloify.vn/privacy.html

name: Memory Link: Save for Later
description:
Where did I save that link? Next time a friend sends you a recipe, a video or a GIF, tap Share and choose Memory Link. It lands in your library. Already copied the link? Tap + to paste it.

Find it your way
Search by title, note or source. Or make a filter called “Recipes to try” and pick your favorite cooking sites. New links from those sites will show up in that filter automatically.

Keep the pictures and the soundtrack
Save photos, animated GIFs and MP3 files. Play audio right in the app. Links get colorful cards created on your device. Give a link your own title or choose a photo for its cover. YouTube videos open in YouTube or your browser. Add a note to any item and share it again when someone asks for it.

From iPhone to iPad
Your library works offline. Sign in to the same iCloud account to sync saved items and filters across your devices.

The free pocket holds 30 items in total. If it starts to feel snug, a one-time Pro purchase unlocks unlimited saves. As for the little pocket holding a coffee? Give it a tap.

name: MES Copy Text
description:
Save the texts you paste again and again, and copy them with one tap.

Email replies, your address, links, hashtags, video descriptions, code snippets, signatures: paste or type them once, then tap a note whenever you need it and paste it anywhere.

* Tap a note to copy it, or "Paste & save" to keep what is on your clipboard
* Boards to keep things apart (work, social, school...)
* Pin your favourites, give notes colours and drag them into order
* Search across every board
* {date}, {time} and {weekday} are filled in when you copy
* Split a long text into separate notes: title, link, description, hashtags
* Show a note big on screen, or have it read aloud
* Bigger or smaller text, light and dark mode
* Back up everything to a file, or encrypted to your own Hive account

Private: no account, no ads, no tracking. Your texts stay on this phone and work without a connection.

name: MezaTill
description:
MezaTill is a complete business management system for shops, supermarkets, wholesalers, pharmacies, salons, bakeries and service businesses. It brings everything you need to run your business into one place: selling, stock, purchases, expenses, customers, staff and accounting. Use it on your phone, and on the web at app.mezatill.com, with the same data on both.

POINT OF SALE
Sell quickly from a picture grid or by scanning barcodes with the camera. Take cash, mobile money, card or several payments in one sale, sell on credit, apply discounts and wholesale prices, hold sales and resume them later. Print receipts on Bluetooth printers or share them on WhatsApp.

WORKS WITHOUT INTERNET
Keep selling when the connection drops. Sales are saved on the phone and sent automatically when you are back online, so you never lose a sale.

PRODUCTS AND STOCK
Manage products with pictures, units, retail and wholesale prices, tax rates and barcodes. Track stock across several stores, move stock between them, count and adjust stock, and get warned when something is running low. Keep consumables and make products from your own recipes.

PURCHASES AND EXPENSES
Record purchases from suppliers, purchase orders, goods received and supplier returns. Pay suppliers in full or in parts. Record expenses with receipt photos.

CUSTOMERS AND INVOICES
Keep customer records with credit limits and statements. See who owes you, send invoices, quotations and proforma invoices, and take payments on debts.

LOYALTY
Reward customers with points, membership tiers, gift cards, coupons and store credit, and run promotions.

SERVICES
Sell services, book appointments and sell service packages.

TILLS AND SHIFTS
Open and close shifts, count cash, record cash in and out, and see any shortage or overage at the end of each shift.

ACCOUNTING
Every sale, purchase and expense goes into your books automatically. See your income statement, ledgers and chart of accounts without doing the bookkeeping by hand.

DASHBOARD AND REPORTS
See today's sales, profit, expenses and best sellers at a glance. Choose from over 60 reports on sales, stock, customers, staff, tax and accounts, and download them as PDF or Excel.

SMS MESSAGES
Send SMS to your customers for reminders, offers and announcements.

STAFF AND PERMISSIONS
Invite staff and give each one a role with exactly what they may see and do. Staff PINs protect sales and money actions, and every action is recorded, so you always know who did what.

SEVERAL BUSINESSES
Run more than one business from one account and switch between them in a tap.

MezaTill helps you know what you sold, what you have, what you owe and what you made, every day.

name: Mile Carrier
description:
Mile Carrier is the app for truck drivers and dispatchers of carriers that run on Mile Carrier. Your company turns on the app for you and gives you your first password.

FOR DRIVERS

Your load, front and center
• See the load you're on: every stop, appointment window and reference number
• A live countdown to your next appointment and your ETA
• One tap to navigate in Apple Maps, call dispatch or send a message
• Slide to mark Picked up and Delivered, so a bump in the cab can't change a load

Paperwork, done at the dock
• Scan your BOL, POD, lumper receipt and other papers with the iPhone's document scanner: edges found, pages straightened, many pages in one go
• Mile Carrier reads what you scanned and tells you right away: "POD, receiver signed", or what to fix, like a missing signature, a missing page or a blurry photo
• See what the load still needs before you leave, so it can be invoiced the same day
• No signal? Your scans wait on the phone and send by themselves

Your pay
• Every settlement, past and present, line by line
• Confirm a settlement, or tell the office what looks wrong, right in the app
• Escrow, what you owe, repeating deductions and your year so far

Everything else
• Messages with dispatch, with quick replies like "Loaded" and "Running late"
• Tasks from the office, with photos when they ask for one
• Your CDL, medical card and other papers, with reminders before they expire
• Ask for time off on a calendar
