• In English, Español, Français, Kreyòl ayisyen, Soomaali or العربية

FOR DISPATCH AND THE OFFICE
• Every driver on one map, by phone or ELD position
• Tap a driver for their route, ETA to the next stop, and whether they'll make the appointment
• Hours of service left, the load they're on, and one-tap call, message or task
• Alerts for late pickups, missing PODs, papers expiring and drivers not sharing location

LOCATION
While you work, Mile Carrier shares your location with your company's dispatch about every 5 minutes, also in the background, so they can plan your loads and answer check calls without calling you. It pauses on your time off and leave, and you can turn it off anytime in More, Location sharing. Your location is only seen by your company and is deleted after 90 days.

Mile Carrier needs an account from your carrier. Ask your dispatcher to turn on the app for you.

name: mimeme – Meme Keyboard
description:
Your memes deserve better than a camera roll.

mimeme is a private vault for the memes you collect. Save them from any app with Share, and mimeme reads the text inside each one — so typing "bat luc" finds "BẤT LỰC THẬT SỰ" instantly, accents or not.

SEND IN TWO TAPS
• The mimeme keyboard works in your chat apps: search, tap, paste.
• Recent, most used and favorites are always on top.
• GIFs stay animated.

FIND ANYTHING
• Text in memes is recognised on your device (English and Vietnamese).
• Add tags and notes; group memes into collections.

WORKS WITH YOUR OTHER APPS
• Optional "mimeme" album so any photo picker can see your memes.
• Browse them in Files, search them in Spotlight, copy your last meme from Shortcuts.

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
• No account needed. Your memes stay on your device.
• The keyboard never records what you type and never goes online.

mimeme Pro (optional)
• Back up every meme and keep the same library on all your devices.
• mimeme Pro Monthly and mimeme Pro Yearly are auto-renewable subscriptions; mimeme Pro Lifetime is a one-time purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; manage or cancel them in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Terms: https://mimeme.uranashel.cloud/terms
Privacy: https://mimeme.uranashel.cloud/privacy

name: MixMK4Stage
description:
MixMK4Stage lets each musician set up their own monitor mix from a phone or tablet, so the sound engineer doesn't have to change it for every request.

It works with Allen & Heath SQ series mixers on the same Wi-Fi network. You sign in with one of the mixer's users, pick one of your Aux mixes, and control what you hear.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
- Set the level, ON/OFF and pan of every channel that sends to your Aux.
- Move the master level and mute of your Aux.
- Mark your own channels with a star. They stay at the top of the list.
- Switch between the mixer's Layers, and give each one a name on your phone.
- Group channels (for example "Drums") and move the whole group with one fader. The differences between channels stay the same.
- Save presets of your mix on the phone and recall them later.
- Keep the screen on while you play.
- Use it upright or on its side, on iPhone and iPad.

WHO CAN DO WHAT
The mixer's own user list decides. A user needs the SQ4You permission to sign in, and sees only the Aux mixes and Layers the mixer allows. The app checks this before it sends anything. An administrator can set up a phone for one user and one Aux, so a band member can't wander into someone else's mix. Passwords are checked on the mixer. "Remember me" keeps a password in the iOS Keychain on that phone only.

TRY IT WITHOUT A MIXER
Tap "Demo mode" on the first screen. You get a sample band, a few users and moving meters, and nothing is sent anywhere.

WHAT YOU NEED
- An Allen & Heath SQ series mixer on the same network as the phone. The app has been tested on an SQ-5. The SQ-6 and SQ-7 are recognized, but have not been tested yet; if the app can't read one of them, it says so.
- Local Network access for the app (iOS asks the first time).
- A free user slot on the mixer.

PRIVACY
The app talks only to the mixer on your local network. It has no account, no ads and no analytics, and it collects no data.

MixMK4Stage is an independent app. It is not affiliated with, approved or sponsored by Allen & Heath. "Allen & Heath", "SQ", "SQ-5", "SQ-6", "SQ-7", "MixPad" and "SQ4You" are trademarks of their respective owners. Use at your own risk.

name: MixtureDock
description:
Turn a material ratio into a quantity sheet you can inspect and save.

Create a mass or volume recipe with named materials, using parts or percentages. Scale it to a total amount, or fix the amount of one selected component and calculate the rest. Percentage recipes must total exactly 100 before scaling; parts are normalized by their total.

• Review raw quantities and independently rounded material rows.
• Choose a rounding step and see the rounded total and difference.
• Keep the rounding remainder visible instead of silently assigning it to another material.
• Freeze a batch with independent PDF and CSV files.
• Reopen historical batches after editing or deleting a live recipe.
• Convert g and kg, or mL and L, without changing dimensions.

MixtureDock performs general material arithmetic. It supplies no formulations, medical or biological instructions, compatibility checks or safety assessments. It does not convert mass to volume or assume a material density.

Recipes and frozen files are stored locally. You choose where to share a report through iOS. Shared copies and system backups are separate from the app's local records.

name: MK IPTV
description:
MK IPTV is a modern player for the IPTV service you already subscribe to. Add your Xtream Codes server, username and password, and browse live TV, movies and series in a clean, cinematic interface.

MK IPTV does not provide any content of its own. To try it right away, a demo playlist with one live channel, Al Quran Al Kareem TV (Makkah Live), is included; you can delete it at any time. For everything else you need your own subscription from an IPTV provider.

Please watch responsibly: we advise you to watch only modest, halal shows and content.

FEATURES
• Live TV with categories, favorites and a now/next programme guide
• Movies and series with artwork, descriptions, seasons and episodes
• Continue Watching that remembers exactly where you stopped
• Watched marks on episodes
• Download movies and episodes to watch offline
• Multiple playlists
• AirPlay and picture-in-picture
• Optional sync between your devices with Sign in with Apple or a link code, with playlist passwords end-to-end encrypted
• No ads and no tracking. No account needed.

name: Modcirque
description: Modcirque on korttipohjainen strategiapeli, joka rakentuu 13-pisteisen syklisen laskujärjestelmän ympärille. Valitse yhdestä kolmeen korttia ja osu tavoitteeseen laskemalla niiden summa kehällä. Hyödynnä samaa maata olevia kortteja ja kehäsuoria kohdatessasi vähitellen avautuvia vastustajia. Kokeile yhdistelmiä koelavalla, päättele kehäaseman piilotettu sääntö ja pura tarpeettomat kortit uuden kortin valmistusaineiksi. Päivänkoitos ja laitteelle tallentuva taisteluhistoria tarjoavat uusia tavoitteita ja auttavat seuraamaan omia ratkaisuja.

name: Mohac Cube Atlas: Roll Puzzle
description:
Mohac Cube Atlas is a puzzle game with a one-sentence rule that keeps you thinking for hours: roll the block and drop it upright into the gold-rimmed hole.

As it rolls, the block stands up, then lies down, changing the space it covers with every turn. Step off the island and it falls. Finding the right sequence is up to you.

● 10 worlds, 1,000 levels: from Meadow Isles to Star Citadel
● A different sky and ground in every world
● New tiles: cracked tiles that only hold a flat block, directional rails, and pillars you can only stand on
● Match the par for 3 stars
● Unlimited undo, hints when you're stuck
● Daily chest: finish 3 new levels each day for a reward
● Swipe to roll; turn on arrow buttons in Settings if you prefer
● Calm, original soundtrack
● Plays offline; progress stays on your device

Replaying finished levels never costs energy.

Free to play, with ads and optional in-app purchases:
● Cube Atlas Pro (one-time): ad-free forever, unlimited energy
● No Ads · Monthly (auto-renewable subscription): removes between-level ads
● Hint and energy packs

Subscription info: payment for the No Ads monthly subscription is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. It renews automatically every month at the same price unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

Privacy Policy: https://kupatlasi.mohacmedya.com/privacy/
Terms of Use (EULA): https://kupatlasi.mohacmedya.com/terms/

name: MojGrad Net
description:
Sve o tvom gradu i općini na jednom mjestu.

MojGrad Network povezuje lokalne novosti, nadolazeća događanja i turističke informacije iz gradova i općina diljem Hrvatske. Odaberi svoje mjesto i istraži sadržaj koji te zanima.

• Čitaj novosti i prati događanja u gradovima i općinama.
• Istraži smještaj, gastronomiju, znamenitosti i aktivnosti.
• Spremi novost, događanje ili lokaciju te čitaj uspješno preuzetu kopiju bez interneta.
• Postavi lokalni podsjetnik približno sat vremena prije događanja.
• Pronađi najbliži grad u mreži, uz dobrovoljno dopuštenje za lokaciju.
• Podijeli zanimljiv sadržaj putem opcija svojeg uređaja.

Registracija nije potrebna. Spremljeni sadržaj i odabrani grad ostaju na uređaju. Lokacija se koristi samo za izračun najbližeg grada na uređaju i ne šalje našem poslužitelju. Pregled sadržaja radi i bez dopuštenja za lokaciju ili obavijesti.

Za offline čitanje prethodno je potrebna internetska veza i uspješno preuzimanje sadržaja. Spremljene kopije mogu sadržavati ranije podatke, stoga termin događanja provjeri kod organizatora. Dostavu i točno vrijeme podsjetnika određuje operativni sustav.

name: Mojobase
description:
AI does the work. You run the business. Mojobase puts your email, team chat, calendar, tasks, files and customers in one app, so Mojo, our AI, can draft your replies, flag what's late and tell you what needs you.

WHAT MOJO DOES FOR YOU
• Writes your replies. You read, change and send.
• Tells you what needs you. Ask "What needs me today?" and get a short answer, linked to the mail, tasks and events behind it.
• Starts your day. Turn it on, and each morning Mojo goes through new mail, the day's calendar and open tasks, drafts replies and flags what's stuck.
• Does what you ask, from any screen. Find an email, add a task or ask a question in one box.

ONE APP FOR YOUR WHOLE BUSINESS
Email, Team chat, Calendar, Tasks, Notes, Files, Handbook, Forms, Customers, Invoices and Numbers. Host email on your own domain, or connect Outlook or Microsoft 365.

YOU STAY IN CHARGE
You choose what Mojo does on its own and what waits for your OK. See changes in Activity, and undo what can be taken back. Each company's data is kept apart from every other's.

ON YOUR IPHONE
Sign in once to reach every company you belong to, and open attachments right in the app.

You need a Mojobase account to use this app.

name: Mokiban
description:
Mokiban es la forma rápida de llevar tus juegos de mesa y tus partidas. Lo tuyo vive en tu teléfono, funciona sin conexión y tiene copia en tu cuenta.

LA LUDOTECA

- Seis estados, un toque: deseado, reservado, en propiedad, en venta, vendido y «no lo tengo». Cambiar de uno a otro es un toque, y se puede deshacer.
- Lo que te costó y lo que recuperaste: precio, tienda y fecha de compra y de venta, con el balance de la colección.
- A quién se lo has dejado: los préstamos, solo para ti.
- Tabla, filas, portadas o cajas, con búsqueda por nombre, autor o tema.
- Las expansiones, dentro de su juego.
- Trae tu hoja de cálculo: cada fila se empareja con su juego y lo ves todo antes de guardar.

LAS PARTIDAS

- Elige el juego, toca a quien ha jugado y escribe los puntos. El ganador sale solo.
- Cronómetro y turno: empieza, baraja el turno, pausa y para; la duración se guarda sola.
- Partidas programadas con quién va, y el día que toca se empiezan desde ahí.
- Tu winrate y un mapa de calor con los días que jugaste.
- La misma partida para toda la mesa: si quien juega contigo también usa Mokiban, la partida es la misma en las dos cuentas. Solo la cambia quien la apuntó; los demás le proponen el cambio y le llega un aviso.

TU AGENDA

- Las quedadas y las partidas a las que vas, en el Calendario del iPhone o en Google Calendar, y al día solas.

name: Mokumocchi: Migraine Tracker
description:
Mokumocchi is a barometric pressure forecast and headache log for people who get headaches or migraines when the weather changes. It shows the pressure for your area hour by hour for the next 72 hours. When your head hurts, one tap on "Headache" logs the time, the pressure at that moment and its 3-hour change; medicine is one tap too. After 5 headache logs your pattern starts to show. With enough logs it finds your alert line — how many hPa (or inHg) of drop in 3 hours tends to come with your headaches — and notifies you when the forecast shows such a drop, and it shows how often those alerts were right (for example 7/10). Logging, alerts and the alert line are free, with ads. Premium (yearly $19.99 with a 7-day free trial, monthly $3.99, or lifetime $39.99) adds an about 10-day pressure forecast, a pressure and headache chart and a report for your doctor (PDF), and removes ads. All records stay only on your iPhone and are never uploaded.

This is not a substitute for a doctor's diagnosis. If a headache is severe or unusual for you, see a doctor.

■ Today
• A 72-hour pressure chart and one line such as "Dropping from around 15:00".
• Mokumocchi, a small cloud, changes its face with the pressure ahead.
• Two buttons: "Headache" and "Took medicine". Undo within 5 seconds. Add severity (mild / moderate / severe), medicine and a note later — all optional.

■ Log
• A monthly calendar shows your headache days. Edit or delete any entry.
• No limit on the number or age of records.
• Changing phones? Export your records to a file and import them on the new iPhone.

■ Patterns and alerts
• Your pattern starts to show after 5 headache logs. After about 10 large pressure drops, you see your alert line (for example −3 hPa in 3 hours) and numbers such as "6 of these 10 drops were followed by a headache within 24 hours".
• The alert line is set automatically, or choose it yourself between 2.0 and 6.0 hPa (0.06–0.18 inHg).
• Alerts arrive 3 hours before such a drop. Set quiet hours (default 23:00–7:00). Long-press an alert to log "Headache" or "No headache" without opening the app.
• Alerts state weather facts only; they never say you will get a headache.

■ Free
72-hour pressure forecast, unlimited headache and medicine logs, alerts, your alert line and alert hit rate, export and import. One banner ad on the Today screen.

■ Premium
• About 10-day pressure forecast
• Pressure and headache chart
• Report for your doctor (PDF): pick a period to get headache count, severity, medicine days, the pressure change at each headache and a calendar on one page
• No ads
Choose yearly ($19.99/year after a 7-day free trial), monthly ($3.99) or lifetime ($39.99). Prices are for the US App Store and vary by country or region.

■ Payment
Yearly and monthly are auto-renewing subscriptions. Payment is charged to your Apple ID when you confirm the purchase. Cancel during the yearly free trial and you pay nothing. A subscription renews automatically for the same period and price unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; renewal is charged within the 24 hours before it ends. Manage or cancel in the iPhone Settings app > your name > Subscriptions. Lifetime is a single payment with no renewal.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://brucechu777.github.io/mokumocchi/privacy.html

■ Weather data and privacy
• Pressure forecasts use data from Apple Weather.
• Location is approximate and used only to set your area. You can deny it and pick your area by name.
• Headache and medicine records stay only on your iPhone. They are not sent to iCloud or to the developer, and are never used for ads. No account needed.
• Pressure shows in inHg when your device region is the US, in hPa elsewhere (changeable in Settings).

name: Mondschaf: Bedtime Routine
description:
Hardly anyone takes a photo before going to bed. Yet these are the moments that fade fastest: the favorite pajamas, the messy hair, the stuffed animal in your arms.

Mondschaf turns it into a little ritual. Every evening a star travels up to your sky, and for each star you keep a photo of the evening. Night after night a sky full of memories grows that would not exist otherwise. Seven stars make a constellation, for example the Star Bunny. The photos stay on your device, with no account and no cloud. If an evening gets skipped, nothing is lost.

THE EVENING, THE SAME EVERY DAY
The Moon Sheep comes down from the moon and walks your family through the evening, step by step: tidy up, pajamas, brush teeth, bathroom, story, count sheep. The sheep says what comes next and shows how it's done. Nobody needs to read.

BRUSHING IN THE MIRROR
Put the phone in the bathroom. The Moon Sheep brushes along in the mirror for two minutes, guided by chewing surfaces, outside, inside. The moon travels around the mirror and shows how long is left, without numbers. At the end the sheep reminds you to brush once more.

THE SCREEN STAYS SECONDARY
The Moon Sheep talks, and the real-life steps happen in the real world. During the story the screen goes dark and only the sound keeps playing.

COUNTING SHEEP
At the end the sheep slowly hop over the fence. The voice gets softer, the screen darker, until it switches off. The music box fades out gently.

TEN LANGUAGES
German, English, Turkish, Kurdish (Kurmancî), Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, Polish and Dutch. The Moon Sheep speaks every one of them, great for families with more than one language.

MADE FOR PARENTS
No ads. No account. No tracking. The evening works in airplane mode too. Purchases and settings sit behind a parent gate in the For grown-ups area. You choose which steps are included and how long the brushing lasts.

FREE
Brushing teeth, the star and photo of the evening, two stories and counting sheep.

MONDSCHAF PLUS
The whole evening with all steps, all the stories and a freely sortable routine. As a one-time purchase or a monthly subscription with a 7 day free trial. Family Sharing included.

The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. You can manage and cancel in your account settings.

Terms of Use: https://mondschaf.vercel.app/en/bedingungen/
Privacy Policy: https://mondschaf.vercel.app/en/datenschutz/

name: Montenegrina: Montenegro guide
description:
Montenegrina is a free guide to Montenegro with no ads: a day-by-day trip planner and a digital passport of the places you have really visited.

PLAN YOUR DAYS
Pick a municipality and the number of days, and Montenegrina builds a plan for each day: places in a sensible order, a map, driving times and directions, plus ideas for spare time. Rearrange the plan, save it, share it with a link or download it as a PDF.

COLLECT STAMPS IN YOUR PASSPORT
Confirm a visit on site and the place goes into your passport. Collect a stamp for each of Montenegro's 25 municipalities, earn points, levels and badges, and climb the leaderboard. Points come only from visits confirmed on site, so everyone plays fair.

DISCOVER
• Nearby: places and stamps around you
• Place cards: swipe and save the places you like
• "Guess where it is": a photo game about Montenegro
• Themed routes, regions and challenges with bonus points

A GUIDE TO ALL OF MONTENEGRO
Hundreds of places, from old towns and beaches to canyons, monasteries, viewpoints and national parks, with photos, stories and practical tips, in Montenegrin, English and Russian.

TRAVEL WITH OTHERS
Public profiles and messages between travellers, with full control over who can write to you. Reporting and blocking keep the community friendly.

YOUR PRIVACY
No ads and no tracking. Your location is used only while the app is open: to confirm a visit or show what is nearby. You can download your data or delete your account in the app at any time.

name: Mood & Mortar
description:
Mood & Mortar is the beautiful home for every idea behind your build, remodel or design project — and the place where homeowners, builders and designers finally see the same vision.

COLLECT WHAT YOU LOVE
• Save photos, videos, notes and product links to boards — one for every room.
• Paste a link to a faucet, light or sofa and Mood & Mortar brings in the photo, store and price.
• Save from Safari, Photos or any app with the iOS share sheet.

PIN SELECTIONS RIGHT ON YOUR PLANS
• Upload a floor plan, elevation, site plan or store layout — even a page from a PDF plan set.
• Tap a room or element to drop a spot, then link the flooring, fixtures, lighting, roofing, paint and finishes that belong there.
• Everyone on the project taps the spot to see exactly what goes where.

DESIGN TOGETHER
• Invite your client, builder or designer to the same project.
• Builders and designers add recommendations; clients love, approve or pass with a tap.
• Track every selection from proposed to approved to ordered.
• Private project chat keeps the conversation next to the inspiration.

PRESENT IT BEAUTIFULLY
• Send a polished presentation of your selections and product schedule to your builder — or anyone — with one link.

FOR EVERY KIND OF PROJECT
New builds, remodels, interior design, kitchens and baths, outdoor living, retail and commercial spaces.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your projects are visible only to the people you invite. Report and block tools keep every project respectful. No ads.

Mood & Mortar is a CCS Developments app, made by people who design and build custom homes.

name: Moonlit Shisen-Sho: Tile Match
description:
"Two bends at most. Connect two matching tiles with red thread."

On the night of the First Full Moon, Tangle the mischievous thread goblin snipped Grandpa Moon's great ball of thread. The red threads that tie every pair in the world scattered like sparks. Join Yeoni, a young embroiderer, and Maggie the magpie on a journey through the four seasons to connect the pairs and bring the red thread back.

■ How to play
· Tap two matching tiles.
· If an empty path with two bends or fewer joins them, both disappear. Paths may run around the outside of the board.
· Every board is checked to be solvable to the end. If you get stuck, we fix it for free, with no penalty.

■ Thread Path — a 300-level story
· A prologue, six chapters and an epilogue: 185 story levels and 28 scenes. Flower Shoe Market, Lotus Pond, the Milky Way Ferry, Windy Fields, Snowy Charcoal Village and the Goblin Woods.
· A new twist in every chapter: currents that slide tiles, darkness that hides them, wind, ice and rocks, and fences that close off the outside path.
· Each chapter ends with one of Tangle's prank boards.
· From Chapter 1 on, every board has a time limit. If time runs out, start over or get more time once per board.
· After the story, 115 more levels continue Beyond the Thread Path.

■ Daily Board
· Everyone gets the same board each day (it changes at midnight Korea time). Keep your streak going.
· Clears on your first try without any help can go on the leaderboards (optional).

■ Practice
· Pick the board size, twist and tile set and play as much as you like, with no time limit.

■ Sewing Room
· Spend the thread you earn on tile faces, board cloths and thread colors.
· A collection of 162 pictures, and every story scene to watch again.

■ Hand-embroidered silk art and Korean traditional music (gayageum, daegeum)

■ Ads and in-app purchases
· A banner ad appears at the bottom of the play screen. Free boards continue while the banner is shown, so they need an internet connection.
· Optional rewarded ads give you extra hints, shuffles and undos, or more time.
· Remove Banner Ads removes the banner and gives rewarded help without ads. With ads removed, you can play without internet for up to 7 days after the last check.
· Ledger of Bonds (+50% thread), Decor Sets Gold Thread and Saekdong. All are one-time purchases, and everything can be earned without buying.

■ Privacy
· Usage statistics and leaderboards are used only if you turn them on in Settings. Players under 16 are not asked.

name: MOTR7
description:
MOTR7 is a UAE platform for everything your car needs.

Parts
• Find the right part for your car from UAE suppliers.
• Add your car once and see compatible parts.
• Request quotes and compare them before you buy.

Workshops and services
• Find workshops and service centres near you.
• Request maintenance, inspections or roadside help.
• Read customer ratings before you choose.

Engineer Khalil
• An AI assistant that answers questions about your car in Arabic and English.
• Helps you identify the part you need and points you to the right service.

Buy and sell vehicles
• Browse listings for cars, motorcycles and caravans.
• Contact sellers through MOTR7 without sharing your phone number.

Your account and privacy
• Sign in with Apple, Google or email.
• Delete your account at any time inside the app.

MOTR7: your car, made easier.

name: MOWUltra
description: MOWUltra provides a simple and intuitive user experience with a clear interface, structured content, and practical features. Users can explore different sections, manage available functions, and interact with various elements through an accessible and user-friendly design.

name: MSX Chat
description:
O MSX é um mensageiro para conversar de verdade, com criptografia de ponta a ponta em todas as conversas.

Mensagens, fotos, vídeos, áudios, arquivos, grupos e status são cifrados no seu iPhone antes de sair dele. Só você e quem recebe conseguem ler. Nem o servidor do MSX tem acesso ao conteúdo.

CONVERSE DO SEU JEITO
• Texto, mensagens de voz, fotos, vídeos e arquivos de até 50 MB
• Chamadas de voz e de vídeo, com viva voz
• Chamadas em grupo: adicione até 4 pessoas na mesma chamada
• Grupos protegidos por chave própria, com convite por link ou QR code (você aprova quem entra)
• Lista de conversas com a última mensagem e a hora, e busca ao puxar a lista para baixo
• Veja a mensagem na notificação e responda dali mesmo, sem abrir o app
• Compartilhe fotos, links e arquivos de outros apps direto para um contato
• Status que somem em 24 horas, com foto ou vídeo da câmera, respostas e reações
• Figurinhas: crie a partir de uma foto, com recorte automático
• Enquetes e @menções nos grupos
• Mensagens de voz em 1,5x e 2x, e transcrição feita no próprio iPhone
• Widget com seus favoritos online
• Convide amigos com seu QR code ou link
• Mensagens temporárias, com o prazo que você escolher

JOGUE COM SEUS AMIGOS
Seis jogos para dois, cada um em tela própria, com placar, revanche e aviso de "sua vez":
• Jogo da velha
• Quatro em linha
• Pedra, papel e tesoura
• Duelo de dados
• Cara ou coroa
• Verdade ou desafio

COM A CARA DOS VELHOS TEMPOS
• Presença com um toque: disponível, ausente, ocupado ou invisível
• Recado no perfil e "ouvindo agora" com a música que você está tocando
• Aviso quando um amigo fica online
• Emoticons clássicos como :) e (y) viram emoji, e emoji sozinho aparece grande e animado
• "Chamar atenção" para dar aquele toque em alguém
• Confirmação de leitura e "visto por último" opcionais

PRIVACIDADE DE VERDADE
• Criptografia de ponta a ponta (ECDH P-256 e AES-256-GCM)
• Sua chave fica no seu aparelho, e a cópia de segurança dela é protegida por um PIN que só você conhece
• Ninguém fala com você sem que você aceite o pedido de contato
• Bloqueio do app com Face ID
• Sem anúncios e sem rastreamento

SEGURANÇA DA COMUNIDADE
Bloqueie ou denuncie qualquer contato direto na conversa. Toda denúncia é analisada em até 24 horas.

Termos de Uso: https://msx.chat/termos
Política de Privacidade: https://msx.chat/privacidade

name: Muduco
description:
New to music? No problem. Muduco teaches you to read music, train your ear, sing, and explore music history, one short lesson at a time. You'll listen, tap, play, and sing, getting a little better every day.

LESSONS
• 800+ bite-size lessons in four sections.
• Ear & Sound: Start with high and low sounds, then learn to hear intervals, major and minor chords, and chord progressions. Recognize instruments by their sound and practice remembering melodies.
• Music Theory: Learn to read music from the ground up with the staff, note values, rhythm, scales, chords, and cadences.
• Music History: Follow music from the ancient world to today, including opera, jazz, rock, and electronic music, plus music from Africa, Asia, and Latin America.
• Vocal Training: Work on breathing, warm-ups, solfege, resonance, diction, and vibrato. When you sing, the microphone tracks your pitch in real time.
• In lessons, you pick what you hear, play the on-screen piano, tap out rhythms, place notes on the staff, build chords, or sing into the mic to hit the right note.
• Every unit ends with a final. Tap a term in a lesson to see what it means.
• Already know some music? Take the placement test, skip what you know, and start at your level.
• Most of the lesson sounds come from real instrument recordings: piano, violin, cello, flute, oud, sitar, koto, and more.

GAMES
• Singing Lamb: Type some lyrics, play the piano keys, and the lamb sings them on your notes. (Lyrics are sung with Turkish pronunciation.)
• Piano game: Tap the falling notes in time. 50 pieces, from simple tunes to Bach, across four difficulty levels.
• Draw a Melody and Draw & Play: Your lines and drawings turn into music.
• Play with a real guitar: Hit the right note to pop a balloon, or play the right chord to slice the fruit. The microphone hears what you play.
• The Melody of Your Name, Melody Repeat, Sound Detective, Music Quiz, and more: over 10 games in all.

TOOLS
• Tuner for guitar, bass guitar, ukulele, violin, viola, cello, banjo, mandolin, and saz.
• Find Your Vocal Range: Sing your lowest and highest notes to discover your voice type. If your voice is on the low side, high notes in the singing exercises move down an octave.

PROGRESS
• Earn XP, level up, and collect 26 badges.
• Pick a daily goal when you start, then keep your streak going. A 7-day streak earns you a shield that protects your streak on a day you miss.
• Track your progress on a weekly XP chart.
• Retry the questions you got wrong.
• Turn on an optional evening lesson reminder.

ACCOUNT & PRIVACY
• No account needed: use the lessons and games as a guest.
• Want an account? Sign in with Apple, Google, or email, then pick a username to join weekly and all-time leaderboards in eight games.
• Microphone audio and camera images are processed only on your device. They are never recorded or sent anywhere.
• Your lesson progress is stored only on this device and doesn't transfer to other devices.
• No ads.
• Available in English and Turkish.

Questions or ideas? Email us at destek@muduco.com

name: Muhurat: Panchang & Choghadiya
description:
The Hindu panchang for your city, and auspicious dates for the occasions that matter to your family.

TODAY
See today's tithi, nakshatra, yoga, karana and month for your city, with sunrise and sunset. Rahu kaal, yamaganda, gulika and abhijit muhurat are shown with their times, along with the day and night choghadiya, so you can tell at a glance whether now is a good time.

SHUBH MUHURAT FINDER
Find good days for a wedding (vivah), griha pravesh, a new vehicle, a baby's naamkaran or mundan, starting a business, or buying property. Each window comes with the reasons it is good, so you can talk it over with your family pandit. If there is no good window in the dates you chose, Muhurat tells you the next good date.

YOUR TRADITION
Month names follow the purnimanta or amanta calendar, whichever your family uses. Choose from more than 1,400 cities, or use your location once to find your times.

YOUR LANGUAGE, YOUR LOOK
Use Muhurat in English, Hindi, Bengali, Gujarati, Kannada, Malayalam, Marathi, Odia, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu or Urdu, with System, Light or Dark appearance.

PRIVATE AND OFFLINE
Every calculation is worked out on your iPhone from the positions of the Sun and Moon. Muhurat needs no account, makes no network requests and collects nothing.

MUHURAT PRO
Today's panchang and the finder for the next 7 days are free. Muhurat Pro shows every window up to a year ahead and reminds you the evening before and an hour before it starts. Choose a yearly subscription or a one-time lifetime purchase. Family Sharing is included.

The yearly subscription is charged to your Apple Account and renews automatically unless you cancel it at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1nwY4wOZO0SP3DD9HOF0g14waITnHpHj-OlSMpzKCgrY/view?usp=sharing

name: My Fan
description:
Stay in your ride.

REQUIRES A WAHOO KICKR HEADWIND. My Fan only works with the Wahoo KICKR Headwind smart fan. It does not control any other fan, and it does nothing without one.

Changing your fan usually means leaving your training app. With My Fan you just say "Hey Siri, My Fan faster" or tap a button in Control Center, and Zwift, TrainerRoad, Rouvy, MyWhoosh or whatever you ride with stays on screen.

SET IT UP ONCE
Open My Fan once to pick your fan. You'll never need to open it again. Siri and Control Center just work.

SAY IT TO SIRI
• "My Fan fifty" (or 25, 75, 100, low, high, full)
• "My Fan faster" / "My Fan slower" (or more / less)
• "My Fan on" / "My Fan off"
You can also record your own phrase in the Shortcuts app.

ONE TAP IN CONTROL CENTER
Add an on/off switch, Fan Up, Fan Down, and a one-tap button for each speed you like. A ring on the button shows how fast your fan is running.

ALWAYS YOUR FAN
My Fan remembers your fan and never grabs another one nearby, handy when two of you ride in the same room. At setup, the fan you tap spins for 3 seconds so you know it's yours. Give it a nickname, and switch fans with one tap.

PRIVATE
No accounts, no ads, no tracking. Nothing leaves your device. My Fan only talks to your fan over Bluetooth.

Requires a Wahoo KICKR Headwind smart fan and iOS 18 or later. No other fans are supported.

My Fan is an independent app, not affiliated with or endorsed by Wahoo Fitness. Wahoo and KICKR are trademarks of Wahoo Fitness.

name: MyBib: Citation Generator
description:
CiteMint is an independent citation and bibliography maker designed for quick, organized reference work on your phone. Create references for books, journal articles and websites with APA 7 and MLA 9 formatting, review source details, and copy or share a bibliography when you need it.

Look up journal metadata using a DOI or book details using an ISBN, then review and edit the results before saving. Your saved projects are stored locally so you can access existing references offline. Manual entry is always available.

Free features include one project, up to 15 citations, APA and MLA references, citation editing, search and plain-text copy/share. CiteMint Lifetime Pro is an optional, one-time in-app purchase that unlocks unlimited projects and citations, Chicago Author-Date formatting, PDF bibliography export and BibTeX export.

CiteMint is independently developed by Starter Studio, Inc. and is not affiliated with the MyBib website. No account or ads. Optional metadata lookups use Crossref and Open Library; CiteMint does not use the MyBib website as a backend. Review metadata, editions, title capitalization and your institution's requirements, especially for unusual or incomplete sources.

Lifetime Pro is a non-consumable one-time purchase. US base price: $6.99 once. Your store displays the actual localized price before purchase. No subscription or free trial. Purchases can be restored inside the app using the purchasing store account; Apple and Google ownership are separate.

Privacy Policy: https://citemint-appfactory.netlify.app/privacy
CiteMint Terms of Use: https://citemint-appfactory.netlify.app/terms
Support: https://citemint-appfactory.netlify.app/support
Terms of Use (Apple Standard EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: MyBramhaCorp
description: MyBramhaCorp is the official app for BramhaCorp homeowners and property buyers. Track your home's construction progress, view payment schedules, receipts and dues, access your documents, and raise service requests with photos or videos, all in one place.

name: MyCake
description:
MyCake, c'est la communauté de pâtisserie MyCake dans ton iPhone. Que tu débutes ou que tu prépares ton CAP, tu trouves ici des recettes fiables, un coach qui t'accompagne pas à pas et des passionnées pour partager tes réussites (et tes ratés).

LES RECETTES
• Des recettes testées et détaillées, étape par étape, avec photos et vidéos
• Les quantités qui s'adaptent à la taille de ton moule
• Tes recettes favorites et ton historique toujours sous la main
• Des fiches recettes à garder dans ton classeur

MYCOACH
• Des parcours guidés pour réussir un gâteau de A à Z
• Des minuteurs qui restent sur l'écran verrouillé pendant la cuisson
• Un quiz du jour pour progresser un peu chaque jour

LA COMMUNAUTÉ
• Le fil d'actualité, le forum et la galerie des créations
• Pose tes questions, réponds aux autres, réagis aux gâteaux des membres
• Messagerie privée, notifications, points et badges

L'ACADEMY
• Les élèves de l'Academy retrouvent leurs ateliers vidéo, leurs ebooks et leurs outils dans l'app

Le compte est gratuit et l'app est sans publicité. Une question ? Écris-nous depuis la rubrique Contact de l'app.

name: MyDogSport
description:
MyDogSport is your logbook for dog sports. Log training sessions and competitions in seconds and see how your dog is progressing.
TRAINING • Quick entry: sport, duration and exercises practiced in a few taps • Rate your dog's form and every exercise with stars • Notes, photos and videos for each session • Starter lists for agility, rally obedience, obedience and general training, plus your own sports and exercises
COMPETITIONS AND APPOINTMENTS • Results with rank, time, faults, points and notes, matched to the sport • Appointments for competitions, tests, training and the vet, with reminders
STATISTICS • Training time per week, month and year as a chart • Average rating per exercise • Hints about rarely practiced exercises • Streak: how many days in a row you trained
DOGS • Dog profile with photo, breed, date of birth, microchip number and sports with class • One dog is free, the subscription adds as many as you like
YOUR DATA STAYS WITH YOU MyDogSport stores everything on your iPhone. There is no account, no advertising and no tracking.
FREE AND WITH SUBSCRIPTION The app is free to use with one dog. The subscription (€1.99 per month, 14-day free trial) unlocks more dogs plus the PDF report and CSV export. Prices in other countries are shown in the App Store.
Subscription notes: After the trial, payment is charged to your Apple ID. The subscription renews automatically every month unless you cancel it at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel it at any time in your Apple ID settings.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/ Privacy Policy: https://appetit-software.de/Datenschutz/Datenschutzerklaerung_MyDogSport_EN.pdf

name: MyVocab - Word Memory
description:
MyVocab is a calm, focused spaced-repetition flashcard app designed to help you remember vocabulary over the long term—without ads, accounts, or distractions.

KEY FEATURES

• Spaced Repetition & Forgetting Curves
Review cards right before you forget them. Track your deck-level forgetting curve against the Ebbinghaus baseline, inspect every word's individual recall history, and preview your upcoming 14-day review schedule.

• Import Your Own Decks & Browse AnkiWeb
Import local Anki .apkg packages (including modern .anki21b zstd format), CSV, or TSV/TXT word lists directly from Files or AirDrop. You can also explore community-shared decks across 10 languages (French, English, Japanese, German, Spanish, Korean, Chinese, Russian, Arabic, and Hebrew) by level or paste any AnkiWeb shared deck link.

• Automatic Multi-Language Pronunciation
Built-in Apple system text-to-speech automatically detects and pronounces each deck's language, with both normal and slow playback speeds for careful listening practice.

• Built-In French Numbers Trainer
Practice French numbers from 0 to 9999 across four difficulty levels with instant spelling, IPA phonetic transcription, and spoken pronunciation—ready to use offline right out of the box.

• Private iCloud Sync & Home Screen Widgets
Your decks, review history, and study preferences stay on your device and sync privately across iPhone, iPad, and Mac using your own Apple iCloud account. Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets keep today's review count in view at a glance.

• Thoughtful Reading Experience
Choose from 11 editorial paper palettes plus Light, Dark, and Warm Eye-Care modes, with full support for touch gestures on iPhone and keyboard shortcuts on iPad.

PRIVACY FIRST
No account required. No tracking. No third-party analytics or ads. Your vocabulary data belongs exclusively to you.

name: Nails Envie
description:
Nails Envie is the work app for licensed nail technicians who partner with Nails Envie, the on-demand mobile nail care service. Clients book with Nails Envie; technicians use this app to receive and manage their appointments.

For Nails Envie technicians:
• Get job offers near your home base and accept the ones that fit your schedule
• See job details, service, time and the client's address
• Tap "On my way" so dispatch can follow your progress, then check in when you arrive
• Message the dispatch team, with photos
• Upload your license, ID and insurance, and keep your profile up to date
• Read company announcements
• Get push notifications for new offers, job changes and announcements, and optional text alerts

For the Nails Envie dispatch team: create and assign jobs, track technicians on the way, review onboarding documents and post announcements.

New technicians can apply in the app. Applications are reviewed by Nails Envie before any work is offered. An account approved by Nails Envie is required to receive jobs.

name: Naughty Santa: Secret Santa
description:
Nice is overrated.

Naughty Santa runs your Secret Santa in three steps and keeps the secret for you.

1. Who's playing: write the names, at least three. Everyone gets a hand-drawn alias. Keep couples, siblings or sworn enemies apart.
2. The party: gift day, budget, where and a note for everyone. Skip what you haven't decided yet.
3. The tone: almost nice, cheeky, properly naughty, or your own rules.

Then draw. The draw is final and nobody sees it, not even you. Each person gets one sealed link to send by WhatsApp, Messages or anything else. When they open it, they learn who they're buying for and can leave gift hints for their own Santa.

Keep track: every list you draw stays on your phone, with who has already opened their invitation.

Stickers for the group chat: three packs of Santa reactions, added to WhatsApp in one tap, and all of them in iMessage too. In nine languages.

Free. No account, no sign-up.

Made in Switzerland by Limmat Studios.

name: Nautivelle
description:
Nautivelle is a cozy offline shipbuilding puzzle game.

Step into a sunny harbor workshop and assemble charming vessels by dragging ship parts onto blueprint sockets. Study the plans, rotate pieces when needed, and complete each hull with care. When the structure is ready, launch your ship for a sea trial and earn coins, stars, and achievements.

Features:
• Handcrafted ship assembly with drag-and-drop parts
• Clear blueprint guides and helpful ghost outlines
• Progressive chapters from simple wooden boats to advanced vessels
• Launch tests with star ratings and rewards
• Achievements, collection, and workshop progress
• Soft nautical art, relaxing music, and offline play
• No account required — progress is saved on your device

Build patiently. Fit every part. Launch proudly.

name: Ne Ngap – Flood & Rain Alerts
description:
Ne Ngap is a rain, street-flooding, and high-tide app built for motorbike riders in Ho Chi Minh City and Hanoi. Before every trip, you can open the app to see whether the streets ahead are clear or flooded and choose a better route in advance.

TRACK 54 FLOOD-PRONE LOCATIONS
• Monitors 54 frequently flooded stretches across Ho Chi Minh City and Hanoi, complete with suggested nearby detour routes.
• Water depth is shown against a motorbike so it is easy to picture on the road: ankle-deep, half-wheel, touching the exhaust pipe, or up to the seat.

LIVE UPDATES FROM RIDERS ON THE ROAD
• When you encounter a flooded street, you can submit a report in just a few taps without typing.
• Riders passing by afterward can tap "Still flooded" or "Gone" so the map always reflects current street conditions.
• Share a flooded location's link straight to a chat so family members or coworkers know to take another route.

DAILY HIGH TIDES & ROUTE RAIN CHECKS
• Shows daily estimated peak tide times in Ho Chi Minh City — helping you avoid streets that flood in the evening even when it hasn't rained.
• See which direction rain clouds are moving, how many minutes until rain reaches your area, and whether your upcoming route passes through heavy rain.
• Save familiar places like Home or Work and add a widget to your phone's home screen to check conditions at a glance.

BUILT WITH RESPECT FOR YOUR PRIVACY
• Ready to use immediately after installation, with no account registration and no request for your name, phone number, or email.
• No advertisements, no behavioural tracking SDKs, and no selling of user data.
• During normal use, the app only identifies your general neighbourhood (within roughly 1 km) to show conditions around you and lets you erase all data linked to your device at any time in Settings.

IMPORTANT SAFETY NOTICE
Ne Ngap is not an official disaster warning. Rain forecasts and tide schedules in the app are estimates for reference, and flood reports are shared by the community. During severe weather, please follow official instructions from local authorities, watch the road ahead, and pull over safely before using your phone.

Map and weather data sources are credited in the app's About screen.

name: Nebula Sling: Space Smash
description:
Pull back the slingshot, aim, and knock down cute alien fortresses floating in a nebula.

Nebula Sling is a physics puzzle game for iPhone and iPad. Every block, barrel and alien has weight, so each shot plays out a little differently.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• 12 campaign levels across three worlds, including 3 boss battles
• 10 shot types with a mid-air skill: Phantom Shot, Twin-Star Bolas, Drill Shot, Grapple Shot, Plasma Dash, Boomerang, Meteor Splitter, Black Hole, Prism Laser and Star Saw
• 4 captains, each with a passive bonus and a once-per-level skill
• Combos between elements: fire + ice thermal shock, black hole + laser, current through gold alloy, prisms, wormholes and magnetic bumpers
• Daily Challenge: a new fortress every day, the same layout for every player
• Endless Mode: wave after wave, pick 1 of 3 boost cards between waves
• Level Workshop: build your own island and swap levels with friends using share codes
• Star boosts and 12 skill medals to earn
• Original music generated in real time on the device; release on the beat for a stronger shot
• Haptic feedback, adjustable screen shake and particles, and color-blind-friendly material symbols

FREE TO TRY
Levels 1–3 and the Daily Challenge are free. A single one-time in-app purchase unlocks levels 4–12, Endless Mode and the Level Workshop. No ads, no subscription, no account.

PRIVACY
Nebula Sling collects no data. It works offline. Progress is stored only on your device.

Support: lunagamesitw@gmail.com

name: Negus
description:
Negus est la carte de visite digitale des professionnels. Partagez vos coordonnées en un instant grâce à votre QR code, enregistrez les personnes que vous rencontrez et suivez chaque contact jusqu'à la signature.

VOTRE CARTE DE VISITE DIGITALE
• Une carte à votre image : photo de profil, fonction, entreprise, téléphone, e-mail, adresse, site web et réseaux sociaux.
• Un QR code personnel : votre interlocuteur le scanne et ouvre votre page de présentation en ligne, sans installer d'application.
• Partagez le lien de votre carte par message, e-mail ou réseaux sociaux, ou copiez-le en un geste.
• Enregistrez votre QR code dans vos photos pour l'imprimer ou l'afficher.
• Modifiez vos informations à tout moment : votre lien et votre QR code restent les mêmes.

SCANNEZ ET ENREGISTREZ VOS RENCONTRES
• Scannez le QR code d'une carte de visite : le contact est pré-rempli automatiquement.
• Photographiez une carte papier : Negus lit les informations et remplit la fiche pour vous.
• Négus repère les doublons pour éviter d'enregistrer deux fois la même personne.

SUIVEZ VOS CONTACTS
• Retrouvez tous les contacts de votre entreprise au même endroit, avec leur photo.
• Classez chaque contact selon son avancement : Nouveau, RDV pris, Closé, En stand-by ou Perdu.
• Recherchez et filtrez vos contacts en quelques secondes.
• Ajoutez des notes, une adresse et des liens à chaque fiche.

MÊME SANS CONNEXION
• Le mode « Hors ligne » vous donne accès à vos contacts sans internet.
• Hors ligne, votre QR code contient votre fiche contact complète : la personne qui le scanne vous ajoute à son répertoire, même sans réseau.

POUR LES ÉQUIPES
• Votre entreprise invite ses collaborateurs et les organise en équipes.
• Chaque collaborateur dispose de sa propre carte et de son QR code.
• Les contacts collectés par l'équipe sont centralisés pour un meilleur suivi commercial.

Negus remplace les cartes papier qui se perdent : vos coordonnées sont toujours à jour, et chaque rencontre devient une opportunité suivie.

Téléchargez Negus et créez votre carte de visite digitale dès maintenant.

name: Neo Tether
description:
Neo Tether is a tethered-shooting app: connect your camera with a USB-C cable and every photo you take appears right away on your iPad, iPhone or Mac. Review and pick shots on the spot in the studio, for product shoots, portraits, or sessions with a client watching.

■ See every shot instantly
・Each shot is imported automatically and the newest one is shown
・Files keep the same names as on the camera
・Shots are sorted into dated folders automatically
・Choose to import RAW, JPEG, or RAW+JPEG
・With RAW+JPEG, show both or JPEG only
・Browse the camera's card and import just the shots you pick

■ Check every detail
・Pinch or double-tap to zoom, with a mini-map to see where you are
・Rule of thirds, grid and diagonal guides
・Compare up to 4 shots side by side: the previous shot, any shot you pick, and the newest one
・Overlay mode lays a reference shot over any shot with opacity or lighten blending, so you can spot shifts in position or pose. Rotate, flip, resize and move the reference, with a lock to prevent accidental changes
・Show shooting info (EXIF) and the AF point (Canon, Nikon, Sony, FUJIFILM) on the photo

■ Select on the spot
・Rate 0–5 stars and reject (×). Tap or swipe across the stars
・Select several shots and rate them all at once
・Filter by stars (≥, ≤, =) or by rejects
・Your JPG and RAW files are never modified: ratings are written to XMP sidecars, so they carry over to Lightroom Classic and other raw editors

■ Sync with other devices
・Other iPads, iPhones and Macs on the same Wi-Fi (or on an iPhone's Personal Hotspot) can view the shoot as it happens. Viewing is free, even on devices with a different Apple ID
・Ratings are shared across devices. Ratings from viewers are applied only for devices the sharing device allows
・Only devices with the same ID and password connect, and the connection is encrypted
・Viewers choose the image quality: Light, Recommended (2560px or 4K) or Original
・The sharing device lists every viewer and can disconnect each one

■ Supported cameras
Mirrorless and DSLR cameras that can transfer photos over USB-C (FUJIFILM, Canon, Sony, Nikon, Leica and others). See the in-app guide for camera settings.
・Live view and firing the shutter from the app are not supported

■ Pricing
The basic features (import, viewing, zoom, guides, rotation, EXIF and AF point display) are free.
Ratings, Compare (side by side and overlay), Wi-Fi sync (sharing side) and XMP export are part of Neo Tether Pro.
・Monthly plan
・Yearly plan
・Both start with a 1-week free trial
Pro works on all your iPads, iPhones and Macs that use the same Apple ID.

When the free trial ends, the price of the plan you chose is charged to your Apple ID. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can cancel any time in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.kazuyaseki.com/neotether

■ Available in English and Japanese

name: neo3
description:
A is to B as C is to D.

neo3 solves the rule of three for designers, video editors, anyone. Beautifully.

Enter three values. Get the fourth.

HOW IT WORKS
• The top row is your reference pair, A → B.
• Enter C and neo3 calculates D. Edit D and it calculates C.
• Each column keeps its unit, so the result always reads naturally.

PRESETS FOR CREATIVE WORK
Start from 59 ready-made presets:
• Video
• Animation
• Grid & Layout
• Typography
• Color
• Print & DPI

SIMPLE MATH
With a keyboard on Mac or iPad, type expressions like 1920/2 or (12+4)*3 right into any field.

MAKE IT YOURS
Choose from hand-picked backgrounds or the system background, and adjust their opacity. neo3 is designed with Liquid Glass for iPhone, iPad and Mac.

ON MAC
• Lives in the menu bar, the Dock, or both
• Click the menu bar icon to show or hide the window
• Opens at login, with the option to keep the window hidden

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No accounts, no ads, no tracking. Your values stay on your device.

One purchase works on iPhone, iPad and Mac.

name: NeverGassed: Boxing & MMA Runs
description:
Roadwork for boxing, MMA, Muay Thai, kickboxing and BJJ, built like your fight. NeverGassed plans your runs as fight-format rounds, places them around your sparring days and builds them back from fight night. After every round run you get a gas-tank score: how much your pace faded in the late rounds.

RUNS THAT COPY YOUR ROUNDS
Pick your format: amateur or pro boxing, MMA (3 or 5 rounds), Muay Thai, kickboxing or BJJ by belt. Round runs use your real round and rest times, with fight pace taken from a recent 5 km time. Scramble rounds add all-out bursts inside the round.

PLANNED AROUND SPARRING
Tell NeverGassed your gym week. No plan puts a hard run on a sparring day or the day before, and hard runs never sit back to back.

ON YOUR WATCH OR YOUR IPHONE
Send a session to the Workout app on Apple Watch with its rounds, rest and bursts. No Watch? Start it on your iPhone: on a treadmill it shows the belt speed for every round, outdoors GPS measures your pace. Bells ring for every round, even with the phone locked, and the lock screen shows the round and the time left.

THE GAS-TANK SCORE
After a run, NeverGassed reads it from Apple Health and shows your pace and heart rate per round and how much you faded. Runs from Amazfit and other watches that sync to Apple Health count too.

FREE
Fight-format round runs planned around sparring, send to Apple Watch, start on iPhone with bells, gas-tank score.

NEVERGASSED FULL
A camp plan from your fight date (base, build, fight-specific, fight week and taper), weeks that adapt to your gas tank, easier days after a poor night (HRV and resting heart rate), and a voice coach on iPhone runs. Monthly or yearly subscription, with a free trial for new subscribers where offered.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your plan and runs stay on your iPhone and in Apple Health.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Manage or cancel in Settings > your name > Subscriptions.

NeverGassed gives training guidance, not medical advice. Talk to a doctor before starting a new training program.

name: Next Stop London
description:
Be the driver. Be the passenger. Welcome to London.

Next Stop London lets you drive the city’s buses, metro trains, trams, main-line trains and black cabs, from quiet suburbs to the busy centre. Stop at the right places, open the doors, keep to time and get every passenger where they need to go.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Junior (4+): the game helps with stopping and steering, so little ones can just enjoy the ride.
• Pro (7+): you work the brakes and the doors, and keep an eye on the speed limit.
• Sim (10+): full controls, from parking brakes and bus kneeling to the train’s power controller and reverse.

SO MUCH TO DO
• Buses, trains, trams, river buses, a cable car and a black cab with a meter and sat nav
• Ride as a passenger: tap in with your travel card, play I spy and answer quiz questions
• Snow days, night services, the Marathon and match days
• Meet the regulars and earn their thank-you cards
• Map puzzles: draw the lines back onto the map
• Fill your sticker book and light up your own map of London

MAKE IT YOURS
• Design your own paint jobs and routes
• Build up your depot with a bus wash, a canteen and even a depot cat
• Take photos for your album and write your own announcements
• Halloween, Bonfire Night and Christmas themes

MADE FOR FAMILIES
• Everyone in the family gets their own driver and progress
• Calm mode, big buttons, picture strips of stops and read-aloud
• Grown-ups area with play time and break reminders
• Plays offline. No adverts, no tracking, no in-app purchases.

Next Stop London is a fan-made game and is not affiliated with or endorsed by any transport operator.

name: Ninelight: 369 Manifest

Ninelight is your personal space to set intentions, practice the 369 manifestation method and visualize the future you want to create.

Build a daily ritual around your intentions with guided affirmation writing, a personal vision board, cosmic reflections and your own voice mantras.

Complete your ritual with 9 repetitions at night.

YOUR VISION BOARD

COSMIC ORACLE

Discover your daily oracle card.

YOUR SACRED JOURNAL

name: NoldVeeren
description:
A rally ends.
You tap one side.
The score is right.

NoldVeeren keeps score for singles tennis and singles badminton, one player against another, played between friends at the club, the park or the school gym. It is quiet, quick and made for a phone held at the net post.

1. Two sports, real rules
Tennis counts love, fifteen, thirty, forty. Deuce and advantage, or no-ad if you prefer. Sets to six, win by two, a tiebreak to seven at six all. Best of one, three or five.
Badminton singles uses rally scoring. Every rally counts. Games to 21, win by two, capped at 30. Short games to 11 are there for a lunch break.

2. A serve marker that knows
A glowing ball or shuttle sits beside whoever serves. A small court shows the box to serve from, right or left. Tiebreak rotation is handled for you.

3. Undo, without fuss
Called it wrong? One tap takes the last point back. The server, the court and the score all return to where they were. Even a finished match can be reopened.

4. History of every match
Finished matches stay. Each one keeps its set scores, the length of play, every rally in order, and a chart of points won per set that grows into place.

5. Stats for each player
Build a roster once. Every player gets a stat line: matches won, points won, points won on serve and on return, sets, longest run and recent form. Filter by tennis or badminton.

Small things, too.
A soft sunset look with a rolling grid floor.
An ice-cube clink when something is saved.
A short tabla flourish when the last point lands.
A snow-globe shake when you clear the court for the next match.
Light and dark appearance.

No account.
No ads.
Nothing to buy.

Your matches live on the phone. An anonymous backup copy, with the player names you type and your scores, is kept so you can restore it later. No account, email or location is collected.

Pick up the racket.
Tap a side.
Play on.

name: NoLight: Long Video Recorder
description:
Record long videos and keep using your phone while it records. NoLight puts a web browser, notes, a clock and a teleprompter in a window over the camera, so you can read a lesson, follow a recipe or check your script without stopping the recording.

iPhone's camera stops recording as soon as you leave the app. That is why the tools live inside NoLight: open one, keep filming, close it when you are done.

RECORD WITH MUSIC AND THE WEB
- Music you play from another app keeps playing while NoLight records, and your voice is recorded with it.
- Browse any website in the built-in browser: guitar lessons, recipes, slides, lyrics. Save pages as bookmarks.
- While recording on the speaker, page sound is muted so your voice stays clear. One tap turns it back on.

TOOLS WHILE YOU RECORD
- Teleprompter: paste your script, set the speed and text size, and read while you talk to the camera.
- Notes: write down ideas during a lecture, a meeting or a practice session.
- Clock: see the time without leaving the camera.
- Every tool window comes in three sizes: small to keep your face in view, big, or full screen.

MADE FOR LONG RECORDINGS
- Record lectures, classes, cooking, practice and talks from start to finish.
- Max time stops the recording on its own when the time you picked is up.
- The screen stays on and the recording indicator with elapsed time is always visible, so you always know it is recording.

CAMERA CONTROLS
- Video in 1080p or 4K, 16:9 or 4:3, and 60 fps on iPhones that support it.
- Time-lapse for long scenes, and photos with burst.
- Start timer, flash, microphone on or off, front and back camera, zoom.

YOUR GALLERY
- All recordings and photos in one place inside the app.
- Save to Photos one by one, or every new recording automatically.
- Lock Screen widget: one tap opens NoLight on the camera.

No account, no ads. Your videos stay on your phone.

name: Nonogram Pixel
description:
Fill cells by the numbers to reveal a hidden picture.

Every row and column has a clue: the lengths of its runs of filled cells. Read the clues, fill what must be filled, cross out what must stay empty, and a picture appears. Every built-in, daily and quick-play puzzle has exactly one solution.

PICTURES TO COLLECT
• 955 picture puzzles in 20 themes: Smileys, Mammals, Ocean, Fruits & Vegetables, Vehicles, Sports & Games, Music & Tech and more
• Black-and-white and colour pictures (725 in colour), up to 20 × 20
• Your collection shows each solved picture with its time and stars; search by name and filter by solved, unsolved or colour

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Daily puzzle: one 15 × 15 puzzle a day, with a streak and a week view
• Quick play: 5 × 5 to 25 × 25, four levels (Easy, Medium, Hard, Expert), 1–3 colours, endless new puzzles
• Enter a puzzle code to play a puzzle from a friend or a book

HELPFUL, NOT INTRUSIVE
• Drag to fill a whole run; pinch to zoom on big boards
• Correct lines flash green and their empty cells are crossed for you (can be turned off)
• Row and column counters show how many cells you have filled
• 3 hints per game (watch an ad for more when they run out), each explaining the line and the technique; "Check" marks mistakes without costing stars
• Solving tips: seven techniques with worked examples
• Stuck? Show the solution (that game gets no stars)
• Pause hides the board and stops the clock
• Undo and redo without limit

STARS AND PROGRESS
• 3 stars: solved without hints and under the target time
• Average time for each level, so you can see yourself improve
• 12 achievements

ON EVERY SCREEN
• iPhone, iPad and Mac, with layouts made for each: tab bar on phones, sidebar and side panel on iPad and Mac
• Keyboard shortcuts and right-click to cross on Mac
• Dark design, Vietnamese and English

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account needed
• Never an ad while you solve. Remove ads for good with a one-time purchase, no subscription (the Mac version has no ads)
• Works fully offline; your progress stays on your device

Picture credits: pictures adapted from Twemoji by Twitter, Inc. and contributors (CC-BY 4.0) and Microsoft Fluent Emoji (MIT). Full licences are in the app under Settings › About.

name: Noor — Islamic Companion
description:
Noor is a calm, ad-free Islamic companion in Arabic and English. Choose your language when you first open the app and change it any time in Settings. English reads left to right; Arabic reads right to left.

READ IN ENGLISH, OR KEEP THE ARABIC FIRST
In English you can read the Quran, hadith and adhkar with the English translation first and the Arabic beneath, or keep the Arabic first and show the English translation below it. You set this once in Settings under Reading language.

QURAN
- Read the Uthmani text of all 114 surahs as a full page or verse by verse.
- English translation: Sahih International. Tafseer: Tafsir al-Jalalayn in English (Al-Tafsir al-Muyassar when the app is in Arabic).
- Search verses by word, surah name or number.
- Listen verse by verse with a choice of reciters.
- Download recitations, Quran text and tafseer for offline use, and delete them any time.
- Bookmark verses and pick up where you left off.

PRAYER TIMES
- Daily prayer times calculated on your device from your location or a city you choose.
- Six calculation methods: Muslim World League (default), Umm al-Qura, Egyptian General Authority of Survey, ISNA, University of Islamic Sciences Karachi and the Moonsighting Committee. Asr: Shafi'i or Hanafi.
- Optional reminders for each prayer, and the Hijri date with a manual adjustment.
- No location permission? Pick a city instead.

QIBLA
- A compass that points to the Qibla using your location and your phone's sensors.

HADITH
- The Forty Hadith of Imam al-Nawawi and the major collections, each with its book, number and grading.
- Explanations and word meanings from HadeethEnc, where available, in English or Arabic.
- Save hadith to revisit later.

ADHKAR AND TASBIH
- Morning, evening and after-prayer adhkar with their sources and English translations.
- A digital tasbih that moves on automatically to the next dhikr when you finish one.

MADE TO BE CALM
- Light, dark or follow-your-device themes.
- Choose Arabic-Indic or Western numerals.
- No account, no ads, no tracking. Your bookmarks, progress and settings stay on your device. Location is used only to calculate prayer times and the Qibla.

SOURCES
Quran text (Tanzil) and the Sahih International translation via AlQuran Cloud; Al-Muyassar via AlQuran Cloud; Tafsir al-Jalalayn via spa5k/tafsir_api; recitation audio via Islamic Network; hadith via the fawazahmed0 hadith-api; hadith explanations by HadeethEnc.com; English adhkar via fitrahive/dua-dhikr; prayer times with the adhan library. Full credits are inside the app. Prayer times can differ by a few minutes from your local mosque, and hadith gradings and rulings should be confirmed with a qualified scholar.

Questions or feedback: support@usewyvo.com

name: NooxThoxo
description:
Good evening, puzzle people, and welcome to the show. Tonight's format is simple. Four items light up on the board. Three of them share a rule. One of them is a misfit. Your job is to call it.

Here's the running order:

1. 220 bundled sets across 10 themes
Creatures, Kitchen, Atlas, Lab, Wordplay, Numbers, Sound, Arena, Cosmos and Palette. Twenty-two sets in each. Pick one theme from the Themes tab, or throw them all in the Mixed bag. Sets you have not solved come up first.

2. An explanation card after every answer
Right or wrong, the card tells you which item was the misfit and spells out the rule the other three share. A whale next to three fish? You'll hear why the whale goes.

3. A hint that removes one wrong option
Stuck between two? Tap Hint and one of the items that does belong gets struck out. One hint per set, so choose your moment.

4. A streak counter with your best streak
Every right answer in Classic mode adds to your run. Miss one and the run ends. The Streak tab shows your current run, your best, and your recent runs as flames that grow taller the longer you lasted. Missed sets wait there too, explanation attached, until you mark them as learned.

5. A 60-second blitz
Set the clock and answer as many as you can. The clock pauses while the explanation card is open, so you still learn something. A hint costs five seconds. Your best blitz score is kept.

A few more notes before we go to the music. The app opens with a short three-page intro, drawn as blueprint-style prints. Getting around is done with a little thumb joystick at the bottom of the screen: flick it left for Play, up for Themes, right for Streak, down for Settings, or just tap the labels. A soft harp pluck marks a right answer and an ocarina tune plays for a new record, and you can switch sound off with the ribbon toggle in Settings.

No account, no sign-in, no ads. Everything works offline. Your answers are backed up under an anonymous device ID, and Settings lets you restore that backup or reset everything in one tap.

That's the show. Four items, one misfit. Over to you.

name: NumupCue
description:
NumupCue yhdistää pokerikortit ja lukupelin. Napauta ruutua, nosta arvoja ja tee kolme samaa rivissä tai sarakkeessa.

Jokainen osuma kerää maan. Kun hertta, ruutu, risti ja pata ovat koossa, maarivi palkitsee nousevalla bonuksella ja uusilla siirroilla. Mitä pidemmälle viet kierroksen, sitä isommaksi bonus kasvaa.

Kolme tilaa: • Klassinen – selkeä peruspeli
• Väripeli – sama maa antaa lisäkertoimen
• Suorapeli – suorat rivit tuovat lisäpisteitä

Pidä yksi kortti talessa ja vaihda se juuri oikealla hetkellä. Selaa kaikki 52 koodilla piirrettyä korttia, seuraa ennätyksiä ja säädä ääni sekä tärinä.

Ei ostoja. Ei Game Centeriä. Ei pilveä. Vain kortit, osumat ja kasvavat pisteet.

name: Oak Print
description:
Oak Print prints from your iPhone and iPad to any AirPrint printer, free. There's no weekly subscription, no trial that turns into a charge, no ads and no account. Printing is never paywalled.

FREE, FOREVER
• Photos: one or many, whole photo or fill the page, on Letter, A4, 4×6 or 5×7

name: Obake Inn: Ghost Spa Tycoon
description:
Ghost guests are visiting your little mountain hot spring. They soak in the open-air bath, snack on rice balls in the dining room, nap in the guest room, then leave their fee and a tip.

Spend your coins to expand rooms and raise your sign, and guests arrive more often. Every guest has a different head piece and body color, 210 in all to collect in your Guestbook. Frequent visitors become Regulars who gift you yukatas, and the closest ones bring special guests with their own stories.

- Day shift doubles Regular affection; night shift brings rare guests three times as often.
- Tap a guest's speech bubble to grant their request and get a tip.
- Open the Yard and move to the Riverside Inn and the Snow Lodge. Each Reputation star raises your rates.
- Guests keep resting while the app is closed.
- Hand-drawn in colored pencil. English, Japanese and Korean.

Ads are rewarded only, watched when you choose.

name: Offline QR Card Maker
description:
Turn a link, short note, guest Wi-Fi network, or contact into a QR card. New cards save automatically on your iPhone. Share the PNG or show the code on your screen.

MAKE AND REUSE
• Choose Link, Text, Wi-Fi or Contact. QR codes are generated offline.
• Share a clean PNG without a watermark. Recent cards have a one-tap share button.
• Find older cards by title, type or public content. Rename a card or use it as a starting point for a new one.

SHARE A LAYOUT
Send a layout code or .qrcard file so someone can make a card with their own details. Layouts carry the card type and style only.

PRINT A QR CARD
Try the printable A4 or Letter PDF for 30 days from the first launch of the paid version. Unlock printing with a one-time purchase. Creating cards, using saved cards and sharing PNGs stay free.

No account, ads or analytics. Your cards stay on your device.

name: Offline Recipe Cards
description:
Save the recipes your family actually cooks. Write your own card, paste a recipe from a message, or add a photo of the finished dish.

Search by recipe name or ingredient. Tap a recipe to read quantities, then tap Start cooking for steps in larger type. Keep a record of the dishes you've finished.

Send a recipe as a readable image, code or editable file. Private notes stay with you. A full single-recipe export can include notes and a photo, and you can restore an existing backup whenever you need it.

Pro is available for 30 days from first launch of the paid edition. It lets you create extra cookbooks, scale ingredients and make full library backups. A one-time purchase keeps Pro after the trial. You can still view, edit and export existing recipes. No subscription or automatic charge.

Recipes stay on your device. Everyday features work offline without an account, ads or analytics.

name: Oil Change & Service Log
description:
Log your last oil change, choose your own interval and see exactly when the next one is due, by date and by mileage.
Oil Change & Service Log is a simple digital service book for your car: every service, receipt and cost in one place.
No VIN, no plate, no account and no vehicle database. A nickname is all you need.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Give your car a nickname.
2. Enter the date and odometer of your last oil change and the interval from your owner's manual or your shop.
3. See the next due date and due mileage right away.

YOUR SERVICE BOOK
- Oil changes, tires, brakes and any custom service you name
- Date, odometer, oil grade, filter part, notes and receipt photos for each service
- Totals that include parts, labor, tax and other fees
- Pick your currency; amounts are never converted
- Search and filter your full history by type, part, shop or note
- One tap to log the next oil change, with your previous oil grade and filter filled in for you to confirm

KNOW WHEN SERVICE IS DUE
- Next due date and due mileage for every schedule, whichever comes first
- Optional date reminders, asked for only when you turn one on
- Mileage status updates when you enter an odometer reading; the app never reads your car or tracks your driving
- Entering a lower reading than before asks you to check it instead of quietly changing your history
- Kilometers or miles, switchable without rewriting past records

YOURS TO KEEP
- Free JSON backup of every vehicle, record and receipt photo, shared only where you choose
- Import a backup on a new iPhone
- Delete All Data whenever you want

PRO
- More than one vehicle
- Cost charts by month and by service type
- Reusable service templates
- A formatted PDF service history to share or print

Free includes one vehicle with unlimited records, receipt photos, date reminders and JSON export. If Pro ends, nothing is deleted or locked: every record and receipt stays readable and exportable.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your vehicles, records and receipts are stored on your iPhone.

Intervals are the ones you enter. Always check them against your vehicle manufacturer's instructions. The app does not diagnose or inspect your vehicle, and reminders depend on your iPhone's notification settings. Never use the app while driving.

SUBSCRIPTION
Pro is optional: weekly with a 3-day free trial for eligible new subscribers, or annual, billed in full once a year. Prices are shown in the app before you buy. Subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled in Settings.
