name: Okrel
description:
Okrel is an offline mechanical puzzle game for players who enjoy logic challenges, brass objects, and hands-on mechanical structures. Users can rotate knobs, slide bolts, and observe mechanical feedback to solve 50 levels across 8 categories of mechanisms without timers, ads, or in-app purchases.

Players can switch between 2D operations and 3D observations, use free tiered hints, and undo or reset actions when encountering difficult locks. Daily challenges let users continue previous states, while the discovery journal tracks completed puzzles and distinguishes independent solutions from hinted ones.

Players can also create custom journal entries for specific levels by adding text, selecting an optional photo from their library, and recording a short voice note to review their problem-solving steps. All progress and notes are stored locally on the device, allowing users to pause and resume their puzzle-solving sessions at their own pace.

name: Oliver Estratega
description:
Oliver Estratega é o aplicativo da Fábrica de Conteúdo da Estratega, para clínicas, profissionais e negócios locais que criam conteúdo com a agência.

No app você:
• Pede carrosséis, posts, capas e vídeos descrevendo a ideia por texto ou falando no microfone.
• Envia fotos e vídeos da sua galeria para a equipe transformar em conteúdo.
• Acompanha cada etapa do conteúdo: roteiro, imagens, cenas, montagem e capa.
• Aprova ou pede ajustes antes de qualquer publicação.
• Vê num calendário só tudo o que está agendado e o que já foi publicado.
• Baixa os arquivos prontos e salva na galeria.

O acesso é feito com a conta criada pela Estratega para você e sua equipe. Cada pessoa vê apenas os conteúdos do próprio negócio.

name: OMYYFlow
description:
OMYYFlow is the mobile field companion for photographers using OMYYFlow on macOS. Keep your active events, live schedules, competitor rosters, delivery clients, shoot checklists, and editorial caption drafts in your pocket—synced end-to-end encrypted from your Mac.

DESIGNED FOR ON-SITE EDITORIAL & EVENT WORKFLOWS

• Docked Caption Composer (10 Auto-Saved Slots)
Draft editorial captions right in the field without switching apps. Keep up to 10 caption drafts in auto-saved slots—swipe or tap to switch slots, expand the editor when typing longer notes, undo edits, and copy or share finished captions in one tap.

• Split-Tap Copy & Smart Insert
Every event, schedule, roster, and client field gives you two instant actions:
- Tap a field to copy it directly to your clipboard.
- Tap "+" to smart-insert the text at your cursor in the Caption Composer, with automatic single-space and punctuation handling.

• Live Event Schedules & Countdowns
View time-zone-aware event itineraries with LIVE and NEXT session indicators, countdowns, and venue sublocations so you never miss a start time.

• Searchable Competitor & Subject Rosters
Filter rosters by name, bib/car number, team, class, or vehicle, and copy or insert formatted IPTC details in seconds.

• Two-Way Synced Shoot Tasks
Create, edit, and check off shoot checklists on your iPhone or iPad—changes merge seamlessly back to OMYYFlow on your Mac.

• Active Delivery Clients
Access client names, short codes, contact emails, default keywords, and delivery notes on the go.

• Private & Zero-Knowledge Sync
Pair in seconds by scanning the QR code in OMYYFlow on macOS. Your data is encrypted on your devices with AES-256-GCM before it ever leaves them—only your paired devices hold the key.

• Try Demo Mode Included
Want to explore the workflow before pairing a Mac? Tap "Try Demo Mode" on launch to test events, rosters, tasks, clients, and the Caption Composer with sample data.

name: One Energy News
description:
One Energy News is Westhon Media's publication on Brazil's offshore and energy market, now on your phone.

FOLLOW THE MARKET
• Oil & gas, offshore wind, shipping and chartering news
• Open Tenders: procurement opportunities, kept up to date
• Columns and analysis from our columnists
• Special series and One Energy Magazine in a built-in reader

AI ASSISTANT
Ask about what we've published ("what's the latest oil news?", "what came out about Petrobras this month?") and get an answer with links to the source articles. You can ask by voice, too.

NEWS ALERTS
Turn on notifications to get the most important stories as soon as they're published. Tap the alert to go straight to the article.

BUILT FOR READING
• English and Portuguese
• Save articles to read later
• Share via WhatsApp, email or any app

No sign-up, no login: just open and read.

name: One House, Many Lives
description:
Begin in 1920. Choose a narrow townhouse, a garden cottage or a corner shop house, and guide it to 2020, four years at a time.

A HOUSE YOU CAN CHANGE
Inspect the living cutaway. Restore a stair, join supported rooms, plant a tree, modernize utilities or save an old shop sign. Building work changes both the floor plan and the story.

PEOPLE WHO LEAVE THEIR MARK
Care for five generations, answer household wishes and follow 20 authored profiles. Returning descendants recognize traces of the past. Read the journal, financial ledger and historical layers to see what endured.

CHOICES WITH CONSEQUENCES
Choose one of three included play styles and a long-term ambition. Keep era promises, prepare for approaching crises and see the actual effects after each four-year decision. There are 34 building and management actions, five eras and 95 contextual event variations.

A LEGACY OF YOUR OWN
Your keeper name and optional house name become part of the history. In 2020, discover the legacy your decisions created and share its report if you choose.

Three complete base campaigns are included. Optional one-time purchases add the Dockside Warehouse campaign, the Family Estate campaign or three cosmetic interior palettes. These are separate permanent non-consumable purchases, not subscriptions. They do not sell repairs, currency or favorable endings.

No ads. No real-time repair timers. No account required. Gameplay works offline; purchases and restoration may require the internet. English and Turkish. Campaigns are stored locally on the device; purchase restoration does not recover deleted progress.

name: One Object, 100 Years
description:
A pocket watch is wound for the last train. A silver ring remembers a teaspoon. A camera waits for someone to fill an empty chair.

From 1920 to 2020, follow one object through five eras of affection, loss, repair and rediscovery. You are its memory and fate: choose which names, marks and opportunities survive. The hands change. The object remembers.

• Six complete stories included: pocket watch, silver ring, film camera, wooden toy, leather-bound book and violin.
• Fifteen substantial decisions in every century, with consequences that return decades later.
• Eighteen fictional characters and branching narrative events.
• Eight kinds of legacy, from a family heirloom to material reborn with a new purpose.
• Layered illustrations, instrumental motifs and tactile archival controls.
• Inspect the wear, follow ownership documents and explore a century-long timeline.
• Collect and share a final exhibit of each journey.
• Play offline, without accounts, advertising or energy timers.
• English and Turkish. Adjustable narrative text, sound, haptics and motion.

Optional permanent additions:
Forgotten Treasures adds a compass, portable typewriter and music box, each with a complete story. The Restoration Atelier follows the patient work of preserving a pocket watch. Collector’s Gallery adds cosmetic display materials. All six original objects are complete without purchases.

name: OneTap Interval Timer
description:
「設定画面を行き来せず、開いてすぐにスタートしたい」
そんな声から生まれた、1画面完結型のインターバル＆カウントダウンタイマーです。

複雑なメニューや多すぎる設定項目をすべて削ぎ落とし、トレーニングや競技の現場で本当に必要な機能だけを直感的に操作できるデザインに仕上げました。

【主な特徴】

■ 画面遷移なし！1画面ですべて完結
時間の調整、プリセットの呼び出し・登録、モード切替、音量調整まで、すべて1つの画面に集約。アプリを開いて迷わずすぐに計測を始められます。

■ 厳選された3つのプリセット（長押しで即登録）
よく使うメニューをすぐに呼び出せるよう、プリセットはあえて3つに厳選。ボタンを長押しするだけで、現在の設定時間をその場で上書き保存できます。

■ 離れていてもクッキリ見える高コントラストLED
暗いジムや道場、コートの端からでも残り時間が一目で分かるデジタルLED風ディスプレイを採用。総経過時間と現在のセット数も同時に確認できます。

■ 誰にでも見やすい3色のユニバーサルカラー（CUD配慮）
赤・シアン・イエローの3色から、ワンタップで数字の表示色を切り替え可能。色覚特性や弱視の方、屋外・照明環境に合わせて最も見やすい色を選べます。

■ インターバル ＆ 通常タイマーをワンタッチ切替
上部のスイッチひとつで「INTERVAL（2つの時間を交互に繰り返す）」と「NORMAL（通常のカウントダウン）」を切り替えられます。

■ 実用性を追求した細かな配慮
・計測中は画面の自動ロック（スリープ）を自動で防止
・アプリ内の音量スライダー＆ワンタップミュート対応
・マナーモード（消音スイッチON）でもカウントダウン音・切替音を再生
・誤って画面を閉じたりロックしたりした場合も、バックグラウンド通知でお知らせ

【こんなシーンにおすすめ】
・筋トレ、HIIT、タバタ式トレーニング
・柔術、ボクシング、MMAなどのスパーリング・ラウンド管理
・ランニング、サーキットトレーニング
・勉強（ポモドーロテクニック）やストレッチの計測

name: OnPace: Walk & Run Pacer
description:
Set a distance and a goal time, and OnPace becomes your pacer for every walk and run.

■ Ahead or behind, in real time
See exactly how many seconds you are ahead of or behind your goal, and the pace you need to finish the remaining distance on time — recalculated as you go. Green when you're ahead, yellow when slightly behind, red when far behind.

■ Voice feedback, eyes free
At the interval you choose (for example every kilometer), OnPace gives short, clear updates like "1 kilometer. 12 seconds ahead." Choose the voice, its pitch and speed, or even use your own Personal Voice. Your music is lowered only while it speaks.

■ Apple Watch and the Lock Screen
Work out with Apple Watch alone, or together with iPhone for the same live view on both, with wrist taps for your time gap. The Live Activity on the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island lets you check, pause and end without unlocking.

■ Your own courses
Tap points or trace a path with your finger to create a course, and preview its distance and time. Save the route of a past workout as a course, and get a start alert when you arrive at the starting point.

■ Heart rate zone goals (Zone 1–5)
Choose a target zone range and get a haptic and voice alert when you drift out of it. Set your own maximum heart rate and zone thresholds.

■ History and sharing
Pace, speed, heart rate and elevation charts, splits, steps, photos and notes — plus share images for feeds and stories. OnPace remembers your last distance and time so you can start right away.

■ Private by design
No accounts, no ads. Workouts stay on your devices and in your own iCloud, and health details such as heart rate stay on your iPhone. Optionally save workouts to Apple Health.

■ Free
Goal pace guidance, time gap and required pace, voice feedback (default items), Apple Watch app, Live Activities, workout history and charts, up to 2 saved courses

■ OnPace Pro (one-time purchase, not a subscription)
Choose voice feedback items, heart rate zone goals and custom thresholds, unlimited courses, draw courses by hand, start point arrival alerts, share images without watermark

Languages: Korean, English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Spanish, German
Heart rate information is for fitness reference only and is not intended for medical use.

name: onSet Monitor
description:
onSet Monitor puts every camera's picture and settings on the iPhone or iPad in your hand, with no cables to the monitor.

Connect straight to your Sony FX6 and FX3 cameras over their own Wi-Fi or your set's network. Watch one camera large or all of them side by side, change exposure without walking to the camera, and roll every camera with one tap.

LIVE VIEW
• Each camera's picture over Wi-Fi, with the current live view size shown beside it
• One camera large, one large with the others beside it, or all of them the same size
• Clean view hides everything but the picture
• Choose High, Medium or Low live view quality for a sharper or steadier picture

CAMERA CONTROL
• Iris, ND, EI or ISO, shutter, white balance, focus mode, frame rate, look and recording format
• Settings the camera has locked are shown but can't be changed by mistake
• Start and stop recording on one camera or on all of them, with a hold switch so a stray tap can't cut a take
• Battery, media time remaining and clip name for every camera

MONITORING TOOLS
• False colour with an on-picture ruler, zebras and focus peaking
• Waveform (luma or RGB), vectorscope and histogram
• Rule of thirds, centre mark and safe area frame lines
• Import your own .cube LUTs, one per camera

TAKE LOG
• Scene, shot and take, with automatic take numbers
• Circle takes, add markers while rolling and write notes
• Export as CSV, EDL, SRT or JSON

SET UP IN SECONDS
• Scan the camera's QR code, or point the iPhone at its Wi-Fi and login screen, and the details fill in for you
• Saved cameras reconnect when you come back

SHARE WITH THE CREW
Run onSet Monitor on a Mac and every iPhone and iPad on the same network can watch the same cameras, view only. Handy for directors, focus pullers and clients.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no analytics, no ads. The app talks only to your cameras and your own Mac. Camera logins stay in your device's Keychain.

Requires a Sony FX6 or FX3 with network remote control (Access Authentication) turned on. Live view over Wi-Fi is a reduced picture, about 1024 pixels wide, sent by the camera for monitoring.

Sony, FX6 and FX3 are trademarks of Sony Group Corporation. onSet Monitor is not affiliated with or endorsed by Sony.

name: OnSite-Soft Kiosk
description:
OnSite-Soft turns your iPad into the reception desk for your site. Visitors, employees and contractors check in and out themselves – fast, paperless and traceable.

SELF CHECK-IN AT THE KIOSK
• Scan the invitation QR code or type the 6-character fallback code
• No tapping needed: the first scan checks in, the next one checks out
• Handheld scanners via Bluetooth or USB-C – the camera then stays off
• Employee and contractor badges with QR or barcode
• German and English

SAFETY AND PRIVACY
• Privacy notice confirmation
• Safety briefings with images and PDFs, confirmed by signature
• Optional visitor photo for the badge
• Hosts are notified automatically

RECEPTION AND EMERGENCY
• Today's visits, pickup and check-out at a glance
• Visitor badges on label or AirPrint printers
• Emergency: live attendance list for the assembly point – even offline

IN YOUR COMPANY'S DESIGN
Logo, colours and welcome text come from your account.

Hosted in the EU, no ads, no tracking.

Note: The app is for companies with an OnSite-Soft account. The iPad is connected with a setup code from the web portal.

name: Oozy Sort!
description:
Sort bright jelly pieces into matching tubes, one move at a time. Tap to move a group or drag it straight to its destination. Take your time, undo a move, restart a puzzle, or open a free extra tube when you need a little room.

Learn with hand-built introductory puzzles and then keep playing with generated levels. Play offline, return to your current puzzle, and set sound and haptics to your liking.

name: OpticPair: Used Lens Checks
description:
OpticPair helps sellers of used interchangeable camera lenses check what they are about to ship against the condition and accessories they disclosed.

MARK THE LENS
Choose a lens zone and import a photo. Pin a visible mark or record that you saw no visible issue on that surface. Describe your observation in your own words and select the included accessories. Issue a dated disclosure that preserves the observation and promised parts.

RECHECK BEFORE PACKING
Compare the physical lens and each promised accessory with the issued disclosure. An unchecked item or mismatch blocks pack-out. A recheck that matches the disclosure clears the item. If what you’ll send has changed, issue a correction and check against that revision. OpticPair keeps the earlier disclosure and its history.

KEEP A CONDITION RECORD
Record dispatch after pack-out and preview the PDF for that disclosure. The report includes the photo and marker, the checks you recorded, and your dispatch entry. Choose Save PDF to save it to Files.

OPEN THE SAMPLE
Start with a fictional 35 mm lens that has a mount abrasion and a missing promised rear cap. See what blocks pack-out, then recheck the cap and preview the result.

Your records, photos, and PDF generation stay on your device. An app account is unnecessary. The app records your observations and entries about condition, packing, and dispatch.

OPTICPAIR PRO
An optional purchase lets you save named sets of promised accessories and use them in new drafts. The disclosure and PDF workflow is included for all sellers. OpticPair Pro offers monthly and annual auto-renewing subscriptions and a one-time lifetime purchase. Apple shows applicable prices and trial eligibility before purchase. Subscriptions renew unless canceled in your App Store account settings.

Privacy Policy
https://nexlevel.com.br/opticpair/privacy.html

Terms of Use
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Oráculo de Hécate
description:
Hécate, diosa de la magia y de los caminos, te acompaña en la encrucijada.

Cada semana —gratis, cuando empieza el lunes— abre tres cartas: la raíz, lo que influye hoy y hacia dónde apunta el camino. Si quieres una lectura más profunda, pregunta con el mazo vivo de 78 cartas: Tres caminos, Amor, Trabajo, Luna Llena o la Cruz Celta. Cada mañana puedes revelar tu carta del día, también gratis, y consultar el calendario lunar con la hora de Chile.

El mazo es propio del Oráculo de Hécate: cada carta tiene ilustración y una animación que la hace cobrar vida. Ilustraciones: Created with Grok. Imágenes generadas con inteligencia artificial. Las interpretaciones se escriben en el iPhone, en español, con un motor local. No hay cuenta, no hay registro y no se envían tus preguntas a un servidor ni a un modelo de inteligencia artificial.

La primera tirada de la semana es gratis. Las consultas siguientes se pagan con créditos que compras en esta app, a través de la App Store. Los créditos son consumibles: se gastan al consultar y viven en este iPhone. No se pueden restaurar en otro aparato.

Las lecturas son solo entretenimiento. No son consejo médico, psicológico, legal ni financiero, y no son predicciones reales.

Una app de Christian Jaramillo.

name: Orbit 9: Galactic Racing
description:
Speed among the stars.

In Orbit 9 you pilot magnetic hover racers that float above suspended avenues at over 400 km/h, with the camera right behind the vehicle. Straights call for speed; curves call for a steady hand: the magnetic field pushes you out and you have to steer inside.

ARCADE RACING, SIMPLE CONTROLS
• Hold ◀ or ▶ to steer; acceleration is automatic (or use the ACCELERATE button) and BRAKE helps in tight curves
• PULSE stabilizes the racer when the field pushes you out
• JUMP clears red obstacles; on the ramp, fly through the RING for a double boost
• Cyan arrows give a boost; leaving the track costs speed

3 CITIES IN THE ROOKIE LEAGUE
• Nova Arcadia: suspended avenues between blue towers, ramps and a gap wide open to space
• Vesper City: magenta neon in the rain and a low-gravity zone with long jumps
• Solaris Gate: golden avenues under a huge sun and solar gusts that push you sideways

6 HOVER RACERS
• Astra, Comet, Pulse, Vektor, Bulwark and Spectra, each with its own strength
• Garage setup for acceleration, top speed and stability (the sum stays at zero)
• Paint, trail color, stripe and emblem bought with the credits you earn racing

GAME MODES
• Quick race: 3 laps against 5 rivals, on Easy, Medium or Hard
• Championship: 3 races, one in each city, with points and overall standings
• Career: podium, win, fast lap, clean race and ring goals, with credit rewards
• Time trial and free practice, plus a tutorial in your first race

HIGH DEFINITION
• Layered cities, glowing thrusters, reflections on the track and light effects
• Comfort settings: button size and opacity, HUD scale and options to reduce shake, flashes and particles

PLAY OFFLINE
• Every track works offline, no login, no account
• Nothing paid changes performance: credits are earned only by racing
• Ads only when leaving the results screen, never during the race, the start or pause; "Remove ads" is a one-time purchase
• In English, Portuguese and Spanish

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://orbit9.filisoft.com.br/privacidade.php?lang=en

name: Órbita 90
description:
Toca los números (o las letras) en orden mientras giran en órbitas, como un sistema solar. Empiezas con 90 segundos; cada nivel suma 5 números y quita 5 segundos. Un toque equivocado te resta 3 segundos. Los aciertos rápidos suben tu racha.

Incluye modo Clásico, Zen, duelo para 2 jugadores en el mismo iPhone, reto del día, torneo semanal, logros, temas y un ranking en línea.

En la tienda puedes comprar recargas de tiempo y comodines para congelar las órbitas, solo para Clásico y Zen. Si los usas en una partida, esa partida no sube al ranking. También hay un pack de temas que se puede restaurar.

En el ranking se muestran apodos de hasta 12 caracteres. Puedes ocultar un apodo en tu iPhone o reportarlo; revisamos los reportes y quitamos los puntajes que no correspondan.

Un juego de Christian Jaramillo / MILLO GAMES.

name: ORTI – Court booking
description:
ORTI is an app for booking courts at your sports club or centre. See free slots in real time and book the court yourself – any time, without calling the club.

FOR PLAYERS
• Booking in one window: day, time and court, then a partner or guest
• Calendar of all courts for a day or a week
• "Notify me": get a notification when a taken slot frees up
• Find a game: post that you are looking for a partner or opponent and book from a response
• Club leagues and tournaments with standings and result entry
• Player card, statistics, achievements and the club leaderboard
• Club noticeboard: sell, buy or give away sports gear (where the club turns it on)
• Notifications on your iPhone, in the app, by Viber or email – each player chooses
• Home Screen widget with your next booking
• Add a booking to your iPhone calendar in one tap
• Pay for a booking by card or with credit, where the club uses it

FOR CLUBS AND SPORTS CENTRES
• Booking rules per badge: days ahead, simultaneous bookings, cancellation deadline
• Prices by hour, day and court, credit packages
• Several sports and courts in one calendar
• Closing courts (rain, maintenance) with automatic notification of affected players
• Notices to members and occupancy statistics

ORTI is available in Slovenian, Croatian and English. To book you need an ORTI account and membership in a club that uses ORTI.

name: Osøyro Simulator
description:
Osøyro, western Norway. 15,000 people, a church from 1870 and Bjørnafjorden glittering in the summer sun. You have OM$0 Os Moneys, a paper cup and half a waffle from the bin behind Billigkroken. A good day, in other words.

Osøyro Simulator is an open-world game about going from beggar to King of Os in a town that really exists. The map is built from real map data: the streets, the houses, the quay, the church and the roundabout everyone has an opinion about.

FROM PAPER CUP TO GOLDEN STATUE
• Beg outside Billigkroken. Granny Solveig says it worked for her uncle in 1974. He owns half of Bjørnafjorden now.
• Sell Bygdebrølet, buy a scooter, bake pizza at Pøsregn, and drive pizza and taxi for Siste Reis Taxi.
• Buy businesses, hire people who steal from the till, and build an empire that earns while you sleep.
• Ten odd jobs: walk dogs, wash windows, mow lawns, gut fish and carry shopping up the hills.
• Haunt Lysekloster as the White Lady, beat the dentist at golf and become King of Os.

A TOWN THAT LIVES
• People with lives of their own: they shop, work, sit on benches and complain. The shops keep opening hours. The bank closes at 15:00. Of course.
• Taco Friday, 17 May, Os Days, church weddings and New Year's Eve on the quay. The sour cream is sold out.
• Bright western-Norway summer days, cosy warm streetlamps at dusk and the occasional passing shower so nobody forgets which coast this is.
• Os-Nytt on your phone knows everything you've done. So does Mamma. She's told everyone.

EVERYTHING YOU SHOULDN'T DO
• Drive anything with wheels. Out of fuel? Then you push. The laser man is behind a bush.
• Våpen-Villy sells everything from a bandy stick to a rocket launcher, with a salmon cannon in between. No refunds.
• The police fight back. The cell has a better view than your flat.
• Twenty golden trophies are hidden around Os. Don't ask.

18+, AND WE MEAN IT
For adults. Contains violence with guns, explosives and a chainsaw, with blood on by default (Ketchup Mode in Settings), simulated gambling played with pretend money, alcohol and tobacco references and dark humour about everything from the council to Bergen. Nothing explicit. No real people. The private businesses and brands are made up; public institutions such as NAV and Vinmonopolet appear only as satire. Just Osøyro.

No tracking. The game is free with ad breaks. You can earn every Os Money one bottle return at a time; an optional one-time purchase turns the ad breaks off, and optional Os Moneys packs from Pant-Per's Stash are sold in the Os Moneys Store. Os Moneys only exist in the game and have no real-world value.

The bridge over Bjørnafjorden isn't coming. You are.

name: Overlook for iPad
description:
Overlook turns your iPad into a beautiful, always-on dashboard for your home. Weather, your commute, the family calendar, your cameras and your servers, laid out on one clear screen for a stand, a wall mount or the kitchen worktop.

YOUR DAY, AT A GLANCE
• Live weather with hourly and 10-day forecasts, rain in the next hour and severe weather warnings
• Air quality and pollen, plus extra locations you can swipe through
• Your commute with live traffic, alternative routes and a "Leave by" time that knows your working days
• Today and the week ahead from your shared iCloud calendars
• A photo slideshow from your photo library

A CLOCK FOR EVERY ROOM
• Eleven clock styles: Digital, Flip, LED, Binary, Words, Rings, Classic, Minimal, Modern, Railway and Roman
• Put the clock on the dashboard as a card, or keep it in the top bar

KITCHEN TIMERS
• Start a timer with Siri ("Start a timer in Overlook") or from Settings
• The alarm rings on the iPad, and a notification reaches you even when Overlook isn't open

YOUR HOME, AT A TOUCH
• Room temperatures, humidity, open doors and windows at a glance
• Switch lights, plugs, switches and fans on and off, and run your scenes
• Live HomeKit cameras, with a pop-up when someone rings the doorbell or there's motion
• Full-screen alarms for smoke, carbon monoxide and leaks, and notices for low batteries and devices that stop responding

ALERTS ON YOUR DASHBOARD
• Send messages to your iPad from ntfy or any webhook: urgent pop-ups, gentle toasts or a scrolling ticker
• Perfect for "washing machine finished", "backup failed" or "someone's at the gate"

KEEP AN EYE ON YOUR HOMELAB
• CPU, memory, storage, network and Docker containers from your Glances servers, with history charts
• Uptime Kuma status pages and Home Assistant entities
• Alert badges when a server goes offline, a container stops or a disk fills up

MAKE IT YOURS
• Tap a card to open it full screen. Touch and hold to move and resize it on a simple grid
• Several dashboards, for the kitchen, the hallway or your homelab, each switching at the time you choose. Swipe sideways to change
• Liquid Glass or solid cards, six colour schemes, and a black, Aurora or photo wallpaper
• A Home Screen widget that shows one card, or rotates through them
• Set it up from your iPhone: scan a QR code and type addresses and server details on your phone

GENTLE AT NIGHT
• A dim night clock on a timetable you choose
• Burn-in protection for OLED iPads: the dashboard drifts slowly, dims when nobody's touched it and can let your iPad lock again

WORKS WITH OVERLOOK FOR APPLE TV
• Settings sync through iCloud with the Apple TV app and between your iPads, and each device picks its own dashboard
• Units follow your region: °C or °F, miles or kilometres

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account and no tracking. Your settings stay on your iPad and in your own iCloud. Passwords and tokens are kept in the Keychain, and your homelab is only ever reached over your own network.

Overlook runs in landscape, full screen, on iPadOS 26 or later.

name: Oyun Gecesi: Party Games
description:
Play with your friends at the same time, everyone on their own phone! Oyun Gecesi ("Game Night") brings 14 party games into one lobby, for house parties, breaks at school or work, and video calls. The games are in Turkish.

HOW IT WORKS
• Type your name to make a profile.
• Create a lobby and send your friends the code, the invite link or the QR code.
• Friends join by tapping the code or scanning the QR.
• When you pick a game, everyone's phone moves into it automatically.

GAMES
• Vampir & Köylü: hidden roles, night and day, find the vampire
• Kelime Ajanları: two teams, one-word clues, find your agents
• Çiz Bil: one draws, everyone guesses
• Karalama Zinciri: write, draw, guess, see where the chain ends up
• Yasak Kelime: describe the word without the forbidden ones
• Kelime Avı: find the same word fastest
• Sudoku Yarışı: same puzzle, fastest solver wins
• İsim Şehir: a letter comes up, fill in the categories
• Casus Kim?: everyone knows the place except the spy
• Bilgi Yarışması: the question on the screen, the answers on your phone
• Emoji Bilmece: what do the emojis say?
• Gizli Söz and Harf Koşusu: quick letter games
• Son Saniye: defuse the bomb together by talking

FEATURES
• Presentation screen: show the game on a TV or a shared screen in a video call
• Join a lobby in seconds with a QR code
• "Your friend is calling you to the lobby" and "the game started" notifications
• Optional weekly game night reminder
• Leaderboard, levels and badges
• Send reactions during the game
• No ads, no sign-up, no e-mail needed

Play safe: report or block anyone who bothers you with a single tap.

name: OZ Portfolio Ops
description:
OZ Portfolio Ops is the field companion to the Origin Zero portal. Complete compliance audits and close corrective actions from site, synced to the portal in real time.

• Answer audits by topic and attach photo evidence
• Raise, track and close corrective actions
• Review audits, add comments and approve
• Get notified when work is assigned to you
• Secure sign-in with a one-time email code

You need an Origin Zero account from your organisation's administrator to sign in.

name: Pack By
description:
Pack By counts down to your departure and paces every gear buy, prep task and packing job so the trip is ready when you are — not the night before.

Pick what you're packing for, set the date, and Pack By spreads the work across three windows that open as the date approaches:

GEAR UP (UP TO T–60 DAYS)
Book and order what you need while there is still runway — a house move starts two months out, a camping weekend about two weeks. Every item can carry an estimated price, so your gear budget is a number, not a guess.

TUNE UP (T–14 DAYS)
Reservations, permits, tune-ups and confirmations — the calls and bookings that make the trip real.

PACK UP (T–48 HOURS)
The final checklist: pack, load, fuel, go. Your phone shows what is left at a glance while the countdown ticks down to departure.

START WITH A TEMPLATE
Six starter plans, each with its own suggested date and countdown — Moving House for movers, boxes, utilities and keys; Vacation for flights, passports and carry-ons; Camp Out for tent or RV trips; Road Trip for car prep and long hauls; College Move-In for dorm gear and logistics; and Hospital Bag so you are ready well before the due date. Download Pack By, set your departure date, and start the countdown.

DEPARTURE CHECK

PACKING FOR HOME
Switch to "Pack for home" before you check out so nothing gets left behind.

FORGOT SOMETHING? FIX IT NEXT TIME
After the trip, mark what you forgot and what you never used. Next time PackList warns you: "Forgot last time" and "Unused last time".

description:
Pangea Golf es tu entrenador de golf en el móvil. Un chat con un profesional que te conoce, te corrige y te dice qué practicar.

PARA QUIÉN ES

Para quien empieza, para quien vuelve después de años y para quien quiere bajar su hándicap. No necesitas equipo especial: solo un móvil y un sitio donde dar bolas.

Pangea Golf la dirige Alex Verges Vila, golfista profesional. Jugó en la NCAA en Estados Unidos y tuvo tarjeta del Challenge Tour.

name: Pantry to Plate: Pantry Chef
description:

MAKE A PERSONAL COOKBOOK
Choose recipes and create a downloadable cookbook with a title, cover and back cover. Save up to 10 custom cookbooks.

Share selected kitchen content, discover community recipes and message friends. Private recipes stay private unless you choose to share them. Message alerts work while the app is open.

Use the Kitchen inspiration widget for eligible public recipes, and open public recipes in Safari. Private recipes are kept out of public widget and handoff data.

name: Parcelnook
description:
Parcelnook keeps the parcels you are waiting on and the return windows you calculate yourself. Record a shop, what you ordered, the dates, and a tracking note. Move each parcel from Expected to Arrived to Opened when you say so. The three dots on a card follow that status.

A return slip stores the day you opened the parcel and the number of days the shop allowed. The deadline is that day plus the window. Open slips past the deadline are marked late. Spending adds the costs you typed, by order date and by shop.

Parcelnook does not look up carriers and does not start a return. If an email or a counter disagrees with a date here, trust that source and edit the slip. Data stays on this iPhone.

name: Pathi - باثي
description:
Pathi is a private place to share your day with your close friends.

Post a thought, a photo, a short video, a voice note, a song with a 30-second preview, your city, or when you wake up and go to sleep. Only the friends you choose can see it.

• A small circle: friends only. No followers, no public feed, no ads.
• Moments in every shape: thoughts, photos, videos, voice, music, places.
• React with faces: see who reacted and tap a face to visit their profile.
• Comments and private messages with your friends.
• You decide who can find you: finding you by email, or suggestions from your workplace or city, are optional and off by default.

Pathi has no ads, no tracking across other apps and websites, and never sells your data.

name: Pawprey: Games for Cats
description:
Turn your phone or iPad into a hunting ground. Pawprey lets your cat chase a mouse, a laser dot, goldfish, a fly or a butterfly right on the screen, with prey that moves like the real thing.

Most cat games just slide a picture across the screen. Pawprey's prey freezes, darts away when a paw comes close, hides off the edge and sneaks back in. When your cat lands a catch, the prey wriggles and escapes so the hunt keeps going.

• 5 hunting modes: mouse, laser pointer, goldfish, fly and butterfly, each with its own scene and sounds
• Calm mode with slow drifting feathers and bubbles to pop
• Set speed, size and how many on screen
• Cat-vision colors: yellow and blue on a dark background, the colors cats see best
• A ripple and a squeak on every catch
• Locked while playing: paws can’t close the game. Hold two fingers for 1.5 seconds to finish
• Play timer (5, 10 or 15 minutes) and a daily log of play time and catches
• Made for iPad too: bigger screen, bigger prey
• No ads, ever. Nothing pops up under your cat’s paws

How to play: pick the prey, press Start and put the device flat on the floor near your cat. Some cats need a few tries to get interested; slow speed and a bigger size help.

description:

CALLS

RECENTS AND VOICEMAIL

CONTACTS AND SETTINGS

• Call forwarding and blocked numbers

• Your time zone; English, Simplified Chinese or Traditional Chinese

name: PaxSoven
description:
Ever reach Friday and wonder where the week went? PaxSoven is a small field notebook for that question. Each day you note what you finished and what got in the way. By the end of the week you have a map of the ground you covered.

It started from a simple hunch: a list of things done tells you more than a list of things to do. And the blockers, written down the moment they happen, turn out to be the most useful notes of all.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

· Log done and blocked entries. Pick Done or Blocked, write one line, press log. You can step back to earlier days and add something you forgot.
· Tag anything. Type tags in the tag field or drop a #hashtag into the entry itself. Recent tags sit under the field as quick picks, and every tag opens its own page with all its entries.
· Read the weekly summary. Each day gets a pair of bars, done beside blocked. A dial sweeps to the share of entries that were done, and you see active days, your busiest day, top tags and every wall you hit that week.
· Export as text. Choose bullets, Markdown or a day-by-day layout, decide whether blocked items, tags and totals belong in it, then copy the text or share it to any app. Handy for stand-ups, reviews or a note to yourself.
· Keep a streak. A day counts when at least one thing is done. Today shows your current streak, your best run and a trail of the last seven days. Hit a milestone and a little drum roll plays.

HOW IT LOOKS

The whole app is drawn like a topographic map: contour lines, compass marks and earthy tints, with stained-glass windows marking the empty places. The tab bar is four moon phases, and the one you are on turns full. Light and dark appearance are both supported.

WHAT IT DOES NOT DO

· No account, no sign-in, no ads.
· No reminders nagging you.
· It works fully offline. When a connection is around, an anonymous backup of your entries is kept, and you can restore it from Settings.

Sounds are short and synthesised on the device: a glassy clink when you log and a timpani roll at streak milestones. Switch them off in Settings any time.

Curious what your week really looked like? Start charting.

name: Peermate

Play chess your way: against the computer, with a friend on the same phone, or online with anyone, with no server in between.

• Two players, one phone; the board turns for each move

FRIENDS
• Add friends with a link or a QR code

• Send private, end-to-end encrypted messages

name: Photo Catcher: Photo Cleaner
description:

COPIES

SIMILAR SHOTS

LARGE VIDEOS

YOU DECIDE
Nothing is removed until you choose it, and iOS asks you to confirm. Removed items stay in Photos › Recently Deleted for 30 days, so you can always bring them back.

PRIVATE
Everything happens on your iPhone or iPad. No account, no tracking, no ads, and Photo Catcher never connects to the internet.

name: Phrasewise
description:
Practice for a while and your "What I can do" page starts filling with lines like these:

I can check in at the airport counter.
I can answer questions at immigration and customs.
I can call the front desk about a problem in my room.
I can book a table, order food, and pay at a restaurant.
I can say how I feel at a pharmacy and get help in an emergency.
I can speak up and ask questions in meetings.
I can disagree politely and suggest other ideas.
I can start a chat about the weather.

Each line belongs to one scene. There are thirty in all, across travel, work and everyday life, and every script, pattern and word list was written by us. Finish a scene and another "I can" joins the list.

How you get there
Follow Today's practice for ten minutes (or twenty, or thirty). Learn two or three core patterns and swap in words to build many sentences. Shadow the model voice, record yourself and compare. Then role-play: the app speaks the other person's line, you answer first, and then you see the most natural way to say it. Spaced repetition brings words back right before you'd forget them, and short listening items ask you to pick the best reply.

Built for people who are afraid of getting it wrong
No red crosses, just "listen once more." No timers. Tap any word to hear it slowly, drop to 0.75x speed or go word by word, and hear US, UK and Australian voices in turn.

See it, then say it
About 360 words come with a small 3D picture, plus a "Picture match" practice; pattern choices and scene sentences have pictures too. While a sentence is read aloud, each word lights up as it's spoken, linked words are marked with ‿ (pick‿it‿up), and long words are split into syllables with the stress in bold (to·MOR·row). Linking and syllable marks can be turned off in Settings.

Help when you're abroad
Feeling ill, lost something, can't find your way? Open the survival sheet for ready-made phrases, play one aloud or show it full screen. No internet needed.

How much is inside
About 440 scene sentences, 90 patterns, roughly 1,000 practical words, 160 listening items, 160 plain-language grammar items and 41 survival phrases, all original. An optional two-minute level check on first launch.

Menus are available in four languages (English, Japanese, and Chinese in both scripts); translations of the English content are in Traditional Chinese.

Your voice stays on your phone
No account, no internet, nothing collected. Speech uses your phone's built-in voices, and recordings are never uploaded or analyzed.

name: PickNest: Spin & Decide
description:
Meet PickNest, the quick way to settle everyday choices. Pick what to eat, what to watch, or what to do this weekend—without building a list from scratch.

Choose from ready-made decks for Food, Movies, Weekend, Drinks, Snacks, Places, Tonight, Games, and Movie Night. Movie Night includes specific offline film suggestions, while curated vibe filters narrow the other decks to ideas that fit the moment. Tap Spin and watch the animated wheel make a weighted random pick, or compare up to three distinct weighted finalists and choose one to save to your history. When you want a different result, turn on Avoid Repeats to skip the last pick while other choices are available.

Make PickNest your own when you need to. Add or edit choices, adjust their weights, hide stale ideas, paste a list, duplicate a deck, and arrange its choices. Save favorite results and review pick counts and top results for each deck in your on-device history.

Keep a quick spin close with the Home Screen widget, or ask Siri to spin your selected deck with the PickNest Shortcut.

**Made for small decisions**

- Start immediately with nine ready-made decks and specific movie suggestions
- Spin an animated wheel or compare up to three weighted finalists
- Avoid your most recent result
- See past picks and history insights
- Use the Home Screen widget or Siri Shortcut
- Customize decks, weights, and choice lists when you want

Your decks and history stay on your device and work offline. PickNest requires no account and includes no ads or analytics of its own.

name: Pilot PTSD Alarm
description:
Captain, it's time to wake up.

Pilot PTSD Alarm is a special wake-up alarm made for pilots.
The cockpit-style warning sounds that kept you on edge through every checkride will now make sure you never oversleep again.

■ TERRIFYING WARNING SOUNDS
Choose from 12 sounds including Stall Stall, Terrain Terrain, Pull Up, Bank Angle, Sink Rate, Wind Shear, Stick Shaker, Overspeed, Fire Alarm and Brace Brace. Preview each one before you pick.

■ ALARMS FOR ANY WEEKDAY + SNOOZE
Set repeating alarms for any day of the week. Name each one ("NYC trip", "Briefing in 30!") and choose a snooze interval from 1 to 15 minutes.

■ RELIABLE, EVEN ON THE LOCK SCREEN
Built on iOS AlarmKit, so alarms ring like system alarms, even in Silent mode or Focus, and you can stop or snooze right from the Lock Screen.

■ AIRPORT WEATHER THE MOMENT YOU WAKE
See the current METAR on the main screen: wind, visibility, QNH and flight category (VFR / MVFR / IFR / LIFR) at a glance.

■ TAF FORECAST INCLUDED
The TAF is shown as a color-coded timeline with a one-line summary of the worst period, so you know what's coming before you leave for the airport.

■ EVERY AIRPORT, WORLDWIDE
Automatically find the nearest airport with GPS, or search by airport name, city, ICAO or IATA code and pin it. Recently searched airports are one tap away.

■ ALWAYS ON LOCAL TIME
Alarms follow your device's current time zone, wherever your layover takes you.

[NOTES]
• Weather data comes from the NOAA Aviation Weather Center (aviationweather.gov) and is for reference only. Always use an official weather briefing for operational decisions.
• "PTSD" in the app name is a lighthearted pilot joke. This is not a medical or health app.
• Requires iOS 26 or later.

name: pinmatics: Bowling Club
description:
pinmatics is the app for your nine-pin bowling (Kegeln) club. One iPhone is enough: enter throws, play the classic Kegel games and keep the fine box – no paper, no account.

TEN GAMES
• In die Vollen and Abräumen
• Big and small house number
• Up and down
• Always more and always less
• Sorry!
• Three and less
• Even or odd
Adapt the rules to your club: throws, rounds, target and start value.

FAST INPUT
Tap the number or mark the fallen pins in the picture. Pudel (miss), Bande (cushion) and Kranz have their own buttons; undo is one tap.

FINE BOX
• Your own fine catalogue
• Misses in a game are booked automatically
• Open amounts and payments per member
• What is in the kitty and what is still open

BOWLING KING AND STATS
Average per throw, wins, Alle Neune, Kranz and Pudel for every member – and who is this year's bowling king.

pinmatics PRO
Free: In die Vollen, Abräumen, big house number, the fine box and up to 6 members. Pro unlocks all games, unlimited members, the season table and sharing the kitty as an image – as a yearly subscription (7 days free) or once for life.

No account, no ads, no tracking. Your data stays on your iPhone.

description:
PinRijk is de Nederlandse community-app waarin je plekken en momenten deelt met andere leden.

Maak een profiel met je eigen gebruikersnaam, plaats foto's en berichten, en bekijk wat anderen delen. Wil je iemand spreken? Stuur direct een bericht aan andere leden en blijf via pushmeldingen op de hoogte van nieuwe reacties en berichten.

Berichten sturen naar andere leden
Pushmeldingen ontvangen bij nieuwe activiteit

name: Pistas: Ski Resorts & Tracker
description:
Pistas is your companion for the mountain, from choosing where to ski to reliving the day.

RESORTS
• 1,000 ski resorts worldwide: browse by country, sort by distance or explore them on a map
• Piste and lift map for every resort, in 2D or 3D over real terrain
• Download a resort's map and use it offline, where the signal is weak
• 7-day and hourly mountain weather
• Lift-ticket prices, webcams and the latest resort news
• Live snow reports for dozens of resorts in Spain, Andorra and Bulgaria: open slopes, lifts and snow depth
• Save favourites to reach them in one tap

GO: TRACK YOUR DAY
• Distance, vertical, top speed, runs, time on lifts and on the piste
• Keeps recording with the screen locked
• Uses the barometer for a more accurate vertical
• Works without signal and without an account; sign in to sync your days across devices

TEAM
• Invite friends with a link or a QR code
• See each other on the map while you ride, and only while you track
• Leave a crew any time

YOUR WAY
• English, Spanish, French, German, Italian and Russian
• Metric or imperial units
• Choose GPS accuracy or battery life

Pistas has no ads and does not track you. Your location is used only to record your day and, if you choose, to show it to your crew.

name: PitchLine: Intonation & Drone
description:
PitchLine turns your iPhone into a distraction-free, 1-meter readable pitch stability trace, interactive etude score coach, and warm cello reference drone built for string, wind, brass, and vocal musicians.

KEY FEATURES
• 60fps Sub-Cent Pitch Stability Trace: See your bow changes, breath support, and vibrato width settle into the ±5-cent emerald target corridor across 4 octaves (C2 to C6), with clean breaks across musical rests.
• Interactive Score Coach: Follow built-in practice scores (including Ode to Joy in D Major, Violin Open Strings, and Bb Wind Long-Tones) that automatically advance as you hold each note in tune.
• Pure 5-Limit Just Intonation: Instantly reveal the -13.7-cent pure major third and +2.0-cent pure fifth target lines for string double-stops, choirs, and wind ensembles.
• Warm 6-Harmonic Cello Drone: Practice over rich, woody cello root and pure-fifth chords instead of harsh electronic buzzes—with adaptive speaker-bleed suppression so simultaneous pitch tracking stays rock-steady.
• Instant Wind Transposition & Concert A4: Display written notes directly for C, Bb, Eb, and F instruments, and calibrate A4 from 415 Hz Baroque to 446 Hz symphony pitch.
• 3 WCAG AAA Stand Themes & Offline Practice Cards: Switch freely between Concert Dark, Sheet Paper, and Stage Amber, log sustained-note stability scores locally, and export CSV reports—100% offline with zero audio recording.

name: Pitfix: DPF Monitor & Regen
description:
Keep the diesel particulate filter of your BMW or MINI clean. See how much soot is in the filter, start a regeneration from your phone and follow it live while you drive.

Pitfix DPF reads the engine control unit of your diesel through an OBD2 or ENET adapter. It shows the soot load, ash, back pressure, exhaust temperature and the distance since the last regeneration, explained in plain words, and tells you when a regeneration is recommended.

START A REGENERATION
- Checks before the start: engine temperature, fuel, faults that would block it
- One tap sends the regeneration request to the engine
- You drive normally, the engine burns the soot while you drive
- Drive mode follows every step: warm up, conditions, burning and done
- Big, clear values you can read at a glance, in portrait or landscape

RESULTS AND HISTORY
- Soot before and after, burn time and peak exhaust temperature
- Every run is saved on your phone, per car
- Watch mode follows a regeneration the car started by itself

ENGINE FAULTS
Pitfix reads the fault memory of the engine, shows which faults can block a regeneration and lets you clear stored faults.

SUPPORTED CARS
BMW diesels with the N47, N57, B37, B47 and B57 engines, from the E series (about 2007) to the F and G series, including 1 to 7 Series, X1 to X7, and MINI R and F series diesels. On some other diesels Pitfix shows the filter values only.

WORKS WITH YOUR ADAPTER
Bluetooth, Bluetooth LE, Wi-Fi and ENET adapters and cables, including OBDLink, Vgate iCar, vLinker and Veepeak. No adapter yet? Try the demo car first.

PAY ONCE, NO SUBSCRIPTION
Reading the filter values, faults and Watch mode are free. Starting a regeneration needs a one-time purchase that works on all your BMW and MINI diesels.

A regeneration heats the exhaust above 500 °C. Drive on open roads, away from dry grass, and keep enough fuel in the tank. A filter that is too full or damaged needs a workshop.

Pitfix DPF is an independent app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by BMW AG.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://pitfix.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://pitfix.app/privacy

name: PitWall Club
description:
PitWall is a private prediction league for race weekends. Play with friends, climb the table and collect achievements all season.

Before every Grand Prix and sprint, make your picks:
- Pole sitter, locked when qualifying starts
- The podium, P1 to P3, locked when the race starts
- Fastest lap and up to two DNFs, or call a clean race

When the result is final, every pick is scored and the league table updates.
Exact podium position: 2 points. Right driver, wrong step: 1. Pole: 2.
Fastest lap, each correct DNF and a correct clean race: 1 each.

Also in PitWall:
- Friends: add players and switch the table to just you and your friends
- Achievements with bronze, silver and gold levels, plus hidden ones to discover
- End-of-season badges, and every past season's table and picks
- Notifications for results, friend requests and support replies, and reminders before picks close
- Share cards for your picks and results
- The full season calendar with sprint weekends, flags and circuit maps
- See everyone's picks once a session locks
- English, Kurdish (Sorani) and Arabic, with full right-to-left layout
- Sign in with a 4-digit PIN. No ads, no tracking, no purchases.

PitWall is an independent fan app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or connected to Formula 1, the FIA or any team.

name: Plain Launcher: Text Widgets
description:
Your apps, as plain text. Tap a line, it opens.

Plain Launcher provides Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets that show the apps and actions you choose as clean text rows. 7-day free trial, then a single $2.99 one-time purchase — no subscription, no icons, no onboarding quiz, no account.

HOW IT WORKS
• Add a Plain Launcher widget to your Home Screen (Small, Medium, Large, or Extra Large) or Lock Screen.
• Touch and hold the widget, tap Edit Widget, and pick the apps you use — or system actions like New Note, Timer, or Find My.
• Tap any line to open the app immediately through iOS. Nothing goes through a redirect app.
• Turn on the optional header to show the current time and date, and assign tap actions to them (for example, Clock and Calendar).

MAKE IT YOURS
• Six presets: Paper, Ink, Graphite, Navy, Terminal, and Serif.
• Customize font family (System, Serif, Monospaced, Rounded), weight, text size, alignment, letter case, row markers (none, dash, bullet, numbers, or arrow), and row spacing.
• Full-color themes for Default icons, plus native support for iOS Clear and Tinted Home Screen styles.
• Built-in Wallpaper generator: create solid or soft-gradient wallpapers tuned to your widget background or 8 quiet tones, rendered at your iPhone's exact screen resolution.

WHAT IT DOESN'T DO
• It does not block apps, track your screen time, or nag you. It is a launcher, not a parent.
• It collects no data, makes no network requests, and includes no analytics or third-party SDKs.

Requires iOS 27.0 or later.

name: PlainMD: Markdown Editor
description:
PlainMD is an offline Markdown editor and reader for iPhone and iPad. Write in plain text, see a paginated preview, and export a copy in the format you need. One purchase includes all current features, with no ads, subscriptions or in-app purchases.

WRITE AND PREVIEW TOGETHER
Edit Markdown with syntax coloring, line numbers and a formatting toolbar. Use Undo and Redo, or switch to basic visual editing for paragraphs, headings, quotes and code. On a wide screen, Side by Side keeps your source and preview together.

On iPhone Duo, source and preview adapt to the inner and outer displays. Partly fold the device to keep content clear of the fold. Your editing position, Undo history and custom zoom stay with you as the layout changes.

Tap a source line number to reveal its rendered content. Preview follows your changes after you pause; Refresh returns to your latest edit.

EXPORT YOUR WORK
Save As PDF, TXT, Markdown, PNG, HTML, RTF or DOCX.
• PDF preserves the page layout you see in preview.
• TXT keeps the original Markdown, including its formatting marks.
• HTML is a standalone document.
• RTF and DOCX provide editable text with basic formatting.
• PNG combines pages into one image; use PDF for very long documents.
Share a local copy using the system share sheet.

READ YOUR WAY
Zoom the whole preview page with a pinch or enter a custom percentage. Use Fit Width, dark appearance or a soft gray light appearance. Preview renders headings, lists, tasks, quotes, code and tables, with support for UTF-8 text, Chinese characters and emoji.

LOCAL BY DESIGN
Create documents or import an editable copy. Source changes save automatically in PlainMD's local library. No account, analytics, tracking or app-managed network requests. PlainMD has no cloud service and does not upload your documents.

Apple's file providers, device backups and the receiving apps you choose in Share are separate services. They may use a network under your settings. Choose On My iPhone or On My iPad for local file storage.

KNOW WHAT IS SUPPORTED
Links remain inactive, images appear as labelled placeholders, and embedded HTML stays literal text. Mermaid diagrams and mathematical notation are not rendered. Complex Markdown blocks stay available in Source when using the basic visual editor. Preview supports up to 8 MiB of source and 1,500 pages. Interface language: English.

Requires iOS or iPadOS 17 or later. No login is needed.

name: Planazo con Plani
description:
¿Qué hacemos hoy? Plani, el camaleón más murciano, te lo dice.

Planazo es tu guía de planes en la Región de Murcia. Abre la app y Plani te propone un sitio para hoy según dónde estés y el tiempo que hace, con lo que tardas en llegar.

QUÉ VAS A ENCONTRAR
• El plan del día: una propuesta de Plani y, si no te convence, «Otro, Plani».
• Cerca de ti: playas, calas, monumentos, museos y naturaleza ordenados por distancia.
• Este finde: lo que hay el sábado y el domingo.
• Agenda: fiestas, Navidad, conciertos y eventos para apuntar en el calendario.
• Mapa: todos los sitios de la guía, cada uno con su ficha, su historia y el consejo de Plani.
• Llévame: te abre la ruta en tu app de mapas con un toque.

EL PASAPORTE PLANAZO
Cuando visites un sitio de la guía, pulsa «Sellar donde estoy» y gana tu sello. Completa playas, pueblos y monumentos, naturaleza y cultura, y consigue medallas.

AVISOS
Si quieres, cada viernes por la tarde te avisamos de los planes del finde.

Hecha en Murcia, para los de aquí y para los que vienen a descubrirla.

name: Plant Care Photo Log
description:
See which pots are due for a soil check as soon as you open the app. Reminders tell you to check the soil, not to water on a schedule.

Log watering in one tap or backdate watering, repotting, and blooms. Each plant has a timeline for care and photos. Export the two latest photos side by side with dates. Give a plant to a friend with a gift card, code, or settings file containing only its name and soil check interval.

Try Pro for 30 days from first launch, with no subscription or automatic charge. Afterward, existing plants remain fully editable, with photos and reminders intact. Adding a fourth active plant or exporting comparison images requires a one-time purchase.

No accounts, ads, or analytics. Care entries and photos stay on your device.

name: Plant Parlour & Little Shop
description:
Welcome to your Plant Parlour! Furnish your home, collect almost 150 real plant species and open your very own little plant shop next door.

COLLECT AND CARE
From pothos to rare collector's pieces: every plant needs the right light, water and pot. Find the perfect spot, repot, treat pests, and watch your plants grow into stunning showpieces.

PROPAGATE AND BREED
Water cuttings, division, air layering, sowing: propagate your favourites like a real gardener. Cross two plants and name your very own variety. With a little luck, a variegated cutting appears.

YOUR HOME
Build rooms, a conservatory, a greenhouse, a garden and a roof terrace. Choose wallpapers, floors and more than 100 pieces of furniture. Every species in your herbarium brings more visitors for good.

YOUR LITTLE SHOP
Fill your shop window, set prices, pack online orders, run workshops and fulfil your regulars' wishes. Hire a team, outsmart the shop on the market square and get reviewed by the town paper.

SOMETHING NEW EVERY WEEK
Seasons, festivals, the weekly market, plant shows, collecting trips and auctions always give you something to do.

FAIR AND RELAXED
No timers to stress you, no sign-up, your progress stays on your phone. Ad videos only play when you want a bonus. The Gardener's Pass is not a subscription.

Playable in English and German.

name: Plein Chantier Direct
description:
Plein Chantier Direct, c'est la ligne directe entre vous et l'équipe qui s'occupe de votre site internet et de votre fiche Google.

• Des messages, comme dans une discussion

name: PlotSlate Field Geometry
description:
Check a polygon and keep its measurements together. PlotSlate Field Geometry is a manual coordinate workspace for straight-sided shapes on a flat plane.

ENTER YOUR VERTICES
Add named vertices in boundary order, edit their coordinates and move them earlier or later in the sequence. Enter coordinates with up to three decimal places. The final vertex connects back to the first automatically.

CHECK THE BOUNDARY
Inspect geometry issues before measuring. PlotSlate Field Geometry identifies repeated points, intersecting or overlapping boundaries, invalid edge contacts and zero-area shapes. A valid polygon shows its orientation, area, perimeter and individual edge lengths.

SAVE THE MEASUREMENT
Freeze a report containing the ordered vertices and calculated results. Later edits to the working plot leave the saved report unchanged. Generate CSV and PDF files, preview them, and share them through the system share sheet.

Use the optional practice rectangle to explore the workflow. About provides a library backup export and restoration of the last good local save.

Choose m, cm, ft or in as a coordinate unit label. Changing the label does not convert coordinates. PlotSlate Field Geometry works with a single simple polygon of 3 to 100 vertices. It does not use GPS, maps or elevation, and it does not model curved boundaries or holes. Results describe the coordinates you enter; this is not a certified surveying instrument.

name: Pocket Card Press
description:
Choose photos from your library and automatically arrange them in a printable PDF.

Match the paper size
A4 is 210 × 297 mm. A 4 × 6 inch photo sheet measures 101.6 × 152.4 mm; the PDF uses landscape orientation.

Pair fronts and backs
Enable double-sided printing and select Add back beside each card. The PDF alternates the front and back of sheet 1, then sheet 2, and so on. Use the same flip edge on the printer and keep blank pages. For manual duplex, print page 1, turn the sheet over the selected edge and print page 2 on that same sheet. Follow the printer’s feed markings.

Align the back
Print both pages of the test PDF on one sheet with the same paper size and flip edge at 100%. Face the back towards you and hold it up to the light. If the cross is 1 mm to the right of the front circle’s center, shift the back 1 mm left. Export another test to check. Offsets are stored on this device for each paper size and flip edge. Reset and retest when changing printers.

One purchase unlocks card and calibration PDFs. Choosing photos, arranging cards, and previewing them are always free.

name: pocket.wav
description:
pocket.wav is a studio that fits in your pocket. tap clips on a grid and they start on the bar, in key, every time. no timeline to learn first.

MAKE A BEAT IN MINUTES
- a live clip grid: tap a pad and the loop joins on the next bar
- drums, bass, keys, and a built-in synth you can shape
- everything follows your project's tempo and key
- a walkthrough builds your first beat with you

SAMPLE ANYTHING
- record from the mic or import a loop
- chop it across pads and play it like an instrument
- your sample locks to the project's tempo and key

FINISH IT
- record a jam, listen back, and save it
- a channel strip on every track: eq, compression, level
- share your jam as audio or as a video

LEARN AS YOU GO
- short lessons that teach by ear and by hand, from the first kick to a finished mix
- the first five chapters are free and end with a track you finish yourself
- streaks and weekly leagues if you want them. the grid is always one tap away

POCKET.WAV PRO
- the full sixteen-track grid
- arrange your jams into songs
- split a sample into drums and melody
- wav export and clean video export
- the upper school: mixing and sound design chapters
- unlimited hearts in lessons
- sync across your devices

name: PocketLidar
description:
PocketLidar turns the LiDAR scanner of your iPhone Pro or iPad Pro into a pocket 3D scanner.

Walk through a room and watch it appear as a colored point cloud. A live quality overlay shows exactly where you are done (green) and where a closer look is still needed (red), so you never miss a corner.

WHAT YOU GET
• Colored point clouds with millimetre-level smoothing and automatic drift correction between scan passes
• Meshes of your scan, colored from the camera
• Automatic floor plans with wall lengths and room height
• Output that is aligned for you: Z-up, walls parallel to the axes, real-world metres

EXPORT TO THE TOOLS YOU USE
• Point clouds: PLY, LAS, PCD, XYZ
• Meshes: OBJ, STL, PLY, GLB (glTF)
• Floor plans: DXF (millimetres, for CAD) and SVG
Pick as many formats as you like – they are exported together and shared via AirDrop, Files, Mail or any app.

PREVIEW BEFORE YOU EXPORT
Orbit, zoom and inspect your scan in 3D, switch between points and mesh, and check the floor plan right on your device.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking, no cloud. Everything is processed on your device and only leaves it when you share it.

Great for renovation planning, interior design, architecture, real estate, 3D printing, game and VFX assets, or simply measuring a room.

name: POISONPRICE
description:
Discover independent producers and hear their newest beats and tracks. Swipe through Drops to watch short videos, follow creators and save audio to your Poison Music library.

Explore Poison Flip to listen to producer battles and vote in open rounds. In Studio, creators can upload music, publish posts and see how listeners interact with their work.

name: Poker Dice: Score & Roll
description:
Poker dice with friends — no pen and paper needed.

• Roll virtual dice (3 rolls, hold the ones you like) or your own real dice — the scorepad does the maths.
• Pass-and-play on one phone.
• Online games: invite friends by code or link and take turns from your own phones.
• Multi-game tournaments with a shared table and results.
• Rating, statistics and achievements.

Points only: no money, no bets, no purchases and no ads. Gambling for money with the app is not allowed.

name: Poker Night Games
description:
Poker Night is a poker table in your pocket, with no ads, no accounts and no tracking. Play against 1 to 5 computer opponents on Easy, Normal or Hard. Everyone starts with 1,000 chips, and the game ends when you win them all or run out.

SIX GAMES
- Texas Hold'em (No-Limit): two private cards, five shared cards.
- Omaha (Pot-Limit): four private cards; use exactly two of them with three shared cards.
- Omaha Hi-Lo (Pot-Limit): Omaha with the pot split between the best high hand and the best low hand.
- Five-Card Draw (Fixed-Limit): replace up to three cards between betting rounds.
- Seven-Card Stud (Fixed-Limit): three cards down, four face up; best five of seven.
- Razz (Fixed-Limit): Seven-Card Stud where the lowest hand wins.
Or choose Dealer's Choice to play a different game every hand.

MADE TO BE EASY TO PICK UP
- Your current hand is always named for you: "Two Pair, Aces and Sixes", "7-5-4-3-A low".
- A bet slider with Min, Half Pot, Pot and All-in buttons.
- In Five-Card Draw, Suggest picks which cards to replace.
- How to Play explains each game, the betting and the hand rankings.
- Side pots, split pots and all-ins are handled for you, by the real rules.

PLAYS ANYWHERE
- Works fully offline.
- Your game saves automatically, so you can stop and pick up where you left off.
- No ads, no in-app purchases, no sign-up, no data collected.

Poker Night uses play chips only. There is no real-money gambling, and chips can't be bought, won as prizes or cashed out.

name: Pomoov
description:
Pomoov is a simple Pomodoro timer that shows you time instead of telling you. A colored disc fills the dial and shrinks while you work: one glance tells you how much is left.

HOW IT WORKS
• One tap starts your focus session.
• When it ends, Pomoov lets you know and offers the break.
• Four focus sessions with short breaks, and a long break at the end.
• "Today's Cycle" shows the whole cycle and where you are.

MAKE IT YOURS
• Focus sessions of 15, 25, 45 or 60 minutes.
• Set the length of the short and the long break.
• Six colors for the focus disc, six for the break disc and six cases.
• Focus and break differ by color and by text.

ALWAYS IN SIGHT
• Widgets for the Home Screen and StandBy.
• Live Activity on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island.
• Apple Watch app with complications, in sync with your iPhone.
• Also designed for iPhone Duo, closed and open.

name: Ponies Ponies
description:
Ponies Ponies is a calm little horse game about one day in the Iowa hills.

Ride your pony out of the pasture, follow the trail down to the creek, and see what the day brings. He picks up the pace by himself as you keep going, from a walk all the way to a gallop, so you can just ride.

When you want something faster, head to the horse show.

STORY
Explore the hills at your own pace. Graze, drink from the creek, whinny, and keep a journal of the day. A soft soundtrack plays while you ride.

HUNTER / JUMPER
Three courses, from a low jumper classic to a 1.50 m grand prix. Walk the course, find your line, and jump about a stride out. A rail down is four faults, and the clock is running.

BARREL RACING
Three arenas and a cloverleaf pattern. Lean into the turns, save your boost for the straights, and try not to knock a barrel.

YOUR PONY
Name him, change his build, and pick his coat and markings.

WORLD LEADERBOARD
The three best rounds on every course are shown to everyone who plays. If you make the board, you choose whether to post it.

GOOD TO KNOW
Simple thumb controls made for phones.
Plays offline. Only the leaderboard needs a connection.
No ads, no accounts, no purchases.

name: PoolMind Business
description: PoolMind Business helps pool service teams stay organised and manage daily operations in one place. Keep your team coordinated and your customers informed throughout every service. Spend less time on administration and more time caring for pools and growing your business.

name: PortickAccess
description:
PortickAccess es la app de control de acceso de Portick. Con la cámara del celular leés el QR de cada entrada y en un instante sabés si la persona puede pasar.

Pensada para la puerta
• Resultados a pantalla completa: verde pasa, ámbar hay que mirar, rojo no pasa. Se leen a un metro.
• Sonido y vibración distintos para cada resultado.
• Detecta entradas ya usadas, anuladas, sin pagar, de otro evento, de otra puerta o fuera de horario.
• Si el evento permite reingreso, quien ya entró vuelve a pasar en verde.
• ¿Alguien sin QR? Lo buscás por nombre, código o celular y registrás el ingreso a mano.

Funciona sin internet
La lista de entradas queda guardada en el celular. Si se corta la conexión, la lectora sigue decidiendo en el momento y sube los ingresos sola cuando vuelve la red. Si dos puertas leen la misma entrada, el panel lo registra.

Todo en el panel de Portick
• Cuántos entraron, por qué puerta y a qué hora, en vivo.
• Cada lectora con su nombre, su puerta y las categorías que deja pasar.
• El historial de cada escaneo.

Cómo empezar
1. En el panel de Portick, abrí tu evento y entrá a Lectoras y equipo.
2. Tocá Vincular lectora y escribí el código de 6 caracteres en la app.
3. Listo: la lectora baja la lista y ya podés escanear.

¿Querés verla antes? En la pantalla de inicio tocá "Ver una demostración" y probala con un evento de muestra.

PortickAccess es para organizadores que venden sus entradas con Portick (portick.app). No tiene publicidad.

name: PPL Track Lab
description:
Pointing is not the same as going. Explore how an aircraft heading and a moving air mass combine to produce a ground track.

A HANDS-ON GROUND-TRACK WORKSHOP
Start with crosswind, headwind or quartering-wind experiments. Change target course, aircraft heading, true airspeed and wind direction/speed independently. Predict whether the aircraft will drift left, right or stay on course. Fly a model leg at 30-times classroom speed, pause it, or advance directly to ten model minutes.

SEE THE PATH, NOT JUST A NUMBER
A north-up plot shows the target course, air and wind vectors, and the moving ground trace. Read ground track, groundspeed, along-course distance and signed lateral displacement. Reveal the correction lesson, apply its constant-wind model heading, then run another leg to investigate the difference. The lesson also explains when the settings cannot hold the target course with forward progress.

BUILD YOUR OWN FLIGHT NOTEBOOK
Save up to 30 debriefs on your device, including model inputs, elapsed duration, drift prediction and your own observations. Overlay a saved trace in pink, reload its setup and vary one input at a time. Compare equal durations and target courses for a controlled experiment. No account, GPS, current weather feed or developer-server upload is needed.

RETAINED GROUND-SCHOOL TOOLS
The runway Wind Lab still resolves wind into headwind/tailwind and crosswind components. The 300-question private-pilot study bank, explanations, topic filters, bookmarks, missed-question review and simulated exams remain available. Study records and recent exam results are stored locally. The readiness figure is an internal study-progress measure, not a flight-proficiency assessment or a passing guarantee.

FREE WITH OPTIONAL AD REMOVAL
All training tools and study content remain free with advertisements. The existing optional one-time Remove Ads purchase removes advertising only; no subscription. Open Ad-free & restore in Track Lab, or the bottom ad-options toolbar, to purchase or restore with the same Apple Account. Apple displays the applicable local price.

CLASSROOM ONLY
This is an independent study aid, not an FAA product, official question bank, flight planner or navigation instrument. The flat-plane model assumes constant wind and one shared north reference. It does not evaluate gusts, aircraft limits, terrain, runway conditions or current weather. Use approved aircraft documentation, current FAA publications and qualified instruction for actual flight and certification preparation.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Präzisionswerk
seller_name: Hayen Holding und Invest GmbH & Co. KG
description:
Click values for long distances – calculated transparently.

Präzisionswerk is the app for long-range target shooting. At its heart is a ballistic calculator that works out the elevation and windage clicks for your scope and shows you exactly how they were derived.

BALLISTIC CALCULATOR
• Elevation and windage clicks in MRAD or MOA, matched to your turret
• Spin drift (Litz) with gyroscopic stability (Sg) from bullet length and twist rate
• Coriolis effect from latitude and shot direction
• Wind by speed and direction, crosswind from the angle to the line of fire
• G1 and G7 drag models, optionally with velocity-banded BCs
• Muzzle velocity table by temperature, uphill/downhill correction
• Hold point in the reticle: shows where to hold instead of dialling
• Ballistic details: every calculation step from time of flight and drop to the lateral offset

EQUIPMENT AND LOADS
• Equipment profiles with calibre, barrel, twist, sight height and zero
• Common riflescopes from a list: turret unit and click value are filled in
• Handloads and factory ammunition with a bullet library

WEATHER IN THE CALCULATOR
• Weather for your approximate location, updated every 10 minutes
• For members: use weather readings shared by club members at the same range

RANGES FROM 300 M
• Map of ranges in Germany and Europe with distances and lanes

EVENTS AND KNOWLEDGE
• Calendar with training sessions, competitions and guest dates
• Knowledge section on equipment, travel and disciplines, also available offline

PRO (IN-APP PURCHASE)
• 10 profiles each for equipment and loads
• Digital DOPE book with training days and the clicks you actually used
• Scans of your paper DOPE book (AI reading, extra scan packs available)
• Sync across all your devices
Pro is available as a monthly or yearly subscription or as a one-time lifetime purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Manage or cancel subscriptions in Settings under your name → Subscriptions. On a new device, choose "Restore purchases".

FOR CLUB MEMBERS
Members of Präzisionswerk e.V. get all Pro features with their membership, plus shooting log, QR check-in, firearm needs application, qualifications and club news.

IMPORTANT
All click values are calculated from your inputs. Always verify them at the range with your own shots. Range rules and the instructions of the range officer apply.

name: Print Farm

• Summary tiles for printing, idle, attention and offline printers

JOBS
• Customer and house orders by status: Printing, Queued, Paused, Quoted, Complete
• Item counts, assigned printers, customer details and job photos
• Mark items done and add photos from the camera or photo library

FILAMENT
• In-use rolls grouped by brand and color, with search and material filters
• Scan spool barcodes and QR codes to look up, start or finish a roll

ALERTS
• Paused, error, offline and low-stock alerts, grouped by day

name: PropAnalytix Basket
description:
PropAnalytix Basket es la app de análisis de props de jugadores de baloncesto. Props, % de acierto, enfrentamientos y cuotas en un solo sitio, sin hojas de cálculo ni mil pestañas abiertas.

- Mercados: los que están en racha, las defensas más flojas y los que más suben de minutos

- Avisos de bajas: te avisamos cuando una baja mueve la línea de un compañero
- Defensa contra posición, nota del enfrentamiento de A+ a F y proyecciones
- Cuotas comparadas y movimiento de líneas
- Favoritos: guarda tus props y sigue cómo se mueven

name: ProPlay – Play Supercharged

ProPlay supercharges the way you play on your PlayStation 5.

Your game stays on the TV. ProPlay connects your iPhone or iPad to your console over your home Wi-Fi and turns it into a control center for your controller.

GYRO AIM
Aim by moving your controller. Smooth, precise and adjustable, with separate horizontal and vertical sensitivity.

ONE-TAP CHEATS
Many games have built-in cheat codes that take a long button sequence. Tap a card and ProPlay enters the whole sequence for you. New games are added over time.

MAP YOUR CONTROLLER
Swap any button on your controller, your way.

SIMPLE AND PRIVATE
No ads, no tracking. Your sign-in and settings stay on your device.

One subscription works on every iPhone and iPad signed in to the same Apple account.

name: PSH HUB
description: PSH HUB은 월간 지출을 명확하게 관리하고자 하는 분들을 위해 설계되었습니다. 먼저 월간 총예산을 설정한 다음, 각 항목별로 예산을 배분합니다. 아직 배분되지 않은 금액은 '미배분' 항목으로 남게 됩니다. 지출을 기록할 때는 카테고리를 선택하기만 하면 되며, 금액을 입력하는 즉시 남은 예산이 실시간으로 표시됩니다. 여러 건의 지출을 연속으로 기록할 경우, 이전에 선택했던 날짜와 계좌 정보가 그대로 유지됩니다. 특정 항목의 예산을 초과하게 되면 '미배분' 항목에서 예산을 추가하거나, 다른 항목에서 예산을 옮겨올 수 있으며, 혹은 초과된 지출 내역을 그대로 기록해 둘 수도 있습니다. 이 앱은 수입, 지출, 계좌 간 이체를 기록하며, 거래 내역이 수정될 때마다 잔액이 자동으로 업데이트됩니다. 월말에는 초기 예산, 예산 조정 내역, 실제 지출액, 그리고 남은 잔액을 검토할 수 있습니다. 내장된 차트를 통해 지출 패턴을 분석하여 다음 달 예산을 계획할 수 있으며, 영수증이나 증빙 서류가 포함된 종합 월간 보고서를 내보낼 수도 있습니다.

name: Pufli: Cozy Virtual Pet
description:
Pufli is a small, calm virtual pet that lives on your iPhone — in the app, on your Home Screen and on your Lock Screen.

Pick an egg and tap it until it hatches. Then it is yours to look after: feed it, bathe it, play with it, tidy up after it and tuck it in at night. Your pet keeps living while the app is closed, so drop by when you have a minute.

WHO WILL IT GROW INTO
Your pet grows for months: a baby becomes a kid in two days, a teen in a week, a grown-up in three weeks and a wise one in two months. How it looks as a grown-up depends on how well you cared for it. Every week of its life is a birthday with a gift.

NO GUILT

ALWAYS WITH YOU
