• Super food with effects: a fizzy drink that keeps your pet full of energy for hours, a candy that keeps it happy.
• A shop with food, outfits and rooms, all for coins you earn by playing. Coins are never sold for money.

FREE AND PLUS
Caring for your pet is free forever: one pet, its whole life, the widget, the game, outfits and rooms for coins.
Pufli Plus adds more: three more species (fox, frog, axolotl), up to three pets at once, the Pairs game, special outfits and rooms, and a double daily gift. Pay monthly, yearly or once, forever. Whatever you got with Plus stays yours even if the subscription ends.

Privacy policy: https://vladislava9009.github.io/pufli-legal/privacy.html

name: Pulse - Workout Interval Timer
description: Pulse is the interval timer that talks to you. Pick AMRAP, FOR TIME, EMOM, Tabata or build your own MIX of blocks, add your exercises, and Pulse announces each move, counts you down and signals rest, in your language. Voice or classic HIIT beeps. Lock-screen timer and Dynamic Island. Works completely offline, no account.

name: PurrLight: Selfie Ring Light
description:
Turn your screen into a soft light for selfies and video. Choose from 12 lighting presets or set your own color, brightness and warmth. In the selfie camera, fine-tune smoothing and filter intensity separately. Capture photos, videos and Live Photos on supported iPhones.

Use the screen light for free without an app account. A one-time purchase unlocks the selfie camera, including photos, video and beauty effects. If you previously bought ad removal, your purchase already unlocks the selfie camera. To restore it, use the same store account on the same platform and select Restore purchases in Settings.

name: QRTrove
description:
QRTrove is an on-device vision workspace — not just a QR scanner. A built-in YOLOv8n model runs locally via CoreML and Vision to detect objects live through your camera, draw boxes with confidence scores, and place 3D labels in an AR scene by raycast. Completely offline. No account, no upload.

LIVE VISION
• On-device object detection with live boxes and confidence scores
• AR raycast labels anchored in 3D space
• On-device OCR for Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese and English (manual start)
• Recognize product links from major shopping sites — results stay on device

CODES, YOUR WAY
• Create 9 code types: text, link, contact, social profile, phone, WiFi, email, SMS, location
• 9 social networks: Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Snapchat, WhatsApp, YouTube, Telegram, X, LinkedIn
• Custom colors per code
• Scan codes and barcodes from camera or album; batch-scan multiple codes in one session

LOCAL VAULT
• Save codes with notes, favorites and scan counts; edit anytime
• Export QR images to Photos or contacts to your address book
• Review recent scan history

PRIVACY BY DESIGN
• No account, no login, no cloud, no network requests
• No ads, no analytics, no tracking
• Camera, photo library and contacts are used only for the features above

QRTrove is not a store and sells nothing. Shopping or social links open in Safari and are governed by their own terms. Data stays on your device — no upload, no sync.

Contact us at 19151010382@163.com

Website: https://qrtrove.pages.dev/
Privacy Policy: https://qrtrove.pages.dev/privacy/
Terms of Service: https://qrtrove.pages.dev/termsOfService.html

name: Quick Audio Trim: Cut & Clip
description:
Import an audio file, record something new, or extract sound from a video. Use the waveform to keep just the part you need.

• Trim one second from each end and export in two taps.
• Drag the selection handles, zoom in, enter exact times, and preview before exporting.
• Save and share single M4A clips for free, with no limit. Your originals remain intact.
• Resume recent drafts and find earlier exports. Share a waveform card or send a selection code to someone with the same original file.

Pro adds 16-bit PCM WAV export, manual splitting, and batch export. Try Pro for 30 days from the first launch of the paid edition, then purchase it once. No subscription or automatic charges. Existing drafts and exports, editing, and single M4A exports stay available.

Files are processed on your device. No account, ads, or analytics.

name: Raccord: le labo des artistes
description:
Raccord, c'est le labo du rappeur et du beatmaker. Tes sons, tes projets et tes crédits au même endroit, de la maquette à la sortie.

TES SONS
• Range tous tes sons : maquettes, prods, versions mixées, en MP3, WAV, AIFF, FLAC, M4A.
• Un son reçu sur WhatsApp, dans Fichiers ou par AirDrop ? Partager → Raccord : il arrive direct dans ta bibliothèque.
• Écoute-les en boucle, même écran verrouillé, avec les commandes sur l'écran de verrouillage.
• Playlists, titres likés, pochettes.

TES PROJETS
• Album, EP ou single : range tes sons dedans, pose une date de sortie.
• Raccord te dit la prochaine étape de chaque projet, jusqu'à la sortie.

TES CRÉDITS
• Qui a fait la prod, le texte, la voix, le mix : note les crédits et les parts de chaque son.
• Tes feats valident leur part depuis leur compte. Une part qui change repasse en validation.
• Une notification te prévient quand on te crédite.

TES RACCORDS
• Les artistes avec qui tu bosses : cherche-les, envoie une demande de raccord.
• Ton profil d'artiste avec tes projets et tes sorties, partagé en un lien ou un QR code.

En sécurité
• Tes sons sont privés tant que tu ne les partages pas.
• Tu peux signaler et bloquer un compte à tout moment.
• Pas de publicité, pas de revente de données.

Raccord est gratuit. Une question ? contact@nbasuite.si

name: Raidwing
description:
The Iron Tide has taken the skies. Pick a fighter and fly from island waters to Marshal Vorn’s fortress in a five-stage arcade shoot ’em up. Your wingmates stay on the radio as enemy formations close in.

Fly the Falcon for a balanced Vulcan loadout, thread a laser through a formation with the fast Lancer, or take the shielded Bulwark into heavy fire. Hold to shoot and charge your special, lift to unleash it, and time a roll to slip through a tight gap.

• Fly over islands, desert, ice and volcanic terrain on the way to the Iron Fortress. Each stage ends with a boss.
• Switch between overhead, chase and cockpit views. Turn to landscape for a side-on run.
• Chain hits, collect medals and replay unlocked stages to improve your rank.
• Steer and shoot with one finger. Keyboard and compatible controllers offer additional ways to fly.

The full single-player campaign is included with one purchase. Play offline with no ads or in-app purchases. Progress and settings stay on your device.

name: Rain Out: Weather Day Log
description:
Rained out again? Prove it.

Every lost day on a job is money and schedule. When the time-extension request or delay claim comes due, you need the record: which days it rained, how much, where it was measured, and what your crew did. Rain Out builds that record for you, every day, for every job, without a spreadsheet.

Add the job, set your contract's rain rule, and Rain Out fills in the weather from the nearest airport weather station back to your start date. Real measured rainfall, cited to the station, ready to hand to the owner, the GC, or the inspector.

BUILT FOR THE FIELD
Made for general contractors, site work and dirt crews, civil surveyors, concrete and paving contractors, utility and pipeline crews, landscapers, roofers, and project managers who carry weather days in their contract.

USE IT FOR
- Time-extension requests and weather-delay claims
- Change orders and schedule updates
- Billing and pay applications
- Daily reports and crew planning
- Settling "was it really too wet to work?" with numbers

RAIN DAYS, FLAGGED AUTOMATICALLY
- Set your contract's threshold (for example 0.50 inch or more) and Rain Out flags every day that meets it
- Flags the next work day as a possible wet-out so you can confirm or reject it
- Rainfall, high and low temperature, and peak wind gust for every day
- Log crew status (worked, partial, rained out) and notes on any day
- Morning rain chance from the National Weather Service

YOUR SCHEDULE, YOUR RULES
- Pick each job's work days: Monday to Friday, seven days, or any mix
- Off days stay in the log but never count, and wet-out moves to the next scheduled work day
- Each job follows its own local time zone

FIND ANY SITE FAST
- Add a job by address, drop a pin, or draw the site boundary on a street or satellite map
- Rain Out picks the nearest station that reports rainfall and tells you how far away it is

ORGANIZE EVERY JOB
- Group jobs into project lists by city, region, or customer, and switch lists from the top menu
- See counted weather days and monthly rainfall at a glance
- Compare each month with NOAA's 1991-2020 normals to show when it was wetter than normal

EXPORTS YOU CAN HAND OFF
- Export to CSV, Excel, or PDF and share by Mail, Files, or AirDrop
- Every row lists the station and the data source
- Missing data is marked as missing and never estimated

PRIVATE AND OFFLINE
- No account, no ads, no tracking
- Jobs are stored on your iPhone, with an automatic backup file in the Files app
- Works offline with your saved data
- Notification when a new rain day is flagged

Coverage: all 50 U.S. states and Washington, DC, using about 1,000 airport weather stations (ASOS) that report rainfall.

PLANS (OPTIONAL SUBSCRIPTIONS)
- Free: 1 job and 1 project list with every feature above, including CSV, Excel, and PDF exports for each job
- Personal: up to 15 jobs, unlimited project lists, and whole-list exports. $5.99/month or $49.99/year in the U.S.
- Unlimited: no job limit, plus everything in Personal. $15.00/month or $150.00/year in the U.S.
- Prices in other countries may vary. If a subscription ends, nothing is deleted or locked. Your jobs stay viewable, editable, and exportable
- Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. A subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel any time in Settings > your name > Subscriptions.
- Terms of Use (Apple standard EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
- Privacy Policy: https://ddlawler-theonly.github.io/rain-delay-tracker/privacy.html

Weather data: Iowa Environmental Mesonet ASOS daily summaries (may differ slightly from the official NWS Climatological Report), National Weather Service forecasts, NOAA NCEI normals. Maps © OpenStreetMap contributors; imagery: USGS The National Map.

name: RainRoute - Mini Water Garden
description:
RainRoute is a miniature garden puzzle about sending rain where it is needed.
Raise or lower soil tiles to carve downhill paths through your garden.
Watch drops split at forks, fill empty basins, and bring daisies, irises, and ferns into bloom.
Solve eight rain challenges with limited water and earn stars by keeping earthwork low.
Choose your own planting, rain inlet, and drop budget in Water Garden.
Save, edit, duplicate, and revisit your own layouts in My Gardens.
Review blooms and water use in Garden Journal, with your progress stored on the device.

name: Raja Pairs:Relax
description:
Raja Pairs supports landscape play on iPhone Duo. You turn over a seven of diamonds. You saw its twin a few turns ago. Was it in the corner or one card to the left? Every card you turn over tells you something you can use on your next move.

Each turn, flip two cards. Match both rank and suit and the pair stays face up. If the cards differ, they turn back over. The round ends when you find every pair.

Start with six pairs on Easy, step up to eight on Classic, or take on all twelve on Royal. Each round gives you three peeks. A peek briefly reveals every unmatched card, so you can check that corner before you commit. There’s no countdown, and you can hide the timer if you’d like to focus on the cards.

After a round, see your moves, time and match accuracy. Your personal best goes to the round with the fewest moves, with time breaking a tie. Each difficulty keeps separate records for rounds played with and without peeks. Open Game history to revisit your last 20 completed rounds.

Play offline in landscape, without an account, ads or in-app purchases. Your settings and game records stay on your device. Choose English or read Hindi in Latin or Devanagari script. Raja Pairs is intended for players aged 18 and over.

name: Rapetón Approved
description:
Descubre música urbana independiente y conecta con la gente que la está creando. Rapetón Approved reúne música, conversación y noticias de la industria.

Explora La Cosecha por país y etapa. Escucha Approved Radio, descubre la selección editorial Cosecha Fresca y guarda tus canciones en playlists.

Entra al Foro para hablar de música o buscar colaboradores. Si eres artista, usa Sembrar para enviar una canción o un álbum y compartir tu perfil.

Lee noticias sobre la industria y descubre entrevistas y episodios de Generación R en RPTN TV.

name: RAW camera – black & white
description:
RAW camera is a manual camera for black-and-white photography. It shows you the black-and-white photo right in the viewfinder – built from real film, filter and paper data – and keeps every frame as a colour DNG too.

CONTROLS LIKE A CAMERA
• P · S · I · M mode dial: program, shutter priority, ISO priority (the iPhone’s aperture is fixed) and manual
• Shutter speed, ISO, exposure compensation and focus on encoders that click in third stops
• Tap to focus, double-tap to spot-meter and see the zone (0–X), hold to lock the exposure
• A + O − LED meter and a dot-matrix readout in the viewfinder
• Camera Control on iPhones that have it: EV, zoom in mm, mode, shutter, ISO, focus or recipe
• Release with the volume buttons, the Action button or AirPods
• Custom modes C1–C3 store your whole setup

A DARKROOM IN THE VIEWFINDER
• 33 recipes in three banks: films, darkroom processes (fine print, split grade, push, lith, platinum…) and toners (selenium, gold, sepia, Van Dyke, salt print, cyanotype, collodion)
• Built from published emulsion data: spectral response, characteristic curve and RMS granularity; no film brand names
• Grain at the physical scale of film – the same at 12 MP, 48 MP and in the viewfinder
• Colour filters for the lens: yellow, orange, red, green, blue – swap them while you shoot
• Your own recipes with an editor and a live preview

LENSES, FRAME LINES AND FORMATS
• 13 · 24 · 28 · 35 · 48 · 120 mm depending on your iPhone; 28 and 35 mm are crops of the main camera, and the DNG keeps the whole sensor
• Smooth zoom by pinching or with Camera Control
• Bright frame lines from 28 to 135 mm, like a rangefinder
• 4:3, 3:2, 16:9, 1:1, 5:4 and 6×7 formats and a 65:24 panorama, with rise and fall
• Shift: the accelerometer straightens converging verticals live in the viewfinder, like a shift lens

DRIVE
• Burst at up to 3 (CL) or 8 (CH) frames per second for as long as you hold the shutter
• Half frame: vertical frames joined into diptychs, just as they lie on the film
• 2 and 10 s self-timer, 3- and 5-frame bracketing, intervalometer
• A 1–36 frame counter; rewind and load a new roll

EVERY FRAME, TWICE
• A developed black-and-white photo as HEIF, 10-bit HEIF, JPEG or 16-bit TIFF – untoned recipes even as true single-channel grey files
• A colour DNG (Bayer RAW or ProRAW) with the recipe for Adobe Lightroom and Camera Raw: it opens in black and white, and one click takes you back to colour. The sensor data stay untouched.
• Import Lightroom presets (.xmp, .lrtemplate, DNG, .zip) and export any recipe as a preset
• Saves to Photos (the DNG attached as the photo’s RAW) and to a folder in the Files app; author, copyright and optional location in the metadata

No accounts, no ads, no tracking. Everything is processed on your iPhone.

Requires iOS 26. Manual exposure shoots 12 MP Bayer RAW; 48 MP ProRAW is available in P on iPhones that support it.

name: Ready Set Serve: Dinner Timer
description:
13:55 — Knead the strudel dough.
15:05 — Strudel into the oven.
15:55 — Duck in at 170°.
18:00 — Potatoes on to boil.
18:45 — Carve.
19:00 — Everyone sits down, and every dish is hot.

That's a big dinner when someone else does the timing. Ready Set Serve is that someone.

Tell it what you're cooking and break each dish into its real steps: what needs the oven and at what heat, what needs a burner, what needs your hands, and what simply rests, chills or steeps on its own. Tell it what your kitchen has — ovens, racks, burners, and how many pairs of hands. Then choose the moment you want to sit down.

It works backwards from that moment and writes out your whole afternoon: when each dish starts, what cooks side by side, and where two dishes want the same thing at the same time. A duck at 170° and a strudel at 190° can't share one oven, so the strudel bakes first and waits for you on the rack. You're told exactly that, in plain words, together with what would change it: another rack, a second oven, a helper at the counter.

Guests running late? Drag the tablecloth at the bottom of the plan and every time slides along with dinner.

When it's time to cook, it leads. One big card shows your next move — press and hold to start it, no fiddly buttons with floury fingers. Running timers count down below, the next moves wait in line, and a reminder taps you on the shoulder before each one, even with the phone in your pocket. Fall behind and it says so, then moves dinner back in a single tap.

Every dinner you cook stays in your log: how close you came to the time you promised, which steps slipped, and which dish tends to hold everyone up. Next year, you'll know to start the dumplings ten minutes earlier.

For Christmas Eve, Easter lunch, a birthday for twelve, or the first time the whole family comes to yours — whenever the roast, the sides and the dessert need to land on the table together instead of one after another.

Ready. Set. Serve.

name: REAL HOUSE
description:
REAL HOUSE는 음악을 "듣는" 게 아니라 "몸으로 체험하는" 음악 플레이 게임이에요.
3D로 만든 페스티벌과 클럽을 걸어 다니다 마음에 드는 무대 앞에 서면, 그 무대의 음악이 들려오고 내 캐릭터가 함께 춤춰요.

■ 음악을 따라 걷는 플레이
• 무대마다 다른 장르: 테크노, 하우스, 딥테크노, 디스코, 앰비언트…
• 가까이 갈수록 소리가 커지고, 무대를 옮기면 음악이 자연스럽게 바뀌어요
• 실시간 DJ 편성표로 지금 방송 중인 세트를 찾아 바로 이동해요

■ 폰을 흔들어 춤추기
• 박자에 맞춰 폰을 흔들면 캐릭터가 춤추고, 손에 진동으로 비트가 전해져요
• 박자가 정확할수록 "두-둥" 더블 진동과 함께 코인을 더 받아요
• 춤춘 만큼 걸음 수가 쌓이고, 100걸음마다 축하 이펙트가 터져요

■ 세 곳의 음악 여행지
• 사막점: 캠핑카를 타고 아트카 사이를 달려 사막 한가운데 무대로
• 이태원점: 골목골목 이어지는 클럽, 지하로 내려가는 테크노 클럽
• 동물원점: 숲속 스테이지와 한옥 무대

■ 나만의 스타일, 함께하는 무대
• 스타일룸에서 옷과 액세서리를 골라 나만의 룩을 만들어요
• 막춤 룰렛과 10가지가 넘는 춤 동작
• 로그인하면 친구를 맺고 같은 무대에서 함께 춤추고 채팅해요

무음 모드에서도 음악이 나오고, 화면을 잠가도 음악이 이어져요. 이어폰을 끼고 플레이하면 더 생생해요.

name: REDStage Piano
description:
REDStage turns your iPhone or iPad into a professional stage piano: a sampled grand piano, a tonewheel organ, an analog and FM synth and a sampler that opens your own sound libraries. Layer them, split them across the keyboard and take them on stage.

FOUR ENGINES, ONE INSTRUMENT
- Piano: a multi-sampled grand with a lid you can open, half-open or close, string resonance, damper noise on release, continuous half-pedal, sostenuto, soft pedal and touch calibration.
- Organ: nine drawbars, percussion, key click, overdrive and a rotary speaker with slow and fast speeds. Or play any sampled organ from your library.
- Synth: analog and FM modes with 15 ready-made sounds, plus two sampled layers from 242 General MIDI sounds to blend strings or choir over your piano.
- Sample: play any instrument you imported, with its own volume, tuning, dynamics and place on the keyboard.
Each engine has its own level, octave, pitch-bend range, key zone and MIDI channel.

BUILT FOR LIVE
- 10 instant setups at the top of every screen: tap to call, hold to save and rename.
- No-cut switching: held notes, reverb and delay tails finish with the old sound while new notes use the new one.
- Setlist with notes on screen, Program Change, MIDI out per sound and incoming MIDI clock.
- Panic button and stage lock.

INFINITE PAD
Pick the key of the song and a worship pad holds forever under every chord: root, fifth and octave, or the open add9 voicing. It fades in and out on its own timer and keeps playing when you change setups.

YOUR SOUND LIBRARY
Import a folder, a ZIP or single files: SFZ, SF2/SF3, DecentSampler, WAV, AIFF, FLAC, OGG and MP3. Velocity layers, crossfades, loops and envelopes come in whole. Loose samples are mapped by their names.

MIDI AND CONTROL
- USB MIDI keyboards connect by themselves, no driver needed.
- Bluetooth MIDI keyboards connect once and reconnect automatically.
- Resizable multi-touch on-screen keyboard with an 88-key map.
- Mixer with MIDI learn that remembers CC and channel, so keyboard zones never collide.

UNDER THE HOOD
A real-time audio engine written in C, up to 256 voices, an effects chain with compressor, reverb, delay and room EQ, live recording to WAV, and it keeps playing with the screen locked. Available in English, Portuguese and Spanish.

SOUND DESIGNER: AI ASSISTANT
Ask for a sound in writing and the sound designer sets up the instrument for you: sounds, layers, effects, pad, programs and setups. It can also compose and play a piece with expression. Each request uses 1 credit; every install gets 10 free credits to try it.

PRIVACY
No account and no ads. Your setups and imported sounds stay on your device, and the instrument works offline. The sound designer needs internet: your request goes through our server to the AI provider. The app counts anonymous usage statistics, which you can turn off in MIDI & SETTINGS.

INCLUDED SOUNDS
Salamander Grand Piano V3 by Alexander Holm (CC-BY 3.0), electric pianos by Greg Sullivan (CC-BY 3.0), VSCO-2 Community Edition strings (CC0) and GeneralUser GS by S. Christian Collins.

AI CREDITS (IN-APP PURCHASE)
- AI monthly plan: 600 credits per month, $3.99 per month, auto-renewable subscription.
- One-time packs: 300 credits $2.99; 1,000 credits $7.99; 3,000 credits $19.99.
Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically for the same period and price unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in iPhone Settings, under Subscriptions. Plan credits are valid for the month and do not roll over; one-time packs never expire. Prices may vary by region.

Privacy Policy: https://redstagepiano.com/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://redstagepiano.com/terms/
EULA (License Agreement): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Reflections by Jainam Sheth
description:
Explore the world through Jainam Sheth’s lens. Reflections brings a personal photography collection together with the places, details, and stories behind each image.

Spin an interactive globe to explore photographs by city, or browse the gallery and find your way through curated collections and trips. Dive into a photograph to see its camera settings and other details, then save it to Photos for use as a wallpaper or share it with a friend.

Look beyond individual frames with photography insights: explore the cameras, lenses, settings, colors, subjects, and places that shape the collection. The yearly view brings the journey together, showing how the work has changed over time.

name: Refract Duo: Mirror Puzzle
description:
Tap a mirror and it turns. Two beams of light enter from the edge and bounce through a 4×4 grid of mirrors. Your job: send beam A to target A and beam B to target B — both at once.

HOW IT PLAYS
• Tap a mirror to switch it between / and \
• Dim mirrors are fixed, so you have to work around them
• Beam B is dashed, so color is never the only cue
• No timer, no lives. Reset whenever you like

SOLO OR TOGETHER
• Solo: take your time and track your move count
• Together: pass one phone back and forth, each player turns one mirror, and you guide both beams home as a team

CONTENT
• 365 puzzles, generated by algorithm and each one checked to be solvable and distinct
• The first 20 puzzles are free, and so is the daily puzzle (the same one worldwide, changing at 00:00 UTC)
• Refract Duo Plus, a one-time purchase, opens the other 345 puzzles and two color themes. No subscription
• Restore Purchases is supported
• Share a result card when you solve a puzzle

DESIGNED FOR EVERYONE
• Plays offline, no account, no ads
• VoiceOver support: every mirror announces its row, column and direction
• No personal data is collected; progress stays on your device

Purchasing and restoring require a connection to the App Store.

name: RegexDesk: Pattern Workbench
description:
Test regular expressions on local text, inspect matches and capture groups, preview replacements, browse examples, and save reusable patterns. Patterns use the system ICU syntax; no code is executed.

• Test a supported ICU expression on text stored on your device.
• Inspect match text, UTF-16 ranges and capture groups.
• Preview replacement templates without changing the source sample.
• Try explained examples and save named patterns with a case option.
• Edit or delete saved patterns; copy a selected match or result.

This app supports a restricted syntax subset: literals, character classes, anchors, alternation, capture groups, and at most one repeated simple atom (*, + or ?). Repeated groups, multiple quantifiers, braces, lookarounds, backreferences and inline options are rejected. Limits: 256 UTF-16 units per pattern, 2,000 per sample, and 200 shown matches.

No sign-in, advertising or tracking SDK is included. Copying and sharing happen when you choose them.

name: Rei do Pitaco: Soundboard
description:
Gør dine arrangementer mere levende med en lydpult, der er klar til brug med det samme. Vælg blandt færdige pultopsætninger, eller byg din egen med indbyggede og importerede lyde. Start, stop og styr lyde med ét tryk, uden internet og uden besvær.

Klar til events fra første åbning, så du hurtigt kan afspille de rette lyde til quiz, fest, præsentation, sport og meget mere.

Hovedfunktioner
- Færdige, redigerbare pultopsætninger - kom hurtigt i gang og gem din egen kopi
- Egen lydsamling - tilføj indbyggede og importerede lydfiler til enhver pult
- Hurtig afspilning - store knapper, tydelig status og stop med et tryk
- Klip og tilpas lyd - beskær start og slut, juster lydstyrke og vælg gentagelse
- Fleksibel organisering - skift navn, ikon, farve og rækkefølge på knapperne
- Offline brug - alt fungerer lokalt på enheden uden internet
- Separate lydroller - brug signaler og baggrundslyd uafhængigt af hinanden
- Kontrol på tværs af pulter - samme lyd kan bruges flere steder med egne indstillinger

Perfekt til
- Quiz og konkurrencer, hvor hurtige lydsignaler gør oplevelsen bedre
- Fester, ceremonier og præsentationer, hvor stemning og timing er vigtig
- Sport, træning og scenebrug, hvor lyde skal kunne startes øjeblikkeligt
- Undervisning, børneaktiviteter og kreative events med mange gentagne cues

Hvorfor vælge os
Rei do Pitaco: Soundboard er bygget til at være brugbar med det samme, men stadig fleksibel nok til avanceret styring. Du får 10 tema-pulter, en indbygget lydbibliotek med kategorier, import af egne lydfiler, automatisk lokal lagring og en klar struktur, der gør det let at finde den rigtige lyd hurtigt. Når du ændrer en kopi, påvirker du ikke originalskabelonen, så du altid kan vende tilbage til udgangspunktet.

Lydene er organiseret med søgning, forhåndslytning og tydelige knapper, så du kan arbejde hurtigt under et event. Appen er skabt til enkel betjening, stærk kontrol og en ren, moderne oplevelse i mørkt design med klare grønne markeringer.

Kom i gang nu og byg din egen lydpult til dit næste event.

name: Release Forms Companion
description:
Release Forms Companion is the on-set app for Boncom production coordinators.

When a performer arrives without having signed their release, the coordinator hands over the iPhone or iPad. The performer reads the image release in English, Spanish or French, fills in their details, signs with a finger or Apple Pencil, and has the required photo taken. The app files the signed PDF on the device and, once a coordinator is signed in, syncs it to the company's release console.

• See who has and has not signed, by project and shoot day
• Hand the device to a performer and take it back with a staff PIN
• Works without a signal; releases sync when the connection returns
• Signed releases can't be edited; corrections are recorded as a void plus a new signature

For use by Boncom staff. Sign-in uses the company's Microsoft account.

name: Relladay
description:
Relladay is completely free, with no account or subscription. Your iPhone turns audio from Apple Watch into searchable text right on the phone. Your recordings and transcripts stay on your devices.

Tap once on Apple Watch and you can record for hours. From the book a friend mentions over lunch to the plans you make on the walk home, your watch keeps recording as the conversation moves on. Open that day on your iPhone to hear it again.

Find the words you remember
Was it the east gate or the west one? Search for “gate” in your saved recordings to find the conversation. Read the transcript or play back the original audio to hear exactly what your friend said. You can edit the text if a name came through wrong.

Pick up where you left off
On a compatible iPhone, turn recordings into short summaries and daily highlights. Ask a question about your recordings, check the quoted words, and choose which next steps to keep as to-dos.

Keep the moments that matter
Favorite a recording to protect its remaining audio and transcript from automatic cleanup. Choose separate retention periods for the rest of your audio and text. Away from your phone? Your watch can hold recordings for transfer when the two devices reconnect.

Recording requires Apple Watch and a paired iPhone. You can stop recording on your watch at any time. Recording time depends on battery life, available storage, and system interruptions. Transcription depends on the speech resources and languages available on your iPhone. Summaries, highlights, and Q&A use Apple Intelligence on iOS 26 or later. Availability depends on your iPhone, language, and region.

name: Remodel Material Calculator
description:
Enter the length, width and package specs to see how many whole boxes, sheets or cans to buy.

• Flooring and panels: enter the effective coverage per box or sheet and adjust waste for the job. Panels are estimated by area, not by a cut layout.
• Paint: enter the label coverage rate, can volume and number of coats. This estimates one wall without subtracting doors or windows.
• Convert between metric and imperial lengths, including tape-measure fractions such as 12′ 7 1/2″, and check rectangular area.
• View saved estimates, share a card, or send a code that opens a read-only copy on another device.

Calculations and records stay on your device. No account, ads or analytics. Always verify package specs before buying.

Conversions, import and existing records are free. New material estimates are available for 30 days from first opening the paid edition; a one-time purchase unlocks new estimates after that. No subscription or automatic charge.

name: Renaissance Labs
description:
Discover the teams publishing AI models, code, and datasets, and learn how their work is done. Renaissance Labs is a free educational companion for students, educators, developers, and curious readers.

EXPLORE THE OPEN LABS ATLAS
Browse 227 research labs, companies, and community projects across 54 countries. Pan and zoom the map, tap a lab’s logo to open its profile, or use the list to search by name, place, or topic. Profiles explain what each team works on and link to selected papers, code, releases, and licence information.

LEARN AT YOUR OWN PACE
Read short lessons on language models, from tokens and transformers to training and evaluation. Check the original sources and mark lessons complete to keep track of your progress. Watch films about machine learning, AI safety, and how minds work in the app’s video player.

KEEP A READING LIST
Bookmark labs, lessons, and films in Saved. Your bookmarks and lesson progress stay on your device. The lab directory and lesson text are available offline. Map imagery, catalog refresh, and film streaming require an internet connection.

Renaissance Labs is free and requires no account.

name: Restwillow
seller_name: Qian Gu Internet Technology (Shanghai) Co., Ltd.
description:
Let the day settle with rain on the roof, waves on the shore, or a campfire after dark. Restwillow is a quiet companion for bedtime, with nature sounds, guided breathing, and short, text-led meditation practices.

Find a sound for the moment
• Explore rain, ocean, forest, and campfire scenes, or listen to wind, streams, and singing bowls.
• Choose one track or play a whole scene in the order you set.

Make it yours
• Save the sounds you love to My Library and build playlists for different parts of your day.
• Set a sleep timer to stop playback automatically, and keep listening while your screen is locked.

Take a few slow breaths
• Follow a gentle on-screen breathing rhythm.
• Try Seven Days of Mindfulness, a series of short, text-led practices.

No account is required. Online scenes need an internet connection. Built-in sounds in Settings are available offline.

Open Restwillow, pick a sound, and take a moment for yourself.

name: Retestbook
description:
Retestbook helps certified backflow testers fill official test report forms on an iPhone, even without a signal.

Pick the state and the city or utility you file with, walk through a guided test, and get the official PDF filled in and ready to print, sign by hand, and send. After the PDF is made, Email report opens your Mail app with the file attached. The To field is filled in only when the official form lists an address. You review the message and press Send.

The app works offline. Tests, licenses, gauge details, and reports stay on your iPhone. When a gauge accuracy test or a license has expired, or will expire within 30 days, Retestbook shows a warning. Warnings never stop you from testing.

Retestbook fills 80 official test report forms used in 37 US states. That includes statewide forms such as TCEQ Form 20700 in Texas, and official utility or city forms where we have the published PDF. It does not yet include every utility in those states. If a form you need is missing, you can request it from the app.

Getting started is free for 14 days, with no card required. The trial starts after you finish setup. After the trial, Retestbook Pro Monthly is $14.99 a month, billed as an auto-renewing subscription through your Apple ID. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews each month unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel the subscription in Settings, Apple ID, Subscriptions. If the trial ends without a subscription, the app locks on the next open. Your data stays on the iPhone and is waiting when you subscribe.

The 14-day trial is provided by the app and is not an App Store introductory offer.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://retestbook-site.retestbook.workers.dev/privacy

Questions and support: william@retestbook.com

name: RetroMMA: 8-Bit
description:
RetroMMA is a pocket-sized cage fight in chunky 8-bit played with one thumb. Tap out the jab, the cross and the power hook in rhythm. Watch him wind up, swipe to slip under it, and fire back before he recovers. Land the big one and his head snaps back in a spray of pixels. Land enough and the ref waves it off.

Win and you climb. Start as an unranked nobody in the Garage Fight League, take its belt, get the call from the UFD, and work your way from the empty prelims to the main event. The rest of the division doesn’t wait around, every card they fight each other, trade places in the rankings, and make their own case for a title shot.

This game contains no grappling! That's because the year is 1989 and wrestling hasn't been invented by hippies yet.

name: Return Window: Receipt & Date
description:
Keep track of what you need to return and when.

Take a photo of a paper receipt, choose an image from Photos, or share a screenshot to Return Window. The app reads the receipt on your iPhone and fills in the details it recognizes. Check the retailer and return date, then set a reminder.

Open a saved return to see the receipt again. Add the deadline to Calendar, look up nearby stores in Apple Maps, or get directions to the receipt address. If a retailer or carrier provides a Wallet pass for a mail return, import it from Files and add it to Apple Wallet.

Track up to three active returns free. A one-time Pro purchase unlocks unlimited active returns.

name: Reverse Challenge: Say It Back
description:
Record a line, hear it backwards, copy the weird sound, then flip it back — does it sound like the original?

HOW TO PLAY
1. Record a sentence, or sing a line of a song everyone knows
2. The app plays it backwards — total gibberish
3. Listen a few times, then record your best copy of that gibberish
4. The app flips your copy back. Does it sound like the original? Get ready to laugh

SOLO OR WITH FRIENDS
• Play on your own and see how close you can get
• With friends: one records, another copies — who does it best?

SHARE IT AS A SHORT VIDEO
• One tap makes a portrait video: original → backwards → my copy → flipped back
• Every part has a caption, so anyone can follow along
• Send it to chats or post it to short-video apps — your call

PLAY WITH PEACE OF MIND
• Completely free, no ads, no limits
• Works offline, no sign-up
• Recordings stay on your phone, are deleted each round, and are never uploaded

name: Ribby: Frog Jump Puzzle
description:
Ribby is a small, very serious frog with one job: reach the big juicy bug at the end of every level.

HOLD to charge. RELEASE to leap. That's the whole control scheme — and there's a lot to discover in it.

• 48 HANDCRAFTED LEVELS IN 6 WORLDS
Dawn Pond, Backyard Garden, Bamboo Creek, Midnight Kitchen, Frozen Lake and Rainy Swamp. Every world brings something new: swaying flower pots, flowers that open and close, sinking leaves, drifting rafts, bouncy jelly, slippery plates, thin ice, icy wind, and fireflies that light up the dark.

• EASY TO PICK UP, SATISFYING TO MASTER
A dotted arc shows where you'll land while you charge. Fall in the water and you pop right back onto your last pad. No lives, no energy, no pressure.

• THREE STARS PER LEVEL
Finish the level, catch every gold bug, and never fall in. Come back any time for a perfect run.

• FAIR AND CLEAN
Play the first two worlds for free. One purchase unlocks everything, including every future world. No ads. No subscriptions. No data collected.

• PLAYFUL SOUNDS, GENTLE HAPTICS
Ribbits, splashes and happy gulps, a little tune when you clear a level, and soft taps you can feel.

New worlds arrive as free updates. Ribbit!

name: Riffora: Slow Down & Loop
description:
A little closer, every loop.

Riffora gives your ears time to catch every note. Bring your own audio or a video with sound, slow down the hard part, and practice it until it feels natural.

FREE PRACTICE TOOLS
• Import from Files or open a file in Riffora from another app.
• Explore a zoomable waveform, seek by dragging, and skip back or forward 5 seconds.
• Change speed from 50% to 150% in 5-point steps while keeping the pitch.
• Set an A–B loop, with an optional 1- or 2-beat count-in.
• Add bookmarks and jump back to important moments.
• Keep listening in the background with Lock Screen and Control Center controls.
• Start with an original, synthesized demo track.

RIFFORA PRO — ONE-TIME PURCHASE
• Transpose by ±12 semitones and fine-tune by ±50 cents.
• Reduce or focus centered vocals in stereo audio.
• Build speed automatically: choose a start, a 1–10-point increase per pass, and a target. Keep looping at the target.
• Save multiple named loops with their practice settings.
• Choose Original, Bass focus, Vocal mids, or Low cut EQ.
• Export one pass of the selected loop or the whole track as M4A with the current speed, pitch, vocal and EQ settings, then share it.
The local price is shown before purchase. No subscription. Restore purchases in Settings.

MADE FOR FOCUSED PRACTICE
Native iPhone and iPad layouts, light and dark appearances, Dynamic Type and VoiceOver. Your library stays on this device. No account, ads, tracking or analytics. No commercial music catalog is included. Files up to one hour are supported; protected files cannot be imported. Vocal processing uses the stereo center channel, so results depend on the mix and are not isolated stems.

Support: zz@hfyy.org

name: Rito: Tattoo Artists in Porto
description:
Find your next tattoo in Porto and book it with the right artist, without endless back-and-forth messages.

Rito brings independent tattoo artists together in one place. See each artist's work, the flash they have available with prices, and their available days, then book or request a quote from your phone.

DISCOVER
• Work and flash in one feed, filtered by style, placement, size and price
• "This week": guest spots and flash days in the next 14 days
• Save what you like on this phone, no account needed

MEET THE ARTIST
• Work, flash, available days, where they work and what to know before you book
• A map of studios and artists near you

BOOK A FLASH
• Pick the design, the day and the time
• Pay the deposit now and the rest on the day of your session

REQUEST A QUOTE
• Describe your idea and add up to 5 reference photos
• Choose the placement, the size and up to 3 days that suit you
• The artist replies with a proposal: price, date and deposit
• Accept it and pay the deposit in the app

YOUR REQUESTS IN ONE PLACE
• Requests and bookings sorted for you: what needs you, what is in progress and what is done
• Sign in with Apple or with your email; requests you made on the website show up here right away

You don't need an account to look around. We only ask you to sign in when you send a request or book.

In Portuguese, English, and Ukrainian.

name: Road Atlas
description:
Record your drives and see which roads you actually covered. Road Atlas keeps GPS trip history on your iPhone and shows your total distance, unique roads, and most-traveled streets for any period you choose.

• Review a day’s route and compare it with another day.
• See the road segments you covered and how often you drove them. Repeated passes count once toward unique distance.
• Start and stop recording from a Home Screen widget and see today’s mileage at a glance.
• Use Shortcuts to start recording when CarPlay connects and stop when it disconnects. The in-app guide walks through both automations.
• Export routes as GPX, statistics as CSV, or a backup of your GPS history as JSON.

GPS recording works offline. Road matching uses road data downloaded for the areas you travel through. Choose miles or kilometers.

name: Roll & Fit: Dice Block Puzzle
description:
Roll the dice. Turn the blocks. Fill every gap. Join Kkomi, a raccoon dog carpenter, to repair the forest paths.

Roll 7 dice to determine 7 rock spaces on a 6×6 forest board. Fill the remaining 29 spaces with 9 blocks, each covering 1 to 4 spaces. Rotate and flip the blocks to fit them all in. Every board is verified to be solvable.

Three ways to play
• Forest Journey: Repair paths with Kkomi through 6 regions and 120 levels. Rescue a forest friend at the end of each region.
• Dice Adventure: Each roll creates a new board for endless puzzles.
• Daily Board: Everyone gets the same board each day.

Think, place and try again
• Earn up to 3 stars: complete the board, finish without hints, and finish within the target time.
• Spend acorns on a hint to reveal where one block belongs.
• Check in each day to collect acorns.
• Undo as often as you like and try another arrangement.

The first 3 levels teach you to drag, rotate and flip blocks, one step at a time. Play in 10 languages with no account required. Gameplay works offline; ads and purchases require an internet connection.

In-app purchases
• 300 Acorns
• 1,000 Acorns
• First Purchase Pack: 1,000 acorns, available once
• Remove Ads: removes banner and interstitial ads, gives 300 acorns right away and 15 acorns each day
Rewarded ads are optional.

Privacy Policy: https://rollfit.vnamu.com/privacy
Support: help@vnamu.com

name: Room to Breathe: Chore Planner
description:
A cleaner home. A little more room to breathe.

Keeping up with your home can feel like another full-time job. Room to Breathe helps you break cleaning into smaller steps that fit the time you actually have.

Whether you have 15 minutes on a busy Monday or more time later in the week, create a routine that makes space for your life.

YOUR DAY, A LITTLE LIGHTER
See today’s chores in one simple list, with estimated minutes and progress as you check things off.

SET A PACE THAT FITS
Choose your available days, set daily limits for chores and minutes, and keep days off for yourself.

MAKE YOUR ROUTINE YOUR OWN
Add your own chores and choose how often they repeat—every few days, weeks, or months.

MAKE ROOM WHEN PLANS CHANGE
Move a chore to another day when you need more time. See when your list needs an adjustment to fit your availability.

A GENTLE NUDGE
Turn on reminders to help you keep up with your routine.

SEE HOW FAR YOU’VE COME
Explore this month and last month in History. Tap a day to see what you completed.

A little at a time can add up to a home that feels more manageable.

MEMBERSHIP
Choose a monthly or annual subscription. Eligible new subscribers can start with a 7-day free trial. After the trial, your subscription automatically renews at the selected price unless canceled. Manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple Account settings.

Questions or feedback?
roomtobreath@yahoo.com

Privacy Policy:
https://room-to-breathe-privacy.buddingnewt4.chatgpt.site

Terms of Use:
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: RosterSwaps: Crew Trip Swaps
description:
RosterSwaps finds trips you can actually swap.

Sync your roster from WebCIS in one tap. RosterSwaps reads your trips and shows colleagues' trips that fit your roster: same base, nearby dates, and inside your duty and rest limits. Every trip comes with a verdict, so you know a swap is clean before you ask.

HOW IT WORKS
• Sync your roster: sign in to WebCIS inside the app and send your roster across. Your password goes to your airline's sign-in page, never to RosterSwaps.
• Find a swap: see trips that work with your roster, best fit first, with what you gain and what you give up.
• Pick up open time: trips other crew want to drop, matched to your free days.
• Stay in the loop: you're notified the moment a colleague accepts, declines, withdraws or confirms.

BUILT FOR AIRLINE CREW
For pilots and cabin crew, short haul and long haul.

name: Rotalune: Shift Calendar
description:
Know when you work and when you’re off. Set up your first schedule on iPhone or iPad. Rotalune Pro is required for further edits and sharing. You can still view the schedule you’ve entered.

Build a repeating rotation with day shifts, nights, and days off. See what’s coming up at a glance. When plans change, edit just that date and keep the rest of the rotation in place. With Pro, share your schedule for a period you choose or send the rotation pattern itself.

Your schedule stays on your device. Use Rotalune offline, without an account. Pro is available as an annual subscription with no trial or a one-time purchase for lifetime access.

Terms of Use (EULA)
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Rotativo BR
seller_name: iTransit Tecnologia e Mobilidade Urbana Ltda
description:
Aplicativo para consulta de saldo, liberação de veículo e recuperação de créditos do Rotativo BR.
Sistema Digital com informações em tempo real possibilitando ao usuário várias maneiras de utilização, visando oferecer praticidade, agilidade e rapidez na utilização. Gerando conforto e o mínimo de esforço para o usuário.
O Sistema Rotativo BR tem como objetivo democratizar o espaço público, gerindo de forma inteligente as vagas para estacionamento veicular, oferecendo vagas para todos.

name: RunnerOutpost
description:
Most running groups live in a chat. The run you posted on Monday is buried by Wednesday, and nobody knows who is coming.

RunnerOutpost gives the group one place to look. Start a group, share one invite link and everyone sees the group's runs on a map. Everyone signs in with an email link, with no password. A member then joins with just a first name. Anyone can post a run (meeting point, time, pace, effort, an optional route), say "I'm coming". Times are shown in each member's own time zone.

A group of up to 10 members is free. Coaches, clubs and run shops can go Pro for bigger groups, unlimited runs and weekly repeats, drawing or uploading routes, bulk import from a pasted schedule or a file, an RSVP history file and a logo on the invite page. Calendar files and a group export are always free.

Groups are private by default: only people with the invite link see them, members see first names only, and meeting points are rounded to about 25 m. There are no ad trackers. The group owner can close the link, remove a run or a member, and delete the account and everything in it. Built on open map data (OpenStreetMap, OpenFreeMap), with servers in the EU.

The free tools are open source (MIT) and also work as an npm package and a browser extension.

Privacy: no ad trackers and no tracking across apps. Members are identified by a first name only.

name: Rupert - The Librarian
description:
Rupert is the librarian for your scanned documents. It works with the folders you already have in iCloud Drive, OneDrive or on your iPhone, so there's nothing to import and nothing to lock in.

FIND ANYTHING
• Search titles, tags, notes and the text of your documents.
• Filter by tags, and keep favorite documents and folders one tap away.
• Open any document to read, share or print it.

SCAN STRAIGHT INTO YOUR INBOX
• Rupert's own camera scanner finds the page's edges, straightens it and saves a sharp PDF.
• Choose color, grayscale or black & white, and the resolution.
• Several pages become one PDF, saved to your inbox folder in iCloud Drive or OneDrive.

WORKS WITH RUPERT ON YOUR COMPUTER
Rupert for Mac, Windows and Linux (free) recognizes the text in new scans, suggests a title, date, tags and folder, and files them when you agree. Titles, tags and dates are stored inside the PDFs, so they appear on your iPhone too.

YOUR DOCUMENTS STAY YOURS
• No account with us, no tracking, no ads. Rupert collects nothing.
• Your files stay in your own storage; Rupert reads them where they are.
• Online-only files aren't downloaded until you open one.
• OneDrive: sign in with your Microsoft account; Rupert only reads your folders and adds new scans to your inbox.

Rupert is free and open source.

name: Sadece İyilik
description:
Sadece İyilik Derneği’nin resmî mobil uygulaması. Bağışınızı birkaç dokunuşla yapın, yerine ulaştığını takip edin; namaz vakitleri, kıble ve Kur’an-ı Kerim de aynı uygulamada.

BAĞIŞ
• Su kuyusu, kurban, yemek ikramı, eğitim ve diğer bağış kalemleri
• Arama ve kategorilerle aradığınız bağışı hemen bulun
• Birden fazla bağışı sepete ekleyip tek ödemede tamamlayın
• Ödeme, derneğin 3D güvenli ödeme sayfasında yapılır; kart bilginiz uygulamaya girilmez
• Üyelik zorunlu değildir; misafir olarak da bağış yapabilirsiniz

BAĞIŞ TAKİBİ
• Bağış geçmişiniz ve bağış sertifikalarınız
• Bağışınız yerine ulaştığında bildirim, tarih ve sahadan fotoğraf
• Kampanya duyuruları ve Cuma hatırlatması (hangi bildirimleri alacağınızı siz seçersiniz)

İBADET ARAÇLARI
• Namaz vakitleri: bulunduğunuz şehrin vakitleri ve sıradaki vakte kalan süre
• Kıble pusulası
• Namaz takibi: beş vakit çizelgesi (kayıtlar yalnızca telefonunuzda tutulur)
• Kur’an-ı Kerim: Arapça metin ve Türkçe meal
• Zekât hesaplama

AYRICA
• Haberler ve faaliyetler, banka hesapları, sık sorulan sorular, iletişim

Namaz vakitleri ve Kur’an-ı Kerim verileri namaz.info’dan alınır. Kur’an metni: Tanzil (tanzil.net); meal: Elmalılı Hamdi Yazır.

name: Safe Diary – Private Journal
description:
Safe Diary is the private journal for everything you want to remember – and keep to yourself. Write a page a day, add photos, a mood and the place you were, and keep it all behind your PIN or Face ID. Your diary stays on your device unless you decide to back it up to your own cloud.

A SHELF OF BEAUTIFUL DIARIES
• Keep as many diaries as you like: one for this year, one for your travels, one just for gratitude
• Give each one a theme – flowers, cats, mountains, a lake, a starry night…
• Make a diary private so it only shows once you've unlocked
• Folders, archive and bin keep the shelf tidy

WRITE YOUR DAY, YOUR WAY
• One page per day, dated – write about today or any day in the past
• Rich text: bold, italic, underline, lists, fonts and sizes
• Photos from your camera or library, right inside the page
• Voice memos, and dictation when you'd rather talk than type
• A mood for every page, and the place you were
• Tags to find every page about family, travel, work…
• Page history: go back to what you wrote before

LOOK BACK
• A calendar coloured by your moods
• "On this day": what you wrote a year ago today
• Statistics: streaks, words written, the day you write most and how your moods change over time
• Search every page of every diary from one box
• Badges for keeping at it
• A daily reminder to write, at the time you choose

LOCKED, THE WAY YOU WANT
• App lock with PIN, Face ID or Touch ID
• Locks again as soon as you leave the app
• A decoy PIN that opens a separate, harmless shelf instead of your real diaries
• See who tried to get in: intruder attempts with a photo
• Keep the app out of screenshots
• Forgot your PIN? Recover it with a secret word or your recovery email

BACKED UP – TO YOUR OWN CLOUD
• Password-protected backups with your pages, photos, voice memos and tags
• Keep them on your iPhone or iPad, or upload to Google Drive, Microsoft OneDrive or Dropbox
• Restore in a couple of taps, with smart conflict handling if a page changed on both sides
• Automatic backups and sync between your devices (PRO)

EXPORT AND SHARE
• Turn a whole diary into a PDF or a Word document
• Import pages from a Word file
• Share single pages as a password-protected file that only Safe Diary can open

MAKE IT YOURS
• Light and dark mode
• Choose your font and text size
• Available in English, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Japanese, Hindi and Ukrainian

SAFE DIARY PRO
The free version has everything you need to write and protect your diary. PRO removes ads and adds automatic backups, sync between your devices, your own imported fonts, photos in PDF and Word exports and the Starry Night theme. Buy it once and keep it forever, or choose the yearly subscription – your call.

The yearly subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase, and the renewal is charged within the 24 hours before the period ends. You can manage or cancel the subscription in your Apple Account settings.

YOUR DATA, YOUR RULES
Your diary is stored in an encrypted database on your device. There is no account to create, and we never see what you write. Cloud backups go straight to your own Google Drive, OneDrive or Dropbox, protected with the password you choose.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://hightouchinnovation.com/safediary-privacy

Questions or ideas? Open the menu → Contact support, or write to hightouchinnovation@gmail.com. We read everything.

name: Sandbits: Sand Block Puzzle
description:
Falling blocks crumble into sand: every block that lands breaks into grains that trickle, slide and pile up into dunes – and as soon as one color reaches from the left wall to the right wall, the whole band bursts.

Sandbits is a retro pixel sand block puzzle with real sand physics: tens of thousands of grains flow in real time, and no two rounds look alike.

HOW TO PLAY
• Drag to move the block, tap to turn it, swipe down to drop it.
• Connect one color from wall to wall – the band bursts and scores.
• Several bands in quick succession build a chain with a bonus.

FOUR MODES
• Classic – faster and more colorful.
• Daily – a fresh round every day; keep your streak.
• Blitz – two minutes, full speed.
• Expert – five colors for experts.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• 60 goals and nine ranks, from Grain to Sand legend
• Five sand color worlds, four of them to unlock
• Haptics you can feel and sandy sound effects
• Your round is saved automatically – continue any time
• One-thumb controls, plays offline without internet
• No ads, no purchases, no sign-up, no data collection

name: Santa Workshop: Christmas Game
description:
Run Santa's magical toy factory! Build a cozy Christmas workshop, make toys with your elves and make children's wishes come true.

Santa Workshop is a cozy Christmas game where you run Santa's toy factory at the North Pole. Build machines, make teddy bears, trains and robots, hire cute elves, answer children's letters to Santa and load Santa's sleigh before Christmas Eve. It mixes a relaxing toy factory tycoon with fun match 3 puzzles and merge games – a festive holiday game for the whole family.

WHAT YOU DO IN SANTA WORKSHOP
• Build Santa's toy factory: place toy machines in your Christmas workshop and watch the toys come to life.
• Answer letters to Santa: every child asks for a gift – make the toy, send the letter and earn coins and stars.
• Play match 3 in the Enchanted Tree: swap Christmas ornaments, bells, gifts and Santa pieces in hundreds of festive match 3 levels with boosters, stripes, bombs and magic stars.
• Merge toys at Santa's Workbench: drag two of the same, merge them into something better and fill the elves' orders.
• Hire elves: each elf has a specialty and makes your toy machines faster.
• Load Santa's sleigh: fill big gift crates and send the sleigh flying across the sky.
• Care for Santa's reindeer: feed Dasher, Dancer, Prancer, Vixen, Comet, Cupid, Donner and Blitzen in the reindeer stable.
• Hunt for gifts in the snowy forest and meet the forest friends.
• Decorate your Christmas village: festive floors, walls, lights, trees and decorations.
• Open the Advent calendar every day, spin the Lucky Wheel and collect stickers in your Christmas album.
• Your workshop keeps working while you are away – come back to a surprise of new toys.

WHY PLAYERS LOVE THIS CHRISTMAS GAME
• A cozy, cheerful Christmas world with Holly the elf as your friendly guide.
• Short, relaxing sessions – perfect for winter evenings and the holiday season.
• Three games in one: toy factory tycoon, match 3 puzzle and merge game.
• New things to unlock as you level up: machines, elves, reindeer and village buildings.
• Daily gifts, events and the Golden Sleigh Pass with seasonal rewards.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
What kind of game is Santa Workshop?
A Christmas simulation and puzzle game: a toy factory tycoon at the North Pole with match 3 levels and a merge board.

Is Santa Workshop free?
Yes. The game is free to download and play. Optional in-app purchases include crystals, bundles, the Golden Sleigh Pass and "No Ads".

Does it have ads?
Optional reward videos and occasional ads between games. One "No Ads" purchase removes the ad breaks forever; reward videos stay optional.

Is it good for kids and families?
Yes, it is a gentle Christmas game for all ages, with no chat and no violence. Children under 13 see only child-friendly, non-personalised ads, and purchases need the approval of the account holder.

Can I play offline?
Yes, you can play without internet; ads and purchases need a connection.

Do I need an account?
No. There is no sign-up and no login. Your progress is saved on your device.

Is there a match 3 game in it?
Yes – the Enchanted Tree has hundreds of Christmas match 3 levels with ice blocks, frost and special combos.

Get ready for Christmas! Download Santa Workshop and help Santa, the elves and the reindeer make this the most magical holiday ever.

Privacy Policy: https://recentfollow.app/santa-village/privacy.html
Terms of Use: https://recentfollow.app/santa-village/terms.html
Support: hello@recentfollow.app

name: SantaGiftCatch
description:
Questo è un gioco casual a tema natalizio, giocabile con un solo dito, in cui devi catturare i regali. Trascina Babbo Natale a sinistra o a destra per afferrare i doni che cadono dal cielo, evitando i pezzi di carbone. Il gioco include 8 livelli, una modalità infinita, renne e slitte nascoste, un sistema di moltiplicatori combo, un guardaroba per il personaggio, statistiche e trofei.

Aiuta Babbo Natale a salvare il Natale! Fai scorrere il dito per muovere Babbo Natale nella notte innevata e afferrare i regali che cadono dal cielo, ma fai attenzione ai pezzi di carbone!

8 livelli festivi: dal Polo Nord alla Montagna del Grinch, ognuno con il suo scenario e la sua sfida. Guadagna fino a tre stelle per livello. Renne e slitta: le renne lasciano cadere una scia di regali e toccando la slitta volante di Babbo Natale riceverai una pioggia di doni.
Combo e potenziamenti: effettua catture a catena per moltiplicare il punteggio, raccogli i biscotti per vite extra e fai tintinnare i campanelli per rallentare il tempo.
Modalità infinita: scopri per quanto tempo riesci a far arrivare i regali mentre il gioco diventa più veloce. Guardaroba: sblocca la signora Claus, un elfo e un pupazzo di neve con le stelle che raccogli.

Statistiche e trofei: tieni traccia dei tuoi progressi e sblocca 11 trofei.

Allegri effetti sonori di campanellini, feedback aptico e una colonna sonora di "Jingle Bells". Facile da imparare, difficile da smettere di giocare.

name: sbcgenie
description:
SBC Genie 是面向 EA SPORTS FC Ultimate Team 的移动端 SBC 助手。它把 SBC 求解器装进手机，帮你在俱乐部库存和转会市场之间找到成本更低的解决方案，少花金币，少走弯路。

 一键求解 SBC
打开任意 SBC 挑战，点击「生成方案」，SBC Genie 会结合你的球员库存、俱乐部物品与转会市场行情，自动计算并生成满足全部挑战限制的阵容，同时给出预计花费。

免责声明
SBC Genie 是独立的第三方工具，与 Electronic Arts 没有任何关联，也未获得 EA 的授权或认可。EA SPORTS FC、Ultimate Team、FUT 等名称与商标归其各自所有者所有。使用本应用即表示你同意遵守 EA 的用户协议与相关服务条款。

多方案对比
一次生成多套可行方案，按花费和评级对比，直接挑最划算的一套，不必反复手动试错。

 灵活调整，贴合你的习惯
· 锁定球员：指定必须保留的球员，方案会围绕他们构建
· 排除项：按联赛、俱乐部、国家排除不想要的球员
· 单卡替换：对某个位置不满意，点「换一个球员」即可替换
· 排除现役阵容：避免拆掉你正在使用的主力阵容

一键应用
确认方案后可一键应用到游戏中；缺少的球员支持直接前往转会市场购买，省去逐个搜索的麻烦。

 画廊与图鉴进度
查看套组进度、评级与代币情况，找出更划算的买卡方案，规划你的收藏路线。

每日快速完成
把常用的 SBC 加入每日快速完成，日常任务一次处理完。

name: ScaleFolio
description: ScaleFolio is a proportional batch notebook for craft and studio work. Create formulas with named components, positive parts and a shared unit. Enter a target amount to calculate each component, choose the displayed precision, and save a dated snapshot. Changing a formula keeps previous batch amounts intact. Search formulas and share the calculated amounts when needed. This is a proportional calculation tool, not a safety or chemical compatibility guide.\n\nCore features work offline. Free, with no account, ads or in-app purchases. Choose from eight languages and System, Light or Dark appearance. Records stay in this app’s local storage. Optional example content is fictional.

name: Screen Mirroring: Mirrilo
description:
Screen Mirroring: Mirrilo – Cast to TV Made Easy!

Turn your TV into a bigger screen with Mirrilo! Easily mirror your iPhone screen, cast your favorite photos and videos, and enjoy content on the big screen — all with just a few taps.
Whether you're sharing memories with family, watching videos, browsing the web, playing games, or giving presentations, Mirrilo makes screen mirroring simple, fast, and convenient.

No complicated setup. No extra cables. Just connect your iPhone and TV to the same Wi-Fi network and start casting!

KEY FEATURES

SCREEN MIRRORING – YOUR PHONE ON THE BIG SCREEN
Mirror your entire iPhone screen directly to your TV. Enjoy your favorite apps, games, presentations, and more on a larger display. Choose your preferred streaming quality for the best viewing experience.

CAST PHOTOS TO TV
Bring your favorite memories to life! Easily display photos from your iPhone gallery on your TV. Perfect for sharing vacation pictures, family moments, and special memories with friends and loved ones.

STREAM VIDEOS WITH SOUND
Watch videos from your iPhone gallery on the big screen. Cast your personal videos with audio and enjoy a more immersive viewing experience.

LIVE CAMERA MIRRORING
Turn your TV into a live camera display! Stream your iPhone camera feed directly to your television and see everything on a bigger screen.

CAST WEB & SOCIAL CONTENT
Enjoy more of your favorite online content on TV. Mirrilo makes it easy to cast content from YouTube, TikTok, and the browser for a more comfortable viewing experience.

FAST & EASY WI-FI CONNECTION
Forget about complicated settings and messy cables. Mirrilo helps you quickly discover and connect to your TV over Wi-Fi, so you can start sharing your screen in seconds.

SUPPORTED TVs
Mirrilo supports a wide range of popular Smart TVs, including:

• Samsung Smart TVs
• LG Smart TVs
• Roku TVs
• Android TVs

Connect your iPhone to a compatible TV over Wi-Fi and enjoy wireless screen mirroring and casting.

WHY CHOOSE MIRRILO?

• Simple and intuitive interface
• Fast wireless TV connection
• High-quality screen mirroring
• Adjustable streaming quality
• Photo and video casting with sound
• Live camera streaming
• YouTube, TikTok, and web content casting
• Support for popular Smart TV platforms
• Great for entertainment, gaming, and presentations

HOW TO GET STARTED
1. Connect your iPhone and TV to the same Wi-Fi network.
2. Open Mirrilo and find your TV.
3. Select your TV and establish a connection.
4. Choose what you want to mirror or cast.
5. Enjoy your content on the big screen!

A BIGGER SCREEN. MORE POSSIBILITIES.

From watching your favorite videos to sharing photos, browsing websites, and presenting ideas, Mirrilo brings your iPhone content to your TV with ease.
Make every moment bigger, brighter, and more enjoyable.

Download Mirrilo today and discover an easier way to mirror your screen and cast content to your TV!

PREMIUM SUBSCRIPTION
- You can subscribe to get unlimited access to certain app features.
- Subscriptions are billed automatically at the rate depending on the selected subscription plan.

By using the app, you are agreeing to our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use:
https://madeapps.tilda.ws/screen_mirroring_privacy_policy
https://madeapps.tilda.ws/screen_mirroring_terms_of_use

name: Scripta
description:
Scripta une tus apuntes a mano con el audio de la clase. Escribes con el Apple Pencil, Scripta graba, y cada trazo queda unido al instante en que lo escribiste.

ESCRIBE Y GRABA
• Pluma estilográfica, bolígrafo, lápiz, marcador y el resto de tintas del iPad, con presión.
• Papel liso, rayado, cuadrícula, puntos o Cornell. Zoom, deshacer y páginas nuevas.
• Marca un momento con un toque para encontrarlo después en la línea del audio.
• Sigue grabando con la pantalla bloqueada.

TOCA LO QUE ESCRIBISTE
• Al reproducir, tus apuntes se vuelven a escribir al ritmo del audio.
• Toca cualquier trazo y el audio salta a ese momento.
• Velocidad de 0,75× a 2× y saltos de 10 segundos.

TRANSCRIPCIÓN
• En el propio iPad y sin conexión, con el modelo de voz de Apple.
• O en la nube con el servicio que tú elijas (xAI Grok en directo, ElevenLabs o compatibles con OpenAI) y tu propia clave: quién habla y el tiempo de cada palabra.
• Once idiomas de clase o detección automática.

PARA ESTUDIAR
• Resumen, esquema, fichas y test a partir de la clase y de tu letra, con el modelo de IA que elijas.
• Las horas del resumen son enlaces: tócalas y el audio salta ahí.

PDF Y COPIAS
• Importa las diapositivas en PDF, anótalas y expórtalas.
• Copia de seguridad en una carpeta de Archivos (iCloud Drive, Google Drive…) en formatos abiertos: PDF, Markdown y M4A.

PRIVACIDAD
Sin cuentas, sin servidor propio y sin analítica. Tus notas viven en tu iPad. Las claves de API se guardan en el llavero y solo viajan al proveedor que elijas, que te cobra directamente. Sin ninguna clave puedes escribir, grabar, transcribir en el iPad y volver a oír cada trazo.

Grabar a otras personas requiere su permiso. Comprueba las normas de tu centro antes de grabar una clase.

name: Scroll Stoics
description:
The wisdom of Marcus Aurelius, Epictetus, Seneca, Cicero & more — in the one feed that's good for you.

Scroll Stoics turns the greatest works of Stoic philosophy into a calm, distraction-free scroll. Read a passage, sit with it, swipe on. If you can scroll, you can be a Stoic.

THE COMPLETE STOIC LIBRARY

5,400+ passages across sixteen complete works — Meditations, the Discourses, the Enchiridion, Letters from a Stoic, On the Shortness of Life, and eleven more, from Cicero's On Duties to Plutarch's Cato the Younger. Classic public-domain translations, curated passage by passage.

• Read the whole library in one calm feed — no noise, no algorithms, just the passages, beautifully set
• Home-screen widgets: stoic lessons, always in view
• Deep Study on any passage: the history, the meaning, and what to do about it today
• Greek & Latin: the original words behind the translation, explained
• The Morning Mirror: a short daily devotional — a passage, one thing to apply, guided readings.
• Reading plans that finish: Meditations in 15 Days, Letters in 30, or build your own — a few passages a day, with streaks that keep you motivated
• Search every word of every work — grief, anger, ambition, there's a passage for that
• Save passages, write your own notes, and share them as elegant cards

GO DEEPER WITH PREMIUM

Your first studies are free — see what you're getting before you pay a cent. Premium unlocks every study tool: Deep Study, Greek & Latin, In Plain Words, and Related Passages, plus full studies in Discover and advanced search.

Choose a monthly or yearly plan — the year starts with a 14-day free trial — or unlock everything forever with a one-time Lifetime purchase.

• Payment charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase
• Subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
• Manage or cancel anytime in Settings, or in your App Store account settings

Terms (Apple Standard EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Privacy policy: https://www.poketdev.com/scroll/privacy.html

name: scubamatics: Dive Log
description:
scubamatics is your digital dive log. Log every dive in seconds and keep track of everything you have seen under water – no account, no cloud.

LOG YOUR DIVES
• Depth, dive time, average depth, water temperature and visibility
• Dive site and region – with the spot on the map
• Tank: start and end pressure, size, air or nitrox
• Weight, suit, shore or boat entry
• Buddy, dive center, rating and notes
• Photos for every dive
Buddy, gear and gas are taken over from your last dive – perfect for a dive trip.

STATISTICS
Number of dives, total bottom time, deepest, longest, coldest and warmest dive, dive sites and your air consumption (SAC) per dive.

CERTIFICATIONS
Keep your certifications from PADI, SSI, CMAS, NAUI and other agencies. The digital overview does not replace your official certification card – always take the original with you when diving.

YOUR DATA IS YOURS
scubamatics stores everything only on your device. Important: if you delete the app, your dives are gone. That is why you can save a free backup file at any time – to Files, iCloud Drive or by message – and restore it later.

scubamatics PRO
Free: up to 25 dives with one photo each, statistics and backup. Pro unlocks unlimited dives, up to 10 photos per dive, the map of all dive sites, charts and CSV export for Excel and Numbers – as a yearly subscription (7 days free) or once for life.

Note: scubamatics is a logbook, not a dive computer. It does not plan dives or calculate decompression. scubamatics is an independent app and is not affiliated with PADI, SSI, CMAS, NAUI or any other diving organisation.

No account, no ads, no tracking.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://maxmatics.de/scubamatics/privacy.html

name: Século Indic.
description:
O Século Indicadores permite que gestores e usuários autorizados de escolas, instituições de ensino técnico e faculdades acompanhem os indicadores do sistema Século III pelo celular.

O aplicativo apresenta informações em quadros e gráficos, incluindo alunos ativos, matrículas por período, curso e unidade, movimentações acadêmicas, desistências, contas a receber, contas a pagar, títulos vencidos e saldo projetado.

Os dados são consultados no banco da instituição. Para utilizar o aplicativo, é necessário informar o código da escola e possuir credenciais de acesso fornecidas pelo administrador responsável.

O acesso depende de conexão com a internet e da disponibilidade do servidor da instituição.

name: Security Camera Planner: CCTV
description:
Plan security camera coverage in 3D, on site, in minutes.

Scan a room, shop or warehouse with your iPhone's LiDAR scanner, put each camera where it hangs or where it will, and see exactly what it covers. Walls, shelves and pillars block the view just as they do in real life, so the blind spots you see are the real ones.

SCAN
- Capture a room in 3D with Apple RoomPlan
- Walls, doors, windows and furniture detected automatically
- No LiDAR? Draw a site by hand or explore the built-in sample store

PLACE
- Set mounting height, tilt, lens and field of view for each camera
- View cones in 3D and on the floor plan
- Test the network speed where a wireless camera will hang

CHECK
- Coverage graded Detect, Observe, Recognize and Identify, in pixels per foot (or px/m)
- A blind-spot map across the whole site
- Audit cameras that are already up: tap one to see exactly what it sees
- Night coverage with infrared range (Pro)
- Suggested positions to close the gaps (Pro)

REPORT
- A client-ready PDF with the plan, the camera list and the coverage of each area
- Share the site file with your team (Pro)

MADE FOR IPHONE DUO
Open it and a site spreads across both pages: the room on one side, everything to check and fix on the other.

TELL US WHAT TO BUILD
Vote on what's next or send a feature request from the app.

FREE, TRIAL AND PRO
- Free: plan one full site with as many cameras as it needs, see its coverage and make a watermarked report. The sample store is always free.
- 7-day trial: every Pro feature, free and never charged. When it ends, the Pro features lock again unless you buy Pro. Your sites are kept.
- Lifetime Pro: unlimited sites, Suggest, night coverage, clean reports and site file sharing. One payment, no subscription.

PLEASE NOTE
- Scanning needs an iPhone with a LiDAR scanner (iPhone Pro models). On other iPhones you can draw a site by hand or use the sample store.
- Coverage figures are planning estimates based on camera specifications and the room. They are not a professional security survey and do not guarantee that a camera will capture an event.
- The built-in store is a sample layout and is labeled as one in the app.
- Security Camera Planner is independent and not affiliated with any camera manufacturer.

PRIVACY, PLAINLY
No account, no ads, no analytics and no tracking. Scans, sites and reports stay on your iPhone unless you share them. The privacy policy names the few services the app contacts and exactly what each one receives.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://arthex.ai/cctv-planner/privacy/
Support: https://arthex.ai/cctv-planner/

name: Seed Magnet: Push & Pull
description:
One finger. Two seeds. Opposite forces.

Hold anywhere to create a field: the gold seed is pulled toward your finger while the blue seed is pushed away. Let go and both keep drifting with their momentum. Choose where and how long to hold so each seed glides into the pot of its own color.

HOW IT PLAYS
• Hold to attract gold and repel blue; release to let them coast
• Touch a thorn and the level restarts in seconds
• Later levels add key-lights that open the pots and directional wind that blows while you hold
• Collect optional light drops for a higher score

CONTENT
• 1,000 levels, generated by algorithm and each one checked by simulation to be solvable
• Levels 1–12 are free
• One-time "Unlock All" purchase opens levels 13–1000. No subscription
• Restore Purchases is supported

DESIGNED FOR EVERYONE
• Plays offline, no account, no ads
• VoiceOver support with a step-by-step coordinate control mode
• Gold uses circles and blue uses diamonds, so color is never the only cue
• No personal data is collected; progress stays on your device

Purchasing and restoring require a connection to the App Store.

name: SelenEpoch
description:
SelenEpoch is an offline lunar companion for people who watch the night sky—not another weather feed.

Explore moon phases across roughly ±200 years, check lunar eclipses, sun and moon rise/set times, and classic solunar windows for outdoor planning. Keep private observation notes on your device. No accounts. No social push. No clutter.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Tonight — live moon phase, illumination, age, distance, and rise/set for your site
• Phases — browse major lunar phases month by month across two centuries
• Sky — upcoming and historical lunar eclipses, filterable by type
• Solunar — major/minor activity windows from lunar transit and rise/set
• Journal — private sky notes stored locally on your iPhone

BUILT FOR THE FIELD
• Works offline after install
• Set your observing site manually, or optionally use device location
• English primary, with Simplified Chinese available in Settings
• Clear accuracy notes for educational and planning use

SelenEpoch (望纪) keeps the focus on the Moon and the sky—quiet, useful, and ready whenever you step outside.

name: Sellalo
description:
Séllalo pone una marca de agua a las copias de tu DNI, pasaporte u otros documentos antes de que los envíes para un trámite, y también a las fotos que publicas en redes.

Todo ocurre dentro de tu teléfono. La app no se conecta a internet: tus fotos y documentos no se suben a ningún servidor, no se procesan fuera y no se guardan. Nadie los recibe. Es gratuita y sin ánimo de lucro.

Qué hace:
• Escribe sobre la copia para quién es, para qué trámite y en qué fecha, con una referencia única.
• Tapa en negro los datos que no hacen falta, de forma que no se puedan recuperar.
• Quita los metadatos de la foto (ubicación, modelo de cámara, hora).
• Añade un aviso de que no autorizas el uso de la imagen con inteligencia artificial.
• Guarda, solo en tu móvil y si tú quieres, un registro de a quién diste cada copia (solo texto, nunca la imagen).

Por qué importa:
Si envías una copia "limpia" de tu DNI y la empresa que la guarda sufre una filtración, esa copia puede usarse para suplantar tu identidad. Una copia marcada con su destino y su fecha vale mucho menos para quien la roba, y si aparece donde no debe, la propia imagen dice a quién se la diste.

Privacidad:
Sin publicidad, sin analítica, sin registro. Puedes usarla en modo avión. La única información que la app guarda son tus ajustes, en el propio móvil.
