Proyecto personal e independiente, sin relación con ningún organismo público ni con las plataformas mencionadas. No es asesoramiento jurídico.

name: Set Ledger: Workout Log
description:
Keep the sets you planned separate from the sets you actually performed. Set Ledger is a local workout record book for your own exercises, templates and sessions.

Enter weight and repetitions, choose kg or lb, and mark sets as completed or skipped. Compare the current session with a previous completed session for the same exercise, original unit and set type. Copied previous values remain unfinished until you complete them. Missing values and recorded zero values stay distinct.

Correct a set with Undo and Redo. Keep original numeric entries and units when changing the display unit. Summaries group recorded weight × repetitions by unit and set type; this is a record total, not a strength estimate or exercise recommendation.

Export and import Set Ledger record CSV files with a choice for conflicting IDs. Keep a full JSON backup of records, plans, drafts, undo/redo history and retained CSV originals. Restoring asks before replacing the current local ledger; it does not merge whole backups. Backups are readable, not encrypted vaults.

Practice the three-step guide in a separate example ledger. Save and reopen your own records locally. Deleting local records does not delete external originals, previously shared files or device backups. Share only to the destination you choose in the system share sheet.

Paid download with full access and no in-app purchases, subscription, account or advertising. No developer server receives your workout records. The interface currently includes English, Korean and Japanese; user-created exercise names and entries are not automatically translated.

name: SewMeasure
description: SewMeasure helps tailors manage customers, body measurements, fabric estimates, orders, and fittings offline with measurement guides and templates.

name: Shawared: Arabic Poetry
description:
Shawared is a library of Arabic poetry as it is recited: hear each poem in its reciter's voice, read its verses as they are recited, and understand what they mean.

• The verse being recited lights up as you listen. Move between verses, or repeat one to learn it by heart.
• Every verse comes with its explanation and the meanings of its words, and every poem with notes on it and its poet.
• Poems from before Islam to today: Imru' al-Qays, Antara, Jarir, al-Mutanabbi, Abu Tammam, al-Buhturi, Abu Firas al-Hamdani, Ibn Zurayq, Ahmad Shawqi and more.
• An English translation of every poem, beside the Arabic.
• Browse by poet, reciter and meter, or search by title, opening line or poet, with or without vowel marks.
• Fully vowelled texts that follow what the reciter says, checked against their sources.
• Your library: keep your favourite poems, poets and reciters, make playlists, and download recordings to listen offline.
• The recitation keeps playing while you browse the app or lock your screen, moves on to the next poem in its list, and answers the lock screen's controls.
• An Arabic or English interface, in day or night colors.

Shawared needs no account and has no ads or purchases. Loading poems and recordings needs an internet connection; the poems you've opened and the recordings you download stay on your device.

Shawared is made by EasyBooks.

name: Shift Pot
description: Shift Pot helps small hospitality teams close out shared cash tips. Split by time, role-weighted time, role shares, or equal people. Explain every cent, record cash after it is handed out, and keep partial handouts and corrections connected to the original records. Local, single-device use with portable backups and private PDF or CSV statements.

name: Shotgem
description:
You liked a product and took a screenshot. What happens next?

Shotgem helps turn the screenshots you allow it to access from the last six months into your product memory. It discovers new screenshots and detects products on your iPhone when you start analysis.

• Browse detected products and search their tags.
• Focus on a product and adjust the selected area.
• Search the selected image with Google Lens.
• Discover objects around you with Snap & Find.
• Save links from several stores with one product.
• Revisit your favorites and saved links.

Product analysis happens on your device. After your permission, tapping Search by image starts a Google search with the prepared product image. Store pages and connection data are subject to the relevant sites' policies. Prices and matches are not guaranteed.

Start with 10 free product previews. Full analysis is available through a 3-day free trial or a one-time purchase. The trial does not charge automatically. New analysis locks after the trial ends; products already in your archive remain accessible. Current pricing and access details are shown before purchase.

name: Shotproof: Work GPS Camera
description:
Shotproof is a jobsite camera and report maker for contractors, trades, property managers and inspectors.

A STAMP ON EVERY PHOTO
Keep a clear record of when and where work was done:
- Date, time to the second, and time zone
- GPS coordinates and altitude
- Street address from the location
- Project name, job category and your notes
- Optional map inset showing where the photo was taken

PDF JOB REPORTS (PRO)
- Cover page with your company name and logo
- Photo grids and a table of all photos and notes
- Map snapshots of each photo location
- Share or print from the share sheet
- Before and After photos paired side by side
- Required-shots checklist with ticks
- Client signature on the last page

OPTIONAL TIMESTAMP CERTIFICATES (PRO)
- Requests an RFC 3161 timestamp from an independent time-stamping authority for each photo
- Makes a later change to the photo detectable (tamper-evident, not tamper-proof)
- Only the file's hash is sent, never the photo, notes or location
- Built-in Verify tool to check a stamped photo

BATCH STAMPING AND EXPORTS
- Stamp existing photos from your library in batches
- Export a job as a ZIP of stamped photos
- CSV register export with coordinates, dates and notes (Pro)

QUICK LAUNCH
- Open the camera from the Action Button, Control Center, Siri or a Shortcut

FREE
- Camera with date, time, GPS and address stamps
- 1 custom job plus the default No Job
- Batch stamping up to 20 photos at a time
- ZIP export and saving stamped photos to Photos
- Company name on the stamp
- Stamped video up to 1 minute

SHOTPROOF PRO
- PDF job reports with map snapshots
- Company logo on stamps and report covers
- Unlimited jobs
- Unlimited batch stamping
- CSV register export
- Timestamp certificates and the Verify tool
- Markup: draw arrows, circles and notes on a stamped photo (the original stays untouched)
- Job checklists of required shots, unlimited (free: 3 items)
- Before/After pairs and client signature in reports
- Voice-note dictation, processed on your device
- Stamped video with no length limit

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
No account, no ads and no tracking. Your photos, jobs and client addresses stay on your iPhone unless you share them.

Shotproof records what the phone reports and is not a legal or forensic service. Check your own requirements before relying on any record in a dispute.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://negishubham007.github.io/apps/shotproof/privacy/

name: SimPal Golf
description:
SimPal turns your iPhone or iPad into a remote, a live screen and a shot tracker for your GSPro golf simulator.

SimPal is a companion app. It needs SimPal for Windows running on the PC that runs GSPro, on the same Wi-Fi. Open the app, scan the QR code on your PC, and you are connected.

CONTROL THE GAME
- Aim, change clubs, take a mulligan and move around the course without walking to the keyboard
- Camera, map, tee and green controls in one place
- Type into GSPro with your device's own keyboard
- Layouts made for iPhone and iPad, upright or sideways

SEE EVERY SHOT
- Carry, total, ball speed, launch, spin and direction, the moment you hit
- A plain-English read of what the ball did
- Every club compared, with how much it varies
- Watch your shots fly over a fairway in 3D

PRACTISE WITH A PLAN
- A practice coach that works from your own shots
- Short guided sessions that score every ball
- Tests that show whether you are really improving

PLAY TOGETHER
- A profile for every player in the bay
- In a scramble, see which ball leaves the fewest strokes
- Rounds, scorecards and course records

Works with any launch monitor that GSPro supports.

SimPal is an independent product. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by GSPro.

name: Simple Keyboard: MIDI
description:
Enough with complicated virtual keyboard apps.
Just looking for beautiful keys to show on your screen?

That’s why we made Simple Keyboard.
Easy to connect. Lovely to look at. Because we’d rather you spend your time playing than learning another app.

Getting started is simple: choose one MIDI input.
The app remembers your input and display settings, so the next time you open it, everything feels familiar.

When you want to focus on your playing, switch to Performance Mode.
Settings and buttons disappear, leaving only the keys. Whether you’re following the notes you play or showing your performance to someone else, the music stays in view.

You’ll be looking at these keys for a while, so we took care of the little things.
Soft reflections, the movement of each key, the shadows that change as you play. Details that make the display feel natural and comfortable.

Of course, everyone has their own idea of beautiful.
Make it yours, from pressed-key colors to keyboard size, proportions and lettering. Set it up the way you like, and let the app remember.

Putting a keyboard on your screen should be this simple.
So you can focus on playing.

Simple Keyboard.

This app visualizes MIDI input. It does not produce sound.

name: Sip N Eat World Tour
description:
Eat and drink your way around the world, without the guesswork.

Sip N Eat World Tour is a festival food guide for your phone. See every booth's menu and price, save what you want to try, and follow a walking loop that takes you from country to country in order.

EVERY MENU, EVERY PRICE
• Every booth and every item, with prices
• Search and filter: sweet or savory, drinks, desserts, mocktails, by country
• Our own short notes on what's worth the queue
• Works offline, so weak park signal doesn't matter

PICK AN ADVENTURE
• Ready-made adventures: a dessert crawl, eat and drink, mocktails and more
• Or build your own: how long you have, countries to skip, sweet or savory
• Tick things off as you go and watch your passport fill up

PLAN IT WITH YOUR CREW
• Share a crew code and everyone's picks show on one map, live
• See who wants what, and clear items together as you eat them

YOUR DAY, YOUR REEL
• Add a photo to each bite and turn your day into a short video to share
• A passport of countries visited, and how much you've spent

PRESS PASS
Everything above is free. The Press Pass adds the guided day: the walking route on the map with walk times and "You're here", your next stop on the Lock Screen, unlimited saves, starting your own crews, budget and drink pacing, and reels without our name.
• One festival: a one-time purchase
• Every festival for a year: an auto-renewing subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple ID. It renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the year; manage or cancel in Settings → your name → Subscriptions.

No ads. No tracking. No account needed to browse or plan.

An unofficial, independent guide to the international food festivals at EPCOT, Walt Disney World. Not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by The Walt Disney Company. Walt Disney World, EPCOT and related marks are trademarks of their owners. Menus and prices can change. No allergen information; always ask at the booth

name: Sistani Questions & Answers
description:
Read the published questions and answers of Grand Ayatollah Ali al-Husseini al-Sistani in a clear Arabic interface, with offline access to thousands of entries.

Features
• Browse topics by their Arabic initial letter and search topic names.
• Search questions and answers, or questions only, across the catalogue or within a topic.
• Highlight matching search terms in results and the reader.
• Save bookmarks and return to recently read entries.
• Discover varied selections and suggested topics.
• Read in dark mode and adjust the reading font size.
• Copy or share a question and answer together with its source link.
• Open the official source for updates or visit the official website to submit a new question.

Reading, search and bookmarks work offline. External links require internet access. No account, advertising or in-app purchases are required. The reference content and app interface are in Arabic.

Source: the questions and answers section of the Office of al-Sistani:
https://www.sistani.org/arabic/qa/

This independent reader is not an official app of the Office and does not issue rulings or accept new religious questions. Its bundled texts are a saved snapshot; consult the source link for the latest information. References to health or legal subjects are published religious-law material, not personalised medical or legal advice.

Developed by the Anwar5 Network team for hosting, software and design.
https://anwar5.net
Support: info@anwar5.net

name: Six Dices Escaper
description:
Think ahead, and find your way to victory in Six Dices Escaper, an exciting dice-based puzzle adventure!

Every move matters. Navigate challenging tile paths, collect every golden pip, and discover the smartest route to complete each trial. Simple to play but challenging to master, every puzzle puts your planning and problem-solving skills to the test.

name: Skinlingo
description:
■ Korean label → English
Each ingredient on a Korean list (전성분) is shown with its English INCI name, in label order. English labels work too.

■ Label scan
Take or choose a photo of the ingredient list. Text is read on your device and the photo is not uploaded. 3 free label scans a week.

■ Barcode lookup and product search
Find a product by barcode or by name in Open Beauty Facts, a volunteer-run open database. Coverage of Korean products is still small. Free.

■ Paste an ingredient list
Paste a list in Korean or English. Free.

■ 0–100 score with reasons
The score uses public EU rules only (Regulation (EC) No 1223/2009):
- an ingredient banned in EU cosmetics (Annex II): −30
- a fragrance allergen that must be named on EU labels: −4
- other Annex III ingredients are allowed within set limits; they are tagged Regulated and don't lower the score.
Every point off is listed. The rules and their sources are in the app. Grades: Excellent, Good, Fair, Poor.

■ My skin filters
Mark what you want to check: added fragrance, alcohol, essential oils, EU fragrance allergens, bee products. Filters don't change the score.

■ Ingredient details
What an ingredient does, how it is scored, and where the information comes from.

■ Compare two products
Score, points off, your filters, and the ingredients in both or only one, side by side.

■ History and sharing
Recent scans stay on your device. Share a result as text.

■ Offline ingredient dictionary
13,000+ ingredient names from the EU Glossary of common ingredient names, with Korean names for common K-beauty ingredients. Works without a connection.

■ Skinlingo Pro (In-App Purchase)
- Unlimited label scans
- Saved products with your own names
- AM/PM routine with ingredient combination notes (for example retinol and AHAs in the same routine), with the source

■ Subscription
Skinlingo Pro is $24.99 a year or $4.99 a month, with a 3-day free trial. Payment is charged to your App Store account. The subscription renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Cancel anytime in your account's subscription settings.
Terms of Use: https://slowmind.kr/legal/skinlingo/terms
Privacy Policy: https://slowmind.kr/legal/skinlingo/privacy

■ Sources
Ingredient names and EU rules: adapted from documents of the European Union, © European Union, CC BY 4.0. Product data: Open Beauty Facts (ODbL). Skinlingo is not affiliated with the European Union or Open Beauty Facts.

No account. No ads. No tracking.
Contact: contact@slowmind.kr

name: Sky Adventurer: Drone Pilot
description:
In Sky Adventurer you are a drone pilot. Complete missions above a living city with day and night, seasons, traffic and street life — plus a beach, harbor, villages, farmland and mountains.

THREE WAYS TO PLAY • Story Mode: a 12-chapter story that unlocks step by step, calm flying • Mission Mode: 100+ missions sorted from easy to hard (Easy · Medium · Hard · Expert) • Ranks: 8 missions for each of the 30 pilot ranks — 240 missions that get harder as you climb, with an exam at every rank

MISSIONS • Search for missing people and animals, scan heat signatures with the thermal camera • Deliver parcels and heavy cargo, land on moving ships • Real-estate, event and sunset shoots • Garden wedding: film the bride's entrance, shoot a 360° promo film, deliver the wedding rings by drone • Herd guard: scare off a wolf stalking the sheep by diving low, using the loudspeaker or the night spotlight • Firefighting, first response at accidents, ambulance escort • Speed radar with the police drone, traffic tickets, runaway car chases • Daily missions, weekly events, radio calls and hidden discoveries

YOUR OWN DRONE COMPANY • Found your company, hire and train pilots; grow your crew for major operations • Take contracts from the board; your pilots keep working while you are away • Hand a mission over to one of your pilots, or lead a 10-drone crew against a big fire • Compete with rival companies in seasonal rankings

UPGRADE YOUR DRONE • Repair Workshop: arms, frame, battery, camera, sensor and antenna take damage depending on the impact; repair, replace or upgrade • A top-down drone diagram on screen: damaged parts glow red • Motor, battery, antenna, camera and sensor upgrades; colored propellers, LED lights and stickers • 8 drones: the starter, racing, cargo and scout drones are free

A NEW GOAL EVERY DAY • Daily chest and a 7-day calendar • Pilot license tests A, B and C • Weekly ring course: race a ghost drone for medals • Exploration atlas: a map that reveals as you fly, plus hidden collectibles • Photo album and quick challenges while you fly

CINEMATIC FLIGHT • Follow and orbit modes, fly a route you draw on the map • Coin-powered autopilot to the mission target • Cinema mode, filters and a 30-second replay; save photos and videos to Photos • Clean screen: hide every menu, keep only the view and the sticks

MADE FOR iPHONE AND iPAD • Each pilot has their own save and drone garage • Dual-stick touch controls (Mode 1 / Mode 2) with haptic feedback • Game controller, keyboard and trackpad support • Graphics and layout tuned for your device • Plays offline; back up your save to a file • English and Turkish

No ads. No subscriptions. The game is free. A one-time "Full Version" purchase unlocks the Police, Fire, Mini FPV and Farm drones and their missions.

name: SmartRefer
description:
SmartRefer turns your recommendations into income. Refer friends and family to local businesses you trust and earn a commission when they become customers.

HOW IT WORKS
• Explore the businesses that pay for referrals and see how much each service pays before you recommend.
• Send a referral in seconds: name, phone and the service the person needs.
• Follow every referral in real time: Sent, Contacted, Closed, Collected, Paid.
• Get paid directly by the business through Zelle, PayPal or check.

WHY SMARTREFER
• One app for all your referrals, across every participating business.
• Clear commissions: you always know what you earn for each service.
• Sign in with a code sent to your email. No passwords to remember.
• Available in English and Spanish.

FOR BUSINESS OWNERS
Do you run a service business? Request your own referral program from the app. Your customers recommend you, you manage referrals, statuses and payouts from one panel, and you only pay when you close a deal.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Commissions are set and paid by each business. SmartRefer does not hold or transfer money.
• Using the app as a referrer is free.

Questions? Write to ceo@web24it.com.

name: Snake 2K Retro
description:
Remember snake on your old phone? Snake 2K brings it back with a full-screen lime LCD look, blocky pixel score and square-wave beeps, rebuilt for today’s iPhones.

• Swipe anywhere to steer, no buttons in the way
• Classic mode: eat, grow, don’t hit the walls or yourself
• Speeds 1 to 5, with your best score saved for each mode
• Works offline, no account needed
• No ads, ever

PREMIUM (one-time $2.99)
• 6 maze levels: Box, Cross, Tunnels, Pillars, Rooms, Corners
• Wrap mode: slide through the edges
• Turbo speeds 6 to 9
• 4 extra screen colors: Moss, Amber, Ice blue, Slate

Pay once, keep it forever. Family Sharing supported.

name: Snap Paper PDF
seller_name: Suzhou Bomei Education Consulting Co., Ltd.
description:
Snap Paper PDF does one thing: turn paper into tidy PDFs, keep them organised, and share them. Works for tests, homework, contracts and receipts.

SCAN IN A ROW
• Uses the built-in iPhone document scanner to capture page after page
• Detects paper edges and straightens skewed shots automatically
• Color, grayscale or black-and-white

RETAKE OR CROP JUST ONE PAGE
• Check the pages before you finish and tap any page to retake or crop it
• Rotate, reorder, insert or delete pages, with undo
• View full size and pinch to zoom

ONE TAP TO PDF AND SHARE
• Pages are laid out on A4, portrait or landscape
• Name the PDF, or let the app name it for you
• The share sheet opens straight away: Messages, Mail, AirDrop or Files

FOLDERS AND ZIP SHARING
• Create folders with any name, such as one class test or a batch of contracts
• Scan into a folder and PDFs are named Folder_01, Folder_02 and so on
• "Create, scan next" saves and opens the camera again, so a whole class takes minutes
• Select several PDFs (or all) and share them as one zip, or move them to another folder

SIMPLE AND PRIVATE
• No account needed
• Scans and PDFs stay on your device and are never uploaded
• Only the camera permission is requested
• Switch between English and Chinese with one tap

name: Snib Keep
description:
Snib Keep is for the moment you are still standing at the door.

Write the door's name on the stile. Thumb the snib down. Shoot the bolt into the keep. The phone keeps the time you shut it, and the Still open list shows the doors you have not shut yet.

It does not lock a real door, talk to a smart lock, remind you, or send anything off this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Sổ Tiệm – Sổ sách hộ KD
description:
Từ 1/1/2026 bỏ thuế khoán, hộ kinh doanh phải tự ghi sổ và kê khai. Sổ Tiệm giúp tạp hóa, quán ăn, tiệm tóc, shop quần áo và người bán online ghi thu chi trong vài giây, tự lập sổ đúng mẫu và biết trước nghĩa vụ thuế của mình.

GHI SỔ NHANH
• Bàn phím số lớn có phím 000, bấm số rồi lưu là xong
• Ghi gộp cả ngày cũng được, không cần ghi từng món
• Gợi ý số tiền vừa ghi, 10 loại thu chi quen thuộc: bán hàng, dịch vụ, bán online, nhập hàng, mặt bằng, điện nước, lương…
• Vuốt để xóa, chạm giữ để xem nhanh, hoàn tác khi lỡ tay

SỔ S1a-HKD ĐÚNG MẪU
• Tự lập Sổ doanh thu bán hàng hóa, dịch vụ theo mẫu S1a-HKD (Thông tư 152/2025/TT-BTC)
• Xuất PDF để in, ký; xuất Excel (CSV) gửi kế toán
• Theo tháng, quý hoặc năm; mỗi ngày một dòng hoặc từng giao dịch

THUẾ RÕ RÀNG
• Theo dõi doanh thu năm so với ngưỡng 1 tỷ đồng (Nghị định 68/2026, sửa bởi Nghị định 141/2026)
• Dự báo doanh thu cả năm, cảnh báo trước khi chạm ngưỡng
• Ước tính thuế GTGT, TNCN theo ngành khi vượt ngưỡng, có giải thích cách tính
• Nhắc hạn thông báo doanh thu và khai thuế quý, hướng dẫn từng bước trên eTax Mobile

BÁO CÁO KINH DOANH
• Lãi theo tháng, quý, năm, so với cùng kỳ
• Xu hướng thu chi, lãi, dòng tiền; kéo ngón tay để xem từng ngày
• Nguồn doanh thu và chi phí đi đâu, lịch bán hàng, ngày bán chạy, khoản lớn nhất
• Cảnh báo khi một khoản chi tăng bất thường

DÀNH CHO NGƯỜI BÁN APP
• Nhập báo cáo App Store Connect (Financial Report, Sales and Trends), quy đổi sang VND và ghi vào sổ

RIÊNG TƯ
• Không cần tài khoản, không quảng cáo, không gửi số liệu đi đâu
• Khóa sổ bằng Face ID; sao lưu ra iCloud Drive khi đổi máy
• Nhiều cửa hàng, cùng mã số thuế thì cộng ngưỡng chung

SỔ TIỆM PRO
Ghi sổ, xem tổng ngày, tháng và nhắc hạn luôn miễn phí. Gói Pro mở xuất sổ S1a-HKD, ước tính thuế, dự báo ngưỡng, báo cáo chi tiết và nhiều cửa hàng.
• Gói Tháng hoặc gói Năm (có dùng thử miễn phí 7 ngày), tự gia hạn, hủy bất cứ lúc nào trong Cài đặt → Apple ID → Đăng ký.
• Điều khoản: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
• Quyền riêng tư: https://sotiem-support.netlify.app/#quyen-rieng-tu

Sổ Tiệm hỗ trợ ghi chép và ước tính theo quy định hiện hành, không thay cho tư vấn thuế.

name: Softhue: Calm Coloring Book
description:
Softhue is a calm coloring book for grown-ups. Pick a mandala, tap a shape and watch it fill with color.
No timers, no scores, no sign-up. Just you, a quiet page and a few minutes to unwind.
Free, supported by ads that never appear while you color.

194 ORIGINAL PAGES, 18 THEMES
• Mandalas and animal mandalas, from simple to richly detailed
• Patterns, cozy home scenes, flowers & nature, birds, butterflies & bugs
• Animals, ocean, space, fantasy, music, farm, food & sweets, cute kawaii
• Vehicles, buildings & places, seasons & holidays
• 4 free packs to download: Christmas, Jungle Safari, Winter Wonderland and Dinosaurs (40 more pages)

SIMPLE, SATISFYING TOOLS
• Tap to fill: each area fills cleanly, edge to edge
• Brush and eraser that stay inside the lines, with soft or hard edges
• Eyedropper to pick up any color from your picture
• 11 hand-picked palettes, from Pastel Dream to Earth Tones, plus your own custom colors
• Zoom up to 8x on iPhone and 12x on iPad for the tiniest details
• Undo and redo, and hints that point out the spots you missed
• Autosave, so you can pick up exactly where you left off

MADE FOR A QUIET MOMENT
• A daily page, picked for you each day
• Gentle streaks and an optional daily reminder
• Soft sounds and optional background music
• Light and dark mode, on iPhone and iPad
• The built-in pages work offline

KEEP AND SHARE YOUR ART
• My Works keeps every page, finished or in progress
• Share your finished artwork or save it to Photos

FREE, AND CALM ABOUT ADS
Softhue is free. A small banner appears on the browse screens only, and an occasional full-screen ad may show when you leave a page, never while you are coloring.
Some special pages and 3 bonus palettes unlock with an optional short video: pages stay unlocked for good, palettes for 24 hours. If no video is available, they unlock for free.

No account needed. Your artwork is saved on your device.

Take a breath, choose a color and enjoy the page.

name: Soon – Big Day Countdown
description:
Soon is a countdown app about enjoying the wait, not just measuring it.

Every countdown gets a small living scene that moves closer to the big day as the time passes. A night flight glides toward the city lights. A sailboat crosses the sea to a lighthouse. A snail inches toward a strawberry. A candle burns down on a frosty windowsill. And on the day itself, each one celebrates in its own way.

24 LOOKS TO CHOOSE FROM
Journeys like Flight, Voyage, Train, Rocket, Balloon, Whale and Paper Boat, and still lifes like Candle, Bloom, Hourglass, Fireflies and Snow Globe. Tap a scene to give it a poke, or tilt your phone to tip the hourglass.

TIME IN UNITS THAT MEAN SOMETHING
See the wait in sleeps, weekends, full moons, back-to-back movies, songs or heartbeats, or in your own weekly ritual, like "4 more Taco Tuesdays".

A TIME CAPSULE FOR THE DAY
Write a note or record a voice memo. It stays sealed until the countdown reaches zero.

SURPRISES FOR FUTURE YOU
Hide a note or a photo behind any day of the wait, and find it when that day comes.

THE DAY ITSELF
Confetti and a celebration that fits the occasion: "Time to go" for a trip, "You made it" for a graduation. A reminder comes the evening before, and another at the moment itself.

ON YOUR HOME SCREEN AND LOCK SCREEN
Widgets in every size show the scene and the days left. In the final 24 hours, a live timer counts down on your Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island.

MEMORIES AFTERWARDS
Once the day has passed, a countdown becomes a memory, with a note and photos, and an "on this day" reminder in the years after.

YEARLY EVENTS
Birthdays and anniversaries roll over to next year on their own.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads and no tracking. Everything you add stays on your iPhone.

name: Sophia's Sight Words
description:
Turn spelling-list practice into an adventure. Start with common sight words or use the Parent area to add and switch between your own word lists. Practice with Find the Word, Unicorn Race, Match Twins, Word Pop, and Word Train.

Visit Letter Garden to grow flowers as you practice uppercase and lowercase letters and their sounds. Earn surprise gifts in the practice games, collect 32 stickers, and help Pip grow through 26 stages.

Parents can see progress by word and adjust practice options. Starter words and other included practice words have recorded audio. You can add custom word lists; words without a matching bundled recording have no spoken audio. Word lists and progress save on your device. Play offline with no account, ads, or subscription.

Some illustrations and the adapted 3D shoe model were made with Meshy. Recorded narration was made with Aidocmaker.com.

name: Sortin' Goods: Holiday Edition
description:
Welcome to Sunlit Boutique Grocers — restock, match, and clear every cozy wooden shelf!

Sortin' Goods: Holiday Edition is a relaxing, tactile 3-column shelf-sorting puzzle game set inside a sunlit neighborhood market and seasonal holiday bazaar. Drag or tap 3D drinks, pantry jars, snacks, self-care bottles, sports gear, and retro toys between warm cubbies—match 3 identical items on the front ledge to clear the set and bring hidden back-row goods forward!

• 24 UNLOCKED HOLIDAY LEVELS + 60 BOUTIQUE AISLES: Switch directly from the top banner between Holiday Boutique Market (all 24 festive seasonal levels unlocked) and Sunlit Boutique Grocers (60 aisles across 6 retail chapters).
• ONE-THUMB 3-COLUMN CLARITY: Crisp upright silhouettes, warm 9-slice wooden cubbies, magnetic snap feedback, and zero visual clutter.
• COLLECTIBLE BRAND DEX: Double-tap any shelf item to open the swipeable Brand Dex card inspector featuring 52 original studio-crafted goods and 24K Gold editions.
• CHAIN RUSH & SMART BOOSTERS: Build fast-match streaks or use Undo, Peek, Magnet, and Restock when a shelf fills up.
• OFFLINE READY: Play all 60 aisles and 24 holiday levels anywhere with no account or internet connection required.

name: Sortovia: Goods Sort Puzzle
description:
Sortovia is a cozy goods sort puzzle: move products between shelves, match 3 of a kind and clear the board. A relaxing sorting game you can play offline, anytime.

Plan your moves, keep an empty slot free and tidy up every shelf before you run out of moves. Easy to learn, surprisingly deep to master!

HOW TO PLAY
• Tap an item, then tap an empty slot to move it
• Bring 3 matching items onto one shelf to clear them
• Clear every item to complete the level
• Clear again within a couple of moves to keep your combo going

FEATURES
• 12 charming goods to sort: jam jars, milk cartons, cheese, donuts, candy and more
• Every level is generated to be solvable, so a win is always possible
• Hard and Super Hard levels with bonus coins for the brave
• Mystery crates with surprise goods inside
• 4 boosters for tricky moments: Undo, Shuffle, +1 Shelf and Magnet
• Daily Challenge with streaks: a fresh board every day
• Daily missions and a 7-day login calendar with growing rewards
• Earn up to 3 stars per level and follow your journey on the level map
• Achievements with coin rewards
• Unlock themes that change the look of your pantry
• Color-blind friendly symbols and haptic feedback
• Play in 23 languages
• Play offline: no Wi-Fi needed

Perfect for a quick break or a long, relaxing session. Sort, match and clear with Sortovia!

name: Sourdough Calculator & Diary
description:
See your dough's true hydration in seconds, with the flour and water inside your starter counted.
Type flour, water, starter and its hydration, then change the number of loaves and every amount scales with you.
No account, no ads, no setup: open the app and the calculator is ready.

WHY "TRUE" HYDRATION
A recipe with 500 g flour, 350 g water and 100 g starter at 100% looks like 70% hydration. Counting the 50 g of flour and 50 g of water inside the starter, it is really 72.7%. The calculator shows both, so you always know which number you are reading.

CALCULATOR (FREE, UNLIMITED)
- True hydration: total water divided by total flour, starter included
- Several flours in one dough (bread flour, whole wheat, rye, spelt…)
- Starter split into its flour and water for any starter hydration
- Salt as a percentage of total flour
- Starter % of added flour and prefermented flour % of total flour, each clearly labelled
- Scale by number of loaves, by any factor or to a target dough weight; hydration stays the same
- Target hydration: tells you how much water to add, and explains when your starter alone already brings too much
- Reads numbers the way your iPhone's region writes them, and points out a typo instead of guessing
- Your last numbers are still there next time you open the app

RECIPES
- Save a recipe in one tap; edits save automatically
- Notes for timings, temperatures and what to try next
- The free version keeps one saved recipe

PRO
- Unlimited saved recipes and one-tap duplication
- A photo bake journal: photos from your library, a star rating and notes for each bake
- Each journal entry keeps a copy of the recipe as it was that day, so later edits never rewrite history
- Printable PDF recipe cards with grams and baker's percentages

If Pro ends, nothing is deleted. Your recipes and bakes stay readable and exportable.

YOUR DATA
Recipes, bakes and photos are stored on your iPhone. Export a complete JSON backup any time (free) and import it again later. Delete All Data erases everything the app stored. Photos are picked with the system photo picker; the app never asks for camera access.

The numbers are arithmetic aids. Flours, starters and kitchens differ, so trust your dough too.

SUBSCRIPTION
Pro is optional: weekly with a 3-day free trial for eligible new subscribers, or annual, billed in full once a year. Prices are shown in the app before you buy. Subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled in Settings.

Privacy Policy: https://motleystudio.site/sourdough-calculator-journal/privacy

name: Sovrynthex StarPrime
description:
Sovrynthex StarPrime brings three original card-and-strategy games together with a daily number puzzle, all set in the fictional Dragon Valley.

Nova Rush puts eleven rockets on the grid. Before each race, meteors knock four out. Study the live win probabilities, call up to two rockets you believe will reach orbit, then watch cards flip from two draw piles to move the field. Spend your limited thrusters to nudge a total up or down and steer the outcome in your favour.

Ten Raiders pairs you with a partner against two rivals in a trick-taking card game built around a single objective: capture the four tens. Trump is not chosen in advance — it is set the moment someone cannot follow suit, which turns every early lead into a calculated risk. A two-deck variant doubles the cards and the tension.

Overload seats you at a shared reactor core. Each turn you play a number, coolant, hold, reverse or max card and try to keep the core at 40 or below. A same-colour card with a lower number can subtract instead of add, so hand management and timing decide who overloads and who survives. Lose three shields and you are out; last player standing wins.

Daily Puzzles present four cards and a target number every morning at three difficulty levels. Combine the card values with basic arithmetic to hit the target, request hints if you get stuck, and build a streak across consecutive days.

A unified dashboard tracks play time, sessions, win rates, XP, a six-tier rank ladder, an activity heat map and eight milestones across all four modes. A full session history lets you review any past visit. Customise card-back themes, adjust per-game defaults, and rename your pilot whenever you like.

name: Spare Sense: Bowling Spares
description:
Left the 10-pin again? Tap the pins you left standing and Spare Sense shows you where to stand and where to aim.

No account. No typing. It works the first time you open it, standing on the approach.

SPARE FINDER
• Tap any leave on the rack: one pin, the bucket, a baby split, anything.
• See the board to stand on and the target to aim at.
• A lane sketch shows your feet, your target and the ball's path.
• One line explains the key pin.

TWO WIDELY TAUGHT SYSTEMS
• Straight ball: a plastic or spare ball, from two corner-pin starting spots.
• 3-6-9: your strike ball and strike target, moving your feet 3, 6 or 9 boards.
• Right- or left-handed. One- or two-handed.
• Set your own starting spots so the numbers fit your game.

SPARE LOG
• Tap Made it or Missed after each try.
• See your percentage for every leave and find the one that costs you most.
• Export your log as a spreadsheet file any time, free.

DRILLS
• Short spare drills you can do on a full rack, with a made and missed counter.

ALSO
• Home-screen widget with your weakest leave this week (Pro).
• Ask Siri: "Spare Sense 10 pin".

PRIVATE
• Everything stays on your phone. No account, no ads, no tracking.

FREE, WITH ONE OPTIONAL PURCHASE
• The Spare Finder, both systems, your own settings, logging and export are free.
• Spare Sense Pro is a one-time purchase. It adds your whole history in the app, every drill and the widget. No subscription.

Missing two easy spares a game costs roughly 16 to 20 pins. The numbers in Spare Sense are a starting point. Lanes, balls and styles differ, so adjust from your own shot.

From the makers of The 200 Code.

name: Spatial Space: 3D Smart Home
description:
Your home, live in 3D.

Forget endless lists of switches and room names. Spatial Space draws your home as a 3D model you can turn, zoom and touch, so controlling it feels like reaching into the room.

Tap what you see
• Tap a lamp or a fan to switch it on or off
• Slide to dim a light and change its colour
• Light up a whole room at once from the tray below the model

Watch it come alive
The model glows with the lights that are on. Walk through your home at night and see, at a glance, what you left switched on.

Start in seconds, make it yours
Explore a ready-made sample home first, with no setup and no account. When you’re ready, add your own home and place your lamps, fans and rooms where they really are.

Works with what you already own
• Apple Home: bring in the lamps from your Home app
• Home Assistant: connect your own server and control the devices it manages

Private by design
Spatial Space has no accounts and no servers, and it collects nothing about you. Your floor plans, device names and access tokens stay on your own devices, and the app talks directly to the hubs you already own.

Made for iPhone and iPad
Use it in portrait on iPhone, or on iPad with room to spread out, in landscape and in Split View.

Spatial Space shows your home the way you picture it. Download it and walk in.

name: Spidery Creators
description:
Spidery Creators connects brands with authentic Instagram creators across India, and keeps every collaboration safe from first offer to final payment.

FOR BRANDS
- Discover verified creators by niche, city, language and audience size
- See each creator's portfolio, authenticity score and real engagement in one place
- Post a campaign brief and get matched with suitable creators
- Send offers, chat once a creator accepts, and approve content before it goes live
- Payment is held safely and released to the creator only after you approve the work

FOR CREATORS
- Build a professional portfolio automatically from your Instagram
- Get discovered by brands looking for creators in your niche
- Receive collab offers, accept the ones you like and chat with the brand
- Submit your content in the app and get paid once the brand approves
- Track your collabs, earnings and payouts from your dashboard

WHY SPIDERY CREATORS
- Only eligible, authentic creators are onboarded, so brands work with real audiences
- A clear agreement for every collab protects both sides
- Brand identity stays private until an offer is sent
- Instant notifications for new offers, messages, submissions and payments
- Help centre and Spidy, our assistant, to answer questions anytime

Spidery Creators is a product of Spidery Web, a digital marketing agency based in Mumbai.

Questions? Visit creators.spideryweb.com/help

name: Spikly
description:
SPIKLY brings the talking reading board to phones and tablets: 44 squares the child taps to hear the voice recorded by their parent.

Designed for autistic, non-verbal or minimally verbal children, for children learning to speak or to read, and for anyone who wants to get better at reading.

YOUR VOICE, NOT A ROBOT VOICE
No prerecorded voice, no synthetic voice. You record each square yourself, 10 seconds at most. A square without a recording stays silent.

9 PROGRESSIVE BOARDS
From vowels and sounds to sentences to put back in order. Each board has its own recordings, every text can be edited, and you can create your own boards.

A CALM SCREEN
The 44-square board is the main screen, fully visible on phones and tablets. No ads, no notifications, no added sound, no flashing.

A PROTECTED PARENT AREA
PIN access: record, listen, validate, re-record or delete each square, with automatic saving, printing and PDF export of the boards.

YOUR DATA STAYS WITH YOU
Voices are kept on the device and the app works without internet. Online backup is optional: it is used only if you create an account.

One purchase, no ads.

Privacy: https://ecloso.com/spikly/privacy.html
Support: hello@ecloso.com

name: SpoolGauge Material Planner
description:
Plan filament use from the weights and material properties you enter.

Record a spool's measured gross weight, empty-spool tare, filament diameter and density. SpoolGauge Material Planner subtracts the tare to show available mass and estimates the length of uniform cylindrical filament.

• Calculate job demand from grams per copy, number of copies and extra allowance.
• Compare a job with the available material on each spool.
• Allocate the whole job to one spool and freeze a remainder receipt.
• Preview a real PDF or share PDF and CSV files through iOS.
• Reweigh a spool to reconcile planned stock with a new measurement.
• Use a separate mass-to-length or length-to-mass calculator without changing stock.

Frozen receipts retain their original spool, job and before-and-after values when live records change. Deleting a job or receipt does not reverse an allocation.

SpoolGauge Material Planner does not connect to a printer or measure actual consumption. Allocations represent planned use. Length estimates depend on the diameter and density you enter and assume uniform cylindrical filament. Records and frozen files are stored locally; shared copies and system backups are separate.

name: SpoolQueue: 3D Print Planner
description:
Plan your 3D printing orders from your iPhone or iPad. Add the duration from your slicer, choose compatible printers, and see which jobs are due next.

When a print fails, log the attempt and preview where the remaining work can fit. See how the change affects other orders before committing to a new schedule.

Start with one printer for free. SpoolQueue Pro adds multi-printer planning, deadline-aware rescheduling, and job history exports with a one-time purchase. No app account is required.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Stepback: Mock State Board
description:
On exam day nobody explains anything. A proctor reads the instructions, a timer starts, an examiner ticks a sheet, and you step back when you are done. Stepback is that room in your iPhone, so the real one is not the first time you hear it.

Prop the phone next to your mannequin and press start. The proctor reads the section aloud in English, tells you how long you have, calls the minutes that remain and says when to stop working. Then Stepback hands you the examiner's sheet: tick what you did, untick what you missed, and see your score.

Three practical exams
Cosmetology: 10 core sections, from set up and thermal curling to haircutting, chemical waving, the predisposition and strand tests, foil highlights, color retouch, relaxer and the blood exposure procedure.
Esthetics: 6 core sections, including the basic facial, hair removal and facial makeup.
Nail technology: 7 core sections, including the manicure, tip application, the sculptured nail and its removal.

What you rehearse
- Working to the clock. Every section runs for its real time and warns you the way the proctor does.
- Listening. With the proctor's voice on, the instructions come spoken in English, as in the exam room.
- The points people lose without noticing: labels, draping, where the trash and the soiled linens go, what goes to be disinfected.
- Stepping back early. Finish before time and Stepback records how long you needed.

Spanish under the English
Turn on Spanish and every instruction and every scored task shows a Spanish line under each English line, so you learn the words you will hear on the day.

Kit and rules
A packing list for each exam and each section, with the English wording you need on your labels, and the rules that fail candidates who know the service: the kit stays closed, nothing goes back in, wipes instead of sprays.

What Pro adds
Every section can be rehearsed with its timer, its instructions and its score sheet, and the first two sections of each exam are complete, with voice and Spanish. Pro adds:
- The proctor's voice and Spanish in every section
- The full mock board: all sections in order, hands on the mannequin from start to finish
- Your history, with the tasks you miss most in each section
- Your own state's time for any section

Pro is a single purchase, or a monthly subscription that renews until you cancel it in your App Store account settings.

Where this comes from
Stepback follows the national practical format that many state boards use. States add, drop or retime sections, so always check your own candidate bulletin. Stepback is a study aid made by an independent developer and is not affiliated with or endorsed by any state board or examination provider.

Your rehearsals and scores stay on your iPhone. No account, no ads.

Privacy: https://stepback.baltajmn.dev/privacy/
Terms of use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: StePlayer
description:
StePlayer è un lettore multimediale veloce e pulito per le liste che già possiedi. Aggiungi una lista M3U o M3U8 oppure l'accesso al tuo server, e guarda i tuoi flussi su iPhone, iPad e Apple TV.

L'app non contiene canali né contenuti: al primo avvio è vuota e mostra solo ciò che inserisci tu.

FUNZIONI PRINCIPALI
• Liste M3U/M3U8 e accesso al server con indirizzo, nome utente e password
• Flussi HLS, MP4, MKV e MPEG-TS
• Guida programmi XMLTV, quando la lista la fornisce
• Sezioni Live, Film e Serie, con ricerca rapida in tutta la lista
• Preferiti, cronologia e "riprendi da dove eri rimasto"
• Tracce audio e sottotitoli selezionabili, con regolazione della sincronia
• Picture in Picture e AirPlay
• Timer di spegnimento e cambio canale veloce
• Download per vedere offline i tuoi video
• Configurazione della TV dal telefono, nella stessa rete Wi-Fi

PENSATO PER APPLE TV
Interfaccia completa per il telecomando Siri Remote: focus chiaro, navigazione rapida e testi leggibili da lontano.

PRIVACY
• Nessun account e nessuna registrazione
• Nessuna pubblicità, nessuna statistica, nessun tracciamento
• Liste, password, preferiti e cronologia restano solo sul tuo dispositivo; le password sono custodite nel Portachiavi

AVVISO IMPORTANTE
StePlayer è esclusivamente un lettore multimediale neutrale: non fornisce, non vende e non include alcun contenuto audiovisivo, canale, lista o abbonamento. Usalo solo con liste e flussi che hai il diritto di riprodurre.

Informativa sulla privacy e termini d'uso: https://stefanob88.github.io/steplayerwebsite/
Contatti: steplayer.help@gmail.com

name: StillTime: Life & Loved Ones
description:
Time passes quietly. The moments that matter deserve our attention.

StillTime helps you see life's days in a new light and reflect on the people who make them meaningful.

SEE YOUR DAYS DIFFERENTLY

Explore a thoughtful visualisation of days lived and estimated days ahead. See the bigger picture without losing sight of today.

THE PEOPLE WHO MATTER

Reflect on your relationships with parents, your partner and your children. A different perspective on time can make ordinary moments feel more precious.

FROM PERSPECTIVE TO PRESENCE

A call, a visit, a shared meal, an unhurried conversation. StillTime is a gentle reminder to make room for what matters now.

SIMPLE, WARM AND INTENTIONAL

An uncluttered experience made for moments of reflection rather than another endless feed.

One purchase. No subscription.

StillTime — Time for what matters.

Note: Life-day visualisations are estimates for reflection. They are not predictions of an individual's lifespan or medical advice.

name: StolaRef
description:
StolaRef is your personal lifestyle companion for women’s outfits and local style moments. Discover curated look ideas, organize the pieces you already own, compose wearable boards, and collect nearby places that photograph well.

Explore
Browse featured women’s outfit references with large images, seasonal filters, moods, and styling notes. Save favorites and turn inspiration into a look you can actually wear.

Closet
Add tops, dresses, outerwear, and accessories with photos, colors, seasons, and notes. Keep a clear shelf of what you have—no account required.

Looks
Combine closet pieces into look boards for weekends, workdays, and evenings. Plan a wear date and keep notes so getting dressed feels easier.

Spots
Find local cafés, boutiques, dining rooms, and photo corners. Mark visited places, favorite the best ones, and add personal notes for your next outing.

Studio
Use the outfit planner and style journal to track what worked. Favorites stay in one shelf. Privacy Policy, Terms, and local data reset are built in.

Everything stays on your device. StolaRef is designed for everyday styling—not trends for the sake of trends.

name: STUDIO 20
description:
¡Descárgate nuestra app STUDIO 20 para tener siempre tu estudio favorito en el bolsillo!
Desde nuestra app, podrás planificar y programar tus clases, ver horarios, inscribirte, ¡y mucho más!
Maximiza tu tiempo y no te pierdas nunca la información más actualizada que tendrás siempre al alcance de tu mano. No esperes más y descárgate ya STUDIO 20

description:

Mit unserer App können Sie Ihre Kurse planen, Stundenpläne einsehen, sich anmelden, und vieles mehr!
Maximieren Sie Ihre Zeit und verpassen Sie nie die neuesten Informationen, die Sie immer zur Hand haben. Warten Sie nicht länger und laden Sie Studio Nou jetzt herunter.

name: StudyBeans
description:
StudyBeans ile ders çalışmak artık tek başına sıkıcı değil! Arkadaşlarınla aynı 3D odada buluş, sayacı başlat, birlikte odaklanın.

BİRLİKTE ÇALIŞ
• En fazla 6 kişilik çalışma odaları
• Kafe, kütüphane, ofis ve ev temalı 3D odalar
• Ortak sayaç: odak ve mola süresini istediğin gibi ayarla (25/5, 50/10, 90/15 ya da istediğin dakika)
• Süre bitince herkes birlikte molaya çıkar
• Molada mesajlaş ya da sesli sohbet et

ÇALIŞTIKÇA KAZAN
• Odaklandığın her dakika para kazandırır
• Turu bitirince bonus, arkadaşlarınla birlikte çalışınca daha fazla bonus
• Bugün ve toplamda ne kadar çalıştığını gör

FASULYENİ GİYDİR
• Sevimli fasulye karakterini 18 renkle kişiselleştir
• Kazandığın parayla kıyafet, şapka, gözlük, aksesuar ve masa arkadaşı al: kedi, köpek, penguen, robot ve daha fazlası

PROF. FASULYE
• Çözemediğin ders sorusunu yaz ya da fotoğrafını çek
• Prof. Fasulye adım adım çözümü anlatsın
• Matematik, fen, Türkçe, tarih, coğrafya, yabancı dil ve daha fazlası

TELEFONUNA ÖZEL
• Tur bittiğinde telefon kilitliyken bile bildirim
• Odak sırasında ekran kapanmaz
• Davet linkini tek dokunuşla arkadaşlarına gönder

GÜVENLİ ORTAM
• Küfür filtresi, şikayet ve engelleme
• Hesabını istediğin an uygulama içinden silebilirsin

Not: Prof. Fasulye bir yapay zekâdır, cevapları bazen hatalı olabilir.

name: SumDrop: Break the Sum
description:
Merge equal drops. Plan every move. End with a single drop.

SumDrop is a calm number puzzle with a water-drop theme. Drag a drop onto a neighbour with the same number and they merge into one drop with the sum. Keep going until only one drop is left on the board.

HOW IT WORKS
• Merge only equal neighbours: up, down, left or right.
• The direction matters: merging A into B or B into A leaves the result in a different cell, and changes the rest of the game.
• Stuck? Undo as many moves as you like, or restart the level.

WHAT YOU GET
• About 1,100 levels in six grid sizes, from 3×3 to 8×8, sorted by difficulty
• Every level is solvable: no luck, only logic
• Hints that show you the next move, or tell you how far back to go
• Up to three stars per level: finish without undo or hints for the full three
• A collection of vases that fills up as you play
• Soft watercolour drops, gentle sounds and haptics, light and dark themes
• Play with a drag or with two taps: comfortable on big grids and accessible
• Works fully offline, no account needed

Short sessions or long evenings: SumDrop is a puzzle you can pick up and put down.

name: Sunday Recap: Sermon Notes AI
description:
Turn the sermon you just heard into a Recap you can use all week.

Record a sermon or import an audio file, and Sunday Recap transcribes it on your iPhone. You get key points, practical next steps and five questions for your small group, with every Bible verse checked.

RECORD OR IMPORT
• Record in the background. Recording keeps going with your screen locked and carries on through interruptions.
• A clear recording indicator stays visible the whole time.
• Tap to mark a moment and add a short note while the speaker is talking.
• Already have audio? Import a file from Files or Voice Memos.

PRIVATE TRANSCRIPTION
• Transcribed on your iPhone with Apple's speech recognition.
• Your audio never leaves your phone.
• No account, no sign-in, no ads and no tracking.

A RECAP YOU CAN ACT ON
• A title and the big idea in one sentence
• 5 to 7 key points, each linked to its place in the transcript
• Application steps for the week ahead
• 5 discussion questions for your small group
• A short prayer note
• A verified verse list

VERSES YOU CAN TRUST
Scripture references are found with rules and checked against a table of real books, chapters and verses. Verse text comes only from the public-domain translations bundled in the app (KJV, WEB and BSB), so it works offline. Prefer another translation? Open the verse in your Bible app.

YOU CHOOSE WHERE THE RECAP IS MADE
• On your device: always available. Uses Apple's on-device language model where your iPhone supports it, and a built-in summary otherwise. Nothing leaves your phone.
• Cloud Recap (optional): only after you agree on a consent screen that names the provider, the transcript text (never the audio) is sent through our server to a third-party AI provider. We do not store the transcript. You can withdraw consent in Settings and keep using the app on your device.
Every Recap is labeled AI-generated. AI can make mistakes, so check important details against the sermon and Scripture.

SHARE WITH YOUR GROUP
Send a Group Recap card, a PDF, or Markdown or plain text through the iOS share sheet. Quotes on cards are limited to 25 words and credit the speaker. Nothing is published online.

KEEP EVERY SERMON
Search the full text of every sermon you save, and organize them in folders by church, speaker or series.

LENT AND EASTER
From Ash Wednesday to Easter, your recaps gather into one Lent journal.
• See your progress through the six Sundays of Lent and the services of Holy Week. Starting partway through Lent is fine.
• From Easter Sunday, turn the season's recaps into an Easter summary: the themes that ran through the sermons and the verses cited most often. Share it as a card, PDF or text.

SERMON VERSES WIDGET
Keep the Bible references from your latest sermon on your Home Screen and Lock Screen. The medium widget also shows the start of the verse text.

SUBSCRIPTION
Sunday Recap Pro unlocks the full app.
• Annual: $49.99 per year, starting with a 7-day trial
• Monthly: $9.99 per month
• Weekly: $5.99 per week
Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase, or when a trial ends. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel in Settings > [your name] > Subscriptions. Prices are for the U.S. App Store.

Please ask your church before you record. Recordings are for your personal use.

Privacy Policy: https://sunday-recap.pages.dev/privacy
Terms of Use: https://sunday-recap.pages.dev/terms
Apple Standard EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Sunstill: Sunlight Wallpaper
description:
Sunstill brings real sunlight into your room.

A window of light falls across a calm plaster wall, filtered through leaves, blinds and glass. It follows the actual sun where you are, minute by minute: crisp and pale in the morning, warm and golden at sunset, then a soft full moon or an orange street lamp after dark. Clouds soften the shadows when the sky is overcast.

Leave it running on your desk or nightstand, glance at it during the day, and let the light tell you the time.

LIGHT THAT FOLLOWS THE REAL SUN
• Sun position calculated for your location and time of day
• Live weather softens the light on cloudy days
• Golden hour turns the whole room amber
• Full-moon nights and lamplit stripes, never a blank screen

SCENES
• Monstera, palm, olive tree and rubber plant shadows that sway gently
• Venetian blinds, louvres, lattice, glass bricks and reeded glass
• Water glass caustics, a crystal's rainbows and pool reflections

A CALM DESK CLOCK
• Optional clock over the light, ideal in StandBy-style landscape on a stand
• Drag across the wall to watch the sun move through the day
• Tap once for the time, the place and the next sunrise or sunset

ON YOUR HOME SCREEN
• Widgets that show the same light at a glance
• Make today's light your wallpaper with Shortcuts

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• Your location stays on your device to compute the sun; Apple Weather receives coordinates for the forecast

Designed for iPhone, including iPhone Duo.

Weather data provided by Apple Weather.

name: SunWin Glass Orbit
description:
SunWin Glass Orbit đưa ba trò chơi giải trí vào một không gian kính với ánh sáng cyan, xanh lá và hổ phách.

Pachinko: chọn vị trí và số bóng, thả qua bảng chốt, ghi điểm theo ô rồi xem lại quỹ đạo của từng bóng.

Spanish 21: luyện tập với bộ bài 48 lá, chọn Rút Thêm hoặc Dừng. Tỷ lệ vượt 21 được tính từ bài công khai, không đọc bài úp của máy. Đây là biến thể luyện tập có luật công bố trong ứng dụng.

Hazard Dice: chọn mục tiêu từ 5 đến 9, tung hai xúc xắc và theo dõi số cơ hội cùng chuỗi kết quả. Hướng dẫn giải thích rõ từng trường hợp.

Không đăng nhập, không cá cược, không xu hoặc tiền ảo, không mua trong ứng dụng, không subscription và không quảng cáo. Điểm thành tích không thể tiêu, chuyển, mua hoặc đổi thưởng. Các trò chơi và tài nguyên được đóng gói để chạy trên thiết bị; lịch sử, ván đang chơi và cài đặt được lưu local.

Giao diện ưu tiên màn hình dọc, hỗ trợ xoay ngang trên iPhone và iPad. Ứng dụng không phát âm thanh hoặc nhạc nền. Có tùy chọn hiệu ứng, rung và nền tối hơn.

**Key Features**
- Ba game với luật giải trí rõ ràng.
- Xem lại quỹ đạo Pachinko và lịch sử tối đa 500 vòng.
- Giải thích xác suất Spanish 21 và Hazard dựa trên trạng thái chơi.
- Thành tích, cấp độ và huy hiệu trang trí lưu trên thiết bị.
- Không tài khoản, không thanh toán, không đổi thưởng.

name: Supercards: Learn Languages
description:
Supercards helps you remember new words for good. Make a deck in seconds, study a few minutes a day, and let smart spaced repetition bring every word back right before you'd forget it.

LEARN SMARTER
• Spaced repetition (FSRS) — the modern algorithm behind the best flashcard apps
• "Today's cards" shows exactly what to review; "Practice" lets you go through everything
• Two simple answers, or four buttons like classic flashcard apps
• Both directions: word → translation and translation → word

CREATE CARDS FAST
• Ready-made decks: the 500 most useful English and European Portuguese words, with examples
• Type a word — get the translation instantly with AI
• Paste a whole list or import a CSV / TSV file
• Words by topic: pick "Food", "Travel" or anything you like, and AI fills your deck
• Up to 5 real example sentences per word, with translation and voice

HEAR EVERY WORD
• Natural AI voices that sound like a native speaker
• Or free built-in iPhone voices that work offline
• Audio is saved on your phone — study anywhere

PLAY WITH YOUR WORDS
• Mix & Match — find word–translation pairs
• Audio quiz — listen and pick the meaning
• Anagram — build the word from its letters
• Type the answer — spell it yourself

AND MORE
• 20 languages: Spanish, English, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Japanese, Korean, Chinese and more
• Daily reminder and streaks to keep you going
• Backup to Files / iCloud Drive
• No account needed — your decks stay on your phone

SUPERCARDS PLUS
Translations are free for everyone. AI voices, example sentences and words by topic are part of Supercards Plus. Words and examples that other learners have already made come from our shared library — unlimited for subscribers. Try it free: every new user gets free AI tries, and the yearly plan starts with a free week.

Supercards Plus is an auto-renewable subscription (weekly, monthly or yearly). Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel any time in Settings → Apple ID → Subscriptions.

Terms of Use: https://flashcards.v23labs.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://flashcards.v23labs.com/privacy

name: Sylla English Academy
description:
Sylla English Academy est l'application mobile officielle dédiée à l'apprentissage pratique et à la maîtrise de l'anglais oral, animée par M. Sylla.

Grâce à notre méthode d'immersion orale active, développez votre fluidité et votre aisance d'expression pas à pas :

• Programme structuré de 25 leçons vidéo progressives axées sur l'anglais parlé du quotidien et du monde professionnel.
• Espace d'entraide communautaire pour poser vos questions et partager vos devoirs écrits.
• Corrections et retours vocaux personnalisés de prononciation directement par M. Sylla.
• Fiches récapitulatives et supports d'étude téléchargeables pour réviser à votre rythme.

Application réservée aux apprenants inscrits à l'académie Sylla English Academy. Connectez-vous avec vos identifiants pour accéder directement à votre parcours de formation.

name: Sylofx pro
description: Please feel free to share your thoughts on the interface, workflows, or your overall experience. Your genuine, firsthand experience is more valuable than any preconceived notions. We will carefully read, organize, and summarize your feedback, using it to guide our future improvements. While we cannot guarantee immediate changes in every instance, we will do our best to ensure that sound suggestions are addressed.

name: TagRoster: Asset Inventory
description:
TagRoster helps office admins, schools, studios, small warehouses and operations teams know exactly what they own and where it is.

IMPORT YOUR SPREADSHEET
• CSV or Excel (XLSX), with sheet selection and column mapping
• Preview new, existing, duplicate and problem rows before anything is saved
• Codes like 000123 keep their leading zeros
• Skip or update matching assets — imports are all-or-nothing

PRINT QR LABELS
• A4 and US Letter label sheets with ready-made presets
• Each label shows the asset name and code next to a crisp QR code
• QR codes contain only a random ID — never serial numbers or notes
• Preview, then print, share or save as PDF

SCAN AND AUDIT
• Scan TagRoster labels or link barcodes you already have
• Pick a location and start an audit: Found, Wrong Location, Unexpected
• Each asset counts once; repeated scans are ignored
• Leave and come back — audits resume where you stopped
• Review pending items before they become Missing
• Export a PDF summary and a detailed CSV

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
• Works offline; no account or login
• Everything is stored on your device
• Versioned backups to Files, validated before restore

TAGROSTER PRO — one-time purchase
• Unlimited assets (free version: 30 active assets)
• No ads
• Large detailed label templates and custom label sizes
• Your organization name and logo on audit reports

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: TamGo
description:
Больше не нужно звонить в кафе, чтобы узнать, что у них есть и сколько стоит, — и по три раза объяснять, куда ехать.

В TamGo меню заведений вашего города с фото и ценами: открыли, выбрали, заказали.

МЕНЮ ПЕРЕД ГЛАЗАМИ Блюда с фото, описанием и ценой. Не надо спрашивать по телефону «а что у вас есть?» и записывать цены на бумажке.

АДРЕС ОБЪЯСНЯЕТЕ ОДИН РАЗ Точка на карте, подъезд, этаж и квартира сохраняются. Курьер едет туда, где вы, а не туда, куда понял по телефону.

ЗНАЕТЕ, ГДЕ ЗАКАЗ Уведомление о каждом шаге: заведение приняло, готовит, курьер в пути. Не нужно перезванивать и спрашивать «ну что там?».

КАК УДОБНО Доставка или самовывоз. Оплата наличными курьеру или картой UZCARD и HUMO там, где заведение её принимает.

ВЕСЬ ГОРОД В ОДНОМ МЕСТЕ Найдите блюдо сразу во всех заведениях: напишите «плов» — и увидите, где он есть и почём.

Вход по номеру телефона: код придёт в SMS. TamGo работает и в Telegram — @tam_go_bot.

—

Kafelarga qo‘ng‘iroq qilib, menyu va narxlarni so‘rash shart emas. TamGo’da shahringiz muassasalarining menyusi rasmlar va narxlar bilan: tanlang, manzilni bir marta belgilang va buyurtmangiz qayerdaligini telefoningizda kuzating.

name: Tandem Palm Rally
description:
Two athletes share one turntable. Tap to flip Coral and Cyan together, line up the right colors, and send visitors flying with a foam-palm slap.

Visitors rush in from both ends of the rooftop. Every half-turn swaps which athlete faces each lane, so watch both approaches before you tap. Match Coral to the circle or Cyan to the lightning bolt when a visitor reaches the turntable.

Paint gates can change a visitor's color on the way in. Boomerang visitors return from the opposite end, and mystery sleeves hide a visitor's color until they get closer. When the pace picks up, use Slow Time for a few extra seconds to react, Palm Guard to survive a mismatch, or Color Pulse to launch matching visitors in both lanes.

- Take on 100 stages across ten illustrated rooftop courts, from a sunny lido to a rooftop observatory.
- Time your turns just before contact for Perfect bonuses and build a streak with every match.
- Earn three stars by clearing a stage without props, then replay to improve your personal best on the local trophy shelf.
- Claim daily tickets and collect sunshine tokens to earn new titles.
- Play the full campaign offline with one-touch controls and optional sound and haptics.

name: Tangivox: Keyboard & Mouse
description:
Tangivox turns your iPhone into a Bluetooth keyboard and trackpad. Pair it once with your computer, tablet or TV, the same way you pair any Bluetooth keyboard, and start typing and pointing. Nothing to install on the other device.

NOTHING TO INSTALL
• No computer app or server to set up
• No Wi-Fi network, IP address or firewall settings
• The other device simply sees a Bluetooth keyboard and mouse

Use it from the couch with a computer connected to your TV, to run a presentation, or when your mouse is missing.

TRACKPAD
• Trackpad on top, keyboard below: keep pointing while you type
• Move the pointer with one finger and tap to click
• Scroll with two fingers, tap with two fingers to right-click
• Pinch to zoom
• Touch and hold to drag, with drag lock for long moves
• Scroll with one finger on the edge strip

KEYBOARD
• Type with the iOS keyboard, including iOS dictation
• Live mode sends each key as you type; Review mode lets you check your text before sending
• Esc, Tab, arrow keys and F1–F12
• A numeric keypad for data entry
• A lock-screen key, and Ctrl+Alt+Del for Windows
• Modifier keys that stay on for one key, or lock

FULL KEYBOARD IN LANDSCAPE
• Turn your iPhone sideways for a full keyboard with F1–F12
• Real key combinations: hold ⌘ or Ctrl and press a key
• Hold the space bar to move the pointer
• Key labels match the layout you choose

VOICE TYPING
• Hold the microphone button, speak and let go: your words are typed on the other device
• Speech is turned into text on your iPhone; audio is never stored or sent
• If nothing is connected, your text waits until you send it
• Available languages depend on your iPhone and iOS version

MEDIA KEYS
• Play/pause, previous and next track, mute
• Volume up and down; hold to keep going

DECK
• A 12-button grid for the shortcuts you use most
• Edit any button: keyboard shortcuts, media keys and multi-step macros
• Templates for OBS (using F13–F24), meetings, presentations and video playback
• Export and import your deck as a file

USB RECEIVER (PRO)
• Plug a small receiver into a USB port; your iPhone types and points through it
• Works in BIOS and boot menus, on consoles and TVs, and on devices without Bluetooth
• Requires an ESP32-S3 board you set up from a computer; the app's guide shows how
• One Pro purchase activates up to 3 receivers

KEYBOARD LAYOUTS
Choose the layout your computer uses so letters and symbols come out right. English (US) is verified. English (UK), Turkish Q and Turkish F are marked "not yet verified" until they've been checked on more computers.

PRIVACY
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• The app never connects to our servers
• Bluetooth is used only between your iPhone and the device you pair it with

Tangivox PRO (OPTIONAL)
Pro is optional. The trackpad, keyboard, landscape keyboard, voice typing, media keys, all keyboard layouts and a 12-button deck page are free to use, with no time limit.
Pro is a one-time In-App Purchase. It adds:
• Unlimited deck pages and templates
• Larger grids, up to 8×8 buttons
• Custom icons
• USB receiver mode
There is no subscription. Pro can be shared with your Family Sharing group. You can also leave an optional tip; tips don't unlock anything.

WORKS WITH
Devices that accept a Bluetooth keyboard and mouse, such as a Mac, Windows PC, iPad, Android device, Linux computer or many smart TVs. Not every TV accepts one, so check your TV's manual. Tangivox doesn't replace an infrared TV remote.

ABOUT DIRECT BLUETOOTH MODE
Direct Bluetooth mode relies on how iOS handles Bluetooth today. A future iOS update could change this and stop Direct mode from working.

Support: in the app, open Settings → Contact support, or visit https://ezulabs.com/tangivox/
Privacy Policy: https://ezulabs.com/tangivox/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://ezulabs.com/tangivox/terms/
Apple's standard license agreement (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Tany App
description:
Tany brings your customers back, again and again.

No more lost paper punch cards. With Tany, every customer gets a digital loyalty card in their phone's wallet (Apple Wallet or Google Wallet), with no app to download.

How it works
• Customers scan your shop's QR code, enter their name and number, and add the card to their phone in seconds.
• At every visit, your cashier scans the card in the Tany app and adds a stamp.
• The card updates on the customer's phone right away, and they get a notification when their reward is ready.

Why Tany
• Design your card with your colors, your logo and the stamp icon you like.
• Send offers straight to your customers' Wallet cards, free, with no SMS.
• Know your customers: who is close to a reward and who hasn't been back in a while.
• Add your cashiers, each with their own account.
• Works on iPhone and iPad.
• Made for cafes, restaurants, barbers, salons, bakeries, car washes and any shop.

Start with a 14-day free trial.

Support on WhatsApp: +20 120 651 4415

name: Tap Idle Wars: Army Game
description:
Build a powerful army, conquer enemy fortresses and become a war legend in Tap Idle Wars, an idle strategy game where every tap counts!

Recruit soldiers, command artillery, defeat enemy waves and conquer the battlefield. Develop your army, master tactical unit counters and earn offline rewards as your troops continue fighting.

TAP TO BATTLE
Take command of your cannon and fire with every tap. Deal critical damage, unleash powerful Artillery Barrages and activate War Cry to destroy enemy squads. Every shot brings you closer to victory.

BUILD YOUR ARMY
Recruit 14 unique unit types, including infantry, archers, cavalry and siege engines. Build a balanced army and use strategic unit counters to deal double damage against enemy formations. Choose your troops wisely and create the ultimate fighting force.

CONQUER ENEMY FORTRESSES
Face a powerful fortress every 10 waves in challenging timed battles. Break through enemy defenses, capture the front line and collect valuable rewards. Discover weapons, armor and banners in four rarity levels, including the Eagle, Wolf, Bear and Lion equipment sets.

EARN OFFLINE REWARDS
Your army keeps fighting even when you're away. Earn gold while offline, return to collect idle rewards and use your resources to strengthen your troops. Progress through enemy waves without having to stay in the game.

UPGRADE YOUR ARMY AND GENERALS
Declare Mobilization to earn permanent War Medals and increase your damage. Unlock the Victory Parade to collect Laurels and powerful Doctrines. Recruit eight unique Generals, improve their ranks and expand your military strength as you advance.

DAILY MISSIONS AND REWARDS
Keep your army growing with daily missions, Order of the Day, login rewards, a Weekly Campaign, achievements and supply convoys arriving every four hours. There is always another objective to complete and another reward to earn.

FREE TO PLAY WAR GAME
Play for free and complete the game without mandatory purchases. Watch optional rewarded ads for extra benefits. No forced advertisements interrupt your battles. Optional in-app purchases are available to speed up your progress.

PLAY YOUR WAY
Enjoy Tap Idle Wars in 20 languages. No account is required. Sign in with Game Center to keep a cloud backup of your progress, climb the leaderboards and unlock achievements, or move your progress to a new device with a save transfer code.

Build your army, conquer every fortress and lead your troops to victory. Start your battle today!

Terms of use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy policy: https://patpatgames.com/tapidlewars/privacy.html

name: Tape & Tine
description:
Put a tape on the rack and see the score add up as you go.

Tape & Tine records whitetail measurements in eighths of an inch. Enter the main beam, normal tines, mass measurements, and extras for each antler, then add the inside spread. The gross score updates as you measure.

• See gross score, spread credit, and typical and non-typical net estimates.
• Follow illustrated guides for beams, tines, mass, spread, and extras.
• Save and revisit scorecards with a deer name, measurement date, and notes.
• Share a scorecard summary image.

Scores are field estimates. Official scoring requires an official measurer.

name: Tapeloft: 4-Track Recorder
description:
Leave something on tape.

Tapeloft is a four-track recording studio with the feel of a small tape machine: warm paper labels, tactile faders and reels that follow your music.

FREE
• Record four mono tracks, play and record together, and punch in or out.
• Adjust volume, pan, arm, mute and solo for each track.
• Layer takes with A–B loops. Use a metronome and count-in.
• Monitor through headphones, compensate recording latency and undo takes.
• Keep three tapes and export a 24-bit/48 kHz stereo WAV.

TAPELOFT PRO — ONE PURCHASE, NO SUBSCRIPTION
Shape tracks with compression, low cut, three-band EQ, drive, wow/flutter, saturation, echo and spring reverb. Add cassette or reel color, and link pitch and speed with 50–150% Varispeed. Keep unlimited tapes, export aligned WAV stems and share editable tape packages.

Export the whole tape or an A–B segment, include effect tails and optionally normalize. Import your tape packages from Files. An adaptive iPad studio works in portrait and landscape.

Recording, mixing and export work offline. No account, ads, tracking, analytics or developer uploads. Microphone permission is used only for recording. Apple handles the optional Pro purchase and restore; help links open when selected. Tapes stay on your device: export a project package before deleting the app.

Support: zz@hfyy.org

name: Tavluno
description:
Bring every dish to the table with a clearer plan.

Tavluno helps home cooks coordinate two to four dishes around a serving time. Choose a menu, select your kitchen equipment and servings, then follow a schedule that accounts for burners and hands-on work.

PLAN FOR YOUR KITCHEN
Set up one or two burners and optional oven access. Adjust meals for one to four servings and review a combined ingredient checklist before you start.

COOK WITH A CLEAR NEXT STEP
See what is cooking, what comes next and what is already finished. Start individual timers and confirm each step when you have checked the food.

ADJUST WHEN COOKING TAKES LONGER
Extend a step and review the updated serving estimate, affected tasks and work you can do next.

KEEP WHAT YOU LEARN
Save a meal photo, taste notes and a reminder for next time. Review recorded cooking times before using them in another plan.

EXPLORE COMPLETE MENUS
Try three free menus and build plans with the dish library. The optional Banquet Collection adds four themed menus with twelve dishes, preparation guidance and serving notes.

Quick Sign In remembers your profile. Optional camera, photo and microphone features help you personalize your cooking journal. Notification permission enables timer alerts.

Coin packs are available through Apple in-app purchase. Cooking times are estimates; check food and equipment throughout preparation.

name: Tavune
description:
Tavune sizes room air purification before you buy another machine.
