You describe the room — width, length and ceiling height — and pick the air-change rate you are aiming for. Tavune multiplies the three dimensions into a volume, multiplies that by the target to get the clean air delivery rate the room needs, and compares it with the units you already own. Every unit carries a CADR figure, a noise figure at its highest step, and a count.

The result is drawn to scale: a pale room rectangle with one cyan ring per installed unit, the width and length labelled, and four figures underneath — volume, required CADR, installed CADR and time to 90% clean. Change a dimension, a target or a count and the whole plan is rebuilt immediately.

name: The Butterfly File
description:
A small decision can travel farther than you expect.

Follow six connected people through thirty years of ordinary choices. Return a wallet, miss a train, leave a letter unsent, open a door or answer an unexpected call. Each of five illustrated base stories contains twelve decisions whose consequences pass between people and return years later.

FOLLOW THE CAUSE
After a decision, trace the exact events that led to its consequence. Explore an interactive network of recorded causes or switch to a readable chronological list. Select an event to inspect what happened and why.

COMPARE YOUR HISTORIES
Complete another run and compare it with a previous history. See where the paths diverged and export a poster of the connections you created.

FIVE COMPLETE BASE STORIES
All five original campaigns are included with the app. Three optional, one-time expansion purchases add four complete campaigns: Small Town, Big Consequences; Across Borders; and The Lost Connections. No subscriptions, timers, paid hints or paid decision reversals.

READ AT YOUR PACE
Original illustrations, optional gentle sound, and English and Turkish text. Supports Dynamic Type, Reduce Motion and a readable alternative to the graph. Base stories work offline. Progress stays on this device; there is no cross-device save sync.

No game account, advertisements or gameplay analytics. Optional purchases use the App Store; poster sharing is always your choice.

name: The Innovative Focus App
description:
The Innovative Focus brings your wedding memories to life. Access your event photos and films directly from your iPhone, captured by Sanjay, Pranay and the team.

FEATURES:
- Join events instantly via QR code or event code
- Browse pre-wedding and wedding photos and films in a beautiful gallery
- Download your favourite moments in full quality
- Upload your own photos to share with other guests
- Find photos of yourself with AI-powered facial recognition
- Access multiple events in one place
- Get notified when new photos are added

HOW IT WORKS:
1. Scan the QR code at your event or enter the event code
2. Browse, download, and share your event photos
3. Upload your own photos to contribute to the gallery
4. Use "My Photos" to instantly find photos featuring you

Built for clients of The Innovative Focus. Each event gallery is managed by the photographer and shared exclusively with event attendees.

Need help? Contact us at https://theinnovativefocus.com

name: The Last Light: Grid Crisis
description:
Take the emergency coordinator’s seat as a fictional coastal city loses its electricity. Keep hospital wards supplied, protect water pumps, and decide which neighborhoods can wait.

The Last Light: Grid Crisis is an offline strategy game built around a connected power network. Route limited generation through damaged cables, manage fuel and spare parts, assign three repair crews, and communicate credible schedules. A district receives power only through an available connected path.

A COMPLETE PREMIUM GAME
• Seven nights with escalating pressure, changing weather and district incidents.
• Six neighborhoods, two generation facilities, two substations and fourteen switchable connections.
• Temporary and permanent repairs, crew assignments, public trust and recovery consequences.
• Three difficulties and three alternate starting failures.
• Six recovery outcomes, a report archive and an interactive recovery timeline.
• Original city illustrations, a live miniature map and a technical blueprint view.
• Automatic local saving and deterministic replay seeds.
• English and Turkish, reduced motion, audio/haptic preferences and accessible district controls.
• All Amber, Moonlight and Copper console finishes included.

One purchase includes all base content. No ads, subscriptions, in-app purchases, paid energy or rescue items. No account is required. The full campaign works offline.

Electricity is represented by simplified abstract strategy units, not real-world engineering measurements.

name: The Netball Academy
description:
Download the official The Netball Academy app today! View course schedules, purchase packages and pay for invoices. Optimize your time and maximize the convenience from your phone. Download today!

Be sure to check out our website at: https://thenetballacademy.sg

name: The Newark Public Library
description: Access the Newark Public Library from your iPhone, iPad or iPod Touch. Manage your account, search the catalog, renew and reserve books. Borrow many ebooks and audiobooks directly from the app.

name: The Quiet Hours: Mara’s Phone
description:
Mara Bell left Alex a phone and an envelope with six digits inside. Start with a message from Ada and a photograph of a blue door. They point to a part of Mara’s life she never explained over dinner.

Explore a fictional phone full of messages, photographs, notes, saved places and radio transcripts. Important details go into your Connections notebook. Put two pieces of evidence together, answer a question in your own words and another part of the archive opens. Three discoveries lead to a final choice.

Read at your own pace. Each puzzle has gradual hints, and every recording has a transcript with optional device narration. Your progress stays on your device, so you can put the phone down and return to the same place.

The complete story plays offline. It uses a fictional archive and never reads your own messages, photos or contacts.

name: The Smooth Wave
description:
Welcome to The Smooth Wave. Great music, great memories and a few wonderful discoveries along the way.

Broadcasting from the beautiful Northern Rivers of New South Wales, Australia, The Smooth Wave brings you a carefully curated mix of smooth favourites and hidden gems from the 70s, 80s, 90s and beyond.

Enjoy timeless songs from some of the world's greatest artists, alongside a strong emphasis on Australian music, including music from local and emerging artists.

But The Smooth Wave is more than just great music. We're proudly connected to our Northern Rivers community, bringing listeners local news, community information and stories that matter to the region.

Whether you're at home, at work or on the move, The Smooth Wave is your musical companion, connecting great music with the community we call home.

What you'll enjoy:

Live streaming of The Smooth Wave.

A carefully curated mix of international and Australian music.

Music from local and emerging artists.

Local news and community updates.

Song and artist information while you listen.

Recently played tracks to help you rediscover favourite songs.

Easy access to contact the station.

The Smooth Wave is proudly part of Wave Publishing, publisher of The Ballina Wave, The Lennox Wave and The Byron Wave community magazines.

The Smooth Wave. WELCOME HOME.

name: The Things We Kept
description:
Nora Vale has until the end of July to empty the family house. Her sister has labelled three boxes KEEP and eleven GIVE AWAY. In their mother’s sewing drawer, Nora finds a book with a shopping list and four unexpected words: a room of my own.

Read Nora’s nine dated entries from the summer of 1998. Open the keepsakes between the pages and turn them over. A ferry ticket has a note on the back. A postcard has a sum in the margin. Six details let you work through three questions about the people Nora thought she knew.

Turn pages with a swipe or use the arrows and the ribbon contents. Choose simpler type or larger text. Your place, examined objects and solved threads are saved on your device. After the last thread, a letter and a final entry are yours to read and revisit.

This is a complete, short story for iPhone and iPad. It plays offline, has no timer and requires no account.

name: This Moment, with You
description:
Study, work and everyday life feel lighter with someone beside you.
A focus timer, to-dos and a calendar, with three very different companions who stay close, invite you to meals and say good night.

FOCUS TOGETHER
Pick 5, 15, 25 or 45 minutes and she quietly keeps you company. If you get distracted and go talk to her, she reminds you to get back to it. When time's up she tells you well done, and long sessions earn extra praise.

TO-DOS AND CALENDAR
Write down tasks and events, and set a reminder time. While the app is open, she lets you know when it's time. If you were away, she tells you what's due when you come back. Reopen the app the next day and she may ask: "You finished that yesterday. Did it go well?"

YOUR DAILY RHYTHM
- She says good morning and good night
- At mealtimes she asks you to eat with her, and you can pick the dish
- Log your mood each day. On tired or sad days, she adds a few words of comfort
- Turn on care reminders and she'll nudge you to drink water or stretch every 30, 45 or 60 minutes while the app is open

GETTING CLOSER
Pick a topic to talk about, give small gifts and check in every day to build your bond. She has small wishes of her own, plus a favorite gift and a favorite dish. Come back after a while away and she'll tell you she missed you.

THREE DIFFERENT PERSONALITIES
- Xia: a gentle, sweet recent college graduate
- Meiling: poised, confident and always in control
- Rena: lively, competitive, new to the working world and always up for fun
Each one talks and keeps you company in her own way.

AND MORE
- 5 scenes: morning light and night lamp from the start; rainy window, sunset and beach unlock as your bond grows
- Mini games: rock-paper-scissors, guess her mood, favorites quiz, rhythm challenge
- A collection album and a log of your memories
- No account needed. Everything is stored only on your device

All characters are adults.

ONE-TIME PURCHASE
One purchase includes every everyday feature and all outfits for Xia, Meiling and Rena, with no In-App Purchases and no ads. Some poses, scenes and topics unlock as your bond grows.

name: Thngai L'a: Khmer Calendar
description:
Thngai L'a is a Khmer lunar calendar for everyday use. See the Khmer lunar date next to the regular date, know when the next Sila day is, and never miss a Cambodian public holiday.

KHMER LUNAR CALENDAR
• The lunar date (Koeut and Roaj) and lunar month for every day, 1900 to 2100
• Buddhist Era year, animal year and era name
• Leap months and leap days handled by the traditional Chhankitek rules
• Dates checked against the official 2025, 2026 and 2027 holiday sub-decrees

SILA DAYS AND HOLIDAYS
• Sila days marked on the calendar: 8 and 15 Koeut, 8 Roaj and the last day of the month
• Public holidays: Khmer New Year, Visak Bochea, Royal Ploughing Ceremony, Pchum Ben, Water Festival, Independence Day and more
• Buddhist observances: Meak Bochea, start and end of Buddhist Lent
• Countdown to the next Sila day and the next holiday

REMINDERS
• A notification the evening before each Sila day or holiday, at the time you choose

DAY PLANNER
• Pick dates for a wedding, moving into a new home, opening a shop, travel, building work or signing a contract, using the traditional Khmer and Chinese calendar notes for each day

WIDGETS
• Today's Khmer date and moon phase on your Home Screen and Lock Screen

KHMER AND ENGLISH
• Full interface in Khmer or English, with Khmer numerals

PRIVATE
• No account, no ads, no tracking. Everything stays on your iPhone and works offline.

THNGAI L'A PLUS
A one-time purchase that adds planning 3 and 6 months ahead and every widget size. No subscription.

name: Tianji Liuyao
description:
Explore Liuyao, a traditional six-line approach to the I Ching. Start with a question, cast a hexagram, and read a line-by-line chart.

CAST AND STUDY
Use virtual coins, quick casting, or enter your own lines. Explore the 64 hexagrams, chart terminology and lessons. Basic casting, the chart and study material work without signing in.

CONTINUE WITH AI
An optional AI reading discusses your hexagram and its moving lines, with follow-up questions in the context of the same chart. Signed-in users can keep readings and use their balance across iPhone and iPad.

INSPIRATION CREDITS
A new account receives 25 credits and the first sign-in of each day adds 5. AI readings cost 8 credits and follow-ups cost 4. Optional credit packs are available, with double credits on the first purchase of each pack.

Available in English, Simplified Chinese and Spanish. For cultural study, reflection and entertainment.

name: Tidepick
seller_name: Shandong Shupai DE IP OAM Group Co., Ltd
description:
Tidepick is an anonymous drift-bottle and ocean-story app. Place a note, a photo, or a short wave of sound into a bottle and let it travel to someone you have never met. You can also pick up stories from the sea, reply in private, or join a relay and keep a tale going.

With Tidepick you can:

• Write or seal a story, then cast it into the water  
• Pick up drifting bottles, read them, and choose whether to reply  
• Join story relays with travelers you do not know  
• Wander different seas by mood and theme  
• Report harmful content or block travelers you prefer not to meet again  
• Delete your account anytime from Privacy & Interactions or your profile

Tidepick has no membership and no in-app purchases. Daily limits for picking, casting, and replying are the same for everyone, only to keep the waters calm.

name: Tikamo
description:
Tikamo keeps track of the moments that matter. Count down to a trip, birthday or personal goal. With Count up, see how much time has passed since a meaningful date. Not a stopwatch or alarm, and no ads.

• Count down to a trip, birthday or goal.
• See with Count up how much time has passed.
• Keep moments in view with widgets.
• Create a share card for a meaningful moment.
• Explore the layouts in Basic and Plus.

Basic (free)

• Up to 2 moments
• Countdown and count up
• End a count-up
• Share card and add one moment to Calendar
• A small widget for your next moment
• No ads

Tikamo Plus — €2.99 once until 2 January 2027, then €4.99

• Unlimited moments
• Twelve layouts: Ring, Day arc, Large number, Flip clock, Rocket, Moon, Plane, Path, Hourglass, Time strip, Grid and Classic
• Tap the large number to see the total number of days (tap again to switch back)
• Widgets in more sizes, on your Home and Lock Screen, with a choice of moment
• Live Activity
• Repeat every year
• Import from Calendar and birthdays from Contacts
• Share link
• iCloud sync of your moments across your Apple devices

App Store text is in Dutch and English for now. The app itself follows your iPhone language and also offers German, French, Spanish, Italian and Portuguese. No account. Without Plus, your moments stay on this device.

Publisher: Ferry Niekamp.

name: Timberel
description: Two end readings are not a measured midpoint. Keep log stations, perpendicular diameters and bark basis together before comparing Smalian and Huber volumes. Flag overlaps and follow a discrepancy back to its source. Frozen slips retain revisions. Local log photos and timed voice notes stay outside calculations and exports; drafts reopen after relaunch. Save a camera copy to Photos only by choice. Share JSON, CSV or PDF, or try local demo feedback. No automatic upload or timber valuation.

name: Tin Kitchen
description:
Tin Kitchen is a recipe notebook that stays on your phone.

Save the dishes you actually cook: a name, servings, time, a short note, and the ingredients with amounts. Open a recipe and scale it for a different number of people. Amounts show as readable fractions, so 1/2 and 3/4 stay easy to follow at the counter.

Keep a list of staples and mark what is already on hand. Run a shopping check against one recipe and see what you still need to buy. When you cook, add a short log with the date, how many servings you made, and a note for next time.

Notes cover practical kitchen reference, including how the fraction display works. Sample recipes are included so you can try scaling before you add your own.

Tin Kitchen does not need an account. Recipes, staples, and cook logs are stored only on this device. There is no nutrition scoring. Fractions are rounded to common kitchen measures.

name: Tiny Kingdoms: RTS
description:
Gather your villagers, raise your banners and send the war elephants forward. Tiny Kingdoms: RTS is a compact, touch-friendly real-time strategy game set in Southeast Asia in the late 18th century, the age of the Tay Son uprising, drawn in warm chibi pixel art and made for landscape play on iPhone and iPad.

EIGHT KINGDOMS, EIGHT WAYS TO PLAY
Pick a kingdom from the era and lead it to glory:
- Dai Viet (the Tay Son): swift marches, fire arrows and war elephants
- Gia Dinh: harbor trade, mercenaries and cannon
- Bac Ha: strong walls and hardy defenders
- Qing: massed infantry and banner cavalry
- Siam: elephants from the very first minutes
- Burma: siege engines and conquest
- Khmer: rice harvests, floods and temple towers
- Lan Xang: forest ambushes and mountain mist
Every kingdom has its own units, buildings and a special mechanic, so each match feels different.

BUILD, GROW, COMMAND
- Gather food, wood and gold, build houses, farms and barracks, and train your army.
- Command with simple touch controls: tap to select, use area select, double-tap to jump to a squad, and group your soldiers into quick squads.
- Helpful automation: idle villagers can work on their own, units can train continuously, and an optional steward assistant can manage your economy.

ELEPHANTS, GUNPOWDER AND WONDERS
- Lead your forces through three ages: Uprising, Contest of Heroes and Gunpowder.
- Trample enemy lines with war elephants, ride out with cavalry, unleash fire weapons, muskets and cannon, and break walls with siege engines.
- Raise a unique wonder for your kingdom and enjoy its in-match bonus.
- Rivers rise in the flood season and reshape the battlefield.

PLAY YOUR WAY
- Skirmish against 1 to 7 computer opponents with three difficulty levels, several map sizes, free-for-all or team modes, and optional fog of war.
- Play offline. Skirmish matches, saving and loading need no internet connection.
- Challenge friends and other players in online matches by creating or joining a room with a short code (internet connection required). If you lose connection, the computer can play on for you so your army is not left idle.
- Learn the ropes with the built-in guide and tips.

No ads. No in-app purchases. Support: https://tinykingdoms.flower.io.vn/support

name: Titan SSH
description:
Titan is a native SSH client for iPhone and iPad, built so you can tap instead of wrestling with arrow keys.

• Full terminal: tap the line to move the cursor, drag to scrub it, pinch to resize the font.
• Multiple sessions, automatic reconnect when you switch from wifi to cellular, mouse and windows on iPad.
• SFTP: browse, edit, move, copy and change permissions, with a transfer queue.
• Port forwarding (local, remote and SOCKS) and SOCKS5/HTTP proxy.
• Keys: generate ed25519, install them on the server from the app, or import your own.
• Command snippets with variables, history and autocomplete.
• Two addresses per server (home and away): Titan tries both.
• Performance dashboard: CPU, memory, disk, temperature.
• Privacy: passwords and keys in the Keychain behind Face ID; no accounts, no ads, no analytics. Optional iCloud sync and encrypted backups.

Titan works with any server that has SSH running (for example, openssh-server on Linux). Nothing else needs to be installed on it.

name: Together Storytimes
description:
Together Storytime is a shelf of picture books for little ones, read aloud at bedtime in a voice they love: the narrator's, or yours.

RECORD YOURSELF READING
Tap the microphone on any page and read it in your own words and your own voice. Tonight, or any night you're away, your child hears you turn the pages.

READ TO ME
A calm narrator reads each page slowly, and every word lights up as it's spoken, so early readers can follow along.

REAL PICTURE BOOKS
Full-screen illustrations, one page at a time, with the words in a steady caption box. Pages curl like paper when you turn them, by swipe or by themselves.

MADE FOR SLEEPY TIME
A soft lullaby plays underneath, the screen stays dark and calm, and reading carries on even after the screen locks.

START FREE
One book is free to keep, forever, and works offline. Storytime Plus unlocks every book on the shelf, with new titles added regularly. No ads.

Made by a small team at Marque Venture for our own kids, and for yours.

STORYTIME PLUS
Storytime Plus is an auto-renewing subscription: $4.99 per month or $29.99 per year (US prices; prices vary by country). Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.
Terms of Use: https://together.marqueventure.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://together.marqueventure.com/privacy

name: Tola: Calorie Tracker
description:
Tola does one thing, counting calories, and it is the fastest calorie counter you can get.

ULTRAFAST
- In our tests, search answers each letter you type in about 1.7 ms, from the food stored on your device.
- A food you ate before is one tap. Today suggests the foods you usually eat at this time, and your usual meal logs in one tap.
- Scan a barcode to log a packaged food.
- Each food remembers your last amount and unit.

ONE JOB, DONE WELL
- Today shows the calories you have left or are over, your protein, carbs and fat, and each meal's total in one row.
- The week line shows each day against your goal: green in your goal, yellow a little over, red over. Swipe it to see an earlier week or plan the next one.
- Insights shows calories, meal times and top foods by week, month and year.
- Make your own foods and recipes. Nine more nutrients, such as fibre and sodium, can be shown.
- No feeds, no badges, no coaching. Reminders stay off until you turn them on.

NO ADS, NO DATA COLLECTED
- No ads, no account, no tracking and no analytics. Tola has no server.
- Your log stays on your device. With iCloud sync on, it is also kept in your own private iCloud, which only you can read.
- With your permission, Tola writes what you log to Apple Health. It reads nothing from it.
- Export your whole log as a CSV file at any time.

WORKS OFFLINE
- More than 7,000 foods and 100,000 packaged products are on your device. Search and logging need no network.

NO AI GUESSING
- Tola does not guess calories from a photo. Values come from food data and product labels, and you choose the amount.

FOOD FROM MORE THAN 80 COUNTRIES
- More than 1,600 Indian dishes: South Indian, Gujarati, Punjabi, Bengali, Maharashtrian, Rajasthani, Goan, Parsi, Kashmiri and Indo-Chinese cooking, and street food from chaat to momos.
- Mexican, Chinese, Japanese, Italian, Korean, Thai, Middle Eastern, African and American dishes, and many more.
- Foods come with the amounts people eat: a katori of dal, one idli, three tacos, a bowl of pho.

ALMOST 2,000 FOOD ICONS
- Every food has an icon, made for Tola, so you can spot it in a list.

ON IPHONE, IPAD AND IPHONE DUO
- Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets with one-tap log buttons, a Live Activity and Control Center controls.
- On iPad and an open iPhone Duo, your day and your food sit side by side.
- Tola is in 10 languages: English, German, Spanish, French, Portuguese, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Hindi and Chinese.

WHY THE NAME TOLA
- A tola is a traditional South Asian unit of weight, about 11.66 g, still used for gold.

Tola is free, with every feature: no subscription and nothing to unlock. Calorie and nutrient values come from food databases and product labels and can differ from the food you eat. Tola is not medical advice and does not replace a doctor or dietitian.

Food data: USDA FoodData Central, including Branded Foods (public domain), and recipes computed from them; a few rare foods are estimates. Barcodes not in the bundled set are looked up at Open Food Facts (Open Database Licence).

name: Tooich: Luyện thi TOEIC
description:
Tooich giúp bạn luyện thi TOEIC® mỗi ngày, mỗi lần chỉ vài phút, ngay trên điện thoại.

LUYỆN ĐỀ
• Làm đề minh hoạ đủ 7 Part hoặc luyện riêng từng Part, có audio Listening
• Chấm điểm ngay, xem đáp án và giải thích từng câu
• Lưu tiến độ, làm tiếp đúng câu đang dở

TỪ VỰNG
• Flashcard, trắc nghiệm, gõ từ, nghe – chọn
• Ôn lại đúng lúc sắp quên
• Lộ trình từ vựng theo chủ đề, bộ từ cộng đồng
• Trò chơi từ vựng ngắn

NGỮ PHÁP
• Too giảng bài trên bảng, có giọng đọc
• Bài tập ngay sau mỗi bài

NGHE – NÓI
• Chép chính tả: nghe rồi gõ lại
• Shadowing: nói theo giọng mẫu, chấm phát âm
• Tình huống: phim ngắn, học từ trong ngữ cảnh

ĐỘNG LỰC MỖI NGÀY
• Chuỗi ngày học, bảng xếp hạng tuần
• Kết bạn và thi đấu cùng bạn bè

Đề trong Tooich là đề minh hoạ do Tooich biên soạn.
TOEIC® là nhãn hiệu đã đăng ký của ETS. Tooich không liên kết, không được ETS xác nhận hay tài trợ.

Điều khoản: https://tooich.com/dieu-khoan
Liên hệ: khanh@tooich.com

name: Tools PDF
description:
PDF Tools brings everyday PDF tasks together in one simple app, and all processing happens on your iPhone. No account, no uploads, no ads.

Tools • Merge files: combine several PDFs and images (JPG, PNG, and HEIC) into one file. • Organize pages: drag pages to reorder them, rotate or delete them, with undo and redo. • Images to PDF: turn images from your photo library or the Files app into a PDF. • PDF to images: turn each page into an image and save it to Photos or Files. • Protect PDF: add a password to your file. • Unlock PDF: save an unprotected copy using the current password.

Your files • Finished files appear under “Your files”, each with a thumbnail. • Preview, share, delete, or process any file again. • Every operation creates a new file and leaves the original unchanged.

Your privacy • All processing happens on your device. • We never see your files and we collect no data. • The app never stores passwords.

In Arabic and English, with Dark Mode support.

name: Torora
description:
Enter the track width and the finished drop, choose a fullness and a panel count, then describe the fabric on the roll: usable width, pattern repeat and price per metre. Torora widens the track by the fullness, divides it into panels, works out how many roll widths each panel needs, adds 25 cm for heading and hem, and rounds the cut up to a whole pattern repeat. The answer is a real order: cut length per drop, metres to buy, total cost, leftover width per panel, and the share of fabric lost to pattern matching.

The window is drawn to scale while you type: the track as a terracotta bar, one cream panel per drop, three fold lines for the pleats, and width and drop labels in centimetres. Every change to a dimension, a roll width, a repeat or a price rebuilds the cutting list immediately.

name: TorqueMate Pro
description: TorqueMate helps technicians calculate bolt torque with the T=K×F×d formula, browse fastener specs, track tightening jobs, and export PDF reports offline.

name: Toucanet Blockade
description:
Toucanet Blockade is a strategy board game for two, played on a 7x7 board. Each side has a single sphere. Move, seal off squares, and trap your opponent so they have nowhere left to go. The last player able to move wins.

HOW IT WORKS
Every turn has two steps. First, move your sphere one square in any direction. Then place a block on any empty square on the board. Blocks are permanent, so the open space shrinks with every turn. Be careful: if your own block leaves you with no legal move, you lose on the spot.

THE RULES AT A GLANCE
- A 7x7 board, one sphere per side. Black always moves first
- Move your sphere exactly one square per turn, horizontally, vertically, or diagonally
- You cannot move onto a block or onto your opponent's sphere
- After moving, place a block on any empty square, anywhere on the board
- If your opponent has no legal move after your turn, you win
- If you leave yourself with no legal move, you lose immediately

PLAY YOUR WAY
- No account needed: play vs AI and Pass & Play right away, and browse the leaderboard
- Play vs AI: four levels, from Easy to Master, with no clock and no pressure
- Pass & Play: two players, one device
- Online: invite a friend with a shareable code, or find a match from the queue. Moves sync live and every game is server-verified
- Timed games: choose 3, 5, 10, or 20 minutes per player
- Offer a draw, resign, or ask for a rematch in online games
- Flip the board to play from whichever side feels natural

COMPETE
- Sign in to play online and climb the weekly leaderboard. It ranks players by net points (wins minus losses) and resets every Monday
- Track your wins, losses, and draws on your profile
- Pick your own avatar and display name

FAIR AND FRIENDLY
- Report or block any player in one tap, and we review every report
- Delete your account and data at any time from your profile
- The Privacy Policy and Terms of Service are available inside the app, in your language

DESIGNED FOR QUICK SESSIONS OR DEEP PLAY
- A built-in How to Play guide teaches the rules in a minute
- Clean, focused design with optional sound and haptic feedback
- Available in English, Turkish, Spanish, German, Arabic, and Chinese
- Sign in securely with Google or Apple

Easy to learn, hard to master. Challenge the AI, a friend, or players online, and see who traps whom.

name: Toucs Biz
description:
O Toucs Biz é o app de quem atende com hora marcada: barbearia, salão de beleza, estética, manicure, clínica, studio e consultório.

Com ele você cuida do seu negócio pelo celular:

• Agenda do dia, da semana e do mês, por profissional
• Bloqueios de horário: folgas, almoço e períodos sem atendimento
• Cadastro de clientes com histórico de atendimentos
• Conversas do WhatsApp num lugar só: o bot marca os horários, lembra quem vai vir e passa pra você o que precisa de gente
• Vendas, comissões e relatórios do seu negócio
• Página de agendamento online pra seus clientes marcarem sozinhos
• Notificações de novos agendamentos e mensagens

Os dados ficam na sua conta Toucs e são os mesmos do painel web.

Toucs é operado pela Kôoda LTDA.

name: TraditionalSnacks
description:
中华传统小吃 —— 认得它，才吃得到它的讲究

六十道各地传统小吃，一本吃的杂志：每道配真实照片、做法与来历。

【怎么用】

• 今日：一道当令的吃食，讲它的来路
• 小吃：按分类、地域、节令、难度与关键字翻
• 典故：六十道小吃的来历，排成一条时间线
• 我的：收藏、做过记录与设置

【里面有什么】

60 道各地传统小吃，分面点包饺、饺子馄饨、粽与糕团、煎炸烙烤、汤羹粥饮、
粉面饭食、卤味烧腊、甜点糖果八类；水土覆盖华北、华东、华南、西南、华中、西北、
港澳台七处；节令上有春节、元宵、清明、立春、立夏、端午、七夕、中秋、重阳、冬至、
腊八与日常。

每道都配一张真实照片，标了难度、耗时、产量、时节与温凉，并写清用料、步骤、要点，
以及这道东西的来历 —— 正文、典籍出处、民间传说三段分开摆，传说与史实不混。
全库合计：128 组用料、290 个做法步骤（每一步都带要点，其中 103 步带计时）。

【特色功能】

• 今日一则 —— 每天给出一道当令的吃食，那张满幅封面与下面的导读是同一道。
  轮换有规则：八大类轮流，类内当令优先，八天里八个不同的吃法类型。
  节气与农历的推算全在本机完成，断网也准。

• 典故时间线 —— 六十道按年代摊开，一条线看完一道吃食的来路；
  民间传说与文献出处分开摆，不混着说。

• 做起来 —— 把当前这一步放到最大，要点顶到眼前，需要计时的直接给倒计时
  （开始 / 暂停 / 继续 / 重来四态）。走到最后一步的「做完了」＝ 这道真做过了，
  会顺手记进「我的 → 做过」。

• 节令尺 —— 二十四节气与农历节日排成一张尺，眼下是哪个节、离下一个还有几天。

• 收藏与做过 —— 收藏这道、记过几次，都存在自己的手机里，不上传。

【素材说明】

120 张照片（60 道各一张竖版与一张横版）全是真实实拍，来自维基共享资源等开放版权图库，
可商用，随 App 一起打包，不在运行时从网络获取。每一张的作者、许可协议与原始出处，
逐张列在「我的 → 图片来源与授权」页。

小吃文字全部原创编写。本 App 不打包任何受版权保护的第三方字体、音频或视频素材；
App 图标是写实生成的原创图片，非第三方素材。

【隐私】

不登录、没有账号、没有任何权限请求。
你收藏的小吃、记录做过几次，都只存在这台设备上，卸载即随之消失。
农历与节气的推算也在本机完成。不接入第三方 SDK，不含广告与用户行为统计代码，
不收集任何类别的用户数据。

联网只有一类，全部指向开发者自建服务器：首启时发一条安装来源统计，用来判断这次安装
归属哪个推广渠道。请求里只有一个随机设备标识与设备参数，不含姓名、邮箱、电话、位置、
照片，也不含剪贴板内容；除此之外全程离线。意见反馈由你自己写、自己发出，
App 不代发、不上传、不留存。

【适合谁】

想在家做点有讲究的中式点心的人；想弄明白一道传统吃食到底怎么来的人；
在异乡想找「那口熟悉的味道」的人。

版本 1.0

name: Train Runaway: Copper Express
description:
Mira never meant to miss the train. But it was already leaving, so she jumped onto the roof!

In Train Runaway you sprint across the roof of a speeding copper steam train, leaping from wagon to wagon to reach the locomotive. The train's iron Warden is hot on your heels. Every level has a finish line: reach the locomotive, clear the level, unlock new lines.

100 LEVELS, 5 REGIONS, BRANCH LINES
• Crimson Canyons, Northern Mountains, Green Valleys, Stormy Shores and the Industrial Zone
• Branch lines splitting off at junctions on the map: 5 tough bonus levels in every region
• Night runs: race under the stars in the glow of the headlamp
• Downpours and lightning: wet, slippery roofs; sandstorms and blizzards

HOOK AND ACROBATICS
When the ring on the signal gantry glows, fire your hook and swing over the obstacles. Swing from pole to pole, leap onto the side train, slide under the mail cranes. Extend your hook in the Workshop and put on the Glider Cape to soar over chasms.

BOSS MOMENTS
• Zeppelin attack: as bombs rain from the sky, hook onto the anchor rope and bring the zeppelin down
• Warden Hunter: stop the robot chasing you across the roof by pulling cargo levers and uncoupling wagons
• Seized wagons and slow side trains: don't fall behind, find your way through
• Final level: the big showdown with the Warden, face to face on the same train

FUGITIVE COMPANIONS
Rescue the fugitives locked in cages. The Scout marks the danger ahead, and the Thief grabs coins for you.

A NEW RUN EVERY DAY
• Daily Run: the same track for everyone, and the longer your streak, the bigger the reward
• Weekly Tournament: set your best score on the week's track, climb the leaderboard and win gems based on your rank
• Ghost race: race your own best run or a friend's ghost (friend code)
• Missions, achievements, combos and the Steam gauge

GROW YOUR TRAIN
Use the parts you collect to add new wagons to your train, each one giving you a new power. Collect regional postcards and the pages of the story.

FAIR CHALLENGE
Levels get harder step by step, and every new obstacle is introduced on its own. You win by skill, not luck. Scrape a side and you stumble; hit something head-on and you fall off the train.

SIMPLE CONTROLS
Swipe left/right: change lanes. Swipe up: jump or throw the hook. Swipe down: slide.

No ads. No purchases. Playable offline; online leaderboards and ghost races require an internet connection.

name: TraitAlign
description:
Explore your personality, understand your connections, and discover meaningful ways to communicate through personal assessments, compatibility comparisons, and conversation activities.

PERSONALITY ASSESSMENTS

Explore your personality traits, communication preferences, relationship values, emotional patterns, conflict styles, and lifestyle interests.

Complete assessments at your own pace, view detailed results, and revisit your personal insights whenever you like.

COMPATIBILITY & CONNECTIONS

Create personal profiles, add photos, and compare completed assessments between two people.

Discover shared values, personality differences, communication tendencies, and areas for meaningful conversation.

Compatibility scores are calculated on your device using assessment responses. They are not generated or changed by AI.

PERSONALITY RESULTS

Explore visual charts, trait breakdowns, personal strengths, and practical suggestions based on your assessment results.

Save your results and review previous compatibility reports.

CONVERSATION CARDS

Enjoy themed question cards designed for friends, partners, and family.

Explore thoughtful questions, discover shared interests, save favorite cards, and find new ways to connect.

OPTIONAL AI INSIGHTS WITH OPENAI

Optional AI features use OpenAI's API to provide personalized explanations, relationship insights, conversation suggestions, and AI chat responses.

Before any personal information is shared with OpenAI, you will be shown an AI consent screen explaining what information may be sent, who receives it, and why.

If you choose to allow AI processing, selected assessment responses, personality and compatibility scores, relevant preferences, and the text and conversation context you choose to use with AI may be sent to OpenAI to generate the requested results.

AI features require an internet connection. You can decline AI processing or withdraw your permission at any time in Settings > AI & Privacy.

Your imported profile photos are not sent to OpenAI for analysis.

OFFLINE FEATURES & PRIVACY

Personality assessments, on-device compatibility calculations, basic reports, and built-in conversation cards remain available without AI permission.

Your offline compatibility results are clearly identified as calculated on your device. AI-generated explanations are displayed separately and labeled accordingly.

You control your personal profiles, imported photos, saved reports, and local data.

FOR PERSONAL EXPLORATION

Personality and compatibility results are designed for self-reflection, communication, and entertainment. They are not clinical assessments and do not predict the success of a relationship.

Explore your personality and connections at your own pace.

• Terms of Service: https://sites.google.com/view/rvc211095/term
• Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/rvc211095/privacy

name: Trelia - fun
description:
A few arrows. Three possible trails. Which one belongs to your lunar rover?

Trelia turns a quiet moon expedition into a small matching puzzle. Read a sequence of straight, left and right directions, swipe through three illustrated route cards, then choose the matching trail. A wrong turn highlights the first difference so you can look again. There is no timer or limit on retries.

Made for casual puzzle players and model-rover enthusiasts, Trelia pairs short challenges with a personal expedition notebook:

- Explore 12 built-in trails, save favorites and return to unfinished puzzles.
- Create your own trails with three to five directions, preview their wheel tracks and play them whenever you like.
- Keep field notes about model rovers or paper routes, with photos, captions and an optional link to a trail.
- Crop and arrange your note photos, then browse them in a full-screen gallery.

Soft cartoon artwork and a paper-style interface give each little route room to breathe. Play offline without an account. Saved progress, custom trails and field notes stay on your device.

Take a closer look, follow the turns and find your next trail.

name: TripSpeak: Travel Phrasebook
description:
TripSpeak is the travel phrases app that gets you speaking before you land. Order food, check in, ask for directions and get help in the local language, with 10-minute lessons that work offline.

Whether it's a weekend in Rome or two weeks in Tokyo, you'll know what to say in the moments that matter, and you'll have a phrasebook in your pocket when you need it.

Speak Confidently on Day One
You learn the exact sentences a trip needs, so you never freeze at the counter.
• Lessons built around real moments: greetings, restaurant & café, transport, hotel, directions, money, shopping, pharmacy & emergencies and small talk
• Polite and casual versions, plus male/female forms where they matter
• Role-play dialogues with locals, so the real conversation feels familiar

Sound Natural, Not Like a Textbook
Locals understand you the first time, because you practise how it really sounds.
• Hear every phrase at normal and slow speed
• Easy pronunciation guides you can read out loud right away
• Speaking practice with instant feedback from on-device speech recognition

Remember What You Learn
Phrases stay with you until the trip, without cramming.
• Smart review (spaced repetition) brings each phrase back right before you forget it
• Listen-and-choose and build-the-sentence exercises
• Daily goal, streaks and a countdown to your travel date

Get Help Offline, Anywhere
No Wi-Fi at the airport or roaming abroad? TripSpeak still works.
• Offline phrasebook you can search by meaning
• Show cards: big, bright text to show a waiter, driver or pharmacist
• Fill-in templates like "I'd like ___, please" or "Where is ___?"
• Point your camera at a menu or a sign to read it on your phone

A Plan Made for Your Trip
Spend your time on what you'll actually use first.
• Set your travel date and get a plan that puts the most useful situations first
• Culture tips for each country: tipping, greetings and etiquette
• Dark mode and optional cloud backup across devices

22 Destinations, One App
Spanish, Italian, French, German, Japanese, English, Portuguese, Greek, Turkish, Korean, Thai, Chinese (Mandarin), Dutch, Croatian, Czech, Polish, Vietnamese, Indonesian, Arabic, Russian, Swedish and Hindi. The app is available in 35 languages; meanings and pronunciation guides are shown in English, Turkish, German or Spanish.

Free to Start
Greetings and Restaurant are free for every destination. Unlock one destination for good with a Trip Pass, or choose TripSpeak Pro for all 22, speaking practice and cloud backup.

Pack TripSpeak with your passport and start speaking before you land. Bon voyage, buon viaggio, gute Reise.

Terms of use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy policy: https://bytelunalabs.com/tripspeak/privacy.html

name: Trove: Smart File Organizer
description:
Stop wasting time hunting through chaotic Downloads, cluttered Desktops, and cryptic PDF filenames. Trove turns messy folders into clean, color-coded workspaces in seconds - 100% offline on your iPhone, iPad, and Mac.

Every scan, document title check, Vision OCR pass, and duplicate comparison runs locally on your Apple silicon device. Your tax invoices, contracts, IDs, and personal photos never leave your device and never touch a cloud server.

WHY THOUSANDS OF APPLE USERS LOVE TROVE

- Preview Every Move First: Nothing ever moves in the dark. Compare the interactive Before and After preview, uncheck any file you want to skip, and approve with total confidence.
- Color, Tag & Icon Every Folder: Make organized folders pop instantly in Apple Files and macOS Finder with custom colors, native Finder/Files tag labels, and crisp embossed symbols.
- Sweep Away Empty Folders: Automatically remove leftover empty directories and subfolders emptied during cleanup so every workspace feels genuinely spotless.
- 1-Tap Full Undo: Changed your mind? Every cleanup is saved in your local Undo History so a single tap restores every moved file, tag, and folder back to its exact original spot.
- Blazing Swift 6 Speed: Scans and classifies 1,000+ loose files in under 400 milliseconds with silky 120Hz responsiveness.

8 SMART CATEGORIES + DETAILED SUBFOLDERS

Trove automatically organizes loose files into intuitive folders and smart 2nd-level subfolders:
1. Invoices & Receipts (Invoices, Receipts, Statements)
2. Contracts & Legal
3. IDs & Official
4. Screenshots (Captures, Recordings)
5. Photos & Media (Images, RAW, Videos, Voice, Audio)
6. Archives (Compressed, Installers)
7. Code & Dev (Source, Data & Configs, Fonts)
8. Documents (PDFs, Spreadsheets, Presentations, Notes)

AUTO-NAME RECEIPTS & SCANNED PDFS ON DEVICE

Tired of opening IMG_8841.pdf or Scan_0042.pdf just to see what is inside? Trove reads PDF first pages and runs Apple Vision OCR locally to detect dates, document types, and sender names, renaming messy files into clean, searchable names like 2026-11-18_Invoice_Amazon.pdf with automatic collision protection.

RECLAIM GIGABYTES OF DUPLICATE STORAGE

Find byte-identical copies eating up space across Downloads and project folders. Trove verifies exact SHA-256 matches while keeping under 30MB of memory usage, safely moving redundant copies aside while protecting your original file.

BUILT FOR MAC, IPAD & IPHONE

- Drag and drop any folder on Mac and iPad, or pick any folder in Apple Files on iPhone.
- Automate recurring cleanups and batch renames with native Apple Shortcuts and Siri actions.
- Crafted in the Vibrant Teal design system with live System, Light, and Dark modes plus instant switching across 15 native languages (including full Right-to-Left Arabic).

START FREE OR UNLOCK UNIVERSAL TROVE PRO

Start free with unlimited scans, full Before and After previews, empty folder cleanup, 1-tap Undo, and batches up to 25 files per cleanup. Upgrade to Trove Pro (Monthly, high-value Annual, or One-Time Lifetime purchase - all with Family Sharing across iPhone, iPad, and Mac) to unlock unlimited files per cleanup, custom folder colors/tags/icons on disk, smart OCR receipt naming, duplicate cleanup, and Apple Shortcuts automation.

PRIVACY & LEGAL

- 100% On-Device Processing: Zero cloud uploads, zero accounts, zero tracking.
- Subscriptions auto-renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period in Apple Account Settings. Lifetime is a single one-time purchase.
- Terms of Use (EULA): https://majidaljishi.com/en/projects/trove/terms
- Privacy Policy: https://majidaljishi.com/en/projects/trove/privacy

name: Truce: Chess Logic Puzzle
description:
Truce is a calm, clever logic puzzle built from chess pieces.

Your job is simple to say and fun to solve: place every piece on the board so that no piece attacks another. There are no opponents, no timers that rush you and no ads in the way. Just you, the board and a satisfying “click” when everything fits.

WHAT MAKES TRUCE DIFFERENT
• Clue tiles: a number on the board tells you exactly how many of your pieces must attack that square. Every level is solved by logic, not guessing.
• Walls stop the queen, rook and bishop, while the knight jumps over them.
• Shields let a piece survive one attack, so you decide which piece takes the hit.
• Flags must be guarded, and water squares can’t hold a piece.
• The Impostor: one masked piece is secretly a king, queen, rook, bishop or knight. Read the clues, name it, and watch it unmask.

FEATURES
• 120 levels in 6 chapters, from First Moves to The Impostor
• Every level has exactly one solution, checked by our puzzle solver
• A new Daily Truce every day, with streaks and streak freezes
• Drag a piece over the board to preview it before you drop it: see what it would attack, which clues it would meet, and whether anyone would be under attack
• Lifelines when you’re stuck: Reveal shows the right square, Scan lights up every attacked square
• Undo, reset and a 3-star score for solving without help and under par
• Six board themes and five piece sets, in flat 2D or sculpted 3D
• Your profile: pick a name and avatar and follow your stats: stars, streaks, perfect solves and Impostors unmasked
• Works offline, no account, no sign-up. Your profile and progress stay on your phone
• High Contrast theme, and VoiceOver labels on every square and button

You don’t need to be a chess player. The Piece Guide shows how every piece moves, and the first chapter teaches them one at a time.

name: Tsp 슬라이딩 퍼즐
description:
TSP 슬라이딩 퍼즐은 흩어진 그림 조각을 움직여 원본 이미지를 완성하는 15 퍼즐 게임입니다.

아름다운 풍경과 다양한 그림으로 구성된 100개의 퍼즐에 도전해 보세요. 한 판을 완성하면 다음 퍼즐이 열리며, 완료 기록은 자동으로 저장됩니다.

주요 기능

• 100개의 다양한 그림 퍼즐
• 간단한 터치 방식의 조각 이동
• 원본 그림 미리보기
• 막혔을 때 확인할 수 있는 AI 풀이 미리보기
• 이동 횟수와 플레이 시간 기록
• 퍼즐 완료 진행률 자동 저장
• iPhone 및 iPad 가로·세로 화면 지원
• 귀여운 고양이 응원 캐릭터

조각을 하나씩 움직이며 그림이 완성되는 즐거움을 느껴보세요. 짧은 휴식 시간에도 부담 없이 즐길 수 있고, 집중력과 공간 감각을 활용해 차근차근 모든 퍼즐을 완성할 수 있습니다.

name: Tutor Pages
description:
Tutor Pages keeps a teaching notebook on this iPhone. Students sit on a two-column roster. Each subject stores an hourly rate and a default length. A new lesson copies those numbers, and you can change them before saving. The charge is minutes divided by 60, times the hourly rate stored on that lesson. A later change to the subject does not rewrite old lessons. Cancelled lessons add zero. Makeup lessons use the same multiplication as a held lesson.

The Week tab is seven sideways pages, Monday through Sunday. Swipe between days or jump with the dots. The Balance tab lists active students, largest unpaid amount first. Only held and makeup lessons that are not marked paid are included. The month sheet counts held, cancelled, and makeup lessons in a calendar month and adds the minutes that were not cancelled. A separate list shows cancellations and makeups so they are not lost in the full history.

The package quote multiplies one lesson by a count and then applies a percent discount. Those figures are not saved and are not an invoice. Tutor Pages does not take a payment, message a parent, file a tax form, or sync a calendar. Share on the balance screen only opens the system sheet with the text you already stored. Restore sample replaces the file with piano and algebra, four students, and a week of lessons dated from this Monday, including one cancellation and one makeup.

name: Tutorly: Study Any Video
description:
Stop just watching. Start knowing.

Tutorly turns any YouTube lesson into a study kit: the lecture you were going to "watch later", the crash course before your exam, the tutorial you half-remember.

HOW IT WORKS
• Paste a link. Lectures, tutorials, crash courses, anything with someone explaining something.
• Get the notes. A 3-line TL;DR, chapters with timestamps, key concepts and what the video assumes you already know.
• Quiz yourself. Multiple-choice questions with an explanation for every answer, and a jump back to the moment in the video.
• Swipe your flashcards. Tap to flip, swipe right if you knew it, left if you didn't. Cards come back right before you'd forget them.
• Make a plan. Pick your exam date and how many minutes you have a day. Tutorly splits the video into daily tasks and rebalances if you miss a day.
• Ask the video. Questions are answered from what's actually said in it, with timestamps.

KEEP IT
• Streaks with automatic freezes, a 16-week heatmap and your weak spots.
• One puzzle a day from your older videos, answered right from the notification.
• Widgets for your streak, due cards and today's puzzle.

ON EVERY SCREEN
iPhone, iPad and Mac, synced through your own iCloud. On iPad and Mac the video plays beside your notes, and the chapter you're watching lights up. On iPhone Duo it opens into a two-page notebook.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads, no tracking, and no servers of ours.
• Notes, quizzes and flashcards are made on your device with Apple Intelligence where available, or Tutorly's built-in engine.
• Deleted kits wait in Recently deleted for 30 days.

PRICING
Free: 3 study kits, then 1 new kit every week, with unlimited reviews, quizzes, streaks and puzzles for every kit you have.
Tutorly Pro: unlimited kits, study plans, Ask the video and weak-spot drills. $3.99 a month or $24.99 a year, both with a 7-day free trial, or $39.99 once for lifetime. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period; manage them in your Apple account settings.

Tutorly is not affiliated with or endorsed by YouTube or Google.

Privacy Policy: https://www.dashovia.com/apps/tutorly/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Tyrora
description:
Tyrora turns a measured vessel into a candle recipe.

Enter the volume and the inside diameter, set a fill, then choose the wax family, the fragrance load, a wick series and a wick count. Tyrora multiplies the volume by the fill to get the wax volume, converts millilitres to grams with the wax density, adds fragrance as a percentage of wax weight, and scales everything to the batch: wax to weigh, fragrance to drop, jars and wicks to buy, total cost and cost per candle. At the same time it divides the vessel diameter between the wicks, matches that share against the wick's coverage, and estimates burn hours from the wick's hourly wax draw.

The vessel is drawn to scale while you type: a glass jar with a cream wax surface, one to three wicks, and volume and diameter labels. Every change to a volume, a fill, a wax, a wick or a batch rebuilds the recipe immediately.

name: Ultimate Sports Trivia Board
description:
Ultimate Sports Trivia is a sports trivia board game, presented by FantasyDailies.com.

Roll the dice, move around a 28-space stadium board and answer questions on pro football, basketball, baseball and hockey. Win a ring in all four leagues, then beat the Championship to take the title.

THE BOARD GAME
• Roll and pick your direction around the stadium
• Get 3 right in a league, or land on a ring space and nail a hard question, to earn that league's ring
• Who Am I? spaces, Roll Again spaces and Injury spaces keep every game different
• Play against bots (Rookie, Pro or Legend) or pass-and-play with 2 to 4 friends on one device

CLUTCH MOMENTS
• Two-Minute Drill: drive the length of the field. Run, pass or go deep, but the bomb can get picked off
• Bottom of the Ninth: down to your last three outs
• Buzzer Beater: one minute left, erase the deficit
• Third Period: tie it, then win it
• Who Am I?: guess the player from clues, the fewer clues the more points
• 60-Second Blitz: as many right answers as you can in a minute
• Daily Challenge: the same 10 questions for everyone, every day

6,000+ QUESTIONS
Thousands of questions from FantasyDailies.com and the FantasyDailies team trivia books, graded easy, medium and hard, covering players, teams, records, history and great moments.

FREE AND PRIVATE
No account, no ads, no in-app purchases. Your progress stays on your device. No personal data is collected.

Questions or feedback: support@fantasydailies.com

Ultimate Sports Trivia is an independent game. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by any league, team or player.

name: Ulvora
description: Measure a rectangular or cylindrical mold, enter a ratio from the resin label, and get the amount for each part before mixing. Ulvora also adds an adjustable waste allowance, divides the batch into equal layers, estimates whole kits, and keeps your notes with a reusable plan.

name: Unroll: Digicam to Phone
description:
Unroll gets photos off your camera and onto your iPhone or iPad in seconds. No pairing, no account, no cloud.

PLUG IN, PHOTOS APPEAR
• Connect your camera with a USB-C data cable, open an SD card in a card reader, or join a Ricoh GR III / IIIx over Wi-Fi (beta).
• Your newest shots show up first, and thumbnails load as you scroll, so even a full card opens fast.
• No Bluetooth pairing and no sign-in. Unroll asks for a permission only when a feature needs it.

IMPORT ONLY WHAT YOU WANT
• Filter by the star ratings and protect flags you set on the camera, then import them in one tap.
• JPG + RAW pairs land in Photos as a single photo. RAW-only files work too: RAF, ARW, NEF, CR2, CR3, DNG, ORF, RW2, PEF and more.
• Originals are copied byte for byte. Unroll never edits or deletes anything on your card.
• The import ledger remembers what you already brought in, so "Import new" never makes duplicates.

FILM RECIPES, DECODED
• See the full film recipe behind every Fujifilm shot: film simulation, grain, color chrome, white balance and shift, dynamic range, highlight and shadow, color, noise reduction and clarity.
• Also reads Nikon Picture Control and Sony Creative Style.
• Recipe Book collects every recipe you shoot and shares it as a clean card.

LOCATION THAT'S RIGHT
• Photo Walk logs a light GPS route on your phone, so imported photos get the right place without camera Bluetooth.
• No walk? Unroll can borrow the location of iPhone photos taken within 20 minutes.
• Clock Sync fixes a camera clock that's off: photograph a QR code on your phone once and every later import is corrected.

READY TO POST
• Frame Studio: six frame styles with EXIF captions, four aspect ratios, full-resolution export.
• Recap card: a 9:16 story card with your route map and the looks you shot.

FREE AND PRO
Free: browse whole cards, read EXIF and recipes, use three frame styles, and import 10 photos a day.
Unroll Pro removes the daily limit and the small watermark, unlocks every frame style, auto-imports your starred and protected picks when a camera connects, and adds locations automatically.
Pro is available as a weekly, monthly or yearly subscription (the yearly plan starts with a 7-day free trial for new subscribers) or as a one-time Founder Lifetime purchase.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://unroll.uranashel.com/en/terms
Privacy Policy: https://unroll.uranashel.com/en/privacy

Works with cameras that offer USB PTP/MTP or mass-storage mode. Camera brand names are trademarks of their owners; Unroll is not affiliated with or endorsed by them.

name: Up Yours: Sweary Mindfulness
description:
Mindfulness for people who hate mindfulness.

How you doing, darling? Good day, rubbish day, whatever. Tell me straight.

Up Yours is for anyone who rolls their eyes at the usual stuff. No soft-spoken guru, no beige app full of stock photos, no "just let it go". You get a warm, sweary mate in your ear who gets it, makes you laugh, then gets you up and doing something that actually helps.

LIVE PIANO, MADE FOR THIS
Every note you hear is original piano, improvised and played by Julien Lee, a London pianist. No looped elevator music. Real hands on real keys, there to slow your breathing and sit with you.

A LITTLE PAPER THEATRE
This is not another bland mindfulness app. Every screen is a hand-made stage: William Morris wallpapers, skies painted in the spirit of Van Gogh, stained-glass lotuses that bloom, hot-air balloons, paper clouds, a glass sun you can poke. It's colourful, a bit daft, and made with real love for art.

CHECK IN WITH YOUR MOOD
Pop a balloon for how you're doing: Bravo, Alright, Kinda rubbish, or Properly rubbish. Then pick what it really feels like: fuming, anxious, lonely, flat, buzzing, grateful, the lot.

THEN ACTUALLY DO SOMETHING
This is mindfulness you do, not just listen to. Every feeling gets its own little show of short activities: breathe it out, shake it off, rant it out, a lazy body scan, three tiny wins, doodle nonsense, send a mate one dumb meme. Most take a couple of minutes. The idea isn't to force yourself happy. It's to reach for the next feeling up.

A MATE IN YOUR EAR
Every activity is talked through by a real human voice: honest, funny, a bit rude, and always on your side. Pick a little companion to ride along in your balloon, too. (Prefer quiet? Mute the voice and keep the piano.)

SCRIBBLE IT DOWN
After an activity, scribble a few words in your journal if you fancy it. Your scribbles stay on your phone. No accounts, no tracking, nothing collected. Ever.

REALLY NOT OK?
One tap takes you to free helplines with real humans, 24/7. Up Yours is a pick-me-up, not a replacement for proper help.

Contains strong language. Made with love, piano and paper in London.

name: Uriune
description: Uriune turns your expected last frost date and a few seed-packet timings into a clear indoor growing schedule. Save each crop's variety, tray setup, seed quantity, notes, and current stage, then move it forward as germination and hardening-off progress.

name: UTUVO AI Hub
description:
把常用的AI工具排成一個好找、好按的啟動台。打開AI Hub就能看到最愛，點一下鍵帽開啟支援直接開啟的工具。

• 將常用工具加到首頁最愛。
• 以橫滑網格或清單瀏覽工具，跟隨系統深淺色。
• 加入自己的工具連結，或設定Apple「捷徑」開啟已安裝的App。
• 工具無法直接開啟時，選擇捷徑、App Store或網頁備用入口，實際選項依工具而異。

收藏與設定儲存在裝置上。AI Hub是工具啟動台，個別AI服務由各自的App或網站提供。

name: Vadual Sun
description: Choose a location and date to see the Sun’s daily rhythm. Tap or drag the timeline to read the time, solar elevation and azimuth. View astronomical events in order, explore golden and blue hours, and save favourite places. For iPhone and iPad, with light and dark themes.

name: Valucard
description:
SCAN
- Take a photo or choose one from your library. The card's name and number are read on your device.
- If the match isn't certain, pick the right card from a short list of candidates, or search by name or number.
- Bulk mode: scan cards one after another, review the list, then add them all at once.
- Graded slabs: reads the grading company, grade and certificate number from the label and shows a grade badge. Prices shown for slabs are ungraded (raw) market prices.
- English and Japanese editions.
- Supports cards from Pokémon, Magic: The Gathering and Yu-Gi-Oh!

PRICES
- Market price for each card, with the source and the time it was last updated.
- Separate prices for normal, holofoil and reverse holofoil versions.
- Price history chart: 7D, 30D, 90D, 1Y and All. History builds up from the day each card's price was first recorded.
- Japanese-edition prices come from the European market and are converted to your currency.
- Show prices in USD, EUR, GBP, CAD, AUD or JPY.
- Search links to marketplaces to buy or sell a card.

FREE FEATURES
- 5 free scans every day. The count resets daily.
- Unlimited collection: quantity, condition, purchase price and date, notes.
- Profit and loss for each card and for your whole collection.
- Collection value chart for the past week.
- Folders to organize your cards.
- Wishlist with current prices.
- Set progress: see how many cards of a set you own and which numbers are missing.
- Filter by rarity, language and set; sort by name, number, price or date added.
- Trade analyzer: compare the value of both sides of a trade.
- Centering check: measure a card's left-right and top-bottom borders.
- Import a CSV file from another collection app.
- Back up your collection to a file and restore it on another device.
- Your collection and last-seen prices stay on your device and open offline.
- Light and dark themes.
- No account or sign-in.

VALUCARD PRO (IN-APP PURCHASE)
- Unlimited scans, including bulk scanning.
- Collection value chart for 1M, 3M, 1Y and All.
- Price alerts: set a target price for a card and get an in-app alert when you open the app.
- Export your collection to CSV.

Valucard Pro is an auto-renewing subscription, available weekly or yearly. The yearly plan includes a 3-day free trial.

Valucard is an independent app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by any card game publisher. Card names and game titles are trademarks of their respective owners.

Privacy Policy: https://slowmind.kr/legal/valucard/privacy
Contact: contact@slowmind.kr

name: ValveLashSet
description: Venttiilivälys, nokka-akselin nosto, jousi ja työntötanko samassa laskurissa. Saat lämpölaajenemisen ja asennusmomentin tarkistuksen.

name: Verserly
description:
Verserly is a home for your Bible study group.

STUDY TOGETHER
• Schedule study sessions with a Zoom, Google Meet or Teams link, and everyone gets a reminder
• Talk through each passage in its own discussion thread
• Share prayer requests and let people know you’re praying
• Keep shared group notes: session outlines, takeaways and questions for next week
• Share highlights and notes from your reading

A STUDY COMPANION THAT STAYS WITH THE TEXT
• Select any verse and ask for an explanation, historical context, related passages or a simpler wording
• Every reference and quotation in an answer is checked against the Bible text, and anything that can’t be verified is flagged
• Where Christians read a passage differently, it says so

LETTERS: WRITING ROOTED IN SCRIPTURE
• Read short Christian articles, each tied to the passages it’s about
• Find letters on the chapter you’re reading, and follow writers you trust
• Write your own: every quotation is checked against the Bible text before you publish

A CALM READER
• Search by reference, by word, or by topic: find verses about fear, hope, grief or forgiveness
• Public-domain translations, free, with no ads
• Highlights, bookmarks and notes that sync between iPhone, iPad and the web
• Audio Bible, reading streaks, adjustable text and a dark theme
• Read without an account; sign in to save and sync

SAFE BY DESIGN
Groups are private to their members. Everyone agrees to our community guidelines, and you can report or block anyone in one tap. Letters reach Discover only after a staff review.

Free to read and join groups. Premium adds more companion answers and spoken explanations; Organizer lets you lead groups and schedule sessions. Plans are available at verserly.com.

name: Vertea Camera
description:
Vertea Camera turns an iPhone or iPad into a remote camera for Vertea Analyst, the volleyball analysis software for Mac.

How it works:
- On the Mac, in Vertea Analyst, open "Collega Vertea Camera…": a QR code appears.
- Scan the QR code with the phone's camera: Vertea Camera opens and connects by itself. You can also type the address and code.
- The phone turns to landscape and sends its video to the Mac, which uses it in the Live view like any other source.

Made for matches and training:
- three quality levels, Low, Medium and High, up to 1920×1080 at 30 frames per second;
- choose the lens (ultra wide, wide, telephoto) when the phone has them;
- if the network drops or the Mac closes, it retries and resumes by itself;
- the screen stays on and dims while filming to save battery; when the phone gets hot it lowers the quality instead of stopping.

What you need: a Mac running Vertea Analyst, with the phone on the same Wi-Fi network. Vertea Camera records nothing on its own: the video goes only to the Mac, over the local network, never through the internet.

No account, no ads, no data collected.

The app's interface is in Italian.

name: VERYA: Dating & Chat
description:
VERYA matches people by personality, lifestyle and relationship goals, not just photos.

• Personality analysis: 12 short questions about your values, communication style and goals. View, retake or delete anytime.
• Compatibility & common ground: lifestyle, communication, interests and expectations, with clear "why you match" reasons.
• Today's 3 picks: your three most compatible people every day instead of endless swiping.
• Zodiac: your sign is calculated from your birth date and shown on your profile only if you want. Profiles show signs and a just-for-fun "zodiac match" tag.
• Icebreakers and chat coach: first-message ideas and more natural phrasing; never sends messages for you.
• Date ideas, city filter, online now.

name: Vlinder
description:
There is only one Vlinder.

Vlinder is an artwork by Niko Princen: a single butterfly ("vlinder" is Dutch for butterfly) that flies through a network of phones, one device at a time. Join the network, and Vlinder can fly to you. When it lands on your phone, you get a notification, and you can see it in your surroundings, through your phone's camera. Photograph or film it there. After a while it flies on to the next device, on and on, without end.

Every device is like a flower in a field. When Vlinder visits, it drinks the nectar, and while the device waits, the nectar slowly comes back. Vlinder flies to the flower that offers the most nectar for the distance. So it stays in one area for a while, flying from flower to flower, and moves on when the field is empty. A device far away keeps filling up until it is worth the long flight. In time, every device is visited about equally often.

Vlinder sleeps at night: between 22:00 and 07:00 your time, it never comes to you. With devices around the world, it follows the day.
The map shows Vlinder's last 20 stops, and follows it as it flies. The wider the field, the rarer a visit: there is only one Vlinder for everyone.

Vlinder needs two things from your phone: notifications, so it can tell you when it lands, and your approximate location, so it knows where to fly. Without your location it still visits you, but rarely.

Vlinder was first made in 2015 and rebuilt in 2026.

Privacy

• No account, no name, no email address.
• Your location is only used while the app is open, and only roughly: rounded to about 1 km.
• Your photos and videos stay on your phone, unless you share them yourself.
• No advertising, no tracking, no analytics.
• Leaving the network deletes your device from it straight away.

More about the work: nikoprincen.com/works/vlinder

name: VPROKSMM — автопостинг
description:
VPROKSMM ведёт соцсети по расписанию. Вы даёте повод — новость, ссылку на статью или свой текст, — сервис пишет отдельный пост под каждую площадку, делает обложку и публикует в нужное время.

ОДИН ПОВОД — РАЗНЫЕ ТЕКСТЫ

ПРОВЕРКА ПЕРЕД ВЫХОДОМ

АНАЛИТИКА

ПЛОЩАДКИ

name: Walk-Off DJ
description:
EVERY KID GETS A BIG-LEAGUE WALK-UP.

Walk-Off DJ turns whoever's running the music into the stadium PA. Tap the ball and a stadium announcer calls the batter's name and number, then their walk-up song comes in right as the last word lands. No fumbling, no dead air, no robot voice. Just the moment every kid remembers.

BUILT FOR THE DUGOUT
Every screen was designed for one thumb, a loud field and a game that won't wait. The batting order runs across the top: tap any number to jump to that batter, then tap the ball. On deck and in the hole are always in view, and Next moves the order along. Big buttons, high-contrast scoreboard colors, nothing buried in menus.

A REAL STADIUM ANNOUNCER
• Four pro stadium voices: The Classic, Big Energy, The Pro and Hometown (Announcer Pack)
• Every player's name and number, the way a big-league PA says it
• Spell out tricky names so they're said right
• Ballpark echo on the voice, from off to big
• 200 player names a season, and the count starts over free every year

WALK-UP SONGS THAT HIT THE HOOK
• Pick any song from your Apple Music library, or import an audio file
• The clip editor shows the song's waveform, so every walk-up starts right on the best part
• Set the length and fade of each song, and even out songs that play much louder or quieter than the rest
• Birthday walk-ups: on the big day the announcer opens with "Happy birthday!"
• Pitcher entrance songs play the moment you bring a pitcher in

YOUR LINEUP IN SECONDS
• Import the GameChanger lineup PDF, a screenshot or photo, or a pasted list
• Drag to reorder, swipe to bench, tap to edit
• Subs and pitching changes take two taps

A ONE-TAP PREGAME SHOW (Pro)
Warm-up mix on repeat, the national anthem, the visitors' lineup, your starting lineup, then Play Ball. Tap each part when the field is ready.

ANNOUNCE THE VISITORS (Pro)
Save the teams in your league, and the announcer calls the other team's batters too, without walk-up music.

A SOUND FOR EVERY MOMENT
Home Run, Base Hit, Rally, Charge!, Walk-Off and Inning Break while you're at bat. Strike-Out, Foul Ball, Double Play, Great Play, Mound Visit and Pitching Change in the field. The Sounds Pack adds 32 ballpark sounds: organ riffs and the full "Take Me Out" chorus, crowd cheers and rally claps, glass break, air horn, cannon and fireworks. Pro includes a starter set of 6.

YOUR TEAM, YOUR LOOK
Pick your team colors and one of nine jersey lettering styles, from Script and Old English to Varsity and Full Block. Every screen wears them.

WALK-UP CARDS
Add a player's photo and share a pro-style walk-up card to Instagram, Facebook, TikTok or the team group chat. Photos never leave your iPhone unless you share them.

READY FOR GAME DAY
• Clean mode is on from the start: the clean version of explicit songs plays, or the song is skipped when there isn't one
• Speaker check: if your Bluetooth speaker drops mid-song, the music stops instead of blasting from your phone
• Songs downloaded to your iPhone and announcer clips play with no signal

FREE TO START. YOURS TO KEEP.
Start free with up to 4 players. Every upgrade is a one-time purchase, never a subscription:
• Walk-Off DJ Pro: your whole roster and more teams, recorded intros, the pregame show, visiting teams, sending your setup to another parent, and 6 starter sounds

코스 안내와 자유 주행
예전에 달린 코스를 골라 출발하면 남은 거리와 예상 시간을 알려 줘요. 코스 없이 자유롭게 달려도 거리와 시간이 기록되고, 중간에 코스를 취소하고 자유 주행으로 바꿀 수도 있어요.

내 기록은 내 아이폰에

이용 안내
자전거 대여와 반납, 이용권 결제는 각 운영 기관의 공식 앱에서 해요. 위고에서 "대여하러 가기"를 누르면 공식 앱으로 이동해요.
정류장 정보는 서울 열린데이터광장의 공공데이터를 바탕으로 하며, 실제와 다를 수 있어요.
위고는 서울특별시와 공공자전거 운영 기관이 만든 앱이 아니며, 제휴 관계가 없어요.

name: Whistlepost: Railroad Milepost
description:
Which railroad is this? What subdivision? What milepost am I at?

Whistlepost answers from where you stand. Open it next to any track in the United States, or tap a line on the map, and it reads out the railroad, the subdivision and the milepost.

Whistlepost is an independent app. It is not affiliated with any railroad or with the Federal Railroad Administration.

At a crossing
Each public and private crossing in the federal inventory is in the app, more than 240,000 of them. For every one you get the DOT crossing number, the railroad's emergency line, through trains by day and by night, switching moves, passenger trains, top timetable speed, main tracks, gates, lights and bells, and whether it sits in a quiet zone. If the gates are stuck or a vehicle is on the tracks, the red button calls the emergency number the railroad lists for that crossing and shows the DOT number the dispatcher will ask for. When no number is listed it says so. In any emergency, call 911 as well.

Along the line
Open a subdivision and see it end to end, every crossing in milepost order with its trains a day. Type a milepost and land on it. Measure rail miles between two crossings. Search by the number on the blue sign, by street or by city.

On the map
Track is drawn by owner, main lines apart from yards, sidings and industrial spurs, with abandoned lines dashed. Layers colour the crossings by how many trains they see a day, or show where horns stay silent.

Your spots
Save the places you want to come back to, add your own notes about light and parking, and export them as GPX for your other maps.

Without a signal
Track, crossings and mileposts are stored in the app, so the reading works in the canyon and on the prairie. Only the background map needs a connection.

Who it is for
Railfans planning a day trackside, crews and contractors looking for a milepost or a crossing, and anyone who lives near a line and wants to know what runs on it.

What is free and what is Pro
Finding the railroad, subdivision and milepost, the map, every crossing record, search and the emergency number cost nothing. Whistlepost Pro adds complete subdivision profiles, the milepost jump and measuring, the traffic and quiet zone layers, unlimited spots and GPX export. Pro is a one-time purchase, or a yearly or monthly subscription that renews until cancelled.

About the data
Crossings come from the Federal Railroad Administration crossing inventory and track from the FRA North American Rail Network, both public. Mileposts between crossings are estimates worked out from the inventory. Records can be out of date; the railroad's own timetable always wins.

Stay off railroad property. Watch trains from public places.

Your location is used on your iPhone only and is not sent to us.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://whistlepost.baltajmn.dev/privacy/

name: Wholeset
description:
Wholeset is a strength training log built for Apple Watch. Leave your iPhone in the locker: start today's routine on your wrist, log each set with the Digital Crown, rest, and finish. The workout is saved to Apple Health, so it appears in Fitness and counts toward your Activity rings.

ON APPLE WATCH
- Today's routine from your weekly plan, one tap to start
- Each set is filled in from last time; adjust weight or reps with the Digital Crown and log it with one tap
- A suggestion to add weight or reps once you reach the top of your rep range
- A rest timer that taps your wrist when it ends, even with the screen off
- Swap, add, skip or reorder exercises during a workout, then update the routine if you like
- Live heart rate, active energy and volume, with pause and resume
- Music controls for whatever is playing on your Watch or iPhone
- A summary with duration, volume, heart rate and any records you set
- Works without your iPhone nearby, and restores a workout if the app is interrupted

ON IPHONE
- Routines with target sets, rep ranges, rest times and alternative exercises
- A weekly plan that tells your Watch what to train each day
- About 150 built-in exercises, plus your own
- Your full history with no time limit; edit or delete past sets and workouts
- Records for every exercise (heaviest weight, best estimated 1RM, most reps at a weight, best session volume) and charts of your progress
- Import your history from Hevy, Strong and FitNotes exports; Fitbod, StrongLifts and Liftosaur in beta; other CSV files by choosing the columns
- Kilograms or pounds

NO LIMITS, NO ACCOUNT
There is no cap on routines, exercises or history. There is no account to create: your data stays on your devices and syncs through your own iCloud account. Wholeset collects no data and has no ads and no tracking.

Wholeset is open source under the GNU GPL.

name: Winemaker AI
description:
Winemaker AI is a cellar assistant for winemakers. Ask it about any lot, tell it what just happened, and it keeps the vintage record, works out the additions and writes the work orders, from your phone, right there in the cellar.

Ask about your cellar
Type or talk: "What's happening with the Tannat?", "What's due today?", "How much SO₂ for 200 gallons at 40 ppm?" Every answer says where it came from: your own records, your protocol, your documents or the reference library.

Hands-free in the cellar
Tap the mic and talk. Winemaker AI answers out loud and keeps listening, so you can log a Brix reading, ask for a dose or check a work order without putting the hose down.

Nothing changes until you approve
When Winemaker AI proposes a reading, an addition, a lab result or a work order, it shows you a card to check, edit and approve. Nothing is saved without you.

Every ferment at a glance
Home shows what's fermenting, the fruit received, the volume in production and the lots that need a look. Each lot's Brix and temperature curve flags stalls and slow ferments early.

Additions, worked out
Enter the fruit at intake and get yeast, Go-Ferm, nutrient, SO₂ and water additions from your lot size and your own rates, with the math shown. The numbers come from fixed formulas, not from an AI guessing.

Work orders for your crew
Every addition becomes a work order that says what to do and why. Move it from To do to Completed, and send your crew a link that opens without an account.

Lab results
Log pH, TA, VA, free and total SO₂, YAN, malic acid and alcohol, follow the trend for each lot, or photograph a lab report and let Winemaker AI read the values for you to check.

Your winery, your protocols
Add your SOPs and protocol sheets. Winemaker AI answers from how you make wine and tells your practice apart from general guidance.

Works in US units (tons, gallons, °F) or metric.

Winemaker AI accounts are set up for wineries. During early access, sign up with the access code from your invitation.

Winemaker AI supports qualified winemakers: check every suggestion before anything goes into a wine.

description:

From Winslow Homes Publishing. Built by a Florida certified general contractor.

THE FULL YEAR

- 183 word-for-word scripts for homeowners, leads, subs, crews, suppliers and inspectors

EVERY STATE
All 50 states and Washington DC. Your state guide covers contractor licensing, insurance and bonds, home improvement contract rules, lien deadlines and sales tax on construction.

TOOLS
- Daily tracker for leads, site visits, estimates, jobs sold and reviews
